TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_000: Man is wont to cast light wheresoever secrets lie hid in darkness─though that which he illuminateth seldom bringeth him joy. So it is with such unhappy truths as Bahamut's immense shadow doth conceal.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_001: Yet ever onward forgeth Mistress Alisaie, undeterred by the burden of knowledge that weigheth heavy on her heart. 'Tis a perilous path she hath chosen, and a painful one. I prithee, , remain by her side as her valiant blade, that she might see her quest to its conclusion.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_002: ─it is well that you are here.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_003: My lady. How might I serve you this day?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_004: I have met with some difficulty in my mission, Urianger, and I should be grateful for your counsel.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_005: As you know, Bahamut's physical form is regenerating beneath the Carteneau Flats even as we speak.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_006: If we are to prevent his return, we must needs disable the two remaining internment hulks that sustain him.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_007: Every moment our mission is delayed, the realm is pushed closer to the brink of destruction.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_008: Alas, though I have determined the locations of the fragments of Dalamud leading to the hulks, I have been unable to find a way to enter them.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_009: ...And gaining admittance is but the first step in your perilous undertaking.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_010: When last thou descended into Bahamut's subterranean fastness, thou didst discover, didst thou not, that the dread primal had bound the shade of Nael van Darnus unto his will.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_011: And though thou didst consign the fallen legatus to blessed oblivion, thou mayest recall that the piteous wretch was not alone. Doubt not but that Bahamut's other thralls shall seek to hinder thy passage.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_012: ...You can say his name, Urianger. I have not forgotten that my grandfather is waiting for us.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_013: My lady. I would remind you, as I must oft remind myself, that the man whom we both loved and revered is no more. What remaineth is but a shade which defileth his memory.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_014: The vile verbiage that spilleth from his lips must not be heeded, for it cometh not from your grandsire, but from Bahamut himself.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_015: You need not worry, Urianger. Come what may, I will not stray from the course.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_016: I will not let Grandfather's sacrifice be in vain!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_017: <sigh> But mere words will not take us whither we must go. As I said, I have been unable to find a way to enter the fragments of Dalamud...
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_018: My lady, might I suggest that you visit the fragments again in 's company? Full oft hath the Warrior of Light set events in motion by virtue of  presence alone. 'Tis possible that  may do so again.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_019: I, the while, shall search for answers of mine own. By our efforts combined, full sure am I that the path shall be revealed to us ere long.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_020: ...Were it anyone else, I should question the wisdom of such advice. Yet I cannot deny that what you say about  is true... Very well, I shall do as you suggest.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_021: ...Assuming you have no objections, of course? Good. Now, we seek entry to two fragments of Dalamud. One lies at the Burning Wall in eastern Thanalan, and the other at the Singing Shards in Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_022: I left an assistant at each location with instructions to continue searching for a means of ingress. It is not impossible that they could since have found something useful to us. Let us begin by visiting my man at the Burning Wall. Deks, I think it was.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_INVESTIGATORA00043_: I say, are you not  , my lady's most faithful companion? Sinis, , at your service! And may I say what an honor it is to meet you!
Ahem. My lady! It shames me to say that I have found no viable path to the fragment.
Though it stands there, before our very eyes, the way thither has thus far proven impassable.
When the fragment fell and pierced the land, it caused a prodigious amount of aether to spew forth.
'Twas this that gave rise to the land's twisted lay, which seems destined to thwart our efforts.
Even were an opening to exist, I fear that we would struggle to reach it.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_037: We cannot give up. Keep trying.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_038: So near and yet so far... Well, it avails us naught to stand here and stare at the thing. Let us away to Mor Dhona, and try the other fragment. Perhaps Sinis has fared better.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_INVESTIGATORA00043_: Ah! U-Upon that note, my lady, there is something I must tell you. I am sorry to report that I lost contact with my brother just over a bell ago...
A-As you know, the Singing Shards are home to many fell creatures, ogres among them... While I do not wish to cause you undue alarm, I fear something unspeakable may have happened to Deks.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_041: What!? Why didn't you─!? Give me strength!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_042: We must hurry to my assistant's aid, .
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_INVESTIGATORA00043_: The Singing Shards are home to a host of fell creatures, ogres among them... If it would not be too much trouble, I should be most grateful if you would find my brother and keep my lady safe.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_INVESTIGATORB00043_: Thank you, adventurer! For a moment there, I feared that my bones were to be ground up and used to bake bread!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_061: I am relieved to see that you are unharmed. It was wrong of me to press such a dangerous task upon you.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_INVESTIGATORB00043_: M-M-My lady! Your worries are wasted on me! 'Twas nothing at all, I assure you!
Ahem! If it please you, I shall report on my findings.
As you can see, though the tip of the fragment is exposed, the rest is encased in rock and crystal, rendering it impossible to enter the structure.
We might try excavating the area around the fragment, but that is like to take time─and there really is no telling how deep we may need to dig before we find a suitable point of ingress.
As such, I am forced to conclude that gaining entry to this fragment is unrealistic. Forgive me, my lady.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_067: Confound it... We are losing precious time. What are we to do now?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_068: 'Tis I, Urianger. Glad tidings have I for thee and my lady.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_069: For a blessing, a way hath been found by which thou mayest enter the remaining fragments of Dalamud.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_070: Pray escort Mistress Alisaie to the Ceruleum Processing Plant in northern Thanalan. There, all shall be made clear.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_072: Then we must go to him at once!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_INVESTIGATORB00043_: You needn't linger on my account. Should Master Urianger's method prove viable, rest assured I shall put many malms between myself and this place.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_090: Mine apologies for summoning you thus from afar, my lady, but 'tis here that your journey may finally begin.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_091: I did wonder. To my knowledge, there are no fragments in northern Thanalan.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_092: Nor are you mistaken, my lady. Yet a pathway doth exist─one which you yourself have made use of in the past.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_093: At the conclusion of your several forays into the Binding Coil, 'twas at the crystal formation which lieth to the north of this place that you did emerge, was it not?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_094: Yes. An aetherial stream bore us back to the surface─that much I had surmised. Are you suggesting that we can use it to return underground?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_095: And even if that were possible, would it not simply bear us back to those places which we have already explored?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_096: It need not, my lady. Pray allow me to explain. Upon the evidence of your experience, it seemeth plain that two internment hulks may share the selfsame aetherial egress. From this, we did infer that others may be connected in like wise. Thus did we labor long to verify the existence of further tributaries to the selfsame stream─in which task we were at length successful. 'Twas then but a matter of arriving at a solution to the problem of traveling to an unattuned destination...
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_097: That one might reach what we may call the headwater, we propose to employ a modified aetheryte which serveth to amplify such ripples as do originate from said source. By focusing one's essence upon these ripples, it should be possible to make the journey. Yet be fairly warned, my lady: as with all untried modes of aetherial travel, this method entaileth considerable danger. Merely to attempt the voyage could cost you your life.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_098: That is a risk I am willing to take! You are brilliant, Urianger!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_099: But I am curious... Did you have assistance in forming this plan? I could not help noticing your repeated use of the word “we”─unless you have taken to using the majestic plural in our absence?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_100: ...Ah. Ahem. Nay, my lady. As you have correctly surmised...I was not alone in this endeavor.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_101: ...Meaning there are others who are aware of our mission.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_102: Well, it cannot be helped now. Preventing Bahamut's return is what matters. If some secrecy must be sacrificed to achieve our goal, then so be it.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_110: Verily, 'twas not my wish to withhold knowledge of the aid I received... I pray that Mistress Alisaie will forgive me when she learneth of its source...
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_120: So that must be the modified aetheryte. But what are the Immortal Flames doing here...?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_121: (-???-)Those men may be sworn Flames of Ul'dah, but they are first and foremost faithful retainers of House Leveilleur.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_122: Alphinaud!? So it was you who was helping Urianger!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_123: Who else could it have been, dear sister?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_124: Lest you worry, I have no intention of making the details of your venture public. Like you, I would prefer to avoid causing a panic.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_125: But given that which is at stake─namely, the survival of the realm─one must be willing to accept help when it is offered. Would you not agree?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_126: At the very least, do not be cross with Urianger─'twas at my behest that he kept silent.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_128: Pray forgive me, my lady, but knowing full well your intent, I judged it meet that Master Alphinaud be informed.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_URIANGER_000_129: Though your grandsire hath become Bahamut's thrall, his noble blood courseth yet through both your veins, and if he must needs be struck down─
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_130: Do you hear that, Alphinaud? I mean to strike down Grandfather! And when I have done so, I shall banish Bahamut to the aether!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_131: Nothing you say will sway me from my course! I will protect Eorzea, and I will uphold Grandfather's legacy!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_132: Grandfather's legacy...? So you still do not know what you yourself desire. Your actions are still driven by borrowed resolve.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_133: Borrowed resolve!? What does that have to do with anything!?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_134: Protecting Eorzea was Grandfather's goal, and we made it ours─both of us! That is why we came here, unless you have forgotten!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_135: Gods forbid I should ever forget, Alisaie. But you misunderstand. I do not question your resolve, only whence it came. If it were your own, you would be able to tell me precisely why you desire so fervently to protect Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_136: Yet you cannot, for it is not your resolve, but Grandfather's. You may struggle to see the difference, but borrowed resolve shall never be as strong as that which springs from within.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_137: ...But let us speak of this another time. For now, preventing Bahamut's return is all that matters.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_138: To be plain, I have no objection to striking down whatever is left of Grandfather. Know, however, that I will be accompanying you this time. As a son of House Leveilleur, I would be present for his final moments.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_139: ...Very well. You may join us...on one condition: I make the decisions.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ERKENRAD_000_140: If it please milady, the name's Erkenrad. Our preparations are just about complete.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ERKENRAD_000_141: When you're ready to embark on your mission, just give me the word. I'll be waiting for you at the Ceruleum Processing Plant.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_142: Pay no heed to my brother. You can rely on me. We have come far together, you and I, and together we shall see our journey to its end.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ERKENRAD_000_150: I've been waiting for you,  . I'm pleased to say that the aetheryte's primed and ready.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ERKENRAD_000_151: As you know, the remaining internment hulks are connected to the fragments in eastern Thanalan and Mor Dhona. It's to the former that we'll be sending you first.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ERKENRAD_000_152: Now, you'll be starting inside the hulk, meaning you won't have to cover so much ground─the drawback being that you'll be fighting for your life from the moment you get there. Best be prepared for anything, for milady's sake if not your own.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ERKENRAD_000_153: And that's about all I can tell you. When your preparations are in order, just give me the word, and I'll send you on your way. I may even throw in a prayer for your speedy return just to be on the safe side.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_SYSTEM_000_154: You now have access to the Final Coil of Bahamut. The subterranean labyrinth can be accessed by speaking with Erkenrad.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_SYSTEM_000_155: For details such as the conditions of entry, speak with the flame sergeant.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_501: So this is how it looks on the inside...
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_503: The teleportation was a success─we are come to the right place.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_504: There is no telling how much further Bahamut has regenerated since we last beheld him.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_505: Let us make haste to the main bridge and deactivate the coil.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_506: There were receptacles similar to these in the previous hulk.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_507: Those held chimerical beasts, but only the Allagans know what other abominations may be sleeping within.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_508: They may well be part of Dalamud's internal defenses. We must stay on our guard at all times.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_601: By the Twelve... Dragons...and so many...
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_602: We were aware that the Allagans possessed the means to control the creatures, but to imprison them thus is...barbaric. I would not wish such a fate upon my worst enemy.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_603: 'Tis plain that no love was lost between the Allagans and the dragons, but was it truly necessary to keep so great a number here?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_604: Dalamud did not want for defenses, this we have experienced firsthand. Such guardians as the Allagans created─both living and unliving─were surely no less capable of repelling intruders than these poor creatures...
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_606: Have you not managed to determine by whose will Bahamut exists?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_607: No, I have not. At first, I assumed that Bahamut had no people of his own─that the Allagans had perhaps discovered a way to simulate prayer itself.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_608: However, Nael's words gave me cause to reconsider─specifically, the shade's mention of Bahamut's “beloved children.”
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_609: From that, I inferred that the primal is given form by the will of worshipers whom we have yet to─
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_611: Gods strike me down for a blind fool!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_612: Bahamut's beloved children, right there before my very eyes... How could I be so stupid?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_613: Who else but the dragons of eld would summon Bahamut? Who else but they could sustain him? And to think I wondered why the Allagans kept them imprisoned here!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_614: Even should the flame of Bahamut's life go out, his faithful children would summon him back.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_615: For this reason, the Allagan Empire kept an army of dragons here in a perpetual state of duress, that they might sustain the primal's existence.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_616: Truly, the Allagans' ingenuity knew no bounds...and neither did their cruelty.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_617: Small wonder that Bahamut was so enraged! Let no one deny that it was man who sowed the seeds of the Calamity!
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALPHINAUD_000_618: Will you now turn your hatred towards our own kind, dear sister?
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_619: Do not patronize me, Alphinaud. I merely acknowledge our guilt.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_620: Lest you be in any doubt, I have no intention of allowing Bahamut to lay the world to waste, regardless of the atrocities the Allagans committed against his kind. We have no choice but to eliminate all who worship him, be they his children or his thralls.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_621: It seems reasonable to assume that the system responsible for the primal's regeneration is also responsible for sustaining the captive dragons. If we disable it, all should perish. Let us press on.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_703: For millennia, Bahamut must have gazed at this unchanging view.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_704: Trapped inside a prison that was scarcely large enough to contain him, unable to move, denied the release of death... How his hatred for man must have burned.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_705: And that hatred found an ideal vessel in Nael van Darnus.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_706: In many ways, Bahamut is to be pitied, not loathed. But knowing the true extent of his fury, I am more convinced than ever of the necessity of our endeavor.
TEXT_GAIUSD501_00043_ALISAIE_000_707: Besides...his is not the only soul that cries out for vengeance!
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_000: And here we are again. After that descent into darkness, the desolation of northern Thanalan seems paradisal.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_001: As promised, I shan't reveal the truth of the Calamity to a single soul. However, the nations of Eorzea will require certain assurances that the threat of a new primal is gone.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_002: Kept in the dark overlong, 'tis only a matter of time before they seek answers of their own accord. Let us recommend that the fragments of Dalamud are sealed off, that the truth may rest undisturbed.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_003: But first, we must go and report to Urianger. It would not do to keep him in suspense. I daresay we shall find him pacing up and down at the Ceruleum Processing Plant.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALPHINAUD_000_010: In spite of your presence, I must confess that there were moments when I feared the worst. But in the end, you plucked us from the flames and bore us safe unto victory─just as you always have. As for Alisaie...I have never been more proud to call her my sister.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_015: Let us go to the Ceruleum Processing Plant and report to Urianger. It would not do to keep him in suspense.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_URIANGER_000_101: Ah, the Warrior of Light returneth undimmed from the depths of darkness...
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_URIANGER_000_102: By thy triumphant bearing, I take it thou hast succeeded in thy mission. And yet thou art alone... Mistake me not, dear friend─full glad am I of thy safe return─but where, pray, are Master Alphinaud and Mistress Alisaie?
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALPHINAUD_000_103: Here, my friend. Forgive us our lateness─we took the scenic route.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_104: Bahamut is no more. The realm is safe.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_URIANGER_000_105: <gasp> By the heavens! Look at you!
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_URIANGER_000_106: What horrors your young eyes must have seen! What suffering your young bodies must have borne!
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_URIANGER_000_107: Pray tell me─where are you hurt? Your wounds must needs be cleansed and dressed at once! I shall make for you a poultice which draweth out─
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_108: Be at ease, my friend! We are hale and whole, I assure you!
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_109: We took a few tumbles, but the worst of our hurts are healed. I believe we have Grandfather to thank for that.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_URIANGER_000_110: Master Louisoix? ...Then you met with him once more? But wherefore should Bahamut's thrall seek to ease your suffering?
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_111: I promise to reveal all to you in due course, dear friend. But first, there is a matter which requires our immediate attention.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_112: Now that Bahamut is defeated, we deem it best to bar entry to all of the fragments of Dalamud.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_113: To this end, we will convince the nations' leaders that the danger is past, and invite their cooperation in ensuring that the fragments are never again disturbed. Come, let us depart and seek an audience with them forthwith.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALPHINAUD_000_114: A moment, Sister. You need not burden yourself with this task. Urianger and I will more than suffice. Might you not take this opportunity to rest? The gods know you have earned it.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_115: But I am fine, Brother. Besides, you have been through as much as I have.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_116: ...Oh, I see now! You would play your game of diplomacy, and wish me out of the way!
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALPHINAUD_000_117: N-No, I... Naught could be further from the truth, Alisaie.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_URIANGER_000_118: My lady, 'tis mine earnest belief that your brother hath your best interests at heart. You have more than done your part, and he desireth but to relieve you of a burden he might easily bear alone.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALPHINAUD_000_119: I have some experience treating with dignitaries, you must allow. And as you never fail to remind me of my fondness for diplomacy, I feel it only right that I remind you of your aversion to it.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Then it is settled. Urianger─pray make arrangements for a chocobo carriage. The ride should give us ample time to prepare our story.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_123: Though our paths are different, we share the same goal, do we not?
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALPHINAUD_000_124: But of course, dear sister. That which we have just achieved together stands as testament to that fact. Whatever path we choose to take, our hearts shall ever lead us to the same end, of that I am certain.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_126: There is a place that I would visit. Might I ask you to accompany me?
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_127: But first, I do believe a change of garments is in order. It won't take a moment.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_201: The landscape is the same. Of course, there is no reason that it would be otherwise.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_202: Though it would be poetic for the fragments to magically disappear, I am well aware that they shall remain long after you and I are gone.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_203: The world may change irrevocably, but life shall ever go on.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_204: Let us take a closer look, shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_205: I have no doubt that Alphinaud will do an admirable job concealing the truth of the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_206: And such truths as were revealed in those dark depths will never see the light of day.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_207: I myself agreed that it must be so...
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_208: But the thought that the people of Eorzea shall forever remain ignorant of their savior─of your deeds... The injustice of it is almost too much for me to bear.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_209: How typical of you, ... Ever the . Even so, I cannot deny that I feel better for your reassurance...
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_210: But I want you to know that I will never forget. You are the one who freed Grandfather's soul and saved Eorzea from Bahamut's wrath.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_211: And though these great deeds will never be remembered in song, their consequences will be felt forevermore by every soul who calls this realm home.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_213: For Grandfather, Nael, and the dragons of Meracydia... For all those who were taken by the Calamity...
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_214: At long last, our struggle with Bahamut is over...
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_215: The realm, given new life through the prayers and sacrifices of countless souls, may look to a brighter tomorrow.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_216: When the dust of our adventure has settled, I shall embark on a journey.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_217: I mean to find my own reason to fight for Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_218: And when I do, I will fight with all my being.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_219: You have done so much for me, . One day, I hope to be able to repay you in kind.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_220: I have no doubt but that you will continue to help those in need, and grow ever stronger in so doing.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_221: I shall endeavor to do the same. And if the Twelve are kind, I hope one day to become Eorzea's sword in the darkness─as you are.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_222: Come what may, you may rest assured that I will not be outdone by Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_223: When next we meet, I promise that I will not disappoint you.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_ALISAIE_000_224: Till that day, fare you well, my friend. And thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_GAIUSD502_00044_SYSTEM_000_100: You may view the opening cutscene for the Final Coil of Bahamut before accepting this quest.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_000: By thy high deeds were the people of Coerthas spared certain doom at the hands of a deiform entity.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_001: Yet, if the missive we have received from Lord Drillemont of House Durendaire speaketh true, 'twould seem that hard-won respite hath come and gone.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_002: Recovered from her wounds, the Lady Iceheart hath rejoined the struggle against Ishgard. Worse, 'tis said that her disciples have already laid claim to a hoard of crystals...
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_003: ...A hoard far exceeding the quantity but recently wrested from the caravans of House Fortemps. 'Tis all but certain that the heretics' mistress intendeth to call upon Saint Shiva once more.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_005: And so, once more, must Eorzea's blade of Light be brought to bear against a primal. None save thee hath might enough to defeat such a foe. 'Tis for this reason that Lord Drillemont hath requested thy presence at Whitebrim Front. Pray hie thee thither with all haste.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_007: None save thee can deliver Ishgard from Lady Iceheart's vengeance. Pray hasten thee to Whitebrim Front, where Lord Drillemont awaiteth thy coming even now.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_010: My gratitude for your timely return, . Would that it were under better circumstances.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_011: Our efforts to contain the heretic threat in the western highlands beyond Snowcloak have suffered a grievous setback.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_012: In order to support expeditions further afield, we sought to establish an outpost in the heretics' former fortress. Under guard, our craftsmen began the necessary improvements, and for a time all proceeded according to plan.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_014: The building work had scarce begun when Iceheart's minions descended upon the fortress from all directions. If I were to guess, I would say that they deliberately delayed their attack until sufficient supplies had been delivered to their doorstep.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_015: I do not begrudge my men their decision to flee. By all accounts, it would have been a slaughter─any survivors condemned to a fate worse than death at the hands of their leader. However, by abandoning our crystal stores, we have given the heretics the means to summon their patron saint.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_016: I beseech you, ─slayer of the gods of beastmen, who banished once before the demon who threatens us now─lend us your strength! Infiltrate Snowcloak and put an end to Iceheart's machinations!
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_017: Thank you, my friend. Though I pray you can stop her before she completes her ritual, I have faith you can defeat Shiva should it come to that.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_018: One of Ser Aymeric's Temple Knights awaits you at Snowcloak. He shall guide you through secret tunnels to the aetheryte at the heart of the heretics' fortifications, whence you may gain entrance to Iceheart's sanctuary as before.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_020: Much hinges on your efforts, . If Iceheart is allowed to summon Shiva, the lives of countless Ishgardians will be in danger.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_TEMPLER00075_000_03: It is an honor, . When you are ready, I shall lead you through the tunnels to the aetheryte. We should not be troubled by heretics or beasts along the way, so you may concentrate solely on the task at hand.
May the Fury grant you the strength to strike down that heathen witch once and for all.
We will depart when you are ready, . You need but speak the word.
You've returned! The deed is done, I take it? Lord Drillemont will want to hear the tale in full.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_040: Praise Halone for your safe return! All here prayed for your success, . Tell us: have our prayers been answered?
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_041: Even stronger than before, you say? Then we are truly fortunate for your intervention.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_042: Yet it would be wrong to glory in this victory, for it is yours, not ours. Indeed, your very presence here is a testament to the inadequacy of our own preparations. Plainly, it is time that we reappraised the threat posed by the heretics, and our readiness to address it. I can no longer say with any certainty that we are equal to the task... But this is none of your concern. Forgive me.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_043: Your deeds shall not be forgotten, my friend. You, Urianger, and your entire order have my utmost thanks.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_DRILLEMONT_000_044: Pray convey our gratitude to Urianger and the rest of your brethren. Were it not for your aid, I know not how many others would have perished.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_055: 'Tis not the first time I have seen thee stride into the Waking Sands wearing such a look. Thou art as an open book, , wherein the tale of thy victory is writ large.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_056: ...In her redoubled strength I glimpse the dark hand of the Paragons. Her return, and her very defeat, serveth merely to continue the escalating cycle of conflict.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_057: Full glad am I of thine all-surpassing martial skills, , yet still more glad would I be were they not required.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_058: <sigh> Would that the Lady Iceheart could be made to abandon her misbegotten crusade... Till she be thus converted, or else slain, the people of Ishgard will know no peace.
TEXT_GAIUSD020_00090_URIANGER_000_059: ...But be not disheartened. One day, by thy light, the darkness within and without shall be purged, and the Ascians shall taste lasting defeat. We need only have faith.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_SCARLET_000_000: ! Your timing never fails to amaze. Unless I am mistaken, you have knowledge of the elder primal Odin, correct?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_SCARLET_000_001: As I thought. Well, as you know, we have long pursued the Dark Divinity, from the pages of arcane scripture to the Shroud itself. Finally, we have a plan to put his prowling to an end. Brother O-App-Pesi has the command.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_SCARLET_000_002: He has personally requested your aid in this venture, and awaits you at Urth's Fount. I am sure he will give you the details once you present yourself. Godsspeed, .
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_SCARLET_000_003: Brother O-App-Pesi has established his command in Urth's Fount, from where to bring down the Dark Rider. Attend him there to learn of his plans.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_010: Adventurer, thank you for coming. We seek the Dark Divinity, and you must be made privy to the plan before the game is afoot.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_011: As you know, Odin hunts in this forest. We would banish him from the Shroud. Yet in actual fact, he has fallen before countless adventurers already. By all rights, the primal should plague us no more.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_012: Yet, though again and again he is vanquished, he rises always to charge through the Twelveswood. His constant reappearance is perplexing to say the least, and raises two questions: who summons him, and how does he change his visage upon manifesting?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_013: Odin is alone amongst the primals in these aspects. Indeed, I can find not a single sentence in the scriptures that sheds light on his devilish abilities.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_014: There is no answer in words writ of the pen. Now, the sword must serve. Our plan is to send a band of adventurers against the Dark Divinity. Brother E-Sumi-Yan, my master, and I will observe the battle from afar.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_015: We believe seeing the moment of Odin's defeat may give us a clue, one that will lead to uncovering the truth of the primal that has escaped us thus far.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_016: Naturally, this hinges upon the company's victory. No one but a Warrior of Light could hope to survive the battle. Hence, I have asked you here.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_017: Indeed, without you, our venture is doomed to failure. So I implore you: lend us your strength! If you acquiesce, I shall invoke the power of the elementals, and draw the Dark Divinity to this spring.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_018: At your word, I will invoke the elementals to draw Odin to this spring. Pray enter as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_020: Your bravery before the Dark Divinity was commendable, adventurer. I am relieved you escaped the battle with your life!
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_100_020: And it was not for nothing, I might add. Brother E-Sumi-Yan and I have observed something remarkable...though I should like to discuss it with him present. Ah, and see how he comes.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYAN_000_021: ! I am honored to have seen you fight. Why, I can scarcely wait to tell Sylphie how a Warrior of Light overcame the terror of the Shroud! No doubt the girl will smile to hear of your valor.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYAN_000_022: That was a splendid show of force, ! Truly, people are right to call you a Warrior of Light.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYAN_000_023: Adventurer, I would offer you thanks for all you have done today. I am E-Sumi-Yan, master of the Conjurers' Guild.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYANI_000_024: Ah, but no doubt you are keen to learn more of the Dark Divinity. Very well. I shall share with you what I have gleaned in observing your battle.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYANI_100_024: To begin, felling a primal allows the aether of their physical manifestation to return to the land─this much you know, yes?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_025: Odin seems to be subject to the selfsame laws. Yet his sword, the Zantetsuken, remains even after his body vanishes. Thus, we thought to examine the blade, and in so doing, found that its aetheric density is unimaginably high!
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYANI_000_026: Now, we had always assumed the being who brandished the weapon was Odin. But what if we erred? What if the sword Zantetsuken is, in and of itself, the Dark Divinity? An unforeseen conclusion, yes, but one that clarifies much of the primal.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_027: Indeed, that would explain why Odin has never truly fallen─no one has thought to destroy the blade. And if the Zantetsuken is the primal, could it not conjure itself a new wielder?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYANI_000_028: Yet, just as Ifrit's tempered or Leviathan's drowned, Odin must needs have his “sundered” to offer crystals in his name─unless he drinks of the Shroud's aether. Such a weak source of power could be why it takes time for the Dark Divinity to manifest again.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_029: You see, adventurer, our theory accounts quite nicely for two of the mysteries that for so long surrounded the primal.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYANI_000_030: And yet, as O-App-Pesi hints, a third mystery remains: if there are no sundered, how does Odin sustain himself? I cannot imagine the wishes of those who first summoned him were so strong as to echo throughout the centuries.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_031: Brother, I do not think our theory is flawed. No, this discovery makes clear the holes in what we had for so long believed of the primals. We must revisit the beings with a keener eye.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_032: I will inform Master Urianger of what we have gleaned here. Adventurer, I urge you to do the same should something else of Odin occur to you.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_033: But today is a victory, all the same. We have the Zantetsuken, and the mysteries that remain pale in import to the act of locking the primal away. With any luck, we can seal the sword and end the Dark Divinity's ride.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_LEWIN_000_034: The Zantetsuken is gone! One of my own men has stolen away with the blade, and left nary a trace to track his flight. I never dreamt he would do such a thing, and I stayed my hand too long to stop him...
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_035: What!? Are your men so disloyal as to rob you!? Tell me, Lewin, why would someone do such a thing!?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_LEWIN_000_036: Forgive me, Brother, but I cannot say. I am as astonished as you. The thief was a sworn man of Gods' Quiver, true as any Gridanian arrow. Moreover, what could he stand to gain by stealing so fell a blade?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYANI_000_037: Mayhap the soul of the thief was stolen along with the blade. It is within the power of all primals to bend mortals to their wills. If the Zantetsuken and Odin are one and the same, then the sword may control the now-sundered man. Is that not right, Brother?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_038: That...that is indeed possible. Gods, could I have been so blind as that?
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_100_038: Bowlord Lewin, it is I who needs apologize. Had I been more wary, I would have foreseen this. Instead, I have cost us dearly, and placed you and your men in great danger...
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_ESUMIYANI_000_039: Let us not cry over lost swords. Bowlord Lewin, send forth the Gods' Quiver and Wood Wailers to scour the Shroud. Brother O-App-Pesi and I will devote ourselves to devising a way to fell Odin after the Zantetsuken is ours again.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_000_040: ...Yes, Brother. Indeed, it would be a poor thing to have the blade in our grasp, and no way to destroy it nor dull its bite.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_OAPPPESI_100_040: Adventurer, I will call upon you again when we have something to show for our efforts. Until then, go in peace.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_SCARLET_000_041: Word of your battle with Odin has traveled quickly. Toppling the Dark Divinity is no small feat, after all.
TEXT_SUBCTS902_00433_SCARLET_000_042: Needless to say, Brother O-App-Pesi will wish to discuss your victory. Pray report to him in Urth's Fount with all due haste.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_000: Ah, , it is good you are come. I have news you must be made aware of.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_001: Alas, none of it bodes well for us, nor for Unei, Doga, and Nero imprisoned in the dark realm.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_002: Think back upon our last foray into Syrcus Tower, if you will. The Calamity stirred the place from its long slumber and awoke Emperor Xande. But you, , you ensured he was laid to rest permanently.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_003: Yet the emperor had sealed a binding covenant with the terrible voidsent known as the Cloud of Darkness. Even as Doga and Unei labored to annul this contract, the entity reached through a rift and dragged the pair of them─and Nero─out of our realm.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_004: Since that day, NOAH has devoted itself to rescuing Unei, Doga, and Nero from beyond the rift. Our research, however, has exposed a far more dire problem.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_005: The Crystal Tower still acts upon Emperor Xande's orders, and collects energy to open another voidgate even as we speak. Indeed, the place nigh hums with energy.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_006: We have done all we can to stop the imperial edict, but to no avail. Just as the gate would open only for Unei and Doga, so too will the tower heed only those with the royal blood of Allag.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_007: 'Tis a most galling design. Granted, this was not always so vexatious, according to the Allagan tomestone Nero presented us.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_008: During the golden age of Allag, the royalty had some means of bestowing their blood upon others. If they hadn't such a technology, Amon and his underlings could never have controlled the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_009: But we do not have either this art or any with royal blood. Every moment we wait, a vast rift through which the Cloud of Darkness can enter our realm threatens to open.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_010: Such a disaster cannot be allowed to come to pass. We must seal the Crystal Tower, and annul Xande's covenant with the dark realm.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_011: If only breaking the latter would suffice... But then what of the energy building in the Crystal Tower? Without suppression, that power could discharge and cause a calamity like to the one that destroyed Allag.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_012: In truth, we have more than just three lost compatriots to worry about. If we do not act, our very world will fall before the might of this threat.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_013: We know but one way out of this predicament: rescue those who can control the tower from beyond the dark realm, and seal the rift shut after them. And mercifully, not all our news is quite so bleak.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_014: 'Tis true we cannot stop the voidgate from manifesting within the tower, but this can be to our benefit.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_015: We can use Syrcus's power for our own purposes, and create a portal to carry us into the dark realm!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_016: We have heard this is possible from a man of the Thaumaturges' Guild well versed in otherworldly matters. And with Master Garlond working to create said portal, the final preparations are well underway. Ah, and here comes the man himself.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_018: Yes, our fellowship is indeed complete, and all parties privy to our strategy. And you, Master Garlond, how fare your endeavors?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_019: Quite well! The device is nearly ready─though attaching the damnable thing to Syrcus Tower took every onze of ingenuity the Ironworks has got. But it should produce the energy we need.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_020: With just a little more fine-tuning, we can open a rift. I'm here to request your presence at the tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_021: I'll leave Biggs and Wedge at the Eight Sentinels as guides. And do hurry, . I'm sure you wouldn't miss another chance to save the world, would you?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_022: Well, Cid certainly seems to have a firm hand on the helm. Shall we make our way to the Crystal Tower?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_030: Time is of the essence, my friend. We must go to the Eight Sentinels.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_BIGGS_000_035: Has the chief filled you in on the plan, ? Opening up that voidgate will be a real feat for the Ironworks.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_BIGGS_000_036: But I'm worried about what comes afterwards. I've never heard of anyone going through a rift, let alone coming back. I don't relish the idea of getting stuck there ourselves...
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_WEDGE_000_040: ! I'll bet you're here to watch us pry open a rift between worlds, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_WEDGE_000_041: We're almost ready. Syrcus Tower is full of engineers scurrying around and making adjustments. We're dealing with a lot of power, and if a single coupling's off... Well, boom!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_WEDGE_000_042: B-But it should be fine. Really! Anyway, you'd best wait at the top. The chief's there overseeing the whole operation.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_050: My friends, you've arrived. I'm just waiting for my engineers to give the signal. Then, we'll see if we can't open a gateway to another world!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_051: Hm? Is there something amiss, G'raha?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_052: ...Ahhh, Emperor Xande's throne─how the mighty have fallen, eh? Once, it stood as a symbol of Allag's art and power. Now, it's nothing more than an empty chair.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_053: Just imagine if Allagan civilization had lived on, and a just emperor still sat on that throne. How different would our history be, how much further would we have advanced? <sigh> Unfortunately, there was no stopping Xande and his ambition.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_055: Xande's war of dominion left no one unscathed. Unable to abide the horrors inflicted upon the people, warriors young and brave took up the sword against Allag.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_056: These men and women became as beacons of hope to those who had suffered─not unlike the Warriors of Light in our age.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_057: But all this merely hastened the destruction. Just as they moved towards Allag's heart for the kill, Xande lashed out in anger and frustration...as trapped beasts are wont to do.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_058: In his desperation, Xande desired that a great rift be opened to hasten the Cloud of Darkness's coming. To this end, he commanded the sun's power held within Dalamud be emptied into Syrcus Tower at once.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_059: The act bore terrible consequences. The tower only withstood the blast by flooding the land below with energy. Syrcus was swallowed by the very earth upon which it once stood.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_060: The Fourth Umbral Calamity... I'd learned of its cause from Unei and Doga. I had no idea that rebellion incited Xande to rashness, though.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_061: Your knowledge of Allagan history is astounding, G'raha. Why, a man could study for two lifetimes and only learn half of what you know.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_062: Mayhap... 'Tis strange, though─I cannot seem to remember where I learned such things...
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_063: Yes? Ah, Biggs, are you ready?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_BIGGS_000_064: Ready and raring to open up that voidgate, Chief!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_BIGGS_000_065: We reckon when this machine's up and running, she'll be able to float five airships the size of the Agrius. So just give us the word, and we'll start channeling energy into the tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_067: Our preparations are complete. Everyone, step away from the throne.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_068: All right, let's see what this machine can do. Now, Biggs!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_069: Ahhh, a rift to the World of Darkness, as Unei called it. Splendid work, Master Garlond!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_070: We can't break out the mead just yet. The tough part's still ahead. We've broken into the dark realm, but the gate's not all that stable: it won't stay open forever, and only a few can use it.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_071: I, for one, will remain here to ensure the voidgate stays open.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_072: As will the Sons of Saint Coinach. This rift is our sole path to salvation─if it closes, we are all truly lost.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_073: Which leaves.... My friend, 'tis a heavy burden I must task you with, but there are none more able. Pray lead the adventurers beyond the rift.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_074: I do not know what awaits you, save the Cloud of Darkness and our three comrades. But you must go, for the fate of our world now rests upon your shoulders.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_075: This is our only gambit, but I have every faith you will succeed.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_076: It will be no small feat to return after you have passed beyond the rift. Make certain you are prepared before leaving.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_077: ...Might I have a moment of your time, ? There is a matter of import we must needs discuss ere you leave.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_080: , I wished to speak to you about my eye. As you are no doubt aware, 'tis a trait seen only amongst Allagan royalty.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_081: Long I have pondered why such is my inheritance. The sanguine hue must have some bearing upon my destiny─this much Doga himself admitted. But what?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_082: In truth, the more I learn of the Crystal Tower, the less I am myself. Somehow, meeting those two clones has wrought great change in me.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_083: I am consumed with remembering...something. Something ancient, but ever so important.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_084: And my father's words echo in my mind, the selfsame ones his father told him: the truth of our eye rests with Allag.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_085: Mayhap what I wish to remember and these words are related. Mayhap not. But I know I must learn the truth that history hides from me. I would see this journey─our journey─through to the very end with mine own two eyes.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_086: So I implore you: allow me to join you beyond the rift!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_087: You have my thanks, my friend. Now, let us venture into the World of Darkness, to save our comrades and our realm!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_090: If you have prepared yourself, let us waste no time in rescuing our comrades from the darkness.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_100: Where in the seven hells are they!? Without them to stem the energy in the tower, our defeat of the Cloud aids our cause little.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_101: Doga! Unei! Can you hear me? Nero!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_102: (-???-)Must you be so infernally loud!? Are you so keen to attract more voidsent?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_103: ...Though I don't blame you for missing my company.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_104: Thank the Twelve! Are you all right?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_105: As all right as can be expected. Unei has simply passed out.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_106: Nero, by the gods... What's happened to you?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_107: Alas, his wounds were too deep, and allowed this foul place entry to his body. Now, the darkness claws at the aether of his very form. Would that we could have protected him...
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_108: The Cloud of Darkness was bound by Xande's unholy covenant to bring prosperity to Allagan royalty. The same blood that sealed this contract gives us a measure of protection.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_109: I say “a measure,” for this vow does not protect us from other voidsent. The Cloud imprisoned us here precisely to unleash fiends upon us. We would be dead had Nero not defended us so valiantly.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_110: Mistake not my actions for kindness. I have use for you yet in Eorzea, and simply couldn't let harm befall you here.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_112: Unei! You are safe─our friends have come for us.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_113: H-Have they? Then perhaps, Doga, there is yet hope we may fulfill our purpose.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CLOUDOFDARKNESS_000: Mortals! You have dared to challenge me, and now must feel my wrath!
Did you think to destroy me in my realm? Here, I am eternal! I will smother your light and entomb your bones amongst my shadows!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_116: A-Are we truly so powerless here?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_117: As long as we fight the Cloud in this realm, I fear so.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_118: And yet...though we may not be able to destroy it, this may be our chance to stop it. If we strike now whilst the Cloud can barely hold her form, mayhap we can sever Xande's covenant!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_119: Yes, and raze the bridge between the Crystal Tower and this foul place once and for all! , G'raha─you must flee!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_120: You...you and Doga mean to stay here!?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_121: 'Tis madness! You must return with us! No one but you can save the world from the threat of the Crystal Tower!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CLOUDOFDARKNESS_000: What is this trickery? ...Your blood! You too gain protection from Xande's blood!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_123: G'raha Tia... You are possessed of royal blood! That is why the Royal Eye runs in your line!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_124: 'Tis a gift you have inherited. G'raha─you have been granted authority over the Crystal Tower!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_125: ...I had thought time would consume all of Allag that was. That a man should still live with his forebears' blood in this age can be no coincidence.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_126: Some person must have planted this gift in your line, and used the highest of Allagan technology to do so.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_127: True, the Crystal Tower is not like to recognize you as Allagan, not as you are now. But your Royal Eye bespeaks a simple truth: within you dwells one feeble glitter that will illuminate all, the light of hope!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_128: But...how should I use this light? Pray, tell me!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_129: You must gain control of the Crystal Tower. We will share our blood with you, G'raha. Though its effects will be but ephemeral, it will bolster the Allagan presence within you.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_130: This is our gift to you, that you may fulfill your destiny. All with the Royal Eye are bound by fate to Allag. Our part in this journey is to bury Xande's dark ambitions in the past. This was the true Unei and Doga's purpose, one we have carried into the future.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_131: Know that as long as this light of hope survives in you, our souls will still remain─even if our bodies are lost.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_DOGA_000_133: You must leave us as well, Nero. I am sorry we could not live up to your expectations.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_134: I must return to you what is yours, though. You dropped it whilst defending us.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_135: What you seek by this instrument may not be possible, Nero. But do not give up. There are many other paths that await you.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_100_136: Doga, Unei, I... Thank you. We shall never forget you. Now, , Nero, let us quit this place.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CLOUDOFDARKNESS_000: You shall not escape me, impudent children of light!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_UNEI_000_138:
No, you shall not escape us.
Here, Xande's bloodstained dreams of glory end.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_141: It...it grows faint! Then the bridge between realms grows fragile by the covenant's annulment!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_142: If that light dies, we are stranded here! Hurry!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_145: I don't need you! If I die here, it'll be because I bloody well decided to!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_146: I failed to master darkness. I'll not suffer watching a green boy master the tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_147: Do what you will with it. But remember me, son of Allag!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_148: I am Nero tol Scaeva, the man who'll yet outdo Allag and Garlond!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_149: That was what you hoped to─
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_SALINA_000_150:
May the Crystal Tower...
again be a beacon of hope for mankind.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_152: <cough> Must move onwards... Th-This is not where I come to rest!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_NERO_000_153:
But how did...?
...So those damn clones did it, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_160: You are returned unharmed, thank the gods!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_WEDGE_000_161: When that voidgate started to close... I had never felt so powerless in all my life!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_BIGGS_000_162: We were running about like madmen, trying to keep the gate open─and then the chief actually went and dived in! But if you're all sa─ Hm?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_WEDGE_000_163: Wh-Where are Unei and Doga? They're not...?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_164: ...I see. I will miss the two of them dearly, but I am happy they fulfilled their purpose.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_165: We who live on must still attend to the Crystal Tower...though we now have no one able to seal it.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_166: That is not true, my friend. Unei and Doga have entrusted me with their blood. I can now control the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_167: G'raha... Yes, I can see it in your eyes. Good. Then let us put an end to this, and seal away the tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_168: I understand your instinct, Rammbroes, but please, give us a moment to rest. I am weary to the bone, and Nero and  are both emerged from long battle.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_169: Of course, of course, you have the right of it. Come, we shall leave this place for a spell, and repair to Saint Coinach's Find.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_170: No one but you could have succeeded in the World of Darkness, .
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_171: Would that I could have been of more use beyond the rift. As it stands, I was but a vessel for Doga and Unei's blood...
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_172: Hm? Have I remembered what I wished to?
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_173: ...Yes, something has come back to me. Gaining royal blood and witnessing true bravery has reminded me of my forebears' dearest wish.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_174: But we need not speak of these things now. It was not my place to keep you. Pray go on ahead of me; there is something small I would do before I return.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_175: I could not have asked for a better comrade. If only I could have been a part of your adventures for longer, ... Alas, fate dictates I have a different role to play.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_176: A wish hidden for millennia, and brought to light by the good people of NOAH...
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_GRAHATIA_000_177: Now, finally, 'tis my time to see it realized.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_CID_000_180: Nero never would've made it back without you, , and for that you have my thanks. I doubt he will hatch any more dastardly schemes for the present. He owes me his life, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_BIGGS_000_185: I'll tell you, that rift started closing up fast. Waiting for you three to pop out was the tensest few moments of my life!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_WEDGE_000_190: No matter how many other clones are still out there, our Unei and Doga were special. I'm going to miss them...
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_200: I cannot express how glad I am you returned safely, ─and with the means to dispel the threat of the Crystal Tower for good!
TEXT_GAIUSD601_00494_RAMMBROES_000_201: Rest if you will, and then let us free ourselves from the specter of the Allagans!
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_000: I trust you have rested, my friend. Good. I wish to seal the tower now...but there is something we must do first.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_001: Let me summon the others, and hear in full what happened beyond the rift.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_010: ...So the Allagan Eye that runs in G'raha's line does mean that royal blood flows in his veins.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_011: I suppose it is not so odd to think his forebears gained it via ancient technology. But who imbued his family with the blood, and for what purpose?
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_012: Mayhap all this was fate, from discovering the tower to G'raha gaining Unei and Doga's blood.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_BIGGS_000_013: Has G'raha said anything? For that matter, where is G'raha? And what of Nero?
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_CID_000_014: I'm not sure about our resident historian, but Nero left the tower with me. Where he's vanished to since, I cannot say.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_CID_000_015: But knowing him as I do, I don't believe he'll scheme against us for the time being. ...Though he is still Nero.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_016: , you say G'raha stayed behind at the Crystal Tower. I wonder if he even now prepares to seal the place off.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_INVESTIGATORA_000_0: 'Tis G'raha Tia, sir! He came into the Crystal Tower, and began ordering researchers out!
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_019: What? Why would he do such a thing?
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_INVESTIGATORA_000_0: I do not know, sir, but he was quite insistent. He all but bodily forced me out of the gates.
I suppose it's possible he told one of the others, but I wasted no time in finding out. I thought it best to hasten here and ask your guidance.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_022: Very well. Let us go and speak with these researchers, and get to the bottom of this queer business.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_023: Master Garlond, , please come with me. No doubt G'raha means to seal off the Crystal Tower, but it worries me that he did not breathe a word of his plan to us.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_INVESTIGATORB_000_0: What in the world was G'raha Tia thinking, demanding we leave the tower?
No doubt you want to know why. I wish I knew that myself!
Of course, he would tell me nothing. But he will be honest with you, ─I am certain of it!
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_040: (-???-)Go no further, my friends! The doors will close ere long.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_041: So you are of a mind to seal the tower, G'raha.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_042: I know time is of the essence, but all I ask is a hint of your plan. Please, come here so we can discuss this.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_044: Come, man, what is this nonsense!? If aught is amiss, surely we can help!
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_045: Not this time, my friend. Just as Unei and Doga fulfilled their destiny, so too must I fulfill mine. My blood has awakened me to this fact.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_046: As my father told me, the truth has always lain with Allag. Or, rather, 'twas there the wish I must grant was born.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_047: You see, not all the world perished in Xande's calamity. Survivors stood amidst the ruins of Allag, looking to the Crystal Tower. But it was nowhere to be seen.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_048: Yet they hoped its spires would again dominate the land, and prayed that the Crystal Tower would be a beacon of hope to people everywhere.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_049: Word of this soon reached the only member of Allag's royalty to outlive the empire: the princess Salina.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_050: Salina was moved by the people's dearest wish. She used the very best of Allag's technology to give her blood and memories to he whom she trusted most. That man was my forebearer.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_051: For millennia, we waited. Allag's art and ingenuity faded. Our royal blood grew thin. But before the last drop could vanish from the realm, the memory of all this returned to me.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_052: And now, I must fulfill the wish of the ancients. The tower will shine forth as a new beacon of hope.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_CID_000_053: G'raha, the Crystal Tower's strength poses too great a threat to Eorzea now.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_CID_000_054: We would need technology as advanced as Allag's to use it correctly. As things stand, we barely understand the tower's workings. Hells, we may never fully comprehend them.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_055: 'Tis as you say, Cid. We could wait for someone, someday, to reach the same heights as Allag, but by then we will have lost the royal blood and the means to control the tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_056: But what if I do as Amon did, and put the tower into a deep sleep?
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_058: I am deadly serious, Cid. The tower may only be used once men rival the Allagans in knowledge. I will slumber within Syrcus Tower until then, to greet those with the means to open the gates.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_059: Then, I will guide them. And thus will the tower shine forth as the beacon of hope it was meant to be. 'Tis the only way to make the wishes of the ancients come true.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_060: The future is where my destiny awaits.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_061: But yours lies outside of these doors. Go. Create a future where hope reigns, and the tragedies of the past are but memories. No one but you can accomplish such things.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_CID_000_062: Nothing we say will make you change your mind, will it?
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_CID_000_063: Onwards to a brighter future... It won't be easy, of course. But that's exactly why we'll do it!
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_WEDGE_000_064: W-We'll catch up with Allag, just you wait! We'll cover all that lost ground before you even know it!
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_BIGGS_000_065: Well said, Wedge! It'll only be a few years before we come knocking, G'raha. Then you're in for a rude awakening!
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_066: You shall be witness to NOAH's accomplishments. Pray keep alive our successes, and forgive us our failures. And may we meet again, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_067: The Twelve keep you till then, Rammbroes. I look forward to learning of your exploits. And you, ─I know history will remember you. No doubt your heroism will be the star by which I chart my course when I awake.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_068: Well, now I must rest. Recalling so much has put me in the mood for sleep.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_GRAHATIA_000_069: Farewell, my friends. I eagerly await a future born of your courage and the ancients' wish.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_NERO_000_070: The Crystal Tower slumbers again, then. 'Tis too quiet for my taste.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_NERO_000_071: Good-bye, Cid. I must put all this at my back. Possibility beckons, and I am bound to follow.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_NERO_000_072: A new dawn has come for me.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_080: You have just missed Cid, . There is much that needs his attention if he is to fulfill G'raha's wishes, it seems.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_081: But this is not the end of NOAH, no matter how lonely Saint Coinach's Find has become for our friends' departure.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_082: We must all walk in different directions now. Remember that we labor for a brighter future, lit by G'raha's beacon. Sealing the Crystal Tower was but the first step.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_RAMMBROES_000_083: Farewell, my friend. May our paths cross again.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_SYSTEM_000_088: You have completed the Crystal Tower quest series. The next main scenario quest can be accepted by speaking with Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSD602_00495_SYSTEM_000_089: You have completed the Crystal Tower quest series. Rest well, champion, for the main scenario and many other adventures await you!
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_SYELE_000_000: Adventurer, may I ask a favor of you?
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_SYELE_000_001: I am sorry to trouble you so soon after your trials in the Crystal Tower, but my colleague Koh Rabntah has gone missing.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_SYELE_000_002: She discovered the oddest orb deep within the tower, and said she was returning here to analyze it. No one has seen her since─though she is too timid a girl to have run off with her find.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_SYELE_000_003: She probably just left to gather artifacts or materials in Revenant's Toll for her studies. But all the same, could you go and look for her there? I cannot shake the feeling something has befallen her...
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_SYELE_000_010: Have you found Koh yet? I suspect she has simply gone to Revenant's Toll in search of artifacts. Pray bid her return if you see her there.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_019: ...Is there something I can help you with?
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_020: You seek Koh Rabntah? Well, you have found the right body, but she is not at home...so to speak.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_021: This lovely girl you see before you is known as “Koh.” But another's soul dwells within her at present─mine, to be precise.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_022: You are speaking with none other than Noah, archmagus of Allag! My scholarly works are legend, my treatises of the cosmos priceless, and my very name known throughout the world!
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_023: ...Or 'twas so once. My soul has whiled away the millennia within an orb. Koh awoke me from my slumber, and... Well, how could I pass up a chance to walk the world again? So I allowed my spirit to flow into her body, and here we are.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_024: ...Hm. Forgive me, but you do not seem overly bewildered by this. Would I be wrong to assume you belong to the scholarly fellowship that carries my name?
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_025: As I thought. Koh revealed this “NOAH” when I entered her mind. Oh, but do be at ease─I bear you no ill will for using my name.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_026: I am, however, intrigued. What discoveries has this organization made? Has it made any findings of note to begin with?
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_027: You act in my name, and so are as disciples to me. I will give you my blessing after you have proven your intellectual worth. Such is my wont. So, are you deserving?
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_028: You have dedicated yourself to creating a brighter future, eh? Then we may be alike in spirit. When I lived, I had a thirst for knowledge, and dedicated myself to understanding the world. 'Twas how I became an archmagus.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_029: Hmmm... You may yet become a disciple of mine. I would learn more of your journey into the Crystal Tower. If I can see your dedication amongst your exploits, I will be happy to give you a token of my immense wisdom.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_030: Pray do not expect too much, though: there are limits to what I can do in this body.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_100_030: ...Whose owner you were seeking, of course. Well, I will make sure that Koh's friend learns of what has happened─some version, at least. And worry not: this body is in safe hands.
TEXT_GAIUSD701_00497_KOHRABNTAH_000_031: And I believe that is the shape of it. If my offer has tantalized you and you wish to prove yourself in my eyes, you certainly know where to find me.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_000: Aha! I thought an inquiring mind like yours could not resist my offer. Well, come then, produce the records of NOAH's expeditions to the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_001: I seek nothing so crude as a tome, though. No, memories speak far truer than written words, my . Kindly conjure all you have seen in the Crystal Tower within your own mind.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_002: No, no, do not tell me either! <sigh> You are clearly unfamiliar with oneiromantic pearls. These are devices capable of holding memories─an invention born of my beloved oneiromancy and some technological manipulation of the mind.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_003: Now, allow your mind to drift back to all you have done with NOAH, every battle fought and comrade lost. Think hard, that I might transfer your experiences to oneiromantic pearls. I shall peruse these memories when you are done, and judge your worthiness by them.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_010: My offer has brought you back yet again, eh? 'Tis lucky for you I never tire of viewing memories.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_011: As before, you will need to relive your time in the labyrinth, tower, and dark realm. Remember each and every tiny detail, so I may seal the memories within oneiromantic pearls for the viewing.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_020: Have you turned your mind's eye to all three places that NOAH investigated? Pray, relive every painful moment and glorious battle, and I shall see all the memories sealed within oneiromantic pearls.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_030: I take it you have recalled all you accomplished with NOAH. The spirit of inquiry in me can scarce wait to see how you faced adversity in the shadow of my civilization. The pearls, if you will be so good.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_040: Thank you. Well, has this fellowship of NOAH outfitted itself bravely amidst Allag's ruins? We shall see, we shall see.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_100_040: Dear me! 'Twould seem our two ages are closely intertwined. And even now, this fellow with the Royal Eye sleeps within the Crystal Tower in hopes that it may light the future?
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_041: I see. Well, beholding your exploits has certainly proven your worthiness in my eyes. I would give you this as thanks. 'Tis an article born of most ancient knowledge; I think you shall find some use for it on your adventures.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_042: <sigh> 'Tis a pity that oneiromantic pearls offer but a single viewing, though... I always miss something the first time. So I shall make you a deal─another token of my wisdom for another look at your memories!
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_043: I quite look forward to it! And in the meantime, there is much else I would see in this enchanting age. Yes, I do believe I shall inhabit Koh's body for a bit longer.
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_050: Your readiness to think back upon all you have done is commendable in the highest! I cannot imagine reliving every moment was pleasant; your reward shall be equal to your tribulations!
TEXT_GAIUSD702_00498_KOHRABNTAH_000_051: Yes, you are indeed worthy of this token of my wisdom. I wish I could offer more, but I dare not lest I hurt Koh's body. So here, take this, and may it light your way to greater adventure still.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_000: I know you have scarce had a chance to rest, but I am afraid there is still work to do.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_YSHTOLA_000_001: The Ultima Weapon's destruction, 'twould seem, has served to embolden the beastmen, who now seek to call down their gods once more.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_PAPALYMO_000_002: Even as we speak, the Amalj'aa, the Ixal, and the kobolds are making preparations for their respective summoning rites. And that is but the half of it.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_PAPALYMO_000_003: Much to our dismay, all three tribes were somehow able to procure vast quantities of crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_YDA_000_004: ...Oh! My turn to say something? Ahem! Basically, this means the primals will be stronger than they were before!
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_005: Far, far stronger. Their previous incarnations will seem as pale imitations.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_THANCRED_000_006: The beast tribes, we believe, began hoarding crystals with a vengeance in the wake of the Ultima Weapon's maiden appearance. You will remember that as the time it devoured three primals in one sitting.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_007: The Grand Companies are aware of the potential primal outbreak.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_008: Alas, due to the losses they incurred to ensure the success of Operation Archon, they are ill equipped to take any meaningful measures.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_URIANGER_000_009: After deliberation, the leaders concluded that they must needs turn to us once more─to thee.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_010: The aetheric waves that were observed in Mor Dhona do not appear to bear a connection to any beast tribe.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_011: Yet much and more still remains beyond our knowing. We must be prepared for all possibilities.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_012: I am loath to send you into the midst of danger again so soon, but none have proven themselves more capable against the primals than you. Will you undertake this mission, ?
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_013: You have my thanks! I truly do not know what we would do without you!
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_THANCRED_000_022: With circumstances as they were, I haven't had the chance to properly express my gratitude.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_THANCRED_000_023: I owe you my life, . Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_THANCRED_000_024: A string of failures had left me feeling powerless. I wanted to be stronger, that I might do right by my fellow Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_THANCRED_000_025: But instead I caused you all no end of grief and suffering. I swear to you, it shan't happen again.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_THANCRED_000_026: Owing to everyone's ministrations, I am quite recovered now. I hope to return to my duties again soon.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_030: Thancred's return marks the beginning of a new chapter for the Scions. Let us renew the fire in our hearts and continue to press ever forward!
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_031: Now then, back to the matter of the primals. With no fewer than three of the beings threatening to appear, it is easy to feel overwhelmed. We must take it one sure step at a time.
