TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_MINFILIA_000_032: Urianger has the overview of the situation as it stands. Please speak with him to receive guidance on your mission.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_URIANGER_000_040: Such knowledge as I possess of the beast tribes and their primals is at thy disposal.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_URIANGER_000_041: Whether man or beastman, we are wont to seek power when plunged into the black depths of despair.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_URIANGER_000_043: That despair doth begin with the Amalj'aa, who may have already summoned forth Ifrit.
TEXT_GAIUSD001_01047_URIANGER_000_044: With our comrade Thancred now returned, thou wouldst do well to seek his counsel.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_000: Confirmation has just arrived from the Immortal Flames.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_001: 'Tis as Urianger said, I fear─the Amalj'aa have already summoned Ifrit. A confrontation with the Lord of the Inferno is inevitable.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_002: I would like nothing more than to lend you my blade, but the Students of Baldesion insisted that I refrain from taking to the field where it concerns primals.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_003: I know not the workings of it, but it would seem that recent events have left me especially susceptible to tempering.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_004: As much as I hate missing out on the fun, for everybody's sake, I must sit this one out. Instead I will focus on gathering and analyzing data.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_005: Now, the Immortal Flames have already conducted a preliminary investigation into Ifrit.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_006: They may well have information that will be of use to you. Do pay a visit to the Hall of Flames and speak with Commander Swift.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_THANCRED_000_007: One last thing before you depart. Doubtless you remember Minfilia's words, but this Ifrit is a far cry from the primal you first defeated. You will want to assemble your most dependable comrades for the mission. Be safe, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_SWIFT_000_020: , we thank you for coming. The Flame General will be heartened to hear that you have answered the call.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_SWIFT_000_022: As we have already relayed to the Waking Sands, Ifrit is returned.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_SWIFT_000_023: For the sake of peace in the region, we humbly request that you vanquish him.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_SWIFT_000_024: The primal is to be found in his domain, the Bowl of Embers. To get there, you must use the beastman aetheryte found within the depths of Zahar'ak, the Amalj'aa stronghold.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_SWIFT_000_025: The Amalj'aa have constructed their own Aethernet from salvaged aetheryte shards. This being the case, you should be able to use it without problem.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_SWIFT_000_026: No doubt you already know this from your fellow Scions, but the present incarnation of Ifrit is far stronger than the last. Facing him with any fewer than seven of your stoutest comrades would be ill-advised.
TEXT_GAIUSD002_01048_SWIFT_000_027: That is all the intelligence we have to share─the rest is in your hands. I shall pray for your victory and safe return.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_000: Ah, , I hear you have triumphed over Ifrit! Of course, this is no less a feat than I would expect of a Warrior of Light, but well done all the same!
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_001: Now, I full had a mind to crack open a bottle of 1547 Bacchus, but the celebration must keep. Garuda, I am afraid to say, has also returned.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_002: As you well know, Garuda's appetite for destruction far exceeds that of other primals. Not to dishearten you, but in her latest incarnation, that appetite has become nigh insatiable.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_003: In the short time since her return, she has already wreaked tremendous havoc. You must send her back to the aether before she can do any more damage.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_004: In the meantime, Yda and I will assist the Order of the Twin Adder in their recovery effort.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_005: When you previously faced Garuda, 'twas the Enterprise that bore you through the storm that shielded her domain. Well, that storm is as a spring breeze beside what she has raised this time; no airship could hope to penetrate it.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_006: And so we must count ourselves fortunate that the Order of the Twin Adder chanced to discover a beastman aetheryte leading to the Howling Eye.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_007: Before you do aught else, I suggest you pay a visit to the Adders' Nest and have words with Commander Heuloix. He will be able to tell you about the said aetheryte, among other things.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_PAPALYMO_000_008: Make no mistake, the Lady of the Vortex will prove a formidable opponent, but I believe that you can weather the storm. May the Twelve keep you safe!
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_VORSAILE_000_020: Ah, ! We are grateful for your aid!
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_VORSAILE_000_022: As you will already know, the accursed Ixal have summoned Garuda once more. Since her return, she has wasted no time unleashing her fury upon the region. Extensive damage has been reported in both the Twelveswood and Coerthas.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_VORSAILE_000_023: She must be stopped, and soon, lest more lives be lost. In the name of the Elder Seedseer, I humbly request you put an end to her reign of terror.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_VORSAILE_000_024: As in the past, Garuda keeps her court within the Howling Eye, which is perpetually protected by a raging tempest. Fortunately, we have learned of an alternate way into her domain.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_VORSAILE_000_025: The Ixal have constructed an aetheryte within Natalan, their stronghold in the central highlands of Coerthas. This aetheryte will take you to Garuda's tempestuous realm.
TEXT_GAIUSD003_01157_VORSAILE_000_026: We owe this discovery to the Ishgardians, who the Elder Seedseer says desired to repay the kindness you showed them. For the sake of our people as well as theirs, may your mission be met with success.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_000: So both Ifrit and Garuda are now vanquished by your hands. Truly, you have earned yourself a rest. Would that you had the luxury of time to enjoy it.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_001: It pains me to say that Titan is also returned, and with a vengeance. As was the case with his primal brethren, he is grown stronger than he was before.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_002: When I went about my investigation, all indications suggested that the kobolds were nowhere near ready to resume their summoning rites.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_003: But it turns out they were deceiving us. I should have known better.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_004: The kobolds' subterranean domain runs deep, and they can easily hoard crystals with our being none the wiser. And a vast hoard it must have been.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_005: Till now, Garuda was the most powerful among the three recently active primals. But according to our latest readings, Titan has usurped that honor.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_006: A primal's might is determined by two factors: the amount of crystals it has gorged upon, and the fervor of its believers. I would like nothing more than to measure precisely how strong the Lord of Crags has become, but I fear the time for such prudence has run out.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_007: We have already received an official request for assistance from the Maelstrom. And as you might expect, it is addressed to you.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_008: For your previous encounter with Titan, you traveled to his demesne by way of the aetheryte first discovered by the Company of Heroes. Sad to say, this aetheryte no longer seems to respond.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_009: But do not despair, for the Maelstrom has reportedly found another in its place. You will want to speak with Commander Rhiki at Maelstrom Command for the details.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_YSHTOLA_000_010: I cannot stress this enough, but Titan has grown fearsome strong. See to it you spare no preparation.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_RASHAHT_000_020: Ah, , your presence is most welcome. I'm chagrined that we must turn to you again to lay Titan low.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_RASHAHT_000_022: No doubt this is yesterday's news to you, but the Lord of Crags has returned more ferocious and formidable than he was before.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_RASHAHT_000_023: We cannot fathom how the kobolds were able to obtain such vast stores of crystals, and in so short a time. We will learn the answer in the coming moons, I suspect, but first things first.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_RASHAHT_000_024: We need you to vanquish Titan before he and the kobolds have a chance to wreak havoc on Limsa Lominsa. You have felled the primal before, and we believe that you can emerge victorious once more.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_RASHAHT_000_025: We've learned of a new aetheryte that will take you to the Navel. It's situated deep within U'Ghamaro Mines─not the most convenient of locations, admittedly─so you will have cut yourself a path.
TEXT_GAIUSD004_01158_RASHAHT_000_026: Please make all haste─Titan's mere presence emboldens the kobolds, and 'tis only a matter of time before they move in force against us. May the Navigator guide you on your way, .
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_URIANGER_000_000: When the senary moon did wane, there sounded a bloodcurdling roar. A new primal had roused, the portents gave us to believe, one whose identity yet lieth beyond our ken.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_URIANGER_000_001: By thy hand, three primals have since been vanquished. As each returned to the aether, 'twas observed that tremors foreshadowing this fourth grew in strength and frequency both.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_URIANGER_000_002: The being doth quicken, and in time it shall become a scourge upon the land.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_URIANGER_000_003: Yet even as we pondered a course of action, a benevolent soul did arise, one who would forestall this threat. Though she be tender in years, she is true of heart and steadfast of resolve.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_URIANGER_000_004: She would solicit thine aid, if thou art willing to proffer it. Lest thou wonder, this maiden is of our order. Thus did the Antecedent straightways consent that thou shouldst assist her howsoever thou mayest.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_URIANGER_000_005: As soon as thou art able, hie thee to Wineport, where thy petitioner doth await thee even now. Thou shalt for a certainty find her visage strikingly familiar.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_010: It has been a while, adventurer. As I recall, my brother Alphinaud took the liberty of introducing us when first─and last─we met.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_011: But for the sake of propriety...Alisaie Leveilleur. I thank you for coming.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_012: I have heard much and more of your exploits. By your hand, the Black Wolf is slain, and his Ultima Weapon destroyed.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_013: You are possessed of great strength and courage, that much is plain. I shall have need of one such as you if I am to see my mission through to its conclusion.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_014: As you may be aware, the violence of Dalamud's fall changed not only the face of the realm, but also the base of the realm. Specifically, it played havoc with the aetheric currents, creating vast confluences of aether below the surface. Among other phenomena, this led to the formation of subterranean caverns at key points of stress.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_015: One such cavern lies beneath Castrum Occidens, and extends to only the gods know where.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_016: Despite appearances, Castrum Occidens is as much a research facility as it is a fortress. Gaius van Baelsar chose the site for no other reason than to probe the caverns without interference.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_017: As you went about vanquishing the returned primals, I observed a repeating wave pattern in the aether, corresponding exactly to the dates on which you were reported to have felled Ifrit, Titan, and Garuda. Upon closer examination, it became clear that these unique waveforms emanated from deep beneath the aforementioned stronghold.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_018: Crucially, I recorded the same pattern during the recent celebrations, and have since been given to understand that this phenomenon bears a disquieting similarity to one observed shortly prior to the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_019: Five years ago, my grandfather invoked the power of the Twelve that he might contain Bahamut.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_020: Alas, his efforts failed, and he vanished, together with his foe.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_021: I would know the truth of what transpired that day─of Grandfather's fate, and of the metamorphosis that swept across the land.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_022: In casting light upon these mysteries, we will find a way to cure what ails this world.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_023: It is my belief that the answers I seek lie hid within the depths of the cavern. I would have you accompany me on an expedition to find them, .
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_024: If truth be told, I am not wont to rely upon others, and have thus far handled matters alone. Yet I am not blind to my limitations. Unescorted, I cannot hope to succeed in this endeavor.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_025: I swore that I would find a way to restore peace to Eorzea. If you desire the selfsame, then aid me, as you aided my brother and the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_026: I am in your debt. You are a  of action, and I sense that we will accomplish much together.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_027: But let us not waste any more time. As I mentioned, Castrum Occidens straddles the cavern I wish to explore. If I am to have a hope of reaching it alive, I will need you to infiltrate the stronghold first and locate a path into the depths.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_028: Once you have done so, pray report your success to Storm Private J'brohka. You may consider her my assistant here in Wineport.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_029: I have every faith that you will not fail me. Twelve speed your way, .
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_050: As I mentioned, Castrum Occidens straddles the cavern I wish to explore. If I am to have a hope of reaching it alive, I will need you to infiltrate the stronghold first and locate a path into the depths.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_JBROHKA_000_040: I've been expecting you, . By your coming, I take it you have successfully located the cavern entrance inside Castrum Occidens?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_JBROHKA_000_041: ...So that's where it's to be found! Marvelous! Oh, but allow me to properly introduce myself. J'brohka is my name, and it is my honor to serve Lady Alisaie. Though, for reasons of convenience, at present I also serve the Maelstrom.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_JBROHKA_000_042: This uniform accords me certain privileges, you see─in particular, ready access to the Maelstrom's regional scouting reports. They provide a wealth of local knowledge, including information on secret passages.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_JBROHKA_000_043: ...But enough about me. I shall notify Lady Alisaie of your discovery, that she may prepare for the expedition.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_JBROHKA_000_044: Though I don't doubt your abilities, none can say what dangers lurk beneath Castrum Occidens. For my lady's sake as well as your own, please spare neither preparation nor caution. Pray choose your companions well.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_SYSTEM_100_050: You now have access to the Binding Coil of Bahamut. The subterranean labyrinth can be accessed by speaking with J'brohka.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_SYSTEM_100_051: Details such as the conditions of entry may also be had by speaking with the storm private.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_100: The scars left by the Calamity...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_101: I can scarce breathe for the surfeit of aether...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_102: Tell me, have you ever seen corrupted crystals such as these?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_103: Such crystals manifested across the realm when the course of the great river of aether was irrevocably altered five years ago.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_104: Behold one of the objects that caused that alteration: a fragment of the lesser moon, Dalamud.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_105: Ancient Allag created Dalamud─or Meteor, to use the Garlean name─to serve as a celestial prison for Bahamut.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_106: Its fall inflicted grievous wounds upon the land─wounds that have yet to heal, as is evident from the corrupted crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_107: Amazing... Dalamud's internal defenses still function in spite of everything─a testament to the ingenuity of the Allagans.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_108: The Garleans seek to appropriate their advanced technology, I am certain of it.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_109: We are about to come face-to-face with secrets that have long lain buried within the sands of time.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_110: Great dangers may lie beyond, but we have come too far to turn back. The truth of the Calamity is within reach.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_121: Dark wings that would engulf the very heavens...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_122: These could only belong to Bahamut, the primal who laid Eorzea to waste five years ago.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_123: At Carteneau, my grandfather sought to imprison Bahamut anew by invoking the power of the Twelve.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_124: Alas, the dreadwyrm proved too powerful, and he soon broke free of his confines.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_125: Yet instead of resuming the destruction he had begun, Bahamut vanished. Whither to, no one knew...until this day.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_126: But I do not understand... If Bahamut is truly a primal, how is it that he retains his physical form?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_127: Did Grandfather defeat him? Or is there some other explanation?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_128: We must press on if we are to learn the truth.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_140: This is going rather more smoothly than I expected. It is indeed convenient to have a hero on hand.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_141: Gods... That the cavern should open up again, even at this depth...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_143: <gasp> And so it should! This is Bahamut's hand!
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_144: As with the wings, it seems to be frozen, and for that I count my blessings. But again I find myself wondering, how is it able to retain physical form?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_145: I had assumed that Bahamut's reversion to aether was the cause of the widespread changes to the realm. But if he is still here, then that theory no longer holds.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_146: What was it, then, that brought about the realm's sudden regeneration? There is still so much we do not know about Carteneau...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_147: I haven't the slightest inkling how deep these caverns run, but we must continue.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_160: This contraption... Is it used to control the saturation of aether?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_161: I suppose there is only one way to find out.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_162: The dragon you vanquished earlier─doubtless you noticed the peculiar contraption about its neck.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_163: It was likely a receptor of some description, used to enslave the creature.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_164: Ancient Allag possessed the means to control dragons, it would seem. The Ishgardians would kill for this knowledge, though to be sure, it could as easily be brought to bear against them.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_165: An army of dragons could turn the tide of any battle, as the Garleans once learned to their sorrow. I would not be the least bit surprised if they now sought to exploit this power.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_166: Whatever their plans, this serves as another reminder of the might of the Allagans. One cannot help but wonder how so advanced a civilization came to fall.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_169: And that enormous crystal─it pulsates as if...as if it were a heart! Then the primal that had awakened...was Bahamut all this time!?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_170: No! No, no, NO! This cannot be true! This...this would mean that Grandfather died for naught!
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_171: Confound it! We do not know enough to strike at it now! We must withdraw!
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_172: Who...? Who is that? No...it can't be...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_174: No... Don't leave me again... Please...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_176: I-I know... We can do no more for now...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_201: How did we come to be in northern Thanalan of all places?
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_202: Oh, but such details matter little!
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_205: But why won't he return to us? I don't understand...
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_206: This expedition has yielded more questions than it did answers.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_207: At any rate, we would both be better for a rest. Let us return to the Waking Sands and reflect upon what we have seen.
TEXT_GAIUSD101_01159_ALISAIE_000_208: Thank you, . Without you, none of this would have been possible.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_000: Full glad am I for thy safe return. Lady Alisaie hath apprised me of thy many experiences.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_001: As thou wilt doubtless be aware, Master Louisoix was my lady's grandsire. Gravely concerned was I for her safety, but 'twould seem I need not have been so. With all my heart, I do thank thee for watching over her.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_002: But come, thou must speak with Mistress Alisaie upon that which transpired within the Binding Coil. May it serve to bring us closer to the truth of the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_040: I am pleased to see you again, . I have already shared the fruits of our expedition with Urianger. Let us together ponder their implications.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_010: Shall we begin, then? Urianger, I understand you have a report of your own to share with us.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_011: Aye, my lady. Even as thou didst emerge from the depths, an aetheric disturbance betokening primal activity was observed.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_012: In Mor Dhona was it marked first. By comparison of time and magnitude, we have since deduced its origin: the Carteneau Flats.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_013: Strange... There have been no reports of primal activity in that region... It could only have been Bahamut.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_014: That would certainly explain how we came to be in northern Thanalan. Somehow, the cavern took us all the way from Vylbrand to the heart of Aldenard.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_016: It is all but certain, then... After Bahamut disappeared five years ago, he hid himself deep beneath Carteneau, and has since lain dormant, regenerating.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_017: Aye, my lady. Taken together with thine own account of Bahamut's continued presence, the land's slowness to heal and the disorder of the aetheric currents do point to one conclusion...
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_018: Bahamut stirreth. If left unchecked, the primal shall drink of Eorzea's life force till he doth waken to rain ruin upon the land.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_019: Rest assured, I do not mean to give up, . Bahamut may still live, but so too does Grandfather.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_020: For the past five years, he has been keeping vigil over his nemesis, making certain that the primal does not escape.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_021: Master Louisoix...doth yet live? I...I durst not hope... And thou art certain 'twas no mere manifestation of thine all too sorely felt grief?
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_022: I know how desperate this may sound, Urianger, but I saw him with my own two eyes─as did .
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_023: But he vanished deeper into the labyrinth before we had the chance to speak.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_024: Two more like fragments of Dalamud pierced the earth when the lesser moon fell. One we have seen. If we can but find the other two, I am certain that we will find Grandfather as well.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_URIANGER_000_025: If thou so believest, my lady, then I too shall have faith. If it please you, I shall notify the Grand Companies of this development. All Eorzea must stand united if we are to avert a repeat of the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_026: That will not be necessary, Urianger. Being the great conciliator that he is, Alphinaud will seek to unite Eorzea of his own accord. If rumors are true, that endeavor is already well underway.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_027: So let us leave the diplomacy to the diplomat, while we continue our investigation of Bahamut.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_028: I swear to you, no matter what it takes, we will find my grandfather and uncover the whole truth of the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_029: ─you have heard me swear to do these things, but without your strength, I cannot hope to make good on my word.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_ALISAIE_000_030: The danger to Eorzea is not passed. For the sake of all who abide here, I pray that you will ever be our sword in the darkness.
TEXT_GAIUSD102_01160_SYSTEM_000_100: You may view the opening cutscene for the Binding Coil of Bahamut before accepting this quest.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_000: Of all my tasks, the one by which I am most keenly vexed is the never-ending journey into the heart of the primals' true nature. Each door I fling wide leadeth me, with inevitable anguish, to another such confounding portal.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_001: It is in these lands that the keys to the knowledge I seek are found. Many seasons did I toil to fashion a net across this vast realm─a net that catcheth not fish, but nuggets of wisdom more valuable than gold.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_002: Much have I learned, but the essence of the primals is ever shifting─no dusty tome doth capture in ink what these terrible beings are now become.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_100_000: It is decided: the stance of the Scions must evolve from shifting sand to unyielding stone. My place, however, is here in this land of unending tragedy. E'er must I remain, until the true nature of the primals is revealed unto me.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_100_001: Many seasons did I toil to fashion a net across this vast realm─a net that catcheth not fish, but nuggets of wisdom more valuable than gold.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_100_002: Yet even possessed of this hoard of knowledge, I cannot purchase all the keys to the confounding doors that bar my passage...
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_003: Thus, must I presume to unsheathe the “blade born of light.” Thine is a strength that shattereth the stoutest barriers, and doth pierce that which obfuscates the impotent gaze of ordinary men. We have not the luxury of time required for my measured scholarly pace.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_004: For the Adders' Nest is astir, hissing with the news of Garuda's return. Her winds have grown ever more violent, ever more destructive...
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_005: What lieth behind this sudden waxing of power? The answer may well prove a vital piece of the puzzle of the primals' existence.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_006: Mine eyes perceive a looming wall of strife, poised to crash down upon our cities with unrestrained fury. For the nonce, you must pacify the Lady of the Vortex.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_URIANGER_000_007: Swiftly now, to the Adders' Nest. High Serpent Commander Heuloix will have such details as thou needest to proceed. I shall await thee at the Waking Sands, and pray for thy success.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_VORSAILE_000_010: Ah, ! Might I deduce from your stern expression that you have heard the disturbing news? Aye, Garuda returns once more to plague our nightmares.
TEXT_GAIUSD011_01194_VORSAILE_000_011: I fear this incarnation of the Lady is more tempestuous than aught we have yet witnessed. If you are prepared to face this roiling storm, then I will brief you on what must be done.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_000: We first learned of Garuda's return when the primal fell upon the Blue Badgers as they sought to construct a new watchspire. The devastation was absolute.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_001: According to the report of the one surviving engineer, Garuda invoked the most horrific gale with but a gesture of her taloned hand. The powerful winds tore apart the half-built tower, crushing the workers and scattering their broken bodies like dolls.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_002: By all accounts, it appears the Lady of the Vortex is grown stronger with this summoning. She must be stopped before the casualties are allowed to pile any higher.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_100_002: But as you might imagine, the Ixal, eager to please their bloodthirsty goddess, are engaging our troops on every front. I have not the soldiers to spare for a primal-hunting expedition.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_101_002: Thus, I sent word to the Scions to beg the aid of proven champions. You and your companions are our best hope for freeing Gridania of this rampaging fiend.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_003: I ask that you confront Garuda in her customary domain: the Howling Eye. Such a titanic conflict is best confined to Ixali lands, wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_004: Though I imagine the birdmen have since made “adjustments” to their crystal, the beastman aetheryte found within Natalan remains the surest means of entry. May the Twelve strengthen your arm, .
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_ASCIANSWORD_000_020: Our efforts to augment Garuda's powers were met with the predicted success. It is mildly unsatisfying, then, that the primal was thus summarily defeated.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_0: Against the Bringer of Light, it appears a heavier hand is required. And now that the focus has been discovered...
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_ASCIANSWORD_000_022: It is of no consequence. Even should they understand the significance of its presence, they have no means to prevent the summonings.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_0: And the beastmen continue to crave ever more powerful avatars every time their gods fall. With each link forged in this chain of ambition, the shackles of chaos are bound ever tighter.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_ASCIANSWORD_000_024: It is not for us to entertain such speculation. We are bid only to convey what we have witnessed. Let us be gone from here.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_030:
Once more, Garuda has fallen to your might! You have our gratitude, . We are blessed to count such heroes among our allies.
...What's this? Some memento of the battle, mayhap?
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_031: Ugh, what an uncanny arrangement of bone. I have never seen its like.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_032: I could not guess for what foul ritual this object would be used... Might there be some connection to the primal, considering the place in which it was found?
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_VORSAILE_000_033: I must ask that you take this grisly trophy to the Waking Sands and consult with Urianger. Perhaps he can provide some insight.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_URIANGER_000_040: Thou art returned whole from thy grueling trial. Hath the battle with the Lady gifted thee a glimpse into the primals' fortress of inscrutability?
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_URIANGER_000_041: Hmmm... A ritual focus of Ixali bone, home to what tainted powers I cannot say. Pray leave this curiosity with me, that I might dwell further on its nature.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_URIANGER_000_042: Garuda's unseemly strength was not fueled by crystal caches and tempered worship alone. Nay, I fear some new rite of summoning was employed.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_URIANGER_000_043: The rigid culture of the Ixal rarely spawneth such anomaly. Methinks agents more deeply versed in primal lore have meddled here─the Ascians, for a certainty.
TEXT_GAIUSD012_01195_URIANGER_000_044: And if those servants of Darkness are afoot, they will not stop at a single tribe. Such revelations do much to explain my recent communications. Art thou prepared to struggle once more against a beastman god?
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_000: The Maelstrom has sent word of a mountain-shaking tremor felt by every man and beast in the northern half of Vylbrand.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_001: Aye, the kobolds have awoken the Lord of Crags, and this shuddering arrival doth echo with the heightened strength shown by his sister primal.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_002: Seek thee out High Storm Commander R'ashaht Rhiki at Maelstrom Command in Limsa Lominsa. Thy path leads once more to the stony feet of Titan.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_010: Ah, . Glad I am to see you answer our desperate summons.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_011: As you have no doubt heard, the kobolds have, it seems, yet again called forth the primal Titan within their mountain abode.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_100_011: The recent quaking of the land can be attributed to no other. And, considering the intensity of the tremor, we can be sure that Urianger's warnings concerning the enhanced power of the primals are far from idle.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_012: We Maelstrom officers would, of course, like naught better than to shatter the belligerent old boulder ourselves, but we cannot risk losing our soldiers to tempering. Once again, we must turn to the seasoned veterans of the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_013: According to our readings, the rumblings are strongest in the Navel─Titan's usual haunt within U'Ghamaro Mines.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_014:
You should be able to enter the primal's domain by re-attuning to the beastman aetheryte found within the kobolds' territory in outer La Noscea─after the previous defeat of their Great Father, you can wager they've “recalibrated” their crystal.
May you crash against this stubborn rock with the fury of a thousand waves!
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_0: Titan displayed a most satisfying degree of destructive power. The intensifying effects of the ritual foci are undeniable.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_ASCIANSWORD_000_031: Powerful though this incarnation was, the primal's eventual defeat was not unexpected. The burgeoning strength shown by the Bringer of Light, however, has grown beyond reckoning.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_0: Such a demonstration of force serves us still─it invites ever greater retaliation.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_ASCIANSWORD_000_033: Yes... As the Light burns brighter, so, too, are the shadows steeped deeper in Darkness.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_040:
The rumblings have ceased! It seems that no matter how powerful the Lord of Crags becomes, you and your companions are up to the task.
...Yes? You found something of interest in the Navel?
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_041: Is this...bone? And such a grotesque design. Honestly, I will never understand the kobolds' sense of aesthetics.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_100_041: You say you acquired a similar object after your battle with Garuda? Then we must consider the possibility that these trinkets are responsible for the primals' appalling new strength.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_RASHAHT_000_042: But I shall leave such conclusions to those more learned in the subject than I. Pray return to the Waking Sands and convey my greetings to Urianger.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_050: So, the Lord of Crags was also possessed of unprecedented vigor. And thou hast returned with yet another curiosity of bone?
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_051: The kobolds are not known for fashioning objects in this manner... What is more, its construction doth bear a striking similarity to that of the trophy recovered by thee from Garuda's lair.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_052: The fleshless remains of beastman worshipers─this is the material common to both of these foreboding ritual tools. What unsavory sorcery have the Paragons bequeathed to their unsuspecting pawns?
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_053: There is yet another commonality to this augmentation of the primals that concerns me─and that is thee, .
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_100_053: For every mountain thou dost conquer, I am struck by the answering waxing in potency of the primals. The pattern is too clear to ignore.
TEXT_GAIUSD013_01196_URIANGER_000_054: Such a cycle bodes naught but ill for the realm─I must unlock the true nature of these immortal entities ere the land is once more wracked with ruin. And, as always, thou art my stoutest ally in the gathering of the requisite keys.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_000: We are fortunate that the Lord of the Inferno hath yet to rear his horned head. I fear, however, that reports of his return will not be long in the coming.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_001: My quest for knowledge yet remains unfinished...but such a task can only properly be undertaken in a world unwracked by chaos. Let us bow to inevitability, and prepare ourselves for what will undoubtedly turn into another blistering trial.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_002: Pray visit High Commander Swift at the Hall of Flames in Ul'dah, and advise him that the fiery primal will likely soon be among us once more. Mayhap with a measure of foresight, we can lessen the impact of Ifrit's arrival.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_010: , your timing is most fortunate. Allow me to brief you on the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_011: Both the Maelstrom and the Order of the Twin Adder informed us of their recent troubles with disturbingly powerful primals. And, as these incidents ever occur in threes, we immediately sought to gather intelligence on Amalj'aa activity.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_100_011: We lost contact with the first reconnaissance party assigned to the task. I then deployed one of our elite units to learn the fate of the missing scouts, but they, also, have failed to report back.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_012: In their most recent missive, my elite troops declared their intention to investigate the Bowl of Embers. Though they may have been overwhelmed by the lizardmen, we must consider the possibility that the Lord of the Inferno has reclaimed his domain...
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_013: It is with some measure of wounded pride, then, that I must request your aid. Assemble a group of your companions, and strike into the heart of Amalj'aa territory in southern Thanalan. If Ifrit has indeed returned, you are to banish him back to the aether by whatever means is necessary.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_014: Ah, you will likely have to renew your bond with the Zahar'ak aetheryte to enter the Bowl of Embers─the lizardmen have undoubtedly realigned their crystal since you last felled their god. And, unfortunately, that means cutting your way through a goodly number of their sentries to reach it.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_015: The Grand Company of the Immortal Flames is no stranger to sacrifice when it comes to battling the primals. But the struggle costs far too many lives, and often creates a host of new tempered enemies. You and your unique talents, however, can spare the families of our soldiers that grief...
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_016: I will pass on news of your involvement in this mission to the Scions myself. Should our primal fears prove substantiated, then I pray your efforts meet with success.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_ASCIANSWORD_000_020: (-???-)Ifrit was reborn with the strength of a thousand raging infernos, and yet you vanquished him. I can offer you naught but praise, Bringer of Light.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_0: (-???-)Ever prepared for confrontation. Good. Those instincts serve us as well as they serve you.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_ASCIANSWORD_000_022: What meaning hides within this constant pursuit of ever greater strength? Have you paused to dwell on its significance? However you might choose to justify your actions, it seems you have tested the very limits of these three primal avatars.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_ASCIANSCEPTER_000_0: Again, such furious response. Did we not make ourselves clear? As amusing as such might prove, we do not come to trade blows with you.
This meeting is at an end. We must thank you for a most enlightening display.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_ASCIANSWORD_000_025: (-Ascian-)We have learned much. The destiny we seek draws closer...ever closer...
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_ASCIANSWORD_100_025: (-Ascian-)How much longer can you stem the tide of Darkness, Bringer of Light? How well will you fare against the next god to reawaken? Hm hm hm...
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_030: So, the infernal primal had returned, after all─it is well that you set out prepared for the worst! Come now, , you must describe your epic encounter in detail that we might revise our tactics for future engagements. Any information could prove useful.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_031: Well, now, this is an ominous relic. While the Amalj'aa are known for their barbaric trinkets, I sense something is different about this one.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_032: ...I see, so it is the third such object you have discovered within the domain of a primal. It certainly seems feasible that it played a role in Ifrit's enhanced volatility.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_SWIFT_000_033: Return with your trophy to the Waking Sands, and pray bid Urianger to continue his investigations. Our eternal gratitude to you both.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_040: The report from the Immortal Flames hath flown before thee. Dost thou return once more bearing a curious tool of ritual magicks?
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_041: Ah, yes, it doth most closely resemble the others in form, and, I daresay, in function. The bone is, of course, Amalj'aa in origin.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_042:
...The servants of Darkness revealed themselves to thee? I am put in mind of Archon Louisoix's words: “Yet ever shall primal desires burn”...
For burn they shall, with the Ascians ever toiling to stoke the fires.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_100_042: We are fortunate─their careless taunting hath provided us with certainty, where before there existed only conjecture.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_043: It is unfortunate, however, that thy actions serve the Ascians' purposes so well... Whenever thou slayest our primal foes, the beastmen seek to raise ever more ferocious gods. And now, it seems, their ceaseless ambitions are answered only by living sacrifice.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_044:
Each ritual object thou didst recover is a manner of focus─a tool fashioned from the bones of a willing worshiper. These foci contained the vast aetheric power generated by the fervent prayers of a beastman zealot in the moment of his death...
This power was then poured into each primal during the rite of summoning, thus giving rise to the augmented avatar thou didst engage.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_045: To free us from the threat of the primals in truth, we must needs discover an escape from this endlessly escalating cycle of conflict. Such an answer will not, I fear, be readily attainable.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_046: So, as long as understanding eludes us, there is no recourse but to continue with the slaying of primals. The aether they invariably hoard must be released back into the land.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_000_047: As the beastman deities wax ever more potent, it is a sad necessity that the nurturing of thine own strength cannot be ignored─an action that thou must take, even though it doth quicken the plans of the Paragons.
TEXT_GAIUSD014_01197_URIANGER_100_048: One of the paths to inexorable might hath ever been the pursuit of sturdy arms and armor. And in that endeavor, I may be able to assist thee...
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_URIANGER_000_000: If thou art to weather these constant clashes against ever-more-potent primals, then thou must perforce arm thyself with extraordinary weapons. I have concluded negotiations with one Rowena, a merchant who doth abide at Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_URIANGER_000_001: In exchange for the ritual objects thou hast collected, she hath promised to provide thee with a selection from her stock of unique armaments.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_URIANGER_000_002: Why wouldst she consent to purchase these unsavory trophies? It is a simple question of infamy. Certain of her clientele are like to salivate at the very thought of possessing such forbidden items─there are few who can lay claim to the ownership of a ritual tool employed in the summoning of a primal.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_URIANGER_100_002: There is no cause for alarum. Any power the objects once held has long since been surrendered to the summoned deities. And lest thou worry on my account, I have gleaned from them what wisdom we required.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_URIANGER_000_003: I return to thee thy hard-won prizes. Hie thee to Revenant's Toll in Mor Dhona, and see them swiftly into Rowena's hands.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_ROWENA_000_010: Greetin's, adventurer. So, you're the one as hopes to trade some primal curiosities, are you? Urianger's guaranteed their authenticity, so why don't you let ol' Rowena here have a look at these ritual objects o' yours?
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_ROWENA_000_011: Hmmm, carved from beastman bones, just like he described... Well, I'd be lyin' if I said these trinkets didn't make my skin crawl like a diremite in my undergarments.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_ROWENA_000_012: In case you misunderstand, that's an expression o' high praise, . My customers'll be guttin' each other in the streets for a chance to purchase your trophies! Show them to Laraina, my acquisitions officer, and she'll walk you through the transaction.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_LARAINA_000_020: Gods damn you, Rowena. You promised me a life of excitement in the exotic land of Mor Dhona, and here I am stocking your shelves like a trained opo─ Ahem. May I help you, ?
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_LARAINA_000_021: Ugh! What in the seven unholy hells are those gruesome things!? Beastman ritual tools?
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_LARAINA_000_022: You adventurers and your penchant for stowing the most disgusting souvenirs in your packs! Blech. And that goes twice for Rowena for wanting to stock the stuff, and thrice for her addled customers for begging to buy it!
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_LARAINA_000_023: <sigh> But that's neither here nor there. Whatever it is that drives you folk also fills my purse with coin. Now, were you seeking to trade for aught in particular?
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_LARAINA_000_024: Ah, the special weapons we deal in, is it? Here, take a few of these tokens, and you'll be able to exchange them for any arms you fancy.
TEXT_GAIUSD015_01198_LARAINA_000_025: If you're one of those completionist types, then you'll no doubt want an entire armory of the things! Just bring me another set of those stomach-churning ritual tools, and I'll see you rewarded with more tokens. Best hop to it!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_000: If the flawless crystals you procured for us are to retain their elemental purity during the shaping process, a very specific set of abrasive substances will be required.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_001: Well, I say “substances,” but one might just as well call them one substance─namely “aethersand”─which has four elementally aspected varieties. Alas, aethersand is neither common nor cheap. Indeed, it is not unusual for the abrasive to exceed the value of the precious stones it is used to polish.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_002: Given the rarity of the materials in question, the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah seemed the likeliest place to purchase the quantity we require. When I contacted the guildmaster, however, I was informed that no aethersand was currently available. Though I requested that word be sent as soon as new stock came in, I have yet to receive aught but apologies. I should mention at this point that I placed the order some time before you procured the flawless crystals...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_003: I am well aware that acquiring aethersand is no small feat, of course, and I am not an impatient man─but I fear the more we delay our investigation, the greater the risk that the tower's secrets may fall into the hands of other...less savory parties.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_004: That is why I wish to entrust you with the payment for our purchase, and send you to speak directly with Guildmaster Serendipity. Mayhap the presence of such a distinguished personage will spur the guild into action. In any event, it is my hope that when next we meet, you will have found at least one of the four varieties of aethersand we require!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_SERENDIPITY_000_010: Ah,  ! Welcome, welcome! What brings you here, if I may ask?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_SERENDIPITY_000_011: You're here on behalf of the Sons of Saint Coinach? What fortunate timing─I was just about to contact Master Rammbroes with the news that we've finally managed to acquire a quantity of fire-aspected aethersand.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_SERENDIPITY_000_012: I'm afraid it may be some time before we can supply the other three varieties, but you are welcome to settle accounts for that which we have now. Pray speak with Jemime over th─
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_SERENDIPITY_100_012: Ah. I do beg your pardon. It seems she's assisting another customer.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_013: Come on, there must be something you can do! Without that sand, we'll have to rethink our whole design!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_JEMIME_000_014: I sympathize with your plight, sir, but as I explained the aethersand in question is already spoken for. If you'd like to reserve the next shipment, then I would be happy to accept the funds you've offered as partial payment...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_015: Partial!? Are you saying it's not enough!? I'm already stretching our research budget as it is! <sigh> ...I suppose a man can do without a midday meal for a year or two...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_016: ! It's been too long! What brings you here, then? Got your eye on something expensive, have you?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_JEMIME_000_017: Well, now...that is quite a money pouch. The sound of so many gil clinking together is strangely satisfying, is it not? Calming...and yet invigorating at the same time...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_018: Oh no... You're here for the blooming aethersand, aren't you?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_019: Well, I can't deny the Allagan civilization's a subject worth researching. The chief said he was looking into something big, but we never thought to ask him what.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_020: Wedge and I have been too busy tinkering with a new airship design to think of much else, see. Well, I say “tinkering”...wrestling would be more like it. Still, after much wringing of hands and gnashing of teeth, we've managed to put together a prototype crystal-powered propulsion system.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_021: We got the idea for it when we heard how you lot had used a corrupted crystal on board the Enterprise, as a matter of fact. Anyway, to cut a long story short, our design calls for all four varieties of aethersand.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_022: And that's why I can't just relinquish my claim on this batch here─even for you, . How're we meant to usher in a brave new age of technological innovation if not by technologically innovating, eh!?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_JEMIME_000_023: Ahem. While I hesitate to interrupt such an impassioned speech, duty compels me to point out that this  is a representative of the organization that reserved the aethersand in question─to mention nothing of the fact that  purse is considerably larger than yours.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_025: All right, all right...this batch is yours. I'll let you have it. But if you're going to take my sand, it's only fair that you grant me a role in this project of yours.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_026: I'll take that as a yes. Ahhh, it's not every day you get a chance to experiment with the wonders of the ancients. With any luck, they'll inspire me to think up another technological innovation or two!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_030: Now then, from what you've told me, I'm guessing you'll be needing the other three varieties of elementally aspected aethersand as well, right?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_031: Then rather than sitting on your rump waiting for a shipment that may never come, I reckon your time would be better spent looking for the stuff yourself. And it just so happens that I know of a good place to start...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_032: There is said to be a peddler in northern Thanalan who─very occasionally─handles the earth-aspected variety of aethersand. Wedge is in the process of confirming the rumor as we speak.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_033: I know what you're thinking: when did my timid little friend decide he didn't need me to hold his hand anymore? The answer being: just the other day! TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_034: Head out to Bluefog and you should find him poking about with his new bodyguard. Oh, did I not mention her? Aye, Wedge thought it might be wise to hire an adventurer to accompany him─just in case your heroic example turned out to be less inspiring than he first thought. Heh heh!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_BIGGS_000_035: If you mean to go looking for the aethersand yourself, you'd best catch up with Wedge over in Bluefog. As for me, I plan to set out for Mor Dhona, just as soon as I've finished locking up the workshop.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_NPC_000_040: Save your greetings. If you're looking for a hired blade, then you'll have to look elsewhere. After the day I've had, the only company I crave is the squat, silent type─the type that has a handle and holds no less than a pint of ale.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_NPC_000_041: ...Hm? You wish to hear my tale? I warn you, 'tis no stirring epic─but as you asked... My employer─a Lalafellin lad─wished to pay a visit to a peddler who deals in some manner of special sand. I forget what it was called but 'tis apparently worth a small fortune. Anyway, when we arrived, the man claimed his stock had been stolen by bandits.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_NPC_000_042: Determined not to return empty-handed, we crept into the bandits' stronghold and set about locating the stolen goods. Long story short, alarums were raised, rogues were awoken, and we fled in a blind panic. I was separated from my employer in the confusion and I've not seen him since. Hm? Oh. A friend of yours, is he?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_NPC_000_043: Then you'd best be prepared for the worst. 'Tis just possible the poor sod may yet be lost in the old Amajina mythril mine...but I fear the bandits will have caught up with him by now.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_NPC_000_044: If he's still alive, your Lalafellin friend will probably be hiding somewhere inside the abandoned Amajina mythril mine where the bandits make their lair. You'll not catch me going anywhere near the place, though─I barely escaped with my life as it was!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_050: How could I be so stupid? Sneaking into a bandit's lair... It's...it's just...not the sort of thing I do! And now I'm going to die for it!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_051: No. No, I-I just need to calm down. I can do this. I can be brave. I'm going to stand up, and I'm going to walk out of here. Here we go!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_052: YEEEAAARGH! I'm-sorry-I'm-sorry-I'm-sorry! Please don't kill me! I promise I'll leave and never come...back?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_053: !? Is it really you!? B-But how did you find me? Can you...smell fear?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_054: A-Actually, ignore that smell. Ahem! I expect you're wondering why I'm here? Well, I was just in the process of retrieving some stolen aethersand which Biggs and I need for our research, as it happens. It was, I concede, perhaps a touch foolish─and very nearly fatal─but I did succeed in snatching the stuff before my bodyguard ran away and several dozen bandits came piling after me with knives and axes and what looked very much like a plank with a rusty nail in it.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_055: A-Anyway, the important thing is that the stolen aethersand is right here in my po─ In my─ Oh. Oh dear. It must have fallen out when I was, um...taking evasive maneuvers. It seems I won't be leaving this infernal place for a while yet...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_056: ...You'll find the aethersand in my stead?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_057: Oh, thank the gods! You're a true friend, ! I hope the search doesn't prove too troublesome─the bandits don't seem to care much for visitors...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_058: The aethersand must have slipped out of my pocket while I was busy evading the bandits. I'm sure it's somewhere around here...
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_060: ! Have you had any luck locating the aethersand?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_061: Yes, that's it! I must return to the workshop at once and tell Biggs the wonderful news!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_062: What's that? You're also on a mission to collect aethersand? And you're working with the chief? A “treasure trove of Allagan knowledge,” you say? ...I see.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_063: Then you should really be the one to have this. Biggs and I are far from exhausting all possible avenues of airship innovation, but it sounds as if your problem can't be solved by any other means.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_064: This expedition of yours sounds jolly interesting, I must say... I'm half-inclined to join you. In fact─I think I will! Any venture worth the chief's time must be worth a look!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_WEDGE_000_065: Right! I'm more than ready to leave this awful place behind! And you should return to Mor Dhona with that aethersand before there are any more, um...little mishaps. Be sure to keep a close eye on your pockets, !
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_070: Ah, , you have returned. I take from your presence that you were successful in procuring us some aethersand. Tell me, which variety did you find?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_071: ...I see! Two varieties. Well, that is two more than could reasonably be expected─and two less than I had hoped you would say. Forgive my flippancy. You have done well, truly. If all goes to plan, we need no longer fear death by fire or earth.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_072: Master Garlond─if you would be so kind as to prepare the relevant crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_CID_000_073: I shall set to work immediately. Truth be told, I've been looking forward to this. One does not encounter materials like these every day.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_CID_000_074: Speaking of which, how in the seven hells did you find them? Mistake me not, old friend─I know only too well how capable you are, but aethersand isn't something you simply find gathering dust at the back of a merchant's rare gem cabinet.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_CID_000_075: ...You had help from Biggs and Wedge?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_CID_000_076: Hmph! Trust them to design a revolutionary new engine the moment I turn my back. How's a genius meant to rest on his laurels when his employees are so damnably inventive, eh? And now they're determined to join us, are they? Typical!
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_CID_000_077: I jest, of course. It will be good to have them around. Still, as a matter of professional pride, let's endeavor to procure the two remaining varieties of aethersand before they arrive, shall we? Tell me, Rammbroes─have we any information on where the water- and wind-aspected types might be hiding?
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_078: Naught as of yet, but...I have made certain arrangements. We shall soon see if my efforts have borne fruit.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_CID_000_079: Forgive me for observing, but you seem less than enthusiastic about that prospect. If there's a complication, I'd rather we discuss it now than risk jeopardizing the expedition.
TEXT_GAIUSD202_01200_RAMMBROES_000_080: <sigh> Mayhap an explanation is in order. But first, let us savor the preliminary victory that  has won for our cause, if only for a moment.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_000: Yes, yes...I must speak of the arrangements I made to acquire the two remaining varieties of aethersand.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_001: Some days ago, I asked a Sharlayan acquaintance of mine to travel to Gridania and there gather the necessary materials. Since that time, however, I have heard nary a whisper from him.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_002: To be frank, this lack of communication is not entirely uncharacteristic, but I cannot discount the possibility that something ill has befallen the man.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_003: Alas, we do not have time to investigate his fate. As I have mentioned before, the more we delay our expedition, the more likely it is that the Crystal Tower's secrets will fall into the wrong hands. Therefore, I would entrust you with the same mission I assigned to my friend. Travel to the Black Shroud, and seek out Parsemontret, the master of the markets in Gridania. If anyone knows where aethersand might be bought, it is he.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_PARSEMONTRET_000_01: Yes? ...I'm sorry? Did you say you wish to purchase aethersand?  have you the faintest idea of the rarity of the material you seek? Why, I have not seen so much as a grain of aethersand in these markets for many a long year.
I could tell you where one might mine the ore from which the water-aspected variety of the abrasive is derived, but only a desperate fool would willingly set foot in the place.

Are you familiar with Urth's Gift? That is where the ore is to be found─in an area inhabited by a particularly pernicious hog. Should you encounter the betusked nightmare, you will know that you are in the right place...albeit at the wrong time. Farewell!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_020: (-Disembodied Voice-)You are too late, adventurer─and not only for the entertainment. You will find no trace of the ore which but recently lay here. Nay, not so much as a speck.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_021: (-Disembodied Voice-)Ah...no. You will never spy me from there. For the time being at least, you will have to trust the evidence of your ears. Now stop squinting at the foliage and listen.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_022: (-Disembodied Voice-)As I told you, the water-blessed mineral you hoped to find is gone─taken by me.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_023: (-Disembodied Voice-)Victory has made me magnanimous, however. Accordingly, I have decided to share the location of an alternative source of aethersand with you─the wind-touched variety, to be specific. I trust I have your attention? Good. A band of Ixal in the North Shroud keeps a quantity of the abrasive for the purpose of removing impurities from lesser crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_024: (-Disembodied Voice-)Well? Do you mean to dally here all day? Make haste, adventurer, before I snatch another prize from under your nose! This is to be a race.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_025: (-Disembodied Voice-)The Ixali logging grounds in the North Shroud shall be our destination. And that is where the real amusement will begin. May the best man win!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_030: (-Disembodied Voice-)Bravo! That was quite a show, adventurer! Why, the spectacle proved so enthralling that all thoughts of aethersand slipped my mind.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_040: (-Disembodied Voice-)I appear to have forfeited our little race! Congratulations─the wind-touched abrasive is yours.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_041: (-Disembodied Voice-)And yet, having been treated to such a memorable performance, I cannot help feeling that the greater prize is mine. This inequity must not stand. I insist that you accept a token of my appreciation.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_042: (-Disembodied Voice-)Payment for this entertainment will be waiting for you to the east, in a clearing within Proud Creek. Pray retrieve the gift ere it is crushed beneath the iron feet of the dullahans!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_050: (-Disembodied Voice-)Not what you were expecting? I took the liberty of refining the ore from Urth's Gift into aethersand. Do keep it safe, adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_051: (-Disembodied Voice-)Lest you accuse me of playing games, you should know that the thought of relinquishing my prize never once crossed my mind─until I saw you in action. Such deeds must needs be rewarded.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_052: (-Disembodied Voice-)It is my vocation, you see, to record history as it is made by mortal men. And I much prefer to chronicle the accomplishments of the bold and the mighty.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_053: (-Disembodied Voice-)Thus, it is my fervent wish that you continue your career with the same courage and zeal you have shown today. We shall meet again, adventurer─and sooner than you may imagine.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_060: What news of your mission? Are we any closer to acquiring the remaining abrasives?
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_061: You've brought both!? I shall have Master Garlond begin work on the crystals immediately.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_062: There. That should do the trick!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_063: Excellent work! We now possess all four of the “fangs” required to pierce the Crystal Tower's defenses. My compliments, Master Garlond!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_064: Oh, it was a trifling matter, I assure you.  here is the one you should be thanking. Anyway, by my reckoning, there's nothing stopping us from striding up to the Allagans' front door!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_066: Biggs! Wedge! Come to lend a hand, have you?
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_BIGGS_000_067: Well, it's not every day you get the chance to study the wonders of the Allagan Empire, is it? Their technology makes Garlemald's look ancient!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_068: I appreciate your enthusiasm, lads, I really do, but we're not here to take this knowledge for ourselves.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_069: Twice in the last decade, the promise of unimaginable power has prompted men to meddle with technology they do not understand, and the realm has been dragged unto the very brink of oblivion on both occasions. We shall not be so irresponsible as to risk another.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_070: Wedge, do you recall our company's creed?
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_WEDGE_000_071: Y-Yes, Chief! It's, um, “Freedom through Technology”?
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_072: Exactly. Freedom. When we forsook our homeland, we swore that we would have no truck with machines that could be used to promote tyranny. That has not changed. Should you feel tempted to break your oath, remember this: the wonders of the all-knowing Allagan Empire could not save their civilization, and have damn near doomed ours. Twice.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_CID_000_073: That is why we must explore the Crystal Tower, and, if needs be, seal away its secrets.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_074: (-Familiar Voice-)A compelling viewpoint. It is unyielding wills such as yours that have defined the course of history.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_075: So, you return at last. What, pray tell, has kept you so wholly preoccupied that you could not spare a moment to inform me of your progress or preservation?
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_076: (-Familiar Voice-)Why, the task you assigned to me, of course. Surely you have not forgotten about the aethersand? I tasked a passing adventurer with delivering it. A more capable courier I could not imagine.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_077: (-Familiar Voice-)Greetings, adventurer! Did I not say we would meet again?
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_078: I believe an introduction is in order. I am G'raha Tia, one of the Students of Baldesion. I look forward to joining you on your groundbreaking expedition!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_079: G'raha Tia has been assigned to the project as an observer. I hope you will forgive him his...eccentricities and welcome him as one of our own.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_080: So then, our fellowship is complete, and all stand ready to step into the unknown! Three cheers for NOAH!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_082: That is the name I have chosen for our little collective. Given our differing backgrounds, we cannot very well call ourselves the Sons of Saint Coinach, can we?
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_GRAHATIA_000_083: And we must have a memorable appellation if our venture is to leave its mark in the annals of history. I could claim that NOAH stands for “Nominated Observers of Artifacts Historical,” and so it does, technically─but my true reason for choosing this name stems from the fact that it is shared by a vaunted Allagan archmagus.
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_WEDGE_000_084: An archmagus? I like the sound of that!
TEXT_GAIUSD203_01201_RAMMBROES_000_085: ...Very well. Now that the pressing matter of what to call ourselves has been settled, it is time we set forth to brave the outer defenses of the Crystal Tower. Is everyone ready to depart?
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_000: ! The secrets of ancient Allag beckon!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_001: Let's not keep them waiting any longer! Adventurer─you and I will join the engineers at the Crystal Tower's main gateway, where we will endeavor to neutralize the structure's outer defenses.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_002: Rammbroes, meanwhile, will remain here and oversee the operation. Given my knowledge of Allagan history, it seems logical that I should lead the expedition itself...though I admit the role does not exactly befit my status as an observer.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_003: Still, we can but make use of the resources at hand. Assuming all are in agreement, let us proceed forthwith to the large, lopsided gate found to the southeast.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_010: The Crystal Tower lies beyond this portal. Now comes the interesting part...
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_011: Cid, you are the only one of our number who has ever crossed this threshold. I ask that you take the lead for the present.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_012: I say... The energy radiating from these statues is...palpable.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_013: Lucky for us that it is. One might otherwise stroll past them... Feast your eyes on the elemental defenses which prompted our lengthy preparations. These sentinels prevent would-be intruders from advancing to within twenty yalms of the tower's inner reaches.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_014: ...No matter how swift they may be.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_015: Happily, the crystal fangs we took such pains to craft should spare us the inconvenience of instantaneous annihilation. Here, allow me to demonstrate.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_017: Dangerous to allow anyone else to risk his life testing one? Quite right. I made the damn things─it's my job to see that they work.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_019: I for one am convinced! Friends─ready your fangs!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_020: This last one is yours, old friend. It seemed only right...
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_WEDGE_000_021: Haha! We did it! So much for the outer defenses!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_022: Indeed. The entrance to the tower is near at hand. My blood fairly sings with anticipation!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_023: Speaking of blood─I have a proposal for the next stage of the expedition.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_024: I suggest we wait here while  and a handpicked party of  adventuring companions enter the tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_025: What!? Without us? I thought we came here to survey the entire structure!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_026: We did─and we will. But our investigations must proceed at a more measured pace.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_027: If the outside of the place is this well defended, can you imagine what awaits us on the inside? Only a true hero could reasonably hope to brave the hazards ahead and live to tell the tale.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_028: here fits that description better than anyone I know.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_029: And it is not as if we shall be idle in  absence. While  and  companions are risking life and limb to beat us a path to the tower, we can set about analyzing this rubble for evidence of how its technologies function.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_030: Your knowledge of ancient lore will be invaluable in that endeavor, Historian G'raha Tia.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_031: Bah! Do you ever tire of being right, old man!?
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_032: Ahem. ─as it seems I won't be accompanying you, allow me at least to provide some instruction. The maze that surrounds the base of the tower is known as the “Labyrinth of the Ancients.” During this initial foray, I suggest you concentrate on ridding the place of hostile elements.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_033: When you are reasonably certain the maze is secure, contact me via linkshell and we shall join you posthaste─no matter what Master Garlond says!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_034: Though we would prefer it if any relics you encounter remained intact, you have leave to do whatever is necessary to secure ingress to the upper levels of the tower. Fortune go with you, .
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_041: Very impressive, I must say! Your name shall be writ large in the volumes that are sure to be penned on this historic expedition.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_042: The scale of this structure defies comprehension... Someone plainly thought bigger was better.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_043: According to the findings of my Baldesion colleagues, the Crystal Tower was constructed to collect and store the endless energies of the sun. A characteristically ambitious undertaking.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_044: Now, what of the tower's inner defenses? Judging by your haggard expression, clearing out the labyrinth was no small feat.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_045: ...A giant of a man wielding a shimmering scimitar, you say? Yes, that will have been Phlegethon. Not Acheron. Phlegethon. He was a hero of the Allagan revolution.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_046: And you gleaned that from what exactly? His choice of weapon?
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_047: Well, I am a historian. And I have a certain, shall we say, “affinity” for the lore of the Allagan Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_048: It is, of course, all knowledge gleaned from musty scrolls and tomes. The ancient texts claim that the Crystal Tower is defended by the champions of eld, resurrected and augmented through the Allagans' extraordinary technology.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_BIGGS_000_049: Chief, you need to see this!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_050: Well, well, there it is...the foot of the tower. What surprises do you have in store for us, I wonder...?
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_CID_000_051: I can't tell you how glad I am to have you with us on this little jaunt, old friend. Had you not beaten a path through that maze, I very much doubt we'd be standing here now...
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_052: Well! We have much to discuss and digest. Let us retire to Saint Coinach's Find for the present and there plan our next step. Lest there be any doubt, our expedition has some way to go yet!
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_060: So good of you to join us, ! Our meeting would be dull indeed without a full account of your experiences in the labyrinth.
TEXT_GAIUSD204_01202_GRAHATIA_000_061: Take a moment to collect yourself, and when you are ready, we shall debate how best to proceed.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_GRAHATIA_000_000: The fellowship of NOAH being accounted for, it is time this assembly was called to order!
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_GRAHATIA_000_001: Rammbroes will be presiding over the meeting. If you would be so kind as to inform him of your readiness to proceed...
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_010: Welcome back, . I have just been reading about your encounter in the Labyrinth of the Ancients. It pleases me greatly to note that you seem none the worse for the experience.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_011: For your reference, I have added my own notes to G'raha's preliminary expedition report, and begun compiling a Crystal Tower survey log. The information contained therein will be available to you at all times. Should you have any questions, you need only ask.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_012: Now, if there are no objections, I shall begin with a summary of the expedition's key accomplishments.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_020: In the course of this, our first foray into the grounds of the Crystal Tower, we succeeded in neutralizing the structure's outer defenses, before proceeding to secure the maze surrounding the base of the spire.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_021: According to 's account, the labyrinth's defenses were most emphatically active. Disturbingly,  report also mentions a violent encounter with a sentry heavily augmented by Allagan technology...
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_CID_000_022: In short: our misgivings were well founded. The Crystal Tower was not simply thrust above ground by the chaotic shifting of earth─it has somehow been reawoken.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_CID_000_023: If, as seems increasingly likely, the tower's secrets should prove too dangerous to share with the world, we will have no choice but to contain them. Short of leveling the place, this will almost certainly involve returning its mechanisms to a state of dormancy. To do that, however, we will first need to address the question of how they work─the answer to which must surely be waiting for us inside the tower itself. In conclusion: that is where we must go.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_GRAHATIA_000_024: A task rather easier said than done, if the perils of the labyrinth are any indication...
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_025: Then I move that all further exploration of the tower be delayed until such time as an exhaustive analysis of the structure's defenses has been completed. Master Garlond, may I entrust this task to you?
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_BIGGS_000_028: It's like you said, Chief─we founded the Ironworks to make sure that technology was used for the right reasons, and that means making sure it's not used for the wrong ones. We wouldn't be doing our jobs if we didn't see this through to the end.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_CID_000_029: Lads... Well, I hope you're ready for some backbreaking chores!
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_GRAHATIA_000_030: Well, everything seems to be in hand here, so I shall take my leave of you for the present. If I am to witness this valiant tale unfold with mine own eyes, I must needs hone my martial skills ere we ascend the spire!
