TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_031: You'll do nothing of the sort, G'raha. Your knowledge may prove useful to Master Garlond's investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_GRAHATIA_000_032: As an observer, I am not, strictly speaking, subject to your authority...
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_GRAHATIA_000_033: Pray do not mistake my intent, . I am well aware that I shall never be a match for one with your innate talents, however hard I train. Be that as it may, pray do not allow your skills to rust from disuse during the coming pause.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_GRAHATIA_000_034: We will need you fighting fit if our subsequent forays are to prove as productive as this one. Mark me: we have not yet caught more than the briefest glimpse of that which time has obscured. Soon, however, we shall cast off the veil, and gaze upon the glory of the Allagan Empire!
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_RAMMBROES_000_035: And with that encouraging thought in mind, it is time to bring this assembly to a close. Let us all focus on the tasks at hand, that our next expedition may begin all the sooner. Meeting adjourned!
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_NERO_000_040: Such a terrible mess. Yet it does leave the door wide open, so to speak.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_NERO_000_041: One cannot help but be impressed. I'm beginning to understand the reliance you place on adventurers, old friend.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_NERO_000_042: So...this is the legacy the Allagan Empire left behind.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_NERO_000_043: If my readings are correct, the energy source waiting atop the tower is a match for even the Ultima Weapon. Nay...more than a match.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_NERO_000_044: Heh heh heh... A new toy for me to play with.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_NERO_000_045: I believed the fates had conspired to deny me my just rewards once again...but it would seem they had a greater destiny in mind for me.
TEXT_GAIUSD205_01203_NERO_000_046: And so long as my ambition burns, I shall strive to seize it. The dream lives on, Cid... Do not disappoint me!
TEXT_GAIUSD016_01309_LARAINA_000_000: Ah, such a typical adventurer─powerless to resist the lure of our unique merchandise! Can I assume you're interested in earning more of Rowena's tokens?
TEXT_GAIUSD016_01309_LARAINA_000_001: As it happens, we've been inundated with orders from wealthy fools who are desperate to decorate their manors with ghastly primal-summoning tools. And you, my friend, are our most trusted supplier. Bring me the goods in complete sets of three, and we can do business.
TEXT_GAIUSD016_01309_LARAINA_000_010: We've been inundated with orders for more of those primal-summoning tools. Bring me the goods in complete sets of three, and we can do business.
TEXT_GAIUSD016_01309_LARAINA_000_011: Not so fast, . Allow me to just... Yes, the shudder down my spine confirms their authenticity. Your tokens, as promised.
TEXT_GAIUSD016_01309_LARAINA_000_012: ...Hmph. Rowena shall rue the day she began treating me like a lackey! I'm positioned now to woo her most affluent patrons, and the Twelve take me if I don't steal them all away the day I open my very own store!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_000: A crystal-choked abyss lieth beneath the Carteneau Flats─the unholy cradle of an elder primal. And by thy hand were truths great and terrible wrested from those once-celestial depths.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_001: Yet, as is oft the case, an answer doth breed a profusion of questions, and the unknown doth beckon with irresistible allure. Ne'er have the mysteries of the red moon lain so neatly within our grasp...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_002: Lady Alisaie hath sent word of her coming. 'Tis time once more to brave the precipice, and leap, unflinching, into the jagged wound that doth gape beneath the land.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_003: Mine apologies. I trust I have not kept you waiting overlong?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_004: . I am both delighted and reassured to have you at my side once more.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_005: I would not waste your time with trivialities─let us proceed directly to the discussion of that which we have learned, and that which we hope to learn anon.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_006: Initially, it was evidence of a new primal that led us to delve into the cavern beneath Castrum Occidens, and to explore the subterranean scars left after the fall of Dalamud.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_007: As you will well recall, what we found was a vast, largely intact fragment of the fallen satellite. And within the depths of that structure, we discovered not the new primal we had expected, but the broken form of Bahamut himself.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_008: ...Yet even this great revelation would soon be overshadowed...by the appearance of my own dear grandfather.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_009: I have since shared our sundry findings with Rammbroes, preeminent scholar of the Sons of Saint Coinach, and he, in turn, did kindly furnish me with his theory concerning the elder primal's Allagan prison.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_010: 'Twould seem that Dalamud was constructed to gather unto itself the rays of the sun, and thence channel this radiant bounty unto the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_011: The ancients saw great potential in Bahamut's capacity to manipulate energies of otherwise unmanageable magnitude─'twas for this reason that they did bind him within the red moon to serve as its living core.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_012: Do you remember the sight that greeted us at the culmination of our journey─the colossal devices that surrounded and seemed to cradle the incomplete form of the elder primal?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_013: From the information provided to us by the Sons of Saint Coinach, we have learned that these contraptions were termed “internment hulks,” and that each bore the designation “Ragnarok-class.”
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_014: The purpose of these hulks is believed to be twofold. First, they are meant to act as binding coils, rendering Bahamut incapable of escape.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_015:
And second...
They are meant to feed him. Perversely, the selfsame energy which prevents him from moving also serves to sustain his corporeal manifestation. Bahamut is permitted neither to die, nor to truly live...he merely is allowed to be.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_016: For century upon century was the elder primal thus imprisoned─bound about in fetters so subtle in their working, and yet so adamant, that though his cell be destroyed, Bahamut lieth yet at the mercy of his long-departed captors.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_017: ...It has long been held that the primals require the prayers of their faithful followers to exist, yet none alive worship Bahamut. Could it be, then, that the Allagans found a way to simulate prayer itself?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_018: It seems the only logical explanation. I would postulate therefore that the regenerative mechanisms in question also supply something akin to the power of prayer.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_019: Consequently, if all of the internment hulks were to be rendered inactive, Bahamut should dissolve into the aether.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_URIANGER_000_020: Upon the evidence of thy previous foray, we determined that the elder primal is sustained by three such binding coils. Thus did we commence to scour the realm, and found in the Twelveswood an as-yet-unexplored fragment of the lesser moon bearing a most familiar aetheric signature...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_021: And after conducting a preliminary investigation, we believe we have discovered a point from which this North Shroud fragment─and the second of the internment hulks─can be entered.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_022: As Eorzea's sword in the darkness, I would have you once more lead the charge.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_023: I will, of course, be there at your side.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_024: Once you have made your preparations, head to Fallgourd Float and make yourself known to my assistant, Serpent Lieutenant Anaelle. The fallen fragment is not far from the settlement, and her position provides a convenient rendezvous point.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_025: I will break these Allagan fetters. For they bind my grandfather as surely as they bind Bahamut...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_020: ? I have been expecting you. My name is Anaelle.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_021: I have been accorded the rank of lieutenant within the Order of the Twin Adder that I may better assist Lady Alisaie with her endeavors here in the Twelveswood.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_022: Such authority has allowed me to act without interference from the local soldiery, and to conduct a preliminary investigation of the Alder Springs fragment.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_023: From what we have seen of the exterior, the structure shares many common features with the one you explored in La Noscea, and likely plays host to a similar complement of guardians.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_024: But I fear words alone will do little to prepare you for what lies ahead. Pray seek out my comrade to the south and west. He is charged with observing all that occurs in the vicinity of the fragment, and will be well placed to show you the thing if nothing less.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_FOLLOWER01313_000_0: What business brings you to this broken land? Unless you fancy being ground to a bloody pulp under the granite fists of a wandering golem, I suggest you bugger o─
Oh! My apologies, ! Lady Alisaie did send word of your impending arrival, but 'twould seem I've grown rather too accustomed to shooing away curious sellswords and reckless explorers.
Behold, if you will, one of the fallen shards of the red moon, Dalamud.
Our initial survey uncovered no evidence of the Empire's presence, which, while fortunate in itself, meant that the approach to the fragment had yet to be cleared.
After much effort, however, we succeeded in carving out a semblance of a path which should grant you access to the entrance. And that, I'm afraid, is where our progress ended.

The interior? Well, assuming that the architecture of this hulk resembles the first, the master controls you seek will be located on the bottommost layer─past all the ingenious and deadly defenses of which the ancient Allagans seemed so indecently fond.
If you would know more, I'm afraid there is nothing for it but to brave the depths of the fragment yourself.
Lady Alisaie will soon be arriving at Fallgourd. Pray do not tarry on your way back to the lieutenant's post─I imagine our young mistress will be most eager to commence the expedition.
The road ahead promises peril aplenty, and I would humbly suggest that this is not the occasion to stint on preparation or provisions. May the Twelve watch over you...
Pray return to Fallgourd Float and await Lady Alisaie's arrival. Oh, and...do take care when you're exploring.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_050: . I trust the private's explanation was worth the journey?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_051: Simply securing an approach to the fragment's entrance proved a monumental task. I dare not think what defeating its inner defenses will entail. If there is aught I might do to aid you─
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_052: Ah, Lady Alis─ Oh! My apologies, Master Alphinaud! Has there been a change of plan?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Urianger informed me of the impending expedition. I merely came to exchange a few words with my fellow Scion before  disappeared into the depths of the second coil.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_054: ─though I would strenuously deny it were she present, my sister's admiration and affection for our grandsire exceeds even mine own.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Upon the matter of his legacy, therefore, Alisaie is wont to go above and beyond the call of duty. In our grandfather's absence, she has made the salvation of Eorzea her personal crusade.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_056: 'Twas that which prompted her to brave the perils of the first coil. Yet the fact that she risks her life in this manner is not the greatest of my concerns. No, it is her subsequent fixation upon my grandfather's shade that worries me most. This quest to rid the world of Bahamut must not become a quest to “save” a man long dead.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_057: My sister must needs have a better reason to fight. A time will come when the fate of the realm rests upon our shoulders, and when it does, we must be strong in our resolve─and certain of the stakes for which we risk all.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_058: There is a wide difference between fighting for the good of Eorzea, and fighting for the love of a man who died for the good of Eorzea. Alisaie must choose her own path. She cannot rely on Grandfather to choose it for her, for he is gone.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_059: ...I am glad that it is you with whom she makes this journey.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_060: If Alisaie is to discover a deeper purpose, then where better to find one than at the side of Eorzea's greatest champion? ...'Twas there that I found mine, after all.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_061: But 'tis past time I was gone! Fair fortune in your endeavors, .
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Ah. Lieutenant Anaelle, was it? I would appreciate you making no mention of my presence here to my sister.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ANAELLE_000_063: Lady Alisaie is due to arrive at any moment. I shall abide in confident expectation of your triumphant return!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_SYSTEM_000_070: You now have access to the Second Coil of Bahamut. Begin your expedition into this fragment of Dalamud by speaking with Anaelle.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_SYSTEM_000_071: Details such as the conditions of entry may also be had by speaking with the serpent lieutenant.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_100: How strange. Why could we not see all this before?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_101: I suppose it is only to be expected that corrupted crystals should accompany a disturbance of this magnitude. After all, the fragment likely pierced the ground to a depth of many hundreds of yalms.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_102: The swirling aether leaking from the wound must warp the very air, creating a veil that hides these formations from view.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_103: Well, it is not as if we expected this to be a straightforward task. Let's tread carefully, shall we, ?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_104: 'Tis imperative that we win through to the depths of this structure, and disable the mechanism that powers Bahamut's regeneration. Of course, if we should chance to encounter my grandfather upon the way...I shall not let him go again─not while there is hope that he may yet be saved.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_105: ...But mayhap we should put such thoughts from our minds until after we have successfully gained entrance to the place. That opening up ahead appears a suitable point of ingress.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_120: That armor─ No, it couldn't be!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_121: Be on your guard, ! Though it defies all reason that he should live, .
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_122: . The legatus of the VIIth Legion.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_123: I speak of the madman who brought the Meteor project to fruition...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_124: We face the White Raven, Nael van Darnus─harbinger of the Seventh Umbral Era!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_126: (-???-)Ah... That was the name of the fool who perished upon the eve of the promised age of glory. It should not be uttered within these hallowed halls.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_127: Out of love for His loyal servant, the one true deity named me Nael deus Darnus.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_128: The “one true deity”? Bahamut! He speaks of Bahamut!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_129: O Lord Bahamut! Thy name is as sweet water to parched lips! How my heart swells at Thy sacred touch!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_130: This blessed sanctum is the domain of my god and His beloved children. Seek to defile its glory, and you will answer to me.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_133: Whatever the truth of the matter, we must be on our guard─there can be no reasoning with the worshipers of a primal.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_150: I am reminded of the passages beneath Castrum Occidens. We must have traveled quite some distance below the surface.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_151: More of the same tunnels... Twelve be good! Surely they cannot continue all the way down from the upper floors?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_152: 'Tis difficult to see inside, but I have a terrible feeling those corridors house more of the dreadful guardians you have already faced.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_153: It is said that the Allagans excelled in the creation of chimerical beasts, and that the red moon teemed with a thousand thousand fantastical monstrosities─all to prevent the enemies of the ancient empire from releasing the elder primal.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_154: I wonder, the creatures that prowl these halls─could they be the “beloved children” of which Nael spoke?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_155: Well, this is yet another mystery to ponder upon our return. Shall we continue onwards?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_170: That...that surely cannot be Dalamud!? How─ Where are we!?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_173: This is a grave for the undeserving.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_174: And for the crime of trespassing upon my god's sanctuary, this place shall serve as your grave too!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_176: In the hour of his failure, Nael van Darnus felt the currents of aether begin to bear away his essence. But before oblivion could claim the last of him, a divine will reached out...and I was born.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_177: Then did the words of my god resound in mine ears...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_178: “Bring unto mine enemies crushing defeat, that they might know despair without end! And claim thee thus the victory which thou wert once denied!”
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_179: ...'Twould seem that little remained of Nael's essence when Bahamut plucked him from the brink of oblivion. And the result was this strange...simulacrum. Nevertheless, her aura bespeaks great power. She channels the rage of the elder primal himself...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_180: Lord Bahamut! Thy wish is my command! None shall 'scape Thine unquenchable fury!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_181: Come, ye dull, unthinking beasts...bare your teeth!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_182: They will avail you naught in the calamity to come!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_200: Poor creature. Would that you had never been born.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_201: You had surrendered your physical form, and collapsed into aether... But Bahamut denied you death, and imprisoned what little was left of you in an aetherial shell resembling...what, I wonder? Images from your memory, perhaps?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_202: But that shell is now broken. And your primal deity seems disinclined to sustain your existence.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_203: My “primal deity”? I kneel to no eikon! What need have I to beg the favor of such filth!?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_204: (-Nael van Darnus-)I am Nael van Darnus! Legatus of the VIIth Legion...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_205: (-Nael van Darnus-)No... A moment... My thoughts are clouded...and this body is not mine own. Could it be that you spoke the truth? Was I ensorcelled by the lesser moon's ancient prisoner? ...That will not happen again.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_206: You speak as if Bahamut no longer controlled you! But that's impossible! Once a primal ensnares a mind, it cannot be freed!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_207: Unless... Unless Bahamut simply relinquished his claim. What need has he of a broken spirit bound for the aetherial realm?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_208: (-Nael van Darnus-)Ohhh...that I should fall prey to the very influence I sought to purge from the land. The irony is galling.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_209: (-Nael van Darnus-)But do not assume that all of my actions were chosen for me. It was my will that the Meteor project be resurrected─mine and none other.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_210: (-Nael van Darnus-)Yet it seems that my grand designs were destined to fail. Even the ungentle release of death was denied me...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_211: Nael, please. You must tell us more of the Calamity. I must know the truth of what has befallen the world...and what has become of my grandfather, Archon Louisoix.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_212: (-Nael van Darnus-)You are Louisoix's grandchild? Ah, the fates are generous with their cruelty.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_213: (-Nael van Darnus-)Continue on, if you would have your answers─they await you at the terminus of your path. But know that this path leads only to despair. The light of truth was ever harsh and unforgiving...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_214: Why do you say this? Grandfather will be freed once we put a stop to Bahamut's restoration, will he not? What are you not telling us!?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_215: (-Nael van Darnus-)Steel yourself, child. Only unbending resolve and merciless strength can conquer what lies ahead.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_216: (-Nael van Darnus-)The weak can do naught but weep under the pall of their own misery. As did the frail child I once was...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_LOUISOIX_000_217: (-???-)Silence, chattering raven. Your wretched wings are broken, and you shall soar no more.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_NAEL_000_218: (-Nael van Darnus-)My crimson moon... Your brilliance sears mine eyes...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_219: I recognize that voice, . But never would he say such words...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_220: Come, let us finish what we came to do. All will be put aright when the final hulk lies dormant. Grandfather will be himself again...I'm sure of it.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_240: Bahamut regenerates more swiftly than I had anticipated. Let us hope that disabling this coil will serve to slow the process.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_241: The display seems...different, but the controls appear to mimic the mechanism we found in the La Noscean hulk. It shouldn't pose a problem.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_242: ..., forgive me. The moment I beheld Nael's transformation, hope wilted in my heart. I did not believe you could stand against the manifestation of Bahamut's power.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_243: For all your fabled strength and skill, I felt certain then that I was going to lose you─just as I lost my grandfather. Even he, a man for whom naught seemed impossible, was humbled before Bahamut's might.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_244: And yet, look how far we have come.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_245: 'Tis incredible the feats of which we are capable─our boundless potential.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_246: 'Twas this capacity for greatness, I believe, that Grandfather so dearly wished to protect. With all that has occurred, I have come to understand that much at least.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_247: 'Tis done. Shall we make our way back to the surface and gather our thoughts? We have seen much that will benefit from Urianger's learned perspective.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_LOUISOIX_000_249: Abandon this quest, Alisaie. I will not countenance further sabotage of the coils.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_250: “Sabotage”? But...but we must disable the coils if we are to prevent Bahamut's revival!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_252: No... No, you are not who I thought you were... My grandfather would never...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_LOUISOIX_000_254: How could the White Raven allow herself to be bested by such sniveling opponents?
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_LOUISOIX_000_255: Listen well. We all exist at the pleasure of one divine will.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_LOUISOIX_000_256: And the word of Lord Bahamut is absolute!
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_LOUISOIX_000_257: Scurry back into your holes, vermin. You have been granted this one reprieve. But should you be so foolish as to crawl into my lord's domain again, I will crush the life from you myself.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_258: That light in Grandfather's eyes... He has suffered the same fate as Nael.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_259: My grandsire is no more. That was naught but a phantom that profanes his noble memory...
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_260: This mockery must be expunged! I will not rest until I free Grandfather's soul from Bahamut's tyranny.
TEXT_GAIUSD301_01313_ALISAIE_000_261: Do you hear me, Bahamut? Your time is at an end! Eorzea─and my family─will be avenged!
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_000: Truly, it is wonderful to escape that stifling air, and return to...northern Thanalan again, it would appear.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_001: I must thank you, . Were it not for your bravery, I strongly doubt that I would be standing here now. Ah, but you need not tarry on my account─the danger has passed. Pray go on ahead, and apprise Urianger of all that has occurred.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_002: I will join you anon. My thoughts are yet unruly, and I would rest here a while...
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_010: Pray return to the Waking Sands, and report our success to Urianger. I shall follow in due course.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_020: The triumphant hero doth return! Thine eyes speak of the dread task's completion: the second coil now lieth dormant!
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_021: ...Yet I sense the tidings thou bearest are not altogether glad. Pray tell me: what ill hath cast the shadow which falleth now across thy brow?
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_022: An old foe and an old friend...
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_023: So 'twas but the aetherial shadow of Master Louisoix that Lady Alisaie beheld─an unnatural conjuration in thrall to the elder primal.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_024: That the fiend should deign to choose him of all men... Even in full knowledge of the shade's true nature, I would be hard-pressed to weather such a confrontation.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_025: Yet what agonies must the young mistress have endured? Such torment did she ne'er deserve. Mayhap 'twere better if the Lady Alisaie did absent herself from future forays unto the coils.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_026: (-???-)I have come too far to surrender to grief, Urianger.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_028: I am resolved to defeat these fiends─and naught shall sway me from my path. Now, let us peer more deeply into the well of our discoveries.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_030: By your leave, I would speak first of the coil's late guardian, Nael van Darnus.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_037: He was fortunate indeed to acquire so powerful a thrall by chance.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_038: 'Tis little wonder he was so loath to part with him. Why let a simple thing like death deprive one of so useful a pawn? ...Though we may accuse him of bungling van Darnus's resurrection, I daresay Bahamut was as content to have a handmaiden as a manservant.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_039: I only hope that the two thralls we encountered were the extent of his flock.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_040: Yet I cannot help but dwell on Nael's words─those “beloved children” of whom he spoke.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_041: I assumed at first that he referred to the moon's beastly guardians...but should Bahamut have enslaved other mortals, we must needs remove this source of worship. Otherwise, our efforts to disable the coils shall be for naught.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_042: Forgive me mine indelicacy, my lady... Thou art wise indeed to speak of expunging the primal's thralls...but canst thou truly pursue a course which would cost thee thine own grandsire?
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_043: My heart and mind are as one on this matter. Grandfather's salvation can be won but by a single method: the destruction of Bahamut, and aught that might serve to sustain him.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_044: ─while Urianger and I endeavor to ascertain the existence of any further thralls, I suggest you grant yourself a moment's respite. Rest assured that I will contact you the moment I have need of your inimitable talents.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALISAIE_000_045: That we have achieved so much, I owe to you. I fear, however, that our trials have barely begun...
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_046: Though time had dulled the pain of thy passing, I find that I am wounded afresh.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_047: Master Louisoix... What good shall come of this unending search for knowledge and truth?
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_048: Long have I believed the pursuit of such treasures to be the duty of every true Sharlayan.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_URIANGER_000_049: Yet when each new revelation serveth only to heap further anguish upon those whom we would fain protect, must we truly reach for more?
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALPHINAUD_000_050: So, you have found your resolve, dear sister.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Will you now find a use for the secret─for the key that only you and I hold?
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Given our familial propensity for curiosity, you would do well to remember that keys may serve to seal doors as well as to unlock them. And Bahamut is a most unwelcome guest, to whom the door should never have been opened.
TEXT_GAIUSD302_01314_SYSTEM_000_100: You may view the opening cutscene for the Second Coil of Bahamut before accepting this quest.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_URIANGER_000_000: Amongst mooglekind, the legend of Good King Moggle Mog XII doth tell of a wise and magnanimous ruler. Alas, the entity thus summoned put the lie to this imagining with his brief and decidedly unpeaceful reign.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_URIANGER_000_001: 'Twas most disturbing for me to learn, then, that the Mogglesguard have once more succeeded in placing their manic potentate upon his thorny throne...
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_URIANGER_000_002: Only with the Ascians' guileful intervention could they have called the king back from the aether with such haste. I am afeared that, as was the case with Ifrit and his primal ilk, the ritual thus employed hath empowered the avatar with a strength far beyond that of his previous incarnation.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_URIANGER_000_003: Methinks the agents of chaos doth lurk in the shadows of this deed. Only with the Ascians' guileful intervention could they have called the king back from the aether with such haste.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_URIANGER_000_004: As ever, it falls to thee─to the blade born of light─to banish the Paragons' dark ambition from our realm. The Twelve only know what dire power doth corrupt the “savior” of these gentle forest folk...
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_URIANGER_000_005: Thy name hast been called, . The more moderate faction of the moogles hath joined with the Order of the Twin Adder in an effort to open thee a path to the Good King's domain.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_URIANGER_000_006: I bid thee make haste to the Adders' Nest, and once more pledge thine aid in deposing this royal myth made flesh.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_010: , glad I am to see you. I assume you have been apprised of the situation regarding the moogle monarch?
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_011: After your previous deposal of the king, Kuplo Kopp approached the Mogglesguard and attempted to convince them of the error of their ways.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_012: ...Unfortunately, it appears his efforts at persuasion had rather the opposite effect. The royal sentries reportedly flew into a frenzy, and focused their righteous indignation into a new summoning ritual.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_013: Mayhap it was the unwavering intensity of the Mogglesguard's prayers, but the king has returned to the forest enveloped in an almost blinding aura of majesty.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_014: Kuplo Kopp tells us that this dauntingly maniacal avatar has now taken to calling himself Great King Moggle Mog XII. Suffice it to say that the Elder Seedseer is willing to condone the necessary act of regicide.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_015: For the safety of all who dwell within the Twelveswood, it has been decided that the king must fall. A certain member of the Elder Seedseer's personal guard has already escorted Kuplo Kopp to the ward that shields the monarch's domain.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_016: Those among us with the ability to see moogles are often in high demand, but, considering the urgency of your mission, our leader felt it best to expedite matters.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_017: Pray make your preparations and set out as soon as you are able. Kuplo Kopp awaits you in the Bramble Patch in the East Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_VORSAILE_000_019: Though I wish it were otherwise, the unenviable duty of dragging “Great” King Moggle Mog XII from his throne falls to you. Head to the Bramble Patch in the East Shroud, and Kuplo Kopp will open the way to Thornmarch.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_KUPLOKOPP_000_020: Oh, I knew you'd come! At least, I was hoping, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_KUPLOKOPP_000_021: Not long ago, I had a stern word with the Mogglesguard about the dangers of turning pleasant faerie tales into disturbing reality. But they insisted that the intimidating force that is Good King Moggle Mog XII─may his scepter of judgment ever command our respect─is exactly the sort of savior we need.
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_KUPLOKOPP_000_022: The Mogglesguard are afraid, kupo. Afraid of how the forest has changed, afraid of the never-ending conflict, afraid that we moogles have no place in this new world...
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_KUPLOKOPP_000_023: I am scared of all those things, too. But the thought of unleashing our royal menace upon the Twelveswood scares me even more, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_KUPLOKOPP_000_024: Please, you must deal with them firmly before this goes too far! A measured thrashing, of course─nothing too brutal!
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_KUPLOKOPP_000_025: You can enter Thornmarch here, through the tear I've made in the ward. Take care, good fortune, and in the meantime I'll go let the others know that Great King Moggle Mog XII─may his reign end with minimal bloodshed─will be vacating his throne, kupo!
TEXT_GAIUSD017_01412_BODYGUARD01412_000_: Kuplo Kopp has nullified the ward in anticipation of your arrival. I pray this royal nightmare is not beyond your abilities...
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_URIANGER_000_000: The Lord of the Whorl, slain at thy hand... 'Twas a deed both heroic and historic─a tale to be told down the ages.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_URIANGER_000_001: I fear, however, that the terror of the Indigo Deep did slumber but briefly in the aetherial sea. The Maelstrom hath assured me with unhappy certitude that Leviathan doth stir from the abyss once more.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_URIANGER_000_002: Should this indeed prove the case, then we face a most troubling and chilling predicament. The Lord of the Whorl is a voracious being─naught less than a treasure trove of crystals would serve to lure the entity back to our plane of existence.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_URIANGER_000_003: 'Tis folly, then, to believe the sea-bound beastmen could gather such a haul with such impossible alacrity. No, we must assume the Sahagin have adopted the disturbing new summoning ritual we observed amongst the other beast tribes.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_URIANGER_000_004: 'Tis folly, then, to believe the sea-bound beastmen could gather such a haul with such impossible alacrity. The Sahagin, I believe, have been entertaining Ascian guests...
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_URIANGER_000_005: A threat of unprecedented magnitude now loometh over Limsa Lominsa. Take thee the swiftest road to Maelstrom Command and offer thy stalwart service. Thy shining light must needs illuminate the ocean's darkened swell.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_010: , you are, as ever, a welcome sight at Maelstrom Command. Our worst fears are realized: the primal Leviathan has returned to threaten our shores.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_011: We did not think it possible for the fishbacks to summon their rapacious god without a considerably longer period of preparation, but there can be no mistake...
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_012: Prior to contacting Urianger, we received a report detailing the almost complete destruction of a merchant fleet upon the open sea. Only one vessel managed to limp into port, bearing the decidedly unwelcome news of Leviathan's resurgence.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_013: Judging by the testimony given by the surviving crew members, the massive waves the entity leveled against the ships dwarfed anything we have ever seen the primal command before.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_014: Should he unleash a tidal wave of similarly empowered proportions, Limsa would be scraped from this island like a barnacle from a hull. It is with such dread imaginings in mind that I bid you sail forth to slay the Lord of the Whorl yet again!
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_015: Our strategy remains unchanged: the twin vessel, the Whorleater, is already being prepared under the command of Storm Marshal Slafyrsyn.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_016: Make your way to the Moraby Drydocks once your own preparations are complete. Seek out Sergeant Styrnlona, and she will see you safely aboard the ship. May the Navigator guide and protect you!
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_RASHAHT_000_019: The primal Leviathan must be dealt with before his strength is allowed to peak. Inform Sergeant Styrnlona at the Moraby Drydocks when you are ready to begin the operation. One day, the sea may swallow all, but it will not be this day!
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_STYRNLONA_000_020: Storm Sergeant Styrnlona, at your service! The Whorleater is loaded and ready, !
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_STYRNLONA_000_021: I'll give the signal for the towing vessel to depart as soon as you're aboard. Leviathan was sighted some distance from the coast, so there should be more than enough time to build up to ramming speed.
TEXT_GAIUSD018_01413_STYRNLONA_000_022: The entire crew is willing to lay down their lives to ensure you reach your target, , so you just concentrate on skewering that overgrown sea serpent!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_000: Ah, 'tis you, my friend. You are doubtless eager to hear of our progress on the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_001: Excellent, I'd be disappointed to hear otherwise. Of course, “disappointed” is the word of the day, I fear. I'm ashamed to say that there is nothing worthwhile to report.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_002: The Sons continue to probe the Labyrinth of the Ancients, and every day brings new discoveries. Alas, the same cannot be said of the Crystal Tower proper. We've not been able to set so much as a single foot inside it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_003: You will recall how the Eight Sentinels stood between us and the labyrinth initially.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_004: In like manner, the entryway into the principal spire─Syrcus Tower, the Allagans called it─is also protected by technology far more advanced than our own.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_005: Cid and I have tried every trick we know, but without success. Frankly speaking, we are at a loss.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_006: It is discouraging, but we cannot give up. There must be a way in.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_007: ...And so the situation stands, my friend. Until we gain entry into the tower, I fear your talents shan't avail us. It will require time that I am loath to waste, but I have a mind to set my people to scouring such ancient texts as we have on hand.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_010: (-???-)Be at ease, friends, for we share the selfsame goal.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_011: I am Unei, and my companion is called Doga. We are scholars of the Allagan civilization, sent by the Students of Baldesion to assist in your endeavor.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_012: Unei and Doga? Rather unusual names for this day and age, if I might be forgiven for observing. But I digress.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_013: You claim to be here at the Students' behest, but we have received nary a word of your coming. I am sure you'll not take it amiss if we seem somewhat doubtful.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_014: You claim to be here at the Students' behest, but we have received nary a word of your coming. Moreover, in light of the recent incident at the Isle of Val, I should think that they have rather more pressing concerns.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_015: We can only assume that the message failed to reach you due to some mishap. I assure you that we are here to help.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_017: Ungh... 'Tis nothing. There was...a pain, but it has subsided.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_018: Well, well, this is rather unexpected. Your right eye is the same as ours.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_019: The same? You...you have the Allagan Eye as well?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_020: This sanguine hue is said to be a trait unique to the Allagans! Yet I inherited it from my father, as he did from his.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_021: Only one child in a single generation is born with the eye. All my life, I have sought to learn the truth of its manifestation. If there is aught you know, I implore you to tell me!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_022: My deepest apologies, but we have no answers for you. Only one thing is certain: those who possess the trait are bound by fate to Allag.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_023: As your eye has placed you upon the path you walk, so too have we come here to fulfill our destiny. Absurd though it may sound, it is the truth.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_024: It seems to me we have naught to lose by accepting their aid. What say you?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_025: If that is your wish, then so be it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_026: Yet know that I still mean to verify your story with the Students of Baldesion when I am able. I trust there will be no objections.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_027: Very well. As of this moment, I name Unei and Doga advisory members of NOAH. Without further ado, let us have them examine the Syrcus Tower entrance.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_028: I promise you'll not have cause to regret your decision.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_029: , I should be much obliged if you were to accompany our new friends to the tower. Biggs and Wedge are presently surveying the Eight Sentinels; the two of them can show you the way.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_030: Upon arrival, pray report to Master Garlond. He will brief you on the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_031: I shall join you, . With Unei and Doga's knowledge, along with your uncanny knack for setting events in motion, I am hopeful that we will finally see progress.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_WEDGE_000_040:
We're examining the rubble in the hopes that it'll yield a clue to entering Syrcus Tower.
...Can you tell we're getting desperate?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_BIGGS_000_050: Well, if it isn't ! Eager to enter Syrcus Tower and kill everything in sight, no doubt. As I'm sure you've already heard, though, the place is locked up tight as a clam.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_BIGGS_000_051: ...New friends from the Students, you say? Excellent! It's been slow going─or rather, no going─for the chief. He'll appreciate the help.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_BIGGS_000_052: If you'll just follow me, I'll take you to him.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_060: Ah, some old faces to lift the spirit...and a couple of new ones besides.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_061: Allow me to introduce Unei and Doga. They are scholars of ancient Allag, sent here by our friends of Baldesion to aid in the investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_062: We understand you're having trouble circumventing the tower's defenses. 'Tis our hope that we can be of some small assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_063: If your attire is aught to go by, your assistance should prove invaluable indeed.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_064: To begin with, let me tell you where we stand. Beyond rises Syrcus Tower, the principal spire of the structure collectively known as the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_065: The only way to get inside is through the proverbial front door─the imposing gate you see here. The problem is, we can't get it to open. It's sealed by some mechanism whose workings are an utter mystery to us.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_066: Having had no success via more orthodox methods, I went at it with everything from a pickaxe to a magitek cannon. Nothing so much as put a scratch on it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_067: For a blessing, the gate doesn't try to reduce us to ashes like the Eight Sentinels, but that doesn't make it any less effective a security measure. It's fiendishly frustrating in its simplicity.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_068: The only clue we have is the elaborate device carved upon it: a man and a woman, respectant. Allagan royalty, by my judgment.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_069: Precisely who these individuals were, we cannot say. Nor do we know whether the device actually serves a purpose. Like as not, it is purely decorative.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_070: If you're thinking to force it, save your strength. It's no use─just ask the calluses on my hands.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_071: Rest assured we do not mean to waste our strength.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_072: Indeed. Why should we exert ourselves...when the gate will open of its own accord?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_073: I...I don't think any of us expected that to happen...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_074: Seven hells... What is this? What did you do? What...what are you?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_075:
(-???-)Piercing the heavens and gathering the light,
a symbol of mankind's glory and might.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_076:
(-???-)Its virtue guarded by gates impregnable,
only to those of royal blood answerable.
...Exactly as passed down through legend, I am delighted to see.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_077: Beg pardons for interrupting your bewilderment. I couldn't help but notice the remarkable playthings you have acquired.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_079: Garlond, Garlond. If I didn't know better, I would say you weren't happy to see me. Ah, but I jest. In light of our recent meetings, you have every right to be wary.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_080: But rest assured I am no longer a threat to you. My legion is for all intents and purposes defunct, and my association with it means a tight noose awaits me back in Garlemald. And so I've been roaming this land Eorzea, a regular itinerant.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_081: In the course of my wanderings, I chanced to catch wind of your latest venture. It sounded positively fascinating, and so I decided to come here and join you.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_082: After the wrongs you've committed? You think us that gullible?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_083: If you are suspicious of my intent, 'tis only my just deserts. But I am determined to make amends. As a gesture of goodwill, I will share with you what I know...starting with these two odd characters.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_084: As you are doubtless already aware, the Crystal Tower was the symbol of ancient Allag's might and prosperity. Entry was permitted only to royalty and a select few individuals.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_085: According to the records I have unearthed, only royal blood can open the gate. In other words, the emperor and his progeny were living keys.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_086: You mean to say that these two are descended from Allagan royalty!?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_087: Oh, I suggest nothing so glamorous.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_088: To put it plain, they are imitations of royalty─living keys born of Allagan ingenuity.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_089: “Clones,” I believe, is the name your creators gave your kind. Is that not so?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_090: 'Twould seem that the time for concealment is past.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_091: Pray accept our apologies. 'Twas not our intent to deceive. We simply wished to avoid causing undue alarm by prematurely making what many would consider deranged claims.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_092: If it please you, let us return to the Eight Sentinels. There is much and more to tell.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_094: Seven hells, do you seriously mean to follow us around?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_095: Come, Garlond. You know me better than to think that I spoke in jest. What more will it take for us to be reconciled? A gift, perhaps?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_096: An Allagan tomestone. It holds the information I just shared with you, and a deal more besides. It used to be the jealously guarded property of the XIVth Legion, but it's yours now. I wish you joy of it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_097: I look forward to working together, old friend.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_100: You have every right to mistrust us, but I beg you to hear us out. Long have we waited for this opportunity to fulfill our life's purpose.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_105: Let us hear what Unei and Doga have to say. It will not be too late to decide upon a course of action afterwards.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_110: It goes without saying that Nero can't be trusted. We'd do well to keep an eye on him at all times.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_115: We may not have gotten off to the best of starts, but the past is in the past. Yesterday's enemies can yet be today's friends. Do you not agree, Warrior of Light?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_BIGGS_000_120: The chief and Nero go all the way back to the Magitek Academy. It's an exclusive school situated in the capital, reserved for the Empire's brightest elite.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_BIGGS_000_121: I don't know the nitty-gritty details, but they didn't get along back then, and they don't get along now. Fate's a bastard for bringing them together again.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_WEDGE_000_125: To think the Allagans could make copies of people... If this knowledge were to fall into the wrong hands, the world would become a terrible place. I shudder to imagine a dozen Biggs, shouting at me all day long... <gulp>
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_130: If you are ready to listen, we shall tell you all.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_131: As it pertains closely to your investigation, your leader, Rammbroes, may wish to be present.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_140: Before we begin, pray allow me to apologize again. It was not our intent to deceive you.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_141: As you will have already gathered, we are not scholars sent by the Students of Baldesion. Nay, we are “clones”─copies of people who once existed, given life through Allagan technology.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_142: This is rather a lot to take in...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_100_142: If it would not be considered unseemly, might I ask why you and yours were created? And more specifically, what is it that you now seek to do?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_143: Answering your questions requires that we revisit Allagan history. Pray bear with us.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_144: The Allagan Empire reached its zenith long before our kind came into being.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_145: In that glorious age, the Crystal Tower stood tall as the symbol of Allagan pride. Parents took their children there, that they might learn how the nigh-limitless energy it produced brought prosperity to the whole empire.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_146: That prosperity, however, bred decadence, and the empire began to show signs of stagnation. This decline was made all the more rapid for want of strong leadership.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_147: In a matter of generations, the Allagan civilization became a pale shadow of its former self. Its once gleaming cities fell into disrepair, and its frontier lands were given over to the wilderness.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_148: Lamenting the pitiful state of affairs, one technologist made it his mission to restore Allag to greatness.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_149: Amon was his name, and he believed that the ailing empire wanted for but a potent ruler. And none was more potent than its founding father, whom he sought to resurrect.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_150: The founding father? You cannot mean Emperor Xande!?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_151: None other. As part of his experiments, Amon created clones of the emperor's descendants. We are the products of that experiment─copies of Unei and Doga.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_152: Historical texts mention the reigns of two Allagan emperors named Xande.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_153: It was commonly believed that the second was the namesake of the first. After all, such a custom is not uncommon among royalty and commoners alike. To think that the two were in fact one and the same...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_154: Aye, Xande returned from the grave and assumed his throne once more. And true to Amon's prediction, the emperor restored his realm to the glory it once knew. Would that he could have been satisfied with that...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_155: In his previous life, the emperor desired to bring the entire world under Allagan dominion─an ambition that ultimately went unfulfilled. Having been granted a second chance, he was determined to succeed.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_156: Realizing that he needed more power to wage his war of conquest, Xande turned his sights towards a forbidden source: darkness. In order to learn how to harness this power, he converted the Crystal Tower into a restricted research facility.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_157: Darkness...again? Seven hells, what is it with megalomaniacal rulers turning to darkness in their lust for power?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_158: Well, at least this one won't be bothering us, being thousands of years dead and all.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_159: Would that you were right, Master Garlond.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_160: Alas, Emperor Xande is very much alive. Within Syrcus Tower he still abides, his ambition burning all the more ardently for his empire's collapse.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_170: Wielding the power of darkness requires prodigious amounts of energy─energy that not even the Crystal Tower could produce. In order to augment the shortfall, Dalamud was created and launched into the heavens. On high it hung, gathering the sun's energy and channeling it to the tower below.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_171: However, a miscalculation resulted in a surge of energy that escaped into the land. This triggered an earthquake of unprecedented violence─the calamity that ushered in the Fourth Umbral Era.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_172: In the blinking of an eye, the mighty Allagan Empire was laid to waste.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_173: Yet even as the Crystal Tower was sinking into the earth, the technologist Amon, now Emperor Xande's closest aide, invoked powerful magicks and halted the flow of time.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_174: Every soul within the structure, the emperor included, was placed in a deep slumber. In that state they were to remain until the time was ripe to awaken.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_175: Eras came and went. After millennia lying dormant, Dalamud was summoned back to the earth. Its descent triggered the Seventh Umbral Calamity, in the wake of which the Crystal Tower reemerged.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_176: At that moment, Emperor Xande awakened.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_177: In his lust for power, the emperor consorted with darkness and was seduced by its corrupting influence. Even though his empire is now little more than a fading memory, he will stop at nothing to see his ambition realized.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_180: 'Tis for no other purpose but to put an end to Xande's madness that we exist. This is the mantle we have inherited from our namesakes─the true Unei and Doga.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_181: Fearing what might befall the world, the two of them sought to thwart their emperor. They gave unto us their will, that we might carry on their mission should they fail.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_182: When we came to our senses within the Crystal Tower, we deliberated a course of action. Concluding that we alone could not overcome Xande, we struck out to find a worthy ally. It has taken years, but our search is finally over.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_183: 'Tis no ordinary  who can cut a path through the Labyrinth of the Ancients. With you as our champion, , we are confident that we can end Xande's dark ambition once and for all.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_184: Well, that'll teach me for speaking too soon... Setting my chagrin aside, I see now why you knew about the Students of Baldesion among a host of other things─you were observing our investigation the whole time.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_185: So, what will we do, ? The world's in grave danger again, and it just so happens you're an expert at saving it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_186: You have our eternal gratitude. Together, let us see the Allagan Empire's dark past laid to rest.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_187: It has been our mission to recover the long-lost knowledge of the Allagan civilization. But what worth is that knowledge if it means subjecting the realm to peril?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_188: Truth be told, it pains me to think that the tower's secrets may become lost to us, but the greater good must ever come first. Besides, no quantity of ancient relics can compare to our friends Unei and Doga─living, breathing Allagans.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_189: And so I hereby declare a change in NOAH's objective. Henceforth, we shall direct all efforts towards sealing off Syrcus Tower. Its dark secrets must never know the light of day.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_190: , as you did for us within the Labyrinth of the Ancients, I would have you enter the structure and eliminate hostile elements. Suffice it to say this includes Emperor Xande himself.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_191: Meanwhile, the rest of us shall examine ways to isolate Syrcus Tower from the outside world. To work, then!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_192: Wait. There is something I must know. My right eye is like yours. Does...does this mean...?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_193: You inherited the trait from your father, you said. Know that clones are unable to bear offspring. You have no cause for concern.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_194: The Allagan Eye, you called it, but to us it is the Royal Eye, owing to the fact that the trait manifests only in those possessed of royal blood.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_195: I cannot well explain why the eye runs in your line, but I am disinclined to think it a coincidence.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_196: Though you are doubtless impatient to learn the truth, pray have patience. All will be revealed in due time.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_200: Though their names do not appear to have survived the passage of time, Doga and Unei were worthy individuals. They were not without faults, but they placed the welfare of the people above all else.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_201: When Xande was resurrected, they supported his second ascension to the throne, in hopes that the empire would flourish once more under his leadership.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_202: When it came to light that Xande was consorting with dark powers, they did all within their power to stop him. Among their many acts, they imbued us, two humble clones, with their will.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_205: Within Syrcus Tower, you will encounter clones who share our appearance.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_206: Though they, too, were created in the image of Doga and Unei, they are but empty husks bereft of independent will. Their sole purpose is to eliminate intruders.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_207: Striking down spitting images of Unei and myself may give you pause, but you must not let that stay your hand.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_210: Technology made the Allagans great, but so too did it prove their downfall. And now the Garleans are treading in their very footsteps, the bloody fools. It's true what they say: history repeats itself.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_BIGGS_000_215: ...Nero? Wandered off on his own a moment ago. Only the gods know what that bastard's scheming. If it were up to me, I'd lock him up and throw the key into Silvertear Lake.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_WEDGE_000_220: While you're off purging Syrcus Tower of nasties, Biggs and I will make a round of the Labyrinth─make certain that no funny business is going on inside.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_230: My apologies if I've given you cause to worry. I am quite well, I assure you. As you can appreciate, there has been much for me to think on.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_231: But now is the time for action, not idle thoughts. Syrcus Tower awaits us!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_232: Your task is to eliminate all hostile elements within the structure, Xande himself included. This will afford us the chance to seal off the facility. May the Crystal grant you strength!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_240: The truth of my eye is ever on my mind, but right now every man of us has a job to do. Rest assured I shan't allow myself to be distracted.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_251: You did it! You defeated Emperor Xande!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_252: Empires may rise and fall, but man's indefatigable spirit ever lives on. Truly, you are the champion we had hoped for, .
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_253: With Emperor Xande now at eternal rest, his dark legacy may be undone.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_254: What are you playing at now, Nero?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_255: In case you haven't noticed, Garlond, these are dangerous surrounds. Can a man be faulted for exercising due caution?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_256: At any rate, you needn't mind me. I am perfectly capable of looking after myself. Go on and finish what you came to do.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_257: There are two ways that we may seal off Syrcus Tower: either isolate it from the outside world, or cripple its ability to produce energy.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_258: The choice of method is yours to make. Before you proceed, however, Doga and I must needs attend to a task.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_260: The power that Xande sought to obtain comes from the void─the World of Darkness, our people called it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_261: And the true nature of that power was none other than the armies of voidsent.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_262: Voidsent feed on aether, as you may already know, and no plane is richer in it than ours.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_263: In exchange for their allegiance, Xande entered into an unholy covenant. He would open a gate through which the voidsent could freely enter our world.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_264: The covenant, I'm afraid to say, is still in effect. However, being of the emperor's lineage, Unei and I believe that we can annul it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_DOGA_000_265: By his blood Xande sealed his dark pact. By our blood it shall be undone.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_UNEI_000_267: Yes, Doga. Finally, we may fulfill our purpose.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_269: Oh, be still my beating heart!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_270: For a moment I feared that this outing would end in disappointment, but my readings were not mistaken! Not even the Ultima Weapon compares to this!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_271: What are you going on about!?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_XANDE_000_280: And so Meracydia is brought into the fold. Soon, all the world shall be united under Allagan rule.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_XANDE_000_281: And yet...with every dream that becomes reality, the memory of death grows ever more vivid─an endless void, bereft of light and warmth.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_XANDE_000_282: Though I may have defeated death, it did not leave me unscathed. Nay, its ravening claws have scarred my soul for eternity. Never shall I know peace.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_XANDE_000_283: Beings without will. You cannot fathom my rage. My melancholy. My fear.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_XANDE_000_284: What worth is wealth and power when all must inevitably be consigned to nothingness? If man has nothing, he need not know the pain of loss.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_XANDE_000_286: Harvest more power, that the gate may be thrown full open. Let the Cloud of Darkness come and engulf the world, devouring all life, hopes, and dreams. Let all be returned to nothingness.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_291: Is there no end to them!? What in the seven hells is happening!?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_293: Nero! Were they part of your grand plan, too?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_294: Save your japes, Garlond! I didn't put up with your arrogant face to play with worthless clones!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_295: Something controls them. A voidsent, and no ordinary one at that.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_NERO_000_297: Confound it! Without them, there's no way to master the darkness!
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CLOUDOFDARKNESS_000: (-Cloud of Darkness-)I am the Cloud of Darkness. I shall devour your light, and return this world to the void.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_301: Damn it, the rift is gone! What are we supposed to do now?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_302: As much as it pains me to leave without them, there's precious little we can do. Let us return to the Find and consult Rammbroes.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_310: I feel as though that I'm forgetting something important, but for the life of me, I cannot remember what that something is...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_315: Rammbroes may know a way to bring our friends back. Let's consult him without delay.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_BIGGS_000_320: Hm? I appreciate the attention and all, but don't you have better things to do than chat with me?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_WEDGE_000_325: Everyone's been in a dark mood since returning. I...I take it the mission didn't go well.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_330: All this happened within the tower? Gods preserve...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_331: The rift that manifested before the throne was a voidgate, of this I am certain.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_332: There exist myriad kinds of voidsent. The more powerful the being, the larger the gate must be for it to pass through.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_333: 'Twould seem that Xande sought to open a gate of unprecedented proportions─one that would allow this Cloud of Darkness entry into our world.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_334: Fortunately for all mankind, he did not succeed. I shudder to imagine what this voidsent is capable of.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_335: However dreadful it may be, we can't abandon our friends. Is there no way to save them?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_336: I will not lie to you, Master Garlond. The situation is bleak.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_337: Though voidsent can enter our world, instances of men entering the void have never been documented. It pains me to give voice to my fears, but we do not even know whether our friends still live.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_338: Damn it... I feel so helpless...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_339: No, I refuse to give up. We must save Doga and Unei.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_340: We share the same eye, 'tis true, but that is not what motivates me.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_341: Above all, I wish to help them to fulfill their mission─a mission whose burden they have borne for thousands of years. And besides...
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_342: We cannot leave matters as they are.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_343: So long as Xande's dark covenant is binding, our world is in danger. 'Tis our duty to prevent the worst from coming to pass.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_344: G'raha. Ever since meeting Unei and Doga, you have not quite been yourself. Tell me true: is all well with your eye?
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_345: I honestly cannot say. I know only that there is a memory that I must recall.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_GRAHATIA_000_346: As a child, my father told me that the truth of our eye rests with Allag. The answer eludes me still...but one day I will find it.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_348: However slim the odds, we must try to save Unei and Doga. Aye, and that bastard Nero as well, if only to make certain that he won't make any more mischief.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_349: You have the right of it. Though we have known them but briefly, Doga and Unei are our comrades. We cannot fail them.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_350: I shall consult experts and literature both. I swear to leave no stone unturned.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_351: Yet know that it may be a while before we are ready to act. I would ask that you all be patient. When dealing with the void, one cannot be cautious enough.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_RAMMBROES_000_352: My thanks again for your assistance. Pray rest now while you can. For when the time comes to go after our friends, you must be at no less than full strength.
TEXT_GAIUSD401_01474_CID_000_353: We'll save them yet, ! Mark my words!
