TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_SCARLET_000_000: Well, if it isn't the slayer of Ramuh, come to see me in the flesh. How fortunate that you should happen by. I was, in fact, on the verge of sending a runner to track you down.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_SCARLET_100_000: We've had some troubling news from the sylphs of Little Solace: it appears that the Lord of Levin walks the Twelveswood yet again.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_SCARLET_101_000: From what I understand of the Elder Seedseer's explanation, your last encounter with the primal was a relatively peaceful affair. There was a battle, aye, but one for which Ramuh did not begrudge your victory.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_SCARLET_000_001: Why, then, has he returned to the forest? 'Tis you, , whom fate has chosen to uncover the answer to that question.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_SCARLET_100_001: It seems that Frixio, the sylph elder, would discuss the matter with you personally. Speak first with Dellexia in Little Solace, and she will announce your arrival to their leader.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_SCARLET_000_002: ...Ah, and I would also consider it a favor if you could pass along aught you learn to the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_SCARLET_000_003: As I understand it, Archon Urianger is a keen scholar in the field of all matters primal. Pray make your final report to him.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_DELLEXIA_000_010: Walking one is here! Has walking one heard of Lord Ramuh's return?
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_DELLEXIA_000_011: Then this one does not need to explain. Walking one should wait here while this one fetches elder one!
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_012: Walking one is most welcome in these ones' home. The gentle sighs of winds and trees and brooks told these ones of walking one's peaceful words with Lord Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_013: These ones also heard that thunderous one challenged walking one to battle. This one is certain that Lord Ramuh was pleased with walking one's strength.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_DELLEXIA_000_014: And such strength walking one has! Arrow-shooting ones often tell grand tales of walking one, and these ones are glad to call walking one friend!
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_015: But this one must warn walking one! Touched ones have summoned Lord Ramuh once more, and this time with an offering of many, many more crystals!
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_016: This one does not think thunderous one means to bring judgment to Gridania─after all, Lord Ramuh made a special promise to walking one.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_100_016: It is the intentions of touched ones that concern this one. Touched ones yet act in fear...and in hate.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_017: Even should Lord Ramuh ignore touched ones' destructive wishes, His presence alone drains the land of aether.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_100_017: It is not just Gridania, but the entire realm that thunderous one threatens.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_101_017: Life will seep from the soil; crops will wither and die. Then, though Lord Ramuh will it otherwise, walking ones will go to war over what remains.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_018: This one begs brave and courageous one to fight again!
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_100_018: Touched ones must understand that summoning thunderous one is futile! That thunderous one respects the strength of walking one!
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_019: Thank you! This one knew walking one would do the right thing!
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_100_019: Walking one knows how to visit the Striking Tree? Touch the aetheryte found in the domain of touched ones, and walking one will soon be face-to-beard with Lord Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_FRIXIO_000_020: These ones will listen to the forest's voices for news of walking one's victory!
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_DELLEXIA_000_021: If walking one is ready to fight Lord Ramuh, then walking one must touch the aetheryte hidden deep within the territory of touched ones. Was walking one not listening to elder one...?
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_URIANGER_000_030: Greetings, . Though I would not discourage the company, few cross the threshold of the Waking Sands on a mere whim. Dost thou require mine aid in some matter?
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_URIANGER_000_031: ...The Lord of Levin was returned unto the forest? The sylphs challenge the Sahagin for the swiftness of their summoning...
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_URIANGER_000_032: And thine account doth paint most vividly the image of Ramuh's amplified energies. I fear the touched ones, too, dabble in sacrificial ritual.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_URIANGER_000_033: Thy stern expression bespeaks thine understanding: even the denizens of the Twelveswood possess no immunity against Ascian manipulations. Once more are we reminded that only with the lifting of darkness shall this primal nightmare cease to haunt us.
TEXT_GAIUSD019_01530_URIANGER_000_034: We shall prevail, Warrior of Light. By the radiance of thee and thy companions, we shall prevail...
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_NERO_000_000: Do I know you? ...Ah! Unless I am very much mistaken, you are the famed adventurer who bested the Garlean Empire's general, are you not? The great  ! Amazing─and more than a little serendipitous. One might even call it fate. I but recently received word of a truly unique opportunity, you see─an opportunity the like of which none but one of your proven worth could take advantage.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_NERO_000_001: The reward? Naught less than the accumulated knowledge of a fallen civilization. The risk? A single misstep could cost you your life. But what is a little danger to a storied hero such as you?
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_NERO_000_002: A  with absolute confidence in  own abilities stands to profit handsomely from this venture. No, no, I crave no recompense for my part in bringing this opportunity to your attention─the historic discoveries you shall make will be reward enough, I assure you.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_NERO_000_003: If my words have fanned the flames of your curiosity, then I bid you seek a man by the name of Rammbroes at Saint Coinach's Find. It is he who stands at the doorway to untold marvels, awaiting the arrival of a champion bold enough to march across the threshold.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_NERO_000_004: It is Saint Coinach's Find to which you must travel. Seek out the man known as Rammbroes, and learn what treasures─and dangers─await you.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_010: Why, if it isn't  ! I was not expecting such a celebrated guest. To what do I owe the honor of this visit?
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_011: You were directed here, you say? By a man clad in foreign garb? Well, the opportunity he spoke of must surely refer to our latest anthropogeographical endeavor. Quite how he came to know of it is another matter. All knowledge of this project was supposed to be restricted to my organization...
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_100_011: ...But that is something for me to ponder in private. You are here now, and your services will, I am certain, prove invaluable. I must warn you, however, that the venture we have in mind is no simple excavation─an unprepared or incautious adventurer could very well find  on an unplanned and unpleasant journey to Thal's solemn halls. Knowing this, do you still wish to lend us your cooperation?
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_012: I rather thought you would say that. Your courage is scarcely a secret.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_014: What brings you to Saint Coinach's? Don't tell me─the Alliance has sent you on another realm-shaking, history-making mission to lay low an apparently insuperable foe, yes? No?
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_015: Ah, I see you two are already acquainted. That is well. Master Garlond, our intrepid hero here caught wind of the forthcoming expedition, and has kindly pledged to assist us.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_016: has, has ? Glad to have you aboard, ! You...don't have the faintest idea what you've volunteered for, do you? Very well, let us begin at the beginning.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_017: The Sons of Saint Coinach are tasked with unearthing the secrets of the long-fallen Allagan Empire, and this present endeavor aims to delve more deeply into the civilization's mysteries than ever before.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_018: ...Ah, but I know that look. In the event that you feel ill equipped to contribute much on the subject of Allagan archaeology, I invite you to recall your encounter with the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_019: That mechanical monstrosity represented a feat of engineering far beyond aught Garlemald can presently achieve─Nero tol Scaeva simply awoke it. I mention this by way of a reminder that you have had what one might term...extensive firsthand experience with a notable Allagan relic. In short, you're practically an archaeologist.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_020: Now, to the core of the matter: here in Mor Dhona, there stands an entire Allagan structure which we have yet to investigate. I speak, of course, of the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_021: After witnessing the destructive capabilities of the Ultima Weapon, and the lesser moon, Dalamud, before it, it seems wise to treat any remnants from that era with the utmost caution. They must be analyzed, monitored, and─above all─kept from falling into the wrong hands.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_100_021: To put it plain: I have no wish to see another megalomaniacal legatus wield one of those weapons. It was this thought which first moved me to contact the Sons and propose that the tower be explored.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_100_022: For several millennia, the Crystal Tower remained hidden, buried deep underground. But, like so many other things that were better left undisturbed, the structure was freed from its stony prison by the great upheaval which accompanied the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era. It now stands revealed in all its splendor, a gleaming spear of crystal, pointed at the bosom of the heavens.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_100_023: We believe the tower to be the repository of much of the ancients' wisdom. Unfortunately, its entrance is guarded by formidable defenses, and we cannot so much as peep through the keyhole, much less set foot inside.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_101_023: These defenses take the form of statues, carved into the likeness of giant swordsmen. “The Eight Sentinels,” as the Sons are wont to call them, is the first barrier we must overcome.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_102_023: Why not simply fly over them in an airship, you ask? It's been tried before: any vessel that ventures too close to the tower is blasted out of the air. We either destroy those statues, or the front door is forever beyond our reach.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_024: My colleagues and I are ill-suited to negotiating such deadly hazards. Thus, if we are to gain access to the tower's secrets, we must needs employ the services of an experienced adventurer.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_100_024: It will be difficult and dangerous, , but I can think of no finer  for the task.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_CID_000_025: If I didn't know better, I'd say you had a taste for these deadly escapades! I look forward to working with you again.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_026: There is much and more to be done before we can begin the expedition proper. Take some time to prepare yourself, and I shall explain the challenges that lie ahead...
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_030: Our first objective is to reach the entrance to the Crystal Tower. As I previously mentioned, however, that will prove no easy task.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_031: The entrance is guarded by powerful defense mechanisms, each utilizing one of the four elements of fire, water, wind, or earth. Anyone attempting to simply stroll past these unsleeping sentinels invites swift obliteration.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_032: Based on Master Garlond's analyses, however, we are reasonably certain that the attacks of these lethal contraptions can be reflected using a crystal of the corresponding element.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_033: Naturally, these crystals must be of surpassing clarity, free of the slightest impurities─much like the flawless specimens used by the beastmen in their primal-summoning rituals.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_034: Ahem. Mayhap I should have said “exactly like” the specimens they use... <sigh> Were there any other way, we would not ask this of you, but we need someone to enter the beast tribe strongholds and “liberate” their perfect crystals.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_035: For the moment, I would have you focus on obtaining two of the four crystals we require. Pray make for La Noscea, where both the Sapsa Spawning Grounds and U'Ghamaro Mines are located.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_036: You may be certain that the materials used in the beastmen's sacred rituals will be well defended. Whether you choose to venture there alone or with companions, I shall leave to your discretion. But whatever you do, please be careful!
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_040: How progress your efforts in infiltrating the beastman strongholds?
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_041: So these are the famed flawless crystals of the beast tribes... I have seen countless specimens from I know not how many excavations, but nothing to compare to these. Their purity is...astounding.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_042: You have done well, . With these in our possession, we lack only the crystals of fire and wind. The former lies in Zahar'ak, the war camp of the Amalj'aa in Thanalan; the latter, in Natalan, the roost of the Ixal in the hills of Coerthas.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_043: You can expect them to be as closely guarded as the first two, if not more so. Still, I look forward to receiving word of your resounding success!
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_BALLOON_000_044: Caw, caw! Ours, these crystals are!
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_050: ! It is good to see you. Tell me, were you able to obtain the remaining crystals from the beastmen?
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_051: Wonderful! With all four crystals in hand, we are now ready to proceed to the next stage of our preparations.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_052: Ah. I hope I did not give the impression that we would be embarking on our journey to the Crystal Tower just yet. Alas, there is another step which must be completed ere we come to that. While the crystals you acquired are indeed flawless, they are of little use to us in their present form. If they are to reflect the elemental forces of the tower's defenses, they must needs be cut and polished.
TEXT_GAIUSX201_01709_RAMMBROES_000_053: ...A process which calls for a very particular set of materials. Procuring them will be a challenge in itself, I fear. Needless to say, we will be requiring your services once again...
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SLOWFIX_000_000: Pssshkoh... Is uplander seeing it? Giant of iron, rising from river?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SLOWFIX_000_001: Y'shtola and Cid leave to learn more, but are not back yet! Great is plight of gobbieflock! Giant is too big, can squash Idyllshire flat! Where are uplanders!?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_003: Ah, . 'Tis well you are here, for our need is dire.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_004: A colossus of steam and steel has risen from the Thaliak.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_005: Yet it is no mere forgotten contrivance of Sharlayan. The resultant aetheric disturbance confirms that it is a primal, and that it was summoned amidst the ruins left for the river to reclaim.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_006: For a mercy, it stopped dead no sooner than it had broken the water's surface. But so long as it remains in our realm, it may spring to life again at any moment.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SLOWFIX_000_007: Yes, yes, but what does uplander find near Idyllshire? Is wilderness still heavy with aether?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_008: Nay, the aether grows perilously thin, and more swiftly than I could have imagined.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_009: The primal is bleeding the land dry. Should it be suffered to continue, this entire region will become a barren waste in a matter of moons.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SLOWFIX_000_010: N-No! Gobbieflock has only just found home after long wanderings! Idyllshire will not fall─Slowfix will not allow it!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_010: And nor will we. I have already spoken with Alphinaud, and he concurs that we Scions of the Seventh Dawn must do all in our power to eliminate the threat. Yet given its size, I deem it wise to attack from two fronts.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_011: Our first and most obvious recourse is to keep our foe in check with blade and magic, much as we have done with other such adversaries. Second, I propose that we attempt to cut off the flow of aether which sustains it, mayhap by physically separating the primal from the land.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_012: If we are to be rid of the colossus, I think the latter course more promising, and mean to enlist Master Matoya's aid in pursuing it. Yet such things take time.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_013: Thus, I have asked Master Garlond to remain here and keep watch over our foe. Given its apparently mechanical nature, his expertise should prove invaluable to you.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_014: “To you,” I say, for I would leave the fate of Idyllshire in your hands. Should the primal chance to stir ere my return, you are to join Cid in repelling it. An unenviable task, but one for which you are singularly qualified.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_YSHTOLA_000_017: Rest assured, I do not mean to linger with Master Matoya any longer than necessary. The moment we find a solution, I shall make haste to rejoin you here. Well then, let us be about our duties. I will leave you to discuss strategies with Cid.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SLOWFIX_000_018: Pssshkoh... Backrix is keeper of knowings for Idyllshire, can say where Cid has gone. Uplander should start with Backrix.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SLOWFIX_000_030: Pssshkoh... Backrix stays at Bigwest Shortstop, keeps eyes on doings of Illuminati.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_035:
Pssshkoh... Shiny junk and sparkly rocks,♪
Bittybobs and whirlycogs.♪
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BACKRIX_000_050: Backrix is keeper of knowings and data! What does uplander wish to learn about? Ah, uplander comes in search of Cid, yes?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_051: My thanks for sharing your knowings, Backrix. These Illuminati are indeed most hostile.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_100_051: Ah,  old friend! You haven't seen Y'shtola, have you?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_052: ...Drained of all aether in a matter of mere moons? Seven hells! How much power does that thing need? Too much, plainly. Well, it sounds as if we have an urgent dismantling job on our hands.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_053: From what Backrix has been telling me, the Illuminati are the most likely culprits. They have the knowledge to summon a primal, and the requisite shortsightedness not to think better of it.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_054: “Fanatical” captures their philosophy nicely, I think─their goal being nothing less than sole ownership of all the world's technology. Needless to say, they're more than willing to kill anyone who stands between them and what they want.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_055: Quite how they managed to coax a primal into the hulk of a Sharlayan defense mechanism I don't know, but it looks like they've made themselves a tidy little fortress inside the colossus.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_056: We'll need to contend with them if we're to disable the thing. As for the task itself, simply destroying whatever serves as its engine should do the trick─assuming it is in fact mechanical. ...But before all that, we'll need to find a way in─through yet another bloody barrier.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BACKRIX_000_057: Pssshkoh... Barrier is not new, rose up three years ago after ground made shiveryshakes. Ruin was freed from riverbed then. Roundrox was there, saw with own two eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BACKRIX_000_059: Daughter of Slowfix. Roundrox loves junk more than all other gobbies, was collecting then, and is playing now. Look.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_060:
Pssshkoh... Shiny junk and sparkly rocks,♪
Bittybobs and whirlycogs.♪
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_061: I'm sorry for interrupting, Roundrox, but I need to ask you a question. When the ground shook three years ago, did something come bobbing up to the river's surface?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_062: “Bobbing”? Nothing bobbed, silly uplander. Ground made shiveryshakes when giant of whirlycogs stood. And then magic walls came up too!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_063: So it wasn't the tremor that freed the colossus─it was the colossus which caused the tremor. And you are absolutely certain you saw it rise from the waters, young one?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_064: Seven hells─I think someone tried and failed to summon it three years ago. But was it the Illuminati, or...?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_PSEUDOBRAYFLOX_000_:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Brayflox comes to trade tongueflaps, uplander.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_066: Ah, just the goblin! Slowfix tells me you're his resident expert on the Illuminati. Pardon me a moment while I consult with my fellow uplander.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_100_066: ─if I may make a suggestion, I'll speak with Brayflox, and learn what I can of our opponents.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_067: In the meantime, could you investigate the colossus itself? Biggs and Wedge are near where its hand landed on the shore of the Thaliak. Join them, and see if you can't find a way inside the machine. Oh, and good luck with that barrier!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_070: Pssshkoh... Here is treasure trove of Roundrox! But shhh─is secret from big gobbies!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BACKRIX_000_075: Pssshkoh... Backrix makes record of uplanders' lipflaps. Cid says...go to Biggs near river shore.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_080:
“Di dah, di dah di di...
Di, dah di di dah...”
What in the blazes...?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_100: ! Come to see the colossus, eh? The chief has us looking for a way in. 'Course, there's a bleedin' barrier around the thing─aye, another one...
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_101: Luckily for us, when the big feller came down, its hand clamped onto the shore here, punching a hole in its defenses, and leaving that round portal there unprotected.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_102: Only trouble is, it's locked and doesn't seem to have a key. For want of a better idea, Wedge is listening in to Illuminati linkpearl communications, in hopes they'll mention the trick to opening it.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_103: “Di dah, di dah di di...” Hrm. There's only one signal coming from inside the giant, and it's always the same pattern.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_104: I'm certain it's a code─the Illuminati always use coded messages. From what I hear, they've developed a special kind of crystal specifically for transmuting linkpearl waveforms.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_100_104: If we could get our hands on one, the chief's decoding machine here should theoretically be able to use it to untangle the meaning. Quite where we'd find such a crystal is another matter...
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_REDBRIX_000_105: Pshkohhh... Does uplander know Roundrox? She makes great collection of junk and things. Maybe is keeping crystal at Shortstop?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_106: Wouldn't that be a stroke of luck!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_100_106: And it just so happens I've been working on a means of identifying the crystal in question! Here, ─take this 3G7-001B!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_107: Sprinkle that powder over this so-called collection, and look for anything that glimmers. It should contain the material we need. You may have to borrow one of Roundrox's treasures, but I'm sure she won't mind if you tell her it's for a good cause.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_110:
I designed 3G7-001B precisely for a moment like this! I do hope it works!
...Ah! I almost neglected to mention: if you sprinkle it on something and it starts to smoke─run away. I-I don't expect it will, though! Just, uh...keep that in mind, all right?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_115: If you don't find anything, we could always try blowing the hatch open. That armor looks pretty thick, though...
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SYSTEM_000_130: Amongst the jumble of bits and bobs, you spy a faintly glimmering stone.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_150: Pssshkoh... Wh-What is uplander doing!? Sneakytaker! Treasure belongs to Roundrox!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_151: Uplander needs it? For giant of whirlycogs? But...but glowstone is most favoritest treasure of Roundrox... Mmm... All right. But uplander must promise to bring it back, or Roundrox is getting very angry.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_160: Pssshkoh... Be careful with glowstone of Roundrox!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_180: Ah, ! No burns, I see! ...Hm? Oh, no reason. Tell me, did the 3G7-001B reveal anything?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_190: Thank you! And you have my word that I'll give this back to Roundrox when I've finished with it. Now, let's take a listen to what the Illuminati are really saying.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_191: Goodness, all that infernal beeping is gone! Now it's a message, clear as day! Let's see...
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_192: “Today's schedule for Gordias. Registration at seventh bell. Stop. Louse the coeurl cubs at third bell. Stop. Rest and recuperation at second bell. Repeat. Today's schedule for Gordias...”
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_193: Coeurl lousing!? B-But I'm sure that was the only message! This has to be some sort of jest!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_194: Don't be daft, Wedge. It's just another code. You need the proper crystal and the proper knowledge to understand it. <sigh> Bleedin' Illuminati... Should've known it wouldn't be so easy.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_196: (-???-)But it's your lucky day. I'll crack the code─assuming we can come to a little arrangement.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_100_196: I'm a treasure hunter by trade, and there's a certain something I want inside the giant. I help you get inside, you help me get out with it. A fair deal, no? The name's Mide, by the way.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_197: Uh...charmed, I'm sure. You are aware that the interior is almost certainly swarming with Illuminati, yes?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_198: Why do you think I came to you? There's strength in numbers, friend. Best we join forces, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_100_198: Now, the words you intercepted are largely gibberish. But paired with the numbers─well, you'll see. “Seven, stop, three, stop, two,” wasn't it?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_199: You, the big one─see the pipes atop the hatch? There ought to be a valve up there, with a handwheel. Imagine it's a clock, and try turning it right to seven, left to three, and then back to two.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_200: Ahahaha! We did it, we did it!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_201: ...So the Illuminati have been announcing the way to enter the colossus all along? Strange. Well done for cracking the code, anyway.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_203: I had less success, sadly. I'm afraid Brayflox knows little more than we do about the Illuminati's plan or the primal.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_204: Come, come, things aren't as bad as all that. We've found a way inside the machine; we'll just have to learn about it as we go.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_205: It's only a massive mammet, after all. Stopping it should be as simple as destroying its core. If we send in a suitably intrepid team of surveyors, I don't see why we can't trace the machine's power back to the source via the struts and piping.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_206: And I know just the  to lead the party. What say you, ?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_207: And what of me, pray tell? I opened the way for this grand expedition of yours─surely that's earned me a place in your little band to hunt for my treasure.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_208: You did as you promised, and you may do as you will now─but only so long as your treasure hunt doesn't endanger the mission.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_CID_000_209: I'd join you if I could, but there's something I need to see to first. I'll leave Biggs and Wedge here in case of emergencies. Good luck, my friend!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_SYSTEM_000_220: You now have access to the Fist of the Father. Gordias can be accessed via the entrance in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_230: You needn't worry unduly about me. Once I have what I'm searching for, I'll leave─simple as that.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_235: If there's anything we can do to help, you need but ask.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_238: I'll keep checking Illuminati communications. If there's any change, you'll be the first to know!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_240: Pshkohhh... Uplanders find way into giant of whirlycogs? Oooh, Roundrox finds new treasures aplenty in the─ Er...uh... Nothing!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_501: Hm? Well, what have we here?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_502: Pshkohhh... Eheheh... Sorry. Roundrox could not stay away. So many new treasures here!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_503: Treasures? Oh, you mean the odd bits and bobs. Well, little one, these machina are yours to take. And some of them are rather beautiful, I must admit.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_504: <gasp> Uplander can tell pretty machines from ugly!? Just like Roundrox!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_505: Heh... No harm in adding one more to our company, is there? I'll keep an eye on her.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_506: Damn it. I was so sure...
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: (-???-)Pshhhkohhh... Uplanders are unwise to come. But most of all is treasure hunter─what she seeks is not here, not in all of Gordias.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_508: As I live and breathe─Quickthinx Allthoughts, master of the Illuminati.

Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Wh-What? Uplander is shooting gobbies!?

And boomdust does not harm uplanders!
Blood! Uplander blood for fallen gobbiekin!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_514: I think now would be a good time to leave.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_515: Pshkohhh... Uplander, what is Enigma Codex? Treasure?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_600: Roundrox has been showing me her treasures─and they're aptly named. Only a fool would call them junk. Just because something has been discarded, it doesn't mean it can't be beautiful.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_MIDE_000_601: She also said that Quickthinx has a face like a machina─cold and calculating. I can only assume she means his mask.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_610: Pshkohhh... Mide is amazing! She can tell pretty junk from ugly almost as well as Roundrox!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_611: This whirlycog Roundrox finds seventy-two yalms north and west. And this one, this one is twenty-four yalms south and east of Arkhitekton!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_ROUNDROX_000_612:
Pshkohhh... Shiny junk and sparkly rocks,♪
Bittybobs and whirlycogs.♪
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_620: Welcome back, ! I'm working with Backrix to intercept Illuminati communications.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_WEDGE_000_621: He's got a wonderful memory for details, and a great mind for codes! I must say, the goblins' grasp of technology is something to behold. I'm impressed!
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_650: Bleedin' hells! Face-to-face with the head of the Illuminati, eh? Sounds like you had quite an adventure! And this “Alexander Initiative” has got me wondering... Do you reckon it might be the giant's name?
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_651: No sign of the core though, eh? Well, we'll just have to look further in. I'll let the chief know, anyway.
TEXT_HEAVNR101_02090_BIGGS_000_652: He'll be happy to hear Mide and Roundrox are safe, too. Those two haven't stopped talking about machines since they got back. I can't say I've ever thought of junk as pretty, but each to their own.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_BIGGS_000_000: Ah, ! Ready to have another go at finding the giant's core?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_BIGGS_000_001: Wedge, could you─ Oi, Wedge! Stop listening to that bloody linkpearl! We barged through the Illuminati's front door─they know we've broken their code.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_WEDGE_000_002: But I've just this moment intercepted a new communication! If you'll give me a moment to... There! It says... Oh. “Death to uplanders... Death to uplanders...” Ahem. I-I think we may have started a war...
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Cuff of the Father. Gordias can be accessed via the entrance in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_020: My, but Roundrox has a lot of treasures! Not many are of much use, but they're all lovely in their own right.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_021: She has a fine eye... Speaking of which, do you recall me mentioning that she had described Quickthinx's face, and how I assumed she must mean his mask? Well, the more I think about what she said, the more I think she really did mean his face. But how could she possibly tell?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_030: Pshkohhh... Roundrox likes Mide. Trading tongueflaps is much fun!
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_031: Look, look─this whirlycog Roundrox finds sixty-three yalms north and west! And that one was only ten yalms from Arkhitekton!
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_032:
Pshkohhh... Shiny junk and sparkly rocks,♪
Bittybobs and whirlycogs.♪
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_WEDGE_000_040: Backrix is still helping me to intercept Illuminati communications.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_WEDGE_000_041: He really is a natural when it comes to codes! Truly, these goblins never cease to amaze me!
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_BIGGS_000_050: If the Illuminati want a war, it seems only fair that we bring their base to its knees. We need to find the giant's core and quick!
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_500: Pshkohhh... Uplander is amazing! Uplander is stronger than...than ten gobbies!
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_CID_000_501: Ah! There you are, old friend. I was beginning to wonder if I'd ever find you. Biggs's account left something to be desired, so I thought it best to see the interior with my own eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_CID_000_503: Hm! A treasure hunter, through and through. Tell me, what exactly do you hope to find here?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_504: Ever heard of the Enigma Codex? It's a book of ideas written some hundred years past─the life's work of one of the greatest technologists ever to draw breath.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_505: Within its pages are found myriad wonders─from designs for machina that could operate ceaselessly for centuries to novel ways of culturing cheese. Even a fragment of the book could bring a king's ransom.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_506: But most remarkable of all are the plans for a walking citadel. It was to be a beacon of logic and reason for all the world.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_CID_000_507: A walking citadel? ...Seven hells! We're standing in it, aren't we!? The Illuminati's primal took its form from that idea! ...But I sense that none of this is news to you. You've read it, then, this Enigma Codex?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_508: The design catered for every needful thing, from warm beds to crops of grain. Its occupants would never have to leave. And all in a fortress on feet, impenetrable and ready to move at a moment's notice.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_509: The citadel was meant to bear the most brilliant scholars and artificers of the age to all four corners of the world, that they might set about unraveling the mysteries of creation. And this utopia...this shining seat of erudition, was to be called Alexander.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_510: Pshkohhh... If Roundrox lived in walking castle, Roundrox could collect treasure from everywhere!
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_511: Indeed you could, little one. And anything you found─be it junk, forgotten teachings, or lost secrets─would be yours for the taking.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_CID_000_512: ...And what exactly would the Illuminati do with all of this knowledge?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_513: They would use it to take control, most likely. Create a world ruled by a few chosen scholars. Unless I'm mistaken, that's why the Illuminati exist.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_CID_000_514: Bloody fanatics. Take a perfectly good idea and make it into an object of faith. What could possibly go wrong...?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_CID_000_515: I can well imagine how a people who have spent decades carrying their homes on their backs might crave a home that could carry them─how such a place could seem like a utopia.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_CID_000_516:
But we're not talking about a machine here─we're talking about a primal. And primals will be the death of us all.
I trust you'll be ready when things come to a head, ?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_517: Pshkohhh... Utopia is happyplace? Hmmm... Where there is junk aplenty, Roundrox is happy. Where is very happyplace of Mide?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_MIDE_000_600: I think Roundrox's pile of treasures may have grown a touch. Not that that's any surprise─she goes hunting whenever she has a spare moment. Heh. A girl after my own heart.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_610:
Pssshkoh... Shiny junk and sparkly rocks,♪
Bittybobs and whirlycogs.♪
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_611: Sometimes Backrix is coming with Roundrox for junk hunting.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_ROUNDROX_000_612: Uplander will come next time, too?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_WEDGE_000_620:
If my ears seem red, it's because Y'shtola just called. Dear me...I didn't think she knew such language! I gather Matoya may not be the easiest of taskmasters.

...Not that I don't sympathize, of course. I wonder what she'd say if she had to work under the chief...?
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_BIGGS_000_650: This Enigma Codex sounds amazing. A walking citadel's one thing, but a self-sustaining, walking citadel...? Genius! It's just a pity the Illuminati had to go and make a bleedin' primal out of it.
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_BIGGS_000_651: From what I understand, this “Alexander” was active for no more than a few seconds─that's seconds─and it nigh drained the hinterlands of aether. Imagine what it'd do if it wandered the whole bleedin' world...
TEXT_HEAVNR102_02091_BIGGS_000_652: I don't think Roundrox realizes how much danger we're in here. Too busy hunting for new treasures. Probably for the best, though, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_BIGGS_000_000: We've got ourselves a problem, , but don't worry─the chief has a plan.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_001: All present and correct, I see. Good. Something has been nagging at me for a while, , and I've finally realized what it is. It concerns the communications Wedge intercepted.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_002: So, we know that the Illuminati have managed to establish a base inside the colossus, meaning they must also have found a way to pierce the magic barrier. Assuming that's the case, what need have they to use the only hatch which the barrier doesn't protect? And why go to the trouble of sending coded messages on how to unlock it?
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_100_002: The answer? Spies. I believe the Illuminati have an agent outside the colossus, most like in Idyllshire itself, who is using the hatch as a back door.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_003: Now, this agent will know we've broken their code, and that the hatch is constantly watched, so he won't have been able to use it for some time. As such, he'll doubtless be desperate to reestablish contact with the inside.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_100_003: And that's why I've cleared the area around the giant's hand. All we need do now is watch and wait...and follow whoever makes a dash for the hatch.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_WEDGE_000_004: Chief! Linkpearl call from Redbrix! He says─ <gasp> He says Brayflox went inside! B-But she can't be─ N-No, it must be an impersonator! Chief─whomever you met earlier was a spy! Quick, you've got to get after her!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Arm of the Father. Gordias can be accessed via the entrance in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_MIDE_000_020: My, but Roundrox has a lot of treasures! Not many are of much use, but they're all lovely in their own right.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_WEDGE_000_040: I really don't think Y'shtola is enjoying working under Master Matoya again, you know... You wouldn't believe the language she used when she called... It was enough to make Biggs blush!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_BIGGS_000_050: Mide and the chief are already inside Alexander! Rally your band and get after them!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_WEDGE_000_060: That Brayflox impersonator had me completely fooled! ...Though, to be honest, those masks all look the same to me.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Gobbie found it? Good. Knowings of missing piece are with Illuminati.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_502: ...This is how you treat those who please you?
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Now is realm in chaos. Broken. Machine with too many parts. But Illuminati plan needs one thing, missing piece to bring world order. Give world harmony. Make world perfect.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_504: And what of those who don't fit your vision of perfection? How many must die to pay for your utopia!?
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_505: Don't you see? You summoned a godsdamned primal! It will devour the aether of every land you visit, until Hydaelyn and everything on it is dead!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Inside fortress of Illuminati, chosen will live on. If inferior on outside die for progress, so be it. This is cost of seeking for knowings.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_507: Hells take you and your damned seeking!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Wise uplanders find happiness in Illuminati rule. Unwise uplanders...utopia does not need.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_509: So it's obey or die, then? Pah! The whole concept is grotesque!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_MIDE_000_510: No, Cid. Like the rest of the ideas set out in the Enigma Codex, Alexander is wonderful in itself. Perfect, even. But in the rush to realize its ideals, even the best of us can be led astray.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_511: Oh, so once upon a time, these Illuminati were starry-eyed philanthropists, is that it? And it was only after they got their hands on your perfect bloody codex that they turned into vicious killers. Tell me, was there any passage in particular that convinced them to abandon their last shred of empathy?
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_MIDE_000_512: <sigh> I cannot speak for the precise contents of the codex. Not anymore. But I haven't forgotten everything I read. I think I can stop the core, if you can get me close enough.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_513: You think you can, or you know you can? And what of its location?
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_MIDE_000_514: It's somewhere in the trunk. How close we are to that, I can't say.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_ROUNDROX_000_515: Pssshkoh... Roundrox can say! Two paces of Roundrox are one yalm. So, by count of Roundrox, chest of whirlycog giant is only a little further!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_516: Ha! Clever girl! You've been measuring how far we've come from the start!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_CID_000_517: All right, I propose we withdraw for the time being. I don't know what will happen when we breach the core, but I do know that we'll be better equipped to deal with it if we're well rested and ready for anything.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_ROUNDROX_000_600: Pssshkoh... If uplander comes back safe from core unmaking, Roundrox will give one piece of secret treasure!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_BIGGS_000_610: Mide says she can dismantle the core, but we'll be on hand too─just in case she needs an extra sledgehammer, like.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_WEDGE_000_620: Just you be careful, ! There's no telling what mechanical horrors are protecting the core!
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_MIDE_000_650: No one should have the power to choose who lives and who dies. The idea is too vile, too insidious to be left unchallenged.
TEXT_HEAVNR103_02092_MIDE_000_651: We have to act. If we don't, Alexander will awaken, and the Illuminati will be unstoppable. Make no mistake, ─it's now or never.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_MIDE_000_000: I think I have the knowledge required to shut down the giant's core. But if I'm to reach it, I'll need you to lend me your strength.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_WEDGE_000_001: Well, really! The Illuminati's latest message is─ It's─ Well, let's just say it's unsuitable for polite company. I should be much obliged if you'd teach those privy-mouthed savages some manners, !
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Burden of the Father. Gordias can be accessed via the entrance in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_ROUNDROX_000_030: Pssshkoh... If uplander comes back safe from core breaking, Roundrox will give one piece of secret treasure!
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_035: Don't worry about us, . You just concentrate on getting Mide to the core in one piece. Wedge and I will bring up the rear when the coast's clear.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_WEDGE_000_040: Just you be careful, ! There's no telling what mechanical horrors are protecting the core!
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_MIDE_000_050: ...Hm? How exactly will I stop the giant? Let me worry about that. All you have to do is get me to the core.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_WEDGE_000_500: W-We're here, and none the worse for wear! So if you need another pair of hands, just say the word!
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_501: So this is the heart of the machine, eh? ...I knew I should've brought a bigger hammer. Not that I'll be needing it, of course. Isn't that right, Mide?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Greater are knowings in braincases of unwise than Quickthinx believed. Perhaps Quickthinx judged too quickly. Perhaps Illuminati should study uplanders.
It is before eyes of gobbie? Good. Do not fail. Illuminati have no use for failing gobbies.
Pshhhkohhh... End of gobbies' long wanderings is close.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_WEDGE_000_506: Something isn't right. Something isn't right at all! The way Quickthinx spoke, you'd think he had won!
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_507: ...He didn't seem too bothered, that's for sure. Do you think he might have planned for us stopping Alexander's core?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_508: What was it the chief said again? About the Illuminati finding what they needed to complete their plan.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_WEDGE_000_509: Something along the lines of a “missing piece,” I thought.
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_MIDE_000_510: And what of Quickthinx's honor guard? The two dolts who're ever at his side─why aren't they here? The Illuminati must surely have known we were coming. What could be more important than protecting their leader?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_511: ...You don't think he sent them to Idyllshire, do you? While our backs were turned, like?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_MIDE_000_600: Quickthinx would not give up so easily... We've got to get back to Idyllshire!
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_WEDGE_000_620: Wh-What do we do? What happened!?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_ROUNDROX_000_630: Pssshkoh... Wh-Where are treasures of Roundrox!?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_REDBRIX_000_650: Pssshkoh... Giant loses power! Uplanders succeed!
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_651: Never mind that, man─did the Illuminati come? Is Idyllshire safe?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_REDBRIX_000_652: Pssshkoh... How does uplander know? Yes, many Illuminati come to take stuffs of gobbieflock. Great was chaos! But suddenly, Illuminati go and take only junk not worth jinglyshine!
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_653: They came barging in, ready to start a war, and then scarpered with a handful of bleedin' junk? Hold on a minute. Where were they last seen?
TEXT_HEAVNR104_02093_BIGGS_000_656: I'll go and find the chief─he'll know what to do!
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_REDBRIX_000_000: Pshkohhh... Uplanders are gone too long for comfort of Redbrix. Shortstop is place of clashings with Illuminati.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_REDBRIX_000_001: Illuminati are up to no good. Maybe using confusion to do foul things. Uplander must go and see, make sure all is well!
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_REDBRIX_000_020: Pshkohhh... Uplander must find Mide, make sure all is well!
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_WEDGE_000_500: Is everything still as we found it? They haven't come back, have they?
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_100_500: No. They're gone for now. And everyone seems to be fine...physically, at least. But Roundrox...
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_502: Poor thing... The Illuminati took everything. I'm just glad she was off collecting trinkets with Backrix when they came. I daren't think what might have happened had she been here...
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_503: Come, come, little one. Dry your tears.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_504: One thief─unconscious. We found him lurking near the edge of town─not far from your treasure, Roundrox.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_ROUNDROX_000_505: Pshkohhh... <sniff> Uplander brings treasures home! Thanks to uplander! Many, many thanks!
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_506: It was all Biggs, little one. He had a feeling a few soldiers might be lurking around, waiting to ambush us, and this is what we stumbled onto when we went to look.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_WEDGE_000_507: But why did the Illuminati take Roundrox's collection in the first place? Surely that can't have been their goal.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_508: I wouldn't be so sure. Were I to guess, I'd say that the Illuminati believed something they wanted was hidden amongst Roundrox's pile of trinkets. Rather than waste time sorting through them, they decided to take the lot. But when they subsequently realized they didn't have what they were looking for, they crept back into town to wait for a chance to seize whatever it was they actually wanted.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_ROUNDROX_000_509: What if bad gobbies want most favoritest treasure of Roundrox─one that is safe with uplanders?
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_WEDGE_000_510: You mean the glowstone that  borrowed? But of course! It's been sitting in the decoding machine all along!
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_ROUNDROX_000_511: Yes, yes! Roundrox would be sad without pretty glowstone! It is special treasure from near old castle. Rusty one that was left by uplanders, from before.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_512: Wait. What do you mean “before”? Roundrox─were you near the Sharlayan ruins when...when the metal giant first appeared?
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_ROUNDROX_000_513: Yes, yes, Roundrox saw whirlycog giant stand three years ago! But was only for a little bit, and big gobbies do not believe Roundrox.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_514: Three years ago─when someone tried and failed to summon the primal...
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_515: A fragment of the codex! Of all the places in the realm...
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_516: Only a fragment of the original? So that crystal must be the Illuminati's missing piece!
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_517: We may have stopped their primal and taken their prize, but our foes are not about to admit defeat. They'll be back, and out for blood, like as not.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_CID_000_518: But we've got you, ─and I'm sure you'll be ready for the onslaught when it comes. Might I suggest you make merry till then?
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_600: I'm glad Roundrox has her treasure back. I only hope it doesn't place her in further danger. You wouldn't believe what some would do for just that small fragment.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_ROUNDROX_000_630: Pshkohhh... Roundrox is happy. Many friends worry, think of Roundrox. Uplander is one. Roundrox thanks kind uplander!
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_631: Let me chime in as well, . Roundrox's home needed protection, and you provided it. Not many would do that, and certainly not in the face of a primal. You have my thanks also.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_ROUNDROX_000_0632: Mide helped Roundrox too! Uplanders have good hearts, and kind.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_633: Only so many of us find machina pretty, my dear. We have to stick together, don't we?
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_ROUNDROX_000_0634: Did Mide always like whirlycogs and bittybobs?
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_635: Not like you, Roundrox. My love, he adored the things─inventing, building, and tinkering with them.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_637: Do I? Well, I suppose I do.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_638: Those times were something else, little one. My friends and I, we were lost in our dream. We thought to put back the pieces of the broken world with logic, reason, and technology. And we were certain we could do it, too.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_639: I hadn't much skill with thinking up things or making them, but I helped in my small way. And that feeling of aiding in someone else's dream, sharing it, washes over you like a wave of happiness. I've never felt that way since.
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_640: Now, it all seems so far away. Even the memories feel like I dreamed them, rather than lived them...
TEXT_HEAVNR105_02094_MIDE_000_641: Well, enough of that. Roundrox is right, adventurer─you're a kindly soul. Keep an eye on our girl till next we meet, will you?
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_TORSEFERS_000_000: Ah, my  ! During your absence, a stranger came calling.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_TORSEFERS_000_001: Upon learning that you were away, he left a message to the effect that he wishes to speak with you, and will await you at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_TORSEFERS_000_002: If you have a mind to oblige this stranger, please be careful. I cannot well explain why, but it put me ill at ease to simply be near him.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_TORSEFERS_000_027: The stranger said that he will wait for you at the Rising Stones. If you have a mind to meet him, please be careful. Simply being near him put me ill at ease.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_000_011: Unukalhai is my name, and I serve a friend. I sought you out that I might alert you to the rising threat of the beings known as eikons.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_000_012: ...You are aware of the threat, you say? Ah, but I speak not of the primals, with which you are exceedingly well acquainted.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_100_012: It may interest you to know that the term “eikon” and the beings to which it refers precede the Garlean Empire by eras.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_100_013: You see, it is the name by which the Allagans called godlike beings, the Dark Divinity Odin among them. And the Garleans, who seek to emulate the glory of ancient Allag, have simply availed themselves of it.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_013: (-???-)Pray permit me to continue the tale.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_000_014: Ah, Urianger. How kind of you to join us.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_015: As the Warrior of Light's comrade, my participation is but to be expected. After all, the matter doth pertain to the very fate of this star.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_016: The eikons of eld... In the distant past, these mighty beings did offer fierce resistance to the Allagan Empire. However, they eventually fell to the men of Allag, who devised the means by which to capture them.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_000_017: And it did not end with capture, as you well know, for the Allagans also learned how to harness the eikons' power.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_100_017: They refined this knowledge at the Aetherochemical Research Facility on Azys Lla. And within the Centrifugal Crystal Engine, they sealed three of the beings─the Warring Triad.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_018: 'Twas first and foremost to acquire the infinite power of the Warring Triad that the archbishop did seek Azys Lla.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_019: But in the wake of his defeat, the bindings which confine the eikons were severely damaged. Doubt not but that they will fail completely ere long.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_000_020: Know that we do not condemn you for striking down the archbishop. You were simply fulfilling your destiny. And yet, were the Warring Triad to be released into the world, unimaginable destruction would ensue.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_021: Take heart, for there is hope still. Through swift action, we may yet prevent their awakening and see them resealed.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_022: But in dealing with this new threat, our first step must be to contend with the old.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_023: Two savage gods are returned, I fear, summoned once more by their worshipers, and at a strength far surpassing their previous incarnations.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_000_024: I speak of the primals Ravana and Bismarck.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_UNUKALHAI_500_024: If left unchecked, they will inevitably seek to seize the power of the Warring Triad. This will serve to feed the confluence of chaos and hasten the eikons' awakening.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_025: To wit, we must needs vanquish both their kinds. I pray thee, however, to first focus thy gaze upon the primals, ere we turn our attention to those eikons and their fitful slumber...
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_100_025: I shall return to the Waking Sands forthwith and consider such measures as are available to us.
TEXT_HEAVNY201_02114_URIANGER_000_026: Meanwhile, I bid thee attend to the task of eliminating the primals. Young Unukalhai shall assist thee. Rest assured he is not our enemy. For the time being, at least.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_110_000: If we are to prevent the awakening of the Warring Triad, then Bismarck must be cast down once more.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_110_001: I am aware of the rather unorthodox method you employed to lure out and slay the white whale before, and had a mind to follow established precedent.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_100_000: That said, islands are not easy to come by...
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_000_001: I should hope it is not necessary, but you may as well show this gemstone to Chief Sonu. He will know it as the Weeping Eye of the Manukmanai, and it will ensure that he is completely committed to our cause.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_000_002: Oh, and before you ask, I have already informed Master Garlond of our plans. He is currently en route to the Blue Window.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_010: The tramontane returns, and with it the White. So too comes the great netherling warrior...
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_011: Like double rainbows in the mists, Sonu knows not what to make of this! An eye in the hands of a netherling!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_012: Storm clouds of the Vundu are no match for the eye's might! Smash it against the aetheryte in the Whale's Crown and He will be vulnerable once more!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_013: Bind Him with chains of steel and drive Him from cloud sea! Return zephyr winds and sunlight to our lands!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_021: As sun rises and falls and returns,  who bears an eye cannot be denied!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_CID_000_020: There you are, . The Enterprise Excelsior is ready to depart whenever you are.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_CID_000_021: ...Say again? Chief Sonu wants you to smash some gemstone against an aetheryte to dispel a barrier of storm clouds? I, uh...I don't even know where to begin...
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_CID_100_021: Bah, the hells with it. Maybe it'll bring us good luck. I'll rendezvous with you there.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_CID_101_021:
You know, you could just lie and say you did it.
...What? <sigh> Fine, we'll do it the hard way.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SYSTEM_000_014: After a pause, you smash the gemstone against the aetheryte. Nothing much happens. Out of habit, you attune with the aetheryte...and once more, nothing much happens.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_030: As storm clouds give way to sunlight, so hope returns to Zundu, and clarity of vision to Sonu.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_031: Sonu sees netherling for who  truly is. Netherling is bearer foretold.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_032: Once, long ago, in the midst of a great battle with a tribe from the nethers, a horrid, wicked demon comes to feast on the bodies of the fallen.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_033: Manukmanai, we name him! Manukmanai, we decry him! For generations he hunts the Vanu Vanu, but this day, we say no more!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_034: Greatest of our heroes climbs atop the beast's back, and with blades black as midnight, she rips his eyes from his head, and casts them into cloud sea!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_035: "In hour of great need, eyes return to the Vanu. Look to their bearer for salvation.“ So she declares, so it comes to pass! And now, netherling's deeds we remember forevermore!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_SONUVANU_000_048: May zephyr winds ever be at your back and sunshine ever warm your brow, O Chosen of the Manukmanai!
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_110_050: You needn't say a word. The aetheric readings left no doubt: the Lord of the Mists is no more.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_110_051: For the time being, at least. After all, such beings have a rather troublesome tendency to return.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_500_051: Let us turn our attention to the Lord of the Hive, who in quiet meditation awaits your coming...
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_600_050: And thus has his essence joined that of the Lord of the Hive in its return unto the land.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_601_051: You have my gratitude, Warrior of Light. Without your valiant efforts, these primal terrors would have invited devastation on a cataclysmic scale.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_602_052: ...For unlike others of their ilk, Bismarck and Ravana both harbor the desire─and the power─to reach Azys Lla.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_603_053: It is with dreadful certainty that I sensed their intent to feed on the strength of the Warring Triad, and thereby amplify their own power by an order of magnitude.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_604_054: By what wisdom do I claim such certainty? I am gifted with... How shall I put this? An intimate knowledge of the primal mind.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_605_055: You are curious, I am sure. But you need not understand the nature of a power to use it, do you? It is much the same with the Echo, I imagine.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_606_056: Ah, the realm of Eorzea... Ever has it been a land embraced by gods. For weal or for woe, I should wonder.
TEXT_HEAVNY202_02115_UNUKALHAI_607_057: For the time being, I shall remain here in the Rising Stones, and assist Urianger with his research into the eikons. If you should require aught further of me...simply ask.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_UNUKALHAI_000_000: As you prepare yourself for battle, so, too, does Ravana...
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_UNUKALHAI_000_001: Within Thok ast Thok he builds his strength, feeding upon the prayers of his innumerable children. But those same children will not suffer you to live should you surrender yourself to them a second time.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_UNUKALHAI_000_002: Nay, you must devise a new way of approaching the Lord of the Hive's domain. Consult with the storyteller, the elder of the Vath, and he will aid in this endeavor.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_UNUKALHAI_000_003: Take this bauble. 'Tis known among the Gnath as the Burning Eye of Ravana. When the time comes, you will know what to do...
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_UNUKALHAI_000_014: The Lord of the Hive crouches within Thok ast Thok, sharpening his blades in anticipation of coming conflict. I ask that you grant him the violence he craves.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_UNUKALHAI_000_015: His children, however, will not be deceived a second time. Speak with the storyteller of the Vath, and devise a new approach into Ravana's domain.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_010:
<click> <click> Ah, our hunter friend. Welcome.
...You come hunting gods once more?
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_011: The Nonmind is glad of your thirst for divine blood. Ever more rapacious do the Onemind grow as they seek offerings to glut our deity's insatiable appetite.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_012: ...Another path to our god's domain? Yes...yes, there is but one way. You must seek out the Gynehive on the far side of the colony, and attune your spirit to the aetheryte ensconced within.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_013: But the deed is not possible─we hear that the crystal is warded by ancient ritual magicks. The Onemind have woven the seal such that only the most worthy of warriors shall be granted leave to enter Thok ast Thok. And they do not share with the Nonmind what they consider “worthy”...
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_021: The path into Thok ast Thok is closed to all but the most worthy of warriors. You are strong, hunter, but we would be sad should you slaughter your way to the Gynehive only to be trapped inside with a warded aetheryte...
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_SYSTEM_000_020: After a pause, you smash the gemstone against the aetheryte. Nothing much happens. Out of habit, you attune with the aetheryte...and once more, nothing much happens.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_030: <click> <click> ...Once more have you slain our ravening god! Your tribe must think you a great hunter indeed!
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_031: Even the Onemind must begin to appreciate the folly of their wasteful summonings...
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_032: But tell us, great hunter: how were you able to pass the seal? Did it simply melt away at the approach of your indomitable presence?
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_033: ...A gemstone of fire and earth? Hmmm. There is something...a memory we have from the Overmind, before we were cast out... A memory of the Burning Eye of Ravana!
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_034:
The Overmind has recollections of legends a hundred generations old. We remember the tale of our god as He once was─an all-devouring beast whose eye was torn from Him by an invading tribe. The Gnath have sought to recover this lost relic for centuries, that it might be rejoined with Ravana reborn.
But even were it found, it is said that only the most worthy of warriors can bear its searing touch... I now understand why the seal granted you passage. But tell us, great hunter: how came you by the eye?
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_035: ...A youngling named Unukalhai? Your deed has returned many memories to the surface of our mind, but that name is not among them. To gift you with such a prize, he, too, must have thought you worthy.
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_036: We thank you, great hunter. Too soon do our memories from the Overmind fade, but you have given us a new story to tell...
TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_STORYTELLER_000_042: Your deeds are become legend amongst the Vath, great hunter. We will tell your story for generations to come.

TEXT_HEAVNY203_02116_UNUKALHAI_600_050: Now, must you set your gaze upon Bismarck, Lord of the Mists.

TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_SHIPOWNER02204_000_: Ah, you have the look of a  who's seen  fair share of trouble─mayhap you'd be willing to help me with mine. I need a capable sort to head into the Sea of Clouds and track down my missing airship.

I had to mortgage my soul to get that vessel built, so winning the contract to ferry supplies out to Cloudtop was a real weight off my mind. But it seems my luck ended there─my ship was due back in Ishgard bells ago and I've been praying for a glimpse of her sails ever since!
I can't help fearing the worst... What if she's run afoul of sky pirates!? My creditors will have their ponze of flesh!

...You think me foolish to fear piracy so far above the waves? Well, let me tell you that no honest merchant is safe now that airship production has─if you will excuse the pun─taken off. Any scoundrel with a sack of coin and a vague sense of direction can terrorize the skies!

Oh, yes, this new breed of buccaneers like to paint themselves as dashing explorers braving the unknown, but the truth of their nature is right there in the name: sky pirates! Given half a chance, they'll strip your ship of every last scrap of cargo and cry “Yahaharrr!” as they launch you screaming over the rails! I've heard the stories!
Please, you must make haste to Camp Cloudtop─that's where the shipment was bound─and inquire as to the fate of my poor ship. Oh, and my poor helmsman! Ask Rontremont! He'll know─if any man does!
Pray make haste to Camp Cloudtop and speak with Rontremont. Mayhap he will have some news of my missing airship.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RONTREMONT_000_020: A supply airship has gone missing, you say? Well, that would certainly explain why our provisions are so late in arriving...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RONTREMONT_000_021: I did, in fact, spy a vessel charting an erratic course northwards a short while ago...but as it seemed disinclined to make port here, I paid it little mind.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RONTREMONT_000_022: Not the most compelling piece of evidence, I grant you, but I have witnessed naught else of interest. I suggest you investigate the landmass to the north. Rest assured, I will send word if I spy any other sign of our errant supply ship.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RONTREMONT_000_025: The vessel I spotted earlier may very well have been the supply ship you seek. It was northward bound the last I saw─mayhap you could continue your search in that direction?
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_HELMSMAN02204_000_0: Hah, we'll make some good coin from this haul! And then we'll see if this fool is worth the ransom...
Aid! Aid, I say! These villains mean to plunder my cargo!
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_AIRPIRATE02204_000_: What've we got here, then? Think you're some sort of hero, do you?
Well then, you won't mind if me mates here join the fun. Make for a more heroical tale, won't it? ...The tale of how three sky pirates fed a meddlin' little shite  own bloody eyes!

What the─
Oh gods, I know that ship! It's─
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_034: (-???-)So you're the scrags what've been draggin' our good name through the mud...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_AIRPIRATE02204_000_: You...you're Redbill Leofard! We ain't done naught to you or yours. What do you want with us!?
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_036: I think I made me position pretty clear: you take on the mantle of sky pirate, you agree to a certain code of conduct. And codes ain't worth much if folk go around breakin' 'em. Frankly, lads, you're makin' us look bad, and we can't have that. No hard feelin's though, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_HELMSMAN02204_000_0: Oh, thank you, Mister Leofard! Thank you! I'm certain my master will wish to repay you...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_038: If your employer does business in Ishgard, he likely knows a merchant or two what trades with me associates. Tell him to say it's for “Leofard” and any reward should reach me soon enough.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_039: As for you, adventurer─'tain't often someone beats me to the scene... But then I'd expect naught less from a hero such as yourself....
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_040: That is who you are, ain't it? I don't know too many other  with one of them marvelous manacutters the Ironworks dreamed up.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_041: Well, then, it seems you've saved me the trouble of trackin' you down. I'd been hopin' to have a word with you, you see...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_042: I'll put it to you straight: I need someone to help out with a little venture I have in mind. Someone used to takin' a few risks.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_043: Now, this wouldn't be no black-hearted brigand's work, so don't go worryin' yourself on that account. Unlike them thievin' curs just now, I don't hold with robbin' honest folk.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_044: For me, you see, the sky pirate's life is all about freedom─the freedom to go where you will; to find out what lies beyond the next cloud! If you're interested in joinin' us on an adventure worthy of the name, then look for me standard in the northern reaches of the Blue Window. Someone'll be waitin' there to greet you.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_050: That's far enough, stranger. If you value your life, tell me true: did you stumble across this marker by chance, or are you here by invitation?
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_053: Then that would make you the hero the captain said to watch out for. Well met.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_054: The name's Stacia. Leofard would call me his right-hand woman, but I feel more like his bloody nursemaid, gods' truth be told...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_055: Ahem. Anyway, my thanks to you for comin' to hear him out. If you'd follow me, I'll take you to the Redbills' nest.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_058: Then you'd best forget we ever had this conversation. On your way.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RADLIA_000_060: (-???-)...I come to you in person, and still you refuse my offer? Arrogant fool.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_061: On the subject of arrogance, Radlia, I bow to your superior knowledge. But that's all the bowin' you'll get from me. As I've told you a dozen times before, I ain't no one's lackey.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RADLIA_000_062: But my dear Leofard, how else do you propose to survive an expedition into the ghost ship? I would fear for my life with naught but your feeble crewmates at my back...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_063: While I'd fear for me life with your mangy crew at my back, on account of 'em bein' murderous untrustworthy bastards to a man.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RADLIA_000_064: Hmph. I thought you cleverer than this, Redbill. But no matter─I always get what I want in the end. 'Tis merely a question of method.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RADLIA_000_065: Now there's a face I've not seen before. Hmmm. You don't have the look of one of Leofard's little birds.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_066: a guest. You understand the concept, don't you? You know, when someone is invited, instead of just burstin' through the door whenever she damn well pleases?
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_067: That was Radlia, captain of the Talons. She knows Leofard's the best sky pirate alive, and the fact he won't join her sticks in her craw.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_SUBORDINATE02204_00: Are you gonna let them talk to you like that, Captain? We should teach them Redbills some respect!
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_RADLIA_000_069: Patience. When all of this is over, we shall see who rules the skies.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_070: Ho there, hero. I promised you high adventure, and high adventure you shall have...for we plan to board the Sea of Clouds' very own ghost ship!
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_071: ...Or what folk have taken to callin' one, anyway. Every day for the past few weeks has brought with it a new sightin' of the selfsame vessel─a massive airship of queer design, adrift on the wind.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_072: Bein' a curious lot, there were a few buccaneers who tried explorin' belowdecks...but not one of 'em's been seen since. And so, naturally, they're sayin' the ship is cursed. Well, “haunted.”
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_073: Like I said: an honest-to-gods ghost ship!
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_074: My guess is she's another relic left behind by the Allagans, but we won't know for sure till we've had ourselves a good poke around inside. ...And liberated whatever ancient treasures she's got molderin' away in her hold, of course.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_075: But before we start dividin' up the spoils, we've got to find the damn thing─which is why we've been workin' on a special new device...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_076: Bah, findin' her'll be the easy part. What we can't do without is a veteran explorer what ain't afraid to fling  face-first into the jaws of danger.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_077: Now, I know you're a gallant champion of the people, and all. But strip away the fame and the glory, and I'll wager you're still an adventurer at heart. So what say you, ? Fancy a plunge into the unknown at the side of the Redbills?
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_078: Then it's settled. Let's pay a visit to our crewmate, Utata─she's been workin' on a way to track the vessel.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_STACIA_000_080: This here's Utata, the lass I was tellin' you about. She's our engineer, and a damn good one at that.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARD_000_082: I always get this little thrill in me chest when I'm about to embark on a new adventure. And once you've felt your heart dance like that, there's naught you wouldn't do to feel it again...
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_LEOFARDSCONSPIRATOR: Might be as there are better engineers in the realm, but I'd wager none are as inventive as our Utata. She earns her keep with her brains, not her brawn, and we're a stronger crew for it.
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_UTATA_000_090: Greetings! The name's Utata! I suppose you'd call me the Redbills' chief of engineering. Smithing, carpentry, magitek─if it's part of an airship, I can fix it!
TEXT_HEAVNM101_02204_UTATA_000_091: ...Just don't expect to see me waving a cutlass and swinging over the rails. If there's fighting to be done, well, that's what we have you for!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_005: This here's Utata, the lass I was tellin' you about. She's our engineer, and a damn good one at that.
