TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_UTATA_100_015: Well met, ladies and gentlepirates! Now that we appear to have our hero, I'm happy to report that we've overcome the last obstacle to boarding the ghost ship!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARD_100_016: ...Meanin' your project is proceedin' as planned?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_UTATA_100_017: That it is, Captain! I knew this would be the perfect place to take readings─the scant amounts of background aether make it easy to follow the derelict's trail.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_018: The ghost ship has what Utata tells us is a “unique aetheric signature.” She's been buildin' a device what can sniff out this particular spectral flavor, and point us in the right direction.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_UTATA_100_019: I call it the “ectocompass”! It's allowed me to collect some solid data on the vessel's movements, and plot a reliable intercept course. No groping blindly through the clouds for us!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_020: All the ships are loaded and ready to fly. Just say the word, Captain.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARD_100_021: Utata, you'd best stay here, out of harm's way. Keep an eye on them aether trails, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_UTATA_100_022: Aye, Captain! Grab an armload of treasure for me!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARD_100_023: Now, we've got no way of knowin' what's waitin' for us on that cursed hulk, , so you'd best bring along a few mates what you know you can trust. Don't hurt to be too careful, seein' as how you'll be goin' in first and all. I did tell you you'd be goin' in first, didn't I? I, well, you will.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARD_100_024: The rest of us'll be guardin' the rear, just in case Radlia and her brood decide to stick their beaks in where they ain't wanted. Don't worry, she'll not get past us, so you can concentrate on carvin' a path into the ship's belly!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARD_100_025:
An honest-to-gods ghost ship...
Ohhh-ho-ho, this is gonna be an adventure and a half!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_030: I'll be on hand to see that our curious captain don't get us all killed meddlin' with some ancient artifact or other─meanin' you'll be free to concentrate on not gettin' killed by whatever's waitin' belowdecks. Can't say fairer than that, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARD_100_035: We'll deal with any sneaky bastards what try creepin' in behind us while you and your mates forge ahead. That hulk's secrets'll be ours alone.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_UTATA_100_040: Leofard will be taking my ectocompass with him. Just follow his lead, and you'll arrive at the derelict soon enough. Who knows what wondrous trinkets await you inside!?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARDSCONSPIRATOR: The captain's dragged us on some hair-raisin' ventures in his time, but summat tells me this one's gonna be the worst of the lot. If we look out for each other, though, I reckon we'll make it home in one piece...with a bit of luck.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: Bugger me... I expected danger, but not a hells-spawned bleedin' nightmare made flesh like that! Didn't stop you and your mates, though, did it!? That's some crew you've got there, and no mistake.
Right, then─let's have a look inside that dirty great coffer-type...thing. Summat tells me it's filled to the brim with booty.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_STACIA_000_00: Don't look at me! I never moved a muscle!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: What in the seven hells is that bastard doin'!?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: (-???-)This way! Swiftly now!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: Er...can anyone else see that talkin' cat over there? Bloody hells, this adventure's gettin' queerer by the minute...
...Still, I'd rather take me chances with a prattlin' puss than stay here. Get your things, mateys─we're leavin'!
You can't spend it when you're dead! We either follow the furball, or make friends with a spell-slingin' voidborn! Your choice!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_STACIA_000_01: Gods damn it! How's an honest sky pirate meant to make a livin'!?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0:
The ship's breakin' up...
Is he tryin' to bring her down?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: (-???-)The voidsent is attempting to initiate a dimensional displacement! But the gate─it cannot possibly be large enough for the entire ship...
(-???-)<gasp> The Queen's Coffin! He takes it beyond our reach!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: Well, there don't seem much point hangin' 'round here. Let's get back to solid ground.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_060: What kind of cat is that anyway? And what was it doin' on that ship...?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_LEOFARDSCONSPIRATOR: Ugh... Me poor heart... 'Tis a pity about the loot and no mistake, but at least we made it out in one piece. As the captain's so fond of sayin', “You can't spend it when you're dead!” <sigh>
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_CAITSITH_100_070:
Long has it been since my paws have trodden aught but those cursed decks...
<sigh> Would that I had made landfall under better circumstances.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_100_0: Aye, 'twas a bit touch and go in places, I grant you, but here we all are, and all with our bits still attached! This calls for a foamin' flagon of─
Hold on. Ain't we missin' someone? Didn't I tell Utata to wait for us here?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_RADLIA_100_08: (-???-)Never fear. We've been keeping the girl company.
But enough about her! Did you see the cannon on that ship? As you know, my dear Leofard, I am not easily moved, but the sheer power on display set me all aquiver.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_100_0: Well, I hope you're content to admire it from afar. That vessel ain't for the likes of you and me.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_RADLIA_100_08: Do not presume to measure me by your own limitations. Besides, I believe I've shown how resourceful I can be.
Which brings me neatly to the point. You have in your possession a device capable of tracking the ghost ship. Hand it over, or your engineer shall suffer the consequences.
...Perfect. A compass pointing the way to my just reward. A weapon like that belongs in the hands of one with the will to use it!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_RADLIA_101_08: Come, lads. Our business here is concluded.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_UTATA_100_088: I'm sorry, Captain. They caught me off guard...
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_089: ...You get a bang on the head or summat? The man I know would never give in to scum like her without a fight. Unless─
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_090: <sigh> What did you do to the compass?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_100_0:
Who, me? Naught.
...Besides slippin' a linkpearl into its casin', like. Hah hah! So long as Radlia keeps it close─and you can be damn sure she will─we'll know exactly what them thievin' bastards are plannin'! Anyone care to wager how long it'll take her to notice me little gift?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_STACIA_100_092: That's very clever and all, but how were you proposin' to stop her from gettin' her hands on that derelict and its great big cannon?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_100_0: I ain't worked that part out yet. But I 'spect it'll start with us keepin' a close eye on the Talons.
'Fore we get into any of that, though, I've got some questions what need answerin'.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_CAITSITH_100_095: You wish to know more of the Void Ark? The “ghost ship,” as you call it?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_100_0: The Void Ark... So that's its proper name. Aye, I'd like to hear whatever you'd care to tell us, puss.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_CAITSITH_100_097: (-Cait Sith-)And I, for my part, am curious to hear your stories. Ere we continue, however, I must insist that you address me by my proper name: Cait Sith. I will not respond to “puss” or “cat,” and most decidedly not “furball.”
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: My tale begins long, long ago in the city of Mhach, which once stood in the lands of Yafaem.
The sorcerers of Mhach were masters of destructive magicks, and they brought that terrible power to bear against Amdapor and Nym in the War of the Magi.

The titanic forces they unleashed, however, took a heavy toll upon the land, ultimately resulting in a colossal flood that drowned the realm of Eorzea─a catastrophe which my master, High Voidmage Cessair, was wise enough to foresee.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_STACIA_000_05: Wait, wait, wait... Colossal flood? Are you talkin' about the Sixth Umbral Calamity?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: Hmm, I suppose you would know it as such... Now, where was I? Ah, yes. When they learned of the fate that awaited them, the Mhachi magi began construction of a gargantuan vessel that would bear their people to the skies, and to safety.

The operation of the Void Ark, as the ship came to be called, was entrusted to Cessair. Prior to that, of course, my master had been a prisoner in her own home, confined for her outspoken opposition to the war...
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_UTATA_000_056: So the Ark was meant as a sanctuary? Then, how did it come to be so...um... I mean, what happened to all the people? And where did all the voidsent come from?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: By what power do you imagine such a massive craft remains aloft? The energy required to raise the Ark was siphoned from over a thousand otherworldly servants sealed within the vessel.

Advances in Mhachi sorcery were made for one reason and one reason only: cataclysmic destructive power. And the swiftest─and most dangerous─method of acquiring that power was through the enslavement of voidsent entities.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_UTATA_000_059: So, the creatures on the derelict...they broke free from your master's control?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: At the very heart of the Ark, the voidmages had entombed a great ruler of the voidsent─Scathach, the Shadow Queen.

But in order to control so potent a prisoner, a mage of adamant will was required. And being Mhach's preeminent sorcerer, Cessair was deemed best qualified. Were it otherwise, my master might never have been released from her own imprisonment...
Yet even with Cessair's peerless skill, the Shadow Queen could not long be subjugated. One after another, the lesser voidsent awoke, and ran rampant within the ship.

In the end, Cessair and the fifty-three voidmages aboard the Ark sacrificed their own life energies to return the fiends to their coffins...leaving me, a lowly familiar, to watch over a derelict prison.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: If I remember me Umbral Eras right, the stuff you just described happened more'n fifteen hundred years past─which is a good while by anyone's measure. And since everythin' seems to have been quiet on board your boat till just recently, I'm thinkin' summat unusual must've happened to wake the inmates up. Am I warm?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: One day, a voidsent that had taken the shape of a bat flew into the ship. At first, it was little more than a nuisance that I brushed away, but the longer it remained on the Ark, the stronger it seemed to become... Eventually I could not contend with its power, and it began shattering seal after seal!
...You have faced this bat-winged fiend before!? It would seem, then, that the creature survived the encounter...and that he intends to celebrate his restoration by liberating his queen.
...Ah, but you looked upon the true form of this fiend as he broke the chains holding the Queen's Coffin. I can only assume that he is one of Scathach's subjects, intent on bringing about her return.
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: Well, that explains that, then─'cept for one small detail, namely, where the Queen's Coffin went. After it fell out of the ship's belly...I'm assumin' it didn't just disappear, right?
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: You recall the great rift that the Ark's cannon ripped in the sky? That was a voidgate.

Such a portal opens a temporary path through the void, allowing the ship to travel almost instantaneously from one location to another. The voidsent, as you saw, only opened a gate large enough to displace the Coffin. As for the Coffin's destination, however...that is as much a mystery to me as it is to you.
I beseech you, conquerors of the Ark: help me find the Queen's Coffin ere the wards binding Scathach are dispelled!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: Smells to me like an adventure! And who knows what ancient Mhachi treasures we might stumble on along the way!? Gods know, they'll make a nice change from all them Allagan tomestones we've been collectin'!
Aye, we'll help you. I'm not riskin' me hide for the sake of the realm, you understand, but I'll be damned if I let either Radlia or that bat-winged bastard take the freedom of the skies from me!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_CAITSITH_000_: You... You care only for how you might be inconvenienced!? If the Shadow Queen were to return, it would have dire consequences for this entire star!
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_LEOFARD_000_0: Count your blessin's, furball! I said we'd help, didn't I?

'Fore we go rushin' off in search of that coffin, though, there's preparations to be made. You might as well get back to your usual heroical employment, . I'll let you know when it's time to round up your mates again...
TEXT_HEAVNM102_02205_02205_RADLIA_000_10: The time is nigh, my dear Talons. Soon, we shall seize control of the ghost ship and all its power, and rule the skies from here to the ends of the world!
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_000: The time has come, Warrior of Light─we must move against the Warring Triad now, or suffer the consequences.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_001: The seal is cracked and the eikons stir. Should they be allowed to awaken and resume their titanic conflict, it will be alike to the coming of a second Calamity. You, , represent our best hope of eliminating this threat.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_002: That said, the very act of entering the containment facility itself presents certain...unique challenges. So unique, in fact, that I struggled to locate an individual with the requisite talents to surmount them. Were it not for the impressively diverse connections of your fellow Scions, I might still be searching. Happily, however, they were able to furnish me with a suitable candidate.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_003: Now, along with you and your Echo-blessed companions, all the pieces we need to proceed with this deadly game are arrayed upon the board. Victory hinges upon no less than the total destruction of the Warring Triad.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_004: But we must also ware the interference of those who covet the Allagans' primal-harnessing technology. I speak, of course, of the blindly grasping hand of the Garlean Empire and its fumbling agents.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_005: The ignorant meddling of the Empire will serve only to hasten the eikons' awakening, and it is my master's desire that the Triad be dispatched before imperial forces delve too deeply.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_006: Being the nearest to wakefulness, the eikon Sephirot shall be your first adversary. Make your preparations, and join me on the Flagship in Azys Lla. We shall speak further there.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_010: Of the Warring Triad, Sephirot's slumber is the most fitful. Join me on Azys Lla's central isle as soon as you are able, and we shall attend to his destruction first.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_030: This is the place, Warrior of Light. Here we will find the containment facility wherein entities of incalculable power lie chained, their fathomless energies siphoned away by Allagan devices.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_031: As I warned you, Sephirot poses the most immediate threat─his dreaming mind drifts perilously close to consciousness. Thus must his destruction be our first concern.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_032: Your fellow Scions will be joining us anon, accompanied by the uniquely talented individual of whom I spoke. From what I gather, the two of you are already well acquainted.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_033: Let us continue inside, and wait before the doors to the containment facility.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_040: You've not been waiting long, I trust? We are eager to lend whatever cooperation we may to your mission, .
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_041: It is an honor to meet you at last. As I know of only one Miqo'te Scion, you must be Archon Y'shtola...meaning your diminutive companion is Mistress Krile of the Students of Baldesion. Correct?
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_042: Diminutive? Perhaps there has been some mistake. I assumed it was for my knowledge and not my stature that you requested my assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_043: Ahem. The mistake is mine. My apologies if I have given offense. Mayhap it would be best if we proceeded directly to the matter of our objectives.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_044: Your adversary is the eikon Sephirot of the Warring Triad, otherwise known by the historians of Allag as “the Fiend.” He was once the patron deity to a tribe of treelike beings native to Meracydia, but was subdued by the Allagan Empire after a lengthy war of attrition.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_045: After his defeat, he was imprisoned for use as a source of power. Even now, Sephirot is neither truly living nor dead─his mind bound in a dream while his body's energies are harnessed by Allagan technologies.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_046: The explanation for his failure to dissipate into aether lies in his restraints. These ingenious devices serve not only to bind him but to continuously regenerate his corporeal form.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_047: Meaning it will be all but impossible to banish him while said restraints are in place, yes? Remove them, however, and we risk allowing an unfathomably powerful─and doubtless vengeful─eikon to run rampant.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_048: It seems we have no choice but to divide our forces: one team must locate the controls to Sephirot's shackles and disable them, while the other stands ready to destroy him at the moment of his awakening.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_049: ...A most succinct assessment, Mistress Krile. While I was aware that the Echo provided you with uncanny insight, I did not expect you to intuit the core of my strategy quite so swiftly.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_050: Ha! If only my gift offered such detailed analysis─which is to say, it doesn't. I merely took it upon myself to learn as much about the Triad's imprisonment as I could before coming here. It will be  and I, after all, who enter the eikon's den.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_YSHTOLA_000_051: Indeed. Given the nature of our adversary, none save those under the aegis of the Echo should be permitted to enter the containment facility. The risk of primal influence is too great.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_052: Well, that's that settled, then. I will disable the restraints, and  and  gifted adventurer friends will welcome Sephirot back into the waking world. Better that than the other way around, I'd say, considering our respective fields of expertise─and, of course, my diminutive stature.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_100_052:
Right.
It's time I had a little “chat” with the doorkeeper over there...
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_VERIFICATIONSYSTEM_: <blip> Activating verification systems. Lifting access restriction to Triad Control...
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_054: I had no idea the Baldesion curriculum was so comprehensive. When we locate the controls for Sephirot's restraints, I shall gladly leave their operation to you.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_YSHTOLA_000_055: When “we” locate the controls? Mayhap my words were unclear. Only those blessed with the Echo may safely enter the facility.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_056: Your concern for my sanity is touching─but unnecessary. Suffice it to say, I am in no danger of falling under the eikon's sway.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_VERIFICATIONSYSTEM_: <blip> <bloop> WARNING! Verification systems detect multiple unauthorized vessels entering restricted airspace. Security systems engaging intruders.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_YSHTOLA_000_058:
The Garleans...
Come, Urianger, we must keep the imperials occupied.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_059: We too should be on our way. Gods...I would be lying if I said I wasn't slightly terrified... But I can't very well leave every deadly task to you Scions.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_060: According to the histories, Sephirot was immense in both size and strength─mighty enough to rout even the implacable armies of the Allagans, and that more than once. To cut a long story short, we have to get this right.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_061: I shall do my best not to wake the eikon up too much. As my grandfather always used to say of certain little monsters: “Get them up and get them moving while their brains are still abed.”
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_080: Sephirot's power beggars belief. But a hero of your standing surely needs no reminding of the dangers of underestimating such an adversary.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_VERIFICATIONSYSTEM_:
<blip> Activating verification systems...
Identification code accepted. Triad Control clearance granted.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_200:
You did it! I've seen you in action before, but never against anything that big...
My legs kept telling me to run, but I just couldn't tear myself away! I don't think I blinked once during the whole battle!
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_201:
A hero, tried and true.
If only I had possessed such strength...
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_202: Y'shtola? This is Krile. Eikon eliminated! Oh, if only you could have seen it...  gave Sephirot the mother of all rude awakenings!
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_203: And your distraction was perfect! We encountered not a single imperial soldier. Hm? Yes. Understood. Let's swap tales at the Rising Stones, then!
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_204: On our path to the control chamber, we discovered a number of dormant thralls. It would seem the machines that preserve their forms also hold them in a state of torpor. We need not fear them summoning their deity anew.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_205: In short, our work here is done─for the present, at least. Let's go home, shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: Your senses are sharp, young one.

I am Regula van Hydrus, legatus of the VIth Legion...and it would seem that that damnable woman and her accomplice have led me a merry dance through the thickest of this infernal island's defenses. To think that I pursued them. <sigh> I shall withdraw for now, my lesson learnt.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_209: I doubt it. You Garleans never learn. You covet the means to enslave primals─but in your headlong dash to control that which you do not understand, you show less wisdom than the very beast tribes that summoned them!
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: I have no interest in crossing blades with children. Live, grow strong, and mayhap one day you will warrant my attention.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_211: I looked back and you weren't there. Did something happen?
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_212: Naught of consequence. I mistook a shadow for a man.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_213: Just what are you hiding beneath that mask of yours? Hmmm... A longing for hope. An appetite for power. A lingering sense of regret.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_214: And do I detect a desire to test your strength against a certain hero...?
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_215: ...Is that what your gifts tell you?
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_216: No, those were just wild guesses. But I wonder if some few of my words didn't strike close to the mark.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_217: Be at ease, Unukalhai─I have no supernatural ability to read minds. The Echo simply allows me to comprehend, regardless of language, that which a fellow being would have me know. You need not mask your heart as you do your countenance.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_218: That was a performance, then? A ruse to uncover my true nature? I see I shall have to keep my wits about me...
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_300: So, Warrior of Light, how did it feel to strike down so great a foe? You must tell me more of the experience once our meeting with your colleagues is concluded...
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_URIANGER_000_310: Through thine all-surpassing skill at arms do we now take our first step in ridding this star of the Warring Triad's baleful presence. And in such wise do we lessen the burden bequeathed unto us by the vainglory of Allag.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_URIANGER_000_311: Know, however, that the two eikons which remain are thought equal in might to Sephirot...and may yet exceed him. Ere thou proceed, I would counsel thee to marshal thy strength, and give careful thought to thy preparation.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_312: Assuming the Garleans afford us the luxury of time. Even now, they grasp for the means to dominate primals, blind to the technology's potential for calamity.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_313: My master taught me that the entity known as Sephirot was this world's first sacred tree, elevated to godhood by the belief of its worshipers. There is no power more fearsome than that born of unconditional faith and unbending ideal.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_YSHTOLA_000_314: 'Tis plain your master found in you a willing student. Tell me, was it he who taught you of Allagan technology's “potential for calamity,” or are those your own words?
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_315: 'Twas but a figure of speech, nothing more.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_100_315: When last we met, I thought I caught a glimpse of the boy behind the mask. ...But it would seem your defenses are firmly back in place.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_316: Must you persist with this infuriating veil of secrecy? I for one would very much like to know who this “master” of yours is─amongst other things.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_UNUKALHAI_000_317: As long as our purposes align, what matter my affiliation?
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_318: It matters a great deal. I do not ask out of idle curiosity─if we are to fight as comrades, we need to be able to trust each other.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_319:
On which note, I should apologize for my earlier trickery. It was merely an attempt to get to the heart of an enigmatic companion.
Truth be told, I was rather glad you reacted as you did. No person of your age has any business being calm and aloof all of the time, much as you might wish to be.
TEXT_HEAVNY211_02230_KRILE_000_320: Anyway, we had best be off. Do send word if there are any further developments!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_000: Pshkohhh... Roundrox thinks long and hard on what to do with precious glowstone...
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_001: It is most favoritest treasure of Roundrox. But glowstone is also what Mide seeks all this time, and has already brought Roundrox three whole years of joy. So Roundrox decides to give it to Mide, so she can be happy too.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_002: For now, Roundrox entrusts treasure to uplander, to give to Mide at next meeting. Even meanest gobbies dare not try to take glowstone from mighty uplander!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_003: Roundrox does not know where Mide is now, but she often gazes out on giant of whirlycogs from broken watercross. Maybe uplander finds her there.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_010: Glowstone will now be Mide's most favoritest treasure! Uplander might find her near broken watercross, looking out over giant of whirlycogs.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_020: From afar, that mass of steel has a certain majesty, does it not? ...But something tells me you didn't come here to share the view. What is it?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_021: Roundrox means to give me the codex fragment? I...I couldn't possibly accept. She values that stone over the rest of her treasures combined...
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_022: And yet...it may be safer in the hands of one more capable of defending it... Safer for all concerned. Gods know the Illuminati will stop at nothing to get it. Very well, if she feels I should have it, I will hold it in safekeeping for her.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_030: Alas, it is of no more use to me than any other rock.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_031: You doubtless recall the moment when Roundrox first revealed the codex fragment to us, yes?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_032: When she took the stone in her hands, a piece of the Enigma Codex burst forth unbidden in a brilliant flash of light. Yet it had been handled many times by others, yourself included, without ever betraying a hint of the secret contained within. Did you not find that strange?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_033: I myself was surprised─albeit for a different reason. The codex is protected by an arcane mechanism, you see. Only those who share its fundamental principles are able to view its contents. It is rare indeed to find an individual with the qualities required to read it.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_034: That Roundrox possesses such qualities is an unexpected blessing, to be sure, but if the Illuminati were to learn of her secret, she would be placed in grave danger.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_035: Even as we speak, they scour the hinterlands in search of their elusive “missing piece,” but as far as I know, they still view our friend as a mere collector of misplaced items.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_036: For her sake, we must do our utmost to draw their attention away from Bigwest Shortstop, before they take it into their heads to return. And it is for that reason that I mean to leave this place. When the Illuminati learn that I have the fragment, it is my hope that they will focus their efforts on ascertaining my whereabouts.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_037: Needless to say, I may not return to Bigwest Shortstop for some time. While I'm gone, I would ask that you watch over Roundrox. See that she does not come to harm.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_MIDE_000_039: As I thought, I am no longer worthy...
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BACKRIX_000_040: Pssshkoh... Wedge searches for uplander with much urgency! Uplander must return to Bigwest Shortstop at once!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_060: Pssshkoh... Is Mide now enjoying treasure too? Many thanks to you, uplander!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BACKRIX_000_070: Pssshkoh... Questions of codex's true nature niggle at Backrix's braincase. He is sure something is missing from data, so turns to Sharlayan book for answers.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BACKRIX_000_071: Backrix cautions uplander against trusting Mide so readily. She has knowings she has yet to share, Backrix is certain of it.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_100: There you are, , and not a moment too soon! The Illuminati are getting ready for something big!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_101: Y'shtola reports that Alexander has started drawing massive amounts of aether from the surrounding land─which can only mean one thing! The Illuminati have resumed their attempts to revive it!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_102: And what's more, Backrix reports that the goblins are amassing substantial quantities of explosives and supplies. By all indications, they're building another weapon! In short─it's bad!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_103: But it's nothing a bit of strategic thinking can't fix! They say he who strikes first strikes last, and that's exactly what I intend to do!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_104: I've devised a plan which should allow us to take the Illuminati unawares, and I'd like you to spearhead the assault! Our rendezvous point is to the south, on the cliffs overlooking the Thaliak. Biggs has gone ahead to scout the area. We shall await your arrival there!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_400: ! Good to see you! I take it Wedge told you the situation. You ready to hit the Illuminati where it hurts?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_401: That's what I like to hear! The chief'll be here soon, and then we can get things underway.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_410: Bloody hells! If it ain't Y'shtola! No one told me you were coming!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_YSHTOLA_000_411: An aetheric disturbance of this scale demands my personal attention. Judging by the marked fall in ambient aether concentrations, the situation is far graver than previously assumed.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_CID_000_412: And you are certain that steel monstrosity is to blame?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_YSHTOLA_000_413: I can see no other explanation. The giant's innards are well-nigh saturated with aether already. Yet I sense something else... An irregular energy coming from within the barrier.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_CID_000_414: Be that as it may, I'm afraid we have more pressing concerns. The Illuminati are up to something, and we mean to hit them before they can put whatever it is they're planning into action.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_415:
To which end─allow me to introduce my newest and perhaps most astounding invention...
...The Electrojammer III, first of its kind!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_416: Speechless with astonishment, I see. As well you should be! The high-frequency waves emitted by this device will interfere with any and all enemy communications, making it impossible for them to coordinate an effective defense! With it working in our favor, victory is all but assured!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_CID_000_417: ...I see. So, assuming I have understood correctly, you need only activate this Electrojammer of yours, and the Illuminati will be plunged into disarray, affording  and  friends ample opportunity to take them unawares? Very well. Proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_418: Er...Wedge? Is this supposed to happen?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_YSHTOLA_000_000_420: Nay. Only the left arm stirs. Could the waves emitted by your device have disturbed something within the barrier, Wedge?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_422: Not to worry, Wedge. With the Illuminati hard at work reviving the giant, 'twas only a matter of time before parts of it started springing to life. You just gave this one a little extra nudge. On a brighter note, it would seem you've saved us the trouble of finding another way in.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_CID_000_423: , old friend─it's time for your customary heroics! The Illuminati are likely still scrambling to work out what just happened. Before they do, I suggest you hop across the river and show them what for!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_YSHTOLA_000_424: I must needs discuss these developments with Master Matoya. Cid, would you be so good as to accompany me? Your insight may well prove useful.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Another core stirs to life. The future unfolds exactly as expected...exactly as written...
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_450: Pshkohhh... Uplander goes once again into giant of whirlycogs? Then Roundrox wishes for brave uplander's safe return!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_451: To search more for shiny bittybobs is tempting...but Roundrox stays here like good girl and polishes treasure until Mide comes back.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_LIGHTKIX_000_470: Pshkohhh... Uplander feels shiveryshakes? Arm of steel giant is wide open, and no Illuminati in sight!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_SYSTEM_000_480: You now have access to the Fist of the Son. Midas can be accessed via the entrance at the Thaliak River.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_500: It's in your hands now, ! We'll be patrolling the area, looking for signs of Illuminati activity. Don't let your guard down in there, eh? Who knows what mechanical monstrosities they've been working on?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_510: Now's your chance, ! I'll wager the Illuminati don't know which way up they are in there! You could creep in and dismantle their new weapon before they even think to use it!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_550: I gather you brought the Illuminati's schemes to a shuddering halt─just as I planned!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_551: Unfortunately, a small...complication arose while you were gone. But, um...Biggs wanted to be the one to tell you.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_570: Pshkohhh... Roundrox does as she says, stays here and makes treasure sparkle!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_571:
Pssshkoh... Shiny junk and sparkly rocks,♪
Bittybobs and whirlycogs.♪
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_600: Well done, ! You left those Illuminati smarting, and without so much as a scratch to show for it!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_601: Now, I'm sure you'd like to finish them off─and we would too, if truth be told─but I'm sorry to say we have a problem. While Wedge and I were out on patrol, we saw something, you see... A meeting...between Mide and the enemy.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_610: ...And then she handed the codex fragment over, just like that! The way she sauntered back into Alexander with the Illuminati, you'd think this was their plan all along!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_611: It certainly looks that way, aye... But we can't rule out the possibility of coercion, considering the parties involved.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Foolish uplanders! Treasure hunter was happy to give codex! And why not? She makes busydeals with Illuminati since very beginning!
And now Illuminati hold all fragments of the Enigma Codex.
Treasure hunter betrays uplanders' trust, and forfeits their future in so doing!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_615: What a load of old bollocks! How daft does he think we are!?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_616: Now, now, Biggs! If the Grand Master of the Illuminati said it, it must be true!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Everything is as written. As it must be. If Illuminati are to guide chosen to perfect world, not one piece can be out of place.
With this, another page becomes reality. When Illuminati find missing piece, the prophecy will be fulfilled.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_619: ...Goodness me! That goblin hasn't the faintest idea how uplanders' minds work. I would have been prepared to believe that Mide was a traitor had he not bothered to come here and confirm it. Now I'm inclined to think she isn't!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BACKRIX_000_620: Pssshkoh... There may be truth to what Quickthinx says. Backrix scours over data, looking for knowings of what happened three years ago.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BACKRIX_000_621: Backrix finds mention of group of Auri treasure hunters. Three years ago, group went to investigate ruins near Thaliak River only to perish in sudden shiveryshakes...
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BIGGS_000_622: Three years ago, you say? That wouldn't be the earthquake that accompanied the failed summoning of that primal, would it? Bugger me... Are you saying it was the treasure hunters doing the summoning? ...And that Mide was one of them?
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_WEDGE_000_623: Now hold on a moment. I'm willing to accept that Mide may have been a member of this doomed expedition─she being an Auri treasure hunter and all─but I fail to see what interest such a group would have in the ideals of the Enigma Codex, let alone summoning a primal...
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BACKRIX_000_624: Pssshkoh... Such was question Backrix asked himself. So he spends much time gathering knowings, and finds answer in book lent to him by Sharlayan uplander.
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_BACKRIX_000_625: Genius technologist who writes Enigma Codex one hundred years ago is Auri Xaela with blue hair, exactly like Mide!
TEXT_HEAVNR201_02249_ROUNDROX_000_626: Pssshkoh... No! Mide would never make busydeals with bad gobbies! Roundrox searches for Mide, hears truth from her!
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_000: If you're worried about Roundrox, don't be. Wedge won't let her come to any harm. Truth be told, I'm more worried about this business with Mide. Still, we should be careful of making any rash decisions, as you can bet that's what the Illuminati want. For now, I reckon we should give her the benefit of the doubt. Innocent till proven guilty, and all that.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_001: And anyway, we've got more pressing matters to deal with. Namely, taking back that codex fragment, and pushing on into Alexander before the Illuminati have a chance to shore up their defenses.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_002: You ready for another round? Good. The sooner you get going, the better, I reckon. Oh, and when you're in the belly of the beast, be sure and break something for me, eh!?
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Cuff of the Son. Midas can be accessed via the entrance at the Thaliak River.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_030: Don't worry─Wedge'll have Roundrox back here in no time. For now, just focus on delving deeper into that primal before the Illuminati have a chance to regroup. And don't forget to break something for me!
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_050: Another Illuminati brainchild back on the scrap pile, is it? Ah, if only I could've been there to watch you dismantle the thing!
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_051: As you've likely noticed, Mide's back. Now, I haven't said a word to her about what went on while she was away, as I wanted you on hand if things turned nasty. But since she gets on better with you anyway, maybe it'd be best if you spoke to her yourself.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_800: Ah, . You haven't seen Roundrox, have you? I was looking forward to hearing about the new treasures she's found.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_801:
...I see.
Well, I will not lie to you. Some of it is true. I did meet with the Illuminati. But that is not the whole story. Allow me to explain.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_810: ...You're saying you handed over the codex fragment to stop the Illuminati from coming here and taking it?
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_811: Yes. But the “fragment” I handed over to them was naught but a stone picked from a pile of rubble. The true codex fragment is here, safe and sound.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_812: Hah! I bloody knew Quickthinx was lying! The way he told it, you'd been working with the Illuminati all along. Load of old bilge, the lot of it.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_813: I...am afraid not. Quickthinx told you true. In fact, it was I who first taught the goblins how to summon the primal. I meant only to use them for my own ends, of course...much as I did you.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_814: The author of the Enigma Codex was an ancestor of mine. The creation of the so-called perfect world proposed within it has long been the goal of certain members of our tribe, myself included. For years, we strove in secret to realize its high ideals─free of the twisted elitism which seems to have infected the Illuminati.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_815: During that time, there was one who served as our leader─a man who made us believe that our perfect world was within reach. A man...with whom I fell in love. I wished for nothing more than to see his dreams come to fruition.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_816: So blind was my devotion, I agreed to help him summon a primal without a second thought. The danger to our lives never even crossed my mind. But on that day, three years ago, I came to know the folly of our mission.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_820: In an instant, the infernal machine laid waste to our hopes, snuffing out the lives of my companions. And the man I loved was dragged into its core.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_100_820: In a last desperate attempt to make right our mistake, I called forth a barrier with which to seal Alexander. At that moment, however, the codex shattered, and the colossus vanished without a trace.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_821: When the dust settled, I found myself surrounded by the broken fragments of the codex; the cold, accusing remnants of our dream of a perfect world.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_830: We were fools to think only of the future. I did not realize it until my friends were gone, but the time we spent on our journey together, pursuing a shared dream...those moments were as precious as any paradise we could have hoped to build.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_831: It's a sad old tale, I'll give you that─but it doesn't explain why you had the Illuminati summon the primal, or why you had us help you infiltrate it. After everything you've been through, you can't seriously think any good will come of reviving Alexander? You all but said as much yourself!
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_832: Good has nothing to do with it. Understand, I did not act out of any lingering adherence to my old ideals. I simply wanted to see him again. And perhaps...walk to the ends of the world with him.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_835: Not Alexander itself, but the soul I believe still resides within.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BACKRIX_000_836: Soul of uplander sleeps in giant machine? Never has Backrix heard such unsense! Mide must abandon this─
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_837: I've got one more question to ask you. What happens when all the codex fragments are brought together?
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_838: Alexander was born from hearts that yearned for a perfect world. The writings of the Enigma Codex inspired such a desire, but they are more than just a collection of texts. The codex can also be used to control the primal.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_839: To be precise, two elements are required: a complete Enigma Codex, and one capable of reading it. When both are present, Alexander can be commanded to transport its residents wherever they choose.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_MIDE_000_840: I myself was once able to read the codex. But those days are long gone. Now, the fragments are as dead to me as the stones beneath my feet. There is another, however, to whom the codex still responds. One we all know quite well.
TEXT_HEAVNR202_02250_BIGGS_000_841: What...Roundrox? Are you saying that little girl is the key to controlling a bleedin' primal?
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_000: Curse me for a fool! I should have known better than to underestimate the Illuminati. I assumed the “missing piece” in their plan was the codex fragment─but they were talking about Roundrox all along!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_002: We must mount a rescue─now, without delay. To the Illuminati, she's no better than a cog in that monstrous machine!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_003: It is like that she is being held somewhere in or close to Alexander's upper body. Continue your push through the left arm, and while the Illuminati are distracted I will search for a way forward.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Arm of the Son. Midas can be accessed via the entrance at the Thaliak River.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BIGGS_020: Tale old as time, eh? Woman falls in love with man, man gets sucked into primal, woman tries summoning primal to be reunited with man... Load of old rot, if you ask me, but Mide seems to believe it.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BIGGS_021: We're all in agreement on one thing, though: an innocent child's at the mercy of the Illuminati, and it's our job to rescue her!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_WEDGES_000_030: It's all my fault! I only lost sight of Roundrox for a moment, but by the time I spied her again, the Illuminati had her surrounded!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_WEDGES_000_031: Gah! Can't I do anything right!? If they hurt her, I shall never forgive myself. Please, ─please bring her back safely.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BIGGS_000_050: So the master of the Illuminati himself came flying in to drive you out? Hah hah! Sounds like you've got him worried! We must be getting close!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_WEDGE_000_060: Ah, . I hear you made short work of Quickthinx's flying machine. He will surely think twice before barging into the Shortstop uninvited again.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_WEDGE_000_061: ...Though I don't suppose he has any reason to come here anymore. He already has his “missing piece”... <sniff> Poor Roundrox... If the Illuminati have harmed her, I...I don't know what I'll do.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BACKRIX_000_090: Pssshkoh... Uplander sends Quickthinx scurrying! Illuminati think twice before threatening us again!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BACKRIX_000_091: Uplander is nearly through left arm. Next uplander must push forward into inner parts, and save Roundrox!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_100: Congratulations on your victory over Quickthinx. While you were busy dismantling his flying machine, I finished charting Alexander's interior. The chamber you reached is situated in the innermost part of the left sector, which means your next aim should be─
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BACKRIX_000_101: Pssshkoh... Backrix does not trust treasure hunter! Three years ago she summoned metal giant. Backrix wonders if she still wishes to finish mission of dead comrades...
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_102: ...I do not blame you for doubting me. Truth be told, my former mentors often stressed that were the unthinkable to happen, it would be my burden, as the youngest, to carry on their work.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_103: But building the codex's perfect world was their dream, not mine. I only borrowed it. As long as I was with those I held dear, I could happily have devoted myself to any cause.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_104: Seeing their passion, their joy─that was what filled me with resolve. And it was that which drove me to collect the pieces of the codex. All their talk of learning and reason, of justice and perfection, meant little to me in itself.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_105: I sometimes wonder why I was able to read the Enigma Codex in the first place. Mayhap it was because my youthful mind was as a blank slate, receptive to any ideal, if put convincingly enough.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_106: In the end, of course, it didn't matter. The primal took my friends' passion, their joy, and their idealism...and ground them into dust. Though I survived, my commitment to the cause did not. Put simply, I had no need for a perfect world without them to share it. So believe me when I tell you that I did not seek Alexander's return to realize the dreams of the dead.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_107: ...I only wished to see him again.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_109: The section of Alexander you have been exploring is called “Midas,” after a king from a legend of eld.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_110: Midas entreated the gods for a finger that would turn all he touched into gold, and the gods duly obliged. But in his carelessness, he transformed the one he loved most in the world into a lifeless golden statue. And thus the thing he coveted became his undoing.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_111: So it was with me and mine. Had we but paused for a moment to consider the means, and not simply the end, mayhap my friends would still be alive. But we did not, and they are gone. My one remaining wish is simple: to speak with the man I love once more. If I could do that, I would be satisfied.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_112: ...There. I have told you everything. Assuming no one else wishes to question my motives, I would speak of Roundrox's rescue─as was my original intent. Now listen well...
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_113: Alexander is divided into three main sections, each powered by an independent core.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_114: You have already fought your way through to the innermost part of Midas, the left arm. The core lies only a little way beyond, but you may be sure that the Illuminati will have deployed the bulk of their forces to defend it.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_WEDGE_000_115: Hold on a minute... Why would they choose to keep Roundrox there? The cores are just power sources.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_MIDE_000_116: You are correct. And the answer is: they wouldn't. Roundrox is most likely being held within Alexander's upper body. But the Illuminati have locked the entrances from either arm, making it impossible to enter. Our only choice is to stop the core, and in so doing stop Alexander.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_WEDGE_000_117: I see... Why, that's actually rather clever! The Illuminati need Roundrox to control the primal, but if it can't move, they'd have no need for her! At the very least, they'll have no choice but to keep her safe until the primal is in working order again!
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BIGGS_000_118: Activating those cores would've used up every crystal the Illuminati had. If we destroy the second one, I doubt they'll have enough to get them operational again.
TEXT_HEAVNR203_02251_BACKRIX_000_119: Pssshkoh... Do uplanders truly think metal giant can be toppled?
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BACKRIX_000_000: Pssshkoh... Treasure hunter truly believes soul of lost love sleeps in metal giant... Madness. But Backrix does not doubt resolve to rescue Roundrox.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BACKRIX_000_001: Go with Mide deep into Midas, and deactivate second core. But do not underestimate Illuminati! Day and night, they bring supplies into steel fortress─Backrix suspects Illuminati are tinkermaking new weapons!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_SYSTEM_000_010: You now have access to the Burden of the Son. Midas can be accessed via the entrance at the Thaliak River.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_040: They tell me the Illuminati have been up all hours ferrying raw materials to Alexander. Seems the thrashing you gave old Quickthinx didn't do much to dampen their spirits.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_041: I reckon that means we're in for a battle and a half when we get to the core. Still, there's naught those goblins can build that you can't break, ─at least I hope there isn't! We'll soon see, I s'pose... Lead the way when you're ready. Me and Wedge will follow with Mide.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_050: I cannot bear to think what the Illuminati might be doing to Roundrox... But as long as Mide has the final codex fragment, she shouldn't be in any real danger...should she?
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_051: I expect the Illuminati will have seen through Mide's ruse by now. But if they dare to try and take the real codex fragment, I will─ I will─ I will jolly well stop them, one way or another!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_MIDE_000_060: Our path is clear. We shatter the Illuminati's last lines of defense, and disable the core housed within Midas.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_MIDE_000_061: In the depths of my despair, with the loss of my friends still fresh in my mind, I would have given anything to take back what we had done. Even if it meant my own life.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_MIDE_000_062: But the world does not work like that. And even if it did, it is not what my beloved would have wanted.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_800: The second core, I do believe! Once that's out of commission, Alexander won't be going anywhere!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_MIDE_000_801: Dayan... Would that I could see you just once more...
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_804: Too frightened to face us alone, I see! Not that I blame you! We all know what  did to you last time!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... To usher in future that has been writ, even strongest gobbie must sometimes pretend to be weak, and let enemies win.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_806: Ohhh...pretending, were you!? And I s'pose losing this core was all part of your plan! Don't make me laugh! You know as much about the future as we do!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Quickthinx knows all. For example, Quickthinx knows one among uplanders carries true fragment of Enigma Codex.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_808:
It seems the game is up, Biggs. There's no hiding the truth from Quickthinx!
Very well, I admit it: I have the fragment. But I won't be handing it over to the likes of you!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_809: Oi, Wedge, didn't you hear him? He knows all!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_810: ...Which means he knows that what you're carrying's a worthless rock, while I've got the genuine article tucked away in me smallclothes!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Quickthinx already knows conclusion of uplanders' childish games.
Long ago was outcome decided. Uplanders think they are victorious, but luck is no friend to them today.
And now Enigma Codex belongs to Illuminati. All pieces fall into our hands.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_300_814: Far as I can make out, the thing's in good working order. No damage, no signs of tampering... I can only think it was an energy fluctuation that did it. Just bad luck.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_815: Bad luck!? You're saying it was pure chance that the platform stopped at that exact moment? Then what about Quickthinx? There is no way he could have predicted something like that! The odds would be infinitesimal!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_816: Well...however he did it, the fact remains that he did. B-But that doesn't mean we have to stand for it! When someone takes something from you, you just have to take it back!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_850: What a bunch of bleedin' dolts! Why didn't we just leave the fragment here with Backrix!?
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BIGGS_000_851: Still, we did do one thing right, I s'pose. The second core's out of action, and that primal's going nowhere.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_860: Try as I might, I cannot think of a logical explanation for what happened back there.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_WEDGE_000_861: Not only did the platforms malfunction at precisely the right moment, but Quickthinx was on the only one that didn't. And it just happened to be in exactly the right place to catch the codex fragment. Do you know how difficult it would be to orchestrate something like that, much less predict it!?
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_MIDE_000_870: ...Forgive me. Through my incompetence, the Illuminati have all they need to control Alexander. And though the beast is now immobile, I cannot help but feel that matters are worse.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_MIDE_000_871: ...Nor do our troubles end there. In our absence, Backrix seems to have taken leave of his senses...
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BACKRIX_000_900: Pssshkoh... Do uplanders forget something? Matters are too urgent for such foolish doings!
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BACKRIX_000_901: ...What? Tongueflaps of uplander make Backrix almost to laugh. Uplander claims already to have stopped core and lost fragment to Quickthinx? Pssshkoh... Look here, uplander: Backrix has braincase like steel trap─catching all heard things, all seen things─and he saw uplanders leave but few moments ago.
TEXT_HEAVNR204_02252_BACKRIX_000_902: Pssshkoh... Backrix senses something is amiss...
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BACKRIX_000_000: Pssshkoh... Backrix is certain that uplanders left for metal giant only moments before returning. He watches uplanders disappear over horizon with own two eyes!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BACKRIX_000_001: But it is impossible to return so soon if uplander's tale is true! ...Why treasure hunter also makes such claims, Backrix does not know. Go uplander, trade tongueflaps with Mide, and together think of explanation.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_030: What a bunch of bleedin' dolts! Why didn't we just leave the fragment here with Backrix!?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_031: Still, we did do one thing right, I s'pose. The second core's out of action, and that primal's going nowhere.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_040: Try as I might, I cannot think of a logical explanation for what happened back there.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_041: Not only did the platforms malfunction at precisely the right moment, but Quickthinx was on the only one that didn't. And it just happened to be in exactly the right place to catch the codex fragment. Do you know how difficult it would be to orchestrate something like that, much less predict it!?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_050: ...Forgive me. Through my incompetence, the Illuminati have all they need to control Alexander. And though the beast is now immobile, I cannot help but feel that matters are worse.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_051: Of course, Backrix claims that none of this ever happened. I only wish he were right.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_060: Have you been able to make any sense of Backrix's account? According to his version of events, we would scarcely have had time to reach the core, much less shut it down. But we were all there─we all know what happened.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_061: Are you sure he's not just confused? Maybe he got lost in all that data of his, and forgot the time.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_062: I'm afraid not. That is, unless the goblin standing watch near Alexander was also confused. His reports corroborate Backrix's. No...something else is going on here, I'm certain of it. The question is, what? If we assume for a moment that the goblins' accounts are true, then hardly any time has passed since we entered the barrier around Alexander.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_064: Impossible? You mean like Quickthinx predicting exactly what was going to happen in the core room? I hate to say it, but maybe he wasn't talking out of his arse. If time doesn't work the same in there, maybe he saw the future!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_065: Hmmm... There may be another explanation for that. There is a device deep within Alexander capable of performing complex mathematical calculations. It is not outside the realm of possibility that it could be used to predict the outcome of simple events.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_067: Using mathematics to predict the future!? Now even if I could believe that, it wouldn't explain this business with Backrix!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_068: Biggs is right. Perhaps the presence of the primal somehow disrupted the flow of time within the barrier. It's only a theory, of course─and a far-fetched one at that─but it might go some way towards explaining recent events.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_069: ...To be clear, you are implying that the Illuminati are aware of this temporal disruption, and have been using it to somehow gaze into the future? Very well. If you are willing to accept that, why not go further? Might it not be the case that they have found a way to bend time to their will?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_100_069: By moving back and forth in time, the Illuminati could effectively manipulate the present however they saw fit. They would ever remain one step ahead of us, our every effort doomed to fail from the first.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_070: Now, that's a sobering theory. But it's still only a theory, right? There's no point panicking just yet! Wedge, give the chief a call on your linkpearl, why don't you? If anyone knows how to untangle this knot, it's him.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_071: Chief, it's me! It's about Alexander! We've noticed something strange about time inside the primal... What? No, not our time inside the primal, the time─I-I mean time itself! Chief, it might be best if you just came here... Aye, aye─we'll await your arrival.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_100: I've heard some strange things in my time, but this might well top the lot. Just thinking about it gives me a sore head. No sense racking our brains over it, though. The chief'll only end up proving us wrong.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_110: The chief says he's on his way! And I think I heard Y'shtola's voice on the other end as well. She kept asking him what I was talking about.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_120: It seems like only yesterday that Roundrox and I spent a few happy hours here sorting through her collection of treasures. How did things come to this?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_CID_000_700: Is that a heated debate, I hear!? Boys! You started without me! Now, what was that you were saying over the linkpearl? Something about running out of time?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_YSHTOLA_000_701: Cid insisted that I accompany him─though I would have come even had he not. Matters have taken a turn for the worse, I gather.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_YSHTOLA_000_702: The aetheric fluctuations are akin to those I observed shortly before the primal's awakening. In the absence of a functioning core, its form is dissipating, albeit slowly.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_CID_000_703: Y'shtola─would you mind lending me your goggles for a moment? It can't hurt to have a second opinion.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_CID_000_704: What in the seven hells...!? The aether pouring from the primal is flowing backwards...as if time were passing in reverse.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_YSHTOLA_000_705: That cannot be. Such a phenomenon is wholly without precedent. Knowing so little of this primal's capabilities, however, it would be remiss to discount the possibility outright.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_706: If it is as we fear, then at this very moment, Alexander could be undoing our efforts to shut down its cores. All of our labors will have been for naught.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_YSHTOLA_000_707: Ah, the treasure hunter of whom we have heard so much. You seem unperturbed by our outlandish speculations. Was this perchance the subject of Wedge's communication?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_CID_000_708: Gods help us... If there is any truth to this, it won't matter how many cores we disable─the Illuminati will simply undo any damage we cause!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_709: Then what do we do, Chief? How do we even begin to fight something like that!?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_710: To erase the past... To return to a clean slate. Could Dayan have known...?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_ILLUMINATIELITEGUAR: Pssshkoh... Preparations for restoration of Enigma Codex are complete! Calculations show margin of error for futurereadings is 0.03 percent!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Foolish gobbie. When future is decided, there is no error.
At last, all pieces are in place! No longer must wise suffer foolishness of unwise!
Time is come to backstrike! Inferiors will make way for perfect world...or die. Now...restore Enigma Codex!
Pshhhkohhh... Now is Alexander Illuminati's to control! Soon will cores disabled by uplanders be disabled no longer.
Once power flows to third core, Alexander will be fully operational! And with third core will its true potential awaken!
Wings of time will unfurl, and all of history will be at mercy of Illuminati! Chosen ones will amend mistakes of past and reshape world into perfection!
Pshhhkohhh... At last, prophecies of Enigma Codex will be fulfilled.
And Quickthinx Allthoughts will rule as king of new world─of correct world! Chosen ones, menders of history...be proud to serve as builders of this paradise!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_750: We don't have the luxury of time to plan our next step. We must rescue Roundrox without delay─for her sake and ours.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BIGGS_000_760: Seems we have more questions than answers where this primal's concerned... If the Illuminati really can see into the future, does that mean they already know what we're going to do next?
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BACKRIX_000_770: Pssshkoh... A primal that bends time!? Impossible!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_BACKRIX_000_771: This data must be recorded at once!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_800: Y'shtola and the chief have returned to Matoya's Cave. Don't worry, between them, they're sure to find the answer to our problems. If it isn't waiting on a shelf in the Sharlayan annals, it'll be in some forgotten corner of the chief's brain, you mark my words!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_WEDGE_000_801: And the next time we meet Quickthinx, we'll be ready for him!
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_802: Adventurer─there is something I would like to discuss with you. But mayhap it would be best to wait until we are safely back at the Shortstop. I will see you there.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_820: I suppose I should start by apologizing. For everything. Were it not for me, the Illuminati would never have summoned that infernal machine...or gained the means to control it.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_821: And now Quickthinx possesses the power to manipulate time. To foresee the future and erase the past.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_822: I dare not think how he will use it. Returning the cores to their former state was but a foretaste. When all three are active, and Alexander can traverse both time and space, nothing will stand between the Illuminati and their twisted utopia...
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_823: ...We cannot let it come to that, . Somehow, we must find a way to stop them.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_824: But first, we must rescue Roundrox. Of all the innocent victims of this sorry tale, her plight pains me the most.
TEXT_HEAVNR205_02253_MIDE_000_825: <sigh> ...The Shortstop just isn't the same without her. I hope someone will keep her treasures safe until she returns...
TEXT_HEAVNY212_02281_UNUKALHAI_000_000: ...I have something for you, Warrior of Light. During our expedition to banish Sephirot, I came across a certain relic, and I believe it would be put to best use in your hands.
TEXT_HEAVNY212_02281_UNUKALHAI_000_001: It is an Allagan device of the kind used to store information─in this case, the record of the furious conflict that took place on the shores of Meracydia between the eikon Sephirot and the forces of Allag.
TEXT_HEAVNY212_02281_UNUKALHAI_000_002: Should you present this tomestone to the verification node outside Triad Control, the node's systems will analyze the various aspects of the conflict and create for you a false eikon against which you can train. Consider it a sort of “mock battle” that presumes a Sephirot who has broken free of his shackles.
TEXT_HEAVNY212_02281_UNUKALHAI_000_003: If I understand its workings correctly, the node should also be capable of manifesting a far stronger incarnation of the eikon. This would mimic the catastrophic consequences were Sephirot ever to absorb an additional source of energy─say, by defeating another member of the Warring Triad. A compelling challenge for a warrior of your ability, yes?
TEXT_HEAVNY212_02281_UNUKALHAI_000_004: You need not possess Mistress Krile's knowledge of Allagan technology to begin this particular battle. Simply present the tomestone to the node on the Flagship, and then follow the orb's instructions. I hope the experience brings you valuable insight, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNY212_02281_UNUKALHAI_000_010: As I explained, simply present the tomestone to the verification node on the Flagship. Follow the node's instructions, and you will soon find yourself facing the towering Sephirot once more!

<blip> Data processed. Adversary: Warring Triad, Sephirot. Defining simulation parameters...
