TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_000: ! I was just about to fly out to Ishgard and track you down.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_001: You remember Cait Sith, that Mhachi familiar? We've been workin' with him on a plan to find Diabolos and the Queen's Coffin.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_002: There've been voidsent sightin's from pirates all over, so we know that bat-winged bugger is hidin' someplace in the sky─we just don't know exactly where.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_003: And as for goin' about pinpointin' the location, Leofard and the feline are bickerin' over just exactly how...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_004: That's where you come in. If you've a spare moment or two, we could use a third opinion to break the stalemate.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_005: Besides all that, Leofard's eager to have another hand to help in the search, so come on over to the Parrock as soon as you're able. You know the way from here, don't you?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_010: Come on over to the Parrock when you've a spare moment. I'm tired of hearin' those two arguin', and that's the gods' honest truth...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_100_010: Thanks for comin'. The captain and the cat are inside, still havin' their “discussion.” Talk to Leofard, will you, before I strangle the both of them.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_015: Like squabblin' children, the pair of them. Help Leofard settle this, would you?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_018: Ah, ! A rational mind such as yours is most welcome! Pray reason with this wind-addled brigand!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_020: If you're here to ask about the Queen's Coffin then you'd best turn around and walk straight out again. This aggravatin' furball's turned my mood sour as month-old aldgoat milk.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_021: Leofard! 's come all this way to help us─at your request, I might add!  deserves to hear where we stand on the search, at least!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_022: ...The “search” is givin' me ulcers, is what it is. By all reports, Diabolos is lurkin' somewhere in the heavens, buildin' up his forces. But the sky is a vast dome, as high as the ocean is deep, and we've not the pirates to scour every damn floatin' rock.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_023: That's when I tried my luck with Radlia. You remember her, don't you? Captain of the Talons? Blonde hair? One eye? Stole our bloody compass?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_024: Well I've been eavesdroppin' with that linkpearl I slipped into the casin', hopin' to catch somethin' useful. But all I've heard from her and her sorry crew is snorin', grumblin', and japes about the archbishop's holy nethers.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_025: In the end, it seems we've no choice but to do this the hard way...but a certain mewlin' annoyance refuses to acknowledge the truth of it.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_026: You cannot possibly hope to investigate the entire sky with this meager handful of ne'er-do-wells! I find my suggestion to seek aid from your fellow pirate gangs a perfectly reasonable one under the circumstances!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_027: Ah, stow it, you mangy alley cat! You've not the faintest idea of how sky pirates operate! Best case scenario, we'd be locked into a deal to hand over any treasure we find─and that's assumin' we weren't laughed out of the room to begin with!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_028: You cannot assume that every man and woman shares your base morality! If we but made the attempt, I am sure we could convince some few of the nobility of our cause!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_029:
And so it goes, 'round and 'round...
Knowin' pirates as I do, I find myself sidin' with the captain on this. But what of you, ? Any thoughts on the matter?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_Q2_000_000: What are your thoughts on the matter?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_A2_000_002: We should seek aid from other crews.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_030: See there!? Even  agrees with me. We proceed as we have been, and try to cover as much sky as possible.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_035: What!? You're sidin' with the furball!? I would've thought you'd learned a thing or two about sky pirates by now...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_040: Hmph. Seems that even the great Warrior of Light has no simple solutions for this problem.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_045: ...However we tackle things, though, we've a long road ahead of us. I'll see if I can't think up a better way to shorten it.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_046: You might as well head back to your adventures, ...unless you're willin' to lend us your experience in another matter, that is.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_047: Utata, our chief engineer, has been mumblin' about the Void Ark and cursin' under her breath for days. Might be as you can provide some insight into her dilemma.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_048: She is conducting her research in the Sea of Clouds, yes? Well, I should rather discuss the properties of the Void Ark than continue with this fruitless debate! I shall see you down there, !
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_055: Leofard is right in not trustin' aught to our fellow pirates, but we could spend years trawlin' through the clouds. There has to be some other way...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_060: Head into the Sea of Clouds and see what's botherin' Utata. Might be as you can shed some light on her problem.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_065: While waiting for word on Diabolos, I have been spending my time learning to pilot the Redbills' little airships. Thankfully, it seems I've mastered enough of the basics to manage this little jaunt.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_066:
Hmmm, mayhap I could make contact with some other pirates without Leofard's mediation...
Ah, but let us first address Mistress Utata's woes, shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_071: What troubles you, Mistress Utata? We were told that some matter regarding the Void Ark was causing you no small measure of grief...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_072: Mistress Utata! What are you─ Oof! Urk!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_073: Ah, I feel so much better now!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_074: My apologies, Cait Sith. You had the misfortune to enter my field of view just as I felt the intense desire to squeeze something warm and furry.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_075:
It's this damnable ectocompass...
I made another one, you see, identical in all respects to the first compass that Radlia stole.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_076: But look! It points in a completely different direction to where the Void Ark should currently be! I don't understand what I did wrong! I used the same plans, the same parts...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_077: I can imagine that would be infuriating. And you are certain there are no flaws in the design or the materials?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_078: Positive. I've tweaked and adjusted and replaced every single piece, but it refuses to function as intended. I'm on the verge of tossing the blasted thing over the edge! What do you make of this, ?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_Q3_000_000: What do you make of it?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_A3_000_001: I don't think the compass is broken.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_A3_000_002: Something may have happened to the Void Ark...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_080: Yes, I am inclined to agree. Judging by your previous work, it would seem unlikely that the compass itself is defective. We must consider other factors.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_085: Yes, the cause may indeed lie outside the compass itself. We must consider this dilemma from a broader perspective.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_090: Hmmm. If you are unable to detect any defects with the compass, then it is unlikely that  or I could do so either. Mayhap we should consider this dilemma from a broader perspective.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_095: Might you explain to us the principle by which the ectocompass tracks the Void Ark?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_096: It all comes down to aetheric signature. I discovered that the Void Ark is encompassed by an energy of rather peculiar composition, so I simply tuned the compass to follow its unique trail.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_097: An energy of peculiar composition, you say...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_098: Of course! The ark was propelled by the siphoned energies of voidsent! Could it be that the compass was tracking not the vessel itself, but the aether of the entities imprisoned within?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_099: That would certainly explain why the compass now points in a different direction than one would expect! After all, Diabolos and the Shadow Queen are no longer on board the ark!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_100: ...Are you implying that if we plotted a course based on the readings from the ectocompass, we would arrive on the demon's doorstep...so to speak?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_101: Just so, Mistress Utata! Assuming my theory is correct, we no longer require outside assistance to pursue our elusive quarry!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_102: Oh, Stacia! What perfect timing! You won't believe the wonderful discovery we've just─
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_103: Talon airships have been spotted en route to our nest! If it's revenge they're looking for, we'd best head back and make ready for them!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_105: I'm glad you're here, , but I don't think they're spoilin' for a fight...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_106: It would not appear that these pirates have come with murder and pillage in mind. Quite the opposite, in fact...they seem rather bedraggled and beaten.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_107: I don't like this, . Why have the Talons come here without their captain? Where is Radlia?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_SUBORDINATE02204_00: We made it, thank the gods...
Truce, Redbill! We need your help to save Captain Radlia!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_111: You... You're one of Radlia's favorites. You threaten my crew, steal our compass, and now you come crawlin' to me for help? What kind of unholy mess have you cretins stumbled into?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_SUBORDINATE02204_00: Aye, we took your damn compass, but it didn't show us to the ghost ship. We ended up at some moldy, old ruins, lousy with voidsent...

Before we knew it, some sort of spider demon was knockin' our ships out of the sky. The two of us managed to pull away, but we saw what happened to them as got caught on the ground... If the captain survived the massacre, she's stuck there with no wings to fly out again.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_114: Why don't you give that linkpearl a listen, Captain? Might be as we can learn if Radlia is alive or dead, at least.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_115: ...Ugh, so much buzzin'. Can't hear a blasted─ Wait. I'm gettin' some words...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_116: “They're after...Mhachi artifact. Damn demons are searchin'... Hide!”
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_117: ...And then a bunch of screamin'. Seems Radlia's still kickin' for now, but who knows for how long.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_118: If those screams were an act, then consider me fooled─I don't think the Talons are layin' a trap here.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_119: I've half a mind to leave Radlia to her fate, but I never turn my back on an adventure! Especially when the scent of treasure is in the air, eh? Now, tell me where you found these ruins!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_SUBORDINATE02204_00: ...You'll help us, then!? You're a good man, Redbill! We left the captain in the Yafaem Saltmoor, just northwest of Mor Dhona.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_121: In Yafaem, you say!? Then you must speak of the ruined shell of Mhach itself! ...By Shatotto's black heart! Could they be after the Nullstone?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_122: What's that, puss? You think you know what those fiends are after?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_123: Right. Utata, see that these Talons are patched up, then have the Raimille ready to fly. And don't spare the oil─you know I love to hear her purr.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_124: , Stacia. Bring the furball to my quarters, and we'll have ourselves a chat about our impendin' trip to old Mhach!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_130: You know, we've never been friendly with the Talons, but that don't mean we can just sit back and let them be torn to shreds by cacklin' voidsent.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_135: I never imagined Diabolos would seek to enter the old city. Ah, but I should have suspected as much when I learned that the floodwaters had receded and left Yafaem exposed...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_SUBORDINATE02204_00: P-Please! You have to rescue the captain!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_145: When Leofard asks me to pay special attention to his airship, that's a sign he's fully committed to his next adventure! He had the same spark right before he left to board the Void Ark.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_UTATA_000_146: ...You're wondering why his ship is named “Raimille”? Hm. I never gave it much thought, but I'd wager it was the name of his first love...or maybe it was a pet!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_150: Right, furball. Let's hear about this artifact that Diabolos is lookin' for.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_151: ...If I am to speak of the Nullstone, then I must first explain the method by which Mhachi sorcerers would bind the voidsent into service.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_152: The more powerful the voidsent, the more difficult it is to manifest its presence in this world. Their own immense strength weighs them down like an anchor, you see, preventing them from breaking the surface of our dimension.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_153: And that is why they “cooperate” with mortal sorcerers. A mage can provide a suitable vessel for the summoning, or rip a large enough hole in the fabric of reality for the entity itself to step through.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_154: ...And let me guess: the mage forces the voidsent to agree to a pact in return for the invitation into our world?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_155: That is correct. But it would be foolhardy to expect such devious and malevolent creatures to abide by the spirit of even the most carefully worded contract.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_156: Thus did the Mhachi magi construct an occult device that would more securely bind the voidsent to their will─a safeguard of sorts, that to the best of my knowledge yet lies entombed within the remnants of the ancient city.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_157: The Nullstone was seen as a last resort! Should a voidsent break its pact and turn on its summoner, the mage could use the relic to disperse the very essence of even the most potent entity, obliterating it completely.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_158: I can't see the “royals” of the void takin' too kindly to a threat like that. Seems those sorcerers were just as ruthless as the monsters they summoned.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_159:
When it came to the glory of Mhach, the ends justified the means...
In any event, we can be certain that Diabolos seeks to secure the Nullstone before it falls into mortal hands, and thereby ensure that Scathach will reign unopposed.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_160: All right, so we know what the fiends are after. But what I don't understand, is why such a valuable relic was left behind when the mages knew a colossal flood was on the way.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_161: Its value was the very reason they chose not to risk its relocation. The Nullstone is kept within a structure constructed for the purpose, secured behind powerful wards and protected by deadly guardians.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_162: And with the rising of the waters, they reasoned that the artifact would be sunk along with the city, far beyond the reach of vengeful voidsent.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_163: But now that Yafaem is more swamp than sea, the demons only have the wards and the guardians to deal with. And I doubt they'd be wastin' their time down there in the mud if they didn't have some trick to break through the wards.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_164: Aye, this's become a race to see who can nab the treasure first─which is just the sort of contest a sky pirate lives for!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_165: So we slip into the ruins, pinch the relic, then rescue Radlia right from under the fiends' noses!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_166: ...Well, I suppose we could save her while we're pokin' around for loot.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_167: I'll grab the new compass from Utata so we know where we're goin'. Check your weapons, pack your smallclothes, and meet me out by the landin' when you're ready to fly!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_170: So, all we need to do is rescue Captain Radlia from a mob of nasty voidsent, then retrieve a dangerous artifact from the magically defended ruins of an ancient civilization. Easy, eh...?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_175: I shall join you in this endeavor to recover the Nullstone. Though after fifteen hundred years, I wonder what remains of the city I once knew...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_180: We'll fly directly to Yafaem from here. Once we arrive, you forge ahead with your band of adventurers as you did on the ark, . Just keep slicin' into the depths until you reach that Nullstone.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_181: Hmmm. We don't want to risk gettin' knocked out of the sky like the Talons, so we'd best land a little ways out from the ruins and head in on foot.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_182: The furball says he knows the place well enough to guide you, so me and the Redbills will follow behind on rescue duty. You concentrate on smashin' a path through to the artifact─we'll check the nooks and crannies for Radlia and her crew.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_183: Don't let your guard down once you reach the ruins, though, eh? There's likely golems and such in there what are worse than the fiends outside, and we wouldn't want our hero losin'  head now, would we?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_190: Your job is to carve a path to the vault where they keep the Nullstone. The Redbills will come in behind, and scour the area for Radlia and her crew...and whatever shiny baubles we can get our greedy hands on.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_200: ...So this is the heart of the ruins, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_201: You've done a fine job dismantlin' the defenses, . I only wish we could say we had the same success, but Radlia and her Talons were nowhere to be found.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_202: Yes, it is quite distressing, but we must focus on claiming the prize at hand. The Nullstone is ours!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_FERDIAD_000_203: (-???-)Mwahahahaha! You've left me such an inviting trail of destruction to follow!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_FERDIAD_000_205: Well, well, well! If it isn't the adventurer I've so longed to dismember! Praise Lord Diabolos for this opportunity─I shall gift him your head in gratitude. Ah, and speaking of gifts, I've brought a present to celebrate our gleeful reunion!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_FERDIAD_000_210: I see you've found the relic, then. Wonderful! Lord Diabolos will be so pleased! And look here! I've brought you a gift as thanks for all your hard work!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_FERDIAD_000_215: This is the lovely lass you've been oh-so-desperately seeking, isn't it? Unless you wish to see her rent limb from limb, then you will hand over the Nullstone!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_216: You think I care about her worthless limbs? That woman's done naught but cause us grief, and I just thought to crow over her grave!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_217: Don't give me that look, Radlia. What? You thought I was here to save your sorry hide?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_218: You've never been aught but an obstacle to me. Do you remember the first time we met? You were roarin' with laughter at the sight of all them Allagan relics until I used your pretty blonde head as a steppin'-stone!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_RADLIA_000_219: Damn you, you selfish bastard! And damn me for expecting you to act any different! If I had my weapons, I'd blow a bloody hole in your belly!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_220: Have you forgotten how awful a shot you are? Not much of a threat when I've seen you miss the side of a cathedral at ten yalms.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_FERDIAD_000_221: Silence, you grinning fool! You've ruined my moment, and now I'll ruin your smirking face!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_224: This world is not your stage, unholy harlequin! Begone from our realm!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_FERDIAD_000_225: Grrr! A clever farce, mortals! But the show is not over...not until you scream!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_226: ...The bugger got away. And I think we'd best do the same.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_STACIA_000_230:
Aye, it all worked out in the end, but I've had just about enough of Leofard's folly.
...Ugh, I must've said that a hundred times by now.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_235: The lady pirate is saved, and the Nullstone is ours! That all went rather well, did it not?
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_240: Now that was some excitement, wasn't it, ! Probably a little too much for Radlia, but we gave her a bed to sleep off the worst of her ordeal. She'll likely be back to her usual cheerful self in no time.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_241: Quite a successful jaunt, all told. You and me, we make a pretty good partnership!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_242: ...But I've got words for you, furball! You said that relic would obliterate a voidsent “completely.” Seems to me that foppish fiend just got scorched before he slipped away.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_243: Oh, that? That was scarcely a fraction of the Nullstone's true power. Once I have learned how to unleash its full potential, such demons shall be consumed like gnats caught in a bonfire.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_244: So you're tellin' me our secret weapon ain't ready for battle? You might as well be wieldin' a blunted sword...
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_CAITSITH_000_245: Might I remind you that this “blunted sword” stung our foe sufficiently to free the lady pirate? A result we could not have achieved with your blustering words alone!
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_246: Bah, I was ready to flee without Radlia if things took a turn for the worse.
TEXT_HEAVNM201_02285_LEOFARD_000_247: ...But you're right. You had the presence of mind to take advantage of my bluff, and it was your actions that saved her in the end.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_STACIA_000_000:
Aye, it all worked out in the end, but I've had just about enough of Leofard's folly.
...Ugh, I must've said that a hundred times by now.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_CAITSITH_000_005: ...Did the captain receive a blow to the head while we were in Mhach? I could have sworn he just paid me a compliment.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_010: We might be waitin' a while before Radlia finally decides to wake up.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_011: But not so long that you've got time to flit away on some other adventure. Come join me in my quarters, and we can ask her a few questions as soon as she's ready to talk.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_STACIA_000_020:
Radlia was moanin' the entire trip back to the Parrock. It can't have been a pleasant experience, bein' dragged around by that nasty fiend...
Anyway, let's go haunt the captain's quarters until she regains her senses.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_CAITSITH_000_025: Once I have learned to harness the full power of the Nullstone, we shall have naught to fear from even the Shadow Queen herself!
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_030: Ho there, . Might as well make yourself comfortable while we wait on Radlia. Besides, after fightin' through them ruins, I'll wager you could use the rest.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_040: Where is the rest of my crew? Surely there were other survivors...?
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_041: Tell me, Radlia. What drove you to risk explorin' old Mhach? The compass sent you there, aye, but you were after the Void Ark. You knew somethin', didn't you?
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_042: I found a book. We were looting these strange ruins in the Sea of Clouds, and one of the lads dug up a tome. It had passages that described the Void Ark...and a powerful relic called the “Nullstone.”
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_CAITSITH_000_043: A tome scribed by a Mhachi sorcerer, mayhap? ...Captain, would you happen to know the author of this work?
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_044: The words are muddled by obscuring magicks, and fifteen hundred years have faded its pages. There is much that remains illegible, but what little my darling cutthroats and I could decipher suggests it was written by a mage of exceptional status.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_045: See for yourself. If what the book says is true, the ark is a source of immeasurable power. With that ship under my command and the mysteries of Mhach in my possession, I had thought to crown myself queen of the skies...
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_046: ...And look how well that turned out. What manner of sky pirate─what manner of queen─can't even keep her own crew alive?
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_CAITSITH_000_047: Ahem. Radlia, is it not? Would I be correct in assuming that you seek revenge against the voidsent who slaughtered your comrades?
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_048: Of course I want revenge! That hells-spawned shite-gobbler killed my crew! If he were here right now, I'd gouge out his eyes and choke him to death with my bare, bloody hands!
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_049: You are not alone in your desire to bring an end to these abominations, Captain. Will you not join us in our endeavor to secure peace for the skies? Will you not join the Talons' strength to ours?
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_050: ...What strength? The way things are right now, I doubt I could keep the peace in a monastery.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_051: This has naught to do with personal grudges, either. I just don't have the men. All my best fighters died in the ruins, and the dregs that are left are scarce sharp enough to be called Talons.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_052: Did you leave your spine back in them ruins, Radlia? You've had your wings clipped, and no mistake, but that's no reason to give up the life. I thought we'd rescued a sky pirate─not some cur that turns tail when her pack ain't there to bite for her.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_RADLIA_000_053: ...I know what you're trying to do, Redbill, but I've lost my taste for glory. You can have the cursed book. Just be sure to make that bastard pay.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_054: ...Hey, furball. How quickly do you think you can decipher that ratty old tome? I need you to figure out exactly how your relic works.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_055: Aye, you sent that one fiend squealin' in fear, but that ain't enough. From what you've told me, we'll need to aim for some of that “obliteration” if we're goin' to take on the Shadow Queen.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_056: The rest of you, put everythin' you've got into what you do best, be that research or bladework. Overdoin' it is doin' it just right, if you get my meanin'.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_LEOFARD_000_057: I'll decorate my walls with voidsent heads if I have to. The skies should belong to no one...
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_DIABOLOS_000_060: ...The Nullstone hath fallen into mortal hands.
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_FERDIAD_000_061: A thousand apologies, Lord Diabolos! I shall personally wring each and every one of their scrawny necks!
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_DIABOLOS_000_062: The time for skulking in shadows hath ended. I am grown weary of these meddling vermin...
TEXT_HEAVNM202_02286_DIABOLOS_000_063: The power of the Shadow Queen waxeth full! Soon, mine ardent desire shall pass from dream into dark reality!
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_000: I am troubled, Warrior of Light. The VIth Legion will not soon surrender its pursuit of Allagan technology...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_001: While it is true that the VIth suffered heavy losses in attempting to breach Azys Lla's defenses, the legion is still very much a force to be reckoned with. Left to his own devices, it will not be long before the legatus moves to─ Hm?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_100_001:
Pray excuse the interruption, but a call to this linkpearl can only come from one of your fellow Scions.
...Archon Y'shtola! What news?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_002: ...And you are quite certain they have broken through!? ...Yes, of course. We shall leave immediately.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_003: ...It would seem the thing I feared most has come to pass. The Garleans have succeeded in dispelling the barrier Urianger placed upon the entrance to the research facility. We must intercept and destroy them before they acquire the means to control primal entities.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_004: Archon Y'shtola requests that we assemble at the scene of the intrusion. Pray depart at once. I will join you when I have informed the other Scions of this development.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_010: Hie you with all haste to Azys Lla. I will join you there anon.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_030: I see we are the first to arrive. No matter. Your colleagues should be here anon. They were wise indeed to keep this area under surveillance. Had the Garleans slipped by unnoticed, I dare not think of the consequences.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_031: Archon Y'shtola set forth for Azys Lla when it became apparent that the legatus was attempting to breach the barrier, and arrived to find that he had succeeded. We must hope that he has yet to find his prize...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_YSHTOLA_000_050: Well met, Unukalhai─and thank you for answering my summons so swiftly, . We shall all be glad of your presence should we meet with the VIth Legion...as seems all but certain.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_YSHTOLA_000_051: As you may be aware, this facility houses some of Allag's most advanced technology. Accordingly, Urianger sought to deny the Empire easy ingress by weaving a ward of singular potency.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_052: Not singular enough, it would seem! I would be surprised if the legatus had not reached the core laboratories already.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_053: 'Tis passing strange... I wove the ward in accordance with the most closely guarded teachings of the archmages of Sharlayan. Naught was left to chance. Naught.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_054: 'Tis well known that the children of Garlemald have no talent for arcane manipulation, nor hath the Empire more than a cursory knowledge of sorcery. That they should succeed in unraveling so complex a skein of magecraft─and with such surpassing swiftness─is... 'Tis passing strange.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_YSHTOLA_000_055: That it is, Urianger─but 'tis a mystery for another day.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_056: Archon Y'shtola has the right of it. Before all else, we must move to safeguard the knowledge which enabled the Allagans to harness primal energies. Of particular concern is the “Genesis Expression”─an aetherochemical formula that allowed the scholars of yore to create substance from nothingness...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_YSHTOLA_000_057: I know of no such formula. Whence came you by this information? From your enigmatic master, perchance?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_058: He did furnish me with that morsel, yes. And knowing exactly which prize the legatus now seeks enables us to predict his position. Do you not see? We have been gifted the perfect opportunity to remove the head of an entire legion!
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_059: I didn't think you quite so bloodthirsty, Unukalhai. Surely safeguarding secrets should take precedence over slaying legatuses?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_YSHTOLA_000_060: Krile's sentiments reflect my own. Yet the two objectives need not be mutually exclusive... What say you, Urianger?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_062: ...Ah! Forgive me. My thoughts were bound up in idle imaginings. In answer to thy question, milady: I am content to be led by thee in this matter.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_063: Right. I've enabled the facility's teleporters. Shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_064: You dwell on the matter of the barrier.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_065: I do. Verily, 'twas a warding spell of labyrinthine intricacy─the brainchild of the head of the Students of Baldesion himself. Even the most learned Archon would require some several moons to disentangle such an enchantment. To do so in mere bells would require some preternatural power akin to the very Echo itself!
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_080: Within the research facility resides the key to controlling primals: the Genesis Expression. I trust I need not remind you of the danger inherent in allowing such knowledge to fall into the hands of the Empire.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_SYSTEM_000_100: The terminal has been activated. Prepare to teleport into the Aetherochemical Research Facility...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_YSHTOLA_000_302: Press on, . I will handle this!
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: I have exposed the bones of their work. Now to extract the marrow...
Even in the moment of my triumph, you persist in your misguided crusade... So be it. I shall present my prize to the Emperor alongside your head!
My wounds will not slow my blade should you seek to bar my path...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_504: And you would slay me, no doubt─but it would be your final act.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: What madness afflicts you Eorzean fools!? The Emperor but desires a means to shackle the eikons and their destructive appetites. Why do you rail against your own salvation!?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_506: It is not for man to wield such power. The primal energy your emperor seeks to contain would be as kindling waiting for a spark.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_507: Forget not the White Raven, Legatus. Like thee, he presumed to wield the power of Allag, and invited the Calamity in so doing.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_508: This star's fate is too important to be decided by any one man, a warmongering savage least of all!
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: Have care, boy─you speak of my emperor.
But dying here in defense of his honor will not further his cause...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_511: Well, well... I appear not to be dead.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_513: I may have cracked a rib...<wince>...or two. But I'll be fine. Honestly.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_514: Our foes gave no quarter. Had Unukalhai stinted in his defense of thee, thou may'st be certain thy hurts would be far worse.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_515: I could do no less. Mistress Krile is here at my behest, after all.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_516: The secrets of Allag are safe for the present, though 'tis doubtful the legatus will return to Garlemald till the prize he coveteth lieth in his grasp.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_YSHTOLA_000_517: Then we must redouble our efforts to protect this place. Krile and I will place additional seals upon the tomelith.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_519: I appreciated you staying at my side. Thank you.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_521: Oh, please. It was a good deal more than that, and you know it. Now let me help you: when a woman thanks you for saving her life, the customary response is “you're welcome.”
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_630: Ah, Urianger, are the new wards already in place?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_631: My colleagues yet toil upon their enchantments. I come unto thee in secret, that I might question thee outside their hearing.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_633: Aye. I would speak with the one who undid my subtlest magecraft─he who invited an imperial legatus into this facility, in hopes of engineering the man's demise at the hands of the Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_634: You accuse me of masterminding this day's events?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_635: The plan may have been thy master's, but the deed was thine. Thou didst lure the legatus of the VIth Legion into a trap from which he was not intended to emerge. 'Tis plain to me now that thy seeming opportunism in proposing his elimination was feigned, and that his death was the object of thy plan from the first.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_636: And you have proof of this?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_637: Thine own words betrayed thee. Thou didst speak of the Empire's desire to claim the Genesis Expression, the existence of which even the learned Mistress Krile was ignorant. Whence then did the legatus come by such definitive knowledge?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_638: And then there is the matter of mine unraveled ward. None save one possessed of an otherworldly gift could have so swiftly effected its dissolution. Know thee of another blessed with such?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_639: Assuming these accusations have merit, what then?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_640: Full many times and oft doth the pursuit of truth lead men down darkened paths. I take no issue with thy purpose, 'tis but thy method I would call into question.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_641: In the Garlean Empire we have a common foe. Hadst thou deigned to share thine intentions with  or Mistress Krile, 'tis like that we would have closed the trap with less risk to life, and more success.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_642: I sought to use the most dangerous secrets of Allag as bait. Who among you would agree to such a reckless plan?
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_643: None, and with good cause. Irrespective, thou wert remiss in thy duty to thy comrades. I note with some disappointment that in matters concerning the primals and those who would control them, the cold rationality upon which thou so pridest thyself is conspicuous by its absence...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_644: Know that the salvation of this star is an end too vast for any one of us to accomplish alone. Shouldst thou fail to trust in thy comrades, I foresee thy actions precipitating some terrible misfortune.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_646: My sincerest apologies, . Urianger is correct in his suspicions: it was I who orchestrated this encounter with the Empire.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_647: I would ask that thou forgive Unukalhai this transgression...and keep mention of it from Mistress Krile. 'Twould be a pity for one foolish decision to wither their budding camaraderie ere it had a chance to bloom.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_KRILE_000_648: There you are, you rotten idler! When Y'shtola realized we were struggling with the wards alone, she was absolutely livid!
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_URIANGER_000_649: Ah. Never mind the Warring Triad─I have awoken Archon Y'shtola's tempestuous wrath! In supplicant mood shall I return at once, and there atone for mine indolence!
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_650: Come, . It is time we returned to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_700: Once again, I must apologize for acting without your consent or counsel. As a gesture of repentance and a sign of good faith, allow me to share something of myself with you.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_701: As Urianger suggested, I possess the gift of the Echo...though it is of a nature different from yours.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_702: Regardless, I would use my gift for the selfsame purpose─the salvation of this star. And nothing─nothing─poses a greater threat to the world than the proliferation of primal-harnessing technology. This I know only too well.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_703: ...What I am about to divulge concerns the fate of another star entirely. On this other world, a magick was devised that allowed the realm's champions to use a stone known as “auracite” to contain the power of primals.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_704: So armed, these heroic souls conquered god after god, oblivious to their weapon's fatal imperfection: its propensity to bleed primal energies. And with each victory, the heroes changed, transforming at last into fiends of endless appetite. Insatiable in their hunger for aether, they ultimately went to war over the star's ever-dwindling life force...
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_705: ...And fought until there was nothing left. Thus, as Urianger so astutely observed, when I am faced with those who rush to embrace power unchecked, I lose all semblance of rationality.
TEXT_HEAVNY221_02288_UNUKALHAI_000_706: Know that my master, too, cares deeply about the fate of this star. I am his servant─his instrument─sent here to ensure that the same tragedy does not consume another world.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_000: Warrior of Light, if this world is to survive, we must needs move forward with our plan─another pillar of the Warring Triad must be toppled.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_001: The question of which has already been answered. Following our encounter with the legatus, Archon Y'shtola detected erratic aetheric waveforms emanating from the sector containing the eikon Sophia, known simply as “the Goddess” in former times. Such readings can mean only one thing...
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_002: She is close to wakening. Let us return to Azys Lla forthwith and put an end to this primal deity lest she rise again in all her terrible glory.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_050: Make your preparations, Warrior of Light. The eikon Sophia stirs, and we must needs return to Azys Lla with all haste.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_080: We appear to be the first to arrive. Shall we await our colleagues here?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_100: Hm? Could the VIth Legion have returned...?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_KRILE_000_102: We're under attack! Y'shtola and Urianger have engaged the foe not far from here!
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_SERVANTONE_000_103: Hah! Rarely is my shield thus tested! 'Twould seem the Allagans have not been lax in their recruitment!
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_SERVANTTWO_000_104: Think you so? Mayhap your arm merely withered whilst you lay idle.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_SERVANTTHREE_000_10: Still your tongues! We have stalled them long enough!
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_SERVANTONE_000_106:
“With scales in hand, the Goddess shall arise,
And righteously cast off Her cursèd pall,
That She, with wrathful Wyrmking at Her side,
Might judge and thence bring balance unto all.”
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_SERVANTONE_000_107: Hear my words and despair, Allagans! Our Goddess is awoken! Your civilization has birthed the instruments of its own undoing!
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_108: 'Tis well that you are here, . I should like to know what our assailants were saying. You understood their words, did you not?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_URIANGER_000_109: 'Twas a Meracydian dialect, if mine ears do not deceive─though one which beareth scant resemblance to any spoken in recent times. As for our antagonists' meaning...I do gladly defer to those blessed with the Echo.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_KRILE_000_110: The one with the shield seemed to think we were Allagans. He recited what sounded like a verse of prophecy, then claimed that their “Goddess is awoken”... Is that about right, ?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_111: And might we assume that this deity of theirs is the very eikon we've come to topple?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_URIANGER_000_112: Aye. From their tongue, their words, and their attire, 'tis like that our antagonists were Meracydian─thralls to the Goddess Sophia and victims of the Allagans' incursions.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_URIANGER_000_113: If, as Krile claimeth, they thought us agents of Allag, 'tis little wonder that they sought to bring us low.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_114: You suggest that Sophia's servants have been liberated from their containment!? Then we have no choice but to accept word of her awakening as truth.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_KRILE_000_115: Gods help us! The Warring Triad have proven formidable enough when we've roused them with a fraction of their true strength. Should Sophia break free at the peak of her powers,  and  friends won't stand a chance!
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_116: Let us be about it, then. , Krile, Unukalhai─the three of you will make directly for Sophia's containment facility. Urianger and I will do what we can to occupy the eikon's thralls.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_117: Mistress Krile─do you perchance recall the words of the prophecy in its entirety?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_KRILE_000_118:
Ah, let me see... I believe it was, “With scales in hand, the Goddess shall arise,
And righteously cast off Her cursèd pall,
That She, with wrathful Wyrmking at Her side,
Might judge and thence bring balance unto all.”
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_120:
"Bring balance unto all...“
One suspects their notion of bringing balance has little to do with fostering harmony.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_130: I see the Goddess is no more. Well done. Once Krile and Unukalhai have rejoined us, we may safely depart.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_131: ...One thing yet puzzles me, however. How did Sophia's servants come to wake from their slumber?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_KRILE_000_132: I believe we have the answer to that!
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_133: We discovered the remains of a Garlean soldier in an adjacent sector of the containment facility. 'Tis like that the fool ventured too close to Sophia during the Empire's previous incursion, and was enthralled for his troubles.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_134: Another reminder, if any were needed, as to the incalculable threat posed by these beings. The Goddess would not even have been conscious when she claimed the man's will. And yet his mistake granted her the means to release her servants, and would have resulted in her own liberation had we not been on hand to intervene.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_URIANGER_000_135: I do much wonder that the eikon's pawn was capable of so effectively manipulating the facility's containment systems. How came he by such rarefied knowledge?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_136: That too is easily explained. During our investigation, Krile discovered a subtle flaw in one of the mechanisms which held the Goddess in check. A flaw which had plainly been added intentionally. Upon examining the facility's records of the period, we were able to piece together the story.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_137: It was a time towards the end of the Third Astral Era, when the peoples of Meracydia faced extinction at the hands of the Allagan Empire. Sophia, a being of incomparable cunning, was said to have communicated certain plans to her servants through the medium of a trusted oracle.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_138: Following the oracle's instructions, they duly conspired with a rebel faction within Allag who, we believe, agreed to tamper with the prison intended for Sophia. And then the Goddess and her thralls chanced to be captured─though we suspect that this had always been their plan.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_KRILE_000_139: Indeed. The prison was situated at the heart of Allag, and we think they intended to attack the city from within. They would merely have had to wait for the rebels to exploit the weakness in their confines.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_140: But the conspirators' dealings with the Meracydians were exposed before they could enact their plot, and all were summarily executed. It seems that the flaw itself remained undiscovered, however, and might have remained so until the end of days had it not been for the actions of the archbishop, and subsequently the Garleans.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_KRILE_000_141: I cannot help but wonder what might have come to pass had their scheme been successful. Mayhap the answer lies in the prophecy.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_URIANGER_000_142: Krile hath the right of it. Its words may be deciphered thus: the “cursèd pall” speaketh of Sophia's prison, from which she was supposed to emerge at the agreed hour. The “Wyrmking,” meanwhile, can be none other than great Bahamut himself, then yet a prisoner, whom the Goddess did intend to unleash upon Allag to set right the scales of justice.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_143: A foolhardy plan. Had it come to fruition, the two of them would surely have razed the realm. Naught would have been spared the devastation, the Meracydians' homeland included.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_144: Their home already stood on the brink of oblivion. Mayhap they wished for naught else but to purge the poison of Allag with primal fire.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_URIANGER_000_145: The tale teacheth us that even the greatest of man's creations may yet be brought low by a single act of treachery. The Allagans were fools to place their trust in technological bondage. To shackle such beings is but to delay the inevitable. Naught save their total destruction shall free us from their menace. Let us return now to the Rising Stones, and there consider the final step of this most needful task.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_146: The threat posed by this facility is far greater than you imagine, Urianger...and one not limited to the eikons themselves. Sophia's remaining servants must be put down.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_VERIFICATIONSYSTEM_:

Enter identification code to continue.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_170: Is aught amiss, Warrior of Light? Archon Y'shtola mentioned that there was a matter she wished to discuss.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_200: Well met, . You will forgive me if I seem curt, but I would settle an account with our young friend.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_201: While conducting a final sweep of Sophia's containment facility, we discovered that all of her remaining thralls had perished in their stasis chambers. This was your doing?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_202: Aye. It was. I chose to act upon the knowledge revealed within the tomestone we recovered. The true purpose of these prisons is far more horrifying than we first assumed...
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_203: The Allagans were not simply observing the eikons and siphoning away their energies─they were conducting experiments in preparation for a far more ambitious project.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_204: If you'll recall, both the Fiend and the Goddess were imprisoned within massive spherical structures. These spheres were the prototypes which paved the way for the successful construction of an artificial celestial body...
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_206: Aye. The eikons' cages are unmistakably of the same design as the red moon. To be plain: the research facility contains the seeds of three calamities which might feasibly be visited upon a chosen target.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_207: Eliminating one of them necessitated the destruction of the Goddess's slumbering thralls─a distasteful task unbefitting one such as the Warrior of Light. Thus did I resolve to perform the deed myself.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_100_207: You have made your case, and 'tis apparent that we were not in full possession of the facts. Nevertheless...
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_208: Your notion of what may or may not be expected of  is presumptuous in the extreme.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_209: When the Warrior of Light chose to join the Scions,  did so in the knowledge that  would be required to face and destroy not only the primals, but also their fanatical servants. That which you term “a distasteful task” is an essential part of our calling─a burden which every Scion is sworn to shoulder.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_210:
...I see.
'Twould seem I misjudged the depth of your resolve.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_211:
No matter. Assuming I have made myself understood, we need not speak of it again.
There is, however, one other subject which merits discussion.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_212: You determined that Sophia's thralls were awoken by a Garlean soldier who had somehow gained access to the containment area, did you not? If that is the case, it seems highly doubtful that the interloper wandered into such a dangerous part of the facility by chance.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_213: Dissidents within the Empire claim that the VIth Legion is rife with agents under orders to thwart the legatus's mission by any means necessary.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_214: Lest you imagine that we have allies in Garlemald, I should clarify that their motive is wholly uncharitable. Regula van Hydrus rose to the top of the Garlean military on merit alone, and is fiercely loyal to the Emperor for recognizing his efforts. His compeers, by contrast, rose through the favor of the established order, and would accordingly do anything to see him fail.
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_UNUKALHAI_000_215: That they would be so reckless... You truly believe that the actions of these agents contributed to the recent crisis?
TEXT_HEAVNY231_02332_YSHTOLA_000_216: Aye─and that they pose no less a risk to the realm than those loyal to the Emperor. Plainly, we must needs continue to do all in our power to prevent the technologies of Allag from falling into the hands of man. On that point, at least, we have ever been in complete agreement.
TEXT_HEAVNY232_02333_UNUKALHAI_000_000: I would like you to have this, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNY232_02333_UNUKALHAI_000_001: It is an Allagan tomestone similar to the one we recovered after your victory over Sephirot. The records contained within describe the Goddess at the height of her power, and will enable Azys Lla's reality augmentation technologies to generate an idealized simulacrum of Sophia against whom to test your skills.
TEXT_HEAVNY232_02333_UNUKALHAI_000_002: From what I have been able to determine, this formed part of a greater trial intended to test Allag's elite warriors. Quite how it will compare to the challenge presented by the Fiend's tomestone, I cannot say...
TEXT_HEAVNY232_02333_UNUKALHAI_000_003: I suppose there is only one way to be certain. Visit the verification node on Azys Lla, and witness firsthand what awaited the champions of eld.
TEXT_HEAVNY232_02333_UNUKALHAI_000_010: Have you the strength to equal Allag's greatest heroes? You need only visit Azys Lla to find out...

TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_000: ...Ah, adventurer. You come at an opportune moment. It would seem we have a visitor.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_001: I was pacing about, thinking of Roundrox, when something in the shadows drew my eye.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_002: I caught only a brief glimpse, but it bore an uncanny resemblance to Quickthinx's constant companion─Shanoa, was it? If the coeurl's here, there's a good chance her Illuminati keepers are close by. We'd best track her down, and quickly. Follow me!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_050:
Just as I thought─it is Shanoa!
...Or is it? One coeurl kitten looks much the same as another, and she doesn't seem to have brought any of her friends.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BACKRIX_000_052: Uplanders! What are all these snapcrashings and─ PSSSHKOH!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_053: ...An Illuminati spy. Sent by Quickthinx to observe our movements, like as not. Given the sizable disadvantage at which we find ourselves, we thought it best to relieve him of duty.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_054: He spent his final moments babbling about all of the Illuminati's deranged schemes. Claimed that once the final core was activated, and Alexander fully operational, the fortress would gain the power to travel through time─taking them along with it!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_055: He seemed quite convinced that Quickthinx was a prophet of sorts─a traveler from the future come to the present to return history to its proper state.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_056: Aye, and that's not the half of it. According to him, the battle for history has already been won─and not by us. For the future is writ in the Enigma Codex, and we but play out our roles in it.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_057: Quickthinx, a traveler from the future? That would certainly explain how he was able to anticipate our every move, but...could it be that he has already conquered the world of tomorrow? Have all our efforts been in vain?
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BACKRIX_000_058: Bah! Tongueflaps of crazed Illuminati make braincase hurt. Backrix would speak of different subject. What brings uplanders back to Shortstop?
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_059: Having settled upon a plan of action, Cid and I were in the process of making our final preparations with Master Matoya when this kitten scampered in, mewing as if to beckon us. We duly followed her, and she led us here...much to the dismay of the fellow at our feet.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_060: I'm not one to look a gift coeurl in the mouth, but something about all of this doesn't sit right with me. She has been at Quickthinx's side─make that on his bloody head─every step of the way, and now she decides to betray her keepers? If the cat could speak our tongue, I would have a question or two for her─mayhap even three.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_061:
...Ugh. I can't believe I'm even considering this, but then it wouldn't be the strangest thing I've heard today.
You there! Cat! You're Shanoa, Quickthinx's little familiar, aren't you? Two mews for “yea,” one for “nay.”
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_063:
Did she truly...?
Do you want to go...home?
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_065: Seven hells! I think the bloody furball might actually understand us. But that doesn't mean we can trust her. For all we know, she could be here to do her master's dirty work.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BACKRIX_000_066: ...A moment, uplanders! Tongueflaps of Roundrox come to Backrix's braincase. Three years ago, when Roundrox found codex splinterstone, Roundrox says black coeurlchild is there, onlooking. Backrix thinks nothing of this then, but now...
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_067: You mean to imply that Shanoa here was present when we attempted the summoning? I very much doubt that. If she were a kitten three years ago, she would be a fully grown coeurl by now.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_068: ...Unless, that is, she took a shortcut through time. An implausible theory, I grant you, but one we cannot well dismiss in light of recent events. If true, it would raise a still more troubling possibility: that Roundrox's discovery of the codex was no mere coincidence, but an event orchestrated by Quickthinx to further his own ends.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_069: Oh, this just gets better and better... Look, whatever is going on here, we're not like to find out by standing around talking. We need to delve deeper into that fortress.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_070: And as luck would have it, Wedge claims his latest invention will allow us to do just that. I've sent him and Biggs on ahead to the Makers' Quarter to perform their final tests. Meet them there when you are ready. I'll join you as soon as my own preparations are complete.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_071: To travel back in time, and set past wrongs aright... Who could resist such temptation? And how grievous the consequences of surrendering to it...?
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_072: For in allowing the past to consume us─and making our every choice, our every action the correct one─would we not cease to live in the present, and in turn lose sight of the future? 'Tis a path not to redemption but to madness.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_080: If Quickthinx truly has seen the future, we may very well be walking straight into a trap. And yet, what other choice do we have?
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_WEDGE_000_090: I must apologize once again for my negligence last time, . Rest assured, I have done my utmost to make it up to you with my latest invention. Why, it may very well be my best yet! Yes, I have a good feeling about this mission. This time, we'll show that power-mad gobbie what for!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_200: Ah, ! All fired up and ready to go, are we? Then I'd best hurry up and brief you on the task at hand!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_201: In a nutshell, we'll be attacking the primal on two fronts. As we speak, Y'shtola's leading an attempt to cut off the primal's source of aether.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_202: Our job, meanwhile, will be to head into the belly of the beast and rescue young Roundrox. Without her to view the Enigma Codex for 'em, the Illuminati won't be able to turn back time anymore─giving us a fighting chance of beating the bastards.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_203: The chief reckons that the shortest path is through the giant's great fat noggin, the only problem being that it's inside the barrier. Not to worry, though! Wedge's latest wonder will take care of that. He's dubbed it the BBG-II, which he tells me is short for “Barrier-Be-Gone.”
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_204: 'Course, the barrier doesn't just serve to keep folk out, it also keeps the primal in─that being why Mide and her mates raised the bleedin' thing in the first place. So the moment it goes down, there'll be nothing to stop the colossus from running rampant, if it has a mind to.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_205: Which means we're going to need to move fast. The chief'll take the Excelsior in as close as he can to Alexander's head, where you'll jump off and secure us a way inside. Wasting no time, you'll then climb back aboard, and Wedge'll reengage the barrier─all before our metal friend even knows what's happening. Got it? Good, 'cause we've got our work cut out for us! Let's get going!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_SYSTEM_000_210: You now have access to the Eyes of the Creator. Alexander can be accessed via the entrance in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_220: We're ready when you are, . Just say the word!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_400: All right! Time to deactivate the barrier!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_401: The smoke is too thick! Can't see a damn thing! You'll have to press on alone!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_700: Fine work, old friend! Thanks to you, we have our way in. Stay where you are─we're coming.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_701: But first─now that you're clear─we had best get that barrier back up before the big fellow gets restless. Wedge, ready the BBG-II and reactivate the barrier on my mark...mark!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_702: Excellent timing, Y'shtola!  has done it─we have a clear path into the heart of the beast!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_703: Good. 'Tis a relief to hear that at least one side of the operation proceeded according to plan.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_100_703: The same may not be said of the other. Our efforts to cut off the primal's source of aether proved wholly ineffective. Quite why, I cannot say─though I am hopeful that one among us can.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_704: What, Mide? On the basis that she summoned the damn thing, you mean? I think you'd better explain.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_705: Like all primals, Alexander constantly draws aether from its surroundings both to sustain itself and to gain in strength. Master Matoya and I believed we could disrupt or at the very least inhibit this process by means of arcanima.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_706: By creating a vast impassible aetheric membrane between the primal and the land from which it drinks, aye. Which is why the old witch had me place those infernal devices of hers in every nook and cranny of this place. Are you telling me they don't work?
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_707: Yes and no. As far as we can tell, the arcanima are functioning precisely as intended. And yet─for reasons we have been unable to ascertain─they have had no measurable effect on the primal.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_708: All right, out with it, Mide. If there is anything you haven't told us, we need to hear it now. We are running out of options.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_709: I fear it will not avail us, but...very well. It all began with a curious encounter in my younger days. I was out playing on my own one day when a stranger appeared before me. He told me anything my heart wished for could be mine if I but heeded his words.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_710: In my youth, I did not fully comprehend what the man was proposing at the time. Nevertheless, his words seemed to burn themselves into my very soul. “Reunite the scattered shards of the Enigma Codex,” he said, “and perform the sacred rite before the ruins that yet stand strong against the river's flow. Then, and only then, shall your hopes and dreams become reality.”
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_711: With that, he handed me a relic─a horn, with a tip of metal─which seemed so foreign as to hail from another world. It would serve as a catalyst for the “summoning,” he explained. “A gift from your friend Travanchet.” And then he was gone.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_712: Travanchet? I know the man. Our paths crossed during my time in Limsa, in the days before the Calamity. I might have guessed that the Ascians had a hand in this.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_713: The horn of which you speak was once rumored to reside on Seal Rock. It is a lost relic of the ancients with the power to manipulate the aetheric energy in the very air around us. The Scions have long pursued the horn, fearing the devastation that might ensue were an artifact of such power to fall into the wrong hands.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_714:
Finally, I do begin to see...
If I have the right of it, Alexander's third core is using the horn to draw aether from far and wide. 'Tis little wonder our plan failed. Even without moving an ilm, the primal possesses the means to drain not just this land of aether, but our very star.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_715: Then our course is clear. If the old witch's magicks won't avail us, we shall just have to get inside and dismantle the core the old-fashioned way!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_716: Indeed. And yet we must be wary. We have seen the course of time reversed once before─we may well see it again. Even should we succeed in destroying our target, there is naught to prevent the Illuminati from simply returning the stricken core to its previous state.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_717: Aye. They are free to turn back the clock again and again, the primal growing stronger all the while...
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_WEDGE_000_718: S-So what do we do then!? We can't just give up!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_719: No. We press on. Lest we forget, controlling Alexander requires the codex, and the codex is but a useless piece of stone without the mind of the gobbie girl. If we can rescue Roundrox, Quickthinx will have no way to flip the hourglass.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_YSHTOLA_000_720: The Circle of Knowing once tasked me with recovering the horn, and 'twas through mine own negligence that Travanchet acquired it. That it now endangers our world is my responsibility. Even were I not a Scion, I should do all in my power to make amends. Whatever assistance I can offer, it is yours.
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_CID_000_721: ...Then it begins! I'll send word to our friends in Idyllshire. Biggs, Wedge, ready the Excelsior! , prepare for departure. Let Operation Rescue Roundrox commence!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_MIDE_000_850: Even if we succeed in freeing Roundrox, what will remain of the girl we once knew? To the Illuminati, she's little more than a cog in their divine machine. They need her alive, aye, but no more than that. And they will not have scrupled to use any means necessary to force her compliance...
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_WEDGE_000_860: Backrix said he saw Shanoa standing on top of the colossus, at Quickthinx's side just as you'd expect her to be. Do you think Backrix's new pet is just a long-lost littermate? The resemblance is truly uncanny!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_900: Seven hells! It wasn't enough that those Illuminati lunatics had a bleedin' time machine, was it? No, it had to be a time machine with the power to destroy the whole bleedin' world!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_901: I mean, I'm used to the future of Eorzea being at stake, but this is the future, past, and present all rolled into one! We have to get Roundrox out of there before those gobbies can put any more of their crazy schemes in motion!
TEXT_HEAVNR301_02335_BIGGS_000_902: Speaking of gobbies, have you talked to old Backrix lately? Turns out the kitten you met wasn't Shanoa after all─just a doppelganger. He's already taken the little furball back to the Shortstop and given it a name: “Shrew-dinger,” or however you pronounce it. Anyway, I'd best be heading back that way meself. See you there, !
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_MIDE_000_000: Even if we succeed in freeing Roundrox, what will remain of the girl we once knew? To the Illuminati, she's little more than a cog in their divine machine. They need her alive, aye, but no more than that. And they will not have scrupled to use any means necessary to force her compliance...
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_WEDGE_000_010: Backrix said he saw Shanoa standing on top of the colossus, at Quickthinx's side, just as you'd expect her to be. Do you reckon Backrix's new pet is just a long-lost littermate? The resemblance is truly uncanny!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BIGGS_000_050: Ready to head back into the belly of the beast, ? All right, let's get this rescue mission off the ground! First, some good news: while the barrier was down, we were able to get our first good look inside Alexander's innards.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BIGGS_000_051: Far as we can tell, Roundrox is being held captive in what seems to be the central control chamber of the whole colossus─called, helpfully, “Central Control.” As to how we reach it, do you remember when you infiltrated Midas, there was that cavernous room with a dirty great city in it? Aye, well, we've spotted one of those floating platforms which goes back and forth between there and the place we need to get to.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BIGGS_000_052: The quickest route to the city is straight through the giant's head. You'll go in through the hatch you opened for us last time, take care of any guards, and secure the platform I mentioned. Meanwhile, the chief and the others will be making their way to you via Midas, after setting out in advance to sweep the place for any nasty surprises. Once you've all rendezvoused, it'll be time to storm the control room, while me and Wedge stage a little diversion. Got all that? Good! Then let's crack some Illuminati skulls!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_SYSTEM_000_060: You now have access to the Breath of the Creator. Alexander can be accessed via the entrance in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_MIDE_000_100: I will go with Cid and Y'shtola, and rid Midas of any lurking Illuminati ambushers. Roundrox is counting on us, friend. Be safe, and I will see you on the inside.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BIGGS_000_110: The Illuminati are holding Roundrox captive in Alexander's central control room. Your task is to go in through the head and secure the platform that'll take us there. You can expect it to be well guarded, but don't you worry─we'll be right behind you!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_WEDGE_000_120: We are ninety-nine percent certain that the Enigma Codex is also in Central Control, both it and Roundrox being required to operate the colossus. Intriguingly, the platform which will take us there seems to have been installed quite recently. One can only assume that the original design sought to make the place less readily accessible for reasons of security. Happily, however, the Illuminati favored a more practical arrangement.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_500: Excellent work, old friend! That platform is our shortcut to the heart of the machine. All seems quiet on our front, so─ Seven hells! We've got company!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_501: Ah, there you are, ! We were met by a small welcoming party, but it was nothing we couldn't handle. Biggs and Wedge just contacted me as well─they're headed here as we speak.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_503: So this is the Enigma Codex...
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_YSHTOLA_000_504: And that must be the third and final core. Twelve have mercy... If you could but see the volume of aether issuing from it...
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_ROUNDROX_000_505: Pssshkoh... Yes... Much swirlybright... Timewings...can spread... Travel to overtimes... Make bad things...good again...
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_MIDE_000_506: Could it be...? Do we truly have the power to change the past? I could erase my mistakes... I could see him again...
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_ROUNDROX_000_507: Three... Three years ago... Mide lost dear one... Mide wants dear one back, yes? Roundrox... Roundrox helps Mide...
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_MIDE_000_508: Roundrox, no! You must save your strength!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_ROUNDROX_000_509: Mide...worries too much. Roundrox is strong gobbie... Uplanders...hold on to braincases. Timewings...spread!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_510: Seven hells, has the girl gone mad!? Stop this, Roundrox! STOP, I say!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_WEDGE_000_600: Uh, Biggs...? Wh-Where are we? And why is everything...spinning?
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_601: Biggs! Wedge! Can you hear me? Roundrox has engaged Alexander's time-distortion mechanism. We're hurtling into the past!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_WEDGE_000_603: B-Biggs, over here! You're not going to believe this!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BIGGS_000_604: Eh? What's Mide doing down there with those─ Hold on! They're performing the summoning ritual! BUGGER ME! We really are in the past!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_605: What in the seven hells...? Someone's taken control of the colossus! Hold tight─I think it's about to go berserk!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_DAYAN_000_606: Damn it all! This isn't right! We must abort the summoning! Quickly, Mide! The seal!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BACKRIX_000_608:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...!?
What is meddlemaking kitten doing!?
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_YSHTOLA_000_700: ...'Twould seem we are back in our own time.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH:
Pshhhkohhh...
Past is made right, and we return to nowtimes. Treasure hunter's friends die─as it is writ, as it must be. Uplanders serve Quickthinx well today.

Pshhhkohhh...
Uplanders are not grasping meaning? Quickthinx breaks into bittypieces, fit in uplanders' tiny braincases. Time is flat roundshape. All things uplanders and gobbies did, are doing, and will do─doings happen over and over and over again. For alltimes.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_703: So, when Mide and her friends attempted to summon Alexander three years ago, what they actually saw was us traveling back in time!? But that's... That's madness!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_MIDE_000_704: ...Time is an endless circle? My failure, my pain, my suffering... It was all doomed to unfold like this from the very beginning?
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_MIDE_000_707: ...No. Nothing remains for me out there. My future, my past, my reason for being... It all ended...before it ever began.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_WEDGE_000_850: Good to see you safe, ! Whatever happened inside the control room, anyway? As for us... On second thought, let's save that for another day.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BACKRIX_000_860:
Pshhhkohhh... Pshhhkohhh...
Uplander has seen Roundrox? Backrix hopes she is safe... As for Backrix... Pshhhkohhh... Backrix is not liking highplaces much anymore.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BIGGS_000_900: Chief, Y'shtola...and Roundrox! Gods, I've never been so bloody glad to see you! I thought we'd never make it back in one─ Wait, where's Mide?
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_ROUNDROX_000_901:
Pshhhkohhh...
Mide stays behind in giant of whirlycogs. All because of Roundrox! Roundrox must go back to giant of whirlycogs! Save Mide!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_902: You leave that to us, child. Wedge! Get Jessie on that linkpearl and tell her to bring the Excelsior around!
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_CID_000_903: Though I don't much care for the answer, we finally know the truth behind the events of that day three years past. The Illuminati masterminded the massacre and─through some ungodly trick of time─'twas us that brought them there to do the deed.
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_BIGGS_000_904: And what about Mide? The only thing keeping her going was the hope that her beau's soul lived on in the machine... But seeing what happened to the poor bastard...
TEXT_HEAVNR302_02336_YSHTOLA_000_905: Aye...we witnessed the truth with our own eyes. Sucked into the core of the colossus to sate the primal's appetite. If aught remains of him, it is no more than heat and light.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_000_000: Jessie had the nerve to give me a dressing down for not saying “please”─said I was getting too big for my britches. Does she have any idea what we've been through!? Honestly!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BACKRIX_000_010:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Roundrox is resting back at Shortstop. Muchly worries for her friend Mide...but is safe.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BACKRIX_000_011: Backrix is happy to be on flatground again. Then uplanders tell Backrix he must go back into giant of whirlycogs for next mission. Shkohhh... What must poor gobbie do to get some rest?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_050: Quickthinx says the future's already been writ, eh? That we're fighting a losing battle? Well, we've got a thing or two to say about that, don't we, ?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_051: Roundrox is safe with us, which means the Illuminati won't be turning back time on us anymore. And that's not all─thanks to your efforts, we've got ourselves a straight path to the third and final core!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_052: Aye, the very heart of the colossus! Put it out of action, and the whole thing will grind to a halt! Let's go, ! We'll show the Illuminati that the future's yet to be decided─and save Mide while we're at it!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_SYSTEM_000_060: You now have access to the Heart of the Creator. Alexander can be accessed via the entrance in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_100: Backrix is with the chief, preparing for the mission. I've been watching over Roundrox's “treasures” in the meantime. Call me a softy, but I'm really starting to see the beauty in them.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_101: I reckon traveling back in time's made me appreciate the here and now a bit more, you know. Gripping as it was, I'm not in any hurry to have another try.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_000_110: Y'shtola returned to Idyllshire to tend to Roundrox. Poor thing─as if being a cog in the colossus hadn't taken enough of a toll on mind and body, she now blames herself for the loss of her friend.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_000_111: All the more reason to disable that core and get Mide out of there! The chief's already enlisted Backrix to join us this time around. You can count on Biggs and me as well, of course!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_000_500: Outstanding, ! Another Illuminati creation reduced to scrap metal. I'll wager the mere sight of you is enough to send the gobbies scurrying back to the drawing board!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_000_501: There it is... The heart of the beast. Only now that I see it up close do I comprehend the true scale of the thing.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_000_502: To have reached this size in so short a space of time, the core must be taking in aether at a positively ungodly rate. I'd be willing to wager that it can regrow itself faster than we could ever hope to chip away at it.
