TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_000_503: ...Which means we'll need to change tack. Hmm... The central control room houses everything required to operate the colossus. It's not inconceivable that it might offer us a way to regulate, or even shut off, the flow of aether to the core. Of course, any attempt to control Alexander is doomed to fail without the guidance of the Enigma Codex─and there is only one person alive who can access its secrets...
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_000_504: B-But, Chief! Do we really need to drag the poor girl back there? What if she falls into Illuminati hands again!?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Uplanders waste their tongueflaps. Quickthinx has seen future─true future─and it ends badly for uplanders. Very, very badly.

Uplanders think they just lazywalk into Central Control? Quickthinx thinks not. All passages are sealed, all floatyboards disabled. Only way left open is here, through corechamber. And when uplanders come next, it will be uplanders' endtimes. Quickthinx has seen it!

Pshhhkohhh!
Bad Shanoa! Stupid creature! What goes on in braincase!?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_508: Oi, Wedge... Is it just me, or are you getting the feeling we've seen all this happen before?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BACKRIX_000_509: Pssshkoh! It...it is watcherbook of Backrix! And look─writings end where Backrix leaves off, when Shanoa sends watcherbook spinnyfalling from Backrix's fingers!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_000_510: What the─? You mean to say the book Quickthinx has been reading from all this time is your journal? The same journal that slipped from your hands when we traveled back in time?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_000_511: So that's how he was able to anticipate our every move! He's no prophet─just a gobbie with delusions of grandeur and a diary from the future!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_512: So the glorious bleedin' future he was always going on about─the one that was writ─was nothing but Backrix's record of the stuff we'd already seen?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_513: Bugger me...I've just had a thought! Oi, cat! Are you Schrödinger from the Shortstop─or are you Quickthinx's familiar Shanoa? Uh...twice for “yea,” was it, Chief?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_515: I bleedin' knew it! She's both! After Schrödinger went tumbling down from the colossus─and don't ask me how she survived the drop─Quickthinx found her, took her in, and gave her a new name! It's like they're two cats─but also one! At the same time!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_100_515: Um, setting aside for the moment the question of whether or not that even makes sense... What possessed that confounded cat─whatever you want to call her─to do all this in the first place!? I swear, all she's done is made a right old mess of everything!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_200_515: Now, now, Wedge. Taking out our frustrations on a mewling kitten won't get us any closer to dismantling the core. Getting back to the crux of the matter...
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_000_516: Backrix. You said the journal ends right where you left off, yes? That it's nothing but blank pages from that point on?
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_CID_000_517: Do you hear that, everyone? Though Quickthinx would have us believe otherwise, the future─the future from here onward, that is─is still to be written. And I'll be damned if we won't be the ones to write it!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH:
Pshhhkohhh...
Futurebook is gone, but no matter! All knowings of truetimes are safe up here, in Quickthinx's braincase! Quickthinx is chosen one. Mender of history! Truth is unchanging!

Pshhhkohhh...
Truetimes choose Quickthinx to do their bidding! Truetimes send Shanoa into past, deliver to Quickthinx knowings of future! Truetimes live inside, guiding all of Quickthinx's doings!

Every tongueflap, every busydeal, every brainspark of Quickthinx brings world closer and closer to perfection! Guides Illuminati to rightful place as rulers of new world order! Truetimes will not be unmade by ignorant uplanders!

Pshhhkohhhhhh...! Pshhhkohhhhhh!
Quickthinx needs no futurebook! No gobbiegirl! Quickthinx needs nothing and no one but ownself! Future has chosen, and future chooses Quickthinx! Yes...even now, power granted by truetimes wells from Quickthinx's fingertips! Power beyond understanding of uplanders' feeble braincases!

Pshhhkohhhhhh...!
Alexander! Overwatcher of truetimes! Deliver divine judgment on ignorant uplanders, and crush them out of existence for alltimes!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_000_850: So the only reason Quickthinx was able to predict the future was because he stumbled onto Backrix's watcherbook three years ago? That's not nearly as impressive as being some kind of “chosen one,” to say the least.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_WEDGE_000_851: All of those uncanny predictions and impeccably timed actions─it was all just a sham! But without his precious book to guide him, it looks like the game is finally up!
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_900: Let me see if I've got this right. Three years ago, the Quickthinx of back then found the journal that the Backrix of now dropped─which was only possible because we traveled into the past, what with time being a circle and all that.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_901: Sooo...he had a look inside and, not knowing the truth of the matter, got it into his head that he was some sort of prophet chosen to set history straight, and that Shanoa, who “miraculously” delivered the book to him, was a messenger from the future sent to show him the way.
TEXT_HEAVNR303_02337_BIGGS_000_902: That's all well and good, but the question remains─why did that bloody cat start all this in the first place? What could she possibly stand to gain from setting in motion this ridiculously convoluted series of events? Another answer found, another question raised─eh, ?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_WEDGE_000_000: So the only reason Quickthinx was able to predict the future was because he stumbled onto Backrix's watcherbook three years ago? That's not nearly as impressive as being some kind of “chosen one,” to say the least.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_WEDGE_000_001: All of those uncanny predictions and impeccably timed actions─it was all just a sham! But without his precious book to guide him, it looks like the game is finally up!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_050: All right, , this is it. We still don't know exactly how we're going to disable the core, but we do know that our only chance is to get back to that central control room. We also know that there's only one way in, and that Quickthinx isn't going to let us through without a fight.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_051: Now, we can be pretty sure he can't see the future─not anymore, at least─and without Roundrox to read the codex for him, he won't be turning back time on us, either. But he's still a power-mad maniac with some of the deadliest machina in the realm at his disposal. And after losing that book of his, I'd wager his trigger finger's feeling pretty bleedin' itchy.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_052: Aye, we'd best be ready for a battle and a half. Muscle against metal, man against machine─gods, I don't know whether to laugh, cry, or soil meself! Mayhap all three! Ah, here comes the chief now. It's time to move out.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH:
(-Quickthinx Allthoughts-)Tick...tock. Tick...tock.
Time moves on, imperfect past giving way to perfect future. Worthy or unworthy of place in new world order─Alexander will judge!

(-Quickthinx Allthoughts-)Yes! All is as Quickthinx foresees! Truthhammer of Alexander falls on uplanders! Ignorant and unworthy are not welcome in Illuminati future! Here, uplanders meet their endtimes!
(-Quickthinx Allthoughts-)What!? Freezetime field is deactivated!? Pshhhkohhh...no matter! Uplanders will be reduced to smolderdust! FIRE!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_102: Seven hells! Now that was a bit too close for comfort. Is everyone all right!?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_103: A colossus inside the colossus...? Look─I don't know what that thing was, but I'm pretty damn sure I know where it went─or, more accurately, when. If I'm not mistaken, what we're looking at is a localized distortion of time.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_104: The only question is when our metal friend will reappear... Hm. Better not to wait, lest it catch us unawares. ─I need you to head into the distortion and dismantle that thing. We'll secure a path to Central Control while you do. Good luck!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_SYSTEM_000_120: You now have access to the Soul of the Creator. Alexander can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_SYSTEM_000_121: Alexander can also be can be accessed via the entrances in the Main Generators and the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_180: A gobbie lookout by the name of Snapclix has been given the job of guarding the hatch to the main generators. When you're ready to head back in, you'll find him in the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_200: I'm quite certain we just witnessed another manipulation of time, but by whom? With Roundrox gone and the Enigma Codex rendered useless, it can't very well be the Illuminati. Could Alexander have a will of its own?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_201: At any rate, we stand ilms from the core─the very heart of a primal. Whatever the true nature of the entity that awaits you in there, you can be sure it'll be like no foe you've faced before. Godsspeed, .
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_210: So that swirling void is some sort of ripple in time? I can't say I like the sound of that─you take care in there, .
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_WEDGE_000_220: Talk about a narrow escape! If I'd been standing so much as a yalm to the left, I'd be a pair of smoking boots by now!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_WEDGE_000_221: A-Anyway, we had better get on with securing the area, so that Y'shtola can bring up the rear with Roundrox. We didn't want to drag the poor child back here, but she's the only one who can access the controls.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_300: You do not disappoint, old friend! The path to the control room is clear! Everyone─follow me!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_YSHTOLA_000_301: The flow of aether to the core must be stopped. Pray lend us your strength one more time, child.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... When Quickthinx winds back time, doings of uplanders will be undone. History will be rewritten, and Illuminati will rule over new world order.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_303: Hah! If you think you can take Roundrox from us, you're welcome to try!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Foolish uplanders. Knowings of the Enigma Codex are not known to just one.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_305: What in the─!? The damn thing's responding to him!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Uplanders are slowseeing. Quickthinx never needed gobbiegirl from beginning!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_307: (-???-)When the final core is activated and Alexander fully awakens, its power will be such that it could entirely consume any who sought to control it. You were too craven to risk your own life─until you had no choice.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Treasure hunter!? But treasure hunter is too slowcoming! Future has chosen!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_309: You poor, deluded fool. You never did work it out, did you? The future doesn't choose us─we choose the future.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_311: So the knowledge in the Enigma Codex allowed you to disable the core...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_312: Power stores are depleting rapidly. Without a steady supply of aether, it's only a matter of time before the whole thing grinds to a halt and fades away.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_ROUNDROX_000_313: Pssshkoh... Roundrox is glad to see treasure hunter safe. But how is treasure hunter sneakyhiding from Illuminati?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_314: I...I don't know. There was a great shaking, and I was thrown from my feet into some dark, cramped place. I must have lost consciousness, because I don't remember anything until a few moments ago...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_315: Hah! Sounds to me like you had a nice nap in a rubbish chute! But what matters is that you're safe. And with that, I think we can declare this operation a success.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_YSHTOLA_000_500: 'Twould seem our work here is done. Let us take our leave.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_501: Damn it all! Didn't we kill that bastard!?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pszzztkzhhht... Negative. Quickthinx betterbuilt own body. Made stronger than ordinary gobbie. Quickthinx is not unmade by simple fleshwound.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_503: Betterbuilt? Seven hells... That's not a mask─it's his face! He's more machina than goblin!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: O, Alexander! Lord of steel and whirlycogs! Outspread wings of time─let ignorant and unworthy feel divine judgment!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_YSHTOLA_000_505: The codex responds... He means to return to the past!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_507: This red glow... Alexander is refusing to obey his commands?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pszzztkzhhht... ALEXANDER!!! Junkbrain machine! Quickthinx is chosen one! Tongueflaps of Quickthinx...must...be...obeyed!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_CID_000_509: It would seem Alexander has achieved what a simple fleshwound could not. Quickthinx's permanent...deactivation. Quite how and why is less clear. If I didn't know better, I would say the machine had a mind of its own.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_510: ...Dayan? My love, could it truly be you!?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_511: You were in there all this time, weren't you? Watching over me. Keeping me safe...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_512: Did it just blink...twice? Bugger me, the machine's actually talking to her!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_WEDGE_000_513: So his soul really was in the primal all this time? Chief, is that even possible!?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_YSHTOLA_100_513: The core...! Without the codex to bridle its power, it rages out of control.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_YSHTOLA_000_514: It drinks in aether like no primal I have ever known. We must stop it now, lest Eorzea be bled dry!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_515: ...Finally, I see. This is why you summoned me to this place─isn't it, my love?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_516: I thank you for guiding me here, . And Roundrox─know that I shall always treasure the time we shared. Farewell...my friends.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_ROUNDROX_000_517: Mide, no! Mide must not go!
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_ROUNDROX_000_518: My friends... Leave this place... Leave now.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_ROUNDROX_000_519:
Fear not...
Alexander will trouble you no longer...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_700: My love...! What...what is this place?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_701: How best to put it? We stand inside a mathematical simulation, calculated and projected by the device at the heart of the colossus. One might equally say it is the dream that Alexander dreams...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_702: And what of our companions? Are they...?
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_703: ...Their fate was not mine to change, Mide. All that came to pass did so for a reason. History is as it was─as it should be─free of the paradoxes that spelled its undoing.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_704: From this place─unfettered by the mortal construct of time─Alexander looks out upon past, present, and future, seeing infinite possibilities. I see what it sees, and feel what it feels─this perfect machine, born from yearnings for an ideal world.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_705: Oh, if you could see the worlds we have seen! A world in which the Illuminati rule history with an iron fist, every nation brought under their yoke. A world in which Alexander spread wide the wings of time and swept the lesser moon from the heavens, averting the Calamity...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_706: Alexander dreamed all the realities imaginable─all the realities mathematically computable─and in the end, reached a single, logical conclusion. It would change nothing, and erase itself from existence.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_708: Alexander possesses the power to travel through time and space, and reshape history for the better─but such power comes at great cost. The sheer quantity of aether consumed in the process means that Alexander itself would─mayhap not immediately, but inevitably─bring ruin to this world. This perfect machine, this supreme manifestation of logic and science, deemed its own existence a threat.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_709: And so it chose to do nothing. To leave history untouched, and the future in the hands of man, with all his imperfections. Such was Alexander's divine judgment.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_710: A time will come when the fate of this world is placed in the hands of one warrior. For reasons hidden to me, the future from that day forth remains shrouded in mystery─beyond even the colossus's ability to calculate. And yet Alexander chose to believe in that , and the light within .
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_100_710: I met that , my love... I believe in , too.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_711: There was but a single time Alexander was spurred to action─not to change history, but to preserve it. The summoning of the colossus, and the events that followed, had potentially disastrous consequence for our reality. Its fabric strained to accommodate an infinite number of potential futures separated by nary a thread.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_712: Were the wings of time to fall into the hands of the Illuminati, the repercussions would be dire indeed. History would be rewritten over and over again, each time bleeding the land of aether. And in the end, the colossus would usher in another calamity.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_713: To prevent this tragedy─to preserve the circle of time as it had already been set in motion─Alexander sent forth a humble servant to do its bidding.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_714: A clockwork coeurl, an eternal child, to gently nudge history back onto its proper path.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_715: And now but one task remains.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_716: Having become one with the horn, the core is well-nigh indestructible. It would only regrow itself until it bled the world dry. And so we must heed Alexander's wish, and seal it away─far from the reach of man.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_DAYAN_000_717: A closed pocket of space-time, a fraction of an instant that will repeat in perpetuity for all eternity. That is where the core must go─and us with it.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_718: Don't you see, my love? We are already there. In coming here─to you─I have closed the circle of time. I am all but certain of it.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_MIDE_000_719: When I accepted the horn all those years ago, the man who gave it to me said that it had the power to grant any wish. And so, as I took it in hand, I prayed and prayed with every onze of my will for the one true desire in my heart...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_WEDGE_000_850: Look at this, ! It's as if everything inside the barrier is frozen in time. I'll have to ask the chief what he makes of this.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_900: Roundrox is back in Idyllshire with the chief. Everyone's safe and sound─'cept for Mide, that is. The poor lass always had a flair for the dramatic, but to think she'd throw herself into the core...
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_901: It's odd, though. I could have sworn I heard her voice in there─saying the colossus would trouble us no more, or something of the sort. And for what it's worth, it has been sleeping like a baby ever since we got out.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_902: And that's not the half of it! Take a closer look inside the barrier, . It's like time is standing still.
TEXT_HEAVNR304_02338_BIGGS_000_903: Buggered if I know what it all means, but I'd like to believe Mide and her love somehow sealed away the core for us. Softens the blow a bit, you know?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_000_000: Just what do you think is happening inside the barrier? Perhaps I'll head down and take a closer─on second thought, maybe not.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_050: Phew! I'm still not sure how we managed it, but I'm just happy to be out of that godsforsaken place in one piece. 'Course, it's a damn shame what happened to Mide...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_051:
...Hold on a moment, .
She's what!? Aye, aye, Chief─leave it to us!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_052: Bloody hells, ─Roundrox's gone missing! I've been worried sick about the poor lass ever since we got back. I mean, how would you feel if you saw your best friend throw herself into a running engine?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_053: I'll wager she's run off somewhere the two of them used to frequent together. Wedge and I will have a look around here. Why don't you search the Collectors' Quarter? Come on, let's find her before she gets herself into any more trouble!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_200: Pshkohhh... Oh, it is uplander. Why does uplander come to this place?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_201: Roundrox is sorry for worrying uplanders. Roundrox just wants to go to quiet place, and do some backthinking...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_210: Running out of giant of whirlycogs, Roundrox feels something rattling in pocket. So Roundrox reaches in and cannot believe what she finds. Rattling thing is glowstone...Roundrox's favoritest treasure.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_211: Pshkohhh... But it is dark. Even with many tryings, glowstone does not glow for Roundrox...not anymore.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_212: There you are, child! We were worried sick about you. What's that, ? Is aught amiss?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_213: ...The codex no longer responds to her touch? Intriguing...if not entirely surprising. Were I to guess, I would hazard that it's because this experience has served to open her eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_214: The Enigma Codex was born from one man's all-consuming pursuit of perfection, its knowledge sealed off from any who harbored even a sliver of doubt as to the merits of the ideals it espoused.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_215: Quickthinx. Mide in her youth. Roundrox. Though their reasons might differ─arrogance, youthful idealism, childish innocence─none thought to question the words within, and so the codex opened itself to them. But now Roundrox has seen with her own eyes what blind devotion to ideals can bring.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_YSHTOLA_000_216: ...And she is not the naive child she was before.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_217: Aye. It's all well and good to dream of building something perfect, but sooner or later you have to stop dreaming and start doing─hammering it together by your own hand, with your own blood, sweat, and tears.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_218: In so doing, you are forced to confront your own failings, and deal with your frustration at the world's unfortunate habit of falling below expectations. Hells, there may come a time when you just want to tear the whole bloody thing apart and start again. But more often than not, you emerge from it all with something you can hold on to, and carry with you into the future. And that will do a damn sight more for you than any starry-eyed ideal.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_219: Pshkohhh... Roundrox understands! Roundrox will collect more and more junk! Build city of great treasures, with own hands!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_220: Roundrox has just one wish... Not-glowing glowstone is piece of Mide's dream. Roundrox would give back to Mide...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_YSHTOLA_000_221: A noble wish, child...would that we could grant it. But I fear the steel giant─and all that lies within that barrier─is far beyond the reach of mortal hands.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_222: Frozen in a single moment until the end of time. That's a fate I'd not wish on anyone...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_224: Well, look who it is! You have a real knack for turning up underfoot, don't you?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_225: I am reminded of the apparent ease with which this little coeurl seemed to slip in and out of the colossus. Were it not for the small matter of time having stopped in there, I'd send her in with Roundrox's glowstone without a moment's hesitation.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_YSHTOLA_000_227: Two mews...? Might that suggest a willingness to try?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_229: Giving a stone to a cat, in hopes of delivering it to two souls trapped in time─now I think we've seen everything. Do you think those two will ever be free of that place?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_YSHTOLA_000_230: Mayhap one day, when the perfect future they sought to bring about becomes a reality. In that sense, one might even say their fate is in our hands.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_231: Pshkohhh... Leave to Roundrox! Roundrox works hard! Builds sparklyshining future for Mide!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_YSHTOLA_000_232:
...As shall we, child.
And with that, , we must take our leave. For all you have done to stave off yet another primal threat, you have our gratitude.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_CID_000_233: I contacted Biggs and Wedge to let them know that they can call off the search. Needless to say, they were relieved to hear that Roundrox is safe. There was also a matter they were looking to discuss with you. They said they'd be waiting for you back at the Shortstop.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_YSHTOLA_000_234: If you will be returning to the Shortstop, I would ask a small favor of you as well. Pray deliver this volume to Backrix, and tell him I believe it is that which he seeks. Till next we meet, .
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_250: Thank goodness Roundrox is safe! With all the Illuminati stragglers running about, I feared the worst. The girl could at least have the courtesy to tell someone before she goes wandering off like that!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_000_260: Here we are then, at the end of yet another harrowing journey! And still with all our important bits, to boot! I─ Wait, my favorite wrench! Oh dear, I hope it isn't lost in time and space somewhere...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_ROUNDROX_000_270: Pshkohhh... Roundrox is sorry for making troubles. Roundrox will be good gobbie, play here with bittybobs.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_400: Pshkohhh... Now Roundrox is safe at Shortstop, and Backrix is easybreathing. Uplanders have thanks of Backrix. Hm? Uplanders bring present for Backrix?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_410: This... This is Sharlayan legendbook from Y'shtola! Backrix has waited for legendbook for long time!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_411: Backrix has been reading about many, many things. About Enigma Codex, and blue-haired uplander that writes it. Maybe these knowings will save gobbieflock from giant of whirlycogs, thinks Backrix.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_412: Now giant of whirlycogs sleeps, and gobbieflock is safe. But still, Backrix would fill braincase with knowings! Fill pages of watcherbook with data! Let Backrix see...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_413: Yes, yes... It is just as Backrix─ Pshkohhh! Are Backrix's eyes playing tricks on him!?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_414: Oi, are you feeling all right, there? You look like you've seen a ghost!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_415: Page tells faerielegend of Hotgo tribe, uplanders of blue hair. Many, many years ago in oldtimes, two children─boy and girl─outstep from belly of great steel giant. Two children grow to man and woman, becoming father and mother of great people of Hotgo...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_416: Names of two are...Dayan and Mide! Look at handdrawing! Even faces are same-looking!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_000_417: Ye gads! If that's our Mide and Dayan, why, that means that one day they'll be freed from their fate, and reborn far, far in the past!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_418: So after searching for near an eternity, they finally found the perfect world they were searching for? It may be just a faerie tale, but I, for one, would like to believe it!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BACKRIX_000_419: And faerielegend goes on... Two children step out of steel giant holding small stone. Stone is dark when sitting on ground, but hold stone in hand and shinylights!
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_000_421: Let me see if I have this straight: the codex fragment you gave to that coeurl a few moments ago now features in a legend from ages past. That can't be possible─can it?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_422: At this point, I'm about ready to believe bleedin' anything. But that reminds me. There was something I wanted to ask you, . Remember when we went into the core, and almost got our arses fried by that colossus-inside-a-colossus? Well, I felt the strangest sensation then─a feeling that chilled me to the bone. As if something terrible had happened that I couldn't for the life of me remember...
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_000_423: I-I felt it, too! So tell us─did you see anything when you were going in and out of time? Do you have any idea what happened to us while Quickthinx was spinning the hands of the clock?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_000_424: Y-You're afraid you do!? Well, that's not ominous in the least! On second thought, how about you don't tell us, thank you very much.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_425: You'll get no arguments from me. There are some secrets better left secret, and from the look on 's face, I reckon this is one of 'em.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_100_424: Y-You don't know!? Well, excuse me if that doesn't exactly put my heart at ease. Would it have killed you to say, “But of course! I saw plenty of alternate realities, Wedge, and I can say without a sliver of a doubt that in none of them were you and Biggs blasted to smithereens!”
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_100_425: Wedge! I know we were both thinking the worst, but you didn't have to go and bleedin' say it. Look, as far as I'm concerned, what  doesn't know can't hurt us, so why don't we just forget we ever asked?
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_BIGGS_000_426: Anyway, it'd seem this long and thoroughly mind-boggling battle of ours has finally come to an end. 'Course, there's still plenty of work to be done, but now that Quickthinx is out of the picture, I've got high hopes that Roundrox and her friends will one day build their shining kingdom of rubbish and refuse.
TEXT_HEAVNR305_02339_WEDGE_000_427: Speaking of work, we'd better get back to it before the chief catches us chattering. Always a pleasure, ─till next time!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_000: ! Cait Sith just sent me out to find you! ...You've a proper knack for showin' up at just the right time, you know that?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_002: Anyway. Cait Sith cracked open that tome what we got from Radlia, and has been studyin' all the Nullstone's secrets.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_003: He thinks he may be onto somethin' important─not just concernin' Diabolos and the Shadow Queen, but also the cat himself.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_004: Come on back to the Parrock, and we can all hear what he has to say together.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_050: You don't need me to remind you how to reach the Parrock, do you? It's just a short flight from the standard there.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_055: Ugh, thank the winds you're here at last. The furball refused to share until you'd arrived.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_UTATA_000_060: Cait Sith has had the darkest look on his face...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_065: Thanks for comin'. Now let's ask Cait Sith what this is all about...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_100: As I suspected, this tome was penned by a Mhachi sorcerer of superior standing. As well as detailing the methods by which the full power of the Nullstone might be unleashed, its pages also contain a number of revelations concerning my master, High Voidmage Cessair.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_101: If these histories are to be trusted, then it seems that Cessair herself was responsible for summoning Diabolos!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_102: But...I thought you said your master was opposed to supportin' the war effort. Why would she be the one to call up that bat-winged monster?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_103: Cessair only agreed to the ritual as a means to bring the conflict to an early resolution. From what I can glean from these passages, Diabolos was intended as a bluff─a threat that was never to be exercised.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_104: But those arrogant imbeciles ignored my master's carefully laid restrictions, and elected to unleash the fiend upon Amdapor. It was when Cessair moved to protest this act that she was branded a traitor and imprisoned!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_105: Once they had contained the “opposition,” the voidmages studied all manner of otherworldly arts at the taloned feet of their new pet...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_106: ...The most dangerous of which was the rite for summoning Scathach, and the method for chaining her power.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_107: Yet even after all they had perpetrated, these ambitious fools had the gall to come crawling to Cessair when the coming of the great floods was predicted. They begged her to take control of the Void Ark, for the “salvation of the Mhachi people.”
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_108: As you saw for yourself, however, the energies of the Shadow Queen broke loose and turned the vessel into a derelict nest of voidsent. It seems obvious now that the arts taught by Diabolos were deliberately flawed...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_109: The only saving grace in all this madness was when that damnable fiend was sealed away by the white mages of Amdapor. I shudder to think what would have happened had he been reunited with his queen.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_110: So now, fifteen hundred years later, Diabolos is lookin' to finish what he started? I thought the bat-faced bastard was just some opportunistic underling, but it turns out he's the main villain behind this whole mess...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_111: Were Cessair alive today, she would accept responsibility for unleashing Diabolos upon the world. As the high voidmage's familiar, it is my duty to act in her stead!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_112: I have deciphered the secrets of the Nullstone, and with its undiluted power shall I erase Diabolos from existence!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_113: ...Heh. I like your spirit, puss, but try not to rush in too quickly, eh? Gettin' yourself killed won't do us─or your master─any good.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_114: Wait, wait, wait! No one's rushin' in anywhere just yet! Or have you forgotten that we're still in the middle of scoutin' out the fiend's lair?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_115: We've got the compass to go by, aye, but who knows what kind of place it'll lead us to or how many demons'll be lyin' in wait when we get there. We fly in with our eyes open, or risk gettin' slaughtered just like the Talons!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_116: Oh, yes, speaking of which, the tome made mention of a potential location for─
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_203: <cough> This is far from over, demon! We'll not allow an abomination like the Shadow Queen to rule this world!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_DIABOLOS_000_204: ...Then thou knowest naught of ruling. It is might which decideth dominion.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_DIABOLOS_000_205: But believe what thou mayest, frail creature. You are playthings. Your screams of denial shall amuse me as I send this rock and all upon it to shatter upon the ground below...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_206: Gods, is that Radlia!? ...Where's she been hidin' that ship?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_DIABOLOS_000_207: I would not tire my arm with the swatting of so many flies. The Nullstone is mine, and there is yet much to be done.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_250: I ain't a healer, but I'd say you've broken your arm, a couple of ribs, and bruised half your innards. We need to get you some splints and bandages...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_255: The loss of the Nullstone is on my head...and I shall see that we win it back.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_UTATA_000_260: How are there still so many Talons? I thought they were massacred at Mhach...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_265: Would you look at that sorry excuse for a sky pirate. I knew Redbill and his ragtag crew couldn't be trusted with saving the skies.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_SUBORDINATE02204_00: Consider our debt to you repaid!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_300: ...Well, well, ain't I a lucky sod: two demons in one day. Found some new dogs to lick your boots, Radlia?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_301: Is that any way to welcome me back to the life? You needed allies, and persuading our reluctant fellows to join in common purpose is a feat only a woman of my charming beauty could accomplish!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_303: And besides, you look too injured to be of much use to anyone. You'd best take to your bed, old man, and let me and your champion there take care of the voidsent.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_305: ...What, so you can tuck tail and run again at the first sign of trouble? You'd not even be standin' there if it weren't for me, and even with me arm busted up I'm still twice the pirate you are.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_306: ...Nay, I think you should stay behind this time, Leofard. We must pursue Diabolos without you.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_307: Time is of the essence, and we cannot afford to wait for you to heal. We must take advantage of Captain Radlia's reinforcements, and proceed with all haste.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_308: Did the demon drop you on your head, furball? Without me there to run things, you'll just end up gettin' in 's way. And no one's makin' haste anywhere until we know what we're flyin' into!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_309: Again, Captain Radlia may hold the answer to that dilemma. I suspect that the island where she uncovered the Mhachi tome is the very location where Diabolos has chosen to lair!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_310: This floating marvel I speak of is not a natural occurrence─it was constructed as a haven for refugees of the floods. The tome makes very clear reference to the island's purpose, and describes in detail the voidsent sorcery employed in its creation...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_311: As the Void Ark never arrived at its destination, however, the island remained uninhabited. I can imagine no more suitable hideaway for our scheming fiend.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_312: Even better, Diabolos will not expect us to suddenly arrive on his secluded doorstep. The Talon fleet will carve us a path through the lesser fiends, and we shall strike swiftly into the heart of the confusion to seize the Nullstone. Once the relic is secured, I will use its power to obliterate our devilish foe!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_313: As a sky pirate, surely you understand how such an assault relies on speed and surprise. We cannot have a wounded companion slow us down...and potentially doom the entire enterprise.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_314: ...So, you think you're in charge now, do you, puss? Poor, broken Leofard's just some dead weight you need to cut away?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_315: You know what? I've had a bellyful of your mewlin' in any case. Go on─fly off without me, and see how far you get with your thrice-damned “enterprise.”
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_317: ...Captain Radlia, compare the direction indicated by the ectocompass with your navigational records, if you please. I think we'll find the coordinates coincide with the island in question.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_318: Certainly. And feel free to board our flagship when you're set to depart. My darling's large enough to accommodate your adventurer and  fellows with room to spare!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_350: This adventure's all yours, . I'll be cheerin' for you from my sickbed like a good little pirate. Promise.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_355: ...This is the way it must be. Considering our need for haste and the extent of Leofard's injuries, my conclusion was merely logical.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_356: Captain Redbill's primary concern should be securing the freedom of the skies, not limping into almost certain death at the hands of the voidsent─no matter how much he chafes at being excluded from the voyage.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_360: Cait Sith was only talkin' common sense. The captain took it hard, but I think he knows it, too. We're doin' the right thing leavin' him behind...ain't we?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_UTATA_000_365: Don't you worry, I'll keep an eye on the captain while everyone is off on this grand adventure. Without him. Hmmm. Are you certain you don't need me to go with you...?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_370: I acquired our splendid flagship after the Ishgardians saw fit to abandon her. I hear she was an attempt to match the airborne agility of their dragon enemies, but the vessel never did live up to expectations.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_371: When she passed to me, we replaced all their “improvements” with structural reinforcements, and made ourselves a flying fortress. Our stately lass'll not soon be knocked from the sky!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_400: Do not relax your guard yet, ! The air is still heavy with his foul presence...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_401: Already taken care of the fiend, have you? And you didn't even need that dusty old relic to do it!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_402: Be careful, Captain! Diabolos yet lurks in the shadows!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_DIABOLOS_000_403: Finally have I claimed the Shadow Queen's power for mine own, yet still am I harried by you noisome weevils!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_DIABOLOS_000_404: I must needs quit this realm for a time... And when I have grown accustomed to my newfound might, there shall be a reckoning for your insolence!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_405: (-Familiar Voice-)This ain't the time for nappin', furball! You've still got a job to do!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_100_405:
...Aye, my work here is unfinished.
In Cessair's name, I unmake thee, Diabolos! My master's will be done!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_DIABOLOS_000_406: Gaaarrrggghhh! For fifteen centuries have I yearned for this power! Thou canst not unmake me! No! Noooooo!
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_407: ...I should have known we were wastin' our breath. The captain only heeds the siren in his heart, and damn the consequences...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_408: Heh... I told you you'd be lost without me, didn't I?
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_409: And look at you, puss, gettin' knocked out cold in your moment of glory. You weren't like to get another chance to honor your master's memory and you almost missed it...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_410: But I suppose you pulled through at the last. ...Aye, I'll give you that much.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_CAITSITH_000_450: The plan was a resounding success...though it did require some intervention on Leofard's part. I am afraid I misjudged his commitment to our cause...
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_STACIA_000_455: Well, I think he'll live. Which is surprisin' considerin' he crashed his ship into a bloody demon... Damned fool.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_RADLIA_000_465:
How vexing to once again be rescued by Redbill...
He'd better recover from those injuries so we can go back to hating each other on an equal footing.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_500: Spare me your concern and your lectures. You all knew I wasn't like to stay abed with such a grand adventure in the makin'. And I'd rather break every bone in me body than be stripped of the freedom to go where I please.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_501: Besides, all's well that ends well, eh? Diabolos is dead, and we're all alive. That counts as a victory in my book.
TEXT_HEAVNM301_02373_LEOFARD_000_502: It's just a pity that it cost me the Raimille in the doin' of it. I hope she rests easy on that island refuge...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_005: The plan was a resounding success...though it did require some intervention on Leofard's part. I am afraid I misjudged his commitment to our cause...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_000: Well, I think he'll live. Which is surprisin' considerin' he crashed his ship into a bloody demon... Damned fool.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_RADLIA_000_015:
How vexing to once again be rescued by Redbill...
He'd better recover from those injuries so we can go back to hating each other on an equal footing.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_050: Bah, me goggles are a mess. But I can always get me a new pair of goggles...and a new airship. I suppose we should be glad we didn't lose aught else after divin' headlong into a voidsent nest.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_RADLIA_000_051: Now that we've taken the skies back, it's time we were taking our leave. The Talons and the Redbills can kiss this brief alliance farewell...unless, of course, you're interested in a more permanent arrangement?
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_052: Your bootlickers might think your voice a siren song, but it grates on me ears like a harpy's screech. No, this is the first and last time we fly together. We're back to bein' rivals─the way it's always been.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_RADLIA_000_053: You are a very stubborn man, Redbill. But you'd do well to remember: I always get what I want in the end!
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_054: ...Head back to me quarters and see to the furball's hurts. I'll be along in a bit.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_055: I feel so foolish, . I demanded that Leofard remain behind, only to have him rescue my mission from certain failure─a failure that would have made mock of your heroic efforts, as well.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_056: You are too kind. Ah, what words exist that can properly express my contrition? I know not how to even begin making my apologies...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_057: I should like to approach the captain, but he has the air of a man who seeks solitude. 'Tis strange to see him so melancholy.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_058: Could it be the loss of the Raimille which troubles him so...? Nay, I shan't intrude upon his contemplation with clumsy questions and trite platitudes. Let us leave him be for the moment.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_100: Go on ahead without me. I won't be long.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_105: The captain is not his usual bombastic self. Mayhap Stacia can enlighten us as to the source of this uncharacteristic malaise.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_UTATA_000_110: ...I heard the Raimille was an unsalvageable wreck. She was a fine vessel, built to endure the captain's reckless flying style, and it seems she kept him safe until her very end. Such a shame...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_RADLIA_000_115: Step up the pace, you sluggards! Let's leave this rock behind and get to celebrating the return of the Talons!
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_150: Mistress Stacia, if I might ask you a question: do you know the cause of the captain's melancholy?
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_151: Is it because of the Raimille? Pray tell me if it is so. I cannot help but feel responsible for the vessel's destruction and I would better understand Leofard's present distress.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_152: Hmmm... If you really want to understand, I suppose I should start with how the captain was orphaned as a child. As matters turned out, he was taken in by a highborn widow who raised him as her son.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_153: From what Leofard has told me, his adoptive mother was a kind, quiet-spoken woman, but due to some illness or other she was rarely able to venture outside. Instead, she spent hours readin' to her boy from a library well stocked with books from faraway lands.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_100_153: Leofard cared for her as her malady grew worse by the day...and he was there by her side when death finally carried her away to Thal's halls.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_154: While she was alive, she never did ask much of him. Not long before she passed on, however, she wrung from him one single promise: that he escape the conformity she had always endured, and live his life as free as a bird.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_155: As you've likely guessed, her name was Raimille. That's her portrait there hangin' on the wall...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_156: Ah, this explains much! I had wondered as to the origin of his vessel's naming.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_157: The sky pirate way is the life Leofard chose for himself. But I like to think he named his ship the Raimille so that his mother would be there to watch over all of his adventures.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_159: Since when were you so loose-lipped about a comrade's private past, Stacia?
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_100_159: ...I ain't in the habit of leanin' on people's sympathies, so you can all keep that tidbit to yourselves, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_161: And I thought I told you to see to the furball's wounds. Look at your cape, puss, it's in tatters. Come here a moment...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_163: Aye, that's a little present we give to every new Redbill.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_100_163: Raimille taught me that it's not protectin' memories that's important─it's havin' the strength to follow your path and make those memories in the first place. Seein' how determined you were to clean your master's slate, I'd say you'd fit right in with our crew.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_164: Listen. If you're thinkin' that that little airship meant a lot to me, then you'd be right. But I'd rather mourn a hunk of metal than lose them as can share in me highs and lows.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_165: So let's get this straight, puss: there's no need for apologies. A sky pirate makes his choice, and he sticks by it.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_166: ...The life of a sky pirate, hm? As I seem to be bereft of both place and purpose now, I suppose I shall accept your offer. I am yours to command, Captain!
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_167: Glad to hear it. Your first duty is to join us in givin' our adventurer here a proper send-off!
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_168: Well, it's about bloody time you two saw eye to eye. But honestly, Captain, you don't mean to head out in those rags, do you? Let's get you cleaned up as well before we say our fond farewells!
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_STACIA_000_200: We've a spare airship the captain can use for now until he feels ready to build a new one...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_CAITSITH_000_205: For fifteen centuries did I wander in the dark, alone. To be so surrounded by companions and given a new hearth to call home fills me with a warmth I had almost forgotten was possible...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_UTATA_000_210: Did you see!? Cait Sith is wearing a Redbills scarf! Isn't that just wonderful!
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_250: It's time we parted ways, . Let's give you an escort down to Coldwind.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_300: That was some adventure, , but our journey into the unknown is over...
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_302: When the skies spit out some new mystery, you can bet that I'm comin' to find you. After all, there ain't nobody else who handles the unexpected quite like you do.
TEXT_HEAVNM302_02374_LEOFARD_000_303: High adventure and the heady rush of danger─surely in this life there is no greater reward!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_000: Greetings, Warrior of Light. But one pillar of the Warring Triad remains: Zurvan, the eikon known as the “Demon.”
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_001: According to the histories I have uncovered, this monstrous being was worshipped by a race of Meracydian beastmen.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_002: These creatures are the key to maintaining Zurvan's manifestation, and we can be sure that many such thralls will be imprisoned somewhere within the research facility.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_003: It is imperative that we determine their exact location as swiftly as possible─we dare not risk repeating the near-disaster we suffered at the hands of Sophia's servants.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_004: As such, your fellow Scions have already begun an exhaustive search, but there are several sectors which only you, Krile, and I can enter without fear of enthrallment. Let us make our way to Azys Lla forthwith and aid the investigations.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_030: Zurvan's thralls must be accounted for ere we face the eikon himself. Azys Lla awaits!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_080: , it is good we caught you! The facility has been swarmed by imperial troops!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_081: By their standards did we judge them soldiers of the VIth. Aye, once more doth Regula van Hydrus stretch forth his hand to seize the forbidden fruits of Allag. And once more have our meticulous wards been swept aside like so many cobwebs...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: (-???-)Your meddlesome wards were destroyed from within by the pulsating energies of an eikon.
Nay, put up your weapons and listen. The followers of Zurvan have awakened, and they toil to rouse their master!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_084: The Demon's worshipers yet slumbered when we confronted Sophia. Could the tampering of her thralls have been more widespread than we thought?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_085: They shared a common enemy─'tis not unthinkable that they would seek to free all those the Allagans had imprisoned.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: Yes, yes, the cage doors are open. And whilst you stand here quibbling over who picked the locks, my soldiers are inside the facility risking their lives and their sanity.

They have volunteered to face death to prevent Zurvan's servants from waking him in the fullness of his power. Now, assuming you have at last understood the gravity of the situation, it is time that I rejoined them.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_087: But you cannot hope to succeed! The eikon will enslave the minds of any who draw near!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: Thus did I seek out those with the power to resist his influence. Aid us, and mayhap my men will not perish in vain.
I have delved into the depths of this place and found its technology wanting. These mechanisms have failed to hold their prisoners, and such broken artifacts are unfit to bring before the Emperor.
Twice have you bested me in combat. Will you now lend me that strength, and stand against our mutual foe?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_093:
'Twas in opposing your reckless schemes that Ysayle was lost to us...
You expect us to simply forgive and forget all that has come before?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: I expect you to put aside your emotions and use your better judgment. But, of course, I am dealing with savages.
I will not stand here and justify the death of the ice maiden. We pursued our ideals, and you pursued yours─such was the result. And mayhap you might consider another point...
In these endless clashes, we have all lost comrades dear to us! Yet I choose to put aside past grievances to beg your champion's aid; to appeal to your reason.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_097: Thou art willing to build a bridge of common purpose upon such tremulous foundations?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_098: I, too, am hesitant to accept this arrangement, Archon Y'shtola. But the offer has been made to the Warrior of Light, and 'tis  involvement which shall ultimately sway its outcome. I shall abide by 's decision.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_A1_102_102: I cannot fight alongside the Empire.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_110: ...Then for better or worse, we shall fight at your side.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_111: Mistress Krile and I are also resistant to primal influences. We shall aid you where we can.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: ...Then let us be on our way.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_100: ...Your answer does not surprise me. I was, however, duty-bound to pursue the most likely means of victory for the Empire. I leave you to your fate.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_100_112: Whilst I cannot match 's strength, I am immune to primal influence. I may prove of some use to you.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_100_113: I shall go as well. I fear that denying the legatus here will invite a lifetime of regret. There is too much at stake.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_100_114: Thus we are shown the error of our ways. I spoke of Ysayle, but she would not have approved of allowing such a horror to surface whilst we clung to old rivalries.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_100_115: Indeed, she would not. There is yet time─let us hasten after our comrades.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_200: You struggle to accept my proposal? An understandable conflict, but I will waste no more words. The hourglass drips with the blood of my soldiers.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_200_111: ...Is it wise to refuse him? The imperials have no means to resist Zurvan's will. The eikon could soon awake in full possession of his power...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_200_112: I never imagined I'd suggest joining hands with the imperials, but I see no alternative. The consequences of inaction are too dire to contemplate.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_200_113: And how rare this moment, when the Empire opposeth us not...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_200_114: Let us then hasten after the legatus and accept his offer. The Twelve forbid we be foolish enough to allow old grudges pave the way for Zurvan's resurrection.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_120: Our companions have already passed through to the research facility. We should not lag behind!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_201: Like a suckling babe, he feedeth upon the aether siphoned unto him by his thralls. We must needs deprive him of this sustenance!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: Then we destroy those devices.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_204: They have turned one against the other. Even half awake, Zurvan corrupts and converts those who enter his aura...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_205: The three of us, then. , Unukalhai: we rush in together and each disable a generator. We cannot give them the chance to rally a defense!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: There are four mechanisms by my count. If I can avoid the eikon's miasma, my blade will make short work of the last one.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_207: We, all of us, have pledged our lives to─
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: Keep your lives. I would rather you tend to my fallen─some may yet survive with their minds intact.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_209: I know not if my strength will be enough. I am no champion...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_REGULAVANHYDRUS_000: The battlefield is no place for uncertainty, boy. Fate has blessed you with a unique talent and an occasion to use it. Do not waste such a gift.
We strike!
Raaargh!
I told you, boy... Yours is a gift too precious to waste. A gift the Emperor may one day have need of in his war upon these untamable eikons...
Emperor Varis, he... He raised me up from the ranks, stood against my detractors... I gladly give my life in his service...
<cough> You must... You must finish this. Slay these leeches upon our star... Kill them all. <cough> Kill...Zurvan!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_220: We must needs withdraw and prepare our assault. At the cost of his very life, the legatus hath prised open for us a window of opportunity.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_300: If you are prepared to enter Azys Lla's core, simply approach the verification node.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_310: Have you lost your way, Warrior of Light? The path to Azys Lla's core can be opened with the verification node near the portal.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_400: I had thought Regula a cold and ruthless man, but he showed surprising compassion for his soldiers.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_401: And it also seems he placed great trust in his emperor. If Regula could be convinced that the technology for containing primals is fatally flawed, then mayhap Varis can be convinced as well.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_410: 'Tis not often that I dare approach so closely to entities such as Zurvan. How sharply am I reminded of the burden we place upon those whom are blessed with the Echo...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_420: These wounded soldiers will live, but further battle is beyond them. I have counseled them to remain here until their compatriots arrive to bear them home.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_IMPERIALSOLDIERONE0: Forgive me if I show little gratitude for my rescue...
It is said that the Emperor and van Hydrus were childhood friends. Foul fortune that we should be the ones to bring news of his death...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_IMPERIALSOLDIERTWO0: The research facility crawls with Zurvan's faithful, and they will not cease in their efforts to rouse him. If you would honor the legatus's sacrifice, then you must slaughter those fiends to the last.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_500: He's dead. Had I only been stronger...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_501: Enough of that! There'll be time for regrets after we've rid the world of Zurvan!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_502: Krile has the right of it. The Demon has fallen back into torpor for now, but we must act swiftly if Regula's death is to have meaning.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_503: The survivors speak of an army of thralls loose in the facility, and we must assume that these followers continue their efforts to awaken the eikon.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_504: Let us then concentrate upon diverting them from their task. Mistress Krile and Master Unukalhai, prithee secure the controls to Zurvan's shackles and limit the restoration of his might.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_505: Archon Y'shtola and I shall forge ahead, and strike down those thralls as would seek to harry you.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_506: Warrior of Light, thine is, as ever, the most perilous duty...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_507: Gather to thee thy trusted companions, and extinguish from this realm the fires of the Demon himself.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_550: The last pillar of the Warring Triad is set to fall! Let's see this to the end, .
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_560:
The legatus spoke truly...
The thick of battle is no place to question oneself, and I will accept any forthcoming duty with certitude or not at all.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_IMPERIALSOLDIERONE0: We will bear the legatus's remains back to Garlemald. His favored blade was shattered, but may your own weapon claim vengeance in its stead!
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_IMPERIALSOLDIERTWO0: When I volunteered for this mission, it was in the knowledge that my death would serve a greater purpose. We fell too quickly... Too quickly...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_700: Incredible as always, ! Hopefully that will be the last our world sees of the likes of Zurvan.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_701: Every one of his thralls has been slain as far as we can determine. Our victory over the Warring Triad is complete.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_702: ...An impossible feat had we not been blessed with your cooperation.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_703: Let us not forget the efforts of Regula van Hydrus and his men. Without their noble sacrifice, the Demon would have awoken far sooner, and possessed of far more formidable energies.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_704: The bodies of the fallen now accompany the survivors on the return journey to Garlemald. 'Tis known that the imperials recognize no god, yet they would honor the dead in their own fashion.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_100_704: And when next we meet, our fleeting alliance will surely be forgotten. 'Twas an interesting exchange, nonetheless.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_705: They spoke of their present ruler as a man who values self-sufficiency. Varis befriended Regula in their youth, it seems, and was highly impressed by his martial prowess. 'Tis common knowledge that Regula's rise to legatus was in great part advocated by the Emperor himself.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_706: Regula freely admitted his shortcomings when it came to politics, and it was Varis's unconditional support that served to win his undying fealty. One does not expect such tales of comradeship to lurk beneath the Empire's iron exterior...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_707: Contrary to all expectations, the man died a hero. Witnessing the way you all leapt into danger without hesitation, it would seem I am surrounded by heroes...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_708: And yet, my own actions were aught but heroic. I have not the qualities nor the character to stand at the Warrior of Light's side.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_709: What a curious thing to say. Are you truly concerned that you do not measure up to some arbitrary requirement?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_710: If you knew of the path I walked to reach this place, then you would understand why I doubt myself so. Return with me to the Rising Stones...and I shall tell you of it.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_790: With your victory over Zurvan, the Warring Triad is finally defeated. I am afraid, however, that mine own efforts have often been more hindrance than help... And you and your fellow Scions deserve to hear the reasons behind my actions.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_800: I promised to tell you of my journey. Of who I am. Of where I am from.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_801: The truth is, I am not of this world.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_802: I was born of a different star─a child whose power of the Echo was too feeble to save his dying world...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_803: A child, who, unlike you, never became a Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_804: When all I knew stood on the brink of destruction, I was yet half-grown. Had I been born but a handful of years earlier, history may have written a different tale; the seeds of other heroes that had yet to fully sprout may not have withered and perished.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_805: The star I failed to save is known to you now as “the void.”
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_806: Though  knew not that I spoke of my homeland, I have explained to  before the cause of its ruin. A magick was devised to contain a defeated primal's might within a stone known as “auracite.” And the energies which bled from this imperfect vessel gradually corrupted the champions who wielded it.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_807: These heroes became slaves to an insatiable hunger for aether, eventually transforming into hideous fiends. And none who clung to the faint traces of Light were strong enough to oppose them.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_808: The demons next turned upon each other in a war which drained the land's aether in ever greater amounts, until one day the star was suddenly swallowed in a flood of Darkness. An entire world unmade in an instant.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_809: The voidsent you encounter here in this realm are the twisted remnants of once-mortal beings who gnaw on what motes of life force remain...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_810: And as I lay dying, beaten and broken in my failed last stand, 'twas a white-robed Ascian who found my tormented spirit and bore me away to the rift betwixt worlds. Elidibus has been my master ever since.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_820: And as I lay dying, beaten and broken in my failed last stand, 'twas my present master who found my tormented spirit and bore me away to the rift betwixt worlds. 'Twas he who first introduced me to Urianger.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_830: At my mentor's feet did I learn of the nature of reality: of the existence of mirrored worlds and the eternal struggle between Dark and Light.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_831: Sudden and overwhelming superiority for either side will shatter the balance, and the world in question will be returned to the void by a calamity beyond imagining.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_832: As the self-appointed custodian of this balance, my master warned me that the Source─the first of all worlds─slips perilously close to oblivion.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_833: In what spirit did this master proffer such a warning? A benevolent gesture? Or veiled threat?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_101_833: To these questions and more do I mean to coax forth answers. Yet no matter his intention, that Hydaelyn doth teeter on a knife's edge is an undeniable truth. Knowing this, what choice was given you to make?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_834: I chose to join my master, and act as his instrument on this star. The tragedy that befell my home cannot be repeated─I will see this world saved.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_835: ...And yet I hesitated at the most crucial of moments. What right have I to stand alongside a true Warrior of Light?
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_836: In thine own words thou wert called before thy time, and I offer that thou dwellest overmuch on the question of what maketh the hero. The search for the answer leaveth thee paralyzed by doubt.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_837: Heed me, Master Unukalhai: thou needest not believe thyself a hero to perform great deeds. 'Tis the deed itself which earneth thee the hero's mantle.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_838: Aye, the ideals you hold can be less important than having the faith to act upon them. Regula's loyalty to the Emperor guided his actions until the last, and though we did not see eye to eye on many things, his final deeds can be called naught less than heroic.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_839: Personally, I find that faith in my companions allows me to act unhindered by uncertainty.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_840: I know that should I ever falter,  and the others will be there to support me...or steer me back onto the right path if needed.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_842: In the days leading up to my world's destruction, I was entirely alone. I never knew what it was to have such comrades...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_KRILE_000_843: I cannot imagine the loneliness you must have felt. But look around you now, Unukalhai...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_848: ...Welcome to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_845: I will fulfill my promise to save this world. And when I stumble, I shall be glad to have your hands there to steady me.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_UNUKALHAI_000_847: My apologies. This is difficult for me. For so long have I spoken from behind a mask...
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_URIANGER_000_848: We should all feel comfortable speaking without such concealments.
TEXT_HEAVNY241_02394_YSHTOLA_000_849: I should hope you appreciate the irony of that statement, Urianger...
TEXT_HEAVNY242_02395_UNUKALHAI_000_000: Whilst we were examining the controls for Zurvan's shackles, I found a tomestone that may be of interest to you, . Would you like to take a look?
TEXT_HEAVNY242_02395_UNUKALHAI_000_001: The information contained within this device appears to have been used to generate a simulated battle of grueling difficulty.
TEXT_HEAVNY242_02395_UNUKALHAI_000_002: Challengers would be pit against a simulacrum of Zurvan, the power of which had been enhanced to the eikon's highest conceivable magnitude. It is described as the final trial for the most elite of Allag's warriors, intended to distinguish the truly exceptional among them.
TEXT_HEAVNY242_02395_UNUKALHAI_000_003: I have witnessed no champion more exceptional than the Warrior of Light. Are you not curious to see just how powerful Zurvan may have been? I urge you to visit the verification node, and undertake this ultimate test of the Allagan elite.
TEXT_HEAVNY242_02395_UNUKALHAI_000_010: If you would test your mettle against the Demon's unfettered might, then you need only present the tomestone to the verification node on the Azys Lla flagship.
TEXT_HEAVNY242_02395_VERIFICATIONSYSTEM_: <blip> Activating verification systems... Elimination trial request acknowledged. Awaiting tomestone data...
<blip> Data processed. Adversary: Warring Triad, Zurvan. Threat level: Extreme.
This is the final qualifying test for surviving elite squad enlistees. Participation is only permitted to candidates who agree to unrestricted biopsy procedures following the trial.
Specifically, enlistees who successfully complete the program will be certified as genetically superior, and must submit to cell harvesting for subsequent cloning initiatives.
Elimination trial survival rates are currently calculated at 1.9 percent.

<blip> Activating reality augmentation... Initiating elimination trial... The Empire thanks you for your service. Postmortem data will be used to improve the survival rates of subsequent candidates. Your sacrifice is appreciated.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_000: Well, I'll be damned! ! If this isn't fate, I don't know what is.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_010: <gasp> , thank the gods you're here! We need your help!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_011: In case you haven't heard, we've set up operations in Rhalgr's Reach, while we look for Omega.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_012: It's been decidedly slow going, I'm sorry to say, and we still haven't seen the blasted thing since it disappeared during the battle with Shinryu.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_013: ...Which is not to say we haven't made any progress. We know now that Shinryu ended up in the imperials' hands, and that it was shackled with some very distinctive-looking bindings when they found it.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_014: Obviously, only you-know-what could have done something like that, and the fact that the restraints were still functioning suggests it didn't shut down when the chief instructed it to either.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_015: Anyway, we were getting close to identifying Omega's whereabouts when we encountered...what you might call...a problem. Mayhap it would be best if you came to the workshop and saw for yourself.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_020: Go on! Suggest something! And I'll be sure to do the exact bloody opposite!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_025: Come now, Chief... That isn't terribly constructive.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_040: ...Surprised? Aye, so were we. He's been brought in as a “consultant,” believe it or not.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_041: How many times do I have to tell you!? You will play no part in this investigation!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_042: Your motives were dubious from the first, and nothing you have done since has served to make them any clearer.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_043: Out of necessity, I agreed to take part in Omega's activation, but that will be the extent of our cooperation!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_044: Passing judgment without due consideration, openly disparaging colleagues... Not very chiefly of you, Chief.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_045: I'll have you know I'm a sensitive new recruit who thrives on encouragement.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_046: Then I trust you'll thrive elsewhere when I encourage you to piss off!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_047: I will not have him on our roster, Jessie─never mind anywhere near our work. His employment is to be terminated, effective immediately!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_JESSIE_000_048: The thing is, Chief...we've already paid him in full. And it wasn't exactly a pittance, either. Four-fifths what you get was the agreement.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_JESSIE_000_049: Look, whatever disagreements you might've had in the past, the fact is, we could do with his expertise now. Let him earn his keep, at the very least.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_050: I don't believe this... You claim my wholly justified ventures represent an “unsustainable risk to the Ironworks”─and then pay him a sultan's ransom in advance!? Him!? Give me strength...!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_100_050: This has been the way of it for a while now... On account of which, we've had to put the investigation on hold...
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_A1_000_053: Let me know how it goes. I'm leaving.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_054: Tsk-tsk. As much as I admire your enthusiasm, hero, you will not get very far without some brains to complement your admirable brawn. Happily, I am blessed with a surfeit of the former.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_055: From this moment forth, you shall be my chaperone. With the realm's savior watching my every move, I couldn't possibly make any mischief─which should surely serve to allay my employer's concerns?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_056: Tsk-tsk. It is not like you to shirk your duties, hero. Were you not present at Omega's activation? And are you not therefore jointly responsible for the havoc it may wreak if left to its own devices? I think we both know the answer.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_057: From this moment forth, you shall be my chaperone. With the realm's savior watching my every move, I couldn't possibly make any mischief─which should surely serve to allay my employer's concerns?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_058: Forgive me, . It was not my intent to embroil you in this mess. I didn't even know you were here. Seeing as you are, though...I cannot deny that I would be glad to have you on board.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_059: The fact is, we are no closer to understanding the true extent of Omega's powers, and even if it was damaged during its encounter with Shinryu, it seems highly doubtful that we will be able to disable it unaided.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_060: We have got as far as identifying its likely resting place, but I for one would feel a lot more confident about surveying the area with you around to deal with any unexpected surprises. Might I persuade you to lend us a hand once more, old friend?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_STAFF02928_000_062: Ch-Chief, we have a problem! The aetheric concentration levels at the Yawn are soaring. Our readings doubled from one moment to the next, and by the time we went to check them, they'd doubled again!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_063: What? But that could only mean─
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_064: Evacuate the site. I shall handle this matter personally.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_065: Biggs, Wedge, ─I need you with me at the Yawn, to the south of here. That's where we believe Omega came to rest.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_066: Jessie─hold the fort while I'm gone. And, if possible, continue surveillance from a safe distance.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_JESSIE_000_067: All right, Chief. Watch yourself out there.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_068: ...Am I to stay and mind the shop too?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_069: Oh no. I'm not letting you out of my sight. But before you fill the room with maniacal laughter, I want you to remember something: when you collected your inexplicably lavish fee, the Ironworks' creed became your creed. That's “Freedom through Technology,” in case you've forgotten─not “Supremacy through Allagan Ingenuity.” Breach this contract and I will have my ponze of flesh.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_JESSIE_000_070: I'll take care of things here. Look after everyone for me, all right? I need the boys back and innovating before our customers tire of our current offerings.
