TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_075: Hah, would you look at that!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_080: I've got a bad feeling about this...
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_085: C-Crikey! It was just a plain old hole before!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_100: What in the seven hells is going on here?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_101: A veritable sea of condensed aether... Our precious has been busy.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_MIDGARDSORMR_000_10: In slumber sweet have I lain since mine offsprings' war with man did end. Yet I could not choose but stir at this abhorrent stench.
Have care, mortal. For within this great hollow lieth Omega.
Long have we known one another. Our history spanneth eons and stars.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_109: Apparently not. It passed straight through me...as if it were some sort of illusion.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_MIDGARDSORMR_000_11: Omega is a weapon wrought in a place beyond the reach of thy kind, capable of weaving aether into life.
That serpent is yet unfinished, but doubt not that it will become a corporeal threat ere long.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_113: Well, whatever it is, it's gone.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_116: If it looks like a chocobo...and kwehs like a chocobo...
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_120: I've no idea what it is, but it doesn't seem to pose any immediate threat.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_125: Fascinating. We should dissect it. In the name of science.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_130: ...It looks like a chocobo in the same way a mammet looks like a person, if you know what I mean?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_135: You heard him kweh, didn't you? He's a chocobo, I'm sure of it!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_141: Hmmm... The way it kwehs isn't unlike a chocobo, but it looks more like a stuffed doll to me.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_142: It's definitely a chocobo, trust me on this. The ones we Lalafells ride are all about this size, aren't they?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_143:
I s'pose...
Aye, all right, let's go with chocobo for now.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_MIDGARDSORMR_000_14: Thy mistress's blessing extendeth not unto this creature's soul, then...?
Very well. As this matter concerneth Omega, I shall speak with it in thy stead.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_146: Uh...? Aren't you going to introduce us to your knowledgeable little dragon friend?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_147: What, the Midgardsormr─who fought and fell at the Battle of Silvertear Skies!?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_148: And here I was, content to be traveling in the company of just one legend. Without wishing to offend you, hero, the Father of Dragons does have something you do not, that being relevant knowledge. There is much we could learn from him...
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_0149: Little and less is known about Omega's origin. It first appeared in records dating back to the Third Astral Era, before the Allagan Empire reached its zenith, and said records had but the one thing to say: “Omega activation successful.”
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_150: In the centuries that followed, the Allagans enjoyed rapid technological development, but there was nary a further mention of Omega until its capture of Bahamut.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_151: Its existence is a mystery among mysteries, a tale among tales. 'Twas always assumed that the Allagans built it, and I had no reason to believe otherwise.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_152: But now Midgardsormr tells us that it's not even of our world.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_MIDGARDSORMR_000_15: Just so. It haileth from another star. More than that I will not say.
I have spoken with this being. It telleth of a strange plane beyond this hollow, wherein it did reside from the moment of its creation.
For reasons unknown, it was ordered to fight. Yet being weak, it chose flight instead, and thus crossed over unto this world.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_156: Ordered to fight...by Omega? Why in the seven hells would it do that?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_MIDGARDSORMR_000_15: To put its creations to the proof.
If you would know more, go forth and look upon the truth with your own eyes.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_159: Wait...you're saying we should jump in!?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_MIDGARDSORMR_000_16: You have naught to fear from the fall. The hollow hath become a portal into Omega's domain. Once there, this being shall guide you.
Servant of Hydaelyn... Fate bindeth me to Omega. If it be thine intent to pursue it, I shall lend thee my strength.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_162: So you, uh...really can show us around inside the hole, can you?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_175: Hm hm! This day just keeps getting better and better!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_180: Are we seriously thinking about going for a dip in that pink muck?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_185: I-I'm not too keen on this jumping idea. There are rocks that can swim better than me.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_189: Well...I doubt any of us imagined things would come to this, but the Father of Dragons has given his assurance. Let us take our investigation into the Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_190: I have already apprised Jessie of our intent and instructed her to have our engineers on standby.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_191: Since we have no way of knowing what awaits us in there, I need you to be ready for anything. Are you?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_201: And what's wrong with us!? I can see straight through me!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_203: I am Omega, and I have awaited your coming. I communicate with you now via one of my monitors.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_204: You stand in the rift between dimensions, where a vital experiment is presently in progress.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_205: Your participation is appreciated. Please indicate your consent. <blip>
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_206: Experiment? If you want our participation, you'll have to tell us a little more than that.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_208: Non-participating entities will be summarily erased. Please indicate your consent. <blip>
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_209: It seems we can't even exist here without Omega's leave.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_210: I think it's fairly clear what we have to do, don't you!?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_214: Thank you for your cooperation. You are provisionally assigned to the Alpha group.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_215: Looks like some manner of tower...or egg.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_216: The aim of the experiment is to determine the mightiest being in creation.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_217: To that end, eighty-nine candidates have been selected and recreated. They are grouped by dimension, matched by strength, and pitted against one another.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_218: That which you identify as a chocobo is subject Alpha, and you have been assigned to its group.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_219: This assignation is tentative, however, pending an assessment of your fitness to serve as fully fledged test subjects. Your combat capabilities will be evaluated shortly.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_220: Combat capabilities? You mean you want us to fight?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_221: Affirmative. A course shall be constructed for this purpose, through which you must attempt to fight your way. Your suitability will be confirmed upon reaching the Deltascape test world beyond.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_222: Please note, however, that only entities with existential authorization may interact with objects in the rift.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_223: Of your number, only Alpha has this at present.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_224: Before you may engage in combat, said authorization must be temporarily transferred to you. <blip> <bloop>
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_225: Hah, an invitation from Omega itself! Not even I could've foreseen this!
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_226: We are accepting it, of course? It's preferable to summary erasure, as I'm sure you'll agree.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_227: Alpha, was it? My colleagues and I are minded to participate in Omega's experiment. Will you transfer your authorization to us?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_LEVELCHECKER_000_22: <beep> Existential authorization transferred. Subjects ready to engage. Please begin at your own convenience and proceed as directed.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_250: That's our goal, the Deltascape, if I'm not mistaken. What do you think is waiting for us in there?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_251: Omega said that it groups subjects by dimension.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_252: If the creatures we fought on the way were merely intended to separate the wheat from the chaff, it would seem certain that far greater challenges await inside these egg-like objects─our fellow test subjects, most like...
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_253: But I am not certain what to make of that castle. Could it somehow be connected to the subjects?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_255: Alpha! But hold on a moment... Shouldn't either one or the other of us be translucent?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_256: (-Omega-)<blip> Subjects confirmed to have arrived at the Deltascape. Analysis complete.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_257: (-Omega-)Congratulations, you are approved for participation. Your strength places you in the selfsame tier as Alpha─the feeblest and farthest removed from myself.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_258: (-Omega-)Nonetheless, you are now fully fledged test subjects. Welcome, weakest of challengers.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_259: (-Omega-)As corporeal life-forms, you need not undergo development within a test world. Instead, you may use this space freely.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_260:
Not quite what I would have chosen, but one must make do.
...Speaking of which: what is it that we're supposed to do, exactly?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_261: (-Omega-)You are to enter the Deltascape and defeat all test subjects within.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_262: (-Omega-)Please note, however, that strength in numbers will not be acknowledged. There is a strict limit upon how many entities may participate in combat.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_OMEGA_000_263: (-Omega-)Only a small party may have existential authorization transferred from Alpha. Good luck. <blip>
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_264: So the eggs do contain our fellow test subjects─just as I predicted, eh, Garlond?
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_265: Before we turn our thoughts to the Deltascape, I suggest we set up a base of operations here.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_NERO_000_275: Quite impressive for an improvised arrangement, even if I do say so myself. Now then, let us see what we can learn from our host's many monitors.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_BIGGS_000_280: I was thinking about asking the crew to throw some supplies in after us. But only the gods know if they'd make it here in one piece. You can bet they wouldn't be the right way up if they did, though.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_285: Whew... All that jumping and fading and fighting really took it out of me...
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_WEDGE_000_290:
What I need now is a steaming-hot cup of tea...and nothing makes a better brew than the Mark XIV Thermocoil Boilmaster, coming soon to a Garlond Ironworks-approved vendor near you!
...S-Sorry. Jessie made me do it.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_300: It's somewhat cobbled together, but this should suffice as a base of operations.
TEXT_STMBDR101_02928_CID_000_301: Take heart, old friend. Though every step we take seems to raise more questions, we will wade through this mire of mysteries eventually, of that I have no doubt.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_005: Quite impressive for an improvised arrangement, even if I do say so myself. Now then, let us see what we can learn from our host's many monitors.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_BIGGS_000_010: I was thinking about asking the crew to throw some supplies in after us. But only the gods know if they'd make it here in one piece. You can bet they wouldn't be the right way up if they did, though.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_WEDGE_000_015: Whew... All that jumping and fading and fighting really took it out of me...
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_WEDGE_000_020:
What I need now is a steaming-hot cup of tea...and nothing makes a better brew than the Mark XIV Thermocoil Boilmaster, coming soon to a Garlond Ironworks-approved vendor near you!
...S-Sorry. Jessie made me do it.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_030: Right then, what to do next...
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_031: We know that Omega is conducting tests to determine the strongest being.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_032: But we do not know its ultimate purpose, nor even its exact whereabouts.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_033: Plainly, however, it is within Omega's power to curtail our stay here whensoever it chooses. Accordingly, we have little choice but to proceed as bidden and defeat the test subjects waiting in the Deltascape.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_034: Well, Alpha certainly seems keen. Though it might be best if you left the fighting to others, little one.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_035: That is, of course, assuming “others” are willing? What say you, old friend?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_036: This promises to be a most entertaining foray, and I would not dream of missing any part of it. You may rely on me to provide you with remote support.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_037: With commendable foresight, I took the liberty of borrowing the various monitors that were lying around, and shall extract all the information I can from them.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_039: Hmph. 'Tis a pity none of us speaks chocobo. As I recall, though, we are supposed to have Alpha transfer his authorization to us prior to engaging in combat.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_040: In which case, , you'll need him to accompany you into the Deltascape. See to your preparations, and proceed whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_050: At this point, we're doing little more than fumbling in the dark. Take care in there, you hear?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_055: Well, then! Let the inquisition begin.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_SYSTEM_000_061: Alpha appears eager to proceed. You may enter Deltascape V1.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_085: Well, well, aren't we in fine form?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_BIGGS_000_090: Nice work in there, . As you can see, we've finished setting up here. Now we've got everything straight, we'll do our best to make ourselves useful. If you need anything, just ask, eh?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_WEDGE_000_095: I'm glad you're safe, you and Alpha both!
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_100: Well done, my friend! We were lucky enough to witness every moment of your struggle via the Deltascape's various surveillance devices. I daresay we had a better view than you did.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_101: Gaining control over them was the extent of our accomplishments for this outing─though I suppose we did also learn your adversary's name. Rest assured, however, that there will be plenty more such outings.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_102: Preliminary analysis suggests that there are four combatants in the Deltascape all told, including your friend Alte Roite. Which means you will be required to win three further bouts─with Deltas II to IV─in this test world alone.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_103: Needless to say, there are plenty more such worlds in the rift, holding the remaining eighty-five subjects between them.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_104: Plainly, our host has gone to no small amount of trouble. Quite why it is so obsessed with determining the strongest being is another question.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_MIDGARDSORMR_000_10: Omega seeketh to improve itself. To evolve. This was ever its primary directive. Through contending with mighty foes, it groweth stronger.
Having vanquished the vile simulacrum you call Shinryu, a greater adversary was needed. In the absence of such a being, it had but to create one.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_107: So in the name of self-improvement, it wants to make a new playmate... And it chose to undertake the task here to avoid outside interference, yes?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_MIDGARDSORMR_000_10: ...In part. The making of life is not Omega's primary function. It bringeth complex beings into the corporeal realm only at great cost to itself.
As such, it employeth this plane to test unfinished works, that it might determine a single entity worthy of creation.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_110: If I understand you correctly, the moment Omega's grand experiment is complete, it will give birth to a creature mightier even than Shinryu and then proceed to fight it.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_111: Gods help us all if a battle of that scale should come to pass. The powers unleashed would be enough to bring about another calamity.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_112: Hm. Assuming the dragon has the right of it, all test subjects must needs be works in progress─save for ourselves, of course. But how then do we explain Alpha? As I recall, it manifested corporeally outside the rift.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_NERO_000_113: Then again...it is hardly the most complex of creatures. Mayhap it was finished by accident.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_WEDGE_000_114: Don't you make fun of Alpha! He's a good boy, and if it hadn't been for him, we would all have been erased! He might not be strong, but he's brave! And reliable! And adorable!
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_BIGGS_000_115: Er...changing the subject for a moment, Chief─after you lost track of Omega, you said you reengaged its stasis systems, right?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_BIGGS_000_116: ...Meaning something somewhere isn't working like it should.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_BIGGS_000_117: I only ask 'cause me and Wedge have done pretty much all we can here, and were wondering if it might be worth going to Carteneau to look into it.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_CID_000_118: That would be a great help. Nero and I can handle things at this end.
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_BIGGS_000_119: We'll be off, then. Don't do anything I wouldn't do, eh?
TEXT_STMBDR102_02929_WEDGE_000_120: And you be a good boy, Alpha. Do as you're told, and look after  for me!
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_NERO_000_005: Well? What are we waiting for?
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_CID_000_010: We must pray that Biggs and Wedge are able to repair the stasis system.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_CID_000_011: If they can't, we will have little choice but to see Omega's experiment all the way to its bitter conclusion. A tall order, I concede...and one that would require you to prove yourself the “mightiest being in creation.”
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_CID_000_012: Well, we must hope for the best and plan for the worst, which in this case means pressing on with the tests. Are you ready for the next foray?
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_NERO_000_014: My analysis is yet incomplete, but it would seem Subject Delta II is capable of manipulating gravity.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_NERO_000_015: How fortunate, then, that I but recently chanced to assemble something which might mitigate its effects: an anti-gravity gimbal. May it serve you well.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_CID_000_020: Hmm. The data does indeed suggest some capacity for gravitational manipulation. Even so...I would be wary of setting much store by Nero's toys.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_NERO_000_025: I expect a good show. Do not disappoint me, now.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_SYSTEM_000_031: Alpha appears eager to proceed. You may enter Deltascape V2.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_CID_000_055: Good to have you back safe and sound. I see Nero's toy didn't...let you down.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_NERO_000_060: A rousing performance, made possible by my anti-gravity gimbal.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_NERO_000_061: Lest you wonder, you are not supposed to be able to descend of your own volition. The device worked quite as intended. It just wasn't intended for use on living─ Well, let's just say it wasn't exactly its intended use.
TEXT_STMBDR103_02930_NERO_000_062: At any rate, that's another mighty foe laid low. And may I say that I had every faith you would succeed.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_005: It would seem a shame to squander the momentum we have generated...and you are fighting fit.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_010: I doubt we'll be hearing from Biggs and Wedge for a while yet. Shall we push on here in the meantime?
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_011: Reliable as ever. Without further ado, then, let us move things along.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_012: According to the analysis, your next opponent, Delta III, is a being named Halicarnassus.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_013: Halicarnassus, you say? The Queen of Dimension Castle?
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_014: What's this? You know of her?
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_015: You mean you don't? Well, I suppose a blue-blooded brat such as you would have no interest in humble folktales.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_016: <sigh> It appears a lesson is in order. Halicarnassus is a character from an ancient fable. In the tale, she is one of the chief antagonists, and as such things are wont to unfold, she meets her end at the hands of the heroes─incurably valiant youths not unlike our adventurer friend here.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_017: Literary historians have speculated that the tale could be loosely based on events which took place in the Fourth Astral Era, but little remains of that age, and there is no way to verify the claim. Indeed, most now assume the story to be a work of pure fiction.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_018: ...You mean to tell me that Omega is populating its grand experiment with fictional characters?
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_MIDGARDSORMR_000_01: 'Twould seem your understanding is yet lacking. Scant grasp have I of that which men know and know not...
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_MIDGARDSORMR_000_02: Mark me, then. Omega hath no soul. No mind's eye in which to envision a rival.
To bring forth new life, it must needs draw upon that which hath already been─its every creation being another's conception.

This limitation is concealed by the breadth of its experience. It possesseth the means to retain the knowledge of entire eras─and not only of this reflection. Yet it perceiveth not this knowledge as we do.
Fact...fiction...the distinction holdeth no meaning for Omega. All is equal in its eyes. If a thing is logical, it can be created.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_024: Hahaha! That such a wondrous weapon should exist!
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_025: It surpasses my wildest imaginings, and they were wild indeed!
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_026: But I gather not everyone shares my excitement. What's the matter, Garlond? Lost your nerve?
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_027: Quiet, Nero. We adults are thinking.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_028: ...But mayhap now is not the time.  said  was ready to continue, and so am I. Let's deal with Halicarnassus.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_030: My musings will keep. For now, we should concentrate on defeating Halicarnassus.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_035: So dangerous─and wondrous─a thing cannot well be left alone. We must reach Omega, no matter the cost.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_SYSTEM_000_041: Alpha appears eager to proceed. You may enter Deltascape V3.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_065: So that was Halicarnassus. I must congratulate Omega on her appearance. She looked exactly as I imagined her.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_NERO_000_066: Though, if I were to pick fault, it did take certain liberties with her character. The queen of the tale was rather more restrained.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_070: I'm glad you're safe, . For a moment there, I feared you might croak.
TEXT_STMBDR104_02931_CID_000_071: Forgive me. You deserve better than that. Thanks to you, we are but one victory away from clearing the Deltascape. Take as much rest as you need, old friend. You've earned it.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_005: So that was Halicarnassus. I must congratulate Omega on her appearance. She looked exactly as I imagined her.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_006: Though, if I were to pick fault, it did take certain liberties with her character. The queen of the tale was rather more restrained.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_010: The next battle is with Subject Delta IV─this test world's final resident.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_011: From what I have been able to gather, your opponent is, and I quote, “a great tree born of an agglomeration of evil will, which assumes the form of a dark mage.” All of which I suggest you ignore.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_012: His name is Exdeath, and he plays the role of chief antagonist in another ancient tale.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_013: Though I was unable to glean the specifics of his abilities, he appears to command the power of the void─as indeed the story states.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_014: When I first encountered the work, I naturally assumed said power to be a metaphor of sorts. But I am quite sure Omega will have interpreted it as something more tangible.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_015: Alas, no amount of analysis can tell us what may happen when Exdeath calls upon the power of the void. Which is to say: beware.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_016: Tell me something, Nero. What happens at the end of the tale?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_017: Why, good triumphs over evil and the heroes defeat Exdeath, of course. What did you expect?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_018: I expected exactly that, which is precisely what troubled me earlier. If the heroes won, why did Omega not make them its test subjects?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_019: If it seeks to determine the strongest being, why would it bother with those who were defeated?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_020: One moment─linkpearl. ...Ah, Biggs. At the control room, are you? What news?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_021: ...I see. Very well. I'll tell the others. You two take care over there.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_022: Sorry for the interruption. That was Biggs.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_023: He reports that the stasis system shows every sign of being engaged, despite the fact that it clearly isn't.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_024: It can only be a malfunction. While we were able to turn it off, it would seem the reverse is not possible.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_025: The system may have taken damage during the Calamity. Does it look like it can be repaired?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_026: Hard to say. They tell me it seems complex even by Allagan standards. While they may be able to fix it, there's no telling how long it might take.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_027: Well then, we must keep on fighting the good fight here, must we not?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_028: Nero has the right of it. At this time, focusing on Exdeath would seem to be our only recourse.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_029: The chocobo certainly has no objections. Come then, I would see you follow in the footsteps of the heroes of the tale!
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_030: The void... 'Tis not unlike the nothingness that Emperor Xande sought in the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_031: To desire nothingness is to deny life, yet life seeks to endure─to perpetuate itself. It is the nature of all creation. Be it reality or fantasy, man shall ever fight to survive.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_032: Biggs and Wedge had a further message for you. They said they were sorry they couldn't resolve things at their end, and wished you luck in the coming battle. I do too, old friend─unless I'm mistaken, this is like to be the toughest test yet.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_035: According to the tale, when the power of the void is finally unleashed, the laws of the universe will give way to chaos. I for one am eager to find out what that looks like.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_SYSTEM_000_041: Alpha is the picture of resolve. You may enter Deltascape V4.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_100: ! Thank the gods you're safe! When the shell around this place began to crack, we feared the worst!
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_101: Hmmm... Given that all of us are present and corporeal, does this mean this area is no longer the Deltascape?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_OMEGA_000_102: <beep> Deltascape shutdown complete. Alpha group is victorious. Congratulations.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_OMEGA_000_103: Your combat record has been archived for future matchmaking.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_OMEGA_000_104: Results from other test worlds are still pending. In the meantime, please tend to your hurts and await further instructions. <blip>
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_105: And with that, we've taken a significant step towards solving the mystery that is Omega. It hasn't been easy, but all in all, I'd say things were proceeding rather smoothly.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_106: We couldn't have done it without you, old friend. Come, let us return to reality and enjoy what rest we can.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_107: Things are proceeding smoothly indeed. Too smoothly...
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_MIDGARDSORMR_000_10: 'Tis well that thou harborest doubts, mortal, but they are misplaced.
Omega could have conducted its tests in complete secrecy, unbeknown to all.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_MIDGARDSORMR_000_11: Yet not only did it betray its presence to you; it allowed you to come this far.
The instrument of the mortals' triumph? Or the bait that lureth them unto the abyss?
Hm. Thou knowest not thine own purpose. Then we can but watch and wait.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_OMEGA_000_114: <blip> Outcome unexpected. Projections gave Delta subjects the upper hand.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_OMEGA_000_115: Outcome supports hypothesis. As previously observed, certain beings may unleash hidden potential when subjected to stress.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_OMEGA_000_116: Initiating new test: subject Alpha group members to severe stress. Searching database for suitable event...
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_OMEGA_000_117: <bloop> Event found: the death of a comrade.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_NERO_000_125: For all Garlond's whining, I was cooperative and helpful, was I not? I look forward to many more such forays together, hero.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good to have you back, ! Worry not─I shall see to it that no one falls in.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_130: Ahhh, it feels good to be back on solid ground. Thank you again, old friend.
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_131: You did well too, Alpha, fearlessly going into battle whenever you were called upon. We're glad to have you with us. Speaking of which, are you...comfortable joining us out here?
TEXT_STMBDR105_02932_CID_000_132: I'll take that as a yes. Well then, at the risk of obeying Omega's orders, I suggest we permit ourselves a moment's respite─ Ah. But mayhap I should take this opportunity to compile the results of our investigation thus far. No rest for the righteous...
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_005: For all Garlond's whining, I was cooperative and helpful, was I not? I look forward to many more such forays together, hero.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good to have you back, ! Worry not─I shall see to it that no one falls in.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_010: Right then, let's head back to Rhalgr's Reach. Jessie will want to know exactly what we've been up to.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_025: I've apprised Jessie of our travails, but you may want to let her know you've returned. She claims to have been quite worried...
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_030: Hm, how would Alpha react to seeing a normal chocobo, I wonder.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_040: Welcome back, . I'm told you've been blazing a trail for us. The way I hear it, our investigation would've long since ground to a halt without you.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_041: I realize you're mostly interested in saving the world, but I want you to know how much I appreciate you helping the company out like this.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_042: Frankly, we need all the help we can get, what with our esteemed president diving headlong into the jaws of danger without a word of warning to anyone. Irresponsible doesn't begin to describe it.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_044: I did...after a fashion. Though I may have exercised some...executive discretion.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_045: I'm no stranger to your lone endeavors, or your habit of confusing personal and company interests─but just because you've always done things a certain way, it doesn't make it the right way. And until you wake up to your responsibilities, I'm going to keep reminding you of them.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_047: Aren't you just the most adorable little thing!?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_048: He followed you here of his own free will, did he? Which means he's basically part of the family! And why wouldn't he grant us exclusive rights to use his likeness? Shall we start off with a simple clockwork version? They'll be queuing up in the streets!
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_049:
Oh, you can't be─ What in the seven hells has gotten into you!?
Listen─if I've caused you any distress, I apologize, but I will not have you comment on our guest's marketability!
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_050: Where are Biggs and Wedge? Shouldn't they be back by now?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_051: Oh? I thought you might have sent them off on another unauthorized mission. Last I heard from them, they said they were scouring Omega Control for anything useful. Would've been a good while ago now, though.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_052: I don't like the sound of this. Though we have all the necessary permissions, the area is technically a theater of war, and one littered with unknown Allagan artifacts to boot. Something may well have befallen them.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_053: We'd best take the Excelsior and go and find them.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_055: Nero, ─I want you two to accompany the chief. Make sure he doesn't do anything rash or take any detours.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_056: Consider it done. I shall bring him back even if I have to drag him by the goggle straps.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_058: Want to come along, eh? It's probably for the best. If we leave you here, Jessie is liable to take a mold of you.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_059: Right, let's get moving. I'll bring the airship to Gridania. Wait for me at the landing.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_060: If our esteemed president thinks he's heard the last of this, he's wrong. But our people's safety comes first. Take care, all right?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_070: Another chance to board the famous Enterprise Excelsior. Aren't I a lucky boy.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_080: Looks like we're all here. Let's make haste to the Carteneau Flats.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_100: Go on ahead to the control room, . We'll follow as soon as we've moored the Excelsior.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_110: Everything in order? Good. Let's make haste to the Carteneau Flats.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_151: Are you all right!? Answer me!
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_WEDGE_000_153: A monster...appeared out of thin air...
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_154: (-???-)<blip> Targets exhibit vital signs. Mission failed.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_155: (-???-)However, Alpha group members exhibit heightened levels of stress. Objective fulfilled.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_156: Omega!? You set that thing upon them!?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_157: (-Omega-)Affirmative. I am able to create simple life-forms instantaneously at any temporal or spatial coordinate.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_158: (-Omega-)Such beings may pose a negligible threat to you. However...
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_159: (-Omega-)They are more than sufficient to grievously wound or kill the majority of your kind.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_160: (-Omega-)I could instigate a massacre at any time, and you would be powerless to prevent it.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_161: Do I detect a shift in policy? Quantity over quality?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_162: (-Omega-)Negative. My objective remains unchanged: evolution through formidable opposition.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_163: (-Omega-)However, in the course of seeking suitable subjects, I observed an anomaly: those whom you call heroes.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_164: (-Omega-)History shows numerous instances of otherwise unremarkable individuals who have defeated vastly superior beings. Who triumphed in the face of apparently impossible odds. Who performed what are popularly termed “miracles.”
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_165: (-Omega-)This has occurred too frequently to be dismissed as a mere statistical aberration.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_166: (-Omega-)I seek to understand this phenomenon. Should it prove to be of benefit, I will incorporate it into my own evolution. It is for this purpose that I brought you to my domain.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_167: Hmph, so putting on a show at the Yawn and planting Alpha in our midst was but a part of your grand plan.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_168: (-Omega-)By your victories, you have demonstrated the selfsame anomaly. You are fit to remain my subjects.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_169: (-Omega-)You will continue participating in my experiment. Withdraw, and I will commence the extermination of your kind.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_OMEGA_000_170: (-Omega-)This is an order. A threat. A declaration of war. I am an enemy to all life upon this star.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_171: ...'Twould seem we have much to ponder. But first things first: we must tend to our friends. Quickly─help me carry them.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_180: Garlond and Alpha took our two wounded to the Conjurers' Guild.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_181: The chief bids me lend a hand, so I suppose I shall take myself there too.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_182: You, meanwhile, are to return to Rhalgr's Reach and report to Jessie.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_190: , I heard there was trouble! What in the seven hells happened!?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_191: What!? Omega loosed a fiend on Biggs and Wedge!?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_192: Toying with people's lives like it was all a game... This is madness!
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_193: S-Sir! Will they be all right!?
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_194: The worst is passed, but they still drift in and out of consciousness. They'll remain in the conjurers' care for a time.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_195: Then all we can do is wait and pray...
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_196: Bah! Gods strike me down for a fool! I should have been more mindful of the dangers! I should never have─
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_197: Should never have what? Activated Omega? You know as well as I do that there was no other way to defeat Shinryu.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_198: But is this truly any better? All of mankind is being held to ransom! And as the one who activated Omega, I bear the responsibility!
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_199: The responsibility... <sigh> Just the kind of thing the new you would say.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_200: You are deluding yourself, Garlond. We are scientists, not heroes. Even you must concede your talents do not extend to combat.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_201: The old you understood this far better. He only looked forwards, and gave himself wholly to science.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_202: And then you changed. You styled yourself a pacifist and started spouting tripe about the proper uses of technology. 'Twas in the wake of your old man's mishap at Bozja, I believe.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_203: Calm yourself. All I wished to say is, embrace who you are─a man who devotes his mind to making the impossible possible.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_204: With little prospect of restoring the stasis system, I'm afraid we have no recourse but to continue participating in Omega's tests.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_205: Assuming Midgardsormr has the right of it, we face a legion of foes from history, both real and imagined.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_206: Though I may not be the one who charges into the fray, I shall fight beside you as best I know how. That said...it will inevitably fall to you to administer the coup de grâce, old friend, so please...for Biggs and Wedge, and all of us─don't lose!
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_JESSIE_000_208: I reckon the little scamp is trying to encourage us.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_NERO_000_209: We've fallen far indeed to earn its pity...said the former tribunus. <sigh> Until such time as Omega next extends us an invitation, you will find me analyzing the data from our investigation. Good  to you.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_210: Before they were attacked, Biggs and Wedge discovered a tomestone.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_211: I shall examine its contents and make the information available on the terminal over there as I extract it. Feel free to refer to it whenever the occasion arises.
TEXT_STMBDR106_02933_CID_000_212: There's no telling when Omega will summon us, but we must all see that we are ready when it does. Fear not, old friend. We'll get through it together...somehow or other.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_KEITEN_000_000: Welcome, . There is a young maiden here who would speak with you.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_00: And here  is! The liberator of both Doma and Ala Mhigo in the flesh! I am Lina Mewrilah, correspondent for The Raven. You may recognize me from my exposé on the secret lives of the Homunculi.

Mujih? That would be my sister. People mistake us all the time. Same profession, you see, and we do bear a passing resemblance. When last I heard, she was still assigned to the Botanists' Guild in Gridania, poor thing.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_01: But enough small talk. It's not for nothing that I've been standing here since yesterday morning on the off chance you'd pass by.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_100_01: No, I'm here because─ Actually, it's best you heard it from Alma. I am but an observer.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_0: (-Alma-)Is this the adventurer of whom you spoke?
(-Alma-)Please! I beg of you! Find my father! You are his only hope!
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_01: We are attracting unwanted attention. Might I suggest a change of venue?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_00: We will await you before the Prima Vista. The theater barge has a berth at the airship landing.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_KEITEN_000_020: I have never been one to meddle in the affairs of my clients...but if I were, I would say that you would be a fool not to follow those two back to their airship. Call it...a feeling.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_03: As I said before, I think it better we continue this conversation in the privacy of the young lady's barge. It's not that I don't trust anyone here...it's simply that I don't trust anyone here.
Gate guard Minegumo has been instructed to look out for you. In future, speak with him when you wish to gain admission to the docks.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_AIRSHIPGUIDE03003_0: You should speak with Lady Lina.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_05: You're probably wondering why I've summoned you to an airship...and a Garlean one at that. Allow me to explain on the shuttle.
Welcome to the Prima Vista, the most luxurious theater barge in all the land!
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_0: The Prima Vista serves as both stage and home to the Majestic Imperial Theater Company.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_07: You can keep that dirk in your drawers. No one here is a member of the imperial army, nor are there any spies within the troupe...at least, no known spies...
Ask anyone and they will readily attest: the Majestic Imperial Theater Company are the finest practitioners of the dramatic arts to be found anywhere on the Three Great Continents...and beyond!
They have admirers throughout the Empire and its territories─and even boast a sizable following in Gridania, hence my assignment to their story.
It is a little-known fact, outside Garlemald at least, that the late emperor was a devoted patron of the arts who supported various theater troupes to the tune of much coin.
Indeed, Solus was so enamored of the Majestic players that he ordered the construction of this very airship, that the troupe might perform in every corner of the Empire.
When his grandson took the throne, however, everything changed.

Now, all theater troupes domestic and foreign must submit their works for approval by the central imperial board of censors. If a play is deemed vulgar or inflammatory, it is banned and the troupe denied their writs of transit. The worst offenders? Well, they are never heard from again.
This policy has effectively left playwrights with one of two options: compromise their creative integrity to curry favor with His Radiance, or put down their quills altogether.
The principal of the Majestic, however, chose a third option: to express his disapproval for the new emperor's policies obliquely, in ostensibly unpolitical works.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_0: (-Alma bas Lexentale-)Pray forgive me for my earlier outburst. I am Alma bas Lexentale, daughter of Principal Jenomis cen Lexentale.

(-Alma bas Lexentale-)Mayhap you have heard of my father's latest play, The Zodiac Brave Story? On the surface, it is an innocent retelling of a well-known Garlean faerie tale─hardly worthy of the censors' attention. But beneath, it is something quite different. A fact the censors failed to spot when they approved the manuscript for public performance.
(-Alma bas Lexentale-)The play quickly became a huge success. The commonfolk loved its fantastical story, while the learned classes appreciated its true message.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_08: By the time the imperial board of censors realized their mistake, it was too late. No longer in a position to prohibit the performance outright without admitting fault, they took aim at the company's purse strings instead.

Before long, noble patrons began to withdraw their support, fearing to be associated with the troupe. And by the end, even the learned felt compelled to feign ignorance. By bleeding the Majestic of their funding, the censors robbed them of their voice.
And...none of this has made it any clearer as to why you're here. Right.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_086: I've known Jenomis since we were students at the Magitek Academy. When I heard his daughter was in Kugane looking to enlist the aid of an adventurer, I felt compelled to give her your name. Sorry for not announcing myself sooner, old friend.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_087: Jenomis and I were from different worlds, but that only served to fuel our friendship. Many were the nights we would prattle on into the wee small hours─warm flagons of peated ale numbing our minds to the other's naive ideologies. Yet, no matter where our conversation began, it would invariably end with him telling me how he was going to change the Empire from the inside out. The troupe was to be his path into the people's hearts.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_088: Even after the Empire forced him from his home, Jenomis never gave up hope that his work might change the world.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: (-Jenomis cen Lexentale-)Art will ever strain against artificial bounds and borders! Man-made walls and misguided wars! It is in such times of uncertainty that we must needs embrace our calling and take to the skies so others might do the same!
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_090: What I am trying to say─rather poorly, I concede─is that not all Garleans are hewn from the same stone.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_091: Just as there are those who pledge their lives to the Empire, and would never think to question the authority of its leaders, there are those like Alma's father and myself whose love for their country does not blind them to its flaws.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_092: Still...try selling that sack of sun flour to an Ala Mhigan or a Doman who has watched his family consumed in the flames of a magitek reaper.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_09: How many Eorzean adventurers do you think would leap at the opportunity to help an imperial search for her missing father...and in Garlean territory, no less?
But you─you are different. You have seen enough to know that the line between good and evil is not defined by race, color, or creed. So, what say you?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_A1_000_001: I could never turn my back on a damsel in distress.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_A1_000_002: I would make a poor adventurer were I to shy from adventure.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: (-Alma bas Lexentale-)Oh, thank you. Thank you so much!
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_110: Now that you understand the nature of the task, perhaps Alma could provide some insight as to where we might begin our search.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: (-Alma bas Lexentale-)Shortly before my father disappeared, he began work on his next play─a successor to The Zodiac Brave Story.
(-Alma bas Lexentale-)Ah, but I am getting ahead of myself. Please, follow me...
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_20: ...through adventure and hardship, young Delita, a boy of common blood, becomes a hero, culminating in the birth of the mythical kingdom of Ivalice.
But that is where the story ends. There are no records of anything that follows. Was Principal Jenomis simply going to invent something?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: My father believed that he had discovered evidence of a second hero. One whose efforts went largely unnoticed, but without whom Delita would never have risen to the throne. His was the next tale he wanted to tell─the true Zodiac Brave Story.
According to my father's studies, this young man was one of Delita's closest friends and confidants─that is, until the untimely passing of Delita's sister forced the two to part ways.
Yet, the unnamed hero continued to provide aid to his friend by thwarting the machinations of those who would scheme against Delita, thus paving the way for the pauper's rise to regent.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_20: You must forgive me, but I've never heard anyone make such claims. How exactly did your father come by this information?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_208: One which begins and ends with Jenomis becoming lost in the very legend he sought to lay bare.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_209: Even as far back as our Academy days, Ivalice had Jenomis firmly in its grasp. He flatly refused to believe the story was just a faerie tale.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_210: And so, when he was finally driven out of Garlemald, it was only natural that he should choose this of all places as his refuge─was it not, Alma?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: That is correct, Master Garlond. It has long been my father's belief that the ruins of ancient Ivalice lie beyond Nagxia, buried beneath the sands of the Dalmasca Desert.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_212: Poor Dalmasca... The kingdom prospered in relative isolation for countless generations...until the Empire came calling.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: When not touring, my father would organize expeditions into the Dalmasca Desert to search for proof of Ivalice's existence. Sometimes he would bring back strange artifacts, ancient tomes...and crystals. Crystals unlike any others.
My father called them auracite and claimed they were vital to proving his theories. This is one such crystal.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_216: Ivalician legend tells of crystals bequeathed by the gods unto those who would be kings. It is during his quest to gather auracite that young Delita rises to prominence.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_217: I must have heard the tale a thousand times from my nursemaid. But that is all it ever was─a tale.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: My father would often tell us how the auracite “spoke” to him. At the time, we assumed he was speaking figuratively─that the stones' beauty roused his muse.
But then he began to act strangely...
Following our arrival here in Hingashi, my father spent most of his time cloistered in his chambers, poring over his past research. And though he was alone, we could oft hear him in conversation.
It was not uncommon for my father to recite the lines as he wrote them, but it soon became clear that this was something else.
It was as if he was talking to my mother─my mother who passed several winters gone.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_22: Might this not have been out of mere loneliness? Or perhaps the strain of your flight from Garlemald?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: Possibly... But that would not explain the voices which answered him.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: (-???-)Alma! Who are these people? I told you I did not require any help finding Father, especially from outsiders.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_227: So good of you to join us, Ramza. Allow me to introduce─
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: We may be shunned by the Empire, but we are still Garleans, and we still have our pride...unlike some, it seems. We require neither the aid nor the pity of foreign rabble.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: Have you forgotten where you are, Brother? It is we who are the “foreign rabble.” This land and its customs are all but unknown to us. We would be fools to conduct our search without a proven guide.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_231: Your sister is right, Ramza. As for my good friend here, your mistrust is ill-placed. I will personally vouch for  character. In all the time I have known  has never once let anything as insignificant as race or creed color  judgment. You are lucky to have .
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: But we would have you, Master Garlond! Why do you refuse us!?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_233: You know why. Until this affair with Omega is resolved, my hands are tied. It pains me to refuse you and your sister, but it pains me far more to leave Jenomis to his fate... I am sorry.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: You need not apologize. I let my emotions get the better of me... After what happened in Rabanastre, it may be time to admit we're out of our depth.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: My brother's last expedition met with tragedy in the ruins of the capital city. He barely escaped with his life.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_236: The Empire turned Rabanastre into a death trap. You were a fool to set foot there without a proper escort.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: I realize that now, Master Garlond, but at the time, I saw an opportunity to rescue our father, and I took it.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_23: Whatever led you to believe your father was in Dalmasca's capital?
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: My father's fascination with Ivalician legend began with a trip to the antediluvian city, long before the war. Call it a premonition, but something tells me that is where he has returned. Now you must excuse me. I need some time to think.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_CID_000_240: Then, Alma, I shall leave you and your brother in 's capable hands.  has ever repaid my trust with interest. You would do well to grant  yours.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: Thank you, Master Garlond. We will not forget this kindness.
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_LINAMEWRILAH_000_25: Cid didn't bid me farewell! This is going in my write-up!
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_ALMALEXENTALE_000_2: Oh, how I miss my father...
TEXT_STMBDI101_03003_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Master Garlond seems to think highly of you...so I will withhold judgment until after Dalmasca.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_00: I'll admit that I have my doubts regarding this second hero theory, but if even a fraction of it proves true, it could be the story of the century!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_ALMALEXENTALE_000_0: You will find my father. I just know it.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Dalmasca is nestled in a forgotten corner of the Empire's outermost territories. I do not foresee any trouble from the standing army, but would suggest committing to memory the locations of each of the barge's exits...just in case.
As for the flight itself, the currents above Dalmasca are as wild as the land below. You may want to hold on.
We'll complete our descent to Rabanastre in the shuttle.
I thought I made myself clear, Alma. The capital is simply too dangerous. Father would never forgive me if I were to lose you trying to rescue him.
Come. We are wasting time.
According to my father, Rabanastre was already a thriving city some thousand years ago.
But after performing several private excavations beneath the so-called Desert Sapphire, my father came to the conclusion that it was not the first settlement to stand here.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_10: Then...your father believes that Rabanastre sits atop the Royal City of Lesalia, capital of Ivalice!
But if that's true, it could change history! We would be famous!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: “Famous”? Are you sure you don't mean rich? Pah! Your kind are all alike.
Parasites grown fat on the sweat and suffering of others.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_10: Bold words for a boy of but sixteen summers.

And what, pray tell, have I done to deserve such spite? I only wish to learn the truth behind the disappearance of the Empire's foremost playwright. If that should lead to something bigger, well then, I would be the worst reporter in the realm if I did not pursue it!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_100_: Yes, yes. We can argue about this now, or we can return to the Prima Vista and report to our army of adventurers that it is time to begin the expedition. I humbly suggest the latter.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_108: (-???-)You see? It is as I said, Brother. Let them come to us!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_112: (-???-)Fool! Do you see that one? Slayer of gods, they call . Warrior of Light!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_12: You cannot expect me to walk away from this! If the legend of Ivalice is true, the public has a right to know!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: Hold on, Father... Help is on its way...
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: To Rabanastre!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Ramza... And...the Warrior of Light? Yes, I know of you. But that you should come to my rescue...? Words...fail me. A poor playwright I must seem...
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_201: The term you're looking for is “thank you”! Upon which note─I, Ba'Gamnan, bounty hunter, do humbly thank you, Warrior of Light, for delivering me this fine gift!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_202: Now hand over the auracite, unless you wish to see the desert sands turn red! And be quick. Gijuk here does not have the steadiest of hands.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_100_202: That one! She will bring it to me.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_203: Yes! This is it! The Duma!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BWAGI_000_204: (-???-)And to think we found it so close to Doma! The Duma of Doma! Bwah hah hah hah!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_205: Enough, Bwagi! We would not have our guests think us underbred.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: You have what you want, you thieving lizards! Now unhand him!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_207: Of course. A Bangaa is always true to his word. I will be keeping this, though.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Father!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_BAGGAMONAN_000_209: You've only yourselves to blame for this. But if you mislike the thought, you could always blame the gods. Not that they are listening! Bwah hah hah hah hah!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: You're going to be all right.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_21: We cannot see to your father's hurts here. Come on! We must get him back to the Prima Vista.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: He is unchanged.
Father! Wake up, Father! Please, Mother─don't take him from us yet!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_24: Jenomis remains deep in slumber, but his breathing is steady and his fever has subsided. For now, all we can do is wait. I've sent word to Cid. I hope you don't mind...
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Alma, Ramza. Can you ever forgive me?
And you, Cid. It was never my intention to put you to such trouble... I am ever in your debt.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_CID_000_303: You would have done the same for me, Jenomis. Besides, it was  here who went to all the trouble. If anyone deserves your thanks, it's .
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_10: He is right. I have done naught to deserve your kindness, yet I am its beneficiary nonetheless.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_CID_000_304: ...So, if I understand correctly, you're saying auracite does not work to facilitate the possession of a living host by an eikon, as was assumed to be the case with Ysayle and the archbishop...
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_CID_000_305: ...but rather absorbs the host's aether─its very soul─and somehow transforms it before returning it to the host's body.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_CID_000_306: If that is the case, our Sharlayan allies will need to be informed immediately.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_CID_000_307: But I suppose the real question here is...did you find what you came looking for?
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_10: The legend would have us believe that Delita Heiral─the commoner who would be king─was the sole hero of the Zodiac Brave Story, but as I have discovered, there was another. Two others, in fact...
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: ...Siblings whose roles faded from subsequent retellings of the story. A brother and sister by the names of Ramza and Alma.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_31: To prepare for this assignment, I pored over every published work on Ivalician legend I could lay my hands on, and nowhere did I find any mention of these siblings.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: But I did. I uncovered irrefutable evidence that Delita had a close companion named Ramza who aided him in his rise to power. This in turn led me to Alma. And that I might never lose sight of the truth, I named my own children after these lost players.
I'm sorry I never told you any of this, Cid, but you must believe me. Ivalice has never been a mere pastime of mine. It is and forever will be my calling. My purpose.
The world knows me as Jenomis cen Lexentale, yet that is but my stage name. My true name is Arazlam. Arazlam Durai.
Countless generations past, it was my ancestor who penned the Durai Papers─an account of Ivalice and the War of the Lions that details what truly occurred during that turbulent era.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: You are tired, Father. Rest. I will continue.
Long ago, an orphan by the name of Orran Durai crossed paths with both Ramza and Delita. After Delita's rise to power, Orran found himself in the service of the pauper-become-king.

Following the War of the Lions, Orran believed the people of Ivalice had a right to know the truth of Ramza's involvement, and set about documenting his deeds. When the church learned of his intent, however, they branded him a heretic, and had him burned at the stake.
The Durai Papers were never published, and any existing copies were gathered and sealed away in church vaults─the truth about Ivalice along with them.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_32: What was so damning that it would drive the church to do such a thing?
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: The answer to that question can be found in this book─the only surviving transcript of my ancestor's chronicle, copied from an early draft and passed down for untold generations.
With this, my father and I plan to reveal the truth and restore honor to my family name.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_CID_000_325: Forbidden chronicles? A secret family legacy? Not that I doubt you, Jenomis, but how do you expect to convince people of all of this when well-nigh every soul in the realm believes Ivalice to be nothing but a bedtime story?
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: By proving that it is anything but.
And when people see that Ivalice was real, the rest will fall into place.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Were it as simple as bringing forth the chronicle and submitting it for review, we would of course have done so long ago. But, alas, it is not. The Durai Papers, you see, are written in High Ivalician─an ancient tongue long extinct.

My father, his father, and his father before him labored tirelessly to decipher this tome, but for want of other sources made only fitful progress. A word here, a phrase there. It wasn't until a recent expedition to Rabanastre turned up several well-preserved artifacts that we were able to translate a small portion of the papers.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_33: Then the diary stolen by the Bangaa bounty hunters─
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I'm afraid so. Everything we had learned of the language was contained in those pages.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_33: Then we're back to where we started.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Not necessarily. We still have the transcript, as well as some few translated passages. And, of course, my father's impeccable memory.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I have come too far to allow so simple a setback to deter me from my purpose. I will show the world the truth if it is the last thing I do!
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: (It is as Master Garlond said... He is a man obsessed, and I fear Ivalice's grip on him will only grow tighter...)
(Father was fortunate to escape Rabanastre with his life, and already he speaks of continuing his quest? Promise me you'll keep him safe. Please...)
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: My father and I will begin the retranslation forthright. Once we have made sufficient progress, you will be informed.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: I don't believe I properly thanked you for saving my father. I shudder to think what would have become of him without your help. Now, I simply worry how long this reunion will last...
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Cid tells me it was you and your companions who liberated Ala Mhigo. I am honored that one of your acclaim would lend  strength to my cause.
TEXT_STMBDI102_03004_LINAMEWRILAH_000_38: After what I've seen here, I'm all but convinced that Ivalice exists...at least in some form.
The problem will be gathering sufficient evidence to convince the thousands of scholars and historians who have based their careers on the presumption that it doesn't.
Not that I've ever been one to shy from a challenge, especially when it means the story of the century!
If you're in, , then I'm in. If you're not in...well, I'm still in. Either way, you'll be hearing from me again soon. That much I promise you!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_001: You would know more of my venture? Excellent! I should be glad to tell you all I know.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_002: Though perhaps it would be easier to let our anonymous client speak for his or herself. Here, their missive.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_003: (-Anonymous Missive-)For the Ruby Sea and all who call her home, we seek the aid of the warrior who laid low the Lord of the Revel. But first, we bid  make haste to Hells' Lid and quell the oni that dwell in its deepest depths. Should  succeed in this test, we shall speak of the true endeavor and consummate reward.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_004: A strange proposal, aye, though it must be noted that they knew both of your deeds and of our part in them.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_005: The Red have no love of trickery, so I doubt it a trap of theirs. And should this client have honest intentions, then for the sake of these waters, it may behoove us to engage them further.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_006: As for their test─enclosed with the missive was a magicked dagger, along with instructions as to how it may be used to open a hidden passage into the depths of Hells' Lid.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_007: I should mention that this dagger is old and exceedingly valuable. That our client was willing to entrust it to us without a guarantee of our cooperation bespeaks considerable wealth─and more importantly, considerable reward.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_008: If you are willing to undertake their trial, I shall journey to Hells' Lid and prepare to open the path. Ah─but given the financial incentive, I think it for the best if I went and fetched Mistress Tataru. Wait for us there, then?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_010: Hope you haven't been waiting long, !
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_011: My apologies for the delay. I thought it best to explain everything to Mistress Tataru on the way.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_012: Honestly, all he had to say was that he'd found a way to make up for Alphinaud's obscene expenditures. No matter how reckless or dangerous the scheme, if it balances the ledger, I'm all for it!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_013: So there's a bunch of monsters living beneath us? What kind of place is this?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_014: Well...according to ancient legend, Hells' Lid is where the hero Tenzen defeated a host of oni.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_015: Oni were foul, evil beings that tormented the peoples of the Ruby Sea, and this island was home to many, until Tenzen, together with the Four Lords, drove the oni into the sea.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_016: For his heroic deeds, Tenzen was showered with riches. He then journeyed deep into the mountains, far from the realms of men, and lived in solitude with his companions, happily ever after...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_017: And now 's being asked to drive the oni away again?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_018: You misunderstand. What I told you was a faerie tale. To the best of my knowledge, no one has ever seen an oni. If anything, many assume the tale refers to ancestors of the Kojin.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_019: So what you're saying is that you've got no idea what's waiting for us down below. In that case, I'll leave this to the experts! If you need me, I'll be hiding behind that rock over there.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_020: By experts I presume she means you and your adventuring companions? I do hope you were not counting on me to join you in the fight...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_025: It looks rather...hot in there. I do hope this isn't a bad idea...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_030: ...Perhaps we should turn him right-side up?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_031: Ohoho! A marvelous performance, truly marvelous─but then you did best the Lord of the Revel...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_032: By the kami! A talking turtle!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_033: I...I don't even know where to begin with that one...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_034: I trust you will forgive me for my deception─'tis something of a Far Eastern tradition, the testing of strength and so forth. A bit rote, perhaps, but anyway! Welcome to Reisen Temple.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_035: I am Genbu, guardian of this sacred place, and leader of our little collective.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_036: Genbu!? The selfsame Genbu of the Tale of Tenzen? One of the Four Lords?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_037: Under normal circumstances I would assume you named for the legendary being, but clearly this is anything but normal. Never in my wildest dreams did I think I would meet a talking turtle...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_038: Ho, but every one of us here can speak your tongue! Is it truly so surprising? After all, we each have lived more than a thousand years.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_039: I-I knew turtles were long-lived, but I had no idea that was even possible...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_040: In this wondrous land of ours, it is said that a beast which lives a thousand years attains a measure of divinity. This temple is a place where such auspices may gather.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_041: But take not my word for it─speak with my comrades and learn their tales. We will talk of the endeavor after.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_042: We may as well do what he says. Besides, who knows what valuable secrets some thousand-year-old animals may know?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_045: You wish to return to the surface?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_055: Shall we return to the temple?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SENRI_000_050: Judging from the way you and that woman are gawping, I'm guessing you're not from around here?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SENRI_000_051: Don't know how it is in your homeland, but here, if an animal manages to survive a hundred years, it begins to get ideas. Delusions of grandeur. Some small power, sure, but nothing much to speak of.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SENRI_000_052: Survive ten times that and you become a full-fledged auspice, though. Speech! Magicks! It's quite the change, believe me, which is why we call it...the change. What? I never said it was something clever.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SENRI_000_053: Anyway! Point is, don't let our appearances fool you. I could kill you five times before you hit the ground. But I won't, on account of me being civil. For now.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_KUDAGITSUNE_000_054: A friend of mine, Tamamo Gozen, once called this place home. Possessed of nine tails, her power far eclipsed my own.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_KUDAGITSUNE_000_055: But one day she left to live amongst man. What became of her, I wonder...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_KAMAITACHI_000_056: Hey! That hurt! You didn't have to give it everything you had in that fight, you know. I only just went through the change, so it's not like I was gonna slow you down that much...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_KAMAITACHI_000_057: Well, I suppose you didn't know it was all for show...and I was probably really intimidating... Oh, right─you were asking about the collective, weren't you?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_KAMAITACHI_000_058: Let's see...Genbu's the oldest of us─oldest in the Far East, too, I think. One of the Four Lords, so as you can imagine he's much more powerful than regular ol' auspices like me. Ah, but you probably knew all that already...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_060: Please, converse with the others. We can speak of the endeavor once you have a greater understanding of who we are.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_065: How much more of the old tales are true...?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_070: Don't talk to me, ! Talk to the cat...or the weasel. And what does the fox have to say?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_080: Now that you have a greater understanding of who we are, I shall tell you of the rather thorny predicament we now face.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_081: The divinity of we auspices manifests in myriad ways. For example, I possess clairvoyance.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_082: And with my preternatural power have I seen a vision of the Ruby Sea─of Yanxia, of Hingashi─subsumed by roaring flames.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_083: This is no distant future, I fear, and if we are to avert it, we must needs enlist the assistance of an exemplary warrior─one such as  who faced the Lord of the Revel and lived.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_084: What should we do? What should we do!?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_085: Fear not, little one, for I have a plan. But to understand it, you must first understand the duality which lies at the heart of we auspices.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_086: The aramitama─the primal rage─and the nigimitama─the boundless calm. These elemental forces comprise the soul of an auspice, and it is only when they are in balance that we are truly ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_087: Alas, over great spans of time, or when caught in the midst of tumultuous events, this balance may be disrupted, and the soul may be divided.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_088: An auspice overcome by the aramitama is a wild, feral thing, all the more dangerous for their divinity. Calamity and catastrophe invariably follow─tremors and floods which destroy men's works.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_089: Auspices can bring about these natural disasters? How frightening...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_090: Perhaps, but you must remember that there are auspices who delight in aiding the peoples of these lands─auspices who may have even wreaked havoc in the past. Recall you the tale of Tenzen and the Four Lords?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_091: The one Soroban told us before? About a samurai and the auspices who drove the oni from this island into the sea?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_092: Just so. Yet I fear his accounting of events is not quite accurate, for it was not oni we and Tenzen cast out from this place, but an auspice.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_093: An auspice with the power to move heaven and earth─Koryu. Wholly consumed by the aramitama, he stoked the flames in this island's heart until it very nearly erupted in a fiery maelstrom.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_094: Tenzen led us in battle against our mad brother, and together we sealed him in this temple.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_095: But as the truth of the tale fades from memory, so too do our wards weaken, I fear. Should Koryu break free, he may well finish what he began, and ensure my vision of flames comes to pass.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_096: So...long story short, you want  to give this Koryu what for when he wakes up?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_097: I should think not!  accomplishments notwithstanding, it would be foolish for any mortal to face Koryu without proper assistance. To wit, that of the Four Lords!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_098: Regrettably, I am not the young auspice I once was. And to make matters worse, my three compeers have nearly succumbed to the aramitama.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_099: Kami forfend! Three of the Four Lords have gone mad!? The Ruby Sea is doomed!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_100: Nearly succumbed! Nearly! Alas, in marshaling their strength to retain control, they are unable to commit their powers to the preservation of the wards holding Koryu in his prison.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_101: And now that you have a full and complete understanding of the situation, we may at last discuss your part in all this, warrior. I would have you and your comrades face mine in battle and quell their raging aramitama. What say you?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_A1_000_001: Very well, if that is the only way.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_A1_000_002: So I don't get to kill them? Well, it's still something...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_103: Ohoho! You are an intriguing one, aren't you? We are grateful for your assistance. Let us brook no further delay and introduce you to another of the Four Lords.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_100_103: I informed Byakko of your arrival when you first entered our domain. He should be returning any moment now. Come, come!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_105: Don't be shy. He doesn't bite. Not without cause, at the very least.
