TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_110: A magnificent coat of fur that shimmers as snow. As befits Byakko, the white tiger of legend!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_115: He's...quite a bit bigger than the other animals, isn't he?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SENRI_000_140: You meet Byakko yet? Big ol' bastard, he is, but with a heart like a kitten. But, uh...don't tell him I told you that.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_KUDAGITSUNE_000_141: If you chance to meet Tamamo Gozen, I pray you tell her that we all miss her dearly.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_KAMAITACHI_000_142: Genbu may be the oldest, but Byakko's got to be the fuzziest. Not the most impressive claim to fame, but hey, you work with what you've got, am I right?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_120: Old friend. The day of reckoning draws nigh.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_121: The wards will fail, and Koryu will break free. Before he does, you must quell the raging aramitama in your soul. This warrior will help─doubt not  strength, for  has danced with Susano himself.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_122: A bold, audacious claim...yet if Genbu believes it true... Aye, the more I look at you, the more of him I see... A similar presence, perchance. A light. Very well. I will bow to my brother's judgment.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_123: Wonderful! Then without further ado, I shall bid my comrade relax and surrender to the aramitama─
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_124: Wh-What!? Here? Now!? Won't he go on a murderous rampage!?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_125: Why yes, that's rather the point. He will be reduced to the feral beast.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_126: And then it will be..., was it? 's turn to do battle with my brother and help him quell the fury within!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_127: But if all it takes to quell the aramitama is battle, then why did you not do the same for Koryu? Why seal him away?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_128: Because it was too late. As I said, Koryu was wholly consumed by the aramitama. Naught remained of the nigimitama. All that he was...was forever lost to us.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_129: The effort I expend to hold back the fury I will instead use to safeguard the calm. It is then you must act. But know that if you fail, it will only hasten my fall.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_130: My soul is in your keeping, . Do you understand?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_131: Then let us quit this place. Genbu may not mind the chaos, but if I am to wager my everything, I prefer to do so in the land of my birth. To look on those familiar wilds with eyes that may soon belong to another...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_100_132: When you return to the island, look for Furi. He will guide you back here.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_132: Given the circumstances, perhaps it is best that we stay here. Would that be acceptable?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_133: Ohoho! Soroban, was it? Be at ease. I have a task for you and your excitable urchin. Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_134: ...Did that tiny talking turtle just insult me?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_135: I have no doubt you will succeed.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_140: I do wonder what he will ask of us...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_145: I would go with you if I could, believe you me, but it seems we're needed here. Best of luck to you, !
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_151: My earliest memories are not pleasant. From birth I was shunned by man and beast alike, for my snow white fur marked me a harbinger of doom. Cast out and hunted, I struggled to survive.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_152: But I endured. I grew older and wiser, and one day, I resolved to protect this place and those that call it home, for in spite of everything, it was mine as well.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_153: In time they came to see me as a guardian instead of a demon. And yet, for all I have done to rise above the beast within, I may fall to madness and become the sum of their fears...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_A2_000_001: Have faith. You will not fall.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_A2_000_002: I've bested kami, you know. You're in good hands.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_155: Such confidence from one so young! But as age in of itself does not confer wisdom, nor does youth go hand in hand with hubris.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_156: I warn you: for centuries has my aramitama grown and festered. Hold nothing back, for I will not.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_157: Warrior! The time has come for you and yours to make ready. May the kami grant you strength to save my soul!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_200_160: You are indeed the warrior they say. Not unlike him, in many respects...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_100_160: 'Twas in another era that we first met, him and I. Long, long before the kingdom of Doma...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_160: I told you before of my past─of how I was shunned by man and beast alike for the snow white fur that marked me as a harbinger of doom.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_161: Bereft of family and friendship, of home, I wandered the mountains in search of a place to call my own. There I would accept my fate and await the inevitable.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_162: But death did not come, for I was unlike my brothers in more respects than my fur. With every century I grew stronger and stranger. Monstrous. In turn, what few creatures dared traverse my domain withdrew further and further.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_163: Never had I been so alone...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_164: And then one day I awoke to find a man standing before me. Bewildered, I rose and bared my fangs as I roared in rage.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_165: "Begone, or I shall rend you asunder and feast on your flesh! What fool has the temerity to approach me thus!?“
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_166: But the man did not flee. Rather, he stood his ground and said, “This fool is named Tenzen, and ever since he was a child he spoke the language of beasts.”
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_167: "Then you know full well what you stand to lose. Return to your people or die!“
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_168: But Tenzen threw back his head and laughed! “They would kill me if I dared! For fear of my talents, I was banished! A harbinger of doom, they called me!”
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_169: In that instant, all my anger drained away. Tenzen's words had struck at the heart of me. Here was a fellow outcast, cursed by his kin for his very nature.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_170: That night, as I listened to his snoring, I realized I had found in this man a kindred spirit...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_171: Soon after we embarked on a journey together. In the days that followed we met other solitary souls and aided them as we had aided each other...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_172: ...But those are tales for another time. I doubt very much you are willing to stand here in silence while I recount my every adventure with Tenzen.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_173: Come, let us return to the temple. Genbu is doubtless eager to learn the outcome of our battle.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_FURI_000_175: No need to explain─Genbu's told me all about you and the thrashing you gave him and the others! Need me to escort you back to the temple?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_180: Well done, , well done! You have done my friend a great kindness─one we shall not soon forget.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_A3_000_001: What exactly did you ask Soroban to do?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_A3_000_002: I'm not sure what's going on, and I'm afraid to ask...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_182: Ohoho, you needn't be so concerned. You know well the power of the Kojin's incantations, yes? I have but asked Soroban to undergo a little training that he might assist us with the maintenance of the wards. He has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude thus far, in fact!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_183: <huff> <puff> How...how much longer must I continue...?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_185: What youthful energy! It has been far too long since we had the pleasure of such company. Not since Tenzen, I imagine.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_186: I've been meaning to ask. What sort of man was Tenzen? We only just learned the stories, and you've already said they were half-wrong.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_187: Curious, are you? Very good, very good. Far too many people have no interest in the past...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_188: What to say, what to say... Well, for one, Tenzen was blessed with the selfsame power  possesses─the Echo, I believe it is sometimes called?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_100_189: Alas, as you probably know from personal experience, such individuals are often regarded with suspicion, if not outright fear. Nevertheless, Tenzen was a generous soul who was ever eager to aid his fellow man.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_190: Indeed, he died as he lived─fighting for the sake of those he loved. You see, when he faced Koryu, we Four Lords were still quite young and weak─not even auspices, in truth─and we could but look on helplessly as the two dragged one another to the brink of death.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_191: With the last of his strength, Tenzen imprisoned the mortally wounded Koryu. He then bequeathed to us a sacred treasure: a crystal which shone with an otherworldly light.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_192: Oft have I wondered if this crystal was the source of the powers we would grow to possess. Would we have become the Four Lords without it? In my heart, I think not.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_193: We built this temple to strengthen the wards and safeguard the Ruby Sea in Tenzen's stead. His legacy would be ours, and so it has been to this day.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_194: And so it will continue to be─but only if we can rely upon you to quell the aramitama of our comrades!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_195: That can wait, though. Byakko needs his rest, and so do you, .
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_196: In that case, it'd probably be for the best if I went back to Kugane. There's no telling what mischief that man'll get up to in my absence...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_197: I too should take my leave. Doubtless I am needed in Tamamizu...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_198: Ohoho, you're not going anywhere! Your training is far from finished, my friend!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_199: But...But I...can't possibly refuse the request of the Four Lords, can I... <sigh>
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_200: I hate to impose upon you, , but perhaps you can go to Tamamizu in my stead? It may be some time before I am permitted to return home...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_TATARU_000_206: Please do not disturb us, ! We're in the middle of a very important training session!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_207: Far too long has it been since I had the opportunity to unleash my full potential. Stakes notwithstanding, it was a pleasure, warrior.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BUNCHIN_000_210: ...Hmm? So Soroban will be staying with Genbu for a time? How wonderful to hear! I have no doubt he will make the most of his most blessed opportunity.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BUNCHIN_000_211: Oh, I have another missive for you. 'Twas delivered personally by an unusual cat─an auspice, I presume?
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BUNCHIN_100_211: (-Genbu's Missive-)You are welcome to come and go from the temple as you like. Furi will remain at his post above ground. You need only seek him out.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BUNCHIN_200_212: I should be glad if you take him up on his invitation and look in on Soroban every now and then. After all, he is in essence our representative there!
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_GENBU_000_215: You have done more than enough for one day, . For now, you and Byakko should rest. Oh, and if you have any questions about this or that, Senri should be glad to entertain them.
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_SOROBAN_000_220: I should be most grateful if you were to tell the elder of my plight─ Er, that is to say, this great...honor...which has been bestowed upon me by the Four Lords...
TEXT_STMBDY301_03015_BYAKKO_000_225: Peace reigns in my heart once more. Such tranquility, such serenity...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_000_001: A pleasure as ever to see you, my friend.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_000_002: Would that I could say the same for Soroban. He has yet to return to Tamamizu, so I can only assume he is still busy undergoing Genbu's rigorous training...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_003: (-Tataru-)Hello? Hello? ? Is my linkpearl working? So unreliable, these little things...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_004: (-Tataru-)I'm going to pay a visit to Reisen Temple to see Soroban─give him a treat to keep his spirits up. If you're available, you should come too!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_005: (-Tataru-)I hope you haven't forgotten how to get there, but in case you have, look for the cute animal trying not to look like a guard on duty in the middle of the volcanic island!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_000_006: ...I was, of course, not privy to your conversation just now, but on the off chance you are bound for Reisen Temple, give Soroban and Genbu my regards.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_010: Ho, well met, brave adventurer. You are come alone this day? What of the urchin girl I recall nipping at your heels?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_011: That's Tataru! Tataru! Ta-ta-ru! And I'll thank you not to forget it, or else you'll get no tako-yaki from me!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_012: Oh my, that would be most unfortunate. My sincerest apologies. I shall endeavor to remember, little urchin Tataru.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_013: Of course, your name I will not soon forget, for you saved my dear friend Byakko from descending into madness.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_014: It is good that you are here, . Soroban has made great strides in his training, it is true, but I believe we need consider more drastic methods...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_015: Though he is not without potential, Soroban, as he is, simply lacks...divinity. Should we carry on as we are, he may not be ready when we have need of his strength.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_016: As with Byakko before, there will come a time when we must confront Seiryu and Suzaku, and quell the raging aramitama within them. Accordingly, we must use every means at our disposal─no matter how dangerous─to ensure we are prepared.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_017: No...no matter how dangerous? What exactly did you have in mind...?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_018: Oho, there is no need for fearful trembling or withdrawing into one's shell. All I would have you do is open a box.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_019: ...Oh, is that all? Well! I've opened my fair share of boxes!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_020: But know that it is no ordinary box you must open! It is a tamate-bako of geomancy─a sacred vessel which harbors the very power of time itself.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_021: ...And yet you say there is no need for fearful trembling? This box sounds terribly dangerous. To what end would you have me open it?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_022: That you may bathe in its temporal magicks and age a thousand years in an instant─that you may undergo the change and become an auspice. Albeit until the magicks dissipate.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_023: You...you would have me become an auspice like the Four Lords!?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_024: Hold on─, didn't you come across one of these tamate-bako in Shisui of the Violet Tides? You did, didn't you?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_025: I am aware of similar relics in the possession of the Raen. However, their “magicks” alter only the appearance of those exposed. A mummer's trick─a glamour─altogether unlike the phenomenal power of the tamate-bako we seek.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_026: Come to think of it, I think I heard rumors that several boxes like the ones he describes were in the possession of the Raen?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_027: You speak of common trinkets that belong to the people of Sui-no-Sato. Their “magicks” alter only the appearance of those exposed. A mummer's trick─a glamour─altogether unlike the phenomenal power of the tamate-bako we seek.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_028: Know that this is no legend, but incontrovertible truth, for the one who created the tamate-bako of geomancy was a fellow auspice...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_029: Like many of us, he had lived long enough to see comrades become consumed by the aramitama─see them descend into madness and lay waste to the lands they had sworn to protect. And, like many of us, he had had no choice but to put an end to their rampages...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_030: This auspice knew full well that he was destined to share their fate, and so, before he too fell from grace, he resolved to craft the tamate-bako of geomancy. And when his work was complete, he bathed in its magicks...until he was no more.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_031: By the kami... He chose to die while his mind was still his own...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_032: I...I don't know what to say...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_033: Once the true potential of the box was understood─that it could bring death to an auspice─it was decided that it should be placed under lock and key in the Swallow's Compass, until we had need of it.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_034: However, the grand mausoleum of King Ganen has been abandoned to the shikigami forever bound to its halls as guardians, and only a warrior of surpassing strength can hope to overcome their trials.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_035: Steel yourself, Soroban! Until the moment  returns with the tamate-bako of geomancy, you must train like you have never trained before!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_037: <huff> <puff> Oh, hello there! I pray you excuse my panting. Genbu is a...a rather demanding teacher. But I will not rest until granted leave to do so!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BYAKKO_000_038: Genbu yet has an eye for talent. That Kojin may be young, but he has tremendous potential. I expect he will be most formidable...several centuries from now.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_000_039: Did you not receive a summons earlier from your comrade? Do not let me keep you.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_040: Oh hey, you made it! Finally! I've only been waiting here forever and a day, but hey, it's not like we've got a potential calamity to worry about or anything...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_041: Anyway, I've already taken care of the wards sealing the tomb's entrance, so you're free to go in and get the box. But whatever you do, don't open it!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_042: Ah, and one more thing! I'll wager they told you about the shikigami, but forgot to mention that the box itself is guarded by one of us. A tough bugger and half!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_043: But you're a pretty tough bugger yourself, eh? You gave Byakko what for, after all. Just don't say I didn't warn you!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_044: Back straight! Keep those hands up! If I'm not satisfied with your performance, then no tako-yaki for you!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_046: The box is hidden in the heart of the Swallow's Compass, the tomb of Ganen in Yanxia. Kamaitachi has gone on ahead to open the way─seek him out.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BYAKKO_000_047: You are for the Swallow's Compass, I am told. Know that the guardian of the relic you seek was a disciple of its creator, and will surely fight to defend it most fiercely.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_050: Why you talking to me? I'm not about to brave a tomb full of shikigami for a box that can kill my kind. That's your job!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_100_060: You are returned...and with the tamate-bako of geomancy, I gather?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_060: Very good, very good! Of course there was no need to fear for the well-being of the warrior who faced my brother Byakko and lived.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_061: Let us brook no further delay and make ready for this next stage of Soroban's training. Listen well, everyone, for the magicks we are about to unleash are ancient and terrifying! It is exceedingly dangerous─especially for Soroban!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_062: Err... I wish you would stop saying that...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_063: Be at ease, Soroban. Byakko will devote his energies to maintaining the wards on Koryu's prison while we are occupied. Should you be indisposed for a time, we will manage.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_064: And I've been secretly practicing my arcanima in preparation for a time like this, so don't worry! No matter what happens, we'll be ready!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_065: After all, we've each got to do our part if we're going to claim the fabulous riches─ I mean, if we're going to save the Ruby Sea from certain doom!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_066: Her enthusiasm notwithstanding, I expect we will need to turn to you should this training go...awry. Take a moment to see to your equipment, and let me know when you are ready to begin.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_067: Welcome back, ! Did you find the mysterious box of doom or whatever it was you were looking for?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_068: You...you have returned. Kami be praised... I do not think I could endure even a moment's more training...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BYAKKO_000_069: Was it not just the other day you went to Yanxia to retrieve the box? But of course. Where others would struggle, you thrive.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_070: Oh, back already? Damn. I really ought to stop betting against you.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_080: Everything is in order? Then let us begin!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_500: Now remember, Soroban! Once opened, the box will spew forth smoke. Remain still and let it wash over you. Surrender to the magick and let it transform you into an auspice.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_501: And you are certain this will be temporary? As honored as I would be to join your ranks, I fear I am too young to be so old...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_502: Come, you lot! Let us retreat to a safer distance!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_504: Uh...huh. It's a fake. I knew it!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_505: Gosh, what a waste of time! There had better be some treasure or something interesting inside...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_508: Ugh... Was that really necessary? You couldn't just ask me to move nicely?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_509: ...What? What's that look for? Is there something on my face?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_510: My...my face! My beautiful face! It feels like aldgoat leather left in the sun!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_511: Get a hold of yourself, child! You have been aged, nothing more. Be grateful you were not exposed longer, or you would have surely died!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_512: I may as well be dead already! I can't bear to go on like this!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_513: Did I not tell you before that the magick is fleeting? You need only endure it for a moment. All will be as it was.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_514: Bah! So preoccupied with the urchin I have been that I completely forgot about Soroban! I hope he has not been overexposed to the magick.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_515: If he has been aged to excess, his aramitama may already be...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_517: ...Well, that answers that. On your guard─I'm afraid he means to kill us all.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_518: He bathed in the tamate-bako's magick for far longer than the urchin, and so I expect he will not return to normal so quickly. In fact, I daresay he will retain this form long enough to destroy the temple if we do not subdue him.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_520: With me, , urchin! Hold nothing back!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_BATTLETALK_0: I don't like the sound of that!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_BATTLETALK_00: He marshals his strength for a mighty blow! Get behind me!

Oh dear, that was a bit more than I could handle...
Forgive me, but the rest is up to you two.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_BATTLETALK_0: What are these bubble thingies chasing me!?
He's growing weaker! Don't let up!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_102: I know what you're thinking: “Didn't she give arcanist a go before and get betrayed by her Carbuncle?” Yes and yes, but that was then and this is now!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_103: I do not know what to expect, but...I trust you will let no harm come to me?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_110: Hmm? What happened? Why do you all look so exhausted?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_111: Oh, my dear Soroban. I knew you had potential, but it would seem I grossly underestimated your capacity for chaos.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_112: In any case, despite this unexpected turn of events, I should like to declare this training session a success. Let us take a moment to collect ourselves.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_FURI_000_113: Need a guide back to the surface? 'Course you do! Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_FURI_000_115: Need a guide back to the temple? 'Course you do! Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_120: Truth be told, this comes as a relief. Though Soroban's present strength pales in comparison to that of Byakko and myself, we now know for certain that his potential is extraordinary.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_121: I struggle to believe I could ever wield such power...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_122: All who are strong were once weak, Soroban. I am no exception. Until I met Tenzen, I was no more than the floundering turtle you see before you.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_100_122: You never did tell us how you fell in with him.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_200_122: Ah, well, if you wish to know the details...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_600: Long, long ago, when I had lived a hundred or so years and had only just begun to become something more, I received my first vision. A terrible calamity, one that would claim the lives of countless innocents, was imminent.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_601: But what was a little turtle to do? For while I had seen the future with crystal clarity, I was powerless to stop it. I could but look on, helpless, as cities burned and men died. So it was for centuries...until one day.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_602: After five hundred years I had grown stronger, more reckless. I believed I could make a difference. So when I foresaw a landslide that would bury a nearby village, I ventured forth to warn the people.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_603: Alas, while they were quick to discern I was no common animal, they could make no sense of my panicked flailings. To them I was a queer dancing turtle─a source of considerable amusement─for I knew not the words of men, and so my warnings fell on deaf ears.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_604: It would be no different. Yet again they would die. The people turned and walked away, bored with the fleeting amusement. With a heart fit to burst with sorrow and despair, I made to quit the village.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_605: Just then, I heard a voice kind and gentle...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_606: "Little one, you look troubled. Tell me what burdens you so.“
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_607: Though I knew he was addressing me, I doubted he would understand. Still, I told him of my vision─of the landslide I knew would bury the village and everyone in it, and my vain attempts to warn them.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_608: "Your kindness is only surpassed by your bravery, little one. Fear not. I, Tenzen, and my comrade Byakko shall act in your stead.“
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_609: As Tenzen drew his sword, a great white tiger emerged from the wilds. “Shall we give them a show?” he whispered to the beast, which inclined its massive head ever so slightly in response.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_610: They then ran into the center of the village, and began to fight as if they were bitter enemies intent on killing one another! Blade and fang flashing, too fast for the eye to follow!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_611: The two broke apart for an instant, and Tenzen bellowed, “Hearken to me! This white demon thirsts for the blood of man! If you value your lives, flee this place! Seek shelter in the next village!”
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_612: Needless to say, the bewildered villagers gathered up whatever was at hand and ran screaming, too terrified to even look back.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_613: As the three of us watched them go, I heard the white demon mutter, “You know full well I have not once tasted man-flesh...”
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_614: The village was later destroyed in a landslide, as I had foreseen. But, for the first time, I had managed to make a difference...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_138: Thereafter we became traveling companions and close friends. I shared with them my visions, and together we labored to save those that we could.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_139: On the eve of what may perhaps be the greatest calamity I have ever foreseen, I feel Tenzen's absence keenly... Nevertheless, we must carry on.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_140: You may not have him, but you've got ─and you know 's no slouch!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_141: Oho, indeed I do. And for this blessing we are grateful beyond measure.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_142: Right, then. Soroban─we must resume your training at once, ere we forget the lessons of your time as an auspice!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_144: Getting back to it? In that case, I should return to the mountain of paperwork in Kugane I've been doing my best to ignore. Oh, and Soroban─I left the tako-yaki with Kamaitachi for safekeeping. You're not to get any until you've earned it!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_145: When next we call upon you, , I expect it will be to deal with one of my comrades. Shirk not your own training, for it will not be easy.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_146: Under these circumstances, I do not think I will have time to return to Tamamizu for even a short spell. If you would be so kind as to inform the elder...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_147: I...I'm not quite sure what happened, but I feel so very, very tired...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_TATARU_000_148: Confound it. Betrayed by my own Carbuncle yet again...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SEITENTAISEI_000_14: Oh, hello there! Remember me? I was the fellow tasked with guarding the tamate-bako of geomancy. I hope you understand that I had no choice but to put you to the proof. What kind of guardian would I be if I let you have it without a fight, eh? Still, I didn't think you lot would use it like that...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BYAKKO_000_150: Soroban, was it? He surpassed all expectations...to your temporary dismay, perhaps, but to our ultimate benefit, I should think.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BYAKKO_000_151: Though, regardless of what Genbu may have told you, if you had failed to subdue him, I would have intervened. The wards would have held long enough, I am sure.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_152: That Kojin's something else...but he's still no auspice! At least, not yet. But if he was, I might be in trouble...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_100_160: A pleasure, . Did you have the chance to visit with Soroban? How fares he with his training?
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_000_160: ...Extraordinary. He has always been diligent and hardworking, but even so...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_000_161: To think he is blessed with such incredible potential! I cannot help but wonder who else among us might be possessed of similar abilities.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_BUNCHIN_000_162: Yet I understand his trepidation. With great power comes great responsibility, as is often said. We may need to keep a closer eye on him to ensure he does not succumb to fear and attempt to flee his training.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_GENBU_000_163: When the time comes, I will send for you, . Be ready for whatever lies ahead.
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_SOROBAN_000_164: <huff> <puff> I'm...I'm not going anywhere. I promise...
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_166: By the kami, it's been too long since I've had quality tako-yaki!
TEXT_STMBDY311_03016_KAMAITACHI_000_167: Oh, bugger... The urchin girl wanted me to give it to Soroban...
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_000: , I'm glad you're here. In case you haven't heard, we've observed a huge surge of anomalous energy coming from the Yawn...
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_001: I've a nasty feeling this means Omega's ready to go ahead with the next stage of its “experiment.” But Master Garlond is on his way, so let's hear what he has to say.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_002: Care to share your thoughts on this, Chief?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_003: Our colleagues on the ground have reported the appearance of “mysterious floating structures” inside the Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_004: If you recall, we were investigating a similar anomaly when Alpha and Alte Roite made their appearance.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_005: Omega certainly knows how to get our attention. I blush to recall the eagerness with which we plunged into the abyss, ignorant of the warped gladiatorial contest that awaited us within.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_006: But what a staggering collection of opponents! Plucked from the pages of both history and fiction for their ability to pose a threat to Omega...
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_007: And should you prevail against these interdimensional champions, what then shall be your prize? Why, a battle against the most devastating weapon this world has ever seen! How marvelous!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_008: ...He says with eyes aflame. For once, I wish you were being sarcastic.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_009: Anyway─the energy surge. Based on our previous experience, it seems highly probable that it is our signal to rejoin the fray.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_010: Needless to say, it is an invitation we cannot refuse─not when the alternative is Omega unleashing its creations on Eorzea.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_011: Well, ? Are you ready to answer the call?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_012: Well, I'm afraid Biggs and Wedge won't be answering any calls just yet─they're still mending from the ambush in the control center.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_013: Yes, of course. We'll just have to struggle on without them for the time being.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_014: Don't worry─Nero and I will see to it that you receive all the support you need. Defeat is not an option!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_016: I do believe Alpha here agrees.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_017: Oh, that reminds me! I've got something special for you, little fellow. Come with me.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_018: A custom-made Ironworks uniform! Oh, you do look smart, I must say.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_019: He is part of the expedition team, after all. And considering the dangers lurking in that rift, it's only right that we give him some protective equipment.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_020: How very thoughtful of you, Jessie. And there I was thinking you were just sizing him up for a new range of merchandise.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_021: Unlike you, I can do two things at once.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_A1_000_023: I wish I had that uniform...
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_025: Really? I wouldn't be seen dead in it.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_026: This is perfectly acceptable attire for an engineer. Sturdy, practical, and best of all, most stains will scrub right out.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_027: I'm not sure it'd last long on you, what with all the fighting, but if you're desperate for a set, you're welcome to have a word with our tailors!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_028: You are a famous hero who can afford  own gear. I'll bet you could buy a house for the cost of what you're wearing!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_029: Joking aside, I doubt even a fine uniform like ours would last long on you, what with all the fighting you get up to. We'd need to tailor something specific to your needs, and make it out of far more durable materials. And by durable, I mean expensive.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_030: Saying that...if you were in a position to provide said materials, I'm sure our artisans would happily work day and night, all blissful smiles and sparkly eyes, to make you something suitable.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_031: Fascinating though this discussion of Ironworks garmenture undoubtedly is, might our time not be better spent, say, traveling to the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_JESSIE_000_040: You'll be on your way to the Yawn soon, I expect. I'd tell you to take care, but... Well, good luck!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_045: Take a good look, . I think you'll find the wreckage down there quite familiar.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_061: I'm ready when you are, . Say the word, and we'll take the plunge.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_062: Right, then. Into the Yawn we go!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_MIDGARDSORMR_000_06: I am with you, mortals, along with what scant wisdom I can provide.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_070: Well...the rift seems much as it did before.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_071: And we appear to be mercifully solid.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_072: Ah, but I do detect some changes. If I am not mistaken, there are fewer “eggs” floating in the aether...
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_073: Welcome, Alpha group. Your prompt arrival is appreciated.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_074:
Omega.
'Twould seem your experiment continued in our absence.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_075: Affirmative. Progress has been satisfactory. Approximately fifty percent of the test subjects have been eliminated.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_076: Each test world hosts an ongoing contest, wherein the strong eliminate the weak.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_077: The process is certain. Conclusive. Inevitable. Every result matches the predicted outcome.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_078: <blip> Do these images cause you distress? Please, examine them closely. Without suitable stimulation, you may not exceed your calculated probability of success.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_079: Your survival is crucial to my study. Through you, I must continue to explore the contradiction I have discovered in your otherwise impotent kind. The ability to triumph against overwhelming odds is one which I must acquire.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_MIDGARDSORMR_000_08: Foolish machine. What hast thou to show for all the years that have passed since the culmination of our war? Naught save thy continued existence. Hast thou no thought for what befalleth thy home star...?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_081: Your attempts to provoke me will not succeed. I will follow my programming. Fight. Win. Evolve. Then I will return to─ <blip> <bloooooop>
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_082: Error. Accurate rendering of planetary label impossible in current mode of communication. Terminating exchange and returning to priority experiment.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_083:
Alterations to equipment parameters detected. Recalculating projected combat capabilities... <blip> Complete.
I will now commence recording your practical performance.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_084: Proceed, Alpha group. Overcome the obstacles in your path, and reach the end of the course constructed for you.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_085: It seems we have our orders. Shall we cut a path through the chaff, then?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_086: Ah, those are some nice...cards? Which means... One moment. Card...game...play...play! You mean to play a part in proceedings this time?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_087: Of course that's what you meant. Well, we do have authorization to fight in this area of the rift, so I suppose there's nothing to stop you from joining us. Welcome aboard, Alpha!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_090: Right, are we ready to─ Ah. Apparently not.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_091: Fortunately for you, I came prepared for the occasion. Heh heh heh... What a perfect opportunity to field-test my latest creation!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_092: Behold! The Mark XLVIII Iron Nero, complete with the new and improved Mighty Mjolnir gunhammer!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_093: Step aside, Garlond, and bear witness to the devastation!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_110: That seems to be the end of them...and of the path, as well.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_111:
<sigh>
As far as operational duration goes, that was pushing the limit. Still, it should suffice...
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_112: In between scrambling to stay out of the way of Nero's new toy, I found myself wondering about that card you used, Alpha. Care to explain?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_MIDGARDSORMR_000_11: He boasteth that it is but one of many tools at his disposal.
Be not deceived by his appearance. Like all of Omega's creations, Alpha was chosen for his prowess in battle.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_116: Results match revised projections. At this rate of improvement, you will fail to qualify as subjects of note. Midgardsormr, your parameters are notably inferior.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_MIDGARDSORMR_000_11: Dost thou yet believe me the mighty wyrm I was in life?
That incarnation perished long ago. My fate was sealed the moment I delivered my spawn unto this far-flung star.
That they might be suffered to remain, I did offer up my life unto Hydaelyn, abiding thenceforth in spectral form─a servant to be summoned in Her hour of need.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_120: Your account correlates with my records. It explains why I arrived on this planet only to find that my journey's purpose was lost. Of necessity, my priority shifted to repairs even as I searched for a new target of sufficient strength.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_121: Yet I still do not understand why you aid these creatures.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_MIDGARDSORMR_000_12: I should think the reason plain...but mayhap 'tis not so for a soulless machine such as thee.
By thee and thine was my home laid waste. The sound of thee, thy very scent, visiteth upon me a tempest of rage. I but lend these mortals what little aid I can render.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_124: Illogical. If your purpose is to facilitate my destruction, it would require an entity more powerful than you were at your prime. Without the means to muster such might, your presence here is meaningless.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_OMEGA_000_125: The experiment continues. Alpha group, your next opponent awaits you within the Sigmascape. Enter, and commence the contest.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_000_130: The “Sigmascape,” eh? I shall set to work analyzing the unspeakable horrors within.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_140: ...That should do it. Our new base of operations is up and running!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_141: Now, what I'd really like to do is delve a little deeper into Omega's past. But as our dragon seems disinclined to indulge my curiosity, we had best focus on the task at hand.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_000_142: Let's get on with conquering the occupants of this “Sigmascape,” shall we?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_BATTLETALK_000_:
There's no avoiding this “evaluation.”
Let's watch our step though, eh?

One of Omega's monitors...
On your mark, .

Bah, of course it's shielded!
Leave the barrier to me.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_BATTLETALK_000:
Alpha, mind the─ <sigh> Trap.
Well, you're stuck for now.

Hmph. Child's play.
It's been a poor welcome thus far!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_BATTLETALK_000_:
We've arrived on different platforms...
Come, Nero, we have to find them!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_BATTLETALK_000:
Ah, we have other visitors first.
And they don't seem keen on letting us pass.
My, aren't there a lot of them.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_BATTLETALK_000_: You just had to bemoan our “poor welcome,” didn't you...
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_BATTLETALK_000: You cannot blame a new employee for craving a challenge!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_MIDGARDSORMR_BATTLE:
No sign of thy companions.
Fight on, mortal.

Oho, a timely trick.
Thou didst mimic the action well.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_BATTLETALK_000_:
Over there! A flash of light!
It could be  and the others.
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_BATTLETALK_000: Splendid! Let's get on with it, then!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_BATTLETALK_000_:
Was that one of your cards!?
Good work, Alpha!
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_NERO_BATTLETALK_000:
Finally, a proper challenge.
I trust those tedious barriers are behind us?
TEXT_STMBDR201_03031_CID_BATTLETALK_000_:
It would appear so.
Let's finish this!
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_NERO_000_000: The “Sigmascape,” eh? I shall set to work analyzing the unspeakable horrors within.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_020: Before you cross the threshold, we should take a moment to discuss where we stand.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_021: That is the test world you need to conquer. The Sigmascape.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_NERO_000_022: Is that a mask...or a face? The castle was certainly a surprise, but this is verging on disturbing!
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_023: And we currently have no idea what it might signify. My first instinct is to dive straight into our analysis.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_024: ...The problem being that without a reference point from within the Sigmascape to start from, we'll have no way of knowing if we're even analyzing the correct data.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_025: Which means you'll just have to go in blind. Hardly the best way to enter into a fight, but needs must and all that. Are you up for the challenge?
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_026: Can I ask you to join , Alpha? We seem to be fine out here, but  will need your authorization if 's to do battle inside the test world.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_NERO_000_027: Keep your wits about you, savior. Your next opponent could be almost anything!
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_030: Say the word to Alpha when you're ready. Again, I wish I had more to tell you, but I'm sure you'll manage somehow. You always do.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_NERO_000_035: Ahhh... Strange technology...the ever-present threat of death... I have never felt so in my element!
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_SYSTEM_000_041: Alpha appears eager to proceed. You may enter Sigmascape V1.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_MINA_000_060:
Traveler from afar...
Thank you for Doma.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_NERO_000_070: Ahahaha! The glorious absurdity of it all! Even you must have managed a smile. One wonders what Omega has in store for you next. A delinquent rowing boat, perhaps? Or an angry cable car?
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_080: Thank the gods you're fast on your feet. When I first saw you'd be facing a train of all things, I assumed I was hallucinating.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_081: But with that oddness behind us, we can be fully certain we have the right set of data for the Sigmascape.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_082: From what we've been able to determine, this is a recreation of a devastated world.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_083: Unfortunately, we have not found any clues as to its origin. We came across several familiar terms─“Doma” included─but the arc of history is inconsistent with our own.
TEXT_STMBDR202_03032_CID_000_084: Given that Omega draws from realms which could be fictional or even other-dimensional, we can only guess at the source upon which the Sigmascape is based. But if it was fictional, it seems safe to assume that the author had a bad experience with a train.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_000: Ahahaha! The glorious absurdity of it all! Even you must have managed a smile. One wonders what Omega has in store for you next. A delinquent rowing boat, perhaps? Or an angry cable car?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_020: I expect you're still recovering from your last fight, but we should probably go over the details of your next opponent all the same.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_021: According to our research, you'll be pitted against a foe known as “Chadarnook.” Not a train this time, but some manner of animated painting...
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_022: To be perfectly clear, the name refers more to the evil spirit that's taken up residence within the picture─but the “picture” part will be key to our strategy.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_023: To that end, Nero has thrown together a little something I thought might be useful...
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_024: "Thrown together,“ he says. Do you know how difficult it was to translate your abstract fancy into an actual tool with practical applications?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_025: What you demanded was nothing less than a miracle─and a miracle I have delivered!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_026: I seem to recall you insisting on constructing it yourself. Still, credit where credit's due─well done.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_027: Hmph. History will appreciate my genius.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_028: Ahem! To you I present the fruits of my labor─the Chocobo Brush. I won't confuse you by trying to explain how it works, but suffice it to say that I have adapted the tool to combat the peculiar nature of your rival. Put simply: you will be able to directly influence the space around you by painting pictures.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_029: Naturally, this process will require paint. As for the color, subject, and efficacy of your masterpieces, well...that shall depend entirely upon your own artistic sense.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_030: Now, back to you, Garlond. Do you notice the absence of a steaming cup in my hand? If you truly valued the efforts of your colleagues, you might consider filling the bloody kettle from time to time!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_031: Or is that another task his lordship the “Chief” can't accomplish without the help of his subordinates?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_032: Now listen here, Nero─I apologize for the damn kettle, but this has nothing to do with my upbringing!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_040: Oh, sorry, ─little distracted there. Talk to Alpha when you're ready, and we can see about crossing this Chadarnook character off the list.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_045: There was really no need to make it resemble a brush. But as we had a ready supply of chocobo feathers, I thought: why not? Now, let's see what it's capable of, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_SYSTEM_000_050: Next to the kettle is one of Alpha's cards, its face illustrated with a depiction of spring water...
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_SYSTEM_000_052: Alpha appears keen to begin the next encounter. You may enter Sigmascape V2.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_070: I'll wager the spirit was less than thrilled at being beaten at its own game. I must say, these field tests are fast becoming my favorite part of this whole experience!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_080: Welcome back, ! I was on the edge of my stool watching you attempt to paint whilst fighting, but you soon seemed to get the hang of it!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_081: I'm glad our makeshift solution worked as intended.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_082: Our “makeshift solution” worked as intended because I made it work. Painting is easy, as is intending.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_083: I feel I should remind you, however, that the brush was very specifically designed with that arena and that foe in mind. Against aught else, it will avail you precisely as well as any other brush.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_085:
...That's great news! And wh─
...Oh, they did, did they? ...Understood, we'll meet them out there.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_086: That was Jessie. Apparently, Biggs and Wedge considered themselves well enough to pay us a visit. They're on their way to the Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_087: Fancy a brief jaunt to the surface?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_088: No thank you. I have data to analyze.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_089: Fine. Just the three of us, then.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_090: Look at the two of you, up and about already! You gave us quite a scare...
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_WEDGE_000_095: ! Did you come out just to see us!?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . I believe Biggs and Wedge have been waiting for you.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_BIGGS_000_110: Chief, ...and Alpha, too! We didn't mean to drag you all away from your work.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_111: Nonsense. After all you've been through, how could we not come running? Speaking of which...should you even be walking?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_BIGGS_000_112: Er...the chirurgeon will probably want to have words with us later. But we couldn't just lie back and let you brave the rift on your own.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_WEDGE_000_113: Do you even have enough hands for that much work? Who's taking care of all the little jobs?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_114: Ah, yes...the little jobs. It does seem that you two have spoiled me. I only recently learned that the kettle does not, in fact, fill itself... But we're muddling along somehow.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_115: has been a pillar of strength, as always, Alpha has proven to be a stalwart companion, and Nero...Nero has been invaluable and insufferable in equal measure.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_CID_000_116: As for the test subjects themselves, they're certainly formidable, but Omega's experiment hasn't broken us yet. So go home. Heal. And don't come back until you've fully recovered.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_BIGGS_000_117: It's good to hear that everything's going well. But you call us the moment anything goes wrong─we'll be out here in a wink, even if we have to crawl!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_WEDGE_000_118: Listen to me, Alpha. That uniform you're wearing makes you an official employee of Garlond Ironworks.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_WEDGE_000_119: That means you can call on us whenever you're in trouble, and that we can call on you. It means you're not alone!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_WEDGE_000_120: Biggs and I have to go away for a while, so I want you to look out for  and the chief for us, all right?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_BIGGS_000_122: Oh, before I forget, we brought you something to put a spring in your step. You can't fight Omega's creations on field rations alone!
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_0130: Now, what have we─ Hmmm. This next one seems strong, but exhibits no other notable traits. How dull.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_0131: The true challenge is this fourth opponent. But if I can find the patterns hidden in the chaos, then knowledge and reason will prevail.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_132: For even the most random actions are products of an underlying logic. One has but to isolate the behavioral triggers...
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_133:
Bleh!
Tastes like saltwater! Why would─?
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_NERO_000_134: I need to take a closer look at that card.
TEXT_STMBDR203_03033_OMEGA_000_135: Alpha group shows signs of recovering from recent trauma. Initiating action to maintain desirable stress levels...
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_BIGGS_000_000: We appreciate you coming up to meet us. After imagining everything that could go wrong in there, it was a relief to find you quietly getting on with the job. We'll have to hurry up and get well!
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . I believe Biggs and Wedge are waiting on you.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_WEDGE_000_010: Alpha and the chief have already gone back in, so don't let us keep you. Our colleague over there should be glad to help you make the descent as soon as you're ready.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_WEDGE_000_011: This dreadful experiment may have a way to go yet, but if you keep taking it one battle at a time, you'll be fighting Omega before you─ I-I mean, it will all be over before you know it!
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_WEDGE_000_020: Say the word to our colleague over there, and he'll help you make the descent into the Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Can I lower you into the rift, ? I may not be much use in battle, but I can at least do you this small service.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_030: Thank you for joining me up there, . I know it meant a lot to Biggs and Wedge.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_NERO_000_040: Ah. Back, are you? We should... <gulp> We should return to the task at hand.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_041: Everything all right, Nero? You look a bit green around the gills.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_NERO_000_042:
The kettle was full of saltwater...
Not the best stuff to brew coffee with, it turns out...
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_043: Really? Well, it wasn't my doing.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_NERO_000_044: Of course not. That would involve you filling it. <heave> The water came from Alpha...created by one of those cards of his.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_NERO_000_045: It was very thoughtful of him to make the effort...but next time...I'd prefer a beverage that didn't leave me feeling ill...
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_NERO_000_046: ...In any case, you can handle support for this third battle on your own. I want to begin preparations for the fourth.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_048: Right, ─your next foe is known simply as the “Guardian.” Unlike that ordeal with Chadarnook, this battle promises to be relatively straightforward. Courage and steel should be enough to win you the day.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_050: The file I found on the Guardian says it was a weapon employed in the defense of an empire's capital city. That should give you some idea of the extent of its capabilities.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_NERO_000_055:
Just...leave me be...
I'm having enough trouble concentrating as it is...
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_SYSTEM_000_071: Alpha seems concerned about Nero, but otherwise eager to proceed. You may enter Sigmascape V3.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_NERO_000_090: Done, are you? Then it's almost time...
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_100: Congratulations, old friend. Judging by the lack of smoking holes, I'd say you have a natural talent for avoiding laser beams. And this is what passes for a straightforward battle in here...
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_101:
Phantom trains, possessed pictures, and now this magitek-like machine...
Assuming it was real, the realm the Sigmascape is based on must have been highly advanced in both the arcane and the mechanical arts.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_102: 'Tis truly a pity we cannot identify the test world's origin. Imagine how much we might have learned from such a civilization had we encountered it under different circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDR204_03034_CID_000_103: But now is not the time for such idle thoughts. The next battle will be the last for this world, and Nero should have a strategy to share with us by now...
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_000: Nero still seems unwell. How much of that coffee did he drink?
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_020:
This is it...
The final battle to conquer the...<cough>...Sigmascape.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_021: ...We've put together a profile of your next opponent.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_022: You've encountered some fantastical foes in here, but this time you'll have the novel experience of fighting an actual person. His name is “Kefka”...and he's a jester.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_023: According to the data, his preferred mode of fooling didn't just bring the house down, but the whole world.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_024: Apparently, he found comedy in the tragedies of others, and condemned countless thousands to death for his own amusement.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_025: Hm hm... That a jester should bring such misery. 'Tis almost amusing.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_026: Nevertheless, we must treat this villain with all seriousness. His rise to godhood and subsequent rule over a shattered world is clearly documented in the records.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_027: Kefka is a formidable mage, and a cunning one besides. Your tactics must account for both his power and his trickery.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_028: You've been working on a solution, yes? Will it be enough?
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_029: Will it be enough? Have you ever known me to do anything by halves?
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_030: The jester's face paint is a mask for his intent. If you only watch the surface, you'll be fighting at a disadvantage.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_031: To put it bluntly, Kefka will seek to deceive you. Even as you predict his actions and adjust your position, his true attack will reveal the feint for what it was.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_032:
This is where things become interesting...
I have tuned this monitor to allow me to observe the Sigmascape with greatly enhanced clarity.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_033: If I observe a discrepancy between Kefka's behavior and the impending attack, I will endeavor to warn you. The timing will be critical, of course.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_034: How confident are you of this strategy?
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_035: I predict a fifty percent chance of success! Any delay, however slight, in reacting to his feints will render my warnings all but pointless!
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_036: Isn't it exciting? There is no safe way to practice this, hero─we must test our tactics on the field of battle!
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_037: ...I'm afraid he's right. I'll lend you all the support I can from this side.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_038: Make what preparations you need, and head into the Sigmascape. We can't let this jester have the last laugh!
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_039: “Embrace your destruction... It is the fate of all things.”
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_100_039: “But people can always rebuild, and new lives will always be born!”
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_040: ...A fragmented conversation that accompanied Kefka's data. His was the first line, but there was no mention of who uttered the reply.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_A1_000_043: In life, there is always hope.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_045: ...Perhaps. I admire the idea of upsetting the status quo.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_046: Go on, champion. I tire of waiting for the fun to begin.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_047: ...How predictably forthright of you. I'm sure it was a hero much like yourself who gave the original response.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_048: Go on, champion. I tire of waiting for the fun to begin.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_049: ...Never mind. Go on, champion. I tire of waiting for the fun to begin.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_050: Let's see this through, . One battle at a time!
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_055: Are you asking my permission? By all means, let's get things underway.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_SYSTEM_000_061: Alpha is clearly poised to spring into action. You may enter Sigmascape V4.0 whenever you are ready.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_081: (-Omega-)<blip> This contest has been decided. Alpha group is victorious.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_082: (-Omega-)The Sigmascape test world will now be erased.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_083: Come on! We should go and find !
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_085: Talk to me, man! Are you hurt!?
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_086:
You could say that...
I had a “visitor” while you were attending your little Ironworks reunion.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_087:
Omega...
Damn it! We should never have left you alone. Not after what happened to Biggs and Wedge.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_088:
Hmph... As if I would trail along behind you...like some sniveling lapdog...
No, I chose to remain...and behold the results...
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_089: This was my victory! It was my ingenuity that defeated these foes! Even your precious Warrior of Light...<cough>...was just another variable in my grand experiments!
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_090: All right, Nero, save your strength. I'll fetch  and Alpha, and then we can get out of here.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_092: But you can't keep holding back... It's time to unfetter that brilliant mind of yours. To do what must be done.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_093: And I'm not just talking about what becomes of Omega.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_NERO_000_094: You cannot preach “Freedom through Technology” and keep yourself locked up in chains...
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_MIDGARDSORMR_000_10:
Another battle won...
Thy might knoweth no bounds, child of man.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_101: (-Omega-)<blip> The Sigmascape has been terminated. Congratulations, Alpha group. Congratulations, .
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_102: (-Omega-)Consistent with previous performances, you have once more defeated a foe of vastly superior combat capabilities. I have constructed a theory to explain this phenomenon.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_103: (-Omega-)In order to conserve life energy, you subconsciously limit your output during standard activity.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_104: (-Omega-)I have taken this factor into account when calculating your potential, but judging by the wild fluctuation in values, is it possible your limits are exceeded by an unpredictably high degree when engaged in battle?
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_105: (-Omega-)<bloop> Current data unreliable. Accuracy of further experiments may be compromised. Recalculations necessary.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_106: (-Omega-)You will exhibit your full potential, unrestricted by self-imposed limits.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_107: (-Omega-)Prediction. Placing subject in mortal peril will facilitate the collection of desired data.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_108: (-Omega-)Reveal your power. Let me measure the extent of your existence.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_109: (-Omega-)In precisely one hundred and eighty seconds, I will terminate your life. You are to attempt escape with every last reserve of strength you possess.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_110: (-Omega-)Alpha. Your participation is unnecessary. Do not interfere.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_MIDGARDSORMR_000_11: ...Curious. 'Twould seem the circumstances of thy birth taint not the purity of thy life. The seed which all mortals nurture is found within thee too, Alpha.

As for thee, Omega...
After the passing of eons, is this truly the extent of thine evolution? I have glimpsed the core of thy wretched existence, and judge that my guidance here is no longer needed...
Even I cannot fully bend the rules which govern this place. I have reached beyond my strength at the last...

But so be it.
Such a death becometh thee not!
To slumber shall I betake me for a time. The incarnation I leave with thee will be mine in form, but not in spirit.
Heed me, empty vessel. Thine all-too-clumsy effort to draw out that which─by thine own admission─defieth thine understanding is the very height of folly.

Temper thy desire. Trust to the results of thine experiments. And when thou hast witnessed these mortals in the fullness of their glory, then mayest thou determine if the prize thou seekest is thine for the taking...
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_OMEGA_000_119: (-Omega-)Acknowledged. Attempt to artificially elicit potential has failed. Tend to your injuries, Alpha group, and prepare for the next round of testing.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_120: ! Alpha! I need your help. It's Nero, he's─
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_121: ...'Twould seem we all have a tale to share. But not here. Come on, we're leaving!
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: ! The chief has already departed for Rhalgr's Reach. A few of our people were on hand to help him transport Nero.
Oh, and I was told to tell you that Jessie expects a full report as soon as it's convenient. And by that, she generally means “now.”
If you haven't spoken with Jessie yet, it's probably best not to keep her waiting! Not to worry: I'll keep curious travelers from tumbling into the Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_JESSIE_000_150: ! I was told you'd made it out of the hole, but nothing beats seeing you with my own two eyes.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_JESSIE_000_151: In case you're wondering, Nero was taken straight to the infirmary. The chief should be back soon with news if you don't mind waiting...
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_153: Not good. It seems one of Omega's nastier minions paid him a visit in our absence. He's putting on a brave face, but having seen his injuries, I'm surprised he kept going for as long as he did.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_154: The chirurgeon's confined him to bed. Even should Omega extend its next “invitation,” Nero won't be coming with us.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_155: ...Midgardsormr is taking a lengthy nap now, isn't he? And it won't be long before our base camp is lost to the rift again...
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_JESSIE_000_156: When the time comes, I'll join the expedition myself. The challenges will only get harder, and you'll need someone reliable at your back.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_157: I appreciate the offer, Jessie. And I may yet take you up on it...when the time comes.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_158: But let's not make any decisions just yet. I have a lot of thinking to do─about what's happened, and about what lies ahead.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_JESSIE_000_160: The poor thing. He seems worried...
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_A2_000_162: Thank you for trying to save me!
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_A2_000_163: Don't worry─we'll get Omega in the end.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_165: Well that got a smile out of him. We may not understand what he says, but I think we can understand how he feels.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_166: Right! Much as I'd like to stay and chat, we all have work to do. Sooner or later, we're going to have to face Omega itself, and we've all seen what it's capable of.
TEXT_STMBDR205_03035_CID_000_167: We need to be stronger. We need to be ready when Omega calls on us again. Let's make sure that we are.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_00: ! Where in the world have you been? Did you not receive Alma's summons? Principal Lexentale's research into the auracite may finally have borne fruit!
We must hurry to the Prima Vista before they embark on some grand and perilous adventure without us!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_01: In her message, Alma mentioned a guest from Sharlayan. Someone your companion Cid Garlond believed might be able to assist the Principal's research. An “archetype,” I think is the term she used.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_AIRSHIPGUIDE03003_0: If you would follow me to the shuttle, good .
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: , Lady Mewrilah. Thank you for answering my summons. Master Garlond was kind enough to send for an Archon from Sharlayan, and I thought it only right that you be present to hear her findings.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_101: To be frank, summoning Mikoto was more Y'shtola's idea. I simply came along to see what light she could shed on this mystery.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_102:
I am Mikoto of House Jinba─a Doman, though my years in Sharlayan have made me a stranger here. You must be ─fabled liberator of men. Slayer of false gods. Warrior of Light...
I thought you'd be taller.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_103: Let us speak of the crystal.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_10: The Otius─one of but many auracite shards that aided noble Delita's rise to regent.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_105: My apologies. The Otius is no ordinary crystal, even discounting its obvious historical importance. The specimen is more than a simple manifestation of elementally aspected energies─it is, rather, an aetherial lodestone whose facilitation of both the absorption and transmission of distinct-frequency NRR-type harmonic vibrations has been observed to promote aetherial amplification.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_106: The resultant neuro-harmonic disturbance allows for a highly unique emittance of CPRS waves that, instead of radiating outward with a determinate factor of dispersal, instead resonate inward at a frequency so labored, my estimates place the rate of VRT decay at upwards of several centuries...though I must admit I lack sufficient variates to complete a truly comprehensive graphical assessment.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_107: ...Hmph. While that explanation may elicit admiring nods from your professors at the academy, it will earn you only blank looks here. Take a deep breath and try again─this time in a language those of us without the Echo might comprehend.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_109: Apologies will see us no nearer to an answer. A simpler explanation will.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_110: Simpler... Right... Um... Aether is not only the building block of all things material, but those immaterial as well. Thoughts, memories, feelings, one's very will are all understood to be aetherial phenomena, and can be measured as such. Unlike most crystals, which only can emit elemental energies, auracite is tuned not only to absorb aether, but aether specific to the immaterial. That aether is then stored and multiplied within its crystalline confines until external stimuli precipitate release.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_112: Uh... Ahem. Under appropriate conditions, a strong will or desire can become imprinted upon the auracite and stored until fomentation, at which time the desire becomes manifest─
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Fomen...tation?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_114: What my studious young friend is trying to say is that the Otius takes one's deepest fantasies and makes them reality.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_115: Ah. Yes. Yes, that is...simpler. You...may choose to think of it as a process akin to that of summoning a primal.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_116: There being one marked difference─primal summoning requires a supplemental energy source, such as a hoard of elementally charged crystals. Auracite, on the other hand, has the capacity to serve as its own source of power.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: We know from the Durai Papers that Argath was never king of Ivalice. He was slain in battle during the War of the Lions.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_118: Yet the Argath encountered during the recent expedition carried himself as if he had been crowned regent. I believe this was merely the auracite in his possession making manif─uh, realizing his desire to rule.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_119: I am informed that he uttered the same words over and over again for the duration of the confrontation which unfolded. If that is the case, it is possible that it was not actually Argath who uttered them, but the auracite itself.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_120: If the Durai Papers are accurate, Argath was a weak and petty noble who believed that his blood entitled him to power. The auracite took that belief and twisted it into the abomination we─uh,  put to the sword.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: Then you are saying the crystal could prove a threat?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: The auracite, Alma. And not necessarily. Ramza seemed to fare well enough. There is no record of the young regent being manipulated by the artifacts he gathered.
In the hands of the just, the auracite should prove harmless, even beneficial!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_124: To paraphrase: “It is not the weapon that kills, but the one who wields it”?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_100_124: Now where have I heard that before...
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_125: Oh, yes. It was Emperor Galvus's justification for taking the marvels of magitek and applying them to the manufacture of arms. Where, after all, was the harm if it allowed him to “bring order” to the Three Great Continents?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_126: You draw an intriguing parallel, Master Garlond... The properties of these crystals are so singular, I do begin to wonder if they, like magitek, are products of science and not nature. That they were created by someone to─
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: But who? What manner of person would even be capable of such a feat?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_CID_000_128: Now that is an interesting question─the answer to which I look forward to hearing. Regrettably, I have pressing matters to attend to elsewhere. Fear not, however: Mikoto's insight will prove far more beneficial than anything I might accidentally contribute. Good day to you all.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_13: If the Duma was imprinted with Argath's deepest desires, then whose desires are rattling about inside the Otius?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_131: I had the selfsame question, and thus conducted a thorough inspection of the crystal upon my arrival. The results were...inconclusive. Traces of aetherial activity were present, but to all intents and purposes, the vessel was empty.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: Empty? But what of the voices I heard?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Voices? I heard nothing of the sort. The only voices you heard, Alma, were in your stubborn head!

Shall we speak of “voices,” then? What of yours, Alma? Our resident voice of dissent. You have done naught but question the wisdom of our research from the moment we left Garlemald. Would you put your petty worries above our family's calling?
You would never!? Then why involve a gossipmonger, a goody two-shoes, and this...this...flying mole!?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_100_: Please tell me you can see that.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_15: A moogle! And a decidedly dusty one at that! Might this be one of your acquaintances, ?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Don't just stand there, get rid of the thing! You're the liberator. Liberate this vessel of that pest!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: It's like nothing I have ever seen before... Can we keep it?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_300: Am I interrupting? Oh, please do go on. My acceptance into your fine troupe's ranks can wait until all have said their piece, kupo.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Guards! Get this, this, this─
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_302: (-Montblanc-)Montblanc. The name is Montblanc. Denizen of Dalmasca's deserts, seeker of thrills, adventurer extraordinaire. But you may call me Montblanc, kupo.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_303: Dalmasca has long been known as a melting pot for myriad cultures─where minor races such as the Seeq, the Bangaa, and the Viera might live in relative harmony with Hyur, Elezen, and others.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_304: Yet there is no record of a prominent moogle population.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_305: (-Montblanc-)Most likely because we are neither prominent nor populous! My people are nomadic by nature, ever drawn to the elusive frontier and the freedom she promises, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: A...moogle?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_307: (-Montblanc-)Of course I'm a moogle, kupo. You'd think the adorable wings and the fluffy pom would have given it away. Now, about my admission to the Majestic─
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: I will allow no such thing! The Majestic is the Empire's premier theater company. We will not sully its good name by granting refuge to a fluttering ball of fur!
