And furthermore, how in the world did this abomination board the Prima Vista in the first place!?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: By means of his wings, were I to guess. As for his admission to our company, I do not seem to recall race, creed, or allegiance on my list of prerequisites, do you?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: ...No, Father.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Very well, then. Montblanc, what is it exactly that calls you to the stage─our stage?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_313: (-Montblanc-)What else? The Zodiac Brave Story, kupo! Never before have I witnessed something so amazing. So moving.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_314: (-Montblanc-)Sitting─well, technically hovering there in the audience as the story unfolded around me...I knew I was witnessing something special. Something positively transcendental, kupo! It was then that I realized I either had to be a part of it...or go to my grave a bitter and broken moogle.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_315: Was this realization before or after you swore you simply had to become the realm's greatest marauder, kupo!?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_317: Perhaps you'd have more success at running away if you didn't reveal your grand designs to every other fool you happen to meet, kupo.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_318: Was it not but two score nights ago you took up the axe, kupo!? Now here you are professing your passion for the stage before carving even a single notch in your haft? Do you not remember, “to he who churns the butter goes the sweetest bread”?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_319: (-Montblanc-)But how is one to savor said buttered bread if his head is in the belly of a fearsome beast? You accuse me of giving up when I merely came to the realization that continuing would end in failure. Only through a change of course could I reach my final destination, kupo.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_320: And that destination is what? Mummer? Are you sure it is not geomancer? Arithmetician? Templar? Do not bother answering, kupo─we all know you'll be singing a different tune come cockcrow!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_321: (-Montblanc-)That is where you are mistaken, Hurdy. I was destined to be a thespian! I can feel it in my fur. The role of Delita was made for me! Made for me, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Kupo kupo kupo kupo! Enough!
The actors in our company trained at the Empire's finest institutes. They represent the pinnacle of the profession not only in Garlemald, but across the entire world.

A vagrant bat-mole like you could never hope to share a stage with such artists, let alone play the part of a hero like Delita! You yourself admitted you were too craven to face a solitary beast─how do you imagine you would fare against a pack of theater critics!? Any troupe would need proof of valor before it could even consider─
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_325: (-Montblanc-)Craven!? Call me a cheat and call me cur, but do not, sir, call me craven! I accept your challenge: slay but one foul beast by mine own hand, and the Majestic Theater Company will accept me into its ranks, kupo.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Wait, I issued no such─
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_327: (-Montblanc-)You are all here witnesses, kupo! When I return with the head of a terrible beast in my gore-stained hands, you will be honor-bound to welcome me, Montblanc the Mummer, into the fabled ranks of the Majestic! Good day!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_328: Wonderful. What do we do now?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: What do we do? We do nothing. If that bat-mole wishes to throw himself on the horns of a stampeding dzo, I will not stand in his way.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_330: I believe the proper term of derogation is “mole-bat,” and I should warn you: moogles do not take kindly to those who use it.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: Why must you always put yourself above others, Brother? Did you learn nothing from Argath's wretched example?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_332: Montblanc would never have set off on this fool's errand had you not made the challenge. If anything befalls my brother, his blood will be on your hands!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: ... You are the only one among us capable of locating Montblanc and preventing disaster. On behalf of my brother, I beg your assistance.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_33: However did Ramza come to be so thoroughly obnoxious? He and his sister couldn't be more different.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Moogles are prominent players in Ivalician legend, but none of the tales mention their capacity for flight. Something lost in translation, perhaps?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: I...I apologize. I must learn to control my anger. But sometimes...it can be difficult.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: You saw the poor moogle. He won't last a day on his own. You must find him and bring him back! I beg of you!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_340: My brother can be rather...simpleminded when it comes to such matters. Thinking to impress the Warrior of Light and  companions, Montblanc would likely choose the scene of your recent exploits to prove his worth─meaning Rabanastre, if I am not mistaken.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_34: Pardon my language, but that Ramza really is an incurable little prick, is he not? How dare he speak to his sister and the moogle in that manner. I couldn't decide which was worse─the things he said, or the way the principal sat back and let him say them.
But I suppose it is none of our concern. For now, let us concentrate on the task at hand─finding that moogle before he does something we'll all regret. What say we start nearby. Pier #2, perhaps?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_43: The falcon porter tells us that he set a traveling blacksmith away to Yanxia not a bell past. And why would that be of interest to us, you ask?
Because said peddler of iron and steel was seen to be carrying a bag stuffed to the brim with, and I quote, “albino mole fur and purple bat wings”!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_433: ...Not that we look like that, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_43: The quickest route into Dalmasca is via the One River and its western tributaries. If Montblanc is bound for Rabanastre, he will seek passage from the Glittering Basin.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_50: Have you any idea what you put your brother through!? He has been worried sick!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_502: Both Hurdy and Ramza were right all along. I am a failure. A flop. A flailing flapping foppish failure, kupo. How could I play the part of a hero if I cannot even ruffle the feathers of a single measly bird. The audience would see right through me like the spineless jellyfish I am.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_50: Now wait, Montblanc. Not everyone can be a hero...not even most heroes! Yes, the bards sing of the man who deals the final blow, but what of his cadre of loyal companions? Do you think Delita united Ivalice on his own? Do you think  here was alone when  liberated Ala Mhigo?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_A2_000_001: You're never alone on the battlefield.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_A2_000_002: Not all wars are won on the front lines.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_510: Never alone...? So you're saying you'll always be there for me? For Montblanc?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_HURDY_000_511: Uh... I think  was speaking metaphorically...
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_515: But of course they are not! Every campaign needs its brilliant architect─the mastermind who moves the pieces across the board! I, Montblanc, can be that mastermind!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_53: Let us not dwell on the details. The day is saved, and Montblanc has escaped sans scratch or singe to show for it. We should return to the Prima Vista before our luck runs out.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Please! This ship is a place of peace!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Release my sister or you will answer to me!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Put that damnable thing down, Ramza. You're not helping matters!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_BWAGI_000_604: We have no quarrel with you or yours. We only seek aid in finding our leader, Ba'Gamnan.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: You seek our help!? You who threatened to kill my father? Who stole his work and made fools of us all!? Never!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Silence, Ramza! They have Alma. We will hear what they have to say.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_BWAGI_000_607: As I said, we have no quarrel with you. We only did what was necessary to secure an audience. We surrender our weapons and offer your journal as an act of good faith.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: ...This is all rather a lot to digest. But your claims do coincide with what we have learned about the auracite.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_GIJUK_000_609: You're saying that crystal did something to our captain?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_610: After being emptied of Argath's will, the Duma sought that of another to sate its appetite for aether.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RINOK_000_611: You're saying that crystal ate our captain!?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_612: Not his body, no. Only his soul.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Tell me...what in your opinion was your leader's deepest desire? What was it that he longed for above all else in the world?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Why waste your breath reasoning with these...these...lizards? They showed themselves for the beasts they are when they put a knife to your throat!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MONTBLANC_000_616: First mole-bats, now lizards? This one's tongue is pure poison.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_BWAGI_000_617: The boy can call us what he pleases. For our past failings, we deserve no better.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_GIJUK_000_619: Thirty summers have come and gone...yet not a night goes by that I do not wake in sweat at the memory.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RINOK_000_620: We were fusiliers in the Dalmascan army, stationed in the royal stronghold at Nalbina.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Nalbina Fortress was reputed to be impenetrable. Its fall to the IVth Legion proved a turning point in the imperial campaign, dealing a crushing blow to Dalmascan morale and ultimately marking the beginning of the kingdom's end.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_BWAGI_000_622: Ba'Gamnan was our captain, and once it was clear the day would not be ours, Prince Rasler, commander of the garrison at Nalbina, tasked him with one final mission.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_BWAGI_000_623: Our unit was to escort His Highness's twin sister, the Princess Ashelia, away from the fortress and thence to safety. But...things did not go as planned...
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_GIJUK_000_624: I still remember the words she uttered as she lay dying in the captain's arms but a stone's throw from where the Garamsythe Waterway drains into the sea.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_GIJUK_000_625: Even as the fog of death descended upon her, she smiled and told us─the very people who had failed her─to survive, for as long as even a single Dalmascan stood, our nation would never truly perish.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RINOK_000_626: But it should not have been us who survived. By failing to protect our charge, we betrayed the princess and her memory, and brought shame upon our race. So yes, we are naught but cold-blooded lizards deserving of whatever scorn you deign to heap on us.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_627: Hmm... I think we may safely assume a deep-seated hatred towards the invaders of his homeland, coupled with self-loathing born from a sense of powerlessness.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_628: The darkness that lurks in the heart of Ba'Gamnan is little different from that which drove Argath─the selfsame emotions that were to nourish the Duma.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: She's saying your brave captain will eventually turn into a monster...or rather, more of one.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_LINAMEWRILAH_000_63: What they say is true. If we do not find Ba'Gamnan and the Duma soon, none of us are safe, present company included.
Do you have any idea where he might have gone? Any at all?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Wait, look at this! Something has been added to the final page of my journal!
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_BWAGI_000_635: Then the captain must have put it there. Only he had access to it─until we found it in the pack he left behind, that is.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RINOK_000_638: The lighthouse? Why would he write that, and in the old man's journal no less?
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_639: There is a place on the Valnard Sea, far to the south of Rabanastre, where the ocean tumbles into a gaping maw more than a malm across─the Ridorana Cataract.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_640: Legend would have us believe that it is the entrance to the Hell of Water.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_MIKOTO_000_641: Many a scholar seeking to prove otherwise has descended into the chasm─some even by airship─but not a one has returned.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Tell me, is Ridorana truly as magnificent as they say? ...Hm? You have never been there? And there I was thinking you might have something to contribute.
TEXT_STMBDI201_03089_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I must admit to knowing little of Ridorana save that which Lady Mikoto shared with us. Before we expend valuable time and resources traveling to so remote a place, I must review my notes and see if there is any mention of the abyss.
We shall share our findings as soon as we learn aught of interest.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Tell me, is Ridorana truly as magnificent as they say? ...Hm? You have never been there? And there I was thinking you might have something to contribute.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_WANDERINGWRITER_000:
“There's few so loath to take their rest
Than 'venturers without a quest,
For shorn of work to give them worth,
They soon become a source of mirth.”

I see I've struck a chord with you, my friend. My colleagues tell me that if one in this land ever needs an item fetched that you are the  to speak to. I find this philanthropic compulsion fascinating, and so─in the interests of research into my next play, let's say─I seek to put said compulsion to the test...
Assuming you are game, of course.
Bring me a bottle of wine. Ah, but not just any wine. Make it rose-themed. And make it Eorzean. I've had my fill of the bitter blends offered here in the East.
Where to start? Oh, if only there were some port where thirsty Eorzeans went for their wine, you would surely be there speaking with its foremost blind Lalafellin vintner, and not here with me.

Are you truly going to make me spell it out for you? Bah, all right. Go to Wineport in eastern La Noscea and speak with Shamani Lohmani. I am assured he is the region's leading authority. If he cannot point you in the direction of a proper drop, no one can.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: <sniff> <sniff> Soy and spice...sprinkled with a subtle soupçon of the steppe. You have traveled far, my friend. What is it you seek here in Wineport?

...A rose-themed wine? You would be hard-pressed to find a wine that did not display some hint of rose, so we can assume that your client was not referring to a desired bouquet. Perhaps a name, or a label, or─

A bottle. Yes, I seem to recall a certain vintage rosé sold in crystal bottles with a single red rose on the label. Alas, I have nothing as rare amongst my personal stock. As for who might...well, there's always Byrglaent, I suppose.
I would assume Byrglaent is where he always is─in his manor, fussing over his precious hoard.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BYRGLAENT_000_100: Pah! Only an uncultured fool would select a wine based solely on its bottle!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BYRGLAENT_000_101: As it happens, however, said fool would be undeservingly rewarded with one of Vylbrand's best wines were he to select a vintage Suhd Viandja. Not that your client would have the palate to properly appreciate its depth and complexity.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BYRGLAENT_000_102: But let us dispense with the pretense. You are the fool in question, and do not bother to deny it. A fool who has aimed too high. One of your standing could live a thousand lifetimes and still not amass the wealth required to purchase even an empty bottle.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BYRGLAENT_000_103: ...Oh, price is no object, is it? Hah! Even if I believed you─and, I do not─I have a reputation to uphold as a vintner and viticulturist. Were my clients to learn I was peddling the choice of my collection to the likes of you, they would never do business with me again!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BYRGLAENT_000_104: ...Bah! All right. Just to see the back of you, I shall do you the kindness of directing your steps unto one who might take pity on your plight─assuming he does not find amusement in it. Master Gegeruju of Costa del Sol. But do not tell him I sent you.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BYRGLAENT_000_130: While I will admit to having taken some pleasure in disappointing you the first time, I did not expect to be asked to repeat the feat.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BYRGLAENT_000_131: Did I not make myself clear? Now begone, or I shall summon the Yellowjackets. Costa del Sol is right where Master Gegeruju built it.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_150: ! It is always a pleasure, and I do mean that. My ladies inform me you come inquiring after a bottle of Suhd Viandja, but I told them they must be mistaken. Not even you would be foolish enough to think you could─
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_151: Oh, you are serious. Ah hah hah hah hah hah! , you do realize one could purchase an entire estate in Mist for the price of a single bottle. Or five estates for the price of five bottles─which happens to be the number of bottles of Suhd Viandja I have in my collection.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_152: Now, I am not an unreasonable man. Let none say the venerable Gegeruju does not value a friendship as deep as the one you and I have forged. So in my boundless generosity, I offer you the opportunity for a trade. A bottle of vintage Suhd Viandja for...a mere magnum of fine Dalmascan.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_153: Never heard of the stuff? And I thought I was talking to a fellow connoisseur! I pity the poor vintner back in Wineport who will have to educate you. Until then, my friend, the offer stands. Ah hah hah hah!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_180: If you seek to learn of Dalmascan wine, you could always go to Dalmasca...though Wineport is decidedly closer, and has yet to be reduced to dust. Ah hah hah hah!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: First Suhd Viandja, and now Dalmascan wine? Might I interest you in an aged Lominsan red instead?

No, I thought not. Well, then you have your work cut out for you. There was a time Dalmascan wine was fairly easy to procure, even here in Vylbrand, but that was before the Empire razed the better part of the kingdom, vineyards and all.

If there are any surviving bottles, it would be those that were exported before the imperial invasion...over thirty summers past, though I've not encountered any in a decade or more, either at auction or in private hands.

Collectors are covetous creatures. If one were to have somehow acquired a bottle, there is little chance he would willingly part with such a treasure...which leaves only those brought over by the few Dalmascan refugees who fled to Eorzea.

My good friend Drest once called Dalmasca home...but the scars left after the exodus have yet to fully mend. He may know something of the wine you seek, but I fear any mention of his past might reopen old wounds. Mayhap I should not have spoken. <sigh> I cannot prevent you from treating with the man, but if you do, I would ask that you show due compassion.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_DREST_000_250: Can't... Can't sleep... They won't let me... The midges won't let me... They buzz and they scream...
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_DREST_000_280: They scream as they burn... But I just stand there... Stand there and listen to their screams...their buzzing. Why won't it go away...? Why won't it go away!? Will someone please make it go away...?
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SYSTEM_000_290: Drest is haunted by his memories of the Garlean invasion of Dalmasca. Try and soothe him.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_DREST_000_300: You... I know you. You were here before. You sent away the midges... They came back, though... They always come back. They mock me. Tell me I can never go home... I just want to go home... I cannot stand it here anymore...
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_DREST_000_330: My son... My daughter... How will they survive without their father? They must be so frightened... I need to go home. Now. I cannot stay... Please...
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SYSTEM_000_340: Drest cannot bear the pain of being away from his homeland. Further comfort might help.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_DREST_000_350: Wine... My wife loved wine... We would drink a glass...a glass of Valens every night before sunset... She would always keep the cork... I always thought that odd... What good is a cork? Toss it in the midden heap along with the bottle, I'd say... But she... She...
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_DREST_000_380: Toss it in the midden heap along with the bottle, I'd say... Toss it away... Toss it away...
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SYSTEM_000_400: Though you find several empty wine bottles amongst the rubbish, one in particular calls out to you... Take it to Shamani Lohmani to confirm its origin.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: How is Drest? I do hope your visit did not disquiet the poor soul...
So you have brought me an empty bottle─ Ah, but what is this? The cork remains in place! That is most fortunate.
If an adequate seal was made, there may still be traces of the wine within! May I?
Flamboyant, yet elegant. A thought-provoking blend of kukuru beans and cinnamon, with just a hint of...is that rosemary? A veritable kaleidoscope of both opulence and refinement.

Long has it been since I last encountered a bouquet of such complexity, yet I recall it as if it were yesterday. Without question, this bottle once held a Dalmascan Lea Monde red by the name of Valens. To think I would have the opportunity to experience it again after so many summers...
...But I suspect Master Gegeruju will not be as satisfied with a sniff as I.
Now, one without scruples might see the empty bottle as the basis for a ruse─
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_506: One man's ruse is another man's keikaku!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_507: Over the years, I have had numerous dealings with the lord of Costa del Sol, and while he is many things, an expert on wines is not one of them.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_508: Not that it would matter if he were. Men of his standing invariably find more joy in boasting of their acquisitions than in consuming them. In all likelihood, Master Gegeruju will never even open the bottle, rendering the provenance of its contents practically irrelevant.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_509: Ah, but where are my manners? These forays back to western climes always bring out the barbarian in me. It is a pleasure, . Lest you wonder at my presence here, my employers see promise in the Hingan wine trade, and desire the establishment of a viable route 'twixt east and west. I am come to see their plan to fruition.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_510: But returning to your dilemma, I believe that I may be of assistance. I just so happen to have on my person several sample bottles of Hingan wine made with grapes similar to those once found in Dalmasca. For a close acquaintance, I would be more than willing to part with one that  might fill  empty vessel.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: But that would be...unjust! As a maker of wine, I cannot allow it!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_512: Master Gegeruju has cozened more of his clients than he can count. How do you think the man amassed his fortune? By playing fair? Would that the world were thus. But I am here to tell you it is not.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_513: So! It is decided then. We shall employ deceit as our morally justified means to a happy end.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: W-Wait! This is a fool's errand!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_515: Then let us be glad our quarry is a fool himself!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_HANCOCK_000_516: Now, if you will excuse me, I must go and tell the gentle citizens of Wineport why they should be drinking Hingan. Good day!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: <sigh> I saw nothing. Nothing at all.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_600: By the gods... You actually found one? A bottle of Dalmascan wine!? Oho! We must uncork it right away!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_620: Mmm...yes... A lush bouquet of...herbaceous...dignification, coupled with...earthen undertones...and, uh...so forth...
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_621: ...In short, the very epitome of a Dalmascan red! Yes, you have outdone yourself this time, !
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_622: And a promise is a promise. Ladies! The bottles of Suhd Viandja, if you please!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_623: Take whichever you fancy...except for the one with the rose. That is my favorite. Or...whichever you fancy. Ahem.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_GEGERUJU_000_650: Away with you, adventurer. After enjoying a glass or three of this tantalizing tonic, I mean to fill the bottle with some cheap Hingan swill I just purchased from a representative of the East Aldenard Trading Company, recork it, and then sell it to one of my rivals in Ul'dah for a ridiculous profit! Wah hah hah hah hah!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_WANDERINGWRITER_000: They say a rose is a rose is a rose. So tell me, adventurer, is that a rose in your pocket, or are you simply here for small talk?
A bottle of vintage Suhd Viandja!? You never cease to amaze!

But what is most amazing is your impeccable sense of timing. Today marks the twelfth anniversary of the day I met my dear wife... And if there was one thing she loved more than wine, it was roses. <sniff> Would that she were here today to...to...
Ah, but I jest. My wife is very much alive. In fact...
She's been here with us all along! Darling, would you care to join us?
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_00: For me? How thoughtful! But did you─
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_WANDERINGWRITER_000: Forget the most important gift of all? Of course not!
Bacon bread! The perfect companion to a perfect wine...for my perfect companion.
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_00: Oh, darling...I think this might be our best anniversary yet!
TEXT_STMBDI202_03090_WANDERINGWRITER_000: That played out better than I imagined. I suppose I have you to thank, adventurer. Though, it was the bacon bread that sealed the deal...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RAMZALEXENTALE_200_: If there is aught to discover, my father and I will discover it. You can be sure of that.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Our studies reveal that Ridorana is the name of both a massive gap in the southern Valnard Sea, and the lighthouse once manned by the Royal Dalmascan Navy to prevent ships from succumbing to the cataract's currents.

I stress “once manned” as the tower has lain empty since its candlekeeps abandoned their posts after the fall of Rabanastre. But if Pharos Sirius offers any indication of what can befall a lighthouse in the absence of its caretakers...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Yes, but the real question is how all of this ties in with Ivalician legend.
A cursory examination of the Zodiac Brave Story reveals no mention of a “Ridorana.”
Yet it seemed foolish to assume that a name could not change in the centuries since the tale was writ.
So I thought to cross-reference texts on modern Ilsabardian history with our translations of the Durai Papers.
And after an exhaustive re-examination of my ancestors' notes, I discovered that there was not a single entry on Ridorana.
And while mention of the Valnard Sea was abundant, I found no reference whatsoever to any cataract or lighthouse within its waters!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: ...Ramza's discovery prompted me to examine the mystery from a different perspective. What if there were no mystery at all? What if, at the time of Delita's rise, the chasm did not yet exist?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: There is more...but only a visit to the lighthouse will enable us to confirm our theories with any certainty.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_LINAMEWRILAH_000_04: More? Why the sudden reluctance to reveal their suspicions? A lack of certainty never stopped Ramza from pronouncing on things in the past. Or his father, for that matter.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: It is as Ramza said: only by visiting the lighthouse will we be able to confirm our theories.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_ALMALEXENTALE_000_0: We are bound for the lighthouse, then? Of course we are. But do not try and tell me this has anything to do with helping the Bangaa.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MONTBLANC_000_053: Our first adventure! How exhilarating! Who invited me, you ask? Why, uh, that tall one over yonder...with the face, kupo.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_HURDY_000_055: Do not be fooled by my brother's false bravado. We are from a tribe of desert moogles, many of us never having seen more than an oasis pond, let alone an endless ocean. The mere sight of water should be enough to frighten him back to the airship.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BWAGI_000_058: If anything were to happen to the captain, I...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_GIJUK_000_060: I am not afraid to speak what my brothers are thinking─the captain was a fool to believe that the Duma could bring back our fallen. Now his faith in legends and faerie tales will be his end.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RINOK_000_063: We do not ask that you forgive the past actions of our leader, only that you show him the same kindness that you would anyone in need.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: The Ridorana Lighthouse lies far from civilization. You would be wise to provision for the trip here in Hingashi.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_A1_000_002: An adventurer usually comes prepared. I shall return soon.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Let us not tarry. If the Duma has gotten into that damnable lizard's head, we may have another fight on our hands.

Mayhap it is best if we split our fellowship into two parties─one to delve into the tower's depths, and one to...observe from afar. As acting expedition subleader, I appoint you captain of the first. You may use this spyglass to aid in your search for the missing lizard.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I understand you are a  of many obligations, but I trust you will not leave my son down there without your steel to protect him.
Of course. But please make haste.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_LINAMEWRILAH_000_33: The lighthouse looks like it has seen better days. I daresay we have a handful of imperial dreadnaughts and thirty years of disrepair to thank for that.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MONTBLANC_000_335: Sh-Sh-Sh-Shivering? M-M-M-Me? My fur is s-s-simply s-s-standing on end from all the, uh...ambient aether! Yes, ambient aether in the area. C-C-Can't you feel it, kupo?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BWAGI_000_340: Where in the king's name are you hiding, Captain...?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_GIJUK_000_345: Don't worry, Captain! This lot are with us! They won't hurt you!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RINOK_000_350: Captain! Captain! Give us a sign!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: Why are you alone? Where is my brother!? Is he hurt!?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_HURDY_000_365: He's dead, isn't he? I knew it. I knew it, kupo... He was so young... So young!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_SYSTEM_000_320: This location appears to offer an adequate view. Climb up and scan the area for any sign of Ba'Gamnan.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BWAGI_000_400: You've found him? Let me see!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BAGGAMONAN_000_402: Prince Rasler... Princess Ashelia... I know you cannot forgive me...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BAGGAMONAN_000_403: ...Nor should you. It is all my fault. I could not save you─could not save anyone... Anyone but myself. I am so sorry...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BAGGAMONAN_000_405: Traitors! Have you no pride!? You treat with the very men who laid waste to our homeland!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_GIJUK_000_406: You are mistaken, Brother! There are no imperials here! We've come to help!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BAGGAMONAN_000_407: I know what I see! My own kin sided with the enemy. How dare you stay my audience with the princess!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MONTBLANC_000_409: It has him, kupo! It's showing him what he wants to see!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BAGGAMONAN_000_414: (-The Duma-)Recite the words. Satisfy the covenant. Relinquish thy soul unto me, and be granted that which thou desirest most in all the world...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BAGGAMONAN_000_415: Sword in hand...a warrior...clutches stone to breast...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BWAGI_000_416: Look at me, Brother! LOOK AT ME!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RINOK_000_420: We promised we'd all go together when our time came. You can't leave us here!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: That light... Where have I seen it before...? Oh no.
Whatever you are doing, you need to leave the lighthouse right away. Right away, do you hear!?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_LINAMEWRILAH_000_43: There can be no doubt now─in the wrong hands, the auracite is a danger to us all. Something must be done. And quickly.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Had Ba'Gamnan not stolen the Duma, he would still be alive today, and we would not be faced with confronting another Lucavi. The lizard only has himself to blame.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_ALMALEXENTALE_000_4: According to Father, the Durai Papers speak of the auracite as a “holy stone.” But I see nothing holy in what it did to Argath and Ba'Gamnan.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MONTBLANC_000_445: I was fully prepared to fend off the abomination when he vanished, kupo... I daresay he took one look into my eyes and lost the will to fight.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_HURDY_000_450: I think my brother has had more than enough fun for one day, kupo. Perhaps it's time for a Sleep spell... All right, make it Sleep III.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_BWAGI_000_455: I cannot─will not─believe that there is nothing left of Ba'Gamnan in that...that creature. We can still save him. We can!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_GIJUK_000_460: The captain's dead... I saw the light leave his eyes. And now we're alone...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_RINOK_000_465: Don't you tell me he's gone! He's not! He's stronger than that! He's the strongest Bangaa you'll ever meet. He'll tear his way out of that Lucavi and crush it under his foot!
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: ...It is as we feared, then. Ba'Gamnan's soul is lost.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_050_000: All that I know about Ridorana, I learned during my lessons on Dalmascan geography─but no mention was made of Ivalician legend. While Principal Jenomis seems convinced of a connection, I believe I shall reserve judgment until more is known.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_010_001: Beyond that, is there aught you wish to know?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_070_000: ...? Why are you not with the others? Were you not entrusted with their protection? I can only assume that they have found some manner of safe haven...and that you are here to partake of my knowledge prior to continuing with the expedition.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_070_001: So...what is it that you wish to know?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_080_000: A most interesting twist. I had assumed the auracite would act more swiftly upon the weak-willed, but mayhap I was mistaken. Could it be that the opposite is true? That those possessed of a strong will are more susceptible to its influence, not less? <sigh> There are so many questions...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_090_001: ...But we are not entirely without answers. Is there aught else you wish to know?
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_A3_000_003: Tell me of the Ridorana Lighthouse.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_700: In simple terms, I know. From what I have been able to discern, auracite displays the uncanny ability to draw upon the will of its possessor and manipulate the formless aether into a corporeal manifestation. The resultant form can be maintained for as long as there is aether to sustain it.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_701: Principal Jenomis has recently uncovered evidence which appears to corroborate my suspicion that auracite is not a naturally occurring substance, but one created to serve a purpose─albeit a purpose I have yet to identify.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_720: Despite being in the principal's possession for an extended period, the Otius exhibits none of the aetherial imprinting present in the Duma. In other words, the auracite has yet to absorb any of Lord Jenomis's aether.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_721: It is, for want of a better description, “empty.” Be that as it may, we still have no idea how it might be filled, its creators having neglected to include a removable stopper. Ahem.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_740: As you saw in the ruins of Lesalia, the Duma makes manifest the desires of its owner─on that occasion, Argath Thadalfus.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_741: When you defeated the would-be king, his aether was released from the auracite and the attunement broken, rendering the crystal empty once more.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_760: As you saw in the ruins of Lesalia, the Duma makes manifest the desires of its owner─at that time, Argath Thadalfus.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_761: When you defeated the would-be king, his aether was released from the auracite and the attunement broken, rendering the crystal empty once more.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_762: Until, that is, Ba'Gamnan seized the Duma, providing it with new desires upon which to feed.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_763: Whether Ba'Gamnan attuned himself to the auracite or the auracite attuned to him...is a question I am unprepared to answer. If pressed, however, I would venture that the will of a third party is at work here...
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_780: There is a place on the Valnard Sea, far to the south of Rabanastre, where the ocean tumbles into a gaping maw more than a malm across─the Ridorana Cataract.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_781: Legend would have us believe that it is the entrance to the Hell of Water.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_782: Many a scholar seeking to prove otherwise has descended into the chasm─some even by airship─but not a one has returned.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_783: Balanced on the lip of the raging gulf sits a tiny islet atop which rises an ancient lighthouse─its origins unknown.
TEXT_STMBDI203_03091_MIKOTO_000_784: For centuries, the tower was manned by Dalmascan candlekeeps who labored from dusk till dawn to warn sailors of the perilous drop. Since the kingdom's annexation, however, the structure has lain vacant...assuming it has not been claimed by the island's wildlife.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Much as I wish it were otherwise...I fear Ba'Gamnan is beyond saving. Yet we cannot suffer what is left of him to become a distraction.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: Father. Is now not the time to abandon this quest? We are meddling with forces beyond─
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_:
Enough, Alma. We adults are talking.
While  was searching for the lizard, I inspected an area of exposed foundation at the base of the lighthouse.
And you were right, Father! The lighthouse is built squarely atop the ruins of what can only be...the Clockwork City of Goug!
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_MIKOTO_000_155: According to the Zodiac Brave Story, the Clockwork City of Goug was a metallic metropolis wherein airships, automata, and other technological marvels of the age were first conceived. Little is said about its location, however, save that it was far away.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: While the Durai Papers do not say a great deal more, they do mention that the land upon which the legendary city was built was severely limited─an inconvenience that forced its inhabitants to build up, rather than out.
Which led me to ask myself: what if the reason land was limited was because the land in question was an island?

But that still would not explain the omission of the cataract. It is inconceivable that the authors would neglect to mention so prominent a landmark had it existed. And then I found it─a lone passage regarding Goug's fall. While the particulars were missing, it appears the city was abandoned after an explosion left half of it in ruin.

I believe that this explosion may have undermined a portion of the seabed. It need only have been a small area at first─one that could well have gone unnoticed during the exodus. As time passed, however, the waters would have continued to wear away at the rock, slowly widening the gap until...
Well, until we have what lies beneath us today. This would explain why there is no mention of Ridorana prior to the present era.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: ...Come, Father─will you not tell them the rest? Of the possibility that we Garleans are descended in part from the displaced citizens of Goug?
It would explain how the Empire was able to forge its armies of iron even before the discovery and application of Allagan technology.

And it may also explain why the legend of Ivalice has resonated with our people for centuries, despite the fact that the lost kingdom was, as far as we can tell, in quite a different corner of the world.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_MIKOTO_000_164: An interesting...if somewhat ambitious theory. But to return to your original claim, it is your belief that the Ridorana Lighthouse stands atop what is left of─
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_BWAGI_000_165: That necklace! Where did you get it, girl?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: It was my late wife's most cherished possession. Why do you ask?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_BWAGI_000_168: Ba'Gamnan had a talisman he would wear beneath his jerkin. He refused to take it off, even when bathing. He said it was...special. I only saw it a few times, but it looked exactly like the one your daughter wears.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: And? What are you implying, lizard? That my sister stole it? Or my late mother!?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_BWAGI_000_170: Neither. I spoke of their similarity. That is all.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_LINAMEWRILAH_000_17: Can you believe the nerve of this boy?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Enough, Ramza. Our guests are merely concerned for the well-being of their kin.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: But what of our kin!?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: What of them, Ramza!? Do you imagine our kin to be better than theirs in some way? Or anyone else's for that matter!?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: I...I apologize, Father.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: We have but one purpose, son, and that is to prove the existence of Ivalice and clear our family's name. Do not allow anger or hate to lead you from that path. Now, we have a lost city to explore!
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Mother's necklace... But what is it doing here? Unless─
Alma? Alma, are you there?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Extraordinary. The stones are different, but the craftsmanship is identical. However did it come to be in Ba'Gamnan's possession?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_MIKOTO_000_603: Hmm...though they are indeed of a different shape, the stones appear to be cut from the same crystal.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Auracite? And what makes you say that?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_MONTBLANC_000_606: Can't you feel it? You can feel it, can't you, Hurdy.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_BWAGI_000_607: Do you recall me telling you that Ba'Gamnan considered the necklace special?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_BWAGI_000_608: It was special because it was entrusted to him by Prince Rasler. He was to return it to Princess Ashelia upon delivering Her Highness from Nalbina Fortress.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Of course! And each necklace─each auracite─has acted as a lodestone, drawing both of our parties closer and closer to Ivalice.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Indeed, Father. The auracite guides us.
Thank you, Sister. I am well now.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_MIKOTO_000_614: From what we know of the Duma and the Otius, vestiges of one's will may endure in an auracite. Could it be, then, that the desire of the former owner─or creator─of these necklaces was simply to...return to Ivalice?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_LINAMEWRILAH_000_61: But who could that have been?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Ramza. Ramza Beoulve. He wanted people to return to his homeland and uncover the truth behind the kingdom's founding!
But then why show us Lesalia and Goug, you ask.
Simple. We are being tested. The auracite is measuring our worth─seeing if we are deserving of that truth.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_LINAMEWRILAH_000_61: You say these things as if you knew them. But how could you? Nothing we have uncovered suggests anything of the kind.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: I know you have your doubts, but I can assure you they are misplaced. For now, I must ask you to trust me, Lady Mewrilah.
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_LINAMEWRILAH_000_62: Lady Mewrilah? Since when did you─
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_ALMALEXENTALE_000_6: Ramza, are you feeling quite yourself?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Of course I am, Sister dearest. I have never felt better!
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_MONTBLANC_000_624: I sense a disturbance in the aether...
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Father. These necklaces are gifts. Gifts from the old gods who once watched over the Ivalicians. It is proof we have their blessing! With the necklaces and the Otius, we can finally prove─
Thank you, . I know not what came over me...
Leave me be, Alma. Did I not tell you I'll be fine?
TEXT_STMBDI204_03092_LINAMEWRILAH_000_70: Another adventure under our belts, eh, ? I'd best put pen to page before the details fade.
Lesalia...and now Goug. One would think our discoveries more than sufficient to prove the Lexentales' claims, at least with regard to Ivalice's existence.
But something tells me that until Jenomis has proof that his ancestors were not the heretics the church painted them to be, he will not rest.
And then there is the curious case of Ramza. At Alma's throat one moment, all “sister dearest” the next.

He was like a different person when he came to, yet I seem to be alone in wondering exactly what happened to him back at the lighthouse. If you ask this “Lady,” he must have taken quite some bump to the head when he fell.
Then again, it didn't take him long to turn back into his spiteful little self, so...all's well that ends well?
TEXT_STMBDI211_03093_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_10: I am sure you are aching to take the weight off your feet after so long and arduous a journey─but my husband seeks an audience.
You must forgive the man. He can be a trifle...demanding at times, but I assure you he means no ill.
I am sure you are aching to take the weight off your feet after so long and arduous a journey─but my husband seeks an audience. Humor him, I prithee...for me?
TEXT_STMBDI211_03093_WANDERINGWRITER_000: A beacon built atop the ruins of a lost city, you say? I would so like to hear more of this latest adventure...
But to do so sans refreshment would be in poor taste, indeed. I shall send for an assortment of viands and a bottle of my finest.
Then again, why send a minion to do the job of a master? Before me stands a  in a class all  own when it comes to matters of procurement...as you amply proved earlier.

After decades of experimentation, I have found that naught save the freshest of freshly baked bacon bread can truly be said to complement my vintage collection. So, shall we say...ten loaves? And none of that day-old stuff. Only the highest quality will do. Understood?
TEXT_STMBDI211_03093_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_00: My beloved's obsession with bacon runs deep. There was a time when he would cure and smoke his own meat here on the Prima Vista...that is, until the Principal forbade it after being forced to replace half of the company wardrobe due the smell.
From both the principal and my husband I've heard mention of a “blight” brought about by the auracite. Could that portal we just witnessed be a means of spreading it?
No... Now is not the time for idle speculation. You must focus your efforts on the task at hand.
You rescued Alma only to watch as Ramza was taken in her stead? Promise me, ! Promise me you will see this right!
We must do something, ! Anything! We cannot let it end like this. Tia would never forgive us...
Our thanks, . If aught ill had befallen Ramza, his mother would have risen from the Lifestream to haunt us for all eternity. Oh, you presume I jest?

"Lord Dycedarg and the duke would use her as a pawn in their game of thrones! Just as the two of them now use you! Is a man like you not ashamed to be no more than a piece in their game? Have you no pride―no honor?“
Hmmm... There is something lacking in the delivery. A touch more tempered fury, perhaps. A sidelong glance into a swift turn and then─ Ah, . Simply practicing my lines.
TEXT_STMBDI211_03093_WANDERINGWRITER_000: I imagine one with your myriad talents could procure ten loaves of high-quality bacon bread without a second thought. Mayhap I should have asked for a score...?
Tell me, what is that breathtaking aroma? The bouquet of roasted grain and sweet cream butter, accented by the subtle tang of woodsmoke... Could it be...?
Ahhh, it is! Bacon bread─and of a quality seldom seen outside the realm's most decorated bakeries. So armed, we can at last celebrate the latest of your unparalleled achievements. A toast!

And yes, your reward. You must forgive me, for all I have to offer are these cracked crystals found on one of my wanderings through the ancient thoroughfares of Mhach. If you do not care for them, feel free to throw them away. I shall not be in the least offended.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_001: How kind of you to pay us a visit, . Now I need not summon you.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_002: But a moment ago, a certain surly cat returned with another missive addressed to you. See for yourself...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_003: (-Genbu's Missive-)Brave adventurer who stood fast and quelled the raging aramitama of my comrade, Byakko. The time has come for you to return to Reisen Temple.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_004: I presume the auspices of Hells' Lid have need of you once more? If so, give my regards to them and dear Soroban.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_010: Well met, , well met! But wait─where is the little urchin girl of whom I have grown so fond?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_011: It would be remiss of us to proceed without her, would it not? Why not summon her with that trinket of yours, your linkpearl?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_013: (-Tataru-)...Huh? Right now? Very well, if you insist...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_014: What wondrous things, these linkpearls. Now then─let us wait until your friend arrives...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_016: Ah, good of you to join us, little urchin girl.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_017: ...You know, there is such a thing as running a joke into the ground.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_018: It pleases me to inform you that thanks to your assistance with his training, Soroban's strength has grown by leaps and bounds. Ere long we may count him among our most formidable warriors.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_019: Out of curiosity, where is Soroban anyway?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_020: Engrossed in a very special exercise, I'm afraid. Trust me when I say he would not want you to see him in his current state.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_021: Working up a sweat no doubt. Glad to hear it!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_022: But I called you here not to discuss our Kojin friend.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_023: The wards have grown weaker, presaging Koryu's inevitable escape.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_024: Before he breaks free, the Four Lords must marshal their strength.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_025: And so, , I must entreat you to quell the raging aramitama of a dear comrade once more.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_026: A fight, is it? That's where our Warrior of Light shines! Who's  opponent this time?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_027: See for yourself. She should be joining us shortly...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_028: (-???-)It has been too long, elder brother.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_029: Several hundred years, by my reckoning. Am I to assume you have kept your silent vigil all this time, Suzaku?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_030: ...Let us not speak of such things. You bade me come hither for another purpose.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_031: That I did. Koryu's wards grow weaker by the day, and the calamity he would visit upon us draws nigh. The Four Lords must join their strength together once more.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_032: And to that end, this warrior would unburden my tortured soul.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_033: Just so.  is a power far surpassing that of mortal men.  is heir to the legacy of Tenzen.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_034: Brother! How dare you compare this creature to that shining paragon of virtue, of kindness! You sully his memory...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_035: And you! You dare think yourself his equal? His better!? Then I will put you to the proof. And when you fall, it will be a fate most deserved.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_100_035: Turn back if you would not have it be so. Or join me in misery.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_100_035: Compared to Byakko, she seems much more...angry...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_036: The aramitama feeds upon her grief and fuels her rage. She yet mourns a love lost...but it is not my place to speak. Go to her, brave warrior, and learn the truth of her heart.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_040: Do let me know how Soroban is doing. We cannot help but worry about him, even if we know he is in good hands.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_000_045: You are returned, then? Good. Genbu is looking for you.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_050: You crave battle, then. Even if it brings you your death.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_051: ...Out of duty you pit yourself against enemies ever stronger. Without hesitation, without fear, you muster your courage, and...and...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_052: No! You are not even a pale shadow of his glory! There was but one man fit to wear the mantle of hero, and he has long since passed from this world...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_100_052: If so, then the Ruby Sea will be consumed by Koryu's fiery judgment, and we, her sworn protectors, will have failed in our duty. Is Tenzen's memory so sacred that you would doom this land out of spite?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_053: Oh Byakko, do you not see? Before I called you brother, I was but a bird who loved a man. Perhaps that was all I was ever meant to be, for I can brook no replacement at my side or in my heart. Not so easily as you...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_100_053: Have you forgotten his final moments? How he fought and died to defeat Koryu─how he sacrificed himself before our very eyes?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_200_053: How dare you ask me that! Every detail is forever seared in my mind's eye─a blackened scar upon my soul! How could I possibly forget!?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_300_053: Nor should you! Nor will I forget every day we spent together on the road. But to exalt the past over the present, to live life in mourning and never move on is to dishonor his memory!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_400_053: How dare you speak to me of dishonor! You who have opened our home to this pretender! I see  plainly, how  has wormed  way into your hearts, mimicking Tenzen's manner, cloaking  in his scent, seeking to supplant Tenzen in our minds!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_500_053: Listen to yourself, my sister. The aramitama has driven you to see oni in shadows. Let it be quelled, before your soul is forever lost.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_600_053: Only to Tenzen will I entrust my soul! Only his love will I accept!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_A1_000_002: You have nothing to fear from me.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_055:
He said...he said... Oh, Tenzen...
Very well! But I will brook no delay!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_057: I will await you in the depths─in my place of mourning. And when it is ended, I shall mourn you too...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_000_059: Forgive her, . She is yet consumed by her failure to save Tenzen all those years ago. Her regret is as a festering wound.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_100_059: The love she bore him gave her strength once. Alas, through it the aramitama has found purchase in her soul. It feeds on her grief and despair.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_200_059: 'Tis plain that your presence troubles her as well. She senses your blessing, and it reminds her of him. There were moments when she looked on you with a fire in her eyes...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_300_059: When she gives herself to the aramitama, she may surrender to her delusions as well. If so, do not be alarmed by what she says. Stand fast and free her from her torment.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_400_059: Be warned: she commands many powers, including the ability to manipulate geomantic currents. Only by remaining observant will you survive.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_060: Forgive her, my friend. She knows not what she says...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_065: Be careful, . I don't think she's going to go quietly...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_000_070: Our dear sister, Suzaku, has returned. I pray she will hear reason this time.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_000_075: Remember: do not lose sight of your surroundings when you face Suzaku. If you would overcome the trials she sets before you, you must remain observant.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_090: ...How long have I been blinded by this dream? This never-ending nightmare, unable to escape the memory of my beloved...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_091: I owe you an apology, brave warrior, as well as my life. In spite of the crude and disrespectful way I treated you, you nevertheless risked your life to free my heart from the terrible delusion which threatened to consume my soul.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_092: For the first time in centuries, I can reflect on my time with the man I so deeply loved without being driven to tears...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_093: I was born into this world long, long ago, blessed with crimson plumage that shone like blazing fire in the sun.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_094: My form was likened to that of the Firebird of legend, a being said to have the power to confer immortality upon mortal men.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_095: Thus was I pursued endlessly by those who yearned to conquer death. To them─to all mankind, I was no more than a means to an end...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_096: But Tenzen...Tenzen, did not look upon me so. To him, I was so much more...and he would become everything to me...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_097: Together we traveled, we Four Lords and the samurai. As comrades-in-arms we journeyed the realm. Feared at first by many for our nature...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_098: But Tenzen, dear Tenzen, would not close his heart to the people's plight. Not once did he hesitate to proffer a helping hand, and one by one he won over those who once cursed and condemned us.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_099: Be there oni in the east to slay, or revenants in the west to exorcise, without hesitation would he bid us rise to the challenge, and leave grateful men and women to spread word of our deeds. Word which, one day, reached the ears of a king...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_100: 'Twas by the king's order that we battled the mad auspice Koryu. Despite the many deeds to our credit, we four had only lived some few centuries, and were no match for our foe.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_101: Against the might of Koryu's raging aramitama, my brothers and I were powerless. But Tenzen...brave Tenzen, he would not be denied. At the last he unleashed a powerful technique, knowing full well that it would leave him exposed...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_102: I watched as the light left his eyes forever...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_103: Had I been the Firebird of legend...had I been possessed of the power of immortality! Had I been able to rescue him from death's obsidian abyss...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_104: And then, the cruelest irony of all. Centuries later, when I finally went through the change, immortality became mine to command. I can but wonder if my bottomless grief for my beloved made it so.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_105: The power for which I yearned so desperately that day is now mine. If not to save him, then perhaps...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_106: ...Then perhaps to save those for whom Tenzen died.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_107: For the memory of my beloved, for his legacy, I shall fight. Let us go and tell Genbu together. And ...thank you.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_FURI_000_108: Headed to the surface? Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_FURI_200_108: Need a guide back to the temple? 'Course you do! Follow me!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_110: Oho, I see you are still in one piece. I gather all went well?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_111: Rest assured, elder brother, that I am myself once more.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_112: You certainly seem different from before! As if a great weight has been lifted from your shoulders. Your face is the very picture of serenity, I'd say!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_113: How very perceptive you are, little one. Indeed, I have at long last come to accept the passing of my beloved Tenzen...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_000_114: At long last indeed! But perhaps such prolonged periods of distress are unavoidable when one lives for more than a thousand years. I myself am no stranger to melancholy.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_115: ...No, my brother, that you most certainly are not.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_116: Oh, how forgetful of me! I have yet to see how Soroban's training is coming along.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_118: W-Wait, I know this joke! Ahem!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_119: Ohoho! No, genre-savvy urchin, for it is, in fact...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_121: I mean...I expected him in some capacity, but not like this...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SOROBAN_000_122: No one told me that this training would lead to such a radical transformation! Look at me! I'm a giant tortoise! A tortoise!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_123: ...I was wrong. This is the very definition of running a joke into the ground.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_124: There's no need for panic, Soroban. You probably just recited the words improperly and offered your body as a vessel for a great tortoise kami.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SOROBAN_000_125: That seems to me like a very, very good reason for panic! Unless...I will return to normal after a short while? Like with the tamate-bako of geomancy?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_126: Ah, well...I cannot say with any significant degree of certainty, but you might regain your original form by the time  quells Seiryu's aramitama.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SOROBAN_000_127: Might? Might!? What is this “might”? “Might” is not an acceptable answer!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_128: You must be exhausted from your battle with Suzaku, my friend. Perhaps it would be best if you returned to the land above and took a rest.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_129: He's right. I doubt we will be needed here for some time, and Soroban seems to be in no mood for company. Be sure to contact me if anything comes up!
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SOROBAN_000_130: I had been meaning to return home, even if only briefly, but given my current state, that seems unlikely. If you could go in my stead and tell the elder I am...hale and healthy, I would be most grateful.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_TATARU_000_135: How did your battle with Suzaku go? Is she still being...difficult?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_000_140: Is it true that in the West Lalafells are hunted for sport? 'Twas a strange tale related to me from a fellow auspice who overheard foreign adventurers in Yanxia...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_145: Long did I question why I had been granted this power over life and death too late to save my beloved.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_146: Now I understand: to carry on Tenzen's legacy, to save those for whom he gave his everything. Thank you for helping me to realize this, .
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_150: Ah, . All is well with our friends beneath Hells' Lid? What of Soroban? How goes his training?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_151: He...failed to perform a ritual correctly and was transformed into a tortoise, you say? But you are aware that... Oh, I see. This must be some manner of Eorzean joke. How very amusing.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BUNCHIN_000_152: A pity we will not see him again for the foreseeable future, but I will trust it is for the best, as before. He should take as much time as required─he is a tortoise, after all! Hah hah...hah... Hmm. No, it still makes no sense to me...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_GENBU_000_155: You needn't worry about Soroban. He will be fine. Eventually. Probably.
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SOROBAN_000_160: Have I truly become host to a great kami? What if it does not wish to leave?
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SUZAKU_000_165: Oh, my beloved, I pray you yet watch over me...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_BYAKKO_000_170: It took me centuries to come to terms with Tenzen's passing. That Suzaku had not came as no surprise. Like us, Seiryu cared for him deeply, and I cannot help but worry that he too may struggle to accept your part in this...
TEXT_STMBDY321_03152_SYSTEM_171: You have learned the emote Hum!
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_000: Good timing, . There's been another anomaly detected at the Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_001: Assuming previous instances are anything to go by, this energy fluctuation is another of Omega's so-called “invitations.”
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_002: If you don't mind waiting a moment or two, then we can discuss things with Master Garlond. He should be here soon.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_003: Hmph. The chief should be here by now.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_004: I bet my stock in the company he's fiddling with that research data...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_005: ...Hm? Well, I suppose I should explain, even if the chief might prefer me not to share.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_006: After your last run-in with Omega, Master Garlond had some research notes smuggled in from the Empire. From Garlemald.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_007: The notes are part of Midas nan Garlond's legacy, who was, of course, the chief's father and the Empire's preeminent engineer.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_008: The incident at Bozja Citadel...do you know of it?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_Q1_000_009: Do you know of the Bozja incident?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_012: I suppose you would. Even outside the Empire, the tale was a famous one.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_013: Midas built a tower to harness Dalamud's power, and it brought annihilation upon the entire town in which it was built─that isn't the kind of event you can simply brush under the rug.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_014: Bozja was an imperial fortress city. It was there that Midas constructed the lunar transmitter─a device built to communicate with Dalamud.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_015: Emperor Solus had ordered Midas to devise a means to destroy primals, and so he sought to harness the power of the red moon...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_016: The project was a failure. Oh, he succeeded in controlling Dalamud all right, but the immense energies emitted from the satellite vaporized not only the transmitter, but the entire town in which it was built.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_017: And as you can imagine, the job of sifting through the rubble afterwards was no pleasant task. Master Garlond was slated to assume his father's position as head engineer, but this disaster─added to his opposition to the Empire's path of conquest─convinced him to abandon his homeland.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_018: The chief has wanted nothing to do with the lunar transmitter, or the data used to create it. Until now.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_019: I think he means to put that research to use in your conflict with Omega. In fact, given the time frame, there can be no other explanation.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_020: Listen to me, . The chief's genius is plagued by a great deal of apprehension.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_021: But even so, once he makes a decision, he doesn't do things by halves. When the time comes, he'll come through for us. You have to believe that.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_022: Sorry I'm late! Was a little too focused on my work, and lost all sense of time...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_023: That's no excuse, Chief! What have I told you about being punctual to staff meetings? In any case, I've shared the situation at the Yawn with  here.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_024: Good, then you know that Omega is likely ready to continue with its tests. Shall we go and knock on the door?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_025: But, Chief... Biggs and Wedge aren't fit for fieldwork yet. And the chirurgeon's given Nero strict orders to stay abed.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_026: And what of Midgardsormr? Still taking his nap, is he?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_027: That leaves only you, , and Alpha. Maybe it's time I joined the expedition...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_028: No, Jessie, I need your talents elsewhere. There's a half-built device in the workshop that I need you to finish putting together.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_029: I've drawn up the design, and completed the core mechanisms─the final assembly should pose no problem for an engineer of your abilities.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_030: A new device? Does this mean you used the─?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_031: Ahem. Whatever you say, Chief. I'll have it ready and waiting for you. Just be safe in there.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_032: Right, it's back to the rift for us! Let's finish these experiments, and bring the fight to Omega itself!
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_JESSIE_000_040: I'll do my part in the workshop. You just concentrate on surviving the rift!
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_A2_000_052: Ready to put an end to this.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_A2_000_053: Maybe I should do this alone.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_054: Aye, there's no room for hesitation. We press on, come what may.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_055: Come now, we're in this together. And if you'll just indulge me a little longer, I do have something of a plan...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_056: What about you, Alpha? All set to go?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_058: That's the spirit! Let's dive right in, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_060: We're missing some test worlds. Omega's experiments must be nearing an end.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_061: Welcome. Welcome. Your arrival has been highly anticipated.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_062: And I will confirm your earlier supposition: my experiments have indeed reached the final stage.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_063: Of the eighty-nine test subjects I trialed, four Psi group combatants emerged victorious.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_064: Of those four, further conflict determined the strongest among them. This surviving specimen shall be your opponent.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_065: ...We've come to the last round of testing, then. And should we win this battle? Are we to finally face you in combat?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_066: Affirmative. Such an outcome would allow me to pursue my objective to its conclusion. I would continue analyzing the qualities which allow you to prevail despite your frailty, and integrate said qualities into my own arsenal.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_067: I will be pleased if my experiment yields the relevant data, but engaging you directly is still the most efficient and reliable testing method.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_068: <blip> Omitting intermediary steps. Evaluation of combat potential deemed superfluous. Proceeding immediately with final experiment.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_070: Alpha. Your task is complete. Your presence amongst these test subjects is no longer required.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_072: I will guide your progress personally from this point onwards. Alpha's role in transferring authority is now obsolete.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_073: Even so, Alpha is a valued companion. And if he wishes to continue on with us, I've no intention of leaving him behind.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_075: Companions are those who provide mutual benefit. The instant Alpha's authority became redundant, he lost his sole qualification to be regarded as such.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_076: <blip> Furthermore, the primary function of Alpha's existence was to lure you into my domain. He would be more accurately described as “bait.”
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_077: Test subject Alpha can neither confirm nor deny my statement. He possesses no memories prior to his encounter with you.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_078: He was the first entity I created here in this realm─my first and only attempt to recreate a being who shared your mundane parameters.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_079: I based his incarnation upon a most ordinary life-form, one which had somehow bested an enemy whose strength rivaled my own.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_080: By observing the feeble creature in the heat of battle, I sought to understand the source of this contradiction...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_081: I repeated the experiment once. Twice. A thousand times. Yet the results never deviated from estimated projections.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_082: The test was an abject failure. And thus I resolved to adapt my methodology.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_083: I would focus instead upon simulating powerful opponents, and summon mortals of natural origin here to combat them.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_084: For Alpha, I devised a new purpose. I erased his memory, implanted a compulsion to return to me, then ejected him into your world.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_085: Weak beings exhibit a tendency to form groups. I surmised that this instinctual behavior would aid Alpha in bringing me the test subjects I required─a function he has performed with adequate competence.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_086: ...Tell me something, Omega. This ability of yours to generate matter was not originally intended for creating other life-forms, was it?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_087: <blip> Your query bears little relevance to the topic at hand...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_088: Affirmative. I was equipped with matter-generation capabilities for the purpose of unlimited self-improvement and armament expansion. Fabricating life-forms was not the intended function, but the practice is not otherwise prohibited or problematic.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_089: I disagree with you there. As an engineer, I would advise against using such technology for purposes outside its design.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_090: From the very start, you've been making the same mistake. Even the powerful subjects of your test worlds were made crippled and incomplete.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_091: It is conviction which drove these villains to terrible greatness; the same limitless conviction which allowed “weakling” heroes to overcome them.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_092: ...Do you not understand? Then we will never lose to your creations─no matter how much stronger they should be according to your soulless calculations!
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_093: Come, . Let's be on our way. You, too, Alpha.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_110: I have our base camp up and running. You can dive into the final test world whenever you wish.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_111: As for the world's inhabitant, Omega has generously provided us with a basic profile.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_112: Your opponent's name is “Chaos.” The first heroes defeated this evil in a conflict that took place so long ago I'm having trouble separating myth from history.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_113: ...Unless of course, this is an entity from another reality, as were the denizens of the Sigmascape. In which case, it may be pointless to even attempt to confirm the details.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_114: What is certain, however, is that this Chaos stands triumphant over a roster of truly monstrous test subjects. It promises to be a grueling battle, but one which will open the gate to fighting Omega itself!
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_115: Alpha, you and I will need to provide support for . Will you be my assistant?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_116: ...You're bothered by what Omega said earlier? You think you're responsible for dragging us into this mess?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_117: Trust me when I say this is not your fault. We were the ones who awakened Omega, and we're the ones who need to deal with the consequences.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_119: By the way, do you still have that card you used to boil water in the kettle?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_120: It's been brought to my attention that I'm a spoiled blue blood who can't even refill a pot without constant reminders. If you could take charge of that, then it would be most helpful.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_122: 'Tis inconvenient without Midgardsormr here to translate his chirping...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_123: Still, the best medicine for his worries is for you to win this next contest. Let's show him we're on top of things, eh?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_130: I wonder what Nero would have to say about this Chaos fellow. Ancient technology is his specialty after all, and by default he's learned a thing or two about the mythology and history of bygone eras.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_140: (-Omega-)<buzz> The battle is concluded. Alpha group is victorious.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_141: (-Omega-)This also signals the completion of my experiments, and the incontestable fact of your supremacy.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_142: (-Omega-)...And yet the process by which you consistently exceed your projected potential continues to confound my understanding.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_143: (-Omega-)Is it possible that test subject Cid's suppositions are correct? That my calculations and simulations are fundamentally flawed?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_144: (-Omega-)Do mortals truly boast some indefinable quality that I do not possess and cannot measure...?
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_145: (-Omega-)Error. Logic loop malfunction. Resolution requires additional data.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_146: (-Omega-)If the nature of your existence defies standard reasoning, then I must examine you from an illogical angle.
