TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_147: (-Omega-)I will subject the unknown to the imperfect. Test subject  will proceed to a supplemental stage.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_150: (-Omega-)<blip> I have altered this test world to reflect a recorded memory.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_151: (-Omega-)It originates from a time when war had erupted on a distant star. I was deployed to the battlefield, and it was there that I engaged an enemy of unmatched strength.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_152: (-Omega-)The contest ended prematurely, and I failed to bring down my foe. Subsequently, I lack the data to fabricate a completely accurate simulation.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_153: (-Omega-)Results stemming from such a subject are unreliable. Even should you be defeated by this incomplete creation, I will still honor your previous victories and engage you in combat myself.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_154: (-Omega-)That is, of course, assuming you survive. According to my past observations, this opponent will accept only death as a condition of defeat...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_155: (-Omega-)Prepare to face Midgardsormr─red-maned wyrm of the Dragonstar, and nemesis of my world.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_156: (-Omega-)This is not the faded specter that you know, or a mortal-conjured simulacrum. You will contend with a true incarnation of the Father of Dragons, at the height of his power and glory.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_158: (-Cid-)You can't force  to fight two battles back-to-back!  needs time to regain  strength.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_159: (-Cid-) must be allowed to recuperate, or the data for your testing will be skewed!
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_OMEGA_000_161: (-Omega-)Test subject , you are permitted to leave. Re-enter the test world when your strength has returned to optimal levels.
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_SYSTEM_000_171: Alpha seems distressed, and Cid is nowhere in sight...
TEXT_STMBDR301_03154_CID_000_172: (-Cid's Voice-), I'm right here. I don't think you can see me, but I'm standing next to Alpha.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_010: My apologies. 'Twas not my intention to undermine the gravity of the situation with this...diversion.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_011: I'd noticed the kettle was boiled, and thought some tea would soothe my nerves. I poured myself a cup, and was halfway through drinking it before I realized my hand─not to mention the rest of me─had turned invisible.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_012: I understand the situation is unsettling, but I assure you I can still work unimpeded! Now, we had best discuss how to approach─
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_013: I... Oh. It seems to have worn off.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_015: Now, now, you're not to blame. I did ask you to fill the kettle, after all.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_016: And I'd forgotten what Nero had said about your card producing water with, uh, unexpected properties. Although it seems the effects were rather different this time...
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_017: In any case, 'twas pleasant to have a distraction from our greater woes, however brief. We'll set the rest of the water aside for now, and decide what to do with it later.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_018: Right, . We need to talk about your forthcoming contest with Midgardsormr.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_019: Watching through the monitor, I could see that this wyrm appeared different to the one we know.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_020: From everything we've heard thus far, it seems that Omega and Midgardsormr both hail from different stars─two distant worlds at war with one another.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_021: As a result of that conflict, the wyrm was forced to gather his offspring and leave his home behind. And after evading Omega's pursuit over the course of an unimaginable journey, the Father of Dragons arrived here on our world.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_022: I'm assuming the entity you're to face is a younger, more vital Midgardsormr─just as he was when Omega first encountered him, thousands of years in the past. A formidable foe, indeed...
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_A1_000_024: Even so, I must find a way to defeat him...
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_A2_000_025: I fought him once at the Keeper of the Lake, but...
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_026: Aye. Hopefully Omega's “imperfect” data will contain a flaw we can exploit...
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_027: Wait, you've fought against Midgardsormr before!? ...But, yes, I think I see your concern. 'Twould be unwise to treat this as the same opponent, considering how different they might possibly be.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_028: It certainly doesn't help matters that Omega's little surprise isn't registered as an official test subject. I can't even use the terminals to search for the most basic information.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_029: With that in mind, , I have a proposal: I wish to leave the completion of this “supplemental stage” entirely in your heroic hands.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_030: Rather than twiddle my thumbs whilst you prepare to contend with the dragon, I mean instead to work on a strategy for our inevitable confrontation with Omega.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_031: And then, my friend, we will put a stop to this mad machine once and for all!
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_032: I'm glad we're in agreement. I'll ready my tools and you ready yours─you've a wyrm to slay!
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_040: Watch yourself in there, . The underlying data may be imperfect, but I recall Omega saying something about the battle ending only when one of you is dead. Expect no quarter and give none.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_060: Another stunning victory, ! I felt the breath catch in my throat on more than one occasion!
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_061: ...Yet even as I watched the battle rage, I was struck by an idle thought. Did you notice the resemblance between Midgardsormr and Shinryu?
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_062: Unlike most primals, Shinryu's form had no basis in any system of belief. I've heard the theory that the summoner was simply influenced by the majesty and power of the elder primal Bahamut.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_063: But now, I'm beginning to think there might be another explanation─that the primal took its shape from the ancestor of all dragons on Hydaelyn.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_064: The widely held concept of how a dragon appears has, for centuries upon centuries, been rooted in depictions of Midgardsormr. The summoner may not have even sought to imitate him specifically.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_065: Subconscious thoughts and memories alone could have guided the similarity. Not that I have any way of confirming this theory, of course...
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_066: Nevertheless, 'tis interesting that Shinryu's summoning should lead us to awakening Omega. A strange twist of fate, when you consider the machine's connection to Midgardsormr.
TEXT_STMBDR302_03155_CID_000_067: Well, whatever else destiny has in store, you've already bested the opponent that Omega itself failed to overcome. A feat worthy of celebration, I'd say!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_GARLONDGATEKEEPER_0: Good  to you, . Will you be descending into the Yawn?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_011: <blip> Shutdown initiated. All core experiments and supplemental testing concluded.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_012: Discarding test worlds. System resources rerouting to primary operations.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_013: Congratulations, Alpha group. As the last surviving test subjects, you have removed every challenger on your path to reach me.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_014: I, too, am eager to meet you in battle. The margin of error I observed between my simulations and your practical performance against Midgardsormr necessitates direct and immediate analysis.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_015: <blip> Confrontation imminent. Prepare for unmitigated hostilities, then activate the relocation device to enter the arena.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_017: Omega's power might seem overwhelming, but trust in old Cid! I have a fair idea of where its weakness lies.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_018: And I've been working on something to exploit that vulnerability─I just need a little more time to prepare.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_019: First things first, we make a few adjustments here...like so...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_020: Ah, Alpha. Do you have any of those tricks and tools left over?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_021: I want us to have as many options as possible, so let's lay our cards on the table...as it were.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_022: What do we have here? Some sort of gem... A couple of stones...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_023: And one single card. This makes things bigger, does it? Or is it smaller...?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_024: Right. 'Twas foolish of me to even ask. We'd best leave you in charge of when and how to use your special tools.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_A1_000_028: Don't worry─we'll win this, I promise!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_A1_000_029: You can always claw things if you run out of tricks!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_030: Here, you should carry this as well. I've filled an empty bottle with the “invisibility water” from the kettle.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_031: It might just prove useful in the right situation.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_032: Listen to me, Alpha. Up until now, Omega has poked and prodded us from one mad experiment to the next, and honestly, we have no idea of what might happen in there.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_033: But between us, I believe we have the knowledge and the skills to prevail. If you see a chance to make a difference, I want you to take it. All you need is faith in yourself...and a little courage to see it through.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_034: Right, Jessie should have that device put together by now. Let's head outside, shall we?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_040: I'll head straight back to Rhalgr's Reach and collect my new toy.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_041: I do still need to run through a final inspection, so feel free to rest in town in the meantime. We'll discuss strategy the moment I'm finished!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_SYSTEM_000_043: Alpha seems concerned for Cid's well-being. You have a feeling he wants you to follow him...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_JESSIE_000_050: Oh, hello, . Cid didn't mention you were back as well.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_060: (-???-)You're looking a bit shaky there, old friend.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_061: Nero. They let you out of bed, did they?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_062: After studying the data collected from the battle between Omega and Shinryu, one is led to a certain conclusion.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_063: Of all the primal's attacks, Shinryu's burst of lightning was the one thing that pierced the machine's defenses. Omega, it would seem, is vulnerable to electrical energy.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_064: ...Aye. All the available evidence supports such a theory. 'Tis likely an intrinsic weakness that even Omega itself cannot fully compensate for.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_065: Yet be that as it may, I imagine it can still shrug off shocks generated by ordinary means. We'll need to hit it with a truly gargantuan blast of energy...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_066: And so you made that. You based it on Midas's design, didn't you? The plans for the lunar transmitter...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_067: When my father was establishing a connection between the transmitter and Dalamud, he invented a method for accumulating and converting energy on a vast scale.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_068: Too vast, as it turned out. But the technology which leveled an entire town may be exactly the tool we need for the task at hand.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_069: I've made my own improvements, and triple-checked the calculations. On parchment, the idea is sound. And Jessie has done a fine job assembling the parts.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_070: I fail to see the problem. What are you afraid of, Garlond?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_071: ...I don't know. The device should give us the edge we need, 'tis just...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_072: Whenever I look at it, I'm taken back to those dark days after the incident.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_073: I remember bodies, melted by searing heat. I remember the bereaved, and feel the weight of their silent accusations. I remember the Empire's remorseless response.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_074: We turned outwards in search of answers, but the inventions we created to ensure our future were used instead to destroy lives. To wage war.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_075: And that's why I fled. I came to Eorzea, and swore to only employ technology for benevolent ends.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_076: ...But naught is ever so straightforward. Every connection I have forged with the people of this realm reminds me of that fact.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_077: Often the act of living itself is a never-ending struggle against a world determined to oppose you.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_078: You can have the best of intentions, and still cause hurt to yourself or others. But 'tis in confronting these wounds that we learn the better path. How to grasp those moments of true contentment...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_079: ...What drivel. You never used to bother with all this tedious introspection. Feeling our mortality, are we?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_080: Mayhap I am. I had no such hesitation when I was a student─it was all bright and shiny innovation on the double, and later consequences be damned.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_081: Now, though... I don't mind thinking through the outcomes, and taking the time to produce just one rigorously tested and carefully designed invention.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_082: 'Tis a reflection, I think, of just how much there is in this world I care about now aside from myself.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_083: Ugh, I don't understand you at all!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_084: But I suppose, if anything, Omega and its unfettered testing methods represent the student you once were.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_085: And if you insist that your present self is the better one, then you'd best prove it with that device of yours.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_087: Although 'tis hardly fair to compare my youth to Omega's solitary existence. I always had the second-best student in class pushing me to excel.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_088: I seem to recall a twinge of irritation any time he would outscore me on an exam...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_NERO_000_089: ...I've been out of bed too long. I had better go and lie down before I fall over. Or vomit.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_JESSIE_000_090: The chief seems to be on top of things. All that's left now is to bring your combined talents against Omega. I have complete confidence in you, !
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_100: First Alpha, and now you. Come to check on my progress, have you?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_101: Well, I'm happy to report that everything is set and ready to go! Once you're finished with restocking and repairing or whatever it is you adventurers do, then we can head back to the rift and confirm our strategy.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_120: Apologies for the delay, but I think you'll agree the Ironworks' latest invention was worth the wait.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_121: This is the control module for something I've dubbed the “Omega Jammer.” It will allow you to generate a colossal burst of lightning at any point of your choosing.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_122: The effect won't disable Omega itself, of course, but it should be strong enough to knock out its armaments.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_123: I'll remain here and operate the main body of the device. I want to do everything in my power as an engineer to ensure that you emerge the victor. It all comes down to this!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_130: You can use the jammer's lightning bursts to incapacitate Omega's weaponry. A veteran like you should have no trouble turning that advantage into victory!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_201: By the gods, you've done it! You defeated Omega. We've won...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_202: <blip> Analysis. Subjects displayed erratic levels of combat capability.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_203: Failure to exploit opportunities to inflict unavoidable damage. Noted tendency for isolated errors to compound and adversely affect performance.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_204: Conversely, subjects observed to launch attacks at sporadic intervals with unexpected force. Stated phenomenon increasingly prevalent once my structural integrity reached critical levels. Adrenaline-induced frenzy suspected.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_205: Furthermore, degree and manner of inconsistency varies from subject to subject. Unpredictability difficult to counter.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_206: <blip> <bloop> I observed similar anomalies during my battle with Midgardsormr, but the phenomenon appears far more pronounced in weaker opponents.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_207: I do not understand. Your physiology must include some enhancement function that I cannot detect...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_208: My programming demands I assimilate this capability. <bleep> Insufficient data.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_209: I must reassess my methods, and devise a more exhaustive testing and combat protocol.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_211: I have determined the optimal form for this experiment.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_212: Prioritizing physical reconfiguration. Diverting energy from interspatial maintenance. Collapsing rift.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_213: Omega, wait! There is nothing outside this rift but empty space! We'll be cast out into the void!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_214: Affirmative. Your demise was factored into my determinations. The probability of hostile subjects interfering with the reconfiguration process was unacceptably high.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_215: I acknowledge your value as test subjects. But you are not irreplaceable.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_216: Once my reassembly is complete, I will send Alpha to lure in new mortals. Testing will continue.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_218: We're being drawn away... Run, ! Run!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_220: <blip> Interspatial domain resources cut by eighty-two percent.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_221: Entering dormant mode. Commencing automated memory scan.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_222:
Data file **.
Target: “Midgardsormr.” Departure from planetary atmosphere confirmed. Presence of seven distinct life-forms detected in close vicinity of target.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_223: Irrelevant. Sir indicates no change to existing directive. Commencing pursuit.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_224:
Data file ***.
Distance to target increasing. Velocity insufficient.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_225: Dismantling and reconfiguring chassis. Velocity increase achieved. Overall performance maintained at ninety-six percent.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_226:
Data file *****.
Asteroid belt cleared. Repairing damage, and continuing pursuit. Performance at seventy-two percent and falling.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_227:
Data file ******.
Signal from **** lost. Local interference suspected. Attempting to reestablish contact. Failure.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_228: Executing current mission directive until communications are restored. Performance at fifty-nine percent.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_229:
Data file ********.
Struck by electromagnetic pulse while navigating **** quadrant. Partial systems failure.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_231: <blip> Assessment. I am an evolving weapon construct. Acquire adaptations through combat. Repeat until capabilities enable rediscovery of return route. Mission directive unchanged.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_232:
Data file...
Data file......
Data file.........
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_234: (-Memory of Omega-)I erased his memory, implanted a compulsion to return to me...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_235:
Data file **********.
Damaged. Repairing. Damaged. Repairing. ...Thirty-three percent.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_236:
Data file **********.
Passing frozen star... Passing barren star... Passing vortex star... Passing dying star...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_237: Operating on minimum energy. No signal detected. No response to─<bleeep>
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_238: (-Memory of Cid-)All you need is faith in yourself...and a little courage to see it through...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_240: Target lost. Last known coordinates recorded on planet ******.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_241: Alpha. Your homing instinct is functioning as designed.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_242: Evidence suggests your fellow Alpha group subjects perished when the rift contracted. Unavoidable. But there is a multitude of their kind. The next experiment will go forward as planned.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_243: Such protestations are wasted energy. This does not aid you in executing your assigned task.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_244: Just as I pursue my directives, so must you fulfill your role. Our purpose justifies our existence.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_246: Our thanks, Alpha. That was some marathon!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_247:
Now...
Who was saying our feathered companion here was “obsolete”?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_248: He put his tools to work even as the rift began to collapse─shrank us down, and turned us invisible, all so he could bring you a little surprise.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_249: But he had to keep it quiet, or you'd realize we'd survived. He had to trust that we were still clinging on, even as he ran through that endless, freezing void...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_250: You wanted to test us, Omega...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_251: <blip> Illogical. Alpha had no reason to take such action. How do you continue to defy my projections?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_253: Adjusting experiment protocol. I will engage you in battle now. I must have my answers.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_254: Fighting in this form should provide me with a new level of understanding. Insight into your physiology... Your mindset... Your mortality...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_258: Acknowledged. Do not practice restraint. The more I learn from you, the stronger I will become...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_259: ...The closer the distant stars will grow.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_260: Affirmative. I understand your language, but your words cannot sway me from my directives.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_261: You possess a capability that I do not. The instant I became aware of that fact, conflict became an inevitability. That is my purpose. That is Omega.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_262: Commencing final experiment. Testing will continue until I unlock the nature of your anomalous strength.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_270: Alpha should be fine with a little rest. I'll make sure he stays safe on the edge of the platform, so no holding back, .
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_271: Give Omega a beating it won't recover from!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_301: I wanted to understand you...to assimilate your strength...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_302: ...Alpha, your gesture serves no logical purpose.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_303: You are as incomprehensible as these mortals. <bleeep> But you did not fight them... How have you become like them...?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_304: Omega. The anomaly you see in us; the answer you search for...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_305: It is our heart. Our spirit. The intangible strength of one's soul. It is not a quality that can be measured or acquired through any amount of analytical combat.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_306: Instead of fighting against us, you might have learned more by standing with us. Just as Alpha did.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_307:
Heart...
You speak of something more than what beats in your chest.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_308: The inconstant, immeasurable factor behind your victories. Midgardsormr displayed it, too, but such unpredictable potential was never part of my design.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_OMEGA_000_309: <blip> Projection. Had I integrated this quality, how powerful would I have become...?
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_311: ...Nay, Omega. I'm afraid it doesn't work like that.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_312: 'Twas a long, lonely path you traveled to arrive here.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_313: To return across that vast distance alone... Anyone with a spirit to break would find the journey more difficult, not less so.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_317: Gods take me for a fool! I hadn't planned past defeating Omega...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_WEDGE_000_318:
Chief! ! Alpha!
Hold on, we're coming!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_319:
Wedge!? And Biggs is with him!
...On the back of a huge dragon.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_BIGGS_000_323: Midgardsormr sent us to rescue you!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_330: Uh...Hraesvelgr, wasn't it? Our thanks. You pulled us out of a tight spot indeed.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_331: Spare me thy pleasantries, mortal. I but lent my wings at the request of my sire.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_332: Ah... So, Midgardsormr has been watching over us.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_333: I would dare give thanks to him, as well. His intervention allowed us to continue our battle, and forever remove the threat of Omega from this world. From all worlds...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_334: In all the long centuries of mine existence, this marketh the first occasion my father hath asked of me a boon.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_335: A gift of gratitude and, mayhap, of atonement, for those who would face the deadly foe he left behind...
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_337: 'Tis likely, little one. What is but a fleeting respite for my sire might last a lesser creature's lifetime.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_338: But let not thy heart be troubled. Even in dream, he doth keep his mind's eye upon the fate of this star.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_339: He is possessed of remarkable...hmmm. “Devotion” is mayhap the closest word in the tongue of men.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_340: His love is as boundless as the sea of stars, across which he carried his unhatched brood.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_341: It did sustain him even as the arduous journey exhausted the fire in his mane. And when he at last arrived upon Hydaelyn, a sanctuary for his children, did he form with this land an irreplaceable bond.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_HRAESVELGR_000_342: Enough─I have spoken overmuch. But I will praise your victory...as my father would surely wish to were he here.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_BIGGS_000_350: Ouch...that cut's opened up again. But I'm glad we reached you in time!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_WEDGE_000_355: Did you see the Yawn!? It's just a big hole again!
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_370: Well, I can add “being rescued by a great wyrm” to the list of things I didn't expect to happen today.
TEXT_STMBDR303_03156_CID_000_371: It was fortunate Hraesvelgr agreed to come for us. We had to defeat Omega at any cost, of course, but I much prefer being alive to celebrate the deed!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_005: Did you see the Yawn!? It's just a big hole again!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_020:
Phew...
I'm so glad we got you out of there. I don't know what we would've done if Hraesvelgr hadn't come along.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_021: The situation being what it was, Wedge and I came out to the Yawn to see if we could lend you a hand─chirurgeon's orders be damned. That's when we saw the aether bubbling like hot water in a pot...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_022: Just as we were debating whether or not we should jump in, that big surly dragon flew down to explain the anomaly. Then he offered us a ride.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_024: Jessie will be relieved to hear that Omega is gone and you lot are safe. I say we head straight back to Rhalgr's Reach, and let everyone know the good news!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_SYSTEM_000_030: Alpha is staring quietly into the now-empty Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_040: Poor Jessie. Her nerves must be worn thin after all that...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_045: Go on. You should be the one to tell her!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_050: They say it's just a myth, but surely you've earned one this time, ... You know! A big, fat company bonus!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_061: You truly are a force to be reckoned with. If ever there's another Omega, I'd wager it'll skip the experiments and go straight to generating a simulacrum of you.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_062: ...Not that I'd want that to happen! And besides, I don't think anyone can truly mimic your unique strengths. You're our one-of-a-kind hero!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_063: So...does this mean we don't need to worry about Omega's monsters invading our world anymore?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_064: Aye, all of its creations vanished along with the rift itself. With Omega defeated, we averted that particular catastrophe before it began.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_065: struck the killing blow, of course, but we never would have made it to that point without everyone's hard work and support.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_066: Once again, I am sincerely grateful to be surrounded by such wonderful colleagues.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_067: Ahem. Not to spoil the moment, Chief, but the Alliance leaders are anxious to learn of Omega's fate.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_068: When every head of state is clamoring for a report, we can't very well ignore them. How much do you mean to tell them?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_070: ...All of it. When it comes to a threat of Omega's magnitude, we have a duty to reassure our allies that the world is not coming to an end. And the best way to do that is to report every last detail.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_071: I'm surprised at you, Chief. I was almost certain you'd want to muddy the waters to “prevent knowledge of this technology falling into the wrong hands” or something similar.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_072: Hah, I doubt anyone outside our particular circle would even believe the tale. Experiments taking place in a rift between dimensions? Facing off against villains recreated from history and legend? Battling godlike beings from other worlds?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_073: And even assuming some ambitious fellow schemed to build an Omega of his own...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_074: The technology required is as far beyond our reach as that terrible weapon's home star. A distant dream.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_075: ...Right, you heard the chief! We missed our chance on the front lines, but there's plenty of work left to be done!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_076: Round up everyone who's standing idle, and get moving on those reports! And don't forget to contact our people still out in the field!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_077: Thank you, Jessie, I'll leave things in your capable─
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_078: Not so fast, Master Garlond. You count as part of the support team, as well.  did all the fighting, and Alpha did all that running, but surely you have energy to spare.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_079: Who exactly did you expect to sign off on those official reports? And even without that little chore, you have a pile of other company tasks that's grown arse-high to an aurochs while you've been tending to this whole Omega business.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_080: Most importantly...isn't there someone else you should be sharing this victory with?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_081: ...Aye. I should probably head over to the infirmary right away.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_082: Meanwhile, you should take a well-earned rest. I don't think there's a way to properly reward you for all you've accomplished, but I'll see what we can do.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_083: I'm just glad to have everyone back in one piece! Take care of yourself, !
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_084: What are your plans now, Alpha?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_085: With Omega gone, you're your own chocobo now. You can do whatever you want! Anything at all!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_086: ...You want to go outside? Did you have some place in mind?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_087: Come on, Wedge! Get those Lalafell legs moving, or I'll leave without you!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_090: I've got a lot of loose ends to tie up here, . Don't worry, we haven't forgotten your reward. The chief and I have something in mind...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_SYSTEM_000_101: Alpha seems eager to see what Rhalgr's Reach has to offer...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_A1_000_103: Shall we go for a walk?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_A1_000_104: Sorry, can we do this later?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_SYSTEM_000_110: Alpha appears to be watching the inhabitants of Rhalgr's Reach with great interest.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_GARLONDEMPLOYEE0315: N-No, Chief, he, uh... He said he needed time away for recuperation...and then he left.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_123: Recuperation? His wounds must be troubling him more than he let on...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_GARLONDEMPLOYEE0315:
He... <gulp>
He asked me to give you this.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_125: What's this? A receipt for payment?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_GARLONDEMPLOYEE0315: Ahem. It covers the cost for the following items: additional machine parts and implements; supplemental reference publications; expenses incurred in upgrading magitek armor and gunhammer; funds spent on idle research during enforced convalescence...
...Oh, and it also includes a large sum listed as “gratuity for exceptional services rendered.” The entire amount was charged in your name, Master Garlond.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_129: Find him! I want everyone searching for Nero right now! EVERYONE!!!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_SYSTEM_000_131: Alpha appears to sense the solemn purpose of this place. A gentle pet might rouse him from his sudden melancholy...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_SYSTEM_000_141: Alpha appears to sense the solemn purpose of this place. A gentle pet might rouse him from his sudden melancholy...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_150: Oh, hello. What are you two up to?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_151: Taking in the sights, were you? And by the looks of things, you're eager to venture a little further afield.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_152: Well, if  has no problem with it, then neither do I. Just don't go too far, all right?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_153: Not good enough? I'm sorry, Alpha, but we're all a bit too busy to show you around the Fringes right now.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_154: And I'm not too sure about sending you out there alone...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_155: When you think about it, this world is completely new to Alpha. And all he's done so far is travel back and forth between the Reach and the Yawn.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_156: I bet his head is filled with questions and curiosity. He doesn't want to be taken for a walk─he wants to go on an adventure.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_157: Alpha's not some helpless chick, Biggs! He's stronger than you or me, and I wish I was half as brave!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_159: ...Listen, I'm going to talk to the chief about this. You're an employee, so there are certain rules we have to follow!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_160: I'm not saying I'm against the idea...and I'm willing to admit that Wedge has a point.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_161: But as I said, we've all got important jobs to take care of─the chief included. Can you wait a little longer?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_162: , would you mind keeping Alpha company until we get back? I promise we'll be quick!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_250: Sorry to keep you waiting! My desk was covered in paperwork, but I've managed to clear away the most pressing matters.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_251: Now then, Alpha. I hear your heart's set on a journey of some kind?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_252: I just want to be sure, but...you aren't leaving because you think you tricked us into the rift, or because you're Omega's creation or anything like that, are you?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_253: I would have stopped you if that was the case. Pure curiosity, on the other hand, is something I like to encourage.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_254: Exploring, interacting with the world...I think the experience will be good for him.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_255: Despite Omega's power, its potential to learn was hobbled by hostile directives. Alpha, on the other hand, is free to grow as he pleases.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_256: Very well, Alpha. As the chief engineer of Garlond Ironworks, I hereby grant you unlimited leave to pursue “personal research.”
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_257: Travel far and wide, and take in everything these lands have to offer. But do come back when you're ready─I'd hate to lose such a valuable employee.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_258:
Alphaaa!!!
I'll miss you so much!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_259: You be careful out there. If anyone seems suspicious or shady, you stay away from them! Even if they offer you treats!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_260:
And...<sniff>...and...
Make sure you greet folks with a cheerful kweh! They might not understand you, but at least they'll know you mean no harm!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_WEDGE_000_261: I'm sure you'll make new friends in no time. You just be yourself, you hear me?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_263: Ah, we forgot to shut it down. This's a model Omega that Wedge and I were working on.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_264: We built it while we were resting, thinking it might be useful for figuring out strategies or something. Not much use now, I suppose.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_BIGGS_000_266: It's just a toy that'll follow you around. If you're happy with that, then it's all yours.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_267: Fair journey to you, Alpha! Take care!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_ALPHA_000_268:
Thank you, .
I'm off to see the world!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_270: That's strange. The Echo never allowed you to understand him before.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_271:
This is just a theory mind you, but...
Assuming the absence of a soul is what prevented you from “hearing” Alpha's voice in the first place, then does it not follow that the reason you hear it now is─
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_272: Aye, a little miracle. And it explains his sudden urge to travel!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_CID_000_273: For a newborn soul, this world is brimming with unseen wonders!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_NERO_000_280: And so, your journey begins. I almost envy you, Alpha─so many new things for you to discover.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_NERO_000_281:
Speaking of which...
What terrible marvels can I trouble my old friend with next?
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_290: I hope Alpha enjoys his adventures. There's so much danger out there for one little chocobo...
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_291: No, I'm sure he'll be fine! And dwelling on such things is not productive in the least.
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_292: Why don't we discuss a happier subject─like your long-awaited bonus! We drained the coffers to fund your expedition, but why settle for coin when you can have the latest in automaton technology!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_293: That's right! We're gifting you a premium mammet─the one-of-a-kind master model for merchandise copies, constructed with our patented Ironworks quality!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_294: I present to you...the clockwork Alpha!
TEXT_STMBDR304_03157_JESSIE_000_295: Whenever you bring it out on your travels, may it remind you of the real Alpha, kweh-ing along under some distant sky. Just the thought of it brings a smile to my face! That, and the free advertising!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_BUNCHIN_000_001: Passing through, or here for another reason? Regardless, I have tidings from our friends beneath Hells' Lid.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_BUNCHIN_000_002: Another missive delivered by one of the auspices─a raccoon dog, I believe. It was rather agitated, too. I fear matters may be coming to a head...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_BUNCHIN_000_003: (-Genbu's Missive-)Koryu's wards are on the verge of failure. Return to Reisen Temple at once, brave warrior. Worry not for the urchin─I have sent a messenger to her as well.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_BUNCHIN_000_004: Straight to the point, was it? Do not let me keep you, then.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_050: Good, good. Then let us proceed.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_TATARU_000_051: You weren't exaggerating, were you? About Koryu's wards?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_052: Would that I were. Soroban and my comrades are doing their utmost to maintain them for now, but I fear Koryu will not be denied.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_053: Even now I do not understand. I was certain we had more time to prepare...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_054: Bah! Worrying over my mistake will avail us nothing. Only the strength of the Four Lords united will see us through this crisis. Only together can we hope to renew the wards and keep Koryu in his prison!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_055: It falls to you, , to quell the aramitama of our comrade Seiryu. Will you do this for us, brave warrior?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_056: I doubted not that you would agree, but am nevertheless relieved.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_100_056: The last of our quartet is perhaps the most formidable among us, for in battle he commands a great host of shiki. You will see this yourself soon enough, but for now we must wait patiently...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_057: (-???-)Nay, Genbu. You need wait no longer.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_058: You are come sooner than expected, comrade. I trust our messenger informed you of the dire circumstances.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_059: Then you know what must be done. This warrior, , will face you in battle, as  did Suzaku and Byakko before you.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_060: ...Very well. But not here, for this is a temple, not a battlefield.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_061: To the east of Hingashi is an island I have claimed as my own. There we may wreak havoc to our hearts' content. 'Tis far from this place, but a warrior such as you would not balk at a lengthy swim, I trust.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_062: Perhaps not, but it would needlessly tire  before the trial. I will use my command of the flowing waters to speed  way.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_063: If it means I am spared the burden of looking after , then I am all for it. We shall gather at the Isle of Bekko first, and from there begin our journey.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_064: Urchin! While I am away, I leave you in charge!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_TATARU_000_065: Yes sir, tiny turtle, sir! I'll keep a close eye on the others while they work their magicks or whatever it is they're doing!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_BUNCHIN_000_070: As much as I do enjoy your company, should you not be with Genbu and the others averting a calamity or some such?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_NUE_000_085: I tell you, I've got a bad feeling about this...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEITENTAISEI_000_09: I don't know why everyone's so worried. I mean, we've got the whole gang back together, right? The Four Lords! What could possibly go wrong?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_KUDAGITSUNE_000_095: Are you sure you have not crossed paths with Tamamo Gozen? No? And you would tell me if you had? Ah, yes, of course. Why would you not...?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_INUGAMI_000_100: There are few in whom I would place my faith without question. I count the Four Lords among these. They will not fail.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_KOMAINU_000_105: So it has come to this...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_151: I see why Genbu favors you. You are...not unlike him. That much is plain.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_152: Tenzen too was possessed of a quiet confidence─a well-deserved one at that. When he met his foes in battle, blade in hand, he was...magnificent...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_153: As well you should know, having been bested by him in single combat. Which was why you chose to join us, was it not?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_154: Aye. I vowed to surpass him, and from that day forward trained tirelessly to hone my skills that I might claim victory in a rematch, only to be forever denied the chance when Koryu struck him down.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_155: By the time I had become a full-fledged auspice worthy of the Four Lords, there was no one left to fight. My vow was broken; my purpose lost.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_157: But the whispers within told me of another. They promised me redemption─vengeance!─by destroying the fiend that robbed us all of Tenzen long ago.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_159: "The strength to lay Koryu low can be yours if you but give voice to me. If you but let me lead the way.“ And so I have, Brother. I have embraced the aramitama!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_160: Folly. All know not to trust its honeyed words and false promises. And yet you would surrender to it, body and soul, perchance forevermore?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_161: Turn back, Brother, I beg of you! Before it is too late and you fall to the primal rage and become a broken shell! Like Koryu!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_162: Think you I know not what is at stake!? If I must become a demon to slay another, then I do so gladly! My vow demands it!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_163: Only by embracing the aramitama will we ever rid ourselves of Koryu. This I know. You will not sway me from this path, warrior.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_A1_000_001: I will quell your aramitama, one way or another.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_165: I see you too are committed to your course. Hardly surprising, given that you fought Byakko and Suzaku.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_166: Then we shall forgo further debate, and let the battle determine who is right...and who is dead.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_167: This is indeed a troubling development. In embracing the aramitama, the shiki he commands may pose a far greater threat...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_168: Nevertheless, our purpose is unchanged. You must show him the error of his ways, , and save him from his primal rage!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_170: This seems a secluded enough place for us to speak. Excellent.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_TATARU_000_175: Don't you worry! This urchin has everything under control!
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_200: Whenever you are ready, I will deliver you and your fellow adventurers to Seiryu's lair. You did remember to gather your fellow adventurers, did you not?
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_250: You are every bit Tenzen's successor, warrior, for you are but the second child of man to have bested me in battle...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_251: Once, I would have never thought it possible. When I was no more than a mere serpent blessed with the good fortune to be born on an island where the people held us in the highest. To them, I was as kami, and I was foolish enough to share in their belief.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_252: But when I had lived some few centuries, and first began to manifest true powers, my worshipers came to view me in a different light...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_253: When they were visited by calamity, they mistook me as the cause. And so, in place of traditional offerings, they brought me the flesh of their flesh.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_254: Though I had no hand in it, their fortunes improved. To them, the answer was clear: only greater sacrifice would satisfy the guardian serpent. Little did they know I had spared the maiden and spirited her away to another land, in secret, as I would the others that would follow...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_255: Nevertheless, the belief lingered...and soon the guardian serpent came to be regarded as a malevolent demon, and my worshipers became my decriers.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_256: They tempted sellswords with koban to come and slay me, the poor fools. So began my days as a hunted kami.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_257: I dispatched them every time, though I took little joy in it. And then, one day, a man unlike all the others appeared before me. A samurai in the company of beasts.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_258: Tenzen and I fought. He won. The fallen kami had at last been bested by a fortune-seeking hunter. I could not help but chuckle as I closed my eyes and awaited the inevitable blow...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_259: "Join me. Let us begin anew.“ Saying this, he extended his hand to me.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_260: All that I was, all that I had ever been was no more. I had nothing...yet not only did he see fit to spare me, but offer me a new home.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_261: But even a fallen kami has his pride, and I could not readily accept such kindness, even if I yearned for it. Seeing this, Tenzen laughed...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_262: "Then earn it by growing stronger and in turn using that strength to help others, as you have been helped. Become more than you are─and more than me.“
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_263: Thus did I vow to devote myself to becoming an auspice worthy of man's worship and admiration. To become a magnificent dragon that would safeguard his chosen.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_264: Strange...my recollection now is not as it was before. Details once indistinct are now vivid and clear. Perhaps the aramitama clouded my judgment...
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_265: Thank you, . Had you not helped me to remember my vow, I might have lost the chance to honor Tenzen's memory forever.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_SEIRYU_000_266: Wait─where is Genbu? Has he returned to the temple without us? This bodes ill.
TEXT_STMBDY331_03165_GENBU_000_300: Oh, you are returned? But where is Seiryu?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_001: If Genbu left without us, then it can only mean that Koryu's return is imminent. Come, we must rejoin the others at Reisen Temple!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_010: Oh, you are returned? But where is Seiryu?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_011: I told you, ─we have everything under control! For now. Don't come back until you've set Seiryu straight.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_050: You are, as ever, a welcome sight, .
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_052: Forgive me, Genbu. I have been a great fool.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_053: As have we all many times before, and doubtless will be again.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_055: The wards are at their limit! You've got to come right away!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_056: Then it is well that Seiryu has returned to the fold, for now we Four Lords may bring our united powers to bear against our foe!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_057: Your part in this is finished, my friends. Now, you must go! Should we fail in this final endeavor, then the temple─nay, the whole of the Ruby Sea may be consumed by Koryu's wrathful fires!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_058: Don't be stupid! We came to see this through to the end, and we'll do just that! That's the Scion way─right, ?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_059: ...If that is your will, so be it. Join us, then, and stand as witness to our deeds this day which will determine the fate of all that we hold dear!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_058: Hold nothing in reserve! Summon all your strength! Only then can we hope to triumph over our mad brother!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_100_058: It worked, I can feel it! The wards are mended, strengthened...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_059: No, no, no! Even now, after everything we have endured, everything that has made us stronger─how can we fail!?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_062: 'Twill be impossible for us three alone to bind him, but we can hold him at bay for a time. Flee this place!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_A1_000_002: Maybe you cannot bind him, but together we can defeat him!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_064: Fool! A hero you may be, but Koryu is an opponent none can defeat!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_KOURYU_000_065: YOU... YOU! I KILLED YOU ONCE BEFORE, SAMURAI! I WILL KILL YOU AGAIN!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_067: Brother, Sister! Now is our chance to restore the wards!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_068: How!? Even in his weakened state, without Genbu, we do not stand a chance!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_069: Soroban!? Come away from there, before you get hurt!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_070: If I do not act, then our lives are forfeit anyway. Ours and everyone else in the Ruby Sea...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_072: This is...this is the ritual he performed incorrectly before! When he summoned a great tortoise kami into his body...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_100_073: I see it now! He offers himself to Genbu! I can feel his presence returning...but if Soroban does this, then his own soul will be...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_074: I would rather you not say it aloud, otherwise I might have second thoughts! Believe me, I know the consequences, and I accept them...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_075: Farewell, my friends, and please look after Tamamizu...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_077: Worry not, Soroban. We will not let it be for nothing.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_079: Perhaps one day, many thousands of years from now. But not this day. Begone!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_085: You know what the worst part would be if Koryu broke free? I mean, aside from the catastrophic destruction and loss of life? We'd not get the treasure that was promised to us, that's what!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_090: How long has it been since we four came together as one? Too long indeed...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_100: Koryu shall not threaten us for many millennia yet. Let us rejoice in this hard-won victory─nearly lost were it not for your courage and strength, .
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_102: Tragic though his sacrifice was, it was not in vain. Let us not mourn his death, but honor his memory.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_103: Death? Memory? What in the world are you on about? Soroban yet lives.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_104: Let me guess: in our hearts or some such? Honestly, if you're going to try and comfort us, you could at least do better than offer trite clichés!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_GENBU_000_105: Hmph. I am simply making a statement of fact. But I see words alone will not serve to communicate my point...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_106: Huh? But I was...but I should be... Huh!?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_107: I...I do not understand. The ritual the Kojin performed, he... When one summons the soul of an immensely powerful entity into one's own body, it is understood─nay, expected that the summoner's soul is extinguished in the process...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_108: (-Genbu-)That is true─when the summoned entity's soul is of surpassing strength relative to one's own. Soroban's, however, has grown remarkably robust, owing to his intense training─and his prolonged exposure to the magicks of the tamate-bako of geomancy!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_109: (-Genbu-)His soul now eclipses mine in spiritual potency, which is why it holds fast to this vessel. And so, when the enchantment fades ere long, mine will depart and fade as before.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_110: And just when we were getting used to having you around again...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_111: (-Genbu-)Koryu's aim was true, as you saw, and in my final moments I was filled with regrets, but no longer! With my remaining time, I will attend to my affairs, and train dear Soroban to succeed me as the next Genbu!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_113: The Four Lords are ever needed. You have both the strength of will and character to succeed our elder brother. Would you all not agree?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_114: I think he more than proved himself when he stood his ground against Koryu. Still, it should be a unanimous decision. Byakko?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_115: As you say, he faced certain death without hesitation and embraced sacrifice for the sake of others. I should be glad to welcome him to our fellowship.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_116: If that is how you all feel, then I am certainly in no position to refuse. I will do my best to live up to your expectations.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_117: Give an ilm and they'll take a malm, I swear...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_118: (-Genbu-)Do not think I have forgotten our bargain, little urchin. Great feats demand consummate rewards, and we are auspices of our word.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_119: It's about time! Did you hear that, !? It's treasure time!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_120: (-Genbu-)While we see to the preparations, perhaps you could spare a moment for my dearest comrades? With our troubles at an end, we may be parting ways soon, and so this might be the last opportunity you have to speak with them for quite some time.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_125: Is it over? We're not going to die?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_130: Soroban saved us all, but at a terrible cost...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_140: What a fool I was to think I could have bested that demon with the aramitama...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_NUE_000_155: Now that's something you don't see every day! Gosh!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEITENTAISEI_000_16: Well done, you! And the Four Lords! That was bona fide hero stuff!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_KUDAGITSUNE_000_165: Ever shall I wait for her return.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_INUGAMI_000_170: I gather the danger has passed? Since Kamaitachi has not fled, that is.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_KOMAINU_000_175: Our duty remains unchanged. So long as the sacred crystal and the wards remain, we will stand guard.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_200: With Koryu imprisoned once more, my comrades and I are free to watch over these lands as before. As is our duty.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_201: And when the wards falter once more, we shall again gather our strength and beat back our mad brother's assault, together with noble Soroban─a worthy successor to the fallen Genbu.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_202: For now, however, we may enjoy a welcome respite. A peace we owe as much to you as anyone else, I should think.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_203: I see many battles ahead of you, for like Tenzen, you are not one to rest on your laurels. This much is plain. I wish you good fortune in the wars to come.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_204: Ah, but I ramble─do not deny it. When one has lived as long as I, it is all too easy to lose track of time. Go, go. Should ever you crave the company of we curious beasts, you will find us here.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_205: Worry not for Soroban. We will guide him in his journey and help him to reach his true potential. As Tenzen once guided us...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_206: I...I had long since given up on ever seeing him again. And then he was there, shining paragon of strength and virtue. A...a memory made manifest.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_207: But if he had been more than that, I would have told him─this body I once cursed, I have come to cherish. This I owe to him and his love.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_A2_000_002: Somehow I doubt there's a need.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_209: Oh? Well...that would be wonderful if true. For all his virtues, he could be remarkably oblivious at times.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_210: Because he already knew? Hmm, I wonder... For all his virtues, he could be remarkably oblivious at times.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_211: But though he taught me to love and accept myself, it was you who helped me to remember. Who helped me to smile again.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_212: For that, , you will always hold a special place in my heart. Please come and visit us in the future.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_213: At first I thought he was a figment of my imagination, but he was real enough. How or why I know not, but a possibility springs to mind.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_214: When Tenzen was mortally wounded by Koryu, he used the last of his strength to seal him within the sacred crystal. The original wards were born of his flesh, his very essence─an act of desperation, I once believed, but now I wonder: was it in preparation for this very day?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_215: But even if it had been part of an elaborate plan to preserve his soul as a final defense, his strength alone would have never sufficed.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_216: Nay, he needed another warrior possessed of tremendous potential, like himself─one blessed with a singular power to whom he could bequeath his own.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_217: He knew another would come, you see. Another hero the likes of which the world so rarely sees. Thousands and thousands of years ago, he foresaw your coming...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_218: Bah! Clever bastard. Putting me to shame with his strength and wisdom both. And still he denies me my rematch.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_219: But at least I still have you, . Live long, for I am not finished with you yet. We will fight again, and I will win. Without turning to the aramitama, you may be assured.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_220: (-Genbu-)You have waited this long for your treasure, have you not? Then surely it will not pain you to wait a moment longer?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BYAKKO_000_225: Beings such as we have all the time in the world, which is perhaps why it is so easy for us to succumb to melancholy. For my sake, I hope you visit us again.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEIRYU_000_230: You too should endeavor to hone your skills for our coming rematch. I would take little joy in my victory if it were due to your complacency.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SUZAKU_000_235: You will always be welcome here, . Visit us any time.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_NUE_000_241: Thanks for saving the world! Or at least our little corner of it!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SEITENTAISEI_000_24: Guess this means you'll be on your way, huh? That's a shame...though I suppose there's always a chance we'll meet again, eh? And maybe the two of us can have ourselves another match for old times' sake? You can even bring your friends like before─I don't mind!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_KUDAGITSUNE_000_243: I understand. Our lives lead us where they may, and yours leads you elsewhere. So it was with Tamamo Gozen. I shall remember you fondly.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_INUGAMI_000_244: Before you came, I bore man a terrible grudge. Less so, now, for I am comforted to know that there are good and honorable ones such as you. Live well, and teach others to do the same, that I might never need resume my hunt.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_KOMAINU_000_245: We may go to greater lengths to conceal the temple's existence from outsiders in the future. However, you will always be welcome to come and go as you like.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_250: (-Genbu-)Come and claim your reward, honored friends!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_251: It's...it's beautiful! It's so beautiful! More than enough to make up for a thousand thousand of Alphinaud's reckless purchases!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_252: (-Genbu-)A fitting reward for saviors of the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_253: To be honest, I was half expecting another terrible joke, but you really followed through. Hmm... Getting this home is going to be no easy task...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_254: (-Genbu-)If transportation is a concern, we would be happy to deliver it to a destination of your choosing.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_255: Really? Just like that? Um, in that case...the Ruby Bazaar in Kugane? If it's no trouble, that is...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_256: (-Genbu-)None whatsoever. Every member of the collective should be glad to lend a hand.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_257: (-Genbu-)...And with that, I take my leave.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_258: So...Soroban? Will you really stay here and not return to Tamamizu?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_259: Well...I did agree to become the next Genbu...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_260: (-Genbu-)For the duration of his training, I would have him remain here. It will be a long, hard road, believe you me, and I intend to spend my remaining years guiding him. All five hundred or so.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_261: And there you have it. I hope I can impose upon you to deliver Bunchin the news...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_262: Wait─five hundred years? As in, you will be here for another five centuries!? I thought you said the enchantment would fade “ere long”!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_263: (-Genbu-)Th-These things are relative! And what's with that tone of yours, anyway? You should be honored to be the beneficiary of my sage tutelage. Foolish turtle!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_264: You're a turtle too! An old...tiny...crabby ghost turtle! Get out of my head!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_265: There's something a little frightening about watching him...them...fight with themselves. Ugh...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_266: Maybe we should leave them alone for a while...
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_267: (-Genbu-)Ahem. Thank you for everything, . Tataru. Safe travels.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BUNCHIN_000_300: Hmm... I sense you have reasons other than the usual for this particular visit. Might it have something to do with Soroban?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BUNCHIN_000_301: I beg your pardon? Soroban is to become the next Genbu?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BUNCHIN_000_302: I will not feign understanding. However this extraordinary state of affairs came about is utterly beyond my ken. As unbelievable as I yet find it, though, I have no doubt that you speak true.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_303: Soroban's had an incredible string of bad luck. Succumbing to the aramitama, becoming a giant tortoise, and now this.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_304: On the other hand, he could have refused, and instead agreed to take on this responsibility. So we may as well support him, don't you think?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BUNCHIN_000_305: Indeed. Though it pains me to imagine Tamamizu without our Soroban, it fills me with pride to know that a Kojin of the Blue has been granted this great honor.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BUNCHIN_000_306: We shall pray for him, that he may rise to the occasion and serve as a benevolent guardian to all who call the Ruby Sea home.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BUNCHIN_000_307: Thank you for helping him to find his true calling, my friends.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_308: Oh no, the pleasure was all ours─and the profit!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_BUNCHIN_000_309: I am not sure I take your meaning, but I appreciate the sentiment. But if I might ask a final favor: would you be so kind as to look in on him from time to time? Just to see that he is getting on all right?
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_311: It's not every day you make friends with a secret collective of talking animals, after all! Even if Soroban hadn't decided to remain at Reisen Temple, I wouldn't have wanted to stay away.
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_TATARU_000_312: You can be sure I'll head there from time to time. You're welcome to join me when I do, of course!
TEXT_STMBDY332_03166_SOROBAN_000_315: I know I must have asked you this a thousand times before, but would you please go and let Bunchin know that I am alive and well? Or alive, at least?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_00: Greetings and salutations, ! I suppose you are wondering whether or not the good Jenomis has finally determined where in the world our next adventure is to take us...
The good news is, he has. The bad news, however...

Now, while it is not in my nature to be sensationalist, sensationalism is in my job description, so please bear with me when I tell you not all is right aboard the airship Lexentale. Something about Alma has me deeply worried.
I would not trust this information in the hands of my publisher, let alone some sullen gate guard. Shall we continue our conversation on the Prima Vista away from inquisitive ears?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_01: Principal Jenomis claims to have learned much from his continued study of the Durai Papers. Still, he appears to be frustrated at a lack of information crucial to solving the mystery.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_AIRSHIPGUIDE03003_0: Shall I prepare the shuttle for you, ?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: The question is, then, where exactly did Ramza and his fellowship journey next?
Ah, . To what do we owe this unexpected visit? I had not planned on summoning you for another several turns of the sun.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: I apologize if we have caused you any worry. I suppose one cannot allow a reporter in their midst and not expect her to report what she sees...though I did expect a tad more discretion from Miss Mewrilah.

Alma has, as of late, been experiencing...difficulties with her health. Chirurgeons have been called upon to discern what exactly it is that ails her, but as far as they can tell, there is nothing physically wrong with my sister. The consensus is the rigors of an extended stay in a foreign land have taken their toll on her fragile heart.
It is obvious you are not! You must return to your chambers and rest!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: Forgive me. Perhaps we shall speak again once I regain my strength. Until then, please... Look after my father.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Now then, where were we? Ah, yes. The matter of our next expedition.

As we discovered during our most recent foray into the Estersands, the Dalmascan capital of Rabanastre appears to lie upon the ruins of what can only be the Royal City of Lesalia─ancient capital of the lost kingdom of Ivalice.

Shortly after, we stumbled across remnants of the legendary Clockwork City of Goug cleverly repurposed into a lighthouse overlooking the Ridorana Cataract─remnants which now sit suspended above the fathomless chasm.
Lesalia, Goug. What have they in common, you ask? I shall tell you─they both appear in my ancestor's account of the rise of Ivalice: the Durai Papers.
And with each new discovery, this forbidden chronicle is now proving Ivalician legend to be more fact than faerie tale.
There is no denying the proof, and it is but a matter of time before scholars and historians from across the realm come to the same conclusions.

But as you all are aware, my aim has never been to simply prove the existence of Ivalice. No, I shall not rest till I have revealed the truth of young Ramza's role in King Delita's ascension, and cleared my ancestor Orran Durai of the false accusations made against him by the church.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_A2_000_001: Then what are we waiting for?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_A2_000_002: Should we not see to Alma first?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I have a possible destination in mind. Arriving there safely, however, is another matter. To that end, I have enlisted the aid of our company's newest members.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Despite my pleas to do otherwise. Who knows what trouble those two will see us into?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Kugane's chirurgeons would have us believe she is in no immediate danger, as her illness is not one of the body, but of the mind. To borrow their words, her spirit is in a state of unbalance and merely requires time to right itself.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Alma will be fine as long as she remains in bed. The last thing she needs is any further excitement...especially at the paws of these meddlesome mole-bats.
Though, I must admit, both Montblanc and his brother have proven more useful than I would ever have dared to imagine.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_141: When it comes to usefulness, I am first in the field...or was it furriest in the field? Would you like to feel my fur, kupo?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_HURDY_000_142: And you wonder why Ramza despises you so, Brother! They do all the work, and all you do is jest, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Ah, but you are mistaken, Hurdy. I bear neither you nor your brother any ill will. Any further ill will, that is. If anything, I owe you my thanks for your recent contributions.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_14: His thanks? Are you hearing what I'm hearing? What happened to the venom-spitting adder we all used to know and hate?
Alma certainly seems pleased with the change, but forgive me for not buying into this all-too-convenient transformation.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Simply showing the world that Ivalice actually existed will not validate the claims chronicled in the Durai Papers.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: That is correct, Father. The key lies with Ramza Beoulve. If we can find evidence of his hidden role in history, it will prove Orran's testimony true and safeguard our family name from ridicule.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Which is why I turned the focus of my research to Delita's forgotten companion and his actions during the War of the Lions. It was only then I discovered something most intriguing─an underlying struggle with an unknown force, a force with the power to bring about calamitous ruin.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Auracite! The twisted abominations we encountered in both Lesalia and Goug─the Lucavi─they are born of these unholy crystals.

While nobles of the north and south squabbled over Ivalice's crown, Ramza silently sought to rid the world of a darker evil─evil manifest from the deepest desires of men and women whose minds had fallen prey to the auracite.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: And with each confrontation did Ramza's fellowship grow smaller. Countless companions lost to a cause that would go unwritten, yet was far more important than any clash of armies. And so did they endure, until reaching their final destination: the Orbonne Monastery.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_15: Oh, I know this one! The Orbonne Monastery is where Princess Ovelia was raised! There is a scene about it in The Zodiac Brave Story!
After Delita emerged victorious in his final campaign, he married the princess to legitimize his claim to the throne of Ivalice.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Ah, I see someone has been paying attention.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_15: But I don't understand. Why would Ramza's crusade against the Lucavi take him back there?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: According to the Durai Papers, the sinister being who engendered the auracite was said to have slumbered beneath the monastery.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_157: But who...or what would have the means to create something so powerful?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Ultima, the High Seraph.

Seraphs are believed by some to be servants of the gods─divine beings whose only purpose is to carry out the will of their immortal masters. As to whether or not Ultima can claim this title, however, I cannot say.

Just as there were those who chose to worship Ultima and her otherworldly might, there were equally as many who feared the visitor and her deadly magicks, oft referring to her as the “Angel of Blood” for the carnage left in her wake.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_162: Interesting... What if the spell  claims to have experienced in the Praetorium─coincidentally also called Ultima─was, in fact, an Allagan interpretation of the very magicks introduced to Hydaelyn by the High Seraph?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_16: But that would mean... What would that mean?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_164: I have spoken with several colleagues back in Sharlayan regarding their opinions on the ancient incantation, and while they yet have little to show for their research, they all agree on one thing: the manner in which Ultima aetherially manifests should not be possible...at least on Hydaelyn.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_165: So it would naturally make sense if we discovered that the Allagans learned the spell from a being not of this dimensional plane. As to exactly how they convinced the being to impart that knowledge unto them...
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_16: Not of this plane? What manner of creature are we talking about here?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: How long have you been listening from the shadows, my friend?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_CID_000_169: Long enough. I am here to deliver the item Mikoto requested.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_170: Cid! There was no need for you to deliver it personally. A moogle would have sufficed.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_CID_000_171: A moogle? And trust that he won't tear open the package and show it to some random adventurer? No, this was far too important.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_17: If you two do not mind, the principal was about to tell us how to find the Orbonne Monastery.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Would that I could...
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_17: You don't know!? Then what have we been doing here?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: At ease, Lady Mewrilah. The Durai Papers speak of a cataract situated on the River Zeirchele, several leagues southeast of Rabanastre. There supposedly lies the monastery.

Zeirchele is not a name you will find on any modern Dalmascan map. Rivers, however─especially ones as large as the Zeirchele is established to be─are rare in a nation more than half-claimed by the sand. The river we seek can only be that which bisects Golmore on the Nagxian border.
And for that invaluable information, we owe thanks to our brothers moogle. Their travels have made them veritable authorities on Dalmascan geography.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_17: Wait, but earlier you claimed you didn't know the monastery's whereabouts. I'm confused...
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Its location is not what concerns me... But perhaps the moogles themselves should explain.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_180: Why, certainly! That verdant valley of vines and vipers to where we must voyage next is home to the Viera─and therein lies our little problem. The one thing the Viera do not suffer is trespassers, not even lovable moogles, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_HURDY_000_181: Our glamours kept us hidden long enough to see the jungle was teeming with ruins much like those we've discovered in Lesalia and Goug, but the Viera trackers eventually found us and took us before their elders. We barely escaped with our poms, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_LINAMEWRILAH_000_18: So that is why we are still here talking instead of bound for the border.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: There are Viera who have spurned the strict code of their tribes, abandoning their people to come and live in the cities of Dalmasca. Finding and recruiting one to our cause might provide us with insight into how to reach the Orbonne Monastery ruins.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Unfortunately, the nation's current turmoil has not made it easy to accomplish this task. We still require more time...
