TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_CID_000_185: Before boarding the shuttle here I was stopped by a Bangaa on the docks. He asked me if I knew a  and bid I deliver  a message.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_CID_000_186: I told him he was welcome to accompany me to the Prima Vista so that he might deliver that message himself, but the man refused.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_CID_000_187: Mikoto. I saw this device crafted to your exact specifications, but cannot guarantee that it will function as intended, seeing as I had nary a subject to test it on.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_188: Of course, Master Cid. If any trouble is met, then most likely it is my design that is to blame.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_CID_000_189: Your confidence in my craftsmanship is flattering, but you sell yourself too short, my dear. Here's to your success. Good day!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_500_000: You won't believe this, but since our time together in the clockwork city, Ramza and I have grown inseparable! Why, I'd consider him a closer companion now than even my good brother, Hurdy! (Just don't let Hurdy know that, kupo!)
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_200: I sense that you are interested in the package Cid delivered. I have every intention to apprise you of its contents, but first I believe we should speak of Alma's condition.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_201: Do you not find her illness all too timely? Jenomis and Ramza would like to believe that her bouts of vertigo are naught but a result of a mind fatigued, but the answer is clear: it is the auracite that plagues her.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_202: Alma recently confided in me that she would hear her father speaking with the Otius, well before even his first foray into Rabanastre. However, I do not think this entirely true.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_203: Which is not to imply that Alma is trying to deceive us. Rather, I think she saw something that led her to believe her father was conversing with the auracite. Moreover, I suspect it was the auracite itself that granted her this vision.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_204: You recall my hypothesis on distinct-frequency NRR-type harmonic vibrations and their tendency to promote aetherial amplification? Or when I mentioned that despite being in the principal's possession for an extended period, the Otius exhibited none of the imprinting present in the Duma? No?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_205: The Otius has never resonated with Jenomis; it has always been his wife's pendant and its auracite shard─the Virgo─that fueled his passion for Ivalice. No, the Otius is bound to Alma's deepest desires...whatever those may be.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_206: The only reasons I can fathom that Alma has not fallen victim to the auracite's grasp is that her desires are not as strong as those we have witnessed in Argath or Ba'Gamnan. That and the aetherial interference caused by other nearby shards.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_207: I have explained all of this to Alma and recommended that she destroy the necklace, yet not only did she refuse, but she begged me to keep this revelation from her father.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_208: And so I did the only thing I could: I devised a means with which I might impede, or at least lessen, the effects of the Otius.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MIKOTO_000_209: This device, while still incomplete, will amplify the NRR wavelengths emitted by the Virgo. This should work to interfere with those emitted by the Otius, thereby shielding Alma from the brunt of their effect.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_210: The city below is all abuzz with word of a Bangaa brigand loitering about the airship landing. Do you think it could be someone we know, kupo?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_500_010: It was Bwagi and his companions! Perhaps they know of the Orbonne Monastery! Sky pirates are bound to have traveled the whole of Dalmasca on their many misdeeds.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_240: Apologies, , but I needed to speak with you...and you alone.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_241: Oh don't mind me, kupo! I'll just be floating over here in perfect earshot.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_242: Why you─! What makes you think I won't lay you low, right here, right now?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_243: Because we're here to offer you a proposition, that's what! We need information on the Golmore Jungle, and thought a man as well traveled as you might be persuaded to provide some.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_244: Golmore? You of all creatures should know that is Viera land. What are you offering, then?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_245: Why, the opportunity to tell us what you know! Jenomis believes our next adventure lies beneath the jungle canopy, kupo.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_246: <sigh> I should have expected as much.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_247: Very well. , I came to ask if you would meet someone. Now it seems that someone may be able to assist Jenomis, as well. Seeing as you and the principal did right by us before, I do not see a reason why I cannot take both of you.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_500_020: That was far easier than I thought it would be, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_280: Let me know when you are ready to depart for Rabanastre. We will travel in our airship. The Prima Vista would draw too much unwanted attention.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_300: Back to a life of brigandry in the clouds, are we?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_301: (-Bwagi-)Of course not! Not that it didn't cross our minds... But when faced with the decision of what to do next, we needed simply to remember the dying words of our leader. Gijuk, Rinok, and I decided to reenlist as Dalmascan fusiliers.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_302: And the occupying Garleans actually said yes, kupo?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_GIJUK_000_304: (-Gijuk-)You no doubt heard of the uprising in Dalmasca that followed the Doman liberation...and how it was crushed under the iron heel of the IVth Legion.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_GIJUK_000_305: (-Gijuk-)The resistance leaders were captured, tortured, and publicly executed. Yet, much to the Empire's chagrin, the gruesome display only served to further rally the survivors.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_306: (-Bwagi-)Remove one head, and two grow back in its place. Remove two, and then there are four. A person can die, but an ideal will live on.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_307: (-Bwagi-)Now there exist several factions throughout Dalmasca. We belong to one known as Lente's Tears.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_GIJUK_000_308: (-Gijuk-)And when we told our commanding officer of our recent crossing with you and yours, she simply insisted that we introduce you.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_309: M-M-Me!? But I wasn't even supposed to be here, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_311: (-Bwagi-)Meet with the general and hear her proposal, . If you are not interested, we shall return you to Kugane unharmed. You have our─
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_314: (-Bwagi-)This way. We've many malms to cover before nightfall.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_330: (-Bwagi-)I've done as asked. I bring you the liberator.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_333: I am Fran, proud daughter of Dalmasca and general of Lente's Tears.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_335: And yes, moogle. I am a Viera. Are you surprised?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_100_335: And yes, moogle. I am a Viera. Are you surprised?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_340: Why yes, in fact, I am! Her kind are all supposed to be living amongst the trees, having shunned contact with the outer world, kupo. There are supposedly a few who have left their homes, but I most certainly did not expect to see one here in this sewer!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_342: This Bangaa claims you seek Orbonne. Does he speak true?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_343: Those ruins lie deep within the Golmore Jungle─a place most sacred to my sisters. They would take great offense were you to defile it with your presence.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_344: What is more, Bwagi tells me you travel with Garleans, openly aiding those who would see our nation burn. How can we place our trust in one who would do such?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_A3_000_001: Jenomis and his family defected long ago! They are not your enemy!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_A3_000_002: My blade has tasted the blood of too many Garleans to count.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_350: A Garlean is a Garlean. Their pathetic attempt at absolution only proves their past guilt.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_355: And then you know the Empire and its people are one and the same. When you slay an imperial soldier, you are not slaying an individual, you are slaying the enemy. Your companions, Liberator, are the enemy, despite their supposed change of heart.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_360: You misunderstand! Kind Jenomis does not approve of the Emperor's warmongering! He wants to help Dalmasca and its impoverished masses, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_361: And what would a moogle know about my people? Does your blood run Dalmascan red? We could cut you open and find out!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_000_362: (-Bwagi-)General, there is no need for threats.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_363: You are right, Bwagi. Let us then parley!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_366: First, the resistance requires men─men and women from the Eorzean and Eastern alliances to join us in ridding Dalmasca of its imperial invaders.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_100_366: First, the resistance requires men─men and women from Doma and the Eorzean Alliance to join us in ridding Dalmasca of its imperial invaders.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_367: Your past deeds have made you well known to the leaders of both. They will listen to you, or if not, they will listen to these Scions to which you claim allegiance.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_368: Second, the resistance requires gold─gold to strengthen our forces from within.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_369: Your allies are in bed with the East Aldenard Trading Company, which continues its dealings with Garlemald even as you raise your sword against them, profiting from the Empire's rampant aggression. As targets of that aggression, I believe my people are entitled to a portion of those profits.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_370: Grant me these simple things, and I shall personally guide you safely to the ruins of Orbonne.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_372: See me to victory, and I'll take the Emperor himself!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_373: Those are my conditions. What say you?
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_A4_000_001: I will deliver your request to the Scions, but can promise no more.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_A4_000_002: Promise me first my companions will see no harm.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_380: Tell them my demands, but know the fate of your expedition hangs on how well you do so.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_385: I will promise you nothing! But if it helps you sleep, know that I have never cut down a man who did not take up arms against me and mine, be he Garlean or Eorzean.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_386: I'd say we have our work cut out for us, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_387: Bwagi. You and the fusiliers are to accompany the liberator. I expect a detailed report on how my demands are received.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_FRAN_000_389: Not that I expect them to be taken seriously. You are a fool to trust them, Princess...
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_BWAGI_500_020: Do not be put off by Lady Fran. The general has quite the edge to her, but it is only because she wants what is best for the resistance.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_GIJUK_500_025: I've finally come to accept Ba'Gamnan is gone for good, but I will never forget how he met his end. I cannot allow my hatred to consume me as it did him.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_RINOK_500_030: The general is not too bad, once you're on her good side─her only good side being her backside...but you didn't hear that from me.
TEXT_STMBDI301_03187_MONTBLANC_000_400: What an adventure, kupo! Just think, by tomorrow, we could all be the newest members of the Dalmascan resistance! Er...not that I'm ready to give up my place on the Prima Vista just yet...
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_500_000: Do not be put off by Lady Fran. The general has quite the edge to her, but it is only because she wants what is best for the resistance.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_GIJUK_500_005: I've finally come to accept Ba'Gamnan is gone for good, but I will never forget how he met his end. I cannot allow my hatred to consume me as it did him.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RINOK_500_010: Fran is not too bad, once you're on her good side─her only good side being her backside...but you didn't hear that from me.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MONTBLANC_000_000: Hurry, hurry! If I don't tell someone of our adventure quick, I'll positively burst, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: This woman asks much of us...
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: The Viera have ever been wary of outsiders. For centuries their many tribes have remained hidden in the jungles, content with their self-imposed solitude.

Each tribe has its own strict code and will mete swift punishment to any who would defy these laws. As such, many a Viera will spend her entire life bound to the territory of her ancestors, both unwilling and unable to venture beyond its borders.
And while the tribes are wholly independent, they have agreed to uphold a single standard: shun all contact with the outside world unless it is to protect the jungle.

That said, with every generation there are those Viera who long for a life beyond the verdant sea of trees and abandon their tribes to start a new life in the kingdom's cities. My guess is that this Fran is one such individual.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MONTBLANC_000_045: Who also happens to be the only individual we know who can guide us to the monastery, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_04: It seems 's sword arm won't be enough to see us through this predicament.  need to don the right mantle of a diplomat if we're to convince the alliances and the East Aldenard Trading Company to grant us aid. What could go wrong!?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_047: (-Hancock-)Yes, yes, I know you said not to call unless it was urgent, but this is urgent. All right, not exactly, but my superiors have come to a decision on your request, and I thought you might want to hear what they had to say.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_048: (-Hancock-)Oh, and let me preempt any request for immediate disclosure with a reminder that the information is much too sensitive to discuss over linkpearl. Meet me at the Ruby Bazaar posthaste and I shall duly apprise you of their judgment.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_04: Well then, . What are we waiting for?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_08: I've read about how you united the whole of Eorzea under a single standard and convinced the Holy See to end a thousand-year conflict. Compared to that, asking for a few soldiers and a coffer or three of gil should be a piece of rolanberry cake!
Ah, I suppose we should inform Bwagi down at Kugane Landing of our progress. You mentioned he was to keep an eye on us.
I've informed Bwagi of our situation. We are ready to make for the Ruby Bazaar when you are.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_090: So you've an answer from East Aldenard already. Impressive. It would seem the Lady Fran has underestimated your influence amongst the realm's players. I assume you have no objections to me joining you then.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_GIJUK_500_030: Rinok and I will stay here with the airship. Our last foray into the city was met with one too many cold stares for my liking.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RINOK_500_035: Vessels such as ours require extensive maintenance to remain skyworthy. You and Bwagi take as long as you need.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_10: Hancock awaits us in the Bazaar. Shall we, ?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_150: A lovely lady and a...Bangaa? And here I was expecting you would be alone, !
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_151: Ah, but excuse my manners. I am Hancock, representative of the East Aldenard Trading Company assigned to oversee her assets here in Kugane. It is a pleasure to meet you.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_152: And I am Yugiri. We apologize for making you come all this way.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_TATARU_000_153: Not that it is far from the landing to─ Ahem.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_154: Bwagi, was it? I serve Lord Hien, rightful ruler of Doma. I have come bearing our nation's reply to your entreaty.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_100_154: Bwagi, was it? I serve Lord Hien, rightful ruler of Doma. I have come bearing my lord's reply to your entreaty.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_TATARU_000_155: And I am Tataru Taru of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. I'm only here seeing as no one else could be bothered. Well, that and to bear a message from the leaders of the Eorzean Alliance.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_156: Thank you both for coming. I am Bwagi, formerly of the Dalmascan Royal Fusiliers. I now claim allegiance to Lente's Tears─a resistance group seeking to accomplish what you have in Doma and Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_157: What tidings have you brought us?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_158: Allow me to begin then. While the East Aldenard Trading Company sympathizes with your plight, we are not in a position to grant you the funding you seek.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_159: As you are aware, the East Aldenard Trading Company prides itself in its neutrality, be it in matters political or personal.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_160: And what of our relationship with the Eorzean Alliance? Ah...yes. What I meant to say was, here in Hingashi, the East Aldenard Trading Company prides itself in its neutrality, be it in matters political and...er...
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_161: You must understand our position. Simply supplying coin to any one group would make it appear that we somehow favor that group over another. Seeing as we conduct business openly and fairly with everyone, doing such would be sending the wrong message, and ultimately harm profits. Yes.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_16: And by selling to both sides, you maximize profits while good men and women perish. How convenient!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_163: We are a business, milady. We do what we must to survive. That does not mean, however, we are blind to the needs of our customers or our allies, which is why we support the Eorzean Alliance and their noble efforts to safeguard their realm's freedom through a mutually beneficial arrangement.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HANCOCK_000_164: If it were my choice, I would provide your little resistance with all the funding it needs, but as my good friend, , knows all too well, it is not my choice.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_TATARU_000_165: Well, now that Hancock's thoroughly lowered your spirits, you won't be as crestfallen when I inform you the Eorzean Alliance will also be unable to provide any assistance.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_166: And let me guess, you did everything in your power to try and convince the leaders of each city-state, only to watch as they politely declined our proposal, claiming an unfortunate lack of intelligence or resources.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_175: Lord Hien sends his greetings to you and yours. Having recently found strength through a newly formed alliance with our neighboring nations, Doma is open to further welcoming like-minded organizations. This includes our Dalmascan brothers and sisters still suffering under the imperial yoke.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_180: Lord Hien sends his greetings to you and yours, and under normal circumstances would welcome allies still suffering under the imperial yoke.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_185: However, word has it that the latest attempt at reclaiming your kingdom ended in failure, resulting in the loss of countless lives, including many of the resistance's leaders.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_186: You are not mistaken. Our army is not what it once was. Those remaining have been forced to take refuge deep beneath the streets of Rabanastre.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_187: The IVth Legion has already defeated you once. Lacking unity and leadership, the current resistance will not survive another tilt against the Empire's disciplined ranks.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_188: If Doma is to join hands with Dalmasca as an ally, you must first prove to us that you will stand as one.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_195: Doma as a full-fledged ally would serve far better to strengthening our cause than a few temporary soldiers.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_200: Doma as a full-fledged ally would serve far better to strengthening our cause than a few temporary soldiers.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_205: Yet even if we were able to wrest Dalmasca from the Empire's grasp, without unity amongst your people, the resulting chaos could prove even more perilous to the kingdom.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_206: You understand much of our situation.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_207: And based on that understanding, you would refuse your aid to Lente's Tears, am I correct?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_YUGIRI_000_208: Do not mistake me. Lord Hien's refusal is but a message─a message to help you plan your next step.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_209: You have a wise master. He understands that without proper planning, driving one enemy from your midst simply creates room for the next.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_210: Lady Fran will no doubt be pleased to hear that your response was exactly what she expected.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_21: You knew this whole time that your demands would be rejected, yet still you let this farce play out?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_212: You have my apologies, but this was all necessary to prove an important point to our leader.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_213: Lady Fran needed to show the princess just exactly what she was getting herself into, and your honesty today will serve us better than any hollow promise. Thank you.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_21: Wait! What about the Golmore Jungle!?
Can you believe this? We're right back to where we started! Principal Jenomis will not be pleased.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: If it is as you say, it is most unfortunate. But, I suppose we did everything in our power, and that is all one could ask.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: I still do not understand. Why would Lady Fran send  on this wild paissa chase if she knew from the start it would be for naught?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_30: Bwagi mentioned something about Fran proving a point to their leader...whomever that may be.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: People in positions of power can prove both naive and stubborn creatures. Simply telling a leader she is wrong may not convince her of the fact. Seeing one's own plan fail, however, is oft the best medicine.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_000_30: Naive and stubborn? Then the resistance is doomed!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MONTBLANC_000_305: If a person as imposing as Fran is taking orders from her, then chances are this “leader” is even worse, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I would not be so certain, Montblanc.
My guess is that the individual in question is still quite young and inexperienced, and that Lady Fran is trying to teach her to be an effective leader through example.

By allowing her to make her own mistakes, Fran is granting her the ability to learn and grow from them─an experience that will ultimately benefit her when the time comes to make some truly difficult decisions.
Now, I seem to recall reading that one of the many faces of the resistance before the recent quelling was a young girl of royal blood. Do you suppose─
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_FRAN_000_310: (-???-)You may cease with your baseless presumptions, defector.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_FRAN_000_313: I would be here on orders from the leader of Lente's Tears. Against my better judgment, mind you.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Greetings. Lady Fran, I presume? I am Jenomis cen Lexentale, principal of the Majestic Theater Company. You and your colleagues are most welcome on the Prima Vista.
What is it your leader would have of us?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_FRAN_000_316: While you failed in meeting even a single of our demands, she recognizes that you were sincere in your attempts to see them fulfilled, and for that effort, you are to be...compensated.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_FRAN_000_318: The ruins which you seek are hidden behind a waterfall here─a point roughly equidistant from the river's source and its delta.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_:
You have our thanks, Lady Fran. We will not forget this kindness.
Father, I shall plot a course immediately.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: Ramza... What is going on here?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Alma! You should be in bed!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: I've slept enough, Brother. Tell me, who are our guests?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_323: It appears you once again prepare a leap into danger's maw. Keep your wits about you, . Lady Fran is strong...but then again, so was Ba'Gamnan.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Are you mad!? A trip to the surface in your condition!?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: Listen to me, Brother. The High Seraph beckons. She speaks to me through the Otius.
There is no need to worry. Mikoto and I have already devised a plan. I can help clear our family name!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: The Sharlayan has no say in this. I am your father and I insist you remain here on the airship! What would your mother say if I allowed aught to befall you!?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: Mother? That is what this is all about, isn't it!? What it has always been about! You care not about Ivalice or the Orran name. No, you only seek to use the auracite to bring Mother back!

But you haven't been able to do that. You still do not understand how exactly it is that the shards translate one's desires into reality. That is where I can help. I can ask the High Seraph. It is she who created the auracite.
Ultima has bid me come to her place of imprisonment. If we free her, she will reveal unto us the secrets of her creations!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Do you hear what you are saying, Alma! Even if there was the slightest chance of bringing Mother back, we cannot risk your life in doing so!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Your brother is right! We have sacrificed too much already! I cannot bear the thought of losing you! Either of you!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: (-Ominous Voice-)I'm so lonely, Father. Why must you love Ramza more than you do me?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MIKOTO_000_337: Do not be cozened by your daughter's words, for they are not her own.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_000_342: I told you. No one can control the power within those shards. No one!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MIKOTO_000_343: ! Here, take this. It might be the only thing that can save Alma, but we must hurry to the monastery!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Come. We leave for the Golmore Jungle...now.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_FRAN_500_060: Was the power I sensed beyond the rift─ Was that the High Seraph?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MONTBLANC_500_065: What do we do!? What do we do!? We cannot just leave poor Alma to become one of those...one of those...monsters, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_HURDY_500_070: I think we saw enough to prove that Ultima is no angel, kupo. But if she's not...then what is she!?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_50: I've been such a fool...and now I've lost my daughter. Will you ever forgive me, Tia?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_LINAMEWRILAH_500_08: I cannot believe what I just witnessed... I won't believe it. I won't. There. It didn't happen.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_00543_MIKOTO_500_08: I have good news and bad news, . The bad news is that it appears the High Seraph was able to employ the Otius as a catalyst to propel her magicks beyond whatever seal she is trapped behind. The good news is, this means my device should function as intended.
Its design is based off of one of Moenbryda's. It repurposes the logic behind her aetheric siphon into a means of disrupting aetherflow by reversing common wavelengths and─
And let us just say it has already been calibrated to match the energy emitted by the Otius. As long as Ultima continues to wield the Otius, we should be able to interfere.
But it only works if we can find Alma. Which is why we must make haste.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_GIJUK_500_090: What happened here? Is everything alright?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RINOK_500_095: Don't tell me... I can see it in your eyes. The auracite claimed another victim. You were fools to think you'd fare any better than Ba'Gamnan. Fools, all of you.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_BWAGI_500_100: I told her. I told her this was a mistake, and now look what has happened. If you were wise, you'd toss all the remaining shards into Hells' Lid and cut your losses. But you've no more wisdom than Ba'Gamnan. And that's why the High Seraph has already won.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Have I your permission to depart, !? Every moment we tarry here, my sister, she─!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_A1_000_002: Now is not the best of times.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Then hold on. I've set engines to full speed!
No, it is the worst of times! I beg of you. Do not ask me to wait any longer. For Alma's sake.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_FRAN_000_450: Welcome to the land of my people. 'Twould be a poor lie if I said I did not miss it some.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_ALMALEXENTALE_000_4: (-Ominous Voice-)Blood...of the invokers... Fulfill...the ancient covenant...and grant unto me...the vessel...promised.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_FRAN_000_458: Bwagi, to me! The girl is not well!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MONTBLANC_000_459: Uh, might I suggest we continue this back at the Prima Vista, kupo!?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RAMZABEOULVE_000_46: (-Unknown Voice-)Have you the courage to face true evil?
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_MONTBLANC_000_461: What are you gawping at!? The ship is this way, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_GIJUK_500_110: If you need help finding Ramza, do not hesitate to ask. We are here to help. It is what Ba'Gamnan would have wanted.
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_RINOK_500_115: Is the boy's father well? I cannot imagine what he is going through. Losing his daughter, only to lose his son moments after her return...
TEXT_STMBDI302_03188_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Now Ramza is gone? Oh, dearest Tia, what have I done? What have I done!?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_GIJUK_500_000: If you need help finding Ramza, do not hesitate to ask. We are here to help. I like to think it is what Ba'Gamnan would have wished.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RINOK_500_005: Is the boy's father well? I cannot imagine what he is going through. Losing his daughter, only to lose his son moments after her return...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: We need to do something...but what recourse is left to us? The only means we had of protecting ourselves could not even prevent my son from... My son from...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_MIKOTO_000_010: I am sorry, Jenomis. My design was...flawed...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_011: Not necessarily, Sharlayan. We all saw how it succeeded in drawing Alma back from the rift and shattering the Otius. The loss of the boy is not yours to bear.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_012: Our focus here should not be on our failures, but what we have learned from them. The being beyond the rift─it spoke before claiming Ramza. It referred to you as the “blood of its invokers.” Could it be your ancestors are responsible for Ultima's summoning?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: Most certainly not! I have discovered no such inference anywhere in the Durai Papers! Besides, tales of the High Seraph existed far before even the earliest of Ivalician legends.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_014: Then who exactly did summon Ultima, and why does she think them your kin?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_MONTBLANC_000_016: I have a bad feeling about this, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_05: (-???-)Ramza, dead!? You lie about as well as you carry yourself in battle, Orran.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_051: I did not say he was dead, my Lord Delita, merely that he had abandoned his mortal vessel, entrusting his aetherial soul to the auracite.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_05: But why would he do such a thing? Peace is finally come to Ivalice! There is naught to be had from further sacrifice!
The kingdom is won, and this victory is as much his as it is mine! He risked life and limb to shield me from the dark that would have seen me perish.
Without him, I would not be standing here before you. It is my duty as both king and colleague to see him saved!
Knights, to me! We ride for Orbonne!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_057: Ajora Glabados, first of the Zodiac Braves, was not the hero the church would have you believe. He betrayed Mother Hydaelyn for the promise of coin and power, summoning forth a terrible evil from the depths of the celestial abyss.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_058: It was believed only one of the land's chosen─only a Warrior of Light might stand against this threat.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_059: Yet while victorious in battle, Ramza was unable to see the darkness vanquished. If failure was all that awaited our Warrior of Light, then what chance do you presume any other might stand?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_06: Are you saying I should do nothing, then!?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMABEOULVE_000_061: No, my lord. Ramza is. My brother's final wish before he surrendered to the aether was that his name be struck from the annals of history.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_06: Alma, you're unhurt! But I was led to believe none but Orran returned from Orbonne. What is this you speak of your brother's wishes?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_063: When it became apparent that we were powerless to truly defeat the High Seraph, we chose the only path left to us─to do what Hydaelyn Herself did countless centuries past: imprison Ultima.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_064: And as you are aware, my lord, a prison is only as strong as the seal on its gates...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMABEOULVE_000_065: Ramza sacrificed his body to ensure that the Angel of Blood would never again walk the land, and he believed that if people knew of this sacrifice, it would only inspire them to seek out the Holy Stones and repeat the mistakes of those come before.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMABEOULVE_000_066: If you truly avouch yourself his friend, then you will honor this, his final plea.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_06: No! Ramza should not be forgotten! He should be raised up as a hero for his deeds and claim his rightful place at my side. Only he might be my Knight Gallant!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMABEOULVE_000_069: Before Ramza was your friend, before he was my brother, he was a Warrior of Light. He did what he did for Hydaelyn, and for those who would one day, too, heed the Crystal's call.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZABEOULVE_000_07: Claim the throne, my friend. Become ruler of Ivalice and restore peace to this war-torn realm once and for all.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_07: Wait, Ramza! Don't leave me! Please! I beg of you!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZABEOULVE_000_07: You will make a fine and just king, Delita. See you do not stray from that path.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_07: The stones in these two necklaces, you are certain they will guide the heroes of a new era to Ramza?
Orran, I do not believe I can bear another farewell this day. Will you not reconsider my offer to remain as a member of my court?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_077: 'Tis but a matter of time before the Cardinal and his Temple Knights grow wise to my past. I would not have my presence here implicate you as well.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_078: Ramza beseeched me strike his name from history, but like you, my lord, I could not bear the thought of future generations blind to the truth. As such, I penned this chronicle of the hero's journeys.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ORRANDURAI_000_079: I fear the world, however, is not yet ready for the gospel contained within these pages; nor would the church ever allow its circulation. In fact, I believe they will confiscate every existing copy and lock them away in their library.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMABEOULVE_000_080: And what better way for the words to remain forever preserved than in one of the most highly guarded vaults in all the realm? Then, one day, when the church has fallen out of favor, the chronicle will be discovered and truth shall prevail.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_08: I must admit, your plan is intriguing, Orran...but once the church learns it was you who penned the chronicle, your life─
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: The removal of Ramza's name from the history books, the Durai Papers, the pendants...it was all set in motion by Orran himself!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_103: And if the liberator's visions are to be taken as fact, it also appears we now know what the High Seraph meant by “blood of my invoker.”
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_MIKOTO_000_104: She was not speaking of ancestors in the sense of actual kin, but the line of those chosen by Hydaelyn to serve Her as Warriors of Light.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_LINAMEWRILAH_000_10: But then why abduct Ramza...or even Alma? Unless...there is something you haven't been telling us!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_000_1: She was using us...to lure . It is  vessel the High Seraph desires.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_LINAMEWRILAH_000_10: Matron's teats, Alma, how long have you been awake!?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_109: I told our leader that it did not matter if our request for aid was refused, for I had an alternative ploy.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_100_109: I told our leader that it did not matter if our request for aid was refused, for I had an alternative ploy.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_111: It is all right, Bwagi. My intention was to claim one of these auracite in the name of the resistance and use its power to lay waste to the Garlean occupants. Only now do I realize how flawed my ambitions were.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_LINAMEWRILAH_000_11: You mean this whole time you were playing us for fools!? Why didn't we see it earlier!? Never trust a woman with ears longer than mine, I always say!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_113: You've every right to be angry, and I apologize for misleading you. But believe me, I no longer have any desire to deceive you and yours. I shall see you to the Orbonne Monastery, and ask naught in return but that you let me join you in your rescue of Ramza.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_114: Do not misunderstand me. I do not do this for any one of you.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_FRAN_000_115: I do it for my people in both Golmore and Rabanastre─people who may die if this High Seraph is allowed to return to power.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_50: It pains me as a father that I am powerless to save my own son. , I have asked much of you these past moons, but naught is more important than what I ask you now. Please, find Ramza.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_500_0: This is all my fault. I was convinced it was Ramza and my father who were bedeviled by the auracite...when in fact, it was me all along...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_MIKOTO_500_03: You are wrong, Alma. The auracite held no power over you. It never did. Your concern for your family was justified, for they allowed their desires to cloud their own judgment.
You needn't blame yourself for matters beyond your control.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_500_0: But what of Ramza? He's gone because he tried to save me...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_ALMALEXENTALE: Please, . You must bring back my brother. I...I don't know what I would do if I lost him, too...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_MONTBLANC_000_200: He's awake, kupo! ...But is it truly him?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: Thank you. Thank you all for coming to my aid.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZABEOULVE_000_20: And you have my thanks, noble Warrior of Light. You have achieved what I could not.
And you, bearer of my blood and the blood of House Durai. Thank you for seeing my final wish fulfilled.
My sacrifice has finally been given meaning...
Now, my friends, let us retire to Mother Hydaelyn's bosom, that we may finally rest.
Farewell. You are the true heroes of this story.
Delita. How I have missed you, old friend.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_DELITAHEIRAL_000_20: Forgive me, Ramza! You deserved better than what history gave you. I...I could have done more... I am truly sorry...
These countless centuries did I long for the day that we might meet once again. And now, that time is finally come. Hydaelyn beckons us both.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_MIKOTO_500_06: . It is almost sad to see our quest come to an end, though we have given the land's scholars much to consider. Sharlayan will have to open a school of Ivalician studies, are we to keep up.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_065: I owe you an apology, . I was wrong to doubt you.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_066: Whether it be in a council room or on the field of battle, you have proven yourself more than worthy of the many praises the bards sing. I am glad to have counted you an ally, for I would not wish you upon even my worst enemy.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_BWAGI_500_070: Despite what Lady Fran says, I had no doubt that you would come through in the end. It has been an honor, . I only wish Ba'Gamnan were here with us to celebrate this day...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_RAMZALEXENTAL: And here we are, . I cannot thank you enough for all you have done for my family...and that is before you saved me from the High Seraph!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_ALMALEXENTALE: You rescued my brother, and for that I shall ever be indebted to you. You will be in my heart, always, .
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_GIJUK_500_085: You slew the she-devil who brought those unholy stones into the world? Then Ba'Gamnan can finally rest in peace. Thank you, .
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_RINOK_500_090: My only regret is that if we had grown wise to the High Seraph's presence sooner, perhaps our captain, too, would be here to enjoy this victory...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_LINAMEWRILAH_: You're alive! Oh, but of course you are. You'd think that after this many triumphs, one might grow tired of saving the world. Consider us all fortunate that you have not! Ah hah hah hah!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_MONTBLANC_500: But they were there, Hurdy, clear as day─the hero Ramza and good King Delita! Why would I lie about something like that, kupo?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_HURDY_500_101: My question is, why wouldn't you? Still, after what we've all been through in the past few days, I might be willing to give you the benefit of the doubt...this time, kupo!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I am so sorry, Ramza. Alma. I convinced myself my research was the most important thing in my life, all the while you two were standing before me. Can you find it in your hearts to forgive your father?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: It is all right. We are still here, are we not?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: And we triumphed. We proved your theory true. Ivalice existed. Ramza existed. And Orran Durai was not a heretic, but a hero. Now all that remains is to tell the world!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: No, my son. We needn't burden ourselves further.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: But Father! We cannot allow our ancestor's name to remain─
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: And we will not. Yet simply not in the manner you think.

I shall be adding a final act to The Zodiac Brave Story telling of how Ramza the forgotten hero and his chronicler Orran Durai smote the Angel of Blood and saved Ivalice from an age of darkness, before quietly embarking on a final journey that would take them far beyond the horizon.
And of course, I shall not leave out those nameless heroes who fought alongside Ramza─without whom the young noble would have surely perished.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: Is that what you truly want, Father? For the story to end?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: It will only end on the stage, my dear, and live on in the hearts of the crowd.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: King Delita and Orran envisioned the Virgo as a beacon which would lead future generations to the truth about the founding of their kingdom. They were right. And just as the pendants guided us, now we shall guide the masses through our play.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: And now you see, my son.
I would offer you my thanks again, , but thanks are not nearly enough to express my gratitude for all you have given us.
Perhaps after I complete The Zodiac Brave Story, I shall pen a tale about the legendary Warrior of Light and  adventures across the Three Great Continents.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_CID_000_314: Then you'll have your work cut out for you, my friend.  has enough battles under  belt to fill at least three tomes, if not four.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_LINAMEWRILAH_000_31: Would you stop doing that, Cid?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_CID_000_316: And  tale is far from over, isn't it?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: All right, this is our final dress rehearsal for the night. Make it count. Positions, everyone!
Lights! Music! There will be no more mistakes from you two, am I clear?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_LINAMEWRILAH_000_35: They are going to perform the new final act!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: What ever will we do? The church has branded us heretics. No home awaits us in Ivalice.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: We shall embark on a journey─a journey together!

Together! The Crystal's call has been answered and evil vanquished
from the land. We are now free to soar like the griffin!
By casting off our noble names and forging a new path─one not bound by fate!
And on that path we shall meet new friends, make a new family.

And unto them we shall entrust the true tale of our deeds
that they may carry on our legacy...for all eternity!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: Sword in hand, a warrior clutches stone to breast.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: In sword etched he his fading memories.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_ALMALEXENTALE_000_3: In stone he tempered his skill.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_RAMZALEXENTALE_000_: By sword attested, by stone revealed.
Their tale can now be told!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_LINAMEWRILAH_000_36: Bravo! Bravo! You both were wonderful!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_JENOMISLEXENTALE_00: I am inclined to agree with the Lady Mewrilah's sentiments, but there is always room for improvement. Back to your positions, everyone! Again from the top!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_MONTBLANC_000_371: Again? I've had enough of this! I was promised a starring role, kupo! It is in my contract!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_HURDY_000_372: Oh, hush, Brother, before Jenomis has us back to polishing boot buckles again!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_SYSTEM_000_399: Meanwhile, in the Clockwork City of Goug...
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_IMPERIALRESEARCHER0: Sir! Further research will be required to reach a positive conclusion, but preliminary tests show that the technology utilized here bears striking similarities to our own.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_GABRANTH_000_402: Excellent. Let the Eorzeans play with their baubles. True power lies within these very walls.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_GABRANTH_000_403: It appears our ancestors were as cunning as they were ruthless.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_GABRANTH_000_404: A weapon powerful enough to carve a gateway to the land's very core. His Radiance will be eager to test this “Tartarus,” wouldn't you all agree?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_MIKOTO_500_20: It has been an honor to serve one as brave and just as you, . I only hope my contributions to this most recent endeavor have proven of value.
Before this assignment, I would spend my days alone in the library poring over texts, learning of others' accomplishments, but never recording any of my own.

But witnessing you and all you achieved in our short time together has inspired me. When I return to Sharlayan, I will put in a request with the Students of Baldesion for an increase in field research!
But I think I shall start with something in lower La Noscea! Thank you, !
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_210: I owe you an apology, . I was wrong to doubt you.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_211: Whether it be in a council room or on the field of battle, you have proven yourself more than worthy of the many praises the bards sing. I am glad to have counted you an ally, for I would not wish you upon even my worst enemy.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_215: In fact, our paths may cross again sooner than expected. I received word earlier that the Eorzean and Eastern alliances have agreed to assist Lente's Tears, though not in the manner my leader first sought.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_218: In fact, our paths may cross again sooner than expected. I received word earlier from both the Eorzean Alliance and Doma that they have agreed to assist Lente's Tears, though not in the manner my leader first sought.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_220: They will be providing refuge for those displaced by the fighting. Children, elderly, the wounded─I have been assured that all are welcome.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_221: Unlike our demand for soldiery, both Lady Tataru and Lady Yugiri seemed much more amicable to this request. Perhaps they remembered how only recently Eorzea received refugees fleeing from Doma and Ala Mhigo. And perhaps it was I who reminded them.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_222: As for now, I must return to Dalmasca with these tidings, and somehow not only convince the myriad resistance factions to cease their infighting, but also cooperate in the organization of a method in which refugees might be transported safely across the borders.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_223: Needless to say, I have my work cut out for me. But even then, this is only the beginning. Once the refugees are safe, there is still a war to be fought...and won.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_FRAN_500_224: And when that time comes, do not be surprised when I come again calling.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_GIJUK_500_230: Reports are that the IVth Legion has marched on Valnain, making the commercial center their new temporary base of operations. If that is so, then that is where we strike next!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_GIJUK_500_231: We had our past misgivings, , but in the end we all learned to work for the same cause. I hope we can do so again, soon!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_RINOK_500_235: It won't be simple uniting the factions, but when has war ever been simple?
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_RINOK_500_236: Once we are a united front, we still have to figure a means of besting the most powerful army in the world. And if, by some miracle, we achieve that, then we have an entire nation to rebuild...starting with the smoldering heap I used to call home.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_RINOK_500_237: But then again, it sure feels better than being a sky pirate. Let the next time we meet, , be in the Desert Sapphire 'neath the royal Dalmascan standard!
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_BWAGI_500_240: If Ba'Gamnan were here, he'd smile and slap us both on the back. You'd probably fall on your face. I miss the captain.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_00543_BWAGI_500_241: I'm not as optimistic as my brothers as to our chances of meeting again, but know this, : I will not forget you, and hope that maybe you will say the same.
TEXT_STMBDI303_03189_LINAMEWRILAH_000_43: Well, wasn't that an adventure, ? It is sad to think we must soon part ways, what with all we've been through these past few moons.

Satisfied with the city's unwillingness to turn him over to the Garleans, Jenomis has decided to purchase a permanent berth above Kugane for the Prima Vista. Supposedly he has already received petitions from hundreds of geiko and geinin to join the company.

And then there is the matter of my assignment. You will be delighted to learn that I am...almost finished. What? How do you expect one to write an exposé when off battling forces of evil from beyond the void? Don't you worry, though. A few more weeks and I'll have a draft! All right...an outline.
Until then, I'll stay here in Kugane a while longer...at The Raven's expense, of course. Farewell!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_WANDERINGWRITER_000: The Suhd Viandja was truly an amazing wine! I admit, before leaving Garlemald, I was worried the outlands' vintages would not agree with my palate, but oh, how I was wrong!
Not only was the rosé one of the best I've had during my time here, it is one of the best I've had...well, ever! I simply had to have more so...
...I went and purchased an entire crate of the stuff! Ah hah hah hah!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_044: And I gave him quite a deal, I might add. Which was not easy, seeing as there is great demand for bottles of Suhd Viandja throughout the Three Great Continents.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_WANDERINGWRITER_000: I shall reserve my judgment on the verity of Hancock's “deal,” but even were the price double, it would have been more than worth it.

Fortunately, I recently sold an entire collection of my works to a little playhouse on Kogane Dori─the Mujikoza, I believe they called themselves (these Hingan words leave my tongue in knots)─and scored myself a tidy profit.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_047: Hm? The price of a single bottle more than a house in Mist, you say? Hah! More than a birdhouse, I suppose.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_048: Oh, you were serious. Well, then, I can inform you that is most definitely not the case. Even during shortages, I've never had to ask more than, say, twenty or thirty thousand gil a bottle. Forty if the buyer was wearing silks.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_049: You say Master Gegeruju provided you with this misinformation, did he?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_050: Why, the conniving devil! Well played, you lecherous Lalafell, you! I mean...that is terrible! What a terrible thing for him to do.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_051: Wait... Was that “Dalmascan” wine we “procured” for Master Gegeruju some moons ago in exchange for one of his bottles of Suhd Viandja?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_WANDERINGWRITER_000: Do I...uh...want to know about this, Hancock?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_053: Probably not, but I shall enlighten you anyway...
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_WANDERINGWRITER_000: It sounds like you and Hancock make quite the cunning devils, . Still, I do feel somewhat responsible for this whole mess...
As an apology, might I offer you a bottle of...vintage Suhd Viandja?
No, of course not. Ahem. Then, what would you say to a bottle of Dalmascan? You could exchange it with the bottle you gave this Master Gegeruju and absolve yourself of all wrongdoing and whatnot.

Ah, now you are probably wondering where one might find a bottle of genuine Dalmascan red, considering the hells you had to negotiate simply to find an empty bottle. Well that, my distrustful friend, is where Hancock comes in.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_058: I do? Oh, yes...ahem, I do. And I just so happen to have a bottle of Dalmascan wine on my person this very moment! Three, in fact!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_059: And why do I carry bottles of the rarest wine in Othard on my person, you ask? I...er...am not at liberty to say.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_060: ...If you must know, I acquired them from one of my acquaintances in Rabanastre... Bah! All right, all right! I purchased them from Lady Fran.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_061: Is this all what I think it is?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_BWAGI_000_062: (-Bwagi-)Enough Dalmascan red to keep a Bangaa happy for a long, long time. Amongst the royal sommeliers there was a Viera like Lady Fran. When word came the Garleans were approaching, she ordered the entirety of the Royal Palace's cellars delivered here where they'd be safe from the Empire.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_BWAGI_000_063: (-Bwagi-)Seeing as the situation with the palace is what it is, I don't believe anyone would mind Lente's Tears using the wine to, say, fill the resistance's coffers.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_065: If this many bottles were to make it to market, the price would fall like a phurble from an oak! I would be ruined!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_RINOK_000_066: (-Rinok-)And here I thought they said you were a shrewd one. Now if it were I to acquire this much wine, I reckon I would only release a few bottles at a time to ensure...what would you call it? Maximum profits?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_FRAN_000_067: (-Fran-)Rinok, there's no need to be rude to our guest.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_FRAN_000_068: (-Fran-)You told me before that the East Aldenard Trading Company could not provide the Dalmascan resistance with aid as it would not be good for business. So, I offer you something that will.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_070: N-Not that it transpired anything like that, mind you! Ahem!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_071: So... Would you care to purchase a bottle? I jest, I jest!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_HANCOCK_000_072: Now take a bottle and consider it my apo-apolo-polo─ Ahem! And consider it the last you'll get from me.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_WANDERINGWRITER_000: Enough, . Poor Hancock looks as if he has lost his mistress to a morbol. Three bottles is more than fair to see your wounded honor restored.

Think of it this way, . If you hadn't saved the world from Ultima's bane, the High Seraph would most definitely have destroyed all that wine in the monastery simply out of spite. Meaning, you're entitled to at least those three.
And, if you so desire, you can take one of those bottles back to Costa del Sol and set things right.

Though, something tells me Master Gegeruju won't take kindly to you waltzing into his manor and demanding he exchange bottles for no apparent reason... Hm... Perhaps you might enlist the aid of that vintner from Wineport. What was his name again? Shamwow...Shamon...Shamani! Shamani Lohmani!

Amazing... Simply amazing. And is it safe to assume you are here to right a past wrong─one involving a fancy bottle full of falsehoods and fabrications?

Well, I am more than willing to help you sort out this sordid mess. If I had said something back when I learned you would be trading a bottle of Valens for mere Suhd Viandja, none of us would be in this position in the first place.

I shall accompany you to Master Gegeruju's seaside manor and explain to the man that the bottle you gave him had not been stored properly, and that we have come to exchange it with one that has. He is certain to believe the claim coming from me, his most trusted supplier.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_500: Spoiled? Shamani! I am shocked to hear that such a careless mistake was made on your watch.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: My deepest apologies, Master Gegeruju. I was not made aware of the error until recently, and have since been seeking to procure a replacement─the one I come bearing today.

Would you care to partake in its aroma? I find you will recognize hints of kukuru, cinnamon...and, if you hold the goblet at just the right angle, freshly cut rosemary. A veritable kaleidoscope of both opulence and refinement, if I do say so.
Without question, this bottle most certainly contains none other than Dalmascan Valens.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_504:
I shall be the judge of that.
Mrmmm...yes... A florid banquet of...wooden...distinctions, hunkered beneath a...rhapsodic veil of undertones...and, uh...what you said.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_505: Yes, this is, without doubt, a vintage Lea Monde! I accept your apology and will allow the exchange!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_506: You two! Fetch me the bottle, now!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: Again, my apologies, Master Gegeruju. I shall endeavor to prevent any similar oversights in the future. You have my word.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_508: Yes, yes. But may I ask...what, exactly, are your plans for that bottle?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: This? Why, dispose of it, of course. It is far too foul to even flavor a stew.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_510: Then you wouldn't mind if I kept it, would you?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: Kept it...? But why?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_512: Why do you think? There is coin to be made! A little wax about the top and I can convince my fool colleagues back in Ul'dah that this is an authentic, sealed bottle of Dalmascan red! And once the bidding ends, I'll have enough for another wing to my manor here!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: Master Gegeruju! Knowingly presenting someone with a bottle of wine understood to be of inferior quality? That would be... That would be... I could never allow such a thing!
Never! Never!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_515: What's one little bottle? I'll even give you a cut of the profits! A small cut.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: I. Said. NEVER!
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_GEGERUJU_000_518: Now look what you've done! Ladies, hurry and collect those pieces. I have some animal glue in the bungalow─
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: And...uh...a good day to you, too!

All's well that ends well, I suppose. The important thing is that we exchanged the bottles. Now, as to how this is all going to affect my future dealings with Master Gegeruju...you let me worry about that.
What's this? A second bottle of Lea Monde? For me? You know I cannot accept such a gift!
There are literally thousands more where this came from? Well, if that is the case, I suppose I can.
Thank you again for the wonderful gift. As a distributor of fine wines, rarely am I allowed the luxury of partaking in mine own supply. I shall truly enjoy this exception.
Perhaps I will even allow old Byrglaent a glass... Half a glass. Here's to hoping it will inspire his winery to even greater heights.
Hm? Is that another bottle I see there sticking its cork from your pack? Gods, those things truly are bottomless, aren't they!?
Well, as happy as I would be to take it off your hands, I believe there is another far more deserving than I. You'll find poor Drest where he always is...
Hopefully the bottle can provide Drest with even a moment's respite.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_650: Why have you come back? There is nothing for you here... There is nothing for any of us...
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_651:
That bottle... Where did you─?
The scent... Home...
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_652: I'm sorry... I just... I don't deserve this.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_653: 'Twas my wife... My wife who...always saved the corks.
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_654: Do you think she'd...she'd forgive me? If I told her I wasn't coming back...
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_655: Would my brothers-in-arms? Would they allow me this...this respite...?
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_656: Maybe it is time I asked them. They'll all be here soon... Just like they are every night. But tonight, I'll have brought them something...
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_DREST_000_670: Thank you, friend. The scents of home are not as frightening as I imagined they'd be...
TEXT_STMBDI311_03190_WANDERINGWRITER_000: You're back! And, my, far quicker than last time. Everything off with nary a hitch then, I presume.
That is truly, truly wonderful to hear...and I'm not simply saying that because there's been this nagging in my gut that's followed me since I asked you to fetch me some wine that fateful day.
Please accept this as a token of my gratitude. I've been told you adventuring types fet─er, collect them, as well.
TEXT_STMBDI312_03191_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_00: Now that old Jenomis has finally discontinued his jolly junkets into the untamed wild, he is once more committed to the company. I venture we have you to thank for that.
And so to show our gratitude, my husband would like to offer you...further opportunity for employment! Isn't that thoughtful of him!?
TEXT_STMBDI312_03191_WANDERINGWRITER_000: ! Did I ever tell you how much I adore this city? It's simply so...so...exotic! And the cuisine! Oh, the cuisine! I've never experienced so many flavors in my mouth at once!

Why, just the other day, I was given a jug of the most wonderful rice wine by the lad from the Mujikoza who purchased my collection of past works. Can you believe it? Wine, made of rice, of all things! What will they think of next?

Ah, but I suppose you're wondering why I had my darling summon you over. Well, it's this wine. While absolutely delightful, none of the nibbles I usually take with my traditional reds and whites pair well with the stuff. And so, once again, I require your help.

The kind woman who operates the shuttle to the Prima Vista tells me if I am to eat like a true Hingan, then I should start with grilled turban, tempura, and some ridiculous thing called “tako-yaki.” I believe three of each should suffice. And as always, only the best of the best.
TEXT_STMBDI312_03191_BEWITCHINGMEMBER_00: When it comes to local cuisine, my husband can be such a snob. Half the time I'm convinced he cannot tell the difference between chicken and chocobo, but still he insists on partaking of only the highest-quality fare.
TEXT_STMBDI312_03191_WANDERINGWRITER_000: Three servings of grilled turban, tempura, and tako-yaki...and nothing like that you'd find at a corner stall. I expect only the finest.
I never doubted you, ! My darling, she may have doubted you, but me? Never! You have quite a knack for this line of work.
Now, let the festivities begin! Here is your reward. Please see yourself out.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_GUARD03255_100_000: Ah, ! Have you seen Ryne? She's been looking for you.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_GUARD03255_200_000: Wait here. I'll go and get her.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_003: The truth is, I need your help...
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_100_003: Now hold on─I haven't even told you what it is yet!
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_004: Ahem. After you defeated Emet-Selch, I sensed a strange concentration of Light, somewhere far to the south.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_005: In the Empty─the lands that were once swallowed by the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_006: I can't tell what it is, but we have to find out. For all we know, it might even be another Lightwarden!
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_100_006: But whatever it may be, I don't intend to stand by and watch. I'll...
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_007: Sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself. Thancred, Urianger, and I have a few theories that we plan to test once we find whatever's causing this.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_008: The three of us were reluctant to ask for your help, considering everything that you've been through. The thing is, you're the only person who can defeat a Lightwarden without becoming one yourself, so we have no choice.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_100_008: While we don't want to jump to conclusions, it would be a good idea to have you there, just in case.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_110_008: So, will you come with us?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_Q1_000_001: I wouldn't have it any other way!
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_Q1_000_002: Perhaps we should let sleeping dogs lie.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_010: Thank you, ! This means a lot.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_020: I see your point, but if we choose to ignore it, we should at least know what we're ignoring first. And there's no harm in taking a look, is there?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_030: First of all, let's head to the Derrick in Amh Araeng. Thancred and Urianger should have everything ready by now.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_040: Sorry to drag you all the way out here. I have a feeling you'll miss this place when you see where we're going next, though.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_041: 'Tis a blessing to see thee so hale.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_050: I hope the desert creatures didn't give you too much trouble on the way here.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_051: I doubt they posed any sort of challenge to . Would that I could say the same with confidence about whatever fiend may be waiting for us out there.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_100_051: Even if the Light that Ryne sensed turns out to be nothing of consequence, the Empty is hardly the most welcoming of places. Anything that could survive out there is not to be trifled with.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_052: Moreover, it should be reiterated that the Light-blasted wasteland poseth as severe a threat as any foe we might face.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_053: In any event, we are in agreement that this phenomenon doth warrant investigation. Though for lack of more precise means of navigation, we must needs rely on Ryne's innate abilities to guide us.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_100_053: I have formed several hypotheses regarding the nature of the Light, but speculation is a poor substitute for firsthand observation.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_055: There'll be plenty of time for us to talk about it on the way.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_056: Ready to take us wherever we need to go, aye. Back again too, maybe, if we ask it nicely.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_057: Though the Light hath been expunged from Norvrandt, the ambient aether of the Empty is still corrupted. Dangerously so, in fact.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_100_057: The Flood of Light devastated everything in its wake. The soil, the air, the water, all rendered incapable of supporting life.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_110_057: 'Tis due to this imbalance that the Empty remaineth utterly uninhabitable, even a century thereafter.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_059: That's why we're taking every possible precaution. Between the aetherometers I've packed and Ryne's unique abilities, we should be able to detect and measure any fluctuations in our alignments.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_100_059: According to the Crystarium scouts, a few days out there won't affect us to any noticeable degree. But much longer than that, and we risk becoming sin eaters...
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_060: Since we still don't know how chocobos and amaro will fare in the Empty, we opted for a more mechanical mode of transportation. This comes courtesy of the researchers at the Mean, who found it in the Crystal Tower and restored it to working order.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_100_062: It's quite safe, I promise. The person in charge said he'll have parts delivered from the Crystarium should anything break.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_110_062: He seemed quite eager to see what we bring back from the Empty, even though I told him we're not hunting for treasure. I'll introduce you if we have a chance to stop by Mord Souq at some point.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_062: Anyway, I think that covers everything. When you're ready to leave, just say the word!
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_070: While I'm piloting and Ryne's navigating, you and Urianger will be free to enjoy the view and engage in rousing conversation. By that, I mean he can spend the whole time talking at you, while you nod in agreement.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_071: Although the Flood of Light is believed to have expunged all traces of life from the Empty, we must remain ever vigilant. We know not what we shall find.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_080: With a name like “the Empty,” I wasn't expecting much in the way of pleasant scenery, but this is downright depressing.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_081: To look on the lands swallowed by the Flood with mine own eyes... 'Tis a chilling sight indeed.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_082: Approximately nine-tenths of this world are as this. A slate all but wiped clean...
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_083: Were it not for the Warriors of Darkness and Minfilia...
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_084: Ryne, are you sure we're heading in the right direction?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_085: Yes, I'm certain. There's no telling how far away it is, though.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_086: Nothing for it but to keep going, then. You two back there may as well take a nap. I have a feeling we've a good few malms ahead of us.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_087: I have to say, it's a touch larger than I was expecting. And is it...sleeping?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_089: I don't like the sound of that... Is it a Lightwarden?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_090: No, I don't think so. Instead of being filled with Light...it is Light.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_092: Long have I strived to unravel the mysteries surrounding the Flood of Light. To discover what set that terrible cataclysm in motion.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_100_092: Every thread led to the same conclusion. The same single point...
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_094: I have reason to believe that the entity we see before us is the first sin eater. The instigator of the Flood─the very foe Minfilia vanquished a century ago.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_095: She gave everything she had...and won.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_096: ...But this abomination could undo her work.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_097: Aye, the possibility cannot be denied. Though it is oft said that destruction and creation are but two sides of the same coin.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_098: Ryne, knowest thou of what I speak?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_099: The power to shape reality, to bend the laws of nature. For what was once shattered may be forged anew.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_100: That's all well and good, but don't you think we should give it a name first?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_102: "Utopia“ in Fae. A most auspicious title.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_THANCRED_000_103: Now that that's settled, perhaps we should find a spot to set up camp. I even brought a couple of tents, on the off chance, but pitching the damned things is something of a fine art. Does anyone fancy helping me?
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_URIANGER_000_110: Though frequent rest may allay the symptoms of prolonged exposure to the Empty's ambient aether, 'twould be unwise to linger here overlong.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_120: I never realized that putting tents up could be such a bother! Still, I'm glad that we got there in the end.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_RYNE_000_121: Thancred should be back from scouting the area soon. Once he's here, we can plan our next move.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_SYSTEM_090_121: During the course of your investigation, you may discover valuable artifacts.
TEXT_LUCKRA101_03255_SYSTEM_100_121: These can be exchanged for equipment by speaking with Ghul Gul in Mord Souq or Yhal Yal in Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_000_000: Though frequent rest may allay the symptoms of prolonged exposure to the Empty's ambient aether, 'twould be unwise to linger here overlong.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_010: I wonder what's taking Thancred so long?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_000_020: Well, that was rather uneventful. Not that I'm complaining.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_000_022: No, thankfully. There's naught but barren plains in every direction, apart from Eden, obviously. I tried approaching it, and the brute didn't even seem to notice me. I thought it best not to tempt fate, so I withdrew.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_023: We should act now, before it's fully awake.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_025: When I think about the Flood of Light, I get the feeling that rather than destroying everything in its path, what it actually did was stop the flow of aether.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_100_025: Of course, that meant that all of the plants, animals, and people here could no longer survive. They must've crumbled to dust in the years since.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_110_025: But the aether is still here, lying dormant.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_120_025: If Eden is the one that caused it, maybe it can get it flowing again.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_130_025: I don't know for certain, but I think I can use Eden to bring life back to the Empty!
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_000_026: Now, hold on a moment! What makes you think that's even possible? And how do you expect to control that kind of power?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_000_027: Ryne's aspirations may not be as preposterous as thou dost surmise.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_100_027: I believe Minfilia halted the Flood of Light's advance not by destroying Eden, but by silencing it.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_110_027: And in so doing, she hath gifted us an opportunity too precious to waste.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_120_027: Even now, the flame of hope burns on.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_000_029: Aye. As Minfilia's successor, it standeth to reason that Ryne doth possess the means to exert her will over Eden. But such a monumental task is not to be taken lightly. What sayest thou, ?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_A1_000_001: I imagine this is easier said than done.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_A1_000_002: It would put Ryne's life at risk!
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_040: Yes, you're probably right, but I have to try!
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_050: There's more at stake than just my life. If Eden is allowed to awaken, who knows what will happen? I have to try!
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_000_060: Very well, Ryne. You've made up your mind. So, how should we go about this?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_200_060: I have an idea. I've been studying it carefully ever since we arrived, and it seems to me that the Light is more...concentrated at a certain point. I suppose you could call it the core.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_210_060: That giant Talos had a core too. Like a beating heart, it controlled the flow of aether. If Eden's core is the same, perhaps we could use it to restore the aetheric balance?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_230_060: By employing Aethernet shards as beacons, mayhap we could trace the aetherial flow to Eden's core, and in so doing secure the means to teleport to the very heart of the beast.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_240_060: Thankfully, the Settlement council has kindly furnished us with a plethora of apparatus by which to perform such feats.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_250_060: However, we must needs first have Ryne study the entity's interior and chart us a suitable course.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_260_060: Once we have reached our destination, I shall fabricate a means by which you may directly communicate with Eden, and mayhap exert a measure of control over it.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_270_060: You can really do that, Urianger?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_280_060: All credit is due to a dear friend. A gentle soul long since departed who imparted to me a wealth of knowledge concerning aetherology.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_290_060: Although I am certain she would be all too quick to chastise my methodology...
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_300_060: Excuse me for interrupting this trip down memory lane, but I don't imagine that Eden will be too happy about us...rummaging around in its innards, for want of a better term.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_310_060: In all seriousness, though, I wouldn't be surprised if there is some sort of welcoming party arranged for intruders. Perhaps you had best lead the way, ?
