TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_320_060: It's true that 's the only one who can defeat a Lightwarden, but I'd rather not rely on  any more than we have to.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_330_060: Yes, I haven't forgotten what happened when  absorbed too much Light. But as Alisaie said, “Making promises you have no way of keeping is not a kindness.”
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_340_060: Now, I wish I could put down Wardens myself, but the simple fact is I can't, and there's no point pretending I can. That's why I'm asking .
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_360_060: You already have a job to do, remember?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_370_060: The only reason this plan even has a chance of success is because of your involvement. We need you to concentrate on the task at hand, and guide us to the core.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_380_060: Not only that, you'll have to keep an eye on Eden itself. If we somehow manage to make it angry, get us out of there.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_390_060: Are you sure you want to go through with this?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_A2_000_001: This is what I do best.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_A2_000_002: For lack of any better plans, this one will have to do.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_100_080: Though we will remain here, Ryne and I shall do our utmost to guide thee along the aetherial stream.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_200_080: After thou hast breached the exterior, we shall remain in contact via these linkpearls, courtesy of our comrades in the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_200_081: Being relics salvaged from the Crystal Tower, I fear they may be somewhat less reliable than those to which thou art accustomed.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_000_090: The teleportation apparatus hath been calibrated successfully, and I believe the probability of irreversible disintegration to be relatively low.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_000_091: I can't get this bloody thing lit! It must be because the aether has stopped flowing, just as Ryne said.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_100_091: Though if this plan of hers and Urianger's actually works, we might have to stop calling this place “the Empty.”
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_095: (-Ryne-)Be careful! Huge amounts of aether are rushing to the core! Wait... What's that!?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_000_100: Though we anticipated some form of resistance, I did not foresee Eden generating a smaller replica of itself. To think that a mere fraction of its power could manifest such a powerful adversary is frightening indeed.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_000_101: It seems that we'll have to wait for the aether within Eden to stabilize before we can all teleport to the core.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_SYSTEM_000_093: It would be best to consult Ryne and Urianger before attempting to use the Aethernet shard.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_110: It seems that Thancred's prediction about there being some sort of guardian was right. Thankfully, it was nothing that you couldn't handle.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_111: And I'm glad to say that you haven't absorbed any Light, either. So far, so good.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_112: Now that the way is clear, the Aethernet shards can send us to the core and back whenever we need. Why don't we give them a try?
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_000_120: Though the apparatus is now in place, a number of minute adjustments must needs be made before attempting to assert control over Eden.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_THANCRED_000_121: Standing around and waiting is hardly my forte, though I daresay I'm more suited to this than whatever Urianger's doing.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_130: Once Urianger has activated the device, it's my turn.
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_RYNE_000_144: Not now...not when I'm so close!
TEXT_LUCKRA102_03256_URIANGER_000_146: I am unharmed, but what of Ryne?
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_001: Well, I'm glad that's over. But for how long?
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_010: It worked... I'm in control now. I think...
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_011: Although I'm now linked to Eden, I still need to figure out how to give it commands.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_100_011: Pray tell, what caused it to convulse so violently?
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_012: It must have been when Eden rose into the air. I'm still struggling to stop it from drifting too far from the camp.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_014: Ah... Above us! Something's coming this way! An enemy!
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_000_015: But how dost thou─ Ah! Could it be a sin eater!?
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_017: I...can't see them clearly, but... No, that's impossible!
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_019: They're inside, too! Lots of them, trying to reach the core!
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_020: Uninvited guests, eh? If I'd known they were coming, I would've tidied the place up.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_000_021: Japes are a poor substitute for a viable stratagem.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_022: In that case, I suggest that you and I deal with the ones who're already inside.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_023: And  can welcome our airborne adversary.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_024: Ryne, find out if Eden has any defenses we can make use of. Preferably ones that don't recognize us as the enemy.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_025: I'm not sure about that, but I can use the aether currents to send you wherever you need to go.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_026: That's my girl. All right, everyone, we've got work to do.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_027: From what I can tell, Eden is able to form simple structures by redirecting aether, so I'll try to give you something to stand on. When you're ready, head for that portal over there.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_030: Come on, Eden! Show me what you can do!
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_041: We came as soon as we took care of our unwanted guests. They were a stubborn bunch and quite unlike anything I've ever seen in the First.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_044: Who are you? What do you want?
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_VOIDWALKER_000_046: (-???-)Why am I here!? What is happening...?
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_047: She's alive, but there's something strange about her aether...
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_048: She didn't seem too pleased with Ryne taking control of Eden, which may be what caused her to appear out of the blue. Beyond that, it's anyone's guess.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_000_049: 'Tis plain she is not a sin eater. Not even in part as Vauthry was.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_000_050: Yet this knowledge does little to assuage my fears, for she is nonetheless possessed of a power most terrible.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_051: On the other hand, if she's feeling cooperative, she might be able to tell us more about Eden.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_052: I'll keep an eye on her until she wakes up. There's no telling what will happen when she does, but I'll make it clear that we mean her no harm. Well, no further harm, at the very least.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_053: Obviously, it's not a good idea to bring her inside Eden. It's likely that reaching the core was her aim from the outset, so I'll take her to the camp.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_054: Now that things have settled down, I should get back inside and try strengthening my link to Eden.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_THANCRED_000_060: The girl is in the tent, fast asleep. Or possibly in a coma. One or the other. Either way, we have little choice but to wait for her to wake up.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_000_061: I have yet to discover the means by which the exterior was breached, though 'twould appear that the fiends that Thancred and I slew were of a similar nature to those led by thine own adversary. Voidsent, in other words.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_070: Although I had my hands full trying to control Eden, I caught a glimpse of your battle. That power... I've never seen anything like it.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_100_070: What thou witnessed was the tearing of the very fabric of reality─the creation of a rift through which voidsent may enter. But pray tell, Ryne, didst thou make any other observations?
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_110_070: Hmm... I couldn't sense any Light at all in that girl or her servants.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_120_070: And I can't really explain how, but she reminded me of Emet-Selch.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_URIANGER_000_071: Though I think it unlikely that she is an Ascian, she may yet be thrall to Zodiark.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_100_071: Maybe we'll be able to find out more once she's woken up. In the meantime, I'll try to improve my control over Eden.
TEXT_LUCKRA103_03257_RYNE_000_072: It seems to be listening more than before, instead of screaming at me like it was in the beginning. And that's not all! I've made an exciting discovery!
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_000: Mayhap Eden hath imparted unto Ryne some manner of ancient knowledge?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_010: I feel a lot more confident in my ability to control Eden now. Of course, this is only the beginning.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_011: And we shall accompany thee wheresoever this path may lead. But pray tell, what manner of discovery hast thou made?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_012: I understand how Eden's power works.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_013: And therefore the true nature of the Flood of Light?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_014: Yes. It affected the balance of all of the aether in the Empty, shifting it so far towards the umbral that it stopped flowing altogether.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_015: The power to tip the scales...
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_016: And to tip them back again.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_100_016: That's what Eden does. It controls the balance of aether over a wide area, forcing it from one alignment to the other.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_110_016: Left alone, it still poses a threat, but if I can harness its power, I think I could use it to breathe life back into the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_120_016: The trouble is, I haven't the foggiest idea of where to start.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_130_016: And if I go about this the wrong way, I'll do more harm than good.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_017: Thou needst not bear this burden alone, Ryne. Nor should thou.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_018: 'Tis no simple matter of awakening that which lies dormant.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_100_018: All things in nature are inextricably linked. The elements maintain a fragile harmony, without which, life cannot prosper.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_020: A solution hath begun to take shape in my mind, though it will require further discussion. For the time being, let us return to the camp. 'Twould be remiss of us not to involve Thancred.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_030: I'm curious to know what connection that girl has to Eden. If only she'd told us a bit more before she collapsed.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_000_031: Still sleeping soundly, I'm afraid. If I'd known she'd take so long to come around, I'd have brought a good book or two to pass the time.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_040: My friends, I believe I have struck upon a method by which we may see this world restored.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_000_041: Urianger, before you go any further, allow me to make a potentially very long story slightly shorter. The plan is to control Eden and realign the aether of the Empty, right?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_042: In essence, yes. However, unleashing elemental energies haphazardly will not suffice.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_100_042: In addition, the Empty is unfathomably vast. Were we only able to effect change over one small region at a time, it would take many lifetimes to complete even a fraction of our task.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_043: Instead, our energies would be better spent revitalizing each element in order, that we might set in motion a more widespread transformation.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_100_044: I hate to say this, but I don't think Eden will be able to draw out a single element without affecting the others.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_045: For that very reason, we shall select a location in which the ambient aether we wish to restore is at its most potent.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_046: Even in a dormant state, certain elements will be more prevalent and therefore more easily manipulated.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_100_046: Then, we rebalance the aether and return it to the land, whereupon it shall be borne on aetherial currents to the farthest reaches of the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_000_047: But what's to prevent that element from breaking free of Eden's hold and causing a disaster of some sort?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_048: It must needs be contained. The question is, how?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_200_048: , indulge me a moment if thou wouldst.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_210_048: Pray imagine a corporeal manifestation of each of the individual elements. What dost thou see in thy mind's eye?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_250_048: Mayhap thou art afeared to utter the fateful word. For to even speak the name “primal” is to invite misfortune.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_260_048: Though invite it we must. As the aether is drawn forth and realigned by Eden, we shall perform a summoning as Master Louisoix once did on the fields of Carteneau.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_270_048: As one who hath laid low countless primals, thy memories will shape the aether into a deiform entity, which must subsequently be dispersed in the traditional fashion.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_280_048: So, “defeat it,” in other words. But is that even possible!?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_A2_300_048: I break my fast on primals!
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_A2_310_048: It's either that or being torn to shreds.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_A2_320_048: To be honest, I'm not entirely sure I can.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_330_048: Lest thou forget, 'twill be no more than an approximation of a foe thou hast previously bested.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_340_048: I have every confidence in thine abilities, .
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_350_048: As do I, though it might help to have some idea of what you will be up against. Have you decided which element to tackle first?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_050_052: I propose water. The source of all life.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_100_052: As for the location, an area to the west of Norvrandt was once home to the world's deepest ocean. Alas, the Flood of Light reduced it to a yawning chasm.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_053: Water... Yes, that seems like a good choice. I'll see if Eden can take us where we need to go.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_100_053: And I shall prepare for the summoning.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_110_053: Thancred, wouldst thou keep watch over our enigmatic antagonist? She may have vital information to impart. In the event that she becometh...agitated, thou mayest have need to restrain her.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_120_053: (-Thancred-)Someone's got to do it, I suppose. I'll be praying for your success while I wait here, twiddling my thumbs.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_100_054: Still, I must say I don't envy you being caught up in yet another one of Urianger's madcap schemes.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_200_054: Though, come to think of it, if the creature you must fight is born from your own memories and imagination, why don't you try thinking of something a bit...tamer than the primals you've fought in the past? Hmm... Perhaps that's not how it works. Anyway, best of luck.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_060: Leviathan is the ideal candidate to embody the element of water. Be warned that the circumstances of said summoning differ greatly from that of the primal encountered in the Source, and the results are difficult to predict.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_000_061: Ryne's acquitted herself well in this whole Eden business, but I think she needs to slow down a little. We're in no hurry, after all.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_070: Eden seems to be responding well to my instructions, so we should reach our destination in no time at all!
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_072: All right, this is the place. I'll see if I can draw out the water-aspected aether.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_073: The rest is up to you, !
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_SYSTEM_000_074: Memories of Leviathan come flooding back...
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_075: 'Twould appear that the summoning was a success, though Leviathan hath yet to reveal himself...
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_080: When you're ready, I'll have Eden teleport you there!
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_090: A most emphatic victory, . Unfortunately, we cannot yet be certain if the aether is behaving as predicted.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_000_091: Have you finished awakening the water element? To be honest, I don't see any difference.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_100: That was incredible! Is that what a primal looks like?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_101: Oh, not quite the same, then. But why is that?
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_102: The Leviathan of the Source was summoned by the Sahagin, to whom he was no less than a god.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_103: Without their faith, the deiform entity that we brought into existence differed on a fundamental level, though it was no less formidable.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_104: The manifestation relied upon 's experiences of Leviathan, and may have been influenced by recollections of other water-aspected beings, leading to further discrepancies.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_106: But I still can't tell if our plan actually worked.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_107: We'll just have to wait and see, I guess.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_THANCRED_000_109: (-Thancred-)If you've finished slaying your primal, or whatever it is, I suggest you get back here on the double. There's something you ought to see.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_111: Evidently, our only recourse is to return to our base of operations forthwith.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_URIANGER_000_122: By the Twelve's good grace... 'Tis a marvel to behold.
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_123: I never thought that a whole lake would suddenly appear like this!
TEXT_LUCKRA104_03258_RYNE_000_124: And we're just getting started. I only hope the burden is not too much for you, .
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_000: Such a profound transformation...though the change appeareth to be limited to an area no more than a few malms in diameter.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_THANCRED_000_001: You know, when I first heard Urianger's plan, I didn't know what to expect. But then that enormous crystal appeared and water came gushing forth and, well...
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_010: I think this proves that the water-aspected aether is no longer lying dormant. So, which element should we realign next, Urianger?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_011: I propose earth. Should we succeed in returning the soil's life-giving energy, the Empty shall become capable of supporting the growth of flora.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_012: Imagine that! Forests in the Empty...
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_100_012: But before we begin, I'd like to know how that girl is doing.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_THANCRED_200_012: Still sound asleep. She didn't so much as stir even when I took her helmet off. I thought it might be getting a bit stuffy in there, and I was curious to know what sort of person we're dealing with.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_THANCRED_300_012: She seems surprisingly normal, not at all like your usual voidsent. I'd say she's around the same age as you, Ryne, perhaps a little older.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_400_012: Well, whoever she is, we should let her rest while we concentrate on the task at hand.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_THANCRED_000_013: As much as I'd love to go with you, I'd best stay here in case she wakes up and is feeling less than cooperative.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_THANCRED_100_013: And while I wait here wishing I had something to read, my thoughts will be with you as you fly off to face the next opponent.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_THANCRED_200_013: It must be a strange feeling to bring something into existence through your own willpower, only to slay it immediately after. I almost feel sorry for the poor things. All the same, I wish you luck.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_300_013: If all goes well, he won't be waiting for long. The sooner we get this over with, the sooner we can see the results.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_020: Once more unto the Empty, dear friend. Thou art prepared, I presume?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_030: Now, before we embark on our journey, there is one question I feel I should ask: where are we going?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_031: I would suggest a certain region that lieth east of Norvrandt which was once home to the great Mount Atlas.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_032: And for the earth-aspected primal we wish to invoke, what could be a more fitting choice than Titan?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_033: I don't think I've heard of that one. What's it like?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_A1_000_001: He is worshipped by the kobolds.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_040: Thancred mentioned those. They're your world's equivalent of the Mord, yes?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_050: It seems like you had a rather traumatic experience.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_060: But if our last battle is anything to go by, this one will be different from the Titan that  remembers, yes?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_061: Aye, 'twould be wise to consider the two as entirely separate beings.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_100_061: As such, thou must needs conceive new stratagems if thou art to triumph in the battle to come.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_062: Past experience will avail thee naught, I fear.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_063: All right, . Once you're ready, we'll be on our way!
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_064: It took a while, but we've finally arrived.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_SYSTEM_000_066: Memories of Titan come tumbling back...
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_070: Remember: the primal will almost assuredly be vastly different from that which thou didst lay low on the Source.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_071: The terrain around here seems a bit rough, but Eden can give you something more level to stand on.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_081: That thou wert able to triumph over this avatar of primordial rage is testament to thy puissance.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_090: Welcome back! You must be exhausted.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_091: For a creature made of rock, he was a lot more agile than I was expecting.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_092: I wonder─ Was the Titan of your world a tough opponent too?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_A2_000_001: He never stood a chance against me.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_A2_000_002: Yes. If I'd put one foot wrong, I would've fallen to my doom.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_100: Well, having seen the way you fight, I can believe that.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_110: So all it would've taken is a momentary lapse of concentration? I don't like the sound of that.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_120: But more importantly, you've defeated another elemental being, which means we're a step closer to reclaiming the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_122: I can't wait to see how much of a difference we've made this time!
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_500: Did we really do all of this?
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_501: Aye, 'twould appear that balance has returned to the element of earth. And yet...
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_502: The transformation hath affected only the immediate vicinity, whereas the lands beyond this lake doth remain unchanged. 'Tis passing strange, indeed.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_504: Though this falleth short of the outcome I had envisioned, 'tis plain our efforts were not in vain.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_505: Mayhap this localized phenomenon is the result of an intersection of aetherial currents...
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_URIANGER_000_506: Therefore, it is reasonable to assume that similar locations in the Empty hath undergone comparable alterations.
TEXT_LUCKRA105_03259_RYNE_000_507: Then the aether will spread out from these points to cover the rest of─
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_000: Perhaps asserting her will over Eden hath taken its toll.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_000_011: That didn't look like nothing to me. You'd better lie down for a while.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_012: No, really, I'm fine. Anyway, we've still got work to do.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_013: Nay, Thancred hath the right of it. 'Twould be unwise to exert thyself overmuch.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_014: I appreciate your concern, but I do wish you'd stop fussing.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_015: Ryne, thou knowest not the strain thou dost place on thyself.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_016: Though the elements of water and earth hath been restored, continued exposure to the Empty's stagnant aether may yet sap thee of thy remaining strength.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_017: Now that you mention it, I've been feeling a bit out of sorts ever since we got here.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_018: I should probably get away from the Empty and rest for a while.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_019: Pray do so. Meanwhile, I shall remain here. The restoration of the first two elements hath produced unexpected results, and I require time to analyze our findings.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_020: However, I must ask thee to refrain from discussing our work in the Empty, even with our closest comrades.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_021: Why? I thought they'd welcome the news.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_100_021: And indeed they shall, once we have more to show for our efforts.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_110_021: Nevertheless, this mission is one of surpassing danger. I am loath to place our dearest friends at risk unless absolutely necessary.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_120_021: You have their best interests at heart, I'm sure. But to be perfectly honest, I'd prefer not to keep secrets from people that I trust with my life. I don't want to make a habit of this, but I'll do as you ask.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_000_022: It seems to me that Ryne isn't the only one who would benefit from a change of scenery. Our sleeping beauty would likely fare better in more hospitable surroundings.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_100_022: We'll need to have our associates from the Crystarium organize a safe place for her to stay. If you and  could go on ahead and have a word with them in Mord Souq, we'll catch up with you once Urianger has finished...whatever it is he needs to do.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_024: Perhaps thou, too, shouldst accompany her on the return journey. I daresay she would be glad of thy presence.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_000_025: No. Not this time. She's come such a long way since we first met, and I worry that relying on me too much will only hold her back.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_100_025: We won't be staying in the First forever. The time will come for Ryne and I to part ways, and for her to follow her own path.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_110_025: I know you understand this too, Urianger. I see you trying to pass on as much of your knowledge as possible while you still can. And to her credit, she's actually taking most of it in.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_120_025: Ryne is possessed of a natural affinity for aetherology, unlike some who shall remain unnamed...
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_130_025: A natural affinity for staying awake during your lectures, more like. Though, come to think of it, she doesn't really take after me at all.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_140_025: However, like thee she is predisposed to brooding in silence in lieu of voicing her concerns.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_150_025: Says the master of keeping his cards close to his chest. Anyway, , you'd better take the skyslipper with Ryne.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_160_025: It's true that she's been through a lot lately, but so have you. We'll need you ready for the challenges that lie ahead, so go on and get some rest.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_170_025: We shall await news of thy safe arrival in Amh Araeng.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_000_070: We'll have to decide whether it's worth posting Crystarium guards to watch over Eden while we're gone.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_071: As there is little risk of our camp being ransacked, it may be left unattended in our absence.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_080: It seemed like you were all having quite a serious discussion. I hope I haven't given you any cause for concern...
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_081: Well, if you say so. I probably shouldn't stay in the Empty any longer than necessary, though. So, do you want to take first shift piloting, or shall I?
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_100: Phew! I'm glad I had you there to keep me company. I've no idea how I would've passed the time otherwise.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_100_100: Now that we're here, I need to find our contact from the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_101: But before that, I was hoping I could have a word with you. Something's been on my mind.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_102: This might not be the best place for it, though. Those creatures over there look a bit hungry...
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_110: When I first spoke to Thancred and Urianger about what I'd sensed in the Empty, part of me wished we could've just left it alone. I guess I was scared of what we'd find.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_112: But now that we've found Eden, I know that I made the right choice.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_113: And if I'd given in to my fear, I probably would've spent the rest of my life wondering what might've been.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_130: From now on, whenever I hear that voice inside telling me to run away, to hide, I won't listen. That's not who I am anymore.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_100_130: Even so, all the courage in the world is not going to help me decide what we should do with that girl when she wakes up.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_110_130: Do you remember what she said right before she passed out? “Why am I here!? What is happening?”
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_120_130: What if she's being controlled or forced to act against her will?
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_130_130: Whatever the case, it's clear that she's not a monster, she's a person, like you or me.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_140_130: Obviously, she knows something about Eden, and we need all the information we can get. But more than that, I just want to talk to her, to find out who she is and if there's anything we can do to help her.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_150_130: On the other hand, we mustn't forget that she's already attacked us once. What's to say she won't try it again when she wakes up?
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_160_130: If she keeps us from reclaiming the Empty, it will be all my fault. It's no good, I can't make up my mind. What do you think we should do, ?
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_A1_180_130: If Alphinaud were here, he'd talk things through with her.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_A1_190_130: Even Emet-Selch had his reasons. We should at least hear her out.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_A1_200_130: There's not much we can do until she's awake.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_210_130: Yes, like that time in Eulmore! Even when confronting Vauthry, he tried his hardest to find a peaceful solution.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_220_130: Hopefully, she'll be a bit more willing to listen.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_230_130: I see what you mean. Perhaps if we'd been able to come to an understanding, things wouldn't have ended the way they did.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_240_130: I hope that she's nothing like Emet-Selch, but we won't know until we speak to her.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_250_130: I'm sorry. I probably shouldn't be trying to decide her fate before we even know who she is.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_260_130: In the meantime, we'll have to be patient and hope that she comes around soon.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_148: Until then, I'll try to concentrate on the here and now. Speaking of which, I still need to see to Urianger's errands.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_149: The people we're on our way to meet lent us the skyslipper and most of the apparatus we've been using. And since we've been sworn to secrecy, I assume the same applies to them and their colleagues.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_100_149: Anyway, once that's over with, we can find a place to relax!
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_150: Now that we're here, allow me to introduce you to two members of our “inner circle,” or whatever you want to call it.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_151: That's Ghul Gul, who's interested in trading for any relics we find in the Empty. Apparently, he mostly deals in exotic weapons and whatnot, but he's agreed to keep us supplied with whatever else we can't get from the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_100_151: Now, the ones we came to meet should be around here somewhere...
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_LEWREY_100_151: (-???-)Ah, Ryne! What a relief it is to see you returned unharmed from your expedition!
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_200_151: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting! We were gone a bit longer than we expected.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_300_151: , I'd like you to meet Lewrey.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_LEWREY_400_151: It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. As representative of the Settlement council, I am here to oversee the delivery of equipment deemed necessary to your mission.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_LEWREY_500_151: I will be on hand to provide any assistance you may require.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_510_151: Actually, there's something we'd like you to take care of...
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_520_151: It's probably best not to talk about it in the middle of the market, though.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_152: I'll take it from here, . You should get some rest.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_RYNE_000_153: But before you go, I'd like to thank you for everything you've done. We still have a long road ahead of us, but if we give it our all, there's nothing we can't handle!
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_URIANGER_000_501: Though it is mere supposition, it would behoove us to proceed with caution. Moreover, I would refrain from discussing the matter with Ryne and  until we know more.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_000_502: Well, I appreciate you telling me, even if it is too soon to be sure. I'm the one watching over her, after all.
TEXT_LUCKRA106_03260_THANCRED_000_504: I pray it is not true.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_RUMORSDWARF03671_00: You heard the latest rumor out of Komra? The strangest find in recent memory, though actual details as to what said find actually is have yet to emerge.
If you do happen to come into any juicy tidbits, I'd be keen to hear 'em. The suspense is killing me here...
Remember: I'm the one what put you on the scent! So if you learn any exciting secrets, you'd best share them with me! 'Tis only fair!
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: I can neither confirm nor deny the existence of a new discovery of untold value that only a select few are allowed to see for themselves.
That said...there may come a time when I find myself utterly fascinated by that pile of rocks over there and would be completely oblivious to anyone attempting to sneak past...
...You're a  of the world, ain't you? Don't make me say it plain.
Wicked white! How bloody stupid are you!?
You─the imbecile─give me─the guard─ten thousand gil. Then you─the imbecile─get to walk past me─the guard─and see the amazing find. Got it?
Then you do not get to pass. You go away! Good day, !
Heh heh, about time you started playing by the rules...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-what in the blazing hells do you think you're doing man-ho!? Is that any way for a guard to behave? Is it!?
No rations for you tonight!
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: It's...<sniffle>...it's not fair, I tell you... A dwarf toils day in and day out for a pittance, only to try and make a little something extra on the side, and what does it get him... <sob>
Right, well, anyway─bugger off. None may pass without the Chief's permission, which I know you haven't got.
Oh look, it's the sinner who cost me my dinner. Go hassle the chief if you want to go in, 'cause I sure as hells ain't letting you pass.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: No time for you, friend. We've our hands full with this latest find of ours...
Wait, wait, don't tell me. I assume you came all this way to put in for the position? Sorry, but it's already been filled.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_A2_000_001: Came all this way for the what-now?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_A2_000_002: You know what they say about assumptions...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Eh? Don't go playing silly buggers with me. The queer ruins we found deep in a cavern through a tunnel over there! The one filled with all kinds of machina? To the point we've started calling it a bloody machina graveyard?
Yes, well, we were looking to hire on another guard, but the position's since been filled by that fellow what tried to swindle you a moment ago.
So you're out of luck, I'm afraid. But chin up, . Your time'll come round again soon enough.

Since you're here and still unemployed, mind delivering a message for me? It's for two younglings in Komra, Anogg and Konogg─sister and brother, twins. Fond of wearing white and black. Twin thing, I suppose.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_10: The message is as follows: “Lali-bleeding-ho! This is no place for children to be messing about! Stay far, far, far away, or else!” Got it?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: If I told you several times before you're not getting in, what makes you think I've since changed my mind? I mean, think about it...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Anogg and Konogg, wearing white and black. You'll know 'em when you see 'em. And don't forget the lali-bleeding-ho!
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_150: Hm? You got business with us?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_100_150: ...The chief put you up to this? And you agreed? Haven't you got anything better to do with your time?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_151: Wait...those garments...that quiet confidence...those powerful neck muscles sculpted by a lifetime of nodding...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_152: (This is that sinner everyone's been talking about, Sister! 's the guileless fool we've been waiting for! The perfect patsy!)
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_153: (Good thinking, Brother. Let's get right to it, then!)
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_154: Ah... Ahem! You wouldn't happen to be that kindly stranger everyone likes and adores? You are, aren't you!? Perhaps you would be willing to do us a teensy little favor? Of course you would!
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_155: My brother and I are conducting some highly secret research at the moment, but we've hit a dead end. To continue, we need to get our hands on an automaton core...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_157: Oh, don't be silly! Everyone knows you're the soul of generosity! A sinner who cannot help but render aid to  fellow sinner in their hour of need! Not for fame or fortune or any other reward, but simply for the joy of it! Am I wrong?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_A4_000_001: ...This is another one of those moments where it really doesn't matter what I have to say, isn't it?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_161: But despite your vehement refusal, deep down we both know you cannot help but aid us in our endeavor. 'Tis your nature. We will pretend that you agreed without a fuss and that will be the end of it.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_163: The core we require is being stored with other sundry materials on the cliffs above us. Once you have it, bring it to my sister.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_165: As soon as you have that automaton core, bring it to me straightaway.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_170: Don't dally, sinner! We need that core for our research!
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_180: Can't you see we're in the middle of a very important conversation?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: You gave 'em the ol' lali-bleeding-ho, did you? Hope they took it to heart.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_251: And is that the core I spy in  hot little hands?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_252: Heh heh heh, brilliant! All we've got to do is sell this for a small fortune, and then we'll be one step closer to seeing our plans for world domination to fruition...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_254: (Oh, right! That was a close one, Brother!)
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_255: Now then, for our next request...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-what in the hells are you two up to-ho!? If you're even thinking of taking advantage of this good sinner, I'll tan both your hides and toss you from the top of White Oil Falls! Now get you gone!
Sorry about that. They don't know any better, on account of them being all on their own. No parents.
They've lost more than most, you could say. More than anyone ever should.

Anyway, I've been meaning to ask. Everyone says you're the soul of generosity─a sinner who cannot help but render aid to  fellow sinner in their hour of need. Not for fame or fortune or any other reward, but simply for the joy of it. Am I wrong?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_A5_000_002: I'd swear you just repeated nearly word for word what those two...never mind.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: We're short a lantern at the dig site. Should be another in the cave just outside of the village. Mind going and fetching it for me? 'Course you don't.
Once you've got it, bring it to me back at the dig. Oh, and don't worry─I'll see you compensated for the trouble.
Got that lantern for me? No? It should be in the cave just outside of town.
There you are. I presume that lantern you're holding's for yours truly?
Much obliged. Here─a little something for your trouble.
Never let it be said a dwarf of character doesn't pay his debts. Anyway, if we've nothing else to discuss...
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_354: We want to see the ruins! Please please please please please!?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: No, no, no, no, no. It's dangerous and off-limits and even if I were the sort of man who could be bribed─which I'm not─I'd be shocked if you two had anything valuable enough for me to risk my neck looking the other way.
Why are you and everyone else so bloody obsessed with trying to get a look at the cavern filled with mysterious machina anyway? It's just a bloody scrap heap, isn't it?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_357: No no─it's so much more! Based on our research, we have reason to believe that those ruins contain─
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_358: (Hush, Sister! How many times must you nearly give the game away!? It's supposed to be our secret!)
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_359: (Oh, yes, right. Right. It's just so hard sometimes to contain my enthusiasm...)
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_360: Nothing. These ruins contain nothing of value whatsoever. We shall leave you to your affairs, honorable guard sir, and bid thee farewell.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Honestly, I'm beginning to hope that there really is nothing of value in there, for all the trouble it's causing. But as I was about to say─if we've got nothing else to discuss, then you'd best be on your way. It's dangerous to wander about an active dig, and I don't want anyone getting hurt.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_ANOGG_000_370: What does it matter to you if we go through? It's not like it's your find! You have nothing to lose!
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_KONOGG_000_371: You really must let us through. It's a matter of the utmost importance!
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: ...What in the hells are you two on about?
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_RUMORSDWARF03671_00: Poked around Komra, did you? Learn anything about that big find?

A machine graveyard, eh? Interesting, interesting... This could be the beginning of a great and grand adventure. Or an utterly nonsensical one─though that does have its appeal on occasion, I'll allow.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Folks ought to keep busy, that's my motto. Idle hands are the fae's playthings.
TEXT_LUCKYA003_03671_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: Wicked white, if you start pestering me like those twins to get inside... <sigh> I tell you, what's the point of being a guard if you can't profit off it? Why would anyone ever take this job?
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_RUMORSDWARF03671_00: Hail, sinner! Have you heard about the string of thefts in Komra? Word has it that they haven't the foggiest who's behind them. Not a clue! They've gotten desperate to find the culprit, I'm told, pointing fingers at any who so much as sneeze in a suspicious fashion.

Why, the next thing you know, they'll be blaming their old rivals in Tomr─ Wicked white! They would do that, wouldn't they? Damn those thin-bearded blighters! Listen, sinner, you go and tell them that if they try to pin this on us, there'll be consequences...
Those bastards! How dare they theoretically accuse us of petty theft!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Yes, yes, lali-bleeding-h─ Oh, it's you. My apologies, sinner. Been under a bit of stress lately and don't really have time to chat. Although...
Perhaps you can help. I know you welcome these sorts of requests for aid, after all.

Things've been going missing, you see─at first it was just the odd tool here and there, but then the thief began making off with finds from the dig. Valuable finds. If you've got the time, I could use some help in identifying the culprit.
I don't like to think of it, but it's likely that the thief is one of our own. Hard to access the site otherwise, and I've stalk─er, investigated most of the unfamiliar faces in town to no avail.

I can't very well ask you to stroll up to folks with a, “Lali-ho! Done any crimes lately?” But do have a look around─perhaps you can find a clue that I've overlooked. I'll take anything at this point, frankly.
If you're wondering why I don't simply lie in wait by the valuables, well...let's just say that if there's one thing I've learned these past few days, it's that I'm not the subtlest tack.
I don't intend to let this miscreant run amok, though. I'll be here waiting when you have something to report.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_DWARFMASTER03671_10: Hmm... You don't look to have our criminal stuffed in your pack there, but I take it you've found some manner of clue?
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Hold on, I think I've seen this before! It belongs to a young lady in the village, if I'm not mistaken─though I couldn't say how she came by such a valuable trinket.

Seeing as regular folk can hardly fail to notice when something jewel-encrusted goes missing, she'll like as not be wondering where it's gone right about now. You'll probably find her in a panic─all the better for getting her to spill her secrets.
Have a look around the village for any lass who seems out-of-sorts. That's who you'll want to interrogate, mark my words.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_YOUNGGIRL03717_100_: Thrice-damned beardless son of a shite-eating hob... Where, oh where could my bloody bracelet have gone!?
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_YOUNGGIRL03717_000_: You found it? And you're returning it, too? Well, bugger my beard! Thank you ever so much─it was a gift, and I'd hate to have lost it.
A gift from who, you ask? You probably don't know him─he's a guard over at the dig site.

I had no idea that sort of job pays so well, but it must. When we met, he was a right bastard where money was concerned─I could hardly get him to pay for my ale─but of late he's been downright generous. In a much better mood, too. Oh, and so very affectionate. Mm, yes...
Focus on the bracelet? If you insist. I don't know where he got it, though─we don't do a lot of talking.
If you're that curious, you'll have to ask him. He keeps watch over the entrance day and night, so he's not a difficult man to find.
The dig site watch's name? It's, er...hmm. You know, I never asked!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_ANOGG_000_250: Come on! Let us in, let us in!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_KONOGG_000_251: Come on! You know you want to!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: What I want is for you two to bugger off. I'm a watchman, not a stand here while everyone annoys the piss out of me-man!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_KONOGG_000_253: Don't look now, Anogg, but our very dear friend is here! And so very heavily armed, too.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_KONOGG_000_254: I'm sure that  can help settle this little dispute.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: Of all the─ Why are you here? As if costing me my dinner weren't enough...
How did I afford a jewel-encrusted bracelet on a watchman's salary? That's...that's none of your concern!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_A1_000_001: Oh, but I have a feeling that the chief will be quite concerned indeed.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_A1_000_002: I recall that you have something of a history with ill-gotten gains...
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: Hmph. Doubt my words all you like. I won't be intimidated by the likes of you!
Doubt my words all you like. I won't be intimidated by the likes of you!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_ANOGG_000_265: Listen here! If you don't let us in, we'll...we'll...
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_KONOGG_000_270: We'll scream really loudly into your ear! How would you like that, hmm?
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I hope that we're finally close to catching the thief. The machine graveyard is a bothersome enough mystery without all of this nonsense.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: ...This proves nothing, you hear me? Nothiiing!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_ANOGG_000_301: Well, I don't know what you were accusing him of, but I'm absolutely sure he's guilty of it.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_KONOGG_000_302: More importantly, he's made off with the key! After him!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_KONOGG_000_351: I don't think he's alone, Sister...
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_ANOGG_000_352: Oh, dear. A hasty retreat does seem to be in order!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: That's right, surprise triplets! What now, baldling!?
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_GUARDBROTHERB03717_: In the name of our collective dinner!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: This is...<pant>...starting to feel like real work...
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_KONOGG_000_360: The jig is up! Now hand over the key!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: Very well, I confess. I did it. Or─we did it. We took turns keeping watch while the others picked over items from the dig site and sold off whatever seemed valuable.
And we would have gotten away with it, too, if it weren't for those meddling kids. Also you, however old you are.
I just wanted to impress her... <sigh> But there's no chance of that now. All I can do is grovel before the chief and hope that he doesn't punish me too harshly.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_SYSTEM_000_403: You notice that something shiny and metallic has fallen to the ground...
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_SYSTEM_000_410: Picking up the glimmering object, you see that it is the very key to the dig site that Anogg and Konogg were so keen to obtain.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_DWARFMASTER03671_00: That's case closed, then. It's a good job that you showed up─who knows how long this farce would have continued otherwise.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_DWARFMASTER03671_10: As for you... You won't be getting any dinner tonight, that's for certain!
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_DWARFMASTER03671_00: To think that I was employing three brothers in disguise this entire time... I doubt I'll be changing my vocation to detective any time soon.
TEXT_LUCKTA001_03717_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: We've all taken our lesson to heart. No need to worry about us─or to draw your weapon, thank you.
...Also, our convoluted plan turned out to be just as much work as taking the job seriously, in the end, so there's that.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_DWARFMASTER03671_00: By the by─haven't seen Anogg and Konogg, have you? Usually when they go this long without getting underfoot, it means they're up to something.
I'd be grateful if you'd track them down again and send them my way. They're peskier than a pack of pixies, but even so, I'd rather keep them where I can see them.
Sooner you can track down the wee scoundrels, the better. It's too quiet...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_TUNNELGUARD03671_00: We've all taken our lesson to heart. No need to worry about us─or to draw your weapon, thank you.
...Also, our convoluted plan turned out to be just as much work as taking the job seriously, in the end, so there's that.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_050: That's the watch taken care of, but we never did get that key...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_051: You mean to say that you picked it up? And no one's even noticed it's missing? Splendid! I shall open the door, and then you may escort us on our foray.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_052: After all, everyone knows that the only thing that brings you more joy than being of service to your fellow man is...adventure! Indeed, your adventurous spirit calls you toward ever greater challenges, no matter how staggeringly ill-advised or outright suicidal!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_A1_000_002: But the chief says we're not allowed. No, no, I couldn't possibly.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_055: And after we've made it sound so very appealing!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_056: How truly, madly, deeply you wound us, !
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_057: I see that we have no other choice but to drag you on this adventure against your will. Never mind the how─we'll come up with something on the way.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_058: Hurry along, now! There are secrets to be found here, and we'll be the ones to bring them to light─and possibly to market, depending.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_100_058: Maybe we'll even give you a share of the spoils! A small one, mind.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_060: Nice work in trouncing those brutes earlier. You're so easy to push around, I had almost forgotten your vocation!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_150: Locked. Which bodes well for us finding something worth our time within, assuming we can get it open...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ROBOT03718_000_153: (-Mysterious Machina-)Intruders sighted. Eliminating with extreme prejudice.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_157: “Machine lifeforms”? What are you talking about? And why didn't you blow up?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_158: I am numbe─ 2P. Call me 2P. The rest can wait.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_159: The machine lifeforms must be stopped. To do that, we must reach the heart of the ruins. Come.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_DWARFMASTER03671_00: How bloody stupid are they!? <sigh> Listen, sinner─I know we've put you to plenty of trouble already, but...I need you to stop them before they dig themselves any deeper. At this rate, someone's going to get hurt.
Not a thimble's worth of common sense between the two of them, I tell you. And once they get going...<sigh>
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_200: Another door! Who needs this many doors?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_210: Sealed per defensive protocols, I believe.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_211: Protocols, shmotocols! We've got something for this immovable object.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_214: I'm sure you were told to keep us from getting into trouble, or some such nonsense, right?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_215: But who took care of those machines? Us! Who got the door open? Us! Who's going to find out what's in there? Us!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_220: If we can't unlock it, we'll need to break it down.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_225: They don't make this easy, do they? These machine-whatsits.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_230: That's the means of ingress secured. Onward.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_235: Aha! Hahaha! Mwahahahahahaha...<cough> <cough> <cough>...<wheeze>... Remind me to save the maniacal laughter for after the dust clears, next time.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_240: Smell that? That gentle scent carried with the draft? That's the smell of secrets!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_DWARFMASTER03671_00: If you won't stop them, at least keep those two from getting themselves killed. I've got enough problems without adding funeral arrangements.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_300: There may be others lying in wait. We should withdraw.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_100_350: She just collapsed! One minute she was walking ahead of us, the next─well, as you see here.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_350: Though after all of that, perhaps the greater shock is that you're still standing. I'm impressed. And a little bit scared.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_351: Truly, you're wasted on the petty errands that everyone else puts you up to.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_353: More importantly, who was that boy in black? How was he controlling the machines?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_354: Not a boy, an android. An advanced machine designed in imitation of mankind. Same as me.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_356: But that's impossible! It's hard enough to make a fully functioning ironbeard, or a wind-up automaton that bears a passing resemblance to a real person. To create machines that look and act and fight like you two... Who could possibly have done such a thing? And how?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_357: But─fine. Let's say, for the moment, that I believe you. Why would one of these androids want to attack us?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_358: I don't know. But he's not the only one out there.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_359: And if the other androids come looking for these ruins, I can't promise they won't be just as...aggressive.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_360: Anyone who gets in their way could be in terrible danger. This whole place could be in danger...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_361: If they're anything like what we just saw, I don't like our chances...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_362: Don't be silly. We have our clever minds! We have loads of explosives! We have an exceptionally violent assistant, and we even have an android of our own!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_364: My systems took too much damage in that battle. I don't...think I'll be functional for much longer.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_365: I can only tell you what you need to do.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_366: Deep within the ruins lies the key. Find it.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_2P_000_367: With it, we can stop them. The machines, the androids...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_369: Restore... Restore her to functionality, maybe?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_DWARFMASTER03671_00: What in the hells was that about?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_372: A very promising discovery, is what!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_373: So we must persevere! Onward! Inward! Awaaay!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_DWARFMASTER03671_00: They're both all right, by the looks of it. Didn't expect that. Well done.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_385: Ah, danger upon danger! Mystery within mystery! How invigorating, this...invigoration!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_400: I knew that there was something of value in there! Mwahaha...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_401: And once we get our hands on it, they'll see. They'll all see!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_402: Oh! Nothing! What? Did you hear something?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_000_404: Ahem. The real question is, do we pack more explosives this time? Maybe we can fit some in your pack, as well...
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_100_404: You are coming along, right? Oh, who am I kidding─I know you wouldn't miss it!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_A2_000_001: Oh, I'm sure I won't be given the choice to miss it.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_A2_000_002: How charming that you continue to pretend to care about my opinion.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_200_404: Yes, yes, we both know that you're loving this.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_600_404: And I have a present for you! Feast your eyes on this!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_300_404: It's a one-of-a-kind recording device─the portable archive! If you spot anything odd, aaanything at all, march right up to it and let this collect its data. Then we'll have a nice little set of records to review.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_ANOGG_400_404: I know, I know, we're brilliant. Anyway, find a place for that in your pack, and do take care of what other preparations need doing. We'll be ready to go when you are.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_SYSTEM_500_404: The Portable Archive is now available under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_SYSTEM_500_405: Fill your archive by using it to record data at promising spots within the ruins!
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_DWARFMASTER03671_00: So there're androids, which are machines, but also other machines, and also...
Look, all I know is that I'm not keen on anything that gets Anogg this excited. Not bloody keen at all.
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_KONOGG_000_415: Having seen all of that from 2P...what else sleeps within those ruins, I wonder?
TEXT_LUCKTA002_03718_SYSTEM_000_420: Try as you might, you cannot detect the sound of breath or whirring cogs, nor any visual indications of life of any sort.
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_ANOGG_000_001: Ready? Trick question─don't care! Let's go!
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_KONOGG_000_005: There's no stopping her now. So much for preparation.
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_ANOGG_000_050: Just think─machines equal to man! No, perhaps even greater! If we can find the key, we can figure out how they work! We can fix 2P, and then...
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_KONOGG_000_051: ...And what? Slow down and use your head! How are we to know that any of what she said was true?
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_ANOGG_000_052: Oh, so you'd have us sit on our hands instead of pursuing the untold power that sleeps in these ruins? Twiddle our thumbs while others race ahead and claim the prize?
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_KONOGG_000_053: I'm as intrigued as you are! But I would not have us put our blind faith in someone we've only just met─particularly someone making such wild claims. Were we to bring this “key” to her, there's no telling what she might do with it...
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_ANOGG_000_054: Hmph. If you want to be a coward, be my guest. I'll be boldly forging a path forward as, if you recall, we planned to do. And if we can secure 2P's continued assistance, all the better.
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_ANOGG_000_055: What about you? You can either dive into the great unknown with me, or stick in one toe at a time like a beardless baby.
TEXT_LUCKTA003_03719_KONOGG_000_060: Sometimes I hate being the reasonable one.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_001: Don't fret about Konogg. He'll see that I'm right and come crawling back eventually.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_002: There's so much that we could learn here. About these ruins, living machines... And 2P is the best source of information we've got. We need to seize this opportunity while we can.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_SYSTEM_000_004: Should you give your support to Anogg's approach, Konogg's path will no longer be available to you.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_SYSTEM_000_005: Please note, however, that your choice will not affect the rewards and challenges to come.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_007: I knew it! Fortune favors the bold!
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_025: These “pod” devices must be part of this place, but they don't seem to be particularly murderous, as far as things in here go. We should be able to use them to ferry us further in again.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_050: Oh. Right. Before we go any further─you remember these odd boxes? They seem to enable aetheric transference.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_051: If we get lost, it should be a simple matter to teleport back to the entrance using one of these, so don't worry your pretty head about becoming trapped down here. And with that said...
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_052: Throw caution to the wind, and go forth and investigate!
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_053: And the moment─the very instant that you find something of note, make sure that you show it to me! Got it?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_100: Found anything mysterious yet? Records, or artifacts, or...I don't know, weird puddles of goo?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_200: You've found something, haven't you? Well!?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_201: Hmm... I'd bet that whatever this is, it's part of a greater whole.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_202: Let's see if we can find any other pieces. I might be able to reassemble it...if I had any idea what it's meant to be.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_300: Have you found me some more parts?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_301: Oh, look at all of these! Hard to say for sure whether we have everything until we take a crack at reassembling it, of course, but it's a start.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_100_301: And this pod! I've been so wanting to take one of these apart...
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_POD_000_304: Alert: multiple lifeforms detected in proximity.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_305: “Lifeforms” would be us, I presume? Interesting.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_306: If it's still functional, there's no need for me to disassemble it. Pity. Still, I say we take it back with us.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_100_306: Any objections? No, of course not! So let's get on with it.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_KONOGG_100_309: It's him! Though how he climbed back up here in that state...
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_KONOGG_000_309: Well, you're the one who wanted to work with 2P. I'm sure she would say to destroy him for good. What do you say?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_310: Oh, Brother, you know me too well.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_311: We take him with us, of course. Just in case. It'll be our little secret.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_KONOGG_000_315: I trust your investigation is going well?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_350: Konogg and I will be heading back out. I want to perform a proper analysis on these parts as soon as possible.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_351: I don't blame you if you want to look around a bit more first─though you had best share your findings!
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_KONOGG_000_352: This may be the clue we've been searching for. I only hope it doesn't blow up in our faces...in any sense.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_401: You know those parts we found? Well, I've managed to cobble them together into a decent approximation of...something.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_402: I was hoping that if I got the basics right, the pod could tell us what it's meant to be, but it won't stop repeating “processing” and beeping at me.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_403: It worked when it was analyzing us, so theoretically it should be up to the task, but it seems we'll have to wait for it to finish...whatever it is that it's doing.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_404: I'm half-tempted to take my tools to it, but if I can't put it back together we'll be back to square one. So─patience it is. Hmph!
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_405: In the meantime, we have quite a bit of other data to analyze. So much, in fact, that I'm certain we will need a considerable amount of time─uninterrupted time─to work. If you take my meaning.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_406: I'm telling you to keep the chief off our backs for a while─I don't care how. Say that his house is on fire, if you like. Or put it to the torch, if you're not comfortable with lying.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_ANOGG_000_410: We simply don't have the time for half a dozen lectures about “protocol” and “safety” and “ethics,” you understand?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_KONOGG_000_415: I thought that “key” was a figure of speech, but...it looks like it could potentially be an unlocking mechanism. If you squint.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_KONOGG_000_425: You heard Anogg: we're counting on you to keep the chief occupied so that we don't have to.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-mysterious machines from the ruins will kill us all-ho, I suppose.
Sorry, it's...been a lot to take in. Did you manage to keep our local miscreants out of trouble?
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_A1_000_001: They're safely studying our discoveries as we speak.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_A1_000_002: I found them to be surprisingly competent, actually.
TEXT_LUCKTA110_03720_DWARFMASTER03671_00: It's true that when it comes to mechanical contraptions, you'll find none cleverer than those two. Or more obsessive.
If anyone's capable of solving the mystery of these ruins, it's them. Much as I hate to say this, we should leave them to their own devices. For now.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_001: There's no point in arguing further─she's immune to reason when she gets like this.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_002: I'm happy to continue investigating─of course I am, that's why we've gone to all of this trouble─but we need to be careful as to how we go about it. Especially where 2P is concerned.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_003: I don't trust her─at least not yet. Even should we find this “key,” we ought to be discreet as possible about sharing our plans and information. Don't you agree?
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_SYSTEM_000_004: Should you give your support to Konogg's approach, Anogg's path will no longer be available to you.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_SYSTEM_000_005: Please note, however, that your choice will not affect the rewards and challenges to come.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_007: Indeed. I knew you'd have the sense to listen to me. Now, let's get started, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_025: I don't like relying on this place's internal mechanisms, particularly to dangle me over a gaping chasm, but it seems we have little choice. Maybe if I close my eyes...
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_050: Before we proceed, we should decide upon what to do in the event that we become lost in this maze of a place.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_051: These teleportation devices should serve. If you can't find your way back to me, use one to return to the entrance immediately. I'll meet you there.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_052: Got it? I'd hate to lose our muscle because you wandered off and fell into a pit somewhere.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_053: Now you're free to take a look around. If you find anything noteworthy, bring it to me.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_100: Found anything of note yet? Records, artifacts, weird puddles of goo?
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_200: That's the look of a  who's on to something! Do share.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_201: Hmm... I'd bet that whatever this is, it's part of a greater whole.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_202: Let's see if we can find any similar pieces. We may be able to reassemble it, if so.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_300: You have more parts for me, I trust?
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_100_300: Don't be a miser, now. Let me see them too!
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_000_301: Oh, look at all of these parts! And this pod! I've been so wanting to take one of these apart...

TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_000_306: If it's still functional, there's no need for me to disassemble it. Pity. Still, I say we take it back with us.

TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_KONOGG_000_308: Well, Sister, you're the one who wanted to work with 2P. I'm sure she would say to destroy him for good. What do you say?
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_000_309: Oh, brother, you know me too well.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_000_310: We take him with us, of course. Just in case. It'll be our little secret.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_000_315: How's investigating with Konogg going for you? Slowly, I expect?
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_000_350: Konogg and I will be heading back out. I want to perform a proper analysis on these parts as soon as possible.
TEXT_LUCKTA120_03721_ANOGG_000_351: I don't blame you if you want to look around a bit more first─though you had best share your findings!

TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: Ah, . Glad you could make it.
As you may have heard, Commander Aldynn has given orders to embark from Alliance Headquarters to hold back the advance of the Empire's latest menace.
Not that the soldiers stationed there are too chuffed about being on the front line against these new Weapons. If they're designed to slay primals, they'd make short work of us mere mortals as well.
Mind you, it's Gaius Baelsar and his followers who've led the charge so far. By all accounts, they've been giving as good as they get.

Unfortunately, their sorties have met with little success. I daresay they'd benefit greatly from your presence on the battlefield. If you're ready, my colleague over at Porta Praetoria will show you the way.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: On your way to headquarters, I take it?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_Q3_000_000: Accompany the Resistance fighter to Alliance Headquarters?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: He was told to wait for you at the foot of the long set of stairs. I imagine he's milling about at the camp, trying not to step in any chocobo shite.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: Then I shall apprise you of the situation.
We have discovered that the previously abandoned Ultima Weapon project is being helmed by the reformed VIIth Legion.
They have already succeeded in producing several prototypes, one of which is set to be deployed on the Eorzean front. Its name: the Ruby Weapon.
Severa and I were able to get within striking distance during one of its test runs and made an attempt to destroy it.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SEVERA_000_055: An attempt that ended in failure, alas. Based on our knowledge of the original Ultima Weapon, the explosives we employed should have been sufficient to blast through its armor plating, but they barely left a mark.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SEVERA_000_056: We suspect the gifts of its predecessor may have proven the source of its resilience.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: As you well know, the Ultima Weapon was designed to absorb aether from eikons, and the Ruby Weapon no doubt shares that ability. If any were summoned during the uprisings in Garlemald's occupied territories, and thereafter consumed, our enemy would become all the more formidable.
But its near-impenetrable armor was only the beginning of our troubles.
It fought back with whip-like claws that can be extended and contracted at will. In the face of such opposition, we were forced to withdraw.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SEVERA_000_060: Gaius was injured shielding me from the Ruby Weapon's assault. Even now, he struggles to stand. Damn it all! If I hadn't been so careless, this wouldn't have happened.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: You need not concern yourself. Let us not forget that I am the one who initiated the Ultima Weapon project. If I must give my life to bury this shameful legacy, then so be it.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_VALDEAULIN_000_062: If you were to face it as you are now, you'd be cut down before you even hobbled within firing distance.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_VALDEAULIN_000_063: In any case, we can't afford to lose the information in your head, on both the foe we face and the Empire itself. We all know that asking for 's assistance presents our best chance of stopping that warmachina.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: 'Tis true that if anyone were capable of putting down such a monstrosity, it would be .
Though I have no right to ask this of you, will you lend us your strength?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_A1_000_001: I'm not one to back down from a fight.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_VALDEAULIN_000_068: And mine, though I must impress upon you the urgency of our situation. We have received word that the Empire is preparing to advance on the Ghimlyt Dark. That is where we will intercept them.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_VALDEAULIN_000_069: If our fears are proven correct, the Ruby Weapon will be among their host. Should it break through our lines, there is no telling the devastation it will wreak. Make no mistake, the very survival of Eorzea hangs in the balance.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_VALDEAULIN_000_070: Once you have steeled yourself for the battle ahead, your escort will lead the way.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_07: ...What price must the world pay for my hubris?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SYSTEM_000_100: A short while earlier, in the Garlean-occupied city of Werlyt's magitek installation...
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_OPERATOR03783_000_1: Commencing Ruby Weapon activation sequence. All units, stand by.
Initiating synthetic auracite system... Fusion successful, no signs of incompatibility. Awaiting your signal.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_MILISANDIA_000_103: (-Gutsy Female Voice-)Ruby Weapon, code name “Darnus.” Ready for launch!
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_VALDEAULIN_000_105: To be honest, we weren't sure if you'd ever show up. I, for one, am glad you've decided to throw in your lot with us.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SEVERA_000_110: Gaius says you are our best hope of defeating that abomination. We have seen only a glimpse of its true power, and even that was more than enough for us.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_RESISTANCEGATEKEEPE: On your way to headquarters, I take it?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_Q4_000_000: Accompany the Resistance fighter to Alliance Headquarters?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_CONVEYOR03783_000_1: Valdeaulin has briefed me on our mission.
I am to take you as far as our expected point of contact with the Ruby Weapon. Once we arrive, the rest is up to you, I'm afraid.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_15: Not only are the Ruby Weapon's claws as quick as lightning, they move with an uncanny degree of flexibility, and can strike from where you least expect it.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_VALDEAULIN_000_160: Given all we've come to expect from the Ascians, it wouldn't surprise me if they were behind the summoning of whatever primals the Ruby Weapon has absorbed.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SEVERA_000_165: Though I will not be able to join the battle with the Ruby Weapon, I have been tasked with keeping an escape route back to the Eorzean front clear, should you need to make a hasty retreat.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_CONVEYOR03783_000_2: I am to take you as far as our expected point of contact with the Ruby Weapon. Once we arrive, the rest is up to you.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_25: Even from afar your figure was unmistakable. As ever, an impressive display.
Though as I am sure you will concur, the Ultima Weapon pales in comparison to this new monstrosity. If their research is allowed to continue, the next model will be nigh on unstoppable.
With that in mind, the Alliance has enlisted the help of─ Wait. I hear something.
Here to sift through what remains of the Ruby Weapon, are you?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_ALFONSE_000_254: (-Imperial Soldier-)Allie! What do you think you're doing!?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_25: It has been too long, Alfonse. And you too, Rex.
Given that the Empire is proceeding with the Weapon project and making inroads into Eorzea, I suppose it was only a matter of time until our paths crossed.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_REX_000_259: It's wonderful to see you again, Father, although I can't say I think much of the company you've been keeping.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_ALLIE_000_260: I know a lot's happened, but I'm just glad you're all right. And now...you can come back to Garlemald with us!
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_SHADOWHUNTER_000_26: My days serving the Empire are over.
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_ALLIE_000_262: Because you're suspected of assassinating Emperor Varis?
TEXT_LUCKYW101_03783_ALLIE_000_263: But we know you'd never do a thing like that! There must be a way to prove your innocence!
