TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_050: But if I train Eden how to nurture the environment rather than drain the life from it, we can leave it to take care of the Empty in our place. I'll channel the aether through myself, and show Eden how it's done!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_051: This isn't some house pet we're dealing with! If it all goes wrong, then what?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_052: I know this all sounds like I'm taking a leap of faith, but it has been a gamble every step of the way.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_100_052: We've managed to come this far because of faith─in ourselves and in each other.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_053: <sigh> I've made my feelings on the matter perfectly clear, but what say you, ?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_A2_000_001: With my memories to guide the summoning, what could possibly go wrong?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_A2_000_002: I'll hold back as much as possible.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_056: Ryne, I suppose that if you've got your heart set on this, there's no point trying to dissuade you. Just don't do anything reckless, is that clear?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_100_057: This is going to work, I promise. I'll make sure of it.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_110_057: Well, for all our sakes, I certainly hope so. Because if the primal takes over...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_120_057: It'll be fine. With all of you by my side, I know that whatever happens, it'll work out in the end.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_130_057: All of us? I hope you're not including me. I can't even deal with my own problems, never mind yours.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_140_057: It's enough just knowing you're here. Anyway, I've decided to take a leaf out of your book. “I do what I want, when I want.” I've made my decision, so now I have to see it through.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_150_057: Yes, but this is a different kettle of fish altogether!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_160_057: Well, the point is that this is what I want, and I'll do whatever it takes to make it work!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_058: So, this is how much it means to you...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_SYSTEM_000_059: Memories of Shiva envelop your mind...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_060: I don't know how...but I can see her too! This might actually work!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_070: I think Eden is sending your thoughts to me! I see Ysayle... And Shiva... They only wanted peace, a land where dragon and mankind could live side by side.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_071: With so many things left to chance, all I can do is wait...and pray. Do you think the Twelve can hear me here in the First?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_URIANGER_000_072: Both Ysayle and Archbishop Thordan offered their corporeal forms as vessels, unto which the likenesses of preeminent figures from Ishgardian history were projected. However, the nature in which each met their demise is perhaps best not dwelled upon...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_073: So, she's not just waiting for the future to arrive, but actually trying to change it?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_081: You were there... I heard you...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_082: What happened to Shiva? Is she still in control?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_085: That hammer... It matches your dress...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_086: Hmph. I see you're back to your normal idiotic self.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_087: Look... Isn't it pretty? Maybe we could take it with us?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_088: Erm... Ice tends to melt, you know.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_091: Anyway, it might even make a nice necklace.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_URIANGER_000_093: Wilt thou not rush to her aid?
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_094: Perhaps I'm getting slow in my old age, because it would seem Gaia's beaten me to it.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_095: To think that she would be the one to break the ice. Ahem.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_096: They may have gotten off to a rocky start, but I think they'll make quite the pair.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_URIANGER_000_097: Is that a hint of melancholy I detect in thy voice? Something akin to a pining mother bird whose chicks have flown the nest...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_098: Father bird, if you don't mind. But aye, you're not entirely wrong.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_099: Still, when the day finally comes to say good-bye, it heartens me to know she won't be alone.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_100: After that, we can go to the Second Serving for coffee biscuits!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_101: Fine. You win. And if they're anything less than perfection itself, I'll never let you live it down!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_102: If they're not to your liking...there are plenty of other things to try!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_103: I suppose we both deserve a little treat after all that hard work. Hehe!
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_105: There we were, laughing as if we had not a care in the world. Fleeting though it was, in that moment, I was content.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_106: But my life was never meant to be so simple.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_THANCRED_000_110: I've had my share of close shaves, but that was...terrifying, to put it mildly. I can only hope the end justifies the means.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_URIANGER_000_111: Ice, being most naturally aligned to Light among all elements, did interact with Ryne's innate gifts in ways unforeseen.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_URIANGER_000_112: Were we not graced with the timely appearance of the Oracle of Darkness, I fear that this tale would have ended somewhat prematurely...
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_GAIA_000_113: I let myself get a little carried away there, but I was definitely the one controlling my powers, not the other way around. Even so, I hope I never have to use them again.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_120: I'm so sorry, everyone. I clearly have a long way to go before I can handle that kind of power.
TEXT_LUCKRA205_03791_RYNE_000_121: But we achieved what we set out to do, as I had faith we would. So without further ado, let's return to camp and admire our work.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_THANCRED_000_000: All this greenery... It's far more than I had dared to hope. I can't help but worry that it's too good to be true.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_001: The rapid propagation of flora appeareth to be limited to the intersections of aetherial channels, as per our earlier findings. Nonetheless, 'tis cause to rejoice that the seeds of aether have quickened in the barren garden that is the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_002: It feels like I'm witnessing the miracle performed by Minfilia a hundred years ago all over again...
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_010: I can feel all of the revitalized elements working in harmony!
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_011: I've always believed Eden had the power to restore the Empty, but I never expected it to happen so quickly.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_A1_000_001: You're the one who made all of this possible.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_A1_000_002: I think we owe it all to Gaia's skills with the hammer.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_A1_000_003: I never did get the hang of summoning primals correctly...
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_012: We ran into a few problems with Shiva, to say the least, but the others all went more or less according to plan!
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_013: That we were able to come so far along this arduous journey may rightly be attributed to thine unwavering resolve.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_THANCRED_000_014: Aye. When you said that you'd reclaim this world, you truly meant it. We're proud of you, Ryne.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_015: Hammer? Whatever are you talking about?
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_016: I'm a woman of gentle birth. Hardly the sort to be swinging such a rude thing about.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_017: must be imagining things! Tee hee!
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_018: Judging by Thancred and Urianger's reactions, it seems most of them were barely recognizable. Far be it from me to worry, but are you sure your memory is all right?
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_019: Though thou hast grasped the basic principles of summoning, it beareth repeating that such deiform entities are not the product of the memory alone.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_020: Nay, myriad other factors contribute to their corporeal manifestation, in a process not unlike the techniques employed in creation magic.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_021: Hmm... I wonder if the effects from the rebalanced aether will spread to the rest of the Empty?
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_022: Perhaps we'll just have to wait and see. Besides, I'm sure we could all do with a rest.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_THANCRED_000_023: I must say, Ryne, it's refreshing to see you take a more measured approach for a change.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_024: Well, if my experience here has taught me anything, it's that I shouldn't rush into things unprepared. And...I've also learned that there are some problems that can't be solved alone.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_026: Since you freed me from Eulmore, I've met all sorts of kind people who've gone out of their way to help me. I thought that I should do everything in my power to repay their kindness and make the world a better place.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_027: But now more than ever, I realize that there's a limit to what I can achieve by myself.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_028: Even though I was able to summon Shiva, I couldn't control such vast amounts of aether. If Gaia hadn't been there for me, I might never have returned to normal.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_029: I could say the same about you. I was trapped in a nightmare, but you freed me.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_030: It seems we're more alike than I thought.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_031: We might not be able to do everything by ourselves, but if we look out for each other, then we can face our problems together.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_034: If things don't work out, we can always go our separate ways.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_035: But on the other hand, if I can resist the urge to punch you whenever you annoy me─which, I must say, is quite often─I have no objections to staying around.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_036: You mean it? Oh, thank you, Gaia!
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_037: May I suggest we continue the conversation in Amh Araeng? Though the Empty may now supporteth foliage, the land's normalization hath but begun, and to linger overlong still entaileth risks.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_THANCRED_000_039: Nothing you need worry about. Let's go.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_THANCRED_000_040: To think that Ryne is the same girl I rescued from Eulmore... Compared to the way she was back then, the difference is like night and day.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_041: Our encampment remaineth in its present state for our anticipated return. I cannot help but wonder how the land may change in our absence.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_042: Off to Mord Souq, are we? I can't say I care for the place. The marketplace reminds me of Eulmore, but instead of fine delicacies, they peddle... Well, I don't know what they are exactly. What I do know is they're far too wriggly for my liking.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_050: Before we do anything else, we should report to Yalfort. He'll want to know how we've been getting on in the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_051: Speaking of Mord Souq, there was a snack of some sort that caught my eye last time. I can't quite describe it, but it looked...squidgy. Despite a strong suspicion that I may live to regret it, I'd like to try one.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_052: Oh! I think I know the one you mean! They might not be much to look at, but I bet they taste amazing!
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_053: Perhaps we could also try a pot of those jellied wrigglers or whatever they're called. I'll even let you take the first bite.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_THANCRED_000_055: First coffee biscuits, now worms in jelly... Heavens forbid the two of you might actually eat some proper food.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_056: , may I ask a favor of thee?
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_URIANGER_000_057: Whilst Thancred and I return unto the Crystarium to inform our comrades of our recent exploits, I would have thee accompany Ryne and Gaia to Mord Souq.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_060: I'm looking forward to showing Gaia around the Crystarium, but we'd better finish our work here first.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_061: I'm prepared to give this Mord fare a try, although I should probably shut my eyes when I do. And my nose, come to think of it...
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_YALFORT_000_070: I trust all is well, Miss Gaia?
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_071: It will be once we get out of this desert town. If I have to spend another night in that dingy little room, I shall scream.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_YALFORT_000_072: I'm terribly sorry to hear that the accommodation was less than satisfactory. I'll investigate the availability of more comfortable lodgings posthaste.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_073: Yes, I think we'll be staying in Mord Souq, at least for the time being. It might take a while for me to write the report, as our expedition was...rather eventful.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_074: , I really appreciate everything you've done, and I'm sorry for all the trouble I've put you through.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_075: Still fretting about that, are you? What's done is done. Besides, it all worked out in the end, didn't it?
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_076: You're right. Now, how about that treat we promised ourselves? They might not have coffee biscuits here, but I've heard the wriggler cakes are to die for. Or was that, “you'll die from eating them”? Only one way to find out, I guess!
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_RYNE_000_077: I'm sure trying the local delicacies will keep us occupied between writing reports and thinking about the next plan of action. Hopefully, we'll have another chance to visit the Empty to see how things are coming along!
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_GAIA_000_078: And don't even think about leaving me behind.
TEXT_LUCKRA206_03792_SYSTEM_000_080: To unlock the next quest, you must complete the main scenario quest “Echoes of a Fallen Star.”
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_YALFORT_000_000: Good news! Or at least, it has the potential to be good news. I've received word from Master Urianger.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_YALFORT_000_001: Unfortunately, the message was rather thin on details.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_YALFORT_000_002: He only requested that you return to the Crystarium and meet him at the Wandering Stairs. Not the most likely of places for important meetings, but I suppose you might be able to squeeze in a pint or two while you're there.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_YALFORT_000_010: I cannot help but wonder why Master Urianger did not meet you here in Mord Souq? I suppose the food and drink on offer in the Crystarium are somewhat better suited to those with sensitive palates. Perhaps that's it?
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_020: Pray accept mine apologies for calling thee hither at such short notice. The matter I wish to discuss is of considerable import.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_GAIA_000_021: If it's that urgent, wouldn't it be quicker to use those linkpearl things Ryne's been telling me about?
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_022: These are words best delivered in person.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_RYNE_000_023: Did something happen to the Empty?
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_024: Naught that doth warrant our immediate attention. The elements are in a state of equilibrium, and the propagation of flora continues apace.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_026: As thou art aware, we are not of this world, hailing from what is referred to as the Source.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_027: However, unlike , Thancred and I exist only as aether given corporeal form. Our bodies remaineth on the Source, though the thread that binds us to them doth grow weaker with the passage of time.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_RYNE_000_028: And if you stay here too long, you might never be able to return.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_029: Precisely. Now, with the wheels of change in the Empty set in motion, we believe this a fitting juncture to take our leave. We shall but regret not being present to see the transformation reach its completion.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_GAIA_000_030: That hardly seems worth losing your bodies over, though. If you have to go back to your own world, who are we to stop you?
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_RYNE_000_031: I always knew this day would come. I just...
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_THANCRED_000_033: I know that you'll see this through to the end. Together.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_RYNE_000_035: I may not be half the woman Minfilia was, but I have friends I can turn to.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_RYNE_000_036: They might be brutally honest in their opinion at times...
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_RYNE_000_037: Or prefer to save their words, and let their actions do the talking. But I wouldn't have it any other way!
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_A1_000_002: Just promise you won't transform into a crazy ice lady and try to kill me. Again.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_THANCRED_000_038: Though I can't say what the future might bring, no doubt Ryne and Gaia will need your support in the days to come.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_039: Alas, the mysteries surrounding the faerie are yet to be solved. Whether thou shouldst find the answers that thou seekest or nay, lend not thine ears to its honeyed words. For thy will is thine own. Never forget this.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_URIANGER_000_041: The time of our departure is at hand. Yet know that, no matter where we may be, ever shall we pray for your success.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_SYSTEM_000_042: With Urianger and Thancred set to leave the First, it seems wise to share this development with Yalfort, who will continue to oversee expeditions into the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_YALFORT_000_050: You're back sooner than expected. Is everything all right?
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_YALFORT_000_051: Oh dear, that's rather unfortunate. I daresay it's something jolly important for them to leave in such a hurry. In any case, I wish them the best of luck, wherever their work may take them.
TEXT_LUCKRA207_03793_YALFORT_000_052: I shall remain here and hold the fort, as it were, and make the necessary provisions should any further forays into the Empty be required. Safe travels,  !
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: . I'm afraid we haven't much in the way of information to share from the front line.
We have, however, received word that Gaius wishes to speak with you at Alliance Headquarters.
I've arranged an escort to take you to headquarters, so when you're ready to depart, speak with the fellow over there.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_Q1_000_011: Accompany the Resistance fighter to Alliance Headquarters?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: I wouldn't like to hazard a guess at exactly what it is your presence is required for, but it's probably not the sort of thing that can be put off until later.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_051: The Ironworks have completed their analysis of the Ruby Weapon, and Cid Garlond wishes to share his findings.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_052: I take it you can spare a few moments?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_053: Very good. Please wait here while I inform him of your arrival.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_054: Glad you could make it, . I'm sure you're as anxious as anyone to hear what we've uncovered.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_055: Our early hypotheses were proven correct. The Garleans have designed a system whereby a pilot's consciousness can be forcibly supplanted with data based on the memories and experience of another.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_056: So, even a rank amateur could obtain the combat capabilities of a seasoned warrior?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_057: Precisely, and we learned how this was made possible when we opened the cockpit. The monitors were still operational, and among the messages displayed, one particular phrase caught my attention: “synthetic auracite system.”
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_059: Well, the core of the Ultima Weapon was referred to as the Heart of Sabik by the Ascians. We believe it to have been a type of auracite.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_060: I can't say much for the synthetic sort at this stage, but I've encountered real auracite before. It was extremely potent, perhaps equal in power to the Heart of Sabik.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_061: It's unclear whether the Garleans' simulacrum possesses the same properties as genuine auracite, but I intend to follow this avenue of inquiry to see where it leads.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_062: What we do know is that it was used to implant the combat data of Nael van Darnus into the pilot, who has been presumed dead since before the Calamity. Are you any closer to discovering how they were able to retrieve this data?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_063: The link didn't occur to Gaius at first, but he later told me of devices fitted to the magitek armor of the Empire's high-ranking officers.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_064: There is reason to believe they were designed to emulate the soul crystals used throughout Eorzea.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_065: Yes, that was rumored to be its true purpose, but it was never publicly acknowledged. Perhaps those in the upper echelons of command wanted to avoid comparisons to the so-called “savages” they were meant to be conquering.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_066: There is also the question of whether this system even functions as intended.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_067: From what we've seen, we can assume they were successful in gathering combat data of those wearing armor equipped with the device. If the comparison with soul crystals is valid, perhaps this data was transferred via aether.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_068: However, it seems that it extracted not only memories relating to combat, but the soldier's very essence. As you saw, the pilot succumbed entirely to the will of van Darnus.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_069: Though this is merely supposition, it's possible that being fused with the Ruby Weapon's core accelerated the process and caused the deceased legatus to manifest in corporeal form.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_070: Could it be that the death of the pilot was caused by the system malfunctioning?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_071: It's hard to say. The Ruby Weapon itself was still largely intact when it deactivated, which strongly implies that it was the synthetic auracite running amok that killed her, rather than the damage incurred during the battle.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_072: But even after our analysis, I'm afraid we still don't have enough information. For now, perhaps we should consult with Gaius as to our next plan of action.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_Q1_000_000: Accompany the Resistance fighter to Alliance Headquarters?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_10: Valdeaulin has come bearing vital information.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_101: I traced the Ruby Weapon's path back to the occupied territory of Werlyt, which appears to be where it was built.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_A2_000_002: My grasp of geography is surprisingly poor. Care to enlighten me?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_103: While Ala Mhigo is placed on the western edge of Ghimlyt, Werlyt lies on the opposite side, to the east. It was once a proud and prosperous city, until it was brought to its knees by the imperial invaders.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_104: You seem rather well-informed. Perhaps I should've taken you with me.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_105: Hmph. I thought that much was common knowledge.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_10: It is also where Alfonse and the others were born.
And now, the Weapon project has brought them home...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_108: Yes, the place is now rife with imperials. They have established an airship supply depot in the coastal town of Terncliff. According to the locals, something resembling one of the Weapons was transported there a few days ago.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_10: This bodes ill indeed. Were it possible, I would attempt to capture Alfonse and his followers before they can launch an offensive.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_11: However, the distance between here and Terncliff presents a considerable obstacle, and in all likelihood, their Weapon will be ready long before we arrive. Approaching by sea would allow us to save time by circumventing their ground-based troops, provided we were able to secure a vessel.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_111: Or you could use the Enterprise and take the most direct route of all: as the crow flies. In fact, this is the perfect chance to put my top secret plan into action.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_11: And might I ask what that entails?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_113: It wouldn't be much of a secret if I told you, now would it?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_114: What I can say is there's a starring role planned for you, .
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_115: Why so surprised? You didn't think I'd let you get off that easily, did you? It'll be here soon, so don't go anywhere!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_120: Gaius will know how best to proceed.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_125: I have just returned from my reconnaissance, and I shall reveal my findings before taking a long overdue rest.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_130: I still need to get to the bottom of how the synthetic auracite system works, and whether the pilot's fusion with the core was a malfunction or planned from the start.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_15: I see Cid still delights in keeping others in suspense. I can only hope he does not make us wait overlong.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_100_151: I present Garlond Ironworks' adaptation of the Ultima Warrior, the G-Warrior!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_15: I know Allagan design when I see it. Excavated from one of their ruins, no doubt.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_153: Azys Lla, to be precise. We came across it during the course of our investigations and decided it would be a shame to let it go to waste.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_15: And you will be taking this refitted relic to face the enemy head-on, yes? Perhaps my knowledge of the Ultima Weapon will be of use.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_155: I'm counting on it, as it happens. But first, we'll need to perform a test run in the simulator before throwing you into battle. Come, we haven't much time.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_160: I must admit, I am not fond of surprises, or secrets for that matter.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_165: Many imperials who fought at Ghimlyt withdrew to Werlyt, though they will have had ample time to recuperate by now. Were we to approach by land, we could expect considerable resistance.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_A6_000_002: Some more practice wouldn't go amiss.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_100_20: Then we shall depart for Terncliff at once.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_200_20: In that case, you should have the technician run the simulator again.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_20: It seems they were expecting us. But who is the pilot...?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_202: , we're almost there! You'd better have your wits about you!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_A4_000_001: It's time to fry this overgrown squid!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_A4_000_002: Ah... Is it too late to back out?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_205: Haha! And save some for me! For research purposes, that is...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_206: That's the  I know, always with a joke at the ready! Wait, you're not joking are you?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_208: (-Pilot of the Sapphire Weapon-)I can't afford to lose... It's all or nothing!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SYSTEM_200_209:
(-Synthetic Auracite System-)Hydrus combat sample ready.
Initiating organic core overwrite.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_21: I will be monitoring the situation from the air. Follow my instructions and eliminate the target.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_215: Incredible... But how does it compare to the Weapons?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_220: I suppose that in theory, any one of us could be the pilot, but I daresay your preternatural abilities give you a certain advantage.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_GARLONDMECHANIC0068: Right you are. Give me a moment while I get it fired up!
Well, if you change your mind, you know where to find me.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_A5_000_001: That damned squid never stood a chance!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_100_25: Now that the immediate threat has been dealt with, we should gather what information we can in Terncliff.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_GARLONDMECHANIC0068: On your way to Terncliff? Allow me to escort you.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_100_30: You did well to pilot the G-Warrior so adeptly in so short a time.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_200_30: And with the Weapon largely intact, Cid and his researchers should be able to gather a wealth of valuable information. Before it is dismantled, perhaps we should take one last look upon our fallen foe.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_300: We should've known Father and his friends would track us down sooner or later. Now, they're at our doorstep, and the Sapphire Weapon still isn't ready!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_301: Even so, it should still be able to fend them off, or at least buy us some time.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_302: Not quite how I'd imagined it, but this seems as good a way to die as any.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_304: Ricon!? Why are you still here!? You're supposed to be moving the other Weapons to a safe location!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_305: You can take care of that...while I pilot the Sapphire Weapon.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_306: What are you talking about!? I'm the pilot, not you! There's no need to put your life on the line.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_307: Besides, it's still incomplete. It can barely perform basic maneuvers, so it'll be practically useless in a real fight.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_309: You want to end up like Milisandia!?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_310: No, of course not. I wouldn't wish that on my worst enemy.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_311: But she didn't give her life in vain. The Ruby Weapon left behind data that's been used to improve the system, to prevent any further malfunctions.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_312: What difference does that make!? Once Oversoul is activated and the pilot fuses with the core, there's no way back.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_313: That's why I should be the one to pilot the Sapphire Weapon, not you, Rex. Alfonse needs you.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_314: You and I both know I'm the least qualified pilot we have. There's less to lose if I don't make it back.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_316: Please, Rex. Hear me out. Ever since we were children, I was the smallest, the weakest, too afraid to stand up for myself. But I had the best brothers and sisters a boy could wish for. You were always there for me, protected me.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_317: Now, it's my turn to protect you.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_318: Take the other Weapons and get out of here. See this through to the end.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_319: Do it for me. For Milisandia. I'm counting on you, Rex.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_320: Hmph. You always did have a stubborn streak. All right, Ricon. I won't let you down.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_REX_000_321: Just promise you'll wait for me...on the other side. We'll meet again, Brother.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_322: You all made me happier than I had any right to be. And now...I've finally found my purpose. I have no regrets.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RICON_000_323: Come on, Sapphire. We may be far from perfect, but we have a job to do. Let's give Father something to remember us by!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_32: The Echo, I presume. What did it reveal to you?
Ricon... My poor boy. You were braver than most could ever hope to be.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_326: It's as we feared. I'm sorry, Gaius.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_32: First Milisandia, now Ricon! We must find the remaining Weapons and end this madness.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_330: I must admit, I envy your talents. Would that I possessed even a fraction of your skill, that I could better serve Gaius.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_335: I cannot help feeling there was a simpler way to defeat the Weapon. Perhaps shooting it in the head with a large cannon would have sufficed?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_350: Tell me: what do you make of Gaius Baelsar?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_351: I understand the two of you have been acquainted since his days as the Black Wolf. He claims to have shed his pelt when he took up the hunt for Ascians, but he's still the same man deep down.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_352: He certainly kept quiet about having a flock of foster children back in the Empire, though. It seems he would rather bare his teeth to his former masters than allow harm to come to them.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_353: Yet try as I might, I cannot make sense of it. Does he truly fight for the good of mankind, as he would have us all believe, or is he merely biding his time before he reveals his true colors?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_354: Whatever the answer may be, in the end he will always be a Garlean. And though there may be honorable men and women among them, I have suffered much and more as a result of their conquests. Barbaric campaigns in which Gaius Baelsar played no small part.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_355: My first encounter with the Garleans was twenty years ago, shortly after the fall of Ala Mhigo. They continued their march into the lands that had long been home to we Duskwights.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_356: We sought to repel the invaders, but we were woefully unprepared. Our bows and arrows were no match for their magitek, and even our most powerful magicks did little to slow their advance.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_357: I fought on the front line, but was knocked unconscious in the opening exchange. When I came to, I was alone, the rest of my unit slaughtered. I hurried back to my village to look for my wife and daughter, only to find the place deserted.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_358:
My search lasted for days, then weeks, then months, and it seemed they had disappeared without a trace. I finally learned from two imperials held at Bittermill that the villagers had been captured and used as test subjects for the poison gas that would later be known as Black Rose.
They were never seen again.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_359: For twenty long years I roamed aimlessly, with nothing but hatred to keep me alive. I eventually found myself at the Order of the Twin Adder, who offered me a place among their ranks. The desire for revenge was the only thing I had left, so without a moment's hesitation, I accepted.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_360: Were it not for the war with Garlemald, I would have been loath to work alongside the city-dwelling Gridanians who for so long had treated my kind as outcasts. But none of that mattered anymore.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_361: It all culminated with Operation Archon. As you led the charge into the Praetorium, we were right behind you. And when the place came crumbling down, most of us were caught in the rubble. I escaped with my life, though many others were less fortunate.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_362: Having dragged myself free from the rubble, I sought a way out. It was then that I encountered none other than Gaius Baelsar, on the verge of death. The gods had delivered to me the man whose conquests had robbed me of everything.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_363: I was poised, ready to exact my revenge. And then, he spoke.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_364: "I will not beg for mercy. I only ask that you stay your hand a while longer.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_365: "I cannot die until I have rid the world of the Ascian menace. For millennia, mankind has danced to their tune. But no more. Then, once we are finally free, my life is yours for the taking.“
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_366: I would have struck him down there and then had I not sensed truth in his words. So, I decided to grant him a stay of execution and join him on his hunt.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_367: All this time, I've kept a close eye on Gaius. Though he is ever on the watch for pursuers, he has granted me ample opportunity to slay him if I so choose. And I still might, if he shows even the slightest sign of betraying our agreement.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_368: But for now, the Ascians are my chosen quarry. If they are indeed the ones pulling the Empire's strings, then it shall not end until they have been eradicated, every last one. Though I could not save my kin, there are those who may yet be spared the horrors of war.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_369: Unfortunately, dealing with the Ascians will have to wait until we have brought an end to Garlemald's Weapon project.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_370: Though we may have vanquished two of the new Weapons, we must make every effort to prepare for whatever the Garleans throw at us next. Perhaps Severa can tell us whether the Ironworks engineers have uncovered any information of note?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_375: Valdeaulin has never been one to openly express himself, at least not in front of Gaius and myself. Even so, I cannot help but notice that something is amiss.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_400: The Ironworks engineers are still at work dismantling the Sapphire Weapon and investigating the Terncliff magitek facility. Though they have yet to make their report, they may have some news to share at this juncture. Please, wait here a moment.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_401: We've yet to finish our investigation, but I can give you a preliminary report.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_40: Were you able to recover anything of note?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_403: Before abandoning the facility, they'd attempted to destroy anything they couldn't take with them, including many of their research materials. Luckily, some information relating to the Sapphire Weapon's combat data was intact.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_40: Judging by what we saw during the battle, it was extracted from Regula van Hydrus, correct?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_405: It also appears that the Sapphire Weapon was actually in an incomplete state, and therefore unable to perform at full capacity.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_406: Even so, it was immensely powerful. Had they been given the chance to finish it before we'd arrived, who knows how it would've ended?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_407: Indeed. We may not be so fortunate next time, so we must prepare for the worst. The Ironworks will continue to investigate the Sapphire Weapon and look into possible countermeasures.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_40: The Echo afforded you a glimpse into the conversation between Ricon and Rex prior to the Weapon's deployment. Do you remember any other details?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_409: Improvements were made to the synthetic auracite system to prevent malfunctions? Then it was never their intent to create a manifestation of Nael van Darnus...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_CID_000_410: But there's one thing that was intended...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_41: Oversoul. Its activation results in the pilot being absorbed by the core, killing them in the process. Rex and Ricon were fully aware of this, were they not?
Then the death of the pilot was by design all along...
Alfonse, how could you!? Sacrificing your own siblings to fuel these accursed war machines!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_414: Surely, there is no cause worth paying such a price.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_415: Aye. Nothing is more precious than family.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SHADOWHUNTER_000_41: This nightmare is far from over. It appears that Rex has fled with the remaining Weapons, and we can assume that Alfonse has every intention of sending them into battle.
We must find a way to disable them before Oversoul can be activated.
I have seen enough death. I do not wish to see any more.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_419: Then there is no time to waste. Let's be about it, Gaius.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_420: Severa, you're in charge here. Keep Cid and his team safe while they carry out the investigation.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SEVERA_000_421: Understood. Please see that no harm comes to Gaius.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_422: While we're gone, I need you to relay everything to the Resistance troops. Your firsthand account should prove useful. If there are any developments, we'll be sure to contact you.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALDEAULIN_000_430: (I'd rather you didn't share what we've discussed with my...traveling companions. It would only complicate matters.)
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: Welcome back! It sounds like you've been on quite the journey. All the way to Terncliff!
And judging by the fact you made it here in one piece, I trust everything went according to plan?
What an astonishing account... I wouldn't mind putting that G-Warrior through its paces myself! Certainly a lot more stimulating than supervising this rabble, I'd imagine.

Anyway, as before, I'll compile the information into a report and leave it over there for your perusal, should you feel so inclined. If we hear anything from headquarters, we'll be sure to pass it on.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_SYSTEM_000_454: Meanwhile, in the VIIth Legion's Werlyt headquarters...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_ALFONSE_100_454: I have come to deliver my report, Lord Valens.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Ah, so you have returned, young Alfred. Or was it Allwick?
Not that it really matters, of course. I hear that you and your darling “brothers and sisters” have allowed the Sapphire Weapon to fall into the hands of the enemy. Do tell me it isn't so...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_ALFONSE_000_457: I am afraid that is the case, Lord Valens.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Oh, come now. No need to be so sullen. As they say, “to err is human, to forgive, divine.” And you know how forgiving I can be. When it suits me...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: So, tell me, whatever-your-name-is: who was able to best the Sapphire Weapon?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_ALFONSE_200_458: Our sources state that the one known as the Warrior of Light was assisted by Cid Garlond and...Gaius van Baelsar, my lord.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_300_: Gaius, Gaius, Gaius. Yes, it seems he's been quite the troublemaker of late. Defecting from Garlemald, assassinating the Emperor... Whatever next? Oh well, there's no use crying over spilt milk.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_400_: Speaking of which, I've become quite the connoisseur since arriving in Werlyt. This particular variety comes from a rare breed of cow, you know. Only a hundred of them in existence and pampered every day of their lives.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_500_: Yes, they are quite valuable. Until their milk dries up, that is. When it does, they are sent to the slaughterhouse like all the rest. For that is their lot in life...
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_600_: ...to be discarded once they have served their purpose.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_700_: Did I create the Ruby and Sapphire Weapons so that you could deliver them gift wrapped to the enemy!? I can see it now─Cid nan Garlond rubbing his hands with glee at all the technological marvels we've bestowed upon him!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_800_: And you let Gaius van Baelsar of all people get the better of you! How do you think this reflects on me!? The legatus of the VIIth Legion humiliated by that traitor! Humiliated, I say!
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_900_: There's only one way to deal with worthless provincial filth like you! Wait for me in the correction chamber. You need to be taught a lesson in obedience.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_IMPERIALCOMMANDER03: Forgive my intrusion, Lord Valens, but it's time for your meeting with the head of magitek development.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: Oh, how time flies when you're whipping useless soldiers into shape! Yes, yes, I'll be along once I've made myself presentable. Can't have people thinking I've let my standards slip, now can I?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_ALLIE_000_460: You wished to see me, Lord Valens?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: So, you're Allie, yes? And you joined the military of your own free will along with your fellow orphans?
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_200_: Such devotion! What an inspiration you are! You see, it is my firm belief that love grants us the power to move mountains, to overcome any obstacle.
TEXT_LUCKYW201_03895_VALENSVANVARRO_300_: Together, we shall discover the strength that lies within you. Take my hand, child. I will show you the way.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-I knew you'd be here sooner or later-ho! You remember the carnival I told you about, don't you?

We've finished preparing, which means it's nearly time to open celebrations with the unfurling of the banners. But first we'll need an officially sanctioned bearer to present said banners to three of our people─and why not let you do the honors?
Others are clamoring for the task, make no mistake─it's an important and highly coveted duty, you understand─but I couldn't deprive you of this opportunity to experience Gogg culture hands-on.
Consider it a thank-you for keeping Anogg and Konogg from blowing themselves up. And look sharp! We haven't got all .
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_VILLAGERA03952_000_: Aha! You'll be the bearer. Well, hand it over! This is what we've all been waiting for!

Ah, the colors of Komra! They speak of our village, our lives, our very souls! ...Except this one. Never really cared for this one. Looks like it tripped halfway through the journey from beige to yellow and fell in a ditch.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_VILLAGERB03952_000_: So the role of bearer went to the outsider after all. Nothin' you can't handle, I hope.

It's not that I think the chief made a poor choice, mind. Bit of a waste, yes, but there's no better way for you to introduce yourself to the rest of the village. And wouldn't you know it─you're not so bad.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_VILLAGERC03952_000_: Time already, is it? Oh, my hands are so sweaty... Do take care, now─I'd hate to be the one what drops the banner.

Whew. Well done. Let's share a drink once it's safely unfurled, eh? The carnival is our way of showing appreciation for each other─and I certainly appreciate you keeping this banner from slipping away like a greased eel.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_VILLAGERA03952_000_: Just wait until you see this unfurled! You'll be inspired, I guarantee it!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_VILLAGERB03952_000_: If you want my advice on gettin' to know the rest of the villagers better─eat, drink, and be merry. It is a carnival.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_VILLAGERC03952_000_: With you here to tell your tales of adventure, I'm certain this year's carnival will be the best one yet! Assuming I don't get tangled in the banner and trip and ruin everything...
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Go on, now. The whole village is waiting.

Finished, have you? Hopefully speaking with those folks helped impress upon you that this wasn't just some menial errand anyone could've done. No, the slightest mishap in the banner delivery process would have spelled disaster, you hear?
Now, without further ado...let the carnival begin!
No need to stand there waiting for someone to give you more work to do. Go and witness the fruits of our labors! Revel! Frolic! Et cetera!
...If you need a task that badly, you can set yourself to working up an appetite. I expect you to partake heartily of our traditional cuisine─not to mention the drinks!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_104: Stone spare me these menial tasks. If I see one more streamer...
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_105: Why, if it isn't ! And run absolutely ragged with tedious carnival duties, no doubt!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_A1_000_001: It is indeed my solemn duty to eat my weight in carnival food.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_A1_000_002: I had the honor of delivering the banners, thank you very much.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_107: Eating!? Are you mad!? There's no time for that─we've got the key to activate!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_108: Oh, and I suppose you were told it was incredibly important, were you? Well, try not to let it go to your head. ...Speaking of your head, I expect it just might explode when you see the key in action. Yes, the key! Don't tell me you've forgotten!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_109: All of this festive nonsense has been an unnecessary distraction, but Konogg and I did manage to make some real progress while the chief wasn't looking.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_110: If you want the details─and I know you do─you'll have to meet us at the usual place. The last thing we need is half the village drunkenly eavesdropping.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_150: We haven't even got to the part where Anogg and I argue yet, and I'm already knackered...
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_160: There you are. Let's review our work, shall we? Doubtless you've forgotten some significant detail!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_161: As hopefully even you will recall, we required a source of energy to restore functionality to the so-called “key” 2P told us about.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_162: We obtained said source in the form of a knocker's crystalline carapace─though the transference of energy from crystal to key proved a challenge.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_163: Nothing that Konogg and I, in my infinite wisdom, couldn't handle, however!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_164: Heheh... You'll find your faith in us well rewarded. The key is now fully powered and, as far as we can tell, functional─so I daresay we'll soon be capable of smiting our enemies with the press of a button!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_165: ...Or we would be, if we had the first clue as to how to operate the blasted thing!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_166: Indeed, it seems the key is a more complicated device than we anticipated. Thus far, we have succeeded only in making it display a series of strange glyphs.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_167: We presented these to the pod for translation, of course, but we cannot make heads nor tails of its terminology, no matter how many times we prompt it to explain.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_168: The androids appear to have an intuitive─or at least finely honed─grasp of technology, so I have no doubt that 2P would know, but...
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_169: ...She's shown no sign of miraculously awakening, that's for certain.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_POD_000_171:
Analyzing android repair sequence...
Error detected. Confirming details...
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_POD_000_172:
Damage to internal mechanism detected.
Proposal: Replace the damaged part.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_173: Hmm... So with a replacement part, repair is possible? I daresay facilitating that process would prove more efficient than continuing our own fruitless experimentation with the key.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_174: I would hardly call wandering the factory for days on end with the barest idea of what sort of part we're looking for “efficient.”
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_175: So unless our friend here just happened to stumble upon a room filled with android corpses ripe for the harvesting...
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_A2_000_002: Oh yeah, the corpse room. That's a thing.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_177: Odd...but superlative! You will take us there at once. We'll bring Pod, too─it can tell us if any of the androids still have the part we need. Onwaaard!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_200: Not that I'm not eager to take apart an android, but...how do we do that?
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_POD_000_205: Tactical support units are authorized to recover android parts and carry out replacement and repair operations.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_210: A look inside the androids and a giant step toward our ultimate goal, mwahaha... By the by, where are we going?
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_SYSTEM_000_215: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or software keyboard to enter any phrase containing “Anogg” to attract the easily distracted dwarf's attention.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_221: Over here, is it? Konogg, Pod, stop dallying!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_223: The color of their garb is different, but they do appear to be of the same make as 2P.
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_224: Which means, ghoulish or not, we can make use of them. This is truly excellent, Konogg!
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_225: My understanding is that Pod should be able to salvage the correct part and initiate the repairs. Let's see...
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_KONOGG_000_250: The more we learn about the androids' technology, the more fascinating─and unnerving─it becomes. Who could possibly have created this?
TEXT_LUCKTA301_03952_ANOGG_000_260: Must we instruct it every single time? Go on, Pod, fix 2P.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_002: Let's not waste any more time about it─2P, do you remember what happened?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_050: I hope that the part replacement won't result in memory loss. We have too many unanswered questions.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2P_000_070: I... I was damaged in combat, and you brought me here.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_071: And then you wildly inconvenienced us by dying on the table, yes.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_072: Fortunately for you, we were clever enough to pick up Pod here! And by the fact that we're having this conversation, I assume it's succeeded in repairing the damage.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2P_000_073: I see... Did you locate the key as I instructed?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_074: Hmph. Despite how little information we had to go on, we did.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_075: It's fully operational, as far as we can tell, so...can you use it?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_076: Wha─ An earthquake!? Everyone, outside! Now!
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_077: The mountain! What happened to the mountain!?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_082: What is the meaning of this!?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2P_000_083: It means that your assistance is no longer necessary.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2P_000_084: Have it your way, then. See this world to its end.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_085: I know I worried, but... I thought she was our friend!
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_A1_000_002: Is your dress about to turn white? Because if so...
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_088: I am a YoRHa No.2 Type B unit─but you may call me 2B. I'm here to destroy the androids in white.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_089: We can discuss this later. Right now, we've got to stop 2P!
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_140: We've made a fine mess of things, to be sure. But it's hardly the first time. Nothing for it but to fix it.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_150: Careful. They may intend for us to follow.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_260: 2P and 2B are identical. How did they come to be on different sides?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_270: I was wrong. So, so wrong! I made you go along with my decisions... I put everyone in danger...
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_272: I'm the one who let the conflict spread this far. Blaming yourselves is unnecessary.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_273: Forgive me, but you seem so similar to 2P, and we still don't really understand either of you. Are you truly our ally?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_274: I can't be certain. All I know is that I was damaged in a battle with the machine lifeforms, and then I was here.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_275: Your world is very...different from where I was. I don't know my coordinates, and I can't contact Command─I just followed the explosions.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_276: Let's approach this from a different angle, then. What are the machine lifeforms, and why were you fighting them?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_277: The machine lifeforms are weapons created by aliens from beyond the stars. As part of YoRHa, my mission is to reclaim the planet from these invaders.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_278: Alien...invaders...? Never mind. What about 2P? As an android, does she not belong to this “YoRHa” as well?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_279: No. She is a copy, built by the machine lifeforms─probably to fight YoRHa specifically.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_280: We also retrieved another android─a boy.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_281: If he's still with you, I would like to see him.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_282: Very well. Can't make things any worse.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_SYSTEM_000_283: A new section has been added to the Portable Archive. Fill it by using the device to record data at promising spots within the Puppets' Bunker!
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_ANOGG_000_305: To think he was on our side after all...
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_POD_000_310:
Accessing data for YoRHa Type-B unit...
Overwrite previous owner ID?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_320: We hid him where 2P wouldn't know to look. Follow me.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_350: He's been out of operation since we brought him here.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_2B_000_371: My duty is to annihilate the machine lifeforms. For that, I require the assistance of 9S.
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_373: Fortunately, we have some experience with this sort of thing. What do you say, Anogg?
TEXT_LUCKTA302_03953_KONOGG_000_375: Er, I'm certain everyone could use a rest before we proceed. A lot has happened, and we should take time to think things through.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_ANOGG_000_005: I didn't think... I didn't think...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_020: Come to think of it, none of us ever did get the chance to enjoy the carnival.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_021: It's possible everyone is still carrying on with it─I've never known a few explosions to dampen their spirits before. Still, I might go and check on them.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_ANOGG_000_025: I suppose there's only one way to find out...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_ANOGG_000_050: P-Please, we didn't mean for any of this to happen!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_DWARFMASTER03671_00: This is what I was afraid of.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_060: Will you all shut─ Oh. Beg your pardon. Bit preoccupied with my duties at the moment.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_000_: Them things came from right here! Saw it with my own two eyes, and that's that! I swear it on my granddad's grave!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERB03954_000_: Always knew those brats were up to something...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERC03954_000_: The village is in shambles! My house may as well be a pile of kindling!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERD03954_000_: Didn't like that. Did not like that at all, no .
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_120: Please, calm down! It's a complicated situation, and even we are not fully─
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_000_: We ain't here for your excuses! Just admit it─ This is all your fault!
You let those things in through the tunnels! They knew you. And look what they did to the place!
We don't care about the whys and wherefores. We want to know how you plan to make amends!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_124: We'll do everything we can, I swear! But...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_125: <sigh> I don't think this is going anywhere good. The village is still in danger!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_126: No one wants to hear it from me, though... Please, can you speak to Elder Glagg and make him understand?
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_140: We never meant for any of this to happen!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_150: And who might you be? Haven't seen your face around here before. Or...have I? I misplaced my spectacles some time ago.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_151: No matter. I'm here to investigate, not conversate. As the eldest elder, it falls to me to determine the truth of the rumors surroundin' this disaster.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_152: The problem bein', of course, that everyone here is stubborn as a diamond ingot! They all insist they know what's true, though you can be sure half of them are up to their eyeballs in ale at any given time.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_153: I need a second opinion. A sober opinion. Here, let me smell your breath.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_154: <sniff> You'll do. Speak with the villagers, and think well on who has the right of it. Then I'll hear what you have to say.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_160: I apologize for involving you in this nonsense on top of everything else...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_200: Blasted youth... No respect for proper procedure...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERE03954_000_: This'll be Anogg's fault, you hear? That girl never had an onze of prudence. If only she were more like her brother...
She ought to have left that machine graveyard well enough alone! But she insisted on barging in anyway, heedless of all danger.
That's what happened, mark my words! And Anogg had better answer for it.
Konogg told her to be cautious─mark my words! And she ought to have heeded him.
I can see from the look in your eye that you agree. I only hope Konogg doesn't end up answering for his sister's folly.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERC03954_000_: Anogg could've saved us from those things, I just know it. There ain't no way a clever girl like her wouldn't have found a way to fight 'em. If only that brother of hers weren't always holding her back...
Don't worry─I don't blame you. I can see you're the sort what knows how to take control of a situation. I'm sure you supported Anogg as best you could.
You ain't from around here, but trust me─Konogg's been making his problems Anogg's problems since they were little. It's a shame, too, because she's a real visionary.
If she'd had her way, she would've found out what was going on and how to put an end to it before those machines could make a beep!
If it weren't for Konogg, I'd be enjoying a nice ale in front of my intact house right about now...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERB03954_000_: You... You're the collaborator. Well, don't think you can come crying to me now that it's all gone wrong.
It's plain as day that Anogg's the type to charge ahead without a care for who she might be getting mixed up in her troubles. And her brother ain't much better.
It's plain as day that Konogg's not one for straightforward solutions. And his sister ain't much better, with her flights of fancy.
They don't have a bit of sense between the two of them, nor any respect for the village, neither. This would never have happened if it weren't for their meddling!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_000_: Oh, Anogg and Konogg, you say? Yes, they did do it. It was them!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_100_: And you... I heard you followed Anogg into the machine graveyard. Heard it with my own two ears, I did! Everyone knows it, too, so you'd better be prepared to pay!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_000_: Oh, Anogg and Konogg, you say? Yes, they did do it. It was them!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_100_: And you... I heard you followed Konogg into the machine graveyard. Heard it with my own two ears, I did! Everyone knows it, too, so you'd better be prepared to pay!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_000_: I didn't know about any of this! You can't prove I did!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-I knew we'd end up here someday-ho.
It's hard to know where to place the blame.
I understand why you followed along with Anogg's plan, but if you all had been just a little more careful...
It's hard to know where to place the blame.
I understand why you followed along with Konogg's plan, but if you all had been quicker to deal with the threat...
I just don't know. Maybe the fault is mine.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERD03954_000_: You want to know what I think? We're doomed! Doooooomed!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_280: Were we...that wrong? Didn't we try our hardest?
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_300: So the fools still can't agree on which way is up. Wish I was surprised.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_301: Let's try puttin' it to a vote, eh? Maybe the ones pretendin' to know more about the matter than they really do will think twice about makin' arses of themselves so publicly.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_302: Can't none of you stitch your beards for half a moment!? I'm askin' you to raise your hands in an orderly fashion!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_303: This is hopeless. We're not gettin' anything useful from them.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_304: I'm not ruling out that one of these idiots accidentally has the right of it, but... In your sober judgment, who's to blame?
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_305: If you still ain't sure, you can try talkin' to everyone again...though I can't say I recommend it.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_306: Just make sure you don't take any detours past the ale casks until this is settled.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERE03954_000_: Only Anogg would be so reckless as to bring the whole village crashing down around our ears!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERC03954_000_: This is what dithering and dragging your feet gets you, I tell you! Ain't no one to blame but Konogg for it.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERB03954_000_: I don't know how to make it any plainer─Anogg and Konogg are to blame here. Fools, the both of them.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERA03954_000_: I haven't said anything we don't all know already! So don't even think about trying to pin this on me!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_DWARFMASTER03671_00: It's important to hear people out, don't get me wrong─but they do have a tendency to oversimplify. And yell. Loudly.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_350: <sniff> Still passably sober, I see. Have you come to a conclusion?
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_A1_000_003: Both Anogg and Konogg are to blame.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_352: Take your time. I'll be keepin' an eye on this lot.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_353: Interestin'. I'll take that under advisement.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_GLAGG_000_354: Ahem! Everyone, I stand before you to present my findin's regardin' culpability in the destruction that has befallen our village...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_2B_000_356: As I've said, blaming yourselves is pointless. This is my doing.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_VILLAGERK03954_000_: It's one of them! Run! Run for your lives!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_2B_000_359: There's no benefit to petty arguments.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_361: She says that...but I think it was kind of her to intervene.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I'll try speaking to the others─see if I can't get them to understand that there's more going on here than it appears.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_400: I'm sure she went to check on her friend─that other android, 9S. I'm going to go and talk to her.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_401: I appreciate your stepping in─but I don't want everyone to see you as the enemy. If we go and talk to them now, we can explain...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_2B_000_402: That's not necessary. I'm leaving anyway.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_2B_000_403: This is not over. For us, or the machines.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_405: I'm worried for Anogg, as well. She hasn't been herself since...well.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_406: If she's not here, she's probably drowning herself in work. Come on─we should check on her.
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_450: She's not here! What is she doing!? This isn't the time to be outside alone!
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_451: We need to find her! I'll look around the village, but...can you search the outskirts?
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_SYSTEM_000_500: You see no sign of your despondent dwarven friend. Perhaps she wandered further afield...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_SYSTEM_000_501: Though you have searched all of the likely places, Anogg is not to be found. Perhaps Konogg has some additional ideas...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_000_551: ...What do I do? This is all because of us, and I...
TEXT_LUCKTA303_03954_KONOGG_100_551: I don't know how to find her.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_YALFORT_000_000: ! So the rumors of your knack for being in the right place at the right time are true! You see, we've just completed our preparations for another expedition into the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_YALFORT_000_001: Miss Ryne and Miss Gaia agree that it's high time you all went to see how things are coming along. Though I must say, being at their beck and call night and day does test my patience on occasion.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_003: We were just getting ready for another ride on the skyslipper. Care to join us?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_YALFORT_000_004: There was one other thing I should mention before you depart. Now that the situation in Eulmore has settled down somewhat, my associates have made some headway in investigating your past, Miss Gaia.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_006: Hmm? I thought that's what you wanted.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_007: So did I. But I quite like the way things are now. Digging around in my past might...I don't know, spoil it somehow.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_008: Besides, uncovering the truth behind the voice in my head and my strange powers is bound to be more interesting than whatever life it was I had in Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_009: I understand. We'll find the answers. Together. Just like we do everything else.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_010: You mean from the ice crystal we found after the battle? I was sure it would've melted by now, but it seems Ryne was right.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_011: And yes, we had it made into a necklace. She insisted that I have it, even though it doesn't suit me at all. Still, I suppose it makes a nice memento, so I keep it somewhere safe.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_012: Oh, come on, Gaia! It'd look lovely on you! Wait...you're not embarrassed to wear it, are you?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_013: Don't be silly, of course I'm not! In any case, I wouldn't want to lose it while we're in the Empty. Unlike the coffee biscuits you've brought along, I can't just go and buy another one.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_014: Ah! They were supposed to be a surprise for !
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_015: Oh, they were delicious, as always! But I hear they're quite fattening, so we usually just buy one and have half each.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_016: And then you always get another one anyway.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_017: Yes, but we break that in half too, so it's fine.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_018: Then we may as well have one each to begin with! Honestly, Ryne, I sometimes wonder if you've got biscuits for brains.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_019: Though I must say, my time in the Crystarium has been rather enjoyable. We even had a chance to make a necklace from the ice crystal we found.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_020: And in case you were wondering, I haven't been neglecting my training. I wouldn't want my skills to get rusty just because Thancred's not around. I'm ready for whatever lies ahead!
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_021: Urianger would also be pleased to hear you've had your head in those fusty old tomes. I've even done a bit of studying myself. After all, it's up to us to take care of the Empty now.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_022: I'm looking forward to seeing how things have changed since our last visit. Come on, let's head over to the Derrick.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_YALFORT_000_030: I'm hoping that one of these days I'll be allowed to visit the Empty and see those remarkable changes for myself. It seems like a fair reward for all my hard work!
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_031: This time, those giant ant things had the good sense to leave us alone on our way here. Seems they've learned their lesson.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_040: I don't suppose you fancy taking the helm this time?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_042: Oh? I didn't realize you knew how!
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_043: While you were off training, I was practicing with another skyslipper they have at the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_045: Hardly. You've been pulling more than your own weight, and I just wanted to do what I can to contribute more.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_046: So you two can sit back, relax, and leave it to me.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_050: Well, Gaia certainly kept that quiet! She's just full of surprises, isn't she?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_060: There's no need to look so apprehensive, you know. Let's get going, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_070: It's so strange suddenly seeing you at the controls. Why didn't you tell me you'd been practicing?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_071: I thought I'd surprise you, that's all.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_072: Well, consider me surprised. All this time, I thought you were only good for smashing things with your hammer.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_073: Hmph! Bring that up again and you can walk the rest of the way.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_074: Hehe, I'd best behave. I wouldn't want to get stranded in the Empty and miss the festival.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_075: Ah, I suppose this is the first you would've heard of it. We haven't exactly been keeping it a secret, but it's still in the planning stages.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_076: You see, the return of the night sky has brought lots of changes. And while everyone is glad, the reality is it's also been quite stressful, having to adapt to a new way of life.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_077: Seeing how hard our elders are working to keep the Crystarium running, youths like myself came up with the idea of hosting an event as way of expressing our appreciation.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_078: Once we return from the Empty, I'll be helping as one of the organizers.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_A2_000_001: I'd be happy to help─provided I'm suitably compensated.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_A2_000_002: I'd offer to help, but I think you have everything well in hand.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_079: Haha, I doubt we could afford the services of a great hero such as you, but thanks for offering. If everything goes well, all you'd need to do is turn up and enjoy yourself!
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_080: I wouldn't be so sure about that...but I'd try my best to make it a success. If everything goes well, all you'd need to do is turn up and enjoy yourself!
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_081: How about you, Gaia? Would you like to help with the festival?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_082: Wh-What's that? I...er, haven't been listening.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_083: My...ah...leg is cramping up a bit. Piloting this thing must've made me more tense than I'd realized.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_084: Then let one of us take over!
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_086: Well, as long as you're sure. But if you feel like switching places, just say the word.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_089: Light... Does this mean there's still too much of it in the Empty?
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_090: Hmm... I'm no expert, but this might be a result of losing control when you restored the ice element. Even though I tried to use Darkness to hold back the Light spilling forth, it seems it wasn't enough.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_RYNE_000_091: Then we're right back to where we started. This is all my fault...
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_092: No, Ryne. You mustn't blame yourself.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIAVOICE_000_095: Restore the Darkness, while you still can!
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_096:
A familiar voice, an inescapable fate.
The promise of salvation at the precipice of ruin.
TEXT_LUCKRA301_03975_GAIA_000_097: In the remnants of a lost past, I would find my truth.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_000: It's been so long since Gaia had one of her headaches that I thought the faerie might've disappeared for good. Do you think it's got something to do with Eden?
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_012: Restore the Darkness...to the world flooded by Light...
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_014: We thought we'd restored balance to the six elements, but perhaps they're still too strongly aligned with Light? If that's the case, maybe we can set things right by using Darkness.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_015: By using Darkness? Are...are you serious!?
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_016: But hold on... It might actually work!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_018: I-I wouldn't go that far. I just remembered what I learned during our adventures, that's all.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_019: But this does mean we'll need to call on your services again, if that's all right with you?
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_020: We've come this far together, and we'll see our mission to the end! To Eden's core!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_030: I'll say one thing before we start: if this all goes horribly wrong, don't even think about pinning it on me! Not that it will, of course...
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_041: But...hmmm... Were there any primals aligned with Darkness? I can't seem to recall any...
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_043: The Ascians' god, Zodiark, may be suitable, but we need something that  has actually encountered─and preferably defeated.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_044: Well, does it have to be a primal for it to work? If it's just a lot of Darkness that we need, perhaps there are other ways to get it.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_045: You may be right! What we ultimately need is a state of highly charged Darkness─it shouldn't matter what form it takes. Does anything come to mind, ?
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_A1_000_001: I daresay the Flood of Darkness had a fair bit of...Darkness.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_A1_000_002: I know a few voidsent that would fit the bill.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_046: You mean the catastrophe that swallowed the Thirteenth and turned it into a lifeless void? Erm, we might need something on a slightly smaller scale...
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_047: The creatures I unleashed while under the faerie's control... If we were able to summon one powerful enough, it just might work.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_048: The Cloud of Darkness... I can't begin to imagine how powerful it must have been.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_049: I'd say we've found the perfect candidate.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_050: But where to find a suitable place, one where Darkness is strong... It won't be easy in a world flooded by Light.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_051: Well, we've got the Warrior of Darkness and the Oracle of Darkness right here. It seems like a good enough spot to me.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_052: But what about the Light-aligned aether that's all around us?
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_053: That's where you come in. You can suppress the Light while I draw out the Darkness. By combining our powers, we can make it work wherever we are.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_055: Yes, between us, there's nothing we can't achieve! Don't be afraid, Gaia!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_056: I'm not afraid─just very concerned that this will all go horribly wrong...which is the same thing, I suppose. Anyway, it's certainly not easy coming up with these plans by ourselves.
