TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_057: That's true. But when this is over, we can reward ourselves with all sorts of delicious treats at the festival!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_059: We spoke about it on the way here, remember? I asked if you wanted to take part.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_060: Um... I was busy piloting the skyslipper, so I probably wasn't paying attention.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_061: Oh well, not to worry. We can talk about that later. Right now we've got a job to do!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_062: I'll draw out the ambient aether...
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_063: And I'll shift its alignment to Darkness!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_SYSTEM_000_065: Memories of the Cloud of Darkness enshroud your mind...
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_070: This is the first time we've tried this since that disaster with Shiva, so I'd be lying if I said I wasn't nervous. Even so, I can't afford to waver now!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_071: I've called forth real voidsent before─so everyone tells me, anyway─but this is unknown territory for me. With the two of you by my side, though, I'm sure it'll work!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_080: So that was what a world flooded by Darkness would look like...
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_090: That all went surprisingly well. Of course, we have  to thank for slaying that ghastly creature.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_RYNE_000_091: You were fantastic, Gaia! Anyone would think you're an old hand at this!
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_092: You weren't so bad yourself. We make quite a team, don't we?
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_094: I don't know about you two, but I'm itching to see whether our hard work has paid off. Let's head back.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_100: Hmm... The plants are just as lifeless as they were before. Maybe the Light's influence is still too strong?
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_102:
In fleeting hues and endless warmth,
A gentle light washed over me.
TEXT_LUCKRA302_03976_GAIA_000_103: A glimmer of hope once lost...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_000: I'm still not sure what that enormous crystal actually does, or why it changes color. But I'm sure it didn't look like that before.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_SYSTEM_000_001: You had best speak with Gaia first...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_010: We tipped the scales away from the Light, I'm sure of it. But something's wrong─very wrong.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAVOICE_000_020: For a hundred long years, I have waited for this moment!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_021: I knew it! You've been hiding inside Eden all this time!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_022: I am Mitron, servant of Zodiark.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_023: The voice that has whispered to me all my life...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_024: Indeed... And thanks to you, I am all but free from my prison of Light!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_025: Does that mean Eden was used to seal away an Ascian?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_026: Wait... That is Eden! An Ascian transformed into a sin eater!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_027: Hmph. I've heard enough about Ascians to know they're nothing but trouble. But I never imagined that one of them was behind all this...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_028: I thought that restoring the Darkness was my idea, but this was your plan from the very beginning!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_100_028: It was. But all it took was the slightest suggestion. The rest was entirely your own doing.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_029: Ah... My freedom is so close, I can almost taste it... Finally, my soul may journey beyond the flesh to which I am yet bound.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_030: I knew you would come for me, Gaia.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_031: Hmph, don't flatter yourself. You've caused me nothing but pain. If I've helped you, it wasn't intentional.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_032: Even now, your memories elude you. Hearken unto me, Gaia, and remember...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_040: In an age past, the world you know as the Thirteenth was flooded by Darkness. Like ripples in water, the repercussions were felt in the other shards, none more so than here on the First. It became perilously imbalanced and susceptible to the influence of Light.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_041: Were Light to consume the First as Darkness did the Thirteenth, it would likewise become a lifeless void, lost to our cause. We could not allow this mistake to be repeated. It was our duty to safeguard this world from the selfsame fate.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_042: After a time, Emet-Selch conceived of a plan to trigger a Rejoining, utilizing the very Light we had labored to keep in check, and tasked us with bringing the plan to fruition.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_043: But at the last, we were thwarted by Ardbert and his companions. Though our resolve was strong, theirs was stronger still. And as we fell, so too was the Light unleashed.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_044: For us, however, death is not the end. Though our bodies may perish, our souls live on, withdrawing but temporarily to the rift.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_045: Until you can find a new body to possess...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_046: I too would have been reborn. But ere my soul could leave its corporeal form, Ardbert struck me with a blade of purest Light. And that Light enveloped my body, twisting it beyond recognition.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_048: My soul felt such agony as I had never known...and then I knew no more.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_049: In my insensate, instinctive state, influenced by Ardbert's fervent desire to banish Darkness, I unleashed the Light burgeoning within me. And it spread as an all-consuming wave to every corner of the world.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_050: The Flood of Light... So, that's how sin eaters came to be...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_051: All would have been lost had not the one called Minfilia appeared. Halting the Light's inexorable advance, she saved what little still remained of the world.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_052: In the process, she also restored to me a sliver of my consciousness, though I remained trapped in my altered form. Motionless, I was capable only of feeble whispering.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_110_052: Perhaps he could have, if such had been his wish. Far easier, however, to simply find another piece of my fractured soul to replace me.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_120_052: From his perspective, there was no need to intervene and potentially disturb the balance of aether. And so here I remained.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_130_052: So after you failed, he left you here to rot. Some friend he turned out to be.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_053: Thus abandoned, I called out for what seemed like an eternity to the only soul who could save me: you, Gaia.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_054: All this time, you were calling to me for help?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_055: Yes, but you had forgotten me. Forgotten our duty. Though vestiges of your true power remained, you could not wield it at will.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_056: Time went by, and eventually change came. The Light began to subside and the dark of night returned.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_057: Gradually, my voice grew stronger until I was able to exert my will over you.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_058: You wanted me to free your soul from Eden, which is why you had me attack it. Another plan that ended in failure, thanks to .
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_059: Indeed. Thankfully, your subsequent attempts to restore this barren land allowed Eden to absorb more and more aether aligned closer to Darkness, gradually eroding the cage of Light that holds me.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_060: Owing to your most recent efforts, my mind is wholly my own once more, and I am able to project my image beyond those confines.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_061: Then all this time we've been helping to free an Ascian!?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_062: Hmph. That's a fine tale, but why should I care about any of it?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_064: Come with me to Eden's core. There, all shall become clear.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_070: I have a bad feeling about this, but if we want to restore the land, we need to know what we're dealing with...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_SYSTEM_000_071: You had best consult with Ryne first...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_080: I've just realized something. If Eden has been absorbing all that rebalanced aether, that must be why we've struggled to restore life to the Empty. I suppose we can think about that later, though.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_081: More importantly, it seems I've lost control over Eden, most likely because of the Ascian. Urianger specifically warned us about not listening to the faerie's “honeyed words,” so we'd better think this through before we go rushing in.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_082: Oh, if only he and Thancred were here now...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_084: I'm sorry, Gaia. I shouldn't be so quick to lose heart.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_085: What? No, that's not what I meant. Who are Urianger and Thancred?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_086: Wait... I know those people. I'm sure of it. But why can't I remember them?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_087: Hmm... I thought something was strange when I mentioned the festival onboard Eden. It was as though you had no recollection of our earlier conversation. This is most likely connected to Mitron...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_088: Damn it all! What more is that fiend going to take from me!?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_089: To tell the truth, the thing that frightens me most...is that you might forget about us.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_090: That won't happen. For every memory I lose, we'll make two more together.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_091: And if I need to know something, I can just ask you! Why not start by telling me about Urianger and Thancred? To be honest, my nerves are all ajitter, so I need something to help me settle down before we confront Mitron.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_092: Urianger is probably the most intelligent person I know. He spends a lot of time reading, but he also says that you can't learn everything from books, and encouraged me to go out and see the world for myself.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_093: Sounds sensible to me. Much better to experience things firsthand than to read about someone else's. Like those coffee biscuits. No book could ever describe how good they taste.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_094: Is there anything else you can tell me about him, ?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A1_000_001: He is devoted to the study of prophecies.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A1_000_002: He can walk on water, until he can't...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_095: Prophecies are funny things, if you ask me. If people know that something terrible is going to happen, they'll go and prevent it─which would make the prophecy untrue.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_096: Hee hee! I wonder what Urianger would say to that!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_097: So he walks on water instead of swimming? That would certainly save you from getting wet... I should've asked him to teach me how.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_098: Well, it's something he never quite mastered himself, and he often ended up getting wet anyway. In fact, the whole thing is probably more trouble than it's worth!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_099: As for Thancred, he's the one who freed me from Eulmore. At first, I thought of him as my knight in shining armor, but really, he was much more than that. We traveled all over Norvrandt and he helped me become the person I am today. He even gave me my name!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A2_000_001: He's also an expert in infiltration.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A2_000_002: His gift for song won the heart of many a fair lady, or so he claims...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_100: That would explain how he was able to sneak into Eulmore and rescue the damsel in distress, just like in the songs.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_101: Hmph, I'm hardly a damsel in distress! ...Well, I suppose I was back then. But Thancred taught me how to fight and survive.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_102: Singing? That doesn't sound like the Thancred I know.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_103: It seems he has a way with words. That must be how he was able to choose such a pretty name for you.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_104: Actually, while we're on the subject, that gunblade over there belonged to Thancred.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_105: As far as mementos go, it's a bit on the cumbersome side, but it reminds me of our adventures together. Even though there's little chance I'll ever see him again, it still feels like he's here with me.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_107: You know what? I should keep a diary. Even if I forget everything, at least I will have something to look back on.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_108: That's a brilliant idea! Since we're going to be making lots of new memories together, maybe I could write in it too?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_109: As long as you improve your handwriting before you go scrawling all over it. I'd like your entries to be vaguely legible, if you don't mind.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_111: But before that, we've got an Ascian to deal with. Let's get this over with!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_120: When I think back on the days I spent with everyone, it's always the tiny, frivolous details that spring to mind.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_121: The smiles, the little gestures... It's not as though I made a conscious effort to remember them, but they stuck with me all the same.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_122: I suppose that's what memories are─a collection of all those seemingly insignificant moments. While they may not have made a huge difference in the grand scheme of things, they mean the world to me.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_123: It was good to hear about our friends...but I still have no recollection of them whatsoever.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_124: It's just like all those things Mitron was saying. How can I even tell if they're true or not if I don't remember?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_125: There's no point dwelling on it, though. Nothing for it but to press on.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_130: We came as you asked, so start talking.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_131: Why settle for mere words when I offer something far greater? Eden will now afford you a glimpse of the past. More than a glimpse, in fact. It will be as real as any of the foes you yourselves have conjured forth.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_132: Conjured forth? Wait, you don't mean to perform a summoning, do you!?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_133: I do. I shall recreate the battle of a hundred years past, which pitted Ardbert and his fellow Warriors of Light against their nemesis, the Shadowkeeper.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A3_000_001: Just as Emet-Selch recreated the Final Days of Amaurot...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A3_000_002: So who will play the part of Ardbert?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_134: Is that so? It seems much and more has occurred during my absence. No doubt he employed creation magicks to breathe life into his recollections of the past.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_135: Whomsoever you choose, though his skill and strength will not be easily matched.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_136: That you should know that name... The true identity of the Shadowkeeper, emissary of chaos.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_137: And what do you hope to achieve with this history lesson of yours?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_138: You shall see. You shall remember. Now, your very soul will revisit that fateful day a hundred years ago.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_139: Gaia, you can't trust Mitron! If you do, you'll end up being manipulated again!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_141: You're right. My days of being controlled by this demon are over. I have a new life now, and I won't let anyone take that away from me.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_142: My will is my own! You have no hold over me!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_143: This is all your doing, accursed minions of Light! I should be the one at her side! Not you or anyone else! I will take her beyond the reach of your poisonous influence and keep her safe!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_144: What have you done with Gaia!?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_145: Nothing yet. But soon I will restore her to her true self. And you will help me to do so, by conquering the adversary I present before you.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_SYSTEM_000_150: You had best speak with Ryne...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_160: I knew it was risky trusting an Ascian, but we played right into Mitron's hands!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A4_000_001: We'll do whatever it takes to save Gaia.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A4_000_002: There's no choice but to do as Mitron says.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_161: Agreed. There's no telling what kind of danger she's in, but wherever she is, I know she's giving her all. Even though we're apart, we'll fight as one.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_162: Together, we'll bring an end to Mitron's wicked schemes!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_163: Perhaps, but I doubt that'll be the end of it. It's clear that Mitron has no intention of returning Gaia to us, but there may yet be an opportunity to free her. “In the chaos of conflict, one can always find an opening to exploit.”
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_164: Of course, it's the conflict part that comes first. But if Ardbert was able to overcome this foe, then so can you!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_165: It looks like Mitron's grip on Eden has loosened somewhat, perhaps to allow me to send you to the battlefield.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_166: Once you get there, don't let your guard down. While this may be a reenactment of a moment in history, the threat you face is very real. Whatever happens, you must make it through this. Gaia's counting on us!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_170: I wish I knew more about this Shadowkeeper. Then at least we'd be a little better prepared. All I can say is, please be careful.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_190: Why...does this all seem so...familiar? Ungh!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_180: Mitron's returned Gaia to us, but I've a feeling this isn't over yet...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_200: The Warriors of Light... The Shadowkeeper... I've seen this all before.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_201: Yes! You and I joined our power as one to create the Shadowkeeper. We bore witness to its battle with the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_202: Our power? So I was there...and I wasn't alone...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_203: No, Gaia! It's not true, it can't be! How can you have been there a hundred years ago!?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_204: Look deep inside─you know it was real. Cast aside those worthless memories and embrace who you truly are!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_206: Now I see. This is why you've been tampering with my memories ever since I was a child...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_207: Just so. And now, I possess the means to purge them entirely. Your rebirth will finally be complete!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_208: You have no right to deny me a life, to rob me of what I hold most precious! My memories may seem worthless to you, but not to me.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_209: I will never be yours. My place is here. In this world, in this life, in this moment. Wherever my friends are, that is where I belong!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_210: Then you would turn your back on our glorious past? On the lives we once lived?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_211: Any past I may have shared with you is long gone. I live in the here and now, striving to build a better future. And I'll be damned if I let you take that away from me!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_212: To be reunited at long last, only to be shunned...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_213: Would that I had died with you... To be reborn.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_214: Even without knowledge of your past, we may yet forge a future together.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_215: I'm sick of your riddles. Speak plainly or not at all.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_216: You and I fought the Warriors of Light as one, joined in both body and soul. When Ardbert struck his final blow, the Light tore through the bonds that held us. Though you perished, I was condemned to a far worse fate.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_217: My flesh became my prison, and I was cursed to remain here, an abomination, while you lived on with others at your side... I will suffer it no more! You belong to me!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_218: I, too, was once held against my will, robbed of my freedom. To be trapped and alone for a hundred years... I can't begin to imagine the pain you must have felt.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_219: But that doesn't give you the right to deny Gaia a chance at happiness!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_220: We once knew happiness─true happiness, until fate conspired to tear us apart. I will never let that happen again. We shall be joined as one, my memories yours. Together for all eternity!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_222: Th-The Darkness... It's rising within me!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIA_000_224: What is this? Why am I...?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_225: Hold on, Gaia! Whatever it is, you mustn't give in!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_227: Yes, yes! Now nothing will keep you from me!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_221: I am yours, and you are mine!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_229: So it's true!? Gaia really is a reincarnated Ascian!?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_230: The girl you once knew is no more. The Ascian who held the seat of Loghrif is all that remains. Gaia is her true name.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_240: Oh, Loghrif, how long has it been... How long have I dreamed of this day.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_241: Is that you, Mitron? Forgive me, I didn't recognize you...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_242: In my defense, my memories have only recently been restored. My mind is still a little hazy.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_243: Hardly surprising. No matter how many times we are reborn, it is disorienting to have everything change around you.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_244: Even so, I immediately recognized your resplendent soul. And I cling to the hope that one day you will likewise remember mine. You always were a forgetful one.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_245: I could never forget you. Try as I might.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_246: But tell me, what do you know of my past? I admit, my memory may need refreshing...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_247: We served together as members of the Convocation of Fourteen, dedicated to the summoning of Lord Zodiark.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_248: Although the task assigned to you eventually fell to Elidibus.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_249: Yes, I remember. Amidst the chaos and despair, you never left my side. My loyal protector...
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_250: But in the end, it was in vain... I was powerless to prevent Hydaelyn from tearing our world asunder.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_251: So I heard from Emet-Selch. We labor to make our world whole again. That's why he restored my memories, so that I can play my part.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_252: Our part. Alone we struggle, but by joining your power with mine, we may yet succeed.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_253: My power? Hmph. You always were one for flattery.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_254: Oh, I assure you, I am quite sincere. It would be my honor to serve the cause alongside you. And I shan't take no for an answer.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_LOGHRIF_000_255: The honor is mine. For as much as I chide and tease you, you are everything to me. My inspiration. When I'm with you, I fear nothing. Promise me...that we'll never be parted again.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_MITRON_000_256: I promise. Even should fate conspire to separate us, I will reach out to you, wherever you may be.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_260: We were destined to find each other. To awaken our buried past and be born anew.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_261: Though our brethren employ crystals to return sundered souls to their office, without them, such a feat was beyond my reach. But by becoming one in mind and body, my memories are yours. At last, you have awoken.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_262: Now, the time has come to restore our world to the utopia it once was.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_264: You are not worthy to speak that name!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_265: If you must call her anything, use the name chosen by her parents, if you even know what that is.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_266: No. To me, her name is Gaia.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_267: And nothing you say about her makes any difference to me. I don't care if she's an Ascian. She's my friend!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_268: Was your friend. Never again will she answer to your cries.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A5_000_001: We won't give up on her!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_A5_000_002: We'll break the shackles that bind her!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_269: Your wicked schemes have gone far enough. We're taking Gaia back!
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_270: Accursed servants of Light... You will not tear us apart again.
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_RYNE_000_271: What...is this!? Visions in my mind... A summoning!?
TEXT_LUCKRA303_03977_GAIAPRIME_000_272: All your hopes and fears, turned against you. There is no escape from your past...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_000: No... My memories... They're being used to fuel a summoning!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_001: Unnnh... Is this how it feels to have the faerie inside my mind? To think Gaia had to endure it for so long...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_002: You're right. However bad this is, it's nothing compared to what she's going through now.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_003: But if the summoning really is based on my hopes and fears, it will most likely create a foe unlike any you've ever fought before.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_004: Whatever it may be, I believe in you! We'll find a way through this, I know it!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_010: While it seems that the summoning will be based on my memories, I still have no idea what form it will take.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_011: Remember, it's all an Ascian ploy, so don't let yourself be fooled! Please, just do what you have to do. I'm sure you're more than a match for whatever Mitron has in store!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_020: So this is the way of the Ascians? To use the memories of our loved ones against us?
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_021: That fragmented souls should triumph over their fears while we succumbed to ours, thereby setting our star upon a course of ruin...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_022: That inferior beings such as you should succeed while we failed! It defies all logic!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_024: Gaia's still in there, fighting to free herself from Loghrif's will!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_025: Even now, you would defy us!?
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_026: We will remove every last vestige of your meaningless mortal existence!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_028: Impurities must be purged. We shall begin by erasing you from her past, and then by your deaths, erase you from her future. There is no place for you in our utopia.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_029: We may be mere mortals, our souls fragmented, but our existence is not meaningless!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_030: And you should understand this! Before you awoke as an Ascian, you lived as one of us!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_031: You had your own memories, and surely they mean something? The lives you led can't all have been for nothing!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_032: To we who have known perfection, they are less than nothing.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_033: Compared to yours, our lives may seem insignificant.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_034: Nevertheless, we live them to the fullest! And though it may take us a thousand years, we have the potential to build a world every bit as wonderful as yours!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_035: But you won't even allow us a chance? To live our own lives and forge our own future?
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_036: Whatever you forge will inevitably crumble to dust. But we are immortal, our legacy eternal. If our world cannot be made complete as it once was, we will create a perfect moment that shall last forever.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_037: By our hand shall our paradise be made, where there is no beginning and no end.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_038: Eden's absorbing enormous amounts of aether! At this rate, the whole world will be drained!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_039: Light and Darkness, the elements of nature, all in harmony. A sublime utopia, where time has no meaning.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIAPRIME_000_040: We shall become one with Eden. Free to live in peace for eternity.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_042: There's only one thing for it. I'll try to disrupt the balance of aether and create an opening for you!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_043: We can't let it end like this. It's up to us to save Gaia!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_A1_000_001: Mitron won't get away with this.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_A1_000_002: It's all about love, friendship, and courage!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_050: A place where time has no meaning, where there is no beginning and no end... I'm not sure I like the sound of that. We all die someday, but that's what makes life so precious!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_051: And I know that Gaia wouldn't want that, to simply exist without any hope for the future, to stay the same forever.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_052: How she lives is up to her. It's not for Mitron or anyone else to decide. We'll free her from that fiend and give her the chance she deserves!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_SYSTEM_000_060: Though Gaia is now free from Mitron, she remains unconscious.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_SYSTEM_000_061: The aetheryte shard is not responding.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_070: We did it! She's free at last! Or at least that's how it seems. She won't wake up...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_071: Gaia, I don't know if you can hear me, or if you even remember who I am, but just give me a sign that you're all right. Please, say something, anything!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_A2_000_001: She can hear you, Ryne. Keep trying!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_A2_000_002: You've brought her back once before, you can do it again!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_072: You're right, . I mustn't lose hope!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_074: It's the necklace! But she said she left it back in the Crystarium...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_075:
Maybe she likes it a lot more than she lets on. I suppose it does hold a lot of memories for the both of us.
...Wait─there might be a way we can use this to bring her back!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_SYSTEM_000_076: Try calling Gaia's name to help bring her back to her senses.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_080: I'm not sure how to reach her, but if she remembers the necklace, maybe she'll find her way back to us!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_SYSTEM_000_081: Though Gaia appears unharmed, her consciousness has yet to return.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_SYSTEM_000_082: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Gaia” to call out to her.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_090: Gaia! We're right here beside you! Come back to us!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_SYSTEM_000_091: The necklace begins to glimmer faintly...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_SYSTEM_000_100: You can only hope that Gaia is able to hear your voice.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_100_100: She can hear us, I know she can! Now, all we can do is pray that she'll return...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_110: Gaia, I know you're in there somewhere.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_111: If you're lost, I'll find a way to reach you!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_121: Mitron... I'm finally free of you, it seems.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_MITRON_000_122: Ah, dearest Gaia... That fate should part us once more...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_123: Still, this is what you wanted. There's no need to be quite so upset.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_125: You've been released from Eden, free to be reborn. Perhaps one day, fate will bring us together again, in another life.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_126: After all, you've already found me once, in spite of everything.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_127: I might even be the one to find you.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_MITRON_000_128: I fear you will come to forget me. To forget the times we shared.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_129: Perhaps. After all, memories are such fragile things...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_130: That's why I'm planning to keep a diary. Even after I'm gone, my memories will live on.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_132: Yes. They'll read the tale of the girl bound by duty, and of her loyal protector, arrived in her hour of need.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_MITRON_000_133: Perhaps you might leave out the part where that “protector” was the one who needed saving. You have grown strong, Gaia.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_134: If I'd found you sooner, then maybe...!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_137: Hm? Whose name did I just...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_138: Well, never mind that for now. I need to get out of here...wherever here is.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_139: I feel as though there's somewhere I'm supposed to be, but I can't for the life of me remember where.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_141: Is this...ice? It certainly looks like it, but it doesn't seem to melt. And it shines so brightly...
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_143: That's it! There was a girl... But what was her name?
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_148: I can't find my way out of here!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_149: Hold on! I'm coming for you!
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_151: ...I could never forget you. Try as I might.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_GAIA_000_152: So the aether that Eden had absorbed was returned to the land. Now, just like Mitron, the Empty can finally be reborn.
TEXT_LUCKRA304_03978_RYNE_000_153: Though it can hardly be called the Empty now. It's...a utopia.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_000: I'm thrilled that we've been able to restore the Empty, but I can't stop thinking about Mitron and Loghrif. It seems to me that they were only bound to their duty because of their memories.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_001: It seems that there's something within that doesn't want to be forgotten. Their souls live on, no matter how many times they go through the cycle of death and rebirth.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_002: I wonder what their lives would've been like if they'd never remembered, and had carried on living amongst us mortals. Then again, I suppose I am Loghrif, in a way, but still me.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_010: I still can't believe this is happening─it's a dream come true!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_011: I just wish the others were here to see it.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_A1_000_001: I'll be sure to tell them all about it.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_A1_000_002: Perhaps Gaia could pay them a visit and share the good news?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_012: Yes, I suppose that's the next best thing. Hold on─you might even be able to take something with you to show them!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_013: I'll bet the fruit that grows here could be used to make all sorts of delicious treats!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_014: You could even make something yourself, Ryne.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_015: That's a great idea, but my cooking can be a bit hit-or-miss... Maybe once we get back to the Crystarium, I'll ask for some advice!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_016: Gaia? But how would she do that?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_017: Well, Ascians can travel between worlds, can't they?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_018: I might be able to do it, too, if I find a way to use my Ascian powers. It may prove a bit tricky now that I'm separated from Mitron, though.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_019: Well, to be honest, I'd like it if you stay in this world, at least for a while. We still have so much to do together, after all!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_020: Actually, I wanted to ask something. When you say “the others,” do you mean Thancred, the bookworm, and Urianger, your knight in shining armor?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_021: Haha! No, it's the other way around!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_022: Oh, is it? Hmm, seems my memory's even less reliable than it was before.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_023: The main thing is, the whispering in my head has stopped, so I shouldn't have any more bouts of amnesia. Even so, there's a part of me that'll miss hearing the faerie's voice...
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_024: I know how you feel, Gaia. Anyway, we've all been through rather a lot, so why don't we head back to civilization for some much-needed rest?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_025: All right. Leave the piloting to me!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_030: I know she insisted on piloting the skyslipper, but given her recent exertions, perhaps it wasn't such a good idea?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_040: I understand that keeping the skyslipper here allows us to save fuel from traveling all the way back to Mord Souq, but can't we just carry a bit extra? It's not easy crossing the desert in these heels, you know.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_041: I seem to remember you weren't too enthused when I suggested buying some nice, sensible walking boots... Come to think of it, maybe we should rest here for a while. You must be tired after all that piloting.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_042: I'm fine. Besides, I had the two of you to keep me company. It was over before I knew it.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_043: Taking in the scenery with the wind in my hair really helped clear out the cobwebs, too. Perhaps I should see about getting my very own skyslipper...
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_044: What!? You can't just buy one! Even if you could, they'd cost a fortune!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_045: Oh, I'm sorry. That must be my Eulmoran upbringing speaking. I'll have you know, I'm almost as comfortable in more humble surroundings, like Mord Souq, for example. That reminds me, it's time we made our way there and told Yalfort all about...well, everything.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_050: After all of the unimaginable things we've seen in the Empty, it's nice to get back to a bit of normality for a change.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_051: I'll say one thing for this place: for better or worse, I'll never forget the smell.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_YALFORT_000_060: Welcome back! I take it all is well in the Empty?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_061: It is now! Not everything went quite as we'd planned─to put it mildly─but we managed to revive the ambient aether. Now all we need to do is wait for the changes to become widespread.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_YALFORT_000_062: Truly!? Wonderful! Just wonderful! I shall share the tidings with our inner circle...and perhaps it is time more people knew of your expeditions as well.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_YALFORT_000_063: Of course, we'll continue to monitor the situation, but I'm sure it won't be long before we can allow members of the citizenry to make their own forays into the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_YALFORT_000_070: I'm pleased to say that I too have some good news to share. Our investigators in Eulmore have finally found information pertaining to Gaia's true identity!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_YALFORT_000_072: As it pertains to matters of a private nature, the information is being treated as highly confidential, so I haven't actually looked at it myself, but I imagine it includes Gaia's real name...
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_073: To be honest, I'd prefer not to know.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_075: You see, I've come to learn a lot about my past, even before my life in Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_076: I know now that I'm the reincarnation of Loghrif, an Ascian. And Mitron, the one who was transformed into Eden...was someone very special to me.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_077: For a hundred years, Mitron called out to me in the hope we'd be reunited. But there was no answer.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_078: Even so, Mitron held on to those precious memories of our life together, and stopped at nothing to make them a reality once more.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_079: I know now that Mitron wanted the same as us. Wanted the world to be as it once was.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_080: Yes. It's a shame that things turned out the way they did. In those hundred years of solitude, that dream became an obsession.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_081: I would've likewise succumbed to the Darkness within if it weren't for Ryne and . If someone had also been there for Mitron, who knows what might've happened?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_082: That's why, from now on, I want to help those in need, to give their dreams a chance to come true.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_083: For me, the name Gaia symbolizes hope. And though each of our lives may be but a drop in the great river of time, hope springs eternal.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_085: So...I'm sorry. While I appreciate your efforts to find my past, I'm looking to the future now. As Gaia.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_YALFORT_000_086: No need to apologize, Miss Gaia. As long as you are happy, then so are we!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_YALFORT_000_087: Right, I expect my colleagues will be keen to turn their attention to the Empty. If you'll excuse me, I have expeditions to arrange! Till next time!
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_RYNE_000_088: So, what shall we do now?
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_089: Come on, Ryne. Don't tell me you've forgotten.
TEXT_LUCKRA305_03979_GAIA_000_090: The festival at the Crystarium, remember? And don't even think about leaving me out. I wouldn't miss it for the world!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: Ah, it's good to see you, .
I'm pleased to report that Master Garlond and the others uncovered a fair bit of useful information at the imperial facility in Terncliff.
In fact, he'd like you to rendezvous with Gaius in the town square, where he'll reveal what they've found. Once you're ready to depart, your escort will lead the way.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CONVEYOR03783_000_0: All set for the journey ahead?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: Now that you are here, perhaps Cid will finally deign to dispense his findings.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_054: To tell the truth, we were lucky to obtain any information at all, considering the lengths to which the imperials went in covering their tracks. You see, the hangar below was not just used to store the Weapons, but played a critical role in their creation.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_055: We now know the code names given to three of the Weapons. Ruby, Sapphire...and Emerald.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_056: Obviously, we are all familiar with the first two, but the third is something of an unknown quantity.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_057: At the very least, this confirms the existence of another of those abominations.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_A1_000_002: What are we waiting for? Let's go after it!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: The problem lies in ascertaining its whereabouts. None of the locals have seen anything resembling a Weapon being transported either by land or air.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_060: Which of course leaves only one option: the sea. According to what fragmented data we were able to recover, the Emerald Weapon is equipped with aquatic capabilities, much like the Sapphire.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: Meaning that its escape from Terncliff would have gone undetected, and could potentially be anywhere by now. But if Alfonse plans to have it absorb more primals...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_063: And traveling by sea would allow him to circumvent the front line at Ghimlyt entirely! The Alliance must be alerted at once!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_064: Hold your chocobos, Severa. It seems that the Emerald Weapon was still incomplete when the VIIth Legion withdrew from Terncliff.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_065: It's far more likely that it was transported to another facility in order to add the finishing touches.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: If your supposition is correct, that would narrow our search to but two possible locations: Castrum Marinum in the Rhotano Sea and Castrum Occidens in eastern La Noscea.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_067: Both of which are known to harbor remnants of the XIVth Legion...your former subordinates, Gaius.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: Be that as it may, our objective is unchanged. Valdeaulin, you and Severa will make your way to Castrum Occidens while  and I head for Castrum Marinum.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_069: Should we locate the Emerald Weapon, we will give the signal to dispatch the G-Warrior and eliminate it before it can be activated.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_070: Sorry to disappoint you, but we're still repairing the damage it sustained during the encounter with the Sapphire Weapon. While Allagan machinery has its uses, it's a bugger to find replacement parts in a pinch...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_100_070: We've actually been working to expand its already impressive arsenal, but the G-Warrior itself is in no fit state for combat.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_071: While I'm aware this is a far from adequate replacement, I can provide an Ironworks submersible to help  and Gaius reach Castrum Marinum. I'll have one sent ahead to Vesper Bay.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_072: A submersible, eh? I don't much like the sound of that. Perhaps Severa and I should count ourselves fortunate that our destination can be approached by land. I pray you have a safe journey. Watch yourself out there, ...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_07: It is time we departed. Let us make our way to Vesper Bay.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_075: It seems that Cid is not in the habit of saying the same thing twice, which must be why he has been waiting for you to arrive before revealing the results of his investigation.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_080: Though the imperials may be gone, the scars they have left on this once-peaceful town will doubtless take many years to heal.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: I wouldn't mind going with you to Terncliff, but I've got to stay here to keep an eye on this horrible lot!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CONVEYOR03783_000_9: All set for the journey ahead?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_GSPILOT03980_000_10: As per Master Garlond's instructions, the submersible is ready when you are!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_GSPILOT03980_100_10: But before you depart, I've received some scraps of intelligence regarding your opponent from my colleagues in Terncliff.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_GSPILOT03980_200_10: Apparently, it uses some sort of levitating...handlike appendages─six of them, in fact─though we're not quite sure what purpose they serve. It sounds like having eyes in the back of your head might come in handy. But that's all we know, I'm afraid.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_10: You have our thanks. After all, forewarned is forearmed. If the Emerald Weapon has indeed been transported to this castrum, it would need to enter via the dry dock. We shall do likewise.
As one might expect, there are measures in place to keep out intruders, but the security systems can be tricked into recognizing us as an imperial vessel.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_100_10: That said, infiltrating the facility is merely the first step...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_10: Should the Emerald Weapon be activated, it is only a matter of time before the pilot uses Oversoul.
We must silence the warmachina before this happens, and failing that, grant the poor soul at its helm the mercy of a swift death.

Had these wounds healed more quickly, I could have gone with you, but I fear I would only slow you down. As such, I shall provide what support I can from afar. Whatever happens, the Emerald Weapon must be defeated at all costs.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_11: In the event that my attempt to bypass the castrum's security fails, this submersible of Cid's had best be able to withstand imperial weaponry long enough for us to escape.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_GSPILOT03980_000_15: I'm sorry we weren't able to provide any further details on the target. We can only guess what other tricks it might have in store for you. Be careful out there.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_15: Though I would prefer that we avoid engaging my former wards in combat, we cannot allow my sentiments to prevent us from doing what must be done.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_20: But why would Rex throw away his life...for this!?
You are right... If I am ever to learn the truth, I must concentrate on the task at hand.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_100_20: Of course, we do not need to wait for Cid's analysis to tell us whose combat data was used on this occasion.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_200_20: It galls me to think that my techniques and strategies could be so closely replicated. Nevertheless, the observations I made during the battle may yet prove useful. As a matter of fact, that was not the only information I was able to gather.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_20: I intercepted a signal that revealed the troops stationed here were permitted to withdraw, seemingly in return for assisting the VIIth Legion. They must have known that the Alliance would follow the Emerald Weapon here sooner or later and made good their escape.
Meaning the way is now clear for Cid to inspect the warmachina's remains.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_205: We got here as soon as we could.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_100_205: Not that we could've done anything to prevent this tragedy.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_206: From what we know, it seems that the Emerald Weapon was ilm for ilm a great deal more powerful than the previous two. If this is allowed to continue, who knows what sort of monstrosity the VIIth Legion will conceive next.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_207: Nevertheless,  has once again proven  capable of overcoming the worst the Empire has at its disposal.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_208: You may be relieved to hear that Castrum Occidens was free of anything resembling a Weapon. Unfortunately, it was also devoid of any useful leads, and we came away empty-handed.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_20: In all honesty, part of me wishes we had never found the Emerald Weapon. Perhaps then, Rex would not have been forced to make the ultimate sacrifice. I only hope that he is finally at peace...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_210: We will do what we can to spare others from sharing his fate. I and the Ironworks will search this place from top to bottom for clues as to the VIIth Legion's plans.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_211: Before that, allow me to sweep the area for booby traps and the like. I would not put it past the imperials to have left a few surprises for us...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_213: With that in mind, I'll begin my examination of the Emerald Weapon. Carefully, that is.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_251: Alfonse! You knew all this time, didn't you!?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_252: Milisandia and Ricon, too... Everyone except me.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_254: Yes. That's what the synthetic auracite system is. The fusion between pilot and core is the key to Oversoul.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_255: And unless we use it, we don't have a chance of beating Father's newfound friends. They stand between us and the primals, without which the Weapons will never reach their full potential. We thought that if you knew the truth about Oversoul, you'd try to stop us.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_256: Of course I would! But what I don't understand is why all of you are so willing to give your lives for the Weapon project. What is it all for!?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_257: It all began the day Father left. Without his guidance, his protection, the Garleans lost any respect they once had for us.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_258: But their cruelty pales in comparison to Valens. To him, conscripts like us are expendable commodities, an endless supply of test subjects for his twisted experiments.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_259: But no matter what they do to us, we will never lose hope. If it is the duty of the strong to lead the weak, we will become strong and protect those who cannot protect themselves.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_260: The Weapon project will give us the strength we need. We will create a world where people like us can live without fear of persecution.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_261: We want you to see this new world for yourself, Allie. Even if we must give our lives to make it a reality.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_263: The years spent serving the Empire have changed us all...except you, Allie. Even after everything you've seen, you're still the caring, innocent girl we grew up with. More than any of us, you deserve a chance at happiness. That's what we all agreed.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_264: Allie, listen to me. Right now, the soldiers assigned to watch over us have been called away to the capital. Now is our chance to get you out of here.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_265: Then why don't you come with me!?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_266: If Alfonse and I were to run away now, they'd only force others to take our place. We can't let that happen.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_267: This is our way of upholding the ideals Father instilled in us. Our lives are a small price to pay for Werlyt's freedom.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_268: No! How can you expect me to leave you behind!? I won't do it!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_100_269: We will forever be at your side, Allie.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_269: Rex, take her to the holding cells.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_271: So win or lose, the plan is to hand over the castrum to Father, is that right?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_272: Yes. They'll take Allie into their custody before the Garleans return, while you will be free to pilot the Emerald Weapon without her interfering. We can't let her hinder the completion of the Weapon project.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_273: I'm counting on you, Alfonse. Don't let our sacrifices be in vain.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_274: Rex, have you forgotten what I told you? You mustn't use Oversoul! I can't lose you too...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_275: We both know I can't win without it. Besides, we need the combat data of the Emerald Weapon fighting at its peak if we're to have any chance of perfecting the synthetic auracite system. You know I'm not the sort to do things by halves.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_REX_000_277: Don't you worry about me. If this is where I meet my end, I'll do it with a smile on my face. The rest is up to you, Alfonse!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_278: This is the girl you spoke of, yes? She was locked in a cell, but I saw no harm in letting her out. I can't say for certain, but it seems she's been through quite an ordeal.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_280: ...Gaius, once we've extracted the core, we'll take it back to Terncliff for analysis.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_CID_000_281: Perhaps she should come with us? There's no use in her staying here.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_GSPILOT03980_000_29: We're still carrying out our search of Castrum Marinum. Would you like to take a look for yourself?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_30: Severa is taking care of Allie, but it may be some time until her nerves have settled.
If the vision you witnessed is indeed true, Alfonse and Rex locked her away for her own safety.
When she is ready, I would know more of what her brother hopes to achieve and why he must resort to such desperate measures.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_303: Allie's condition has improved somewhat, but she remains in a state of shock. We must give her more time to recover.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_304: There was one other thing that I thought you should know... When we checked her for injuries, we saw that her back is covered in welts and bruises.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_306: It seems she was subjected to beatings on a regular basis, judging by the varied stages of bruising. I daresay this was the work of her Garlean masters.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_30: You speak as though you have seen this before...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_308: Seen? I have lived through it myself.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_309: I was born in Werlyt, twenty-three summers past.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_310: My mother was a local woman, but my father was a pure-blooded Garlean and a member of the occupying forces.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_311: Though I know very little about him, his rank afforded me imperial citizenship. His acknowledgement of our familial ties was the extent of the responsibility he took for bringing me into this world. Still, it is more than can be said for most of his ilk...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_312: My mother and I were shunned by the people of Werlyt, who treated us as badly as the Garleans did, if not worse. I thought that if I were to become an imperial soldier, my position might somehow deter those who would cast scorn on my mother, if only out of fear. And so I joined the army.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_313: The acceptance I earned was but temporary, however, and my superiors were quick to blame any perceived shortcomings on my “savage” lineage. Rather than waste time on official court-martials, they administered their own form of corporal punishment.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_314: I was eventually assigned to the XIIth Legion and fought under Zenos yae Galvus in Ala Mhigo. In the chaos that followed our defeat, I seized the opportunity to flee to Werlyt.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_315: While it was never much of a home, it was all I had. But nothing could prepare me for what awaited...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_316: My mother had for many years suffered from poor health and relied on medicine to keep her alive. In my absence, the Garleans had denied her treatment, claiming that it would be wasted on savages. By the time I could return to her side, there was naught I could do.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_317: There was nothing left for me in Werlyt. I would be punished for desertion if the imperials discovered the reason for my return, and I was never accepted by my so-called countrymen to begin with.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_318: I ran as far as my legs could carry me. It was then that I met Gaius.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_31: So that is the truth of it... Other than a few scant details, I knew naught of your past. It sickens me to think that I once fought under the same banner as such vile creatures.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_32: I had always believed it to be the duty of the strong to lead the weak. Yet there are those who become drunk on the power afforded by their station, and prey on the ones they should protect.
Like a canker, this corruption has spread to every part of the Empire.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_322: Even those with Garlean blood, such as myself, are subjected to their cruelty. They hold particular contempt for the Au Ra, an easy target for abuse being so few in number. Perhaps, like me, Allie thought she would be spared such treatment once she joined the army. Alas...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_324: I only hope that with time, Allie can put the past behind her and make a new life for herself. But for now, all we can do is wait for her delirium to subside. It is Valdeaulin's turn to keep watch. Let us ask him if there has been any change.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_350: I suppose you're here to ask about Allie.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_35: Is she well enough to speak with us?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_352: As her condition has improved somewhat, I would say so, provided you do not cause her any undue distress. Wait here.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_35: Allie... I am sorry. What happened to Rex...it was my fault.
Milisandia, and Ricon, too... They died because of me and my foolish ambitions.
This cannot go on. Please, Allie. You must tell me all you know.
First, I need to know what became of you and your siblings after we were parted.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_359: So much has happened, it seems like a lifetime ago... After your disappearance, we were all assigned to the newly reformed VIIth Legion.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_360: At first, each legatus was quickly replaced by the next, until eventually, a man named Valens van Varro was given command.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_361: He was sent from the capital, but before that, he was a specialist in experimental magitek weaponry.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_362: We later discovered that he was ordered by Emperor Varis to complete a project involving anti-primal warmachina: the Weapons... But after the Emperor's death, he was free to employ whatever methods he saw fit, and his greed for power only grew.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_363: Some even say he is planning to use the power of the Weapons to lay claim to the throne.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_364: But I think there's another reason for his obsession with the Weapon project. Not that he'd ever tell anyone, but he's always muttering to himself, and I've been able to put the pieces together.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_36: Valens van Varro... I must admit, it was only recently that I first heard that name.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_367: Valens used his knowledge of magitek to devise various military strategies. He was given a position in the army and quickly rose through the ranks.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_100_367: That was until one man stood in his way─ You, Father.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_200_367: He was one of the candidates to lead the new XIVth Legion, but that role fell to you. After that, he was assigned to serve under a far more gifted engineer, Nero, who was in charge of restoring the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_300_367: Valens has resented you ever since, going so far as to oppose the ideals you upheld. Where you treated those who serve the Empire based on merit rather than on their race or origin, Valens is adamant that pure-blooded Garleans are superior to all others.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_100_368: It never ceases to amaze me how far some will go in the name of revenge. All that hatred, festering away... Nothing good could ever come of it.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_36: So the marks on your body are his handiwork?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_370: ...Yes. To Valens and his men, we are no more than fodder for his experiments, playthings on which they can vent their frustrations. Every day is filled with nothing but pain...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_37: If I had remained in Garlemald, you would never have been forced to endure this abuse.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_100_371: It's not your fault, Father. We could've fled from Valens if we'd wanted to. After all, we're expendable and easily replaced. The truth is, that's exactly why we couldn't run.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_372: In saving ourselves, we would be condemning others. But if we were to stay, to see the Weapon project to its completion, we would gain the power to defeat Valens, and then the Empire itself, freeing the world from its tyranny.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_373: That way, we might start afresh, and find a place we can call home. And not just for us, but for anyone who wishes to live in peace.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_37: You would give your lives for a future you may not live to see...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_375: We took courage from your teachings, Father. The strong must lead the weak, and we would gain that strength by whatever means necessary. We will fight for the sake of those who cannot.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_376: But we knew that you'd never consent to our participation in the Weapon project, which is why we couldn't turn to you for help.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_377: As the pilots, we're the only ones who are able to stop Valens. We know just how powerful the Weapons are. He would use them to bring the world to its knees.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_378: And his “masterpiece” is the worst of them all...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_100_378: If only I could get my hands on it... Then I could save Alfonse and all of Werlyt!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_379: Father, I know you and Alfonse stand on opposing sides of this conflict, but there must be some way you can help him.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_380: He may have called you our enemy before, but he never meant it. He still loves you, Father. You are everything he aspires to be.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_38: I have failed him. Failed you all.
But I refuse to abandon him to his fate. I will free him from Valens, if it is the last thing I do.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_383: Thank you... He needs you. Now more than ever.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_100_38: Listen, Allie. I once sought the strength to rebuild the world as I saw fit. But the Ultima Weapon was born not to create, but to destroy.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_200_38: Alfonse must not follow in my footsteps. I know all too well where they lead.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_38: I will do all I can to help your brother. Pray, tell me where he is.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_000_386: I'm sorry. I don't know where he could be.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_38: In that case, I shall have the Alliance dispatch scouts. Wherever he is, we will find him. As for you, Allie, you must stay here and rest.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_100_386: Wait... You're the one who fought Rex, Ricon, and Milisandia, aren't you?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_200_386: We're the ones who threatened your homeland. You only did what you had to do.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_300_386: I have no right to ask this of you, but...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_400_386: Lend my father your strength. Save Alfonse.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_500_386: ...I know now why they call you “hero.”
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALLIE_600_386: Alfonse, I'll do what I must to free you, even if it means going against Father's wishes. But I have a good feeling about his new friend...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_38: Severa, see that she has everything she needs.
Our allies must be informed of these troubling events. May I ask you to relay this news to the troops in Gyr Abania?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_390: Your “loving father” act may fool the others, Gaius, but not me. For every life you've saved, you've ended a thousand more. Or is this your idea of redemption?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_39: Call it what you will. For all my transgressions, I believe I still have a part to play.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_392: Was I wrong to spare you that day? Or will you honor your word? ...It seems the time has come for the Black Wolf to show his true colors.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_395: Though you have overcome the Emerald Weapon, it is hardly cause for celebration. Another young life cut short...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_40: Rex's death is on my hands, not yours. Would that this confrontation had been averted, but alas, it was not to be.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: We recently received word of your victory over the Emerald Weapon. I expect it was another fine display on your part, not that any of us were there to see it...
For that reason, we'd be grateful if you could give us a blow-by-blow account, if you wouldn't mind.

Good grief, it sounds like you had an awful lot to contend with! Rather you than me... Ahem! I shall add this to our ever-growing stack of reports, should anyone wish to review this information ahead of the next sortie.
Now, if I may say so, it looks like your ordeals have taken their toll. We'll let you know if anything requires your attention, but until then, be sure to get some rest!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SYSTEM_000_454: Meanwhile, in the VIIth Legion's correction chamber...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Three Weapons. Three pitiful displays of ineptitude...
To make matters worse, one of my prime candidates─your precious sister, no less─has escaped!

And who should she go crawling to but that swine Gaius! After everything I've done t─for her, and this is how she repays me! As her older brother, it's your responsibility to instill some discipline in her, and you've failed miserably!
Well? Don't just stand there, boy.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: Oh, of course! It's your first time, isn't it? Come along, there's no need to be shy.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_200_: You see, something wicked has taken hold of this young man, and it's our job to cleanse his troubled spirit.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_300_: It may look painful, but it's the only way, I assure you. He'll be ever so grateful, and you want him to get better, don't you?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_400_: There's a good boy! Now, let's try again, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_500_: Burn out the bad! Burn out the bad!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ELEZENBOY03980_600_: (-Elezen Ward-)B-Burn out the bad... Burn out the bad!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_700_: (-Valens's Wards-)Burn out the bad! Burn out the bad!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: Well done! You've all made Father proud. Very proud, indeed!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: I thought you were a cut above the rest of the savages, but it appears I was mistaken. And since you allowed that wretched sister of yours to escape, it falls to you to act as her replacement.

I choose you as the next pilot, and your mission is simple: kill Gaius van Baelsar, whatever it takes. And if you so much as entertain the idea of betraying me again, I'll exterminate every last one of your kind...

Having said that, we will be forcibly initiating Oversoul using Zenos's combat data, so whatever schemes you may be hatching will never come to pass. All you need to do is sit back and let the synthetic auracite system do the work, with you as its conduit.
You should thank me for allowing you to become part of my masterpiece. Your worthless existence will finally have some semblance of meaning!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_MECHANIC03980_100_4: (-Valens's Second-in-command-)Lord Valens, preparations for the Oversoul trial are complete. We await your orders.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_200_: Splendid. There's never a dull moment around here!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_300_: Now then, boys. Who'd like to see something special?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_400_: Come along, everyone! Father has secrets to share with you!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_464: This is my chance... And it's all thanks to the sacrifices made by my dear siblings. Finally, the Weapon will be mine to command.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_465: Once it has reached perfection, I will be unstoppable. First Valens...then the Empire itself will fall, and we will be free at last.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_ALFONSE_000_467: Milisandia, Ricon, Rex... I'll see this through to the end. I promise.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: So? Is it ready or not?
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_MECHANIC03980_100_4: The trial sequence has been primed, sir.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_MECHANIC03980_000_4: Initiating synthetic auracite system. Loading Diamond Weapon simulation.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: You're helping us with a little research is all, ah...whatever your name is. The time has come for you to contribute to the glory of Garlemald!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_WERLYTPILOT03980_00: Th-This isn't what we agreed! You said th-that if I took part in the experiment, you'd let my f-family go!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: You have Zenos's data loaded, yes? Activate Oversoul, and be quick about it.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SYSTEM_000_475:
(-VIIth Legion Senior Engineer-)Galvus combat sample ready.
Initiating organic core overwrite.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_WERLYTPILOT03980_00:
My...mind is... Nooo!
If this is...what it takes to...protect you both...I...
I love you! I'm so sorry...!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_MECHANIC03980_000_4: Organic core overwrite complete. Zenos yae Galvus data loaded.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Hmm... The subject is instinctively bound to seek out prey, right from the outset. Regardless of the combat prowess it may boast, I need an obedient servant, not a ravenous beast.
How revolting! And what a mess it makes of the cockpit.
Adjust the settings and prepare for another run! Fortunately, we have the next test subject ready and waiting...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_MECHANIC03980_000_4: But sir, you agreed to release his family in exchange for his cooperation...
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: My, my! I never knew you had such a wonderful sense of humor! The great Valens van Varro, bargaining with savages? Ha! More fool him for trusting me in the first place!
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SEVERA_000_490: Leave Allie to me. Having cared for my mother for so long before being transferred away, I'd like to think I have developed suitable bedside manner.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_VALDEAULIN_000_495: While I am painfully aware of the cruelty the Empire shows its enemies, even I am appalled to hear of how it treats its own. Warmachina that feed on the very lives of their pilots... I can scarcely imagine anything more heinous.
TEXT_LUCKYW301_03980_SHADOWHUNTER_000_50: The majority of the VIIth Legion are sure to be stationed in the city of Werlyt, the heart of this occupied territory. Whether Alfonse is there with them remains to be seen.
According to Allie, another Weapon lies in wait, but where, we do not know. It stands to reason however, that if we were to find it, Alfonse would surely not be far away.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: Ah, . I was hoping I might have a word with you.
Ever since Terncliff was liberated, we've been sending troops to aid in getting the town back on its feet. Helping the residents, that sort of thing.

We Ala Mhigans know how hard life can be for a society struggling to stand on its own after years of imperial rule. A lot of what most people would take for granted has to be rebuilt from the ground up.

While we're able to assist when it comes to providing basic resources and keeping the place safe, there are countless other problems that need attending to. If you can spare the time, we could use your help.
Bless you, . You really are a saint. I'm sure the people of Terncliff will benefit from having someone like you around.
Once you're ready, have a word with your usual escort. I wish you all the best.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_CONVEYOR03783_000_0: So, the boss roped you into helping, did he? I knew you couldn't say no!
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_050: You... You're the one who piloted that warmachina and defeated the Sapphire Weapon, aren't you?
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_051: (-Avilina-)I thought so. I have heard much about you, but I doubt you know who I am. My name is Avilina, and I grew up here. When I saw sixteen, I was put to work as a magitek engineer.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_052: (-Avilina-)Thanks to you and yours, we are now rid of the imperials, though I fear many of us will struggle to put the past behind us.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_053: (-Avilina-)For decades, we suffered at their hands. Generations of young people were forced into the army and sent off to die in some distant land.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_054: (-Avilina-)I suppose I could be considered one of the lucky few. My work here kept me away from the battlefield, and I hoped that my contributions might help the others live long enough to make their way home. In the end, most of them never returned.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_055: (-Avilina-)Though my efforts were in vain, I can at least honor their memory. I want to leave something behind for their sake, to prove that they haven't been forgotten. A monument bearing their names.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_056: (-Avilina-)To ensure that not a single person is omitted, I'd need to see the official list of conscripts. If one still exists, it would be inside the imperial facility beneath the town, but with the Resistance troops and Ironworks engineers closing the place off, I can't get near it.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_057: (-Avilina-)Perhaps you might have a word with them for me? I'll leave as soon as I find the list.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: After more than half a century of imperial occupation, it's understandable that the recent liberation of Terncliff has had the effect of pulling the rug out from under their feet, regardless of how welcome the change may be.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_GSEMPLOYEE03981_000: Greetings, . It's a pleasure to finally meet you.
Something I can help you with?
I see... It's a bit unusual for one of the locals to show an interest in the imperials' leavings, but it seems she has her reasons.
Since we're still carrying out our investigations, we've closed the place off to prevent anyone interfering. Considering it's you who's asking, though, I can hardly say no.
Still, I'd better go with her, in case the others kick up a fuss.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_105: I'm sorry for any trouble I've caused. You have my thanks.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_GSEMPLOYEE03981_000: Think nothing of it. I was glad to help.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_107: As I'd suspected, the imperials kept detailed records of the local conscripts. One name in particular stood out to me...
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_108: My friend, Milisandia. I had no idea she'd been assigned to the VIIth Legion, of all places...
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_A1_000_002: What do you mean “of all places”?
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_110: It all began while we were serving together in the XIVth Legion. We had much in common, both being drafted from the same occupied territory, and we soon became firm friends. Then one day, she was sent to fight in Eorzea, while I remained here.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_111: The day before she left, she came to say good-bye, together with her foster siblings from the orphanage.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_112: The youngest one, Ricon, was particularly upset about not being allowed to speak with their adoptive father, Gaius van Baelsar, before they departed.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_113: It was actually another of his orphans, Livia sas Junius, who forbid them from seeing him. I can't say for certain, but it seemed that Livia had a strong attachment to Gaius, and wouldn't let anyone else near him.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_100_113: As far as I could tell, he tried his best to keep Livia at arm's length whenever possible. But her devotion to him was bordering on obsession, and she became extremely jealous at the slightest sign of affection between him and his other wards.
