TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_114: Others, however, treated them far more kindly. In fact, a praefectus castrorum of the XIVth Legion came specifically to meet them.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_115: While I was surprised that a Roegadyn had risen to such a rank, I was even more taken aback by the unguarded manner in which he spoke with his subordinates. I had hoped that with people like him serving on the Eorzean front, they would be in safe hands.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_116: Then, the time came for Milisandia to leave. We shared a few final words, and then she was gone. It would be the last I ever saw of her...
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_117: After that, I was assigned to the tribunus laticlavius of the XIVth, Nero tol Scaeva, and I worked on restoring the Ultima Weapon. I was even at the Praetorium on the day it was destroyed, but I escaped aboard an imperial ship moments before it came crashing down.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_118: I eventually made my way back to Werlyt, only to be drafted into the VIIth Legion to continue working on the Weapon project.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_119: ...Even now, it makes me sick to my stomach to think I'd helped bring those abominations into the world.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_120: Using a living pilot to feed the Weapon's core was part of the design from the very beginning. Of course, they'd never dream of subjecting a trueborn Garlean to such barbaric treatment. Not when the VIIth Legion has a ready supply of provincial conscripts ripe for the taking.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_121: The pilots were referred to only by their code names, and we engineers were not made privy to their true identities. Even with this list of conscripts, I still don't know who was sacrificed in the name of the Weapon project.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_A2_000_001: Your skills and knowledge can finally be put to good use.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_A2_000_002: Let's bring an end to the Weapon project. Together.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_123: But what can I do? For years, all I've known is how to build tools of destruction.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_124: The VIIth Legion is far from finished. They're biding their time, waiting until the right moment to unleash the final Weapon.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_125: And when they do, it will bring naught but death and woe to all who stand in their way. Even after everything they've taken from us, they still want more...
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_126: If it weren't for the Empire, Milisandia would still be here... She was the kindest person I ever met, but to the Empire, she was just another pawn in their games. I will never forget her.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_127: There's a way I can make a difference. I know there is.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_128: But first, I need to speak with members of the Ironworks.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_129: I've a feeling that warmachina you used to beat the Sapphire Weapon will be called into action again. Until then, there's still time to make improvements, and I intend to help.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_130: I'll still be going ahead with the plan to build a monument, but stopping the Empire must come first. I hope Milisandia and the others can wait a little longer...
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_131: Before I go, allow me to express my gratitude. I don't know what I'd have done if it weren't for you. Until we meet again.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_AVILINA_000_135: I'll let you do the talking, if that's all right.
TEXT_LUCKYW311_03981_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: So, how was your time in Terncliff?
I see... Fate has dealt her a cruel hand, but now she has a chance to make a fresh start. The same could be said of the whole of Terncliff.
It seems the liberation of that one small town will become a pivotal moment in Werlyt's history. Perhaps it won't be too long before the rest of the region is free from the Empire.
Naturally, we'd be honored to fight alongside the people of Werlyt. We won't rest until the imperials are sent fleeing with their tails between their legs.
Until that day arrives, we'll carry on doing our bit to support you and the others in ending the Weapon project. I'll be sure to pass on any pertinent information. In the meantime, take care.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_001: Here to see me? I appreciate it, but...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_002: I'm afraid I don't have much to tell you. There's still no sign of Anogg, and the villagers are...well, you know how they are.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_003: Can't blame them, really. 2P used us─she said as much─but we were the ones who allowed ourselves to be manipulated. I keep thinking about what we might have done differently...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A1_000_001: It serves no one to dwell on what could have been.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A1_000_002: You can't change what you've done, but you can change what you do now.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_005: You're right. I have to fix this, somehow. Or at least try.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERC03954_000_: What are you lazing about here for, Konogg? Where's Anogg?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERA03954_000_: She's still up to no good, I bet! And run off before we could make her own up to it!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERG03954_100_: Go on. Explain to us where exactly Anogg is.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERG03954_000_: Because I'll tell you where my wife is... She's at death's door because of the injuries she suffered in the attack!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERG03954_100_: Even if she wakes, she may never make a full recovery...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERG03954_000_: So if you know what's good for you, you'll get out of this village before I do something we'll both regret.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_SYSTEM_000_015: Konogg seems in dire need of comfort.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_SYSTEM_000_051: Konogg is openly weeping. Someone ought to comfort him.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_053: I wish I could do something to help...for that man and his wife, especially.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_054: But I don't know either of them well, and I doubt anyone is willing to talk to me now...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A2_000_002: I'll see what I can do. But you owe me─double if anyone punches me in the face.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_057: With a bit of luck, they'll open up to you. If there's anything I can do to make things better, anything at all...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_058: In the meantime, I'll find another way to make myself useful. It's not as if there's a shortage of rubble that needs clearing around here.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_060: I'm sure I can be of some use...somehow...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERB03954_000_: Look who it is. I hope you're not up to more mischief with Anogg and Konogg.
A woman with severe injuries and an angry husband... Yes, I know who you mean.

I doubt there's much to be done, but I won't stop you from trying. Those two have always been inseparable─I don't think I've ever seen them not holding hands. Can't imagine how he's feeling, now that she's in such a state.
You're friends with the poor dears, aren't you?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERD03954_000_: The very best of friends. And how I long for those days we drank away, without a care in the world! She always loved the mead...we all did...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERB03954_000_: Perhaps someday we'll be able to go back to the way things used to be.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERD03954_000_: No...I'll never have that kind of peace of mind again.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_150: They talked to you? And no one got violent?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_151: Mead? I suppose we are dwarves, so maybe it's not such a terrible idea. <sigh> But as far as I know, none of our stores survived the attack.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A3_000_001: Down the cliff we go, then.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A3_000_002: We can buy more in Stilltide.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_153: Oh! If there's some available for purchase, I'd happily spend the coin. Can you show me the way?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A4_000_002: It's too dangerous for you out there.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_155: No! No, I insist. I've accompanied you to much more dangerous places before, and I assure you I won't be a burden. And...I need to do this.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_156: I still have a few things to tidy away before I leave, so I'll meet you at the bridge in a bit.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_200: There you are! Now, if you'll show me the way?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_201: Ah, the Ladder! I've never used it before. This will be an adventure!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_250: The view is different outside of the village. Maybe I can find the perspective I need.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_300: It's massive! How in the world did you get this moving?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A5_000_001: With a great deal of help.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A5_000_002: I don't quite understand it myself. Luckily, I have people for that.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_302: Well, go on! Tell me all about it!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_303: I had no idea all of that happened in Eulmore! And the Talos...marvelous!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_304: I wish I had your ability to bring out the best in people. Maybe then Komra wouldn't be...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_305: Never mind. I thank you for your enlightening tale. And now...we descend!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_350: Far be it from me to complain after having insisted upon accompanying you, but...are we there yet?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_400: Deep breaths, Konogg. Just act natural. Confident. You can do this. ...Yaaah!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_403: L-Lali-ho! I would like some mead! Please! Ma'am!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_THEVA_000_404: Well, I can't say no to one who asks so nicely...and any friend of 's is welcome here. I'll bring out our finest.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_405: Did you see? I did it! Ah, it feels so good to be working toward a goal again...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_407: Thank you, ma'am! I think this should be sufficient payment...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_408: Let's hurry back. As exhilarating as this adventure has been, I want to make a gift of the mead right away.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_450: Would you like to come with me? When I deliver the mead, I mean.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A6_000_001: Someone has to look out for you.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_452: I appreciate it. I admit that I'm a bit nervous... But this is my chance to help, if only in a small way, so I have to take it.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_500: Excuse us! We, um...we wanted to offer our best wishes. And...my sincere apology, as well.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_501: I know it doesn't come close to making up for what you've been through, but I brought you this. I thought that maybe you could share it...later...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_VILLAGERG03954_000_: Go away. We don't want anything from you.
All I want is for you to sod off so that me and my wife never have to see you again!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_SYSTEM_000_507: Konogg sounded to be in considerable distress. You had best follow him lest he come to harm.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_SYSTEM_000_550: The bottle of mead that Konogg had so earnestly wished would cheer the unfortunate couple now lies forlorn.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_DWARFMASTER03671_00: (-???-)Lali-we've got another situation in our beards-ho!

Konogg just ran right past me toward the crater. I don't know about you, but I'd really rather not have him there by himself─especially not when he's so upset. I could hear the sobs from yalms away...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A7_000_002: The villagers still blame him for all of it...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Hmm... It's a tragic state of affairs all around.
The man you met─his wife was with child before her injury. Can't blame him for lashing out, given the circumstances.
But that doesn't mean Konogg deserves to take the brunt of it all.
I'd consider it a personal favor if you'd find him and tell him so. ...Another personal favor, at any rate.
He's not the most athletic dwarf I've ever met, so with any luck he won't have gotten far while we've been talking.
I'll go and have a word with certain folks in the village. See if we can't repair some of the damage that's been done.
I've never seen Konogg so worked up. I hope he's all right...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_SYSTEM_000_600: You find no sign of the dwarf you seek─a state of affairs that you are becoming all too familiar with.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_SYSTEM_000_650: You've still to see so much as a wisp of beard disappearing round the corner. Konogg must be further down.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_ANOGG_000_702: Don't run off, Konogg! It's dangerous. Let your big sister take the lead.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_100_705: A-Anogg? Anogg! Are you down there? I'm coming!
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A8_000_001: That thing from the orb can't be Anogg. I'm sorry.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A8_000_002: Konogg... I think Anogg may be...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_714: How do you know? How did you even know about back when she─
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_715: Never mind. It doesn't matter. Anogg is what matters. Anogg, she...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A9_000_001: I know. But you can't stay here.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A9_000_002: Let's go home and take some time to think, all right?
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_KONOGG_000_755: I just...need to be by myself for a while.
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A10_000_001: I'm afraid something has happened to Anogg...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_A10_000_002: I don't know what I saw, but...
TEXT_LUCKTA401_03998_DWARFMASTER03671_00: ...She fell from a cliff, you say? And then when she reappeared from this “orb” there wasn't a scratch on her?
I admit that sounds bad. But I found those two in these very tunnels myself, years ago.
They were a pair of troublemakers since the start, and they've always been a little strange, to be sure. They have good hearts, though─both of them.
Anogg's too headstrong to let a little tumble keep her down. And I'm certain she'll be back with us before you know it.

As for the orb...I haven't the slightest idea, so don't you go prodding it. And keep it quiet for now. We may not be able to keep Konogg from dashing off again later, but we can preserve the peace for now.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: I wasn't expecting to see you here, considering all that's been happening about Eorzea of late. Still, if you've a mind to assist us, we'd like to share the latest developments in Werlyt.
You've come at the right time. There've been some developments in Werlyt we'd like to share with you.
And as luck would have it, here comes the ideal person to explain the situation.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_005: (-???-)I'm glad to see you looking so well, .
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_007: Yes, it certainly has! I haven't seen you around Rhalgr's Reach much lately. Anyone would think you're trying to avoid me...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_008: That attention-seeking imbecile who stinks of gunpowder?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_009: Hmph! Of all the people to be mistaken for! Even as a joke, that stings, you know!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_010: Oh, just on a few dozen occasions. Perhaps you're suffering from amnesia? If so, I hear there's no better remedy than a quick smack to the head...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_011: But as much as I'd love to stand around chatting, I'm afraid I've got some serious business to discuss.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_012: Following the liberation of Terncliff, it seems the people of Werlyt also have their hearts set on freeing themselves from the grip of the Empire.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_013: Like-minded citizens have rallied under the banner of the Werlyt Revolutionaries, and they aim to depose the VIIth Legion that currently occupies the city.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_014: Their ranks include many former conscripts, and between them, they possess no small amount of combat experience. The only thing they lack is someone to lead them.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_015: After much consideration, they decided to turn to none other than Gaius Baelsar. Of course, many would balk at the thought of turning to a former enemy─and many did─but desperate times call for desperate measures.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_016: His reputation as a legatus speaks for itself, and as most Ala Mhigans will attest, he was a far more reasonable and pragmatic leader than his predecessor the mad king Theodoric, or his successor Zenos, for that matter.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_100_016: But most importantly, he was the one who led the invasion of Werlyt in the first place, so who better than him to take it back? After accepting their offer, he requested the delivery of additional arms and provisions from the Ala Mhigan Resistance.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_017: We've got our hands full dealing with the Telophoroi, as do the rest of our allies in Eorzea, but we'll do what we can.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_018: While my comrades see to the preparations, I've been assigned to meet with him in person.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_019: Not that we have much to spare at present, but we'll do what we can. While my comrades see to the preparations, I've been assigned to meet with him in person.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_020: I was wondering...could you accompany me to Terncliff?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_021: Thanks, ! To be perfectly honest, coming face-to-face with the Black Wolf is a rather daunting prospect, even if he has supposedly turned over a new leaf. But I'm sure having you there will make a world of difference!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_022: I believe you're acquainted with our escort, yes? Let him know when you're ready to get going.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CONVEYOR03783_000_0: Another trip to Terncliff, is it?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_051: I come bearing the Ala Mhigan Resistance's official reply to your request for aid.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: I see... You have my thanks.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_HIGHOFFICIAL3783_00: Does this mean we can finally make our move?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: With the assistance of the Ala Mhigans, we will soon have sufficient arms at our disposal to stand a chance at victory. But lest we forget, the VIIth Legion has been conserving its strength thus far, and we must be prepared for severe casualties should its full might be brought to bear.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SOLDIER3783_000_055: If our lives must be the price of freedom, we will pay it willingly.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_056: Let me be clear. We Ala Mhigans have not forgotten that it was you who led the invasion of our homeland. The blood of our fallen loved ones is on your hands.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_057: Even so, the people of Werlyt chose you to lead the revolution, and we will honor their decision. I only hope they will not come to regret it.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_100_05: Should I be found unworthy of their trust, I shall submit to their judgment and whatever that may entail.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_HIGHOFFICIAL3783_00: Forgive me, but might we return to the task at hand? First, I would like to discuss the transportation of supplies from Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: Once again, I prepare to lead an army into Werlyt. The irony is not lost on me.
It is a cruel twist of fate that these people─so desperate from years of oppression─should turn to their conqueror for salvation.
For most of my life, I believed that only the Empire possessed the strength and wisdom to lead mankind. That only through great sacrifice could civilization hope to thrive.

And so I led the conquest of Eorzea, forcing the doctrine of Garlemald upon the “ignorant and uncivilized.” In every territory, I sought out those with the potential for greatness, without regard for one's birth or circumstances, that they may serve the Empire.

But there are those such as Valens who see being born Garlean a virtue in itself, one above all others. To think that a monster such as him should be granted the position of legatus and everything that entails... It makes my blood boil.
Valens brings shame upon our homeland, and makes mock of the ideals it once stood for. By my hand, he shall pay for his foul crimes.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_067: We are running out of time, Gaius. We have to go after her!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: There is something I would show you, but not here. Come with me.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MNAAGO_000_070: I know it's an important mission and all, but it's been so long since I've traveled outside of Gyr Abania, a change of scene will do me good. As long as I try not to think about Gaius Baelsar along the way, I'm sure it'll be a pleasant journey.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CONVEYOR03783_000_0: We'll all be praying for your safe return, although I expect you'll be perfectly fine even without divine intervention!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_HIGHOFFICIAL3783_00: Many of my comrades were dead against having Gaius Baelsar of all people lead the charge, but as I always say, “If you want a job done properly, hire a professional.” After all, he's already conquered Werlyt once, so I'm certain he'll be just as successful a second time!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SOLDIER3783_000_085: It's been a long time coming, but finally, Werlyt will throw off the shackles of imperial rule!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CONVEYOR03783_000_0: On your way back to Terncliff, eh?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_10: You must keep this to yourself. I do not want the soldiers to think I am being distracted by personal matters.
This letter was found in her room.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_105:
(-Allie's Letter-)Dear Father,
I am sorry for leaving without saying good-bye, but the thought of Alfonse suffering alone is more than I can bear.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_106: (-Allie's Letter-)For his sake, and for the freedom of Werlyt, I have decided to take matters into my own hands.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_107: (-Allie's Letter-)I know of a way to save them, a way to end it all. I have to seize this chance before it is too late. My mind is set. Please, do not try to stop me, Father.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_108:
(-Allie's Letter-)The days we spent together were the happiest of my life, and no matter what happens, nothing can take that away from me.
With all my love,
Allie
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_10: She is heading for the VIIth Legion's stronghold in Werlyt. I am certain of it.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_110: Taking matters into her own hands...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_111: She must be planning to take control of one of the Weapons.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_112: If so, there's no time to waste! We have to mobilize our forces and save Allie and Alfonse!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_11: I want nothing more than to save them, but I cannot ask the Werlyt Revolutionaries to risk their lives to rescue two imperial soldiers.
In any case, if we were to rush into battle without adequate preparation, the VIIth Legion would tear our partisan army to shreds.
And as capable a warrior as  is, if  were to charge headlong into the heart of the enemy,  would be overwhelmed by sheer numbers.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_116: But if we don't do something, Allie and Alfonse are as good as dead!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_11: I know, Severa. And so did Allie when she wrote that letter. Returning alive was never part of her plan.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALDEAULIN_000_118: (-Valdeaulin-)Can you hear me? I'm in Werlyt, just outside Castrum Collinum. All hells have broken loose!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALDEAULIN_000_119: (-Valdeaulin-)There was an enormous explosion, and through the smoke and flames, I saw what appeared to be another Weapon! At this rate, the entire─<KRRRZZZT>
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_12: Confound it─we have lost the signal.
This must be what Allie spoke of in her letter...a way to end it all.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_100_12: Alfonse and the others were planning this from the beginning.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_200_12: To bring the Weapon project to completion and use it to free Werlyt from the Empire, even at the cost of their own lives.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_200_121: If the Revolutionaries were to hear that a Weapon has been unleashed upon the imperial headquarters, they would see it as the perfect opportunity to strike.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_300_121: If it's running amok, it may not distinguish between our allies and the imperials. A large force would draw too much attention, but the three of us should be able to get close enough without it noticing us!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_A2_000_002: Between us, we'll find a way to save them!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_12: I cannot allow it. This is my burden to bear, and I shall bear it alone.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_A3_000_001: Rest assured, I have every intention of making it out alive.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_A3_000_002: I'll have you know my record for surviving dangerous missions is impeccable. So far.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_12: For the time being, I will have the Revolutionaries stand by and await my signal. An opportunity to reclaim Werlyt may yet present itself, but we must first be allowed to remove the threat of this new Weapon.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_100_12: Severa, have Cid ready the G-Warrior.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_12: Once your preparations are complete, let us reconvene outside the hangar.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SYSTEM_000_129: Some time earlier, in the VIIth Legion's Werlyt headquarters...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: How wonderful it is to see you again, my dear! I was beginning to think that you weren't coming back.
In my impatience, I may have vented my frustrations on that brother of yours. I do hope you'll forgive me...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_132: Lord Valens, you mentioned before that the previous Weapons were merely prototypes used to gather combat data within their cores.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Yes, very good! I see you were paying attention after all!
Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald... The primals they absorbed and the data they accumulated will serve a singular purpose...
...the completion of my masterpiece, the Diamond Weapon!
But while you and your siblings were able to retrieve the necessary data from the Ruby Weapon before Gaius and his lackeys arrived...
...Sapphire and Emerald were handed to the enemy on a silver platter! Those worthless curs failed to meet even my exceedingly low expectations!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_138: As detailed in my report, I took it upon myself to infiltrate Gaius Baelsar's band of rebels and reclaim the data.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Yes, you have done well, my dear. My engineers have already finished feeding it to the Diamond Weapon.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_140: Then all that remains is for me to assume my role as its pilot, and for you to release my brother and the rest of our compatriots, as per our agreement.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Of course, of course! A handful of savages is a small price to pay for your remarkable talents.

Even though the Weapon project's revolutionary technology allows even an untrained pilot to fight with the skills of a veteran soldier, only the truly gifted can draw out the full potential of the synthetic auracite.

In addition to their physical attributes and combat prowess, I require unwavering loyalty before I can even consider entrusting a candidate with one of my creations. And you...are everything I desire.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_144: I am honored that you regard me so highly, Lord Valens. However, in return for my continued cooperation, I wish to propose an extra condition to our arrangement.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_145: I request that the people of Werlyt be given full imperial citizenship and the right to self-govern.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: My, my! How very bold of you. And quite astute, at that. Yes, I could grant the people of Werlyt citizenship, if I so desired. Unfortunately, a mere legatus such as myself is in no position to simply relinquish control of imperial territory on a whim.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_147: Come now. We both know that the Weapons are but a means to an end.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_148: Your true intent is to march on the capital and claim it for yourself, correct?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_149: Once you have taken the throne, one small territory would seem a fair reward for those who played a vital role in the ascension of Emperor Valens.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Heh... Hehehehehe...
I say! For someone so sweet and innocent, you certainly drive a hard bargain! Very well, if it's Werlyt you want, it's yours! I'll soon have no need for this stinking backwater province anyway!
Ah yes, Allwick. Or was it Alfred? Whatever his name is, you needn't worry. I've made special arrangements for him.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: He'll be perfectly safe...provided you uphold your side of the agreement.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Excellent! Now, let's get you aboard the Diamond Weapon, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: Ah... One step closer to my coronation!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_200_154: This is the moment I've been waiting for!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_300_154: ...I know this isn't what Father would've wanted, but it's the only way. Please, forgive me.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_155:
Initiating the synthetic auracite system. All sensors activated.
...So far, so good.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_100_155: Diamond Weapon, code name “Zenos.” Commencing activation sequence.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Behold perfection itself!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_157: Milisandia, Ricon, and Rex gave their lives...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_159: Nnngh... The auracite is taking hold...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_160: I'm just glad that you didn't have to go through this, Alfonse... But you'll have to go on without me. You and Father still must work together to─ Aaagh!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_161: ...I'm sorry I can't be there at your side. This is...the only way!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: What's that, my dear? Is something the matter?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_162: The Diamond Weapon is mine! Your tyranny ends here, Valens!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Lowborn filth! If you think your little performance had me fooled, you are sorely mistaken!
What are you waiting for!? Shut it down!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MECHANIC04031_000_1: Y-Yes, my lord! Transmitting deactivation signal!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Ha...hahahaha! That insolent whelp had me worried for a moment!
Bring her to me alive, even if it means damaging the machine! When I am through with her, she will beg for death...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_169: No...I can't let it end like this! Milisandia, Ricon, Rex, guide my hand!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALLIE_000_170: Alfonse...wherever you are, lend me your strength!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SYSTEM_000_171:
(-Synthetic Auracite System-)BZZZT... Combat sample...BZZZT...ready.
Initiating Overmind... Subject name: BZZZT...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_MECHANIC04031_000_1: This can't be! It's ignoring the shutdown signal and initiating Overmind! But how!?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: I don't care how! Stop that thing before it brings down the whole castrum!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_180: Why did Allie have to keep this all a secret? We could have helped her!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AIRMAN04031_000_200: Ready to depart? I'll send for Master Garlond.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_201: We all expected another Weapon to appear sooner or later, but not quite like this.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_20: According to Valdeaulin, after it finished laying waste to the headquarters of the VIIth Legion, it took to the sky.

Though this has dealt a massive blow to the imperial forces, I am certain that Allie is on board the Weapon. It must be halted before she comes to harm, and for that, I need the G-Warrior and airships to transport it.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_204: I see that one thing hasn't changed since your days as the Black Wolf: your penchant for gigantic warmachina.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_205: But if this means the G-Warrior has another chance to shine, I'd be happy to oblige. Only this time, rather than having it unceremoniously towed by airships, I have a more dynamic entrance in mind.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AVILINA_100_205: It's good to see you again, .
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_200_205: From what I hear, we have you to thank for Avilina volunteering to help the Ironworks. Since she joined the team, our work has come on leaps and bounds.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AVILINA_300_205: I'm just grateful for the opportunity to finally put my knowledge and skills to good use.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AVILINA_400_205: And as far as I can tell, your target is the Diamond Weapon, the most powerful of them all.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AVILINA_500_205: What's worse, its design incorporates all of the combat data and abilities of the other Weapons, making it far more formidable than those you encountered before.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AVILINA_600_205: Thankfully, we've had time to prepare for such an occasion.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_800_205: Let me put it like this...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_900_205: Thanks to Avilina's tireless dedication, the G-Warrior has been reborn!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_206: But there'll be time to explain more on the way. Come on, the Enterprise is waiting.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_20: Very impressive, but may I ask what purpose it serves?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_208: Since our objective is to rescue the pilot, we've added a means of capturing the Diamond Weapon.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_209: We come to save lives, not to end them, and for that reason, the G-Warrior has been reborn. I present to you the G-Savior!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_23: I was unable to save Milisandia, Ricon, and Rex, but there may yet be hope for Allie and Alfonse...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_231: Were it not for you, I suspect Gaius would have ventured into Werlyt by himself, with little more than a gunblade for protection. Thank you for persuading him to take a less rash course of action.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AIRMAN04031_100_200: Ready to take to the skies?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_GSEMPLOYEE04031_200: Master Garlond and the others are ready when you are!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_25: Once again, Cid and his engineers have provided precisely what we require before we even knew it ourselves.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_251: Due to the added complexity, we'll have Gaius pilot while  handles the various armaments.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_25: There will be little opportunity for us to grow accustomed to our roles, but even so, we must succeed at all costs.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_CID_000_255: I'll be monitoring the situation from the Enterprise. Should things take a turn for the worse, I'll be ready to intervene.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_256: While you and Gaius deal with the Diamond Weapon, I'll be doing my best to aid Valdeaulin's safe return from Werlyt. Hopefully, he's taken advantage of the chaos to make good his escape.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_AVILINA_000_257: You're off to save Milisandia's foster siblings, Alfonse and Allie, aren't you? Please, do whatever you can to bring them back safely.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_30: It seems the controls are the same as the previous iteration. Though it has been some time since I last piloted warmachina of Allagan origin, lack of practice is no excuse for failure.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_35: We must reach the Diamond Weapon before the imperials.

In all the years since the invasion, this place has hardly changed. I was expecting to find some sign of the VIIth Legion here, but it would appear the Diamond Weapon has already taken them out of the equation.
I pray we are not too late.
Please, take her back to Terncliff. I have some unfinished business to attend to...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_100_35: Now to learn what has become of Alfonse.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_35: If you have a score to settle, now is your chance. Show yourself!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Come to gloat, have you, Gaius!? It's not over yet...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_35: You certainly have an instinct for self-preservation. I would expect nothing less from the coward who sacrificed his own soldiers to further his ambitions.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: How dare you speak to me of ambitions! You are the one who stood in my way at every turn!
If not for your meddling, the Empire would've been mine! Mine!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_36: Enough of your delusions of grandeur. Where is Alfonse?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Heh...
Why, he's right in front of you!
Once you hear the answer, you'll kick yourself for not realizing it sooner!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: You see, in all of the previous models, the combat data was either incomplete or unstable in some way, making their performance in battle wildly unpredictable. But then an idea struck me.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Rather than using data gathered in battle, I should use something a little more...realistic.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: It turns out that beloved boy of yours was quite brilliant...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_200_: ...when he put his mind to it!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: By my ingenuity, he has been reborn as the core of the greatest machine ever devised! None but the great Lord Valens van Varro could conceive such a marvel!

And to think that Allie came here to steal the Diamond Weapon to save her brother, only to find he'd already become a part of it! Perhaps it wasn't the reunion she'd envisioned, but I'm sure she was grateful nonetheless!
Oh... That might also explain why Overmind activated all by itself. It was clearly an attempt to protect his precious sister! A fascinating anomaly, but I can't stand disobedience!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_37: That such atrocities should continue unabated is proof of the rot that has spread throughout the Empire.
Your crimes are an affront not only to Garlemald, but to all of mankind. And now...you will die.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: Have you forgotten, Gaius? I've seen your data, I know your every move! Such pitiful swordsmanship is a relic of the past, just like you!
Gaaargh!
B-But...this wasn't in...my data!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_100_: Th-This can't be...! How is it still functional!?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_400_: Agh! Stop this at once...! Please! Let me go... Albert... No, Apharmd! W-Wait, no! No!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_500_37: Even the names of those sacrificed in your twisted experiments are beneath your notice. You are beyond redemption.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_600_: Who are you to judge me, Gaius!? Do you remember the names of the tens of thousands of men, women, and children killed for the sake of your conquests?
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_600_37: I do not deny the blood spilled at my behest. Nor will I run from my past.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_700_37: That is why I fight. To prevent the wrongs I committed from being repeated.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_900_: Y-You can't do this to me! I'm V-Valens van Varro! Better th-than Gaius, better than all of them!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALENSVANVARRO_000_: It c-can't end this way!
Aaannngh!
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SHADOWHUNTER_000_38: Alfonse, my son... I have failed you.
But this is not the end. I will see your dreams fulfilled. This I swear. I ask only that you, Milisandia, Ricon, and Rex watch over me.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALFONSE_100_383: (-Overmind Alfonse-)Father... The memories stored in the Diamond Weapon... Give them to Allie...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALFONSE_000_383:
(-Overmind Alfonse-)Watch over her...in my stead.
Father...I cannot go on like this... Please...
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_ALFONSE_000_385: Thank you. I am proud to call myself your son.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_400: ...I see. We will remain here until further notice.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_401: That was Gaius. Valens van Varro and the Weapon project are no more.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALDEAULIN_000_402: Seizing the opportunity, the Werlyt Revolutionaries have taken control of the city. Though they still suffered considerable losses, they have at last gained their freedom.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_SEVERA_000_403: And even with the Empire gone, for people like me, life under imperial rule is all we've ever known. We might never be able to heal the scars left by decades of oppression.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALDEAULIN_000_404: While there is hope for those who have survived this ordeal, nothing can bring back the dead. The loss of my wife and daughter left a void in me that can never be filled.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALDEAULIN_000_405: In the years since, I have struggled to find a purpose, a reason to keep on living. It is the same for Gaius. No matter how hard he tries to make amends, the children he lost are gone forever.
TEXT_LUCKYW401_04031_VALDEAULIN_000_410: It's been some time since we last heard from Gaius.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_001: The recent events in Werlyt have had a profound impact on the lives of many, many people, but none more so than Allie. She's been in a state of shock ever since she returned. We've even called in Cid to see if he can ascertain what the problem might be.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_002: You see, there's a strong possibility that the Diamond Weapon itself is what's caused Allie to close herself off like this. But for the time being, all we can do is wait.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_003: Ah, there was one other thing. Avilina came by looking for you earlier, so perhaps you could go and see her?
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_005: I can see how heavily the burden weighs on him, just as it does on me. In truth, it never gets any lighter. We can only hope to grow strong enough to bear it.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CONVEYOR03783_000_0: If you're making your way to Terncliff, allow me to escort you.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_AVILINA_000_010: Thank you for coming to meet me. I'm glad to see you're none the worse for your experiences.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_AVILINA_000_011: Actually, I've been meaning to show you this.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_AVILINA_000_012: Thanks to the Ala Mhigan Resistance, the monument to the fallen is complete.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_AVILINA_000_013: Though they may no longer be with us, we'll never forget them. This way, they'll always be a part of Terncliff and future generations will be reminded of the sacrifices that were made.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_AVILINA_000_014: You were always so kind to me, and now it's my turn to do the same for others.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SYSTEM_000_015: Avilina is absorbed in prayer. Now would be a good time to return to Severa.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_016: When I last saw Avilina, she was headed towards the new monument. Is it true that she oversaw its construction?
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_020: I hope all is well with Avilina. Actually, while you were speaking with her, I received word that Gaius will be here soon.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SYSTEM_000_030: Avilina is absorbed in prayer. Now would be a good time to return to Severa.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: I wish to see Allie. Would you send for her?
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CID_000_054: At first, we thought the Weapon's influence had caused this, but it seems there is more to it than that.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CID_000_055: The chirurgeons say that this is most likely the result of intense trauma. Her mind has been scarred, perhaps irrevocably.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_05: ...She boarded the Diamond Weapon with the intention of saving her brother.
Little did she know that Valens had used the synthetic auracite system to transform Alfonse into a living component of the machine.
Then, when she boarded the Diamond Weapon...
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CID_000_060: I've never heard of anything so cruel...
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_061: Just a moment. In each of the previous cases, pilots became fused with the Weapon's core. So how was Allie able to escape a similar fate?
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CID_000_062: That's one of the many things we're still looking into.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: There is no need. I already know the answer: it was Alfonse who kept her safe.
In the end, I was unable to save your brother. My son.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_065: All they wanted was a place to call home, where they could live in peace. But after all the pain and hardship they endured, this is their reward?
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_06: No. This is not the end of their story.
I taught them the strong must lead the weak. But absolute power corrupts absolutely, and those who have suffered at the hands of the corrupt are beyond counting.
Alfonse dreamed of a land without oppressors and the oppressed, where all may live as equals. Thanks to his sacrifice, and that of his siblings, the cornerstones of such a nation have been laid.
Milisandia, Ricon, Rex, Alfonse, and Allie. They risked everything to win the freedom of Werlyt.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_07: And now, it has come to pass.
I will see that their ideals are upheld. This I swear. As their father.

The long and arduous process of rebuilding Werlyt has begun. In the days to follow, I shall be working alongside the new government to create a place that people like Allie and Severa would be proud to call home.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_100_073: For so long, all that kept me alive...was hate. But the time has come to cast it aside.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_200_073: I'll only regret it if I don't. And while nothing I do can bring back the ones I've lost, I owe it to them to make the most of the life I've been given.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CID_000_074: Times change. People change. And it's just as well─we inventors would soon find ourselves out of work if everything stayed the same. If you've a need for my creations, just say the word.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CID_000_075:
You know, Gaius, I could fill a book with all the things I've been meaning to say to you over the years. But what would be the point? What's done is done.
...There is one thing, though.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_CID_000_076: If anyone can get through to Allie, it's you. She looks up to you the same way I did as a boy. Don't give up on her.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_080: Perhaps in time, Allie will return to some semblance of her former self.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_100: For all my life, I've been searching for my place in the world. Everywhere I went, I was always on the outside looking in.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_101: But I've realized if we can't find one, we just have to make it ourselves.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_102: That's what I learned from Gaius's children. Despite everything, they never gave up, and neither will I.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_103: For now at least, my place is at Gaius's side. I'll follow him and see where this journey leads.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_104: And before I leave, I want to tell you how grateful I am that you chose to stand by us until the end. I hope we'll meet again one day.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_12: I would not have made it this far without my constant companions, Valdeaulin and Severa. In fact, I believe she has a few words to share with you.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_130: It's taken me a long time─too long─but I've finally found a reason to live for the present. For the future.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_105: All this time, I'd been trying to convince myself that Gaius was every bit the villain I'd imagined him to be. The ruthless subjugator of nations. Evil made flesh.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_106: And while many who fight under the banner of Garlemald are all that and worse, I realize now that Gaius was driven by his own notions of right and wrong, misguided as they were.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_107: Since then, he has turned his back on the Empire and its hateful doctrine. His guilt and anguish only strengthen his resolve.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_108: The day I spared his life, he was given a second chance. To set right the wrongs he had committed. To become the man his children believed him to be.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_109: I was a father once. A husband. In many ways, I still am. And even though they're no longer with me, I want to be someone they would be proud of. Now, I too have been given a chance to make a difference. In a land far from home.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_110:
I'll never forget my past, but neither will I be beholden to it. When I meet the people of Werlyt, I'll be sure to tell the tale of your bravery and compassion. May it grant them the strength to face the struggles ahead.
Pray, go in peace, my friend.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_115: I must admit, the thought of returning to Werlyt fills me with apprehension. As a half-Garlean and former imperial soldier, it won't be easy to gain acceptance. But if they're willing to turn to Gaius Baelsar of all people for help, anything's possible!
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_12: I understand that Valdeaulin wishes to speak with you.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_AVILINA_000_121: Now that the Weapon project has come to an end, I'm searching for a way I can use my engineering skills to help others. I'm sure the same technology used to build warmachina can be used for more peaceful ends.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_100_13: Though we were brought together under strange circumstances, Valdeaulin, Severa, and I will continue to work together, at least for the foreseeable future.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_131: And who might these charming young men be?
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_13: They were found in the VIIth Legion's headquarters, in one of the few areas that escaped unscathed following the Diamond Weapon's rampage. Perhaps that was Alfonse's intention...
Do not be afraid. We mean you no harm.
My name is Gaius Baelsar. And like Valens van Varro, I was once a legatus of the Garlean Empire.
Though I believed I was fighting for a just cause, my conquests came at a terrible cost.
Pray, forgive me. I do not mean to scare you. If you would lend me your ears, I have a story to tell.

A group of courageous young men and women, not so different from yourselves, stood up to protect their people from the tyranny of the Empire. They fought with everything they had, and finally, victory was theirs. But it came at a terrible price...
As their father, I still struggle to come to terms with their sacrifice. And yet, they have entrusted the future to me, and I will stop at nothing to see their dream fulfilled.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_14: Even so, there is only so much one old soldier can achieve by himself. I would be honored to have your support in the days to come.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_141: At ease, lads. He's not as scary as he looks.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_142: And if he steps out of line, he'll have me to answer to.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_14: Though they were fortunate enough to escape the destruction of the castrum, they may have been injured while fleeing. Have the chirurgeons look them over and find a place for them to stay.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_15: It seems the time has come for us to go our separate ways once more.
I myself can scarcely believe that we were once bitter adversaries. But my encounters with you have led me to question the very ideals I swore to uphold.
What is strength? What is weakness?
If those who grasp the reins of power are said to be the strong, then those who lack such power must therefore be the weak. For better or worse, however, we are far more complex creatures than that.
I see now that true strength is not granted by others, but resides within us. Strength of character, of spirit, of resolve.
Therein lies the power to cast off the shackles of oppression, to overcome any adversity, to stand firm in the face of impossible odds.
That is the strength you possess. May it never leave you.

It seems I will have to summon all the resolve I can muster if I am to keep my promise to Alfonse. The process of establishing the independent governance of Werlyt is underway, and I will do all in my power to see it become everything my children dreamed of and more.

For the immediate future, we shall continue to work closely with the Ala Mhigan Resistance, whose role in the revolution cannot be understated. That reminds me, if you are passing by Porta Praetoria, the soldiers stationed there wish to hear your version of events.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_16: I hope that when our paths cross again, I will have glad tidings to share with you. Until next we meet.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_170: While I may no longer have a place to call home, I now have the opportunity to help the people of Werlyt rebuild theirs. And who knows? Perhaps I will choose to settle down there one day.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: Welcome back, ! Congratulations on another hard-earned victory!
Ever since we first heard the news, I've been dying to hear exactly how it all unfolded. So, what can you tell me of this Diamond Weapon?
By Rhalgr's beard... Even for the Empire, that must be a new low. Those poor orphans...
I can only pray that the citizens of Werlyt are able to enjoy the freedom that Gaius's wards gave their lives for.
At the very least, we need no longer live in fear of the monstrous creations birthed by the Weapon project. I shall add your account to our official report.
Finally, on behalf of the Ala Mhigan Resistance─and the whole of Eorzea, for that matter─allow me to express my heartfelt gratitude! Thank you!
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_ALFONSE_000_160: Father... The memories stored in the Diamond Weapon... Give them to Allie...
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_200_20: Projections from within the synthetic auracite...
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_ALLIE_500_206:
I don't want to live in a world without you.
That's why...I'm going with you.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_RICON_600_206: No, not yet, Allie. Now is not your time.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_MILISANDIA_700_206: Father still needs you. Please take care of him...in our place.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_REX_800_206: And if you're worried about Alfonse, don't be. He's got us for company!
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_ALFONSE_000_206: We want you to see this new world for yourself...
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_ALFONSE_000_207: We will forever be at your side, Allie.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SHADOWHUNTER_000_21: My children gave everything so that others might be free. I will not rest until the world they dreamed of becomes a reality.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_SEVERA_000_220: The citizens of Werlyt and the Ala Mhigan Resistance are still attending to those injured in the fall of the castrum.
TEXT_LUCKYW402_04032_VALDEAULIN_000_230: I like to think that my wife and daughter would approve of my decision. When I recall our time together, I remember the person I used to be. The person I still can be.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-I may have been too optimistic-ho, .

The fact that the villagers are still nursing a grudge doesn't surprise me─not that I haven't tried to make them think better of it. But why hasn't Anogg come back and given them what for yet? It ain't like her to fret over what people think.
Then there's Konogg. I was worried he'd go chasing after her again─which is why I'm even more worried that he's been shut up in the tunnels this whole time.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_STRONGMINER00642_00: We need to clear the rubble so we can start digging again, but the others won't stop bickering about whose job it is. Not even when I threaten to boot 'em clear into the sea!
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I'll be right there. Two boots are better'n one, as they say.
Looks like I have other business to take care of─not that I was having much luck here. Can you check on Konogg in my stead?
What with Anogg gone and the villagers treating him like he's got the blight, he could do with a reminder that not everyone has abandoned him...
And who's to say─maybe one of your tales of adventure will cheer him up.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_A1_000_001: I've got just the thing! Though I've forgotten the names of everyone involved.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I'm sure whatever you come up with will be fine. Probably.
...And let me know how he's doing, all right? Even if he doesn't want to talk to me, I─ I want him to have the help he needs, is all.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_SYSTEM_000_050: Konogg is radiating an uncommon amount of heat. The many layers insulating his head probably aren't helping.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_A2_000_001: You collapsed, is what. You need rest...
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_A2_000_002: That feeling like your head is full of fiery bees? That's a fever.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_A3_000_002: Anogg wouldn't want you running after her in this state.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Konogg collapsed!?
We need to do something about that fever! I think some of my wife's supply of remedies survived...
I'll go and see─you keep an eye on Konogg!
I thought you said he was bedridden!
Wicked white, where did he go?
I know he wanted to search for Anogg, but how did he even make it out of here?
Damn it all─let's go. Quickly!
We should ask around, find out if anyone saw him go past.
Not that I expect they'll be too inclined to help...
Still, any lead is better than none at all. I'll speak with my miners, you talk to...whoever else.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_VILLAGERE03954_000_: No, I haven't seen Konogg leaving the village... Why?
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_VILLAGERC03954_000_: Finally realized he's no good to us and left, did he?
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_VILLAGERA03954_000_: But without him or Anogg, who's going to be held responsible for what happened?
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_VILLAGERB03954_000_: Their collaborator here, for one. Listen, outsider, I'm sure you thought you were helping, but...
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_GESUGG_000_255: A search for Konogg, you say? That can't be easy. Those twins aren't really the sort to stand still.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_GESUGG_000_256: Wish I could help, but I haven't seen anything out of the ordinary─not more than usual, at any rate. Certainly no fever-addled dwarves.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_GLAGG_000_257: Now Konogg's missin' too? We're droppin' dwarves like ale from a leaky cask!
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_GLAGG_000_258: Well, I hope you find 'em. The matter of culpability is still unsettled, and I'll never get the villagers to agree on what's what if the most guilty-lookin' parties up and vanish...
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_VILLAGERE03954_000_: Now, more than ever, it's important that we exercise prudence─just as I'm always urging.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_GESUGG_000_285: I've run out of machine oil... Other than that, no, I still have nothing to tell you.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_GLAGG_000_290: I almost wish a few of those damned Tholls would turn up. Nothing brings us all together like a spot of unfriendly rivalry.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-I thought I'd never escape-ho! Who knew that questioning every miner in Komra could be so time-consuming...
I hope you weren't waiting too long. Did you learn anything useful?
Wish I could say I was surprised.
My lot also had some...difficulty focusing on the immediate issue, but one of them did see Konogg.
It sounds like he was wandering in the direction of the crater─again. We should search the area.
What's that big wheel? Some kind of machine?
Well, that doesn't sound good. Though I'm still more concerned about where Konogg might have gone.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_A6_000_001: I have a bad─and familiar!─feeling about this...
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_A6_000_002: Perhaps I should have mentioned where exactly I found him last time.
TEXT_LUCKTA501_04034_DWARFMASTER03671_00: You think he's inside? And he's probably not alone...
<sigh> Here we go again.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_DWARFMASTER03671_00: If you're ready to face whatever's in there, then let's get this over with. The longer we wait, the more I worry...
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_A1_000_002: If anything in there needs killing, I can handle it myself.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I'm coming with you. I'll leave the dangerous bits to you, but I can't stand by and do nothing! Not anymore...
I need to make sure he's safe. Please.
Konogg... What have you gotten yourself into?
Sorry for lagging behind─have to keep reminding myself not to get distracted. To tell the truth, I'm starting to understand the intrigue.
You said that the place you found Konogg before is through here?
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_2P_000_053: Beings of this world... Watch closely.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_ANOGG_000_055: There's no time─destroy the sphere! Quickly!
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_9S_000_056: This is bad. We have to get out!
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_A2_000_001: What in the seven hells was that?
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_A2_000_002: I feel I'm owed several explanations...
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_ANOGG_000_059: I know you're confused, but there's no time.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_ANOGG_000_060: We must destroy that sphere. 2P's plans are already in motion, and this whole world will be consumed...
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_2B_100_061: We came to save this world─and now we have a debt to repay. You saved 9S, after all.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_9S_000_062: And there's still so much here we haven't seen! Right, 2B?
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_9S_000_064: Er, right. Leave it to us.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_ANOGG_000_065: It'll take everything we've got to stop them. I believe we can succeed...but we'll need your help. Be ready.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_A3_000_001: I'd feel weirder if you weren't ordering me around.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_A3_000_002: Fine... But I'll get my explanations from you yet!
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_ANOGG_000_068: I'm sorry, Chief─can you look after Konogg?
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Ahem. Yes, of course. I'll carry him back and make sure he rests. You look after yourself, now─and tell me what all of this is about later.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_9S_000_080: I wish we had time for a few quick scans at least...
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_ANOGG_000_085: The sooner we can destroy that sphere, the better.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_2B_000_150: We can't let it keep opening!
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_ANOGG_000_153: I'll help you─from the other side.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_POD_000_154: Alert: Unit 2B and 9S vital systems offline. Saved data found in memory regions. Initiating playback...
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_POD_100_160: (-Audio Data: 2B-)We discovered that our enemies─the white-clothed androids, the tower, that colossal girl─came from that white orb.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_POD_300_160: (-Audio Data: 2B-)It's a gate between worlds, and its purpose...is to destroy this one.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_POD_400_160: (-Audio Data: 2B-)As long as 9S and I are on this side, it can never be closed. We have to go.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_POD_500_160: (-Audio Data: 2B-)But we'll save the memories of our reunion─and of the time we spent in this world, with you.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_POD_600_160: (-Audio Data: 2B-)Some things are just too precious to lose.
TEXT_LUCKTA502_04035_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-that scared the shite out of me-ho!
The tower just up and disappeared! It sort of...folded in on itself. In the blink of an eye!
Glad to see that you're safe, though.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: So... What happened in there?
...Well, I won't pretend I understood half of that. Can't say metaphysics is my area of expertise. Still, I knew that those androids in white and their weird orb were trouble.
And you're saying that you gave 'em what for, so they won't be coming back. Which is good...right?
Glad to hear it. Thanks for risking your neck for us.
Where's Anogg, though? And your android friends, for that matter? Seems like they should've come back with you...
No, she... But why!?
It just...don't seem fair.
I was holding out hope, you know? That everyone would be fine, and life would go back to normal.
I should have known better, sure, but...
<sigh> Someone will need to tell the villagers. Again.
As for Konogg─can you speak with him? I managed to talk him out of running back in there as soon as he woke up, but this... It might be better coming from you. Or maybe I'm just a coward.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_POD_000_050: Alert: The tower can no longer be detected.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_060: You're back! But where's everyone else?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_061: No... She can't be gone. She wouldn't leave me forever!
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_062: Because if she did, I'd... There'd be no one left who...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_064:
“Konogg,
I've been to another world. I've seen it...”
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_100_064: Wh-What does she mean? She...the world...they're “constructs”?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_200_064: That's hardly a reason to run off on her own! She could've...<sniff>...I would've...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_065: Um. I...I have something I need to do. So...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_066: That watch belongs to the chief's wife. I found it when I was clearing rubble earlier.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_067: It was broken, but I...<sniff>...I went ahead and fixed it. She'd probably like it back, so can you give it to the chief for me?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A2_000_002: Wouldn't they be happier if you delivered it yourself?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_069: Thank you. Right now, I... I'm sorry.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_070: I...can't. I need to─ Never mind. I'm sorry.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_071: I appreciate all that you've done for us. If only I was as strong as you are...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_KONOGG_000_075: If the chief asks, tell him not to worry.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: How did it go?
Eh? Something for the missus?
Wicked white, we thought this was gone for good! She'll be glad to have it back. It's all she has left of her parents.
Why didn't Konogg come in person, though? He must know we'd want to thank him.
No... Not him too!
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_SYSTEM_000_105: It seems that you once again have cause to comfort a distraught dwarf...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: He left a letter of farewell.
He's gone.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_10: I wish I could've done something... Anything.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: We've lost them both, and it's our own fault. We drove them to this.
This can't be right...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A3_000_001: What do you plan to do about it?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I don't know what I should do. I don't know how to make things right, but...
I don't know, but this ain't it.
The villagers need to understand that we can't keep on like this.

They might be better listeners now that they don't have to live in fear anymore─if they can believe that's the case, that is. Would you mind sticking around? It'll seem more credible coming from the both of us.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A4_000_001: I'm here for as long as you need me.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A4_000_002: How much does this position pay?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I knew you would be. You're always willing to do what needs doing.
I'm ready to do my part, too. Wait here.
Ha! That's right─took you for an aspiring gate guard at first, didn't I?
And we've been nothing but trouble to you since. Not sure there's enough money in all of Komra to compensate you at this point...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A5_000_001: It's fine. I'm happy to help.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A5_000_002: I also accept eternal gratitude and the right to ominously reference “debts to be repaid.”
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: It's a deal, then. But I do hope we can pay you back someday.
For now, wait here─I'll get the villagers.
Now that you're all here, I have an important announcement:  has put an end to those machines and their plot.
That means the danger's passed, but more importantly, that it's time we look to the future. We'll need to come together─
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_GLAGG_000_202: Hold your ironfrogs! Even if those things are gone, this ain't over.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_GLAGG_000_203: The culprit needs to be brought to justice. How can you expect people to move forward if we don't set an example?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERA03954_000_: That's right─we want to see consequences! Death! Mutilation!
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Do you really!?
We need to talk them down, or we'll never get anywhere with this. Bloodthirsty bastards...
You can't force one person to shoulder the blame for all of this! Some things are bigger than all of us, Glagg.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_GLAGG_000_215: Folk'll never accept that. It just ain't a satisfyin' conclusion.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERA03954_000_: The sooner we do away with the culprit, the sooner we can all relax. You know I'm right─Glagg thinks so too!
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A6_000_001: You'd change your tune if the finger were pointed at you.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A6_000_002: The blame could just as easily fall on someone you love.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERA03954_000_: You wouldn't dare accuse me! Everyone knows I'm innocent.
Ha! That ploy won't work on me. I don't have anyone to worry about. No family, no friends, no lovers...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERB03954_000_: All we need is one or two people to take the blame. Then the rest of us can get back to our normal lives.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A7_000_001: You'd build your life by destroying others'?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERB03954_000_: Wouldn't you? The way I see it, anyone here would throw you to the eaters in a heartbeat for their own gain. You, or me...
Why should I? I've done nothing wrong!
No, not... Not a single thing...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERC03954_000_: Justice should be swift and decisive, I say. Nothing so satisfying as the headsman's axe coming down.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A8_000_002: And if it comes down on the wrong person?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERC03954_000_: Why shouldn't it be? Punish one person and everyone else feels better for it. That's justification enough.
Anything would be better than feeling like this...
At least we'll be able to put this mess behind us. Forget the whole thing.
I can't think about it anymore. I just can't.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERD03954_000_: I-I only need to do what Glagg says, right? Then he won't blame me...and whatever happens, it won't be my fault.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A9_000_001: You think that will protect you?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A9_000_002: No. This is a choice you must make yourself.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERD03954_000_: W-Won't it? I haven't done anything wrong...
B-But then it'll be my responsibility─no matter what happens!
Someone else... Someone else should be the one...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERE03954_000_: The most prudent course is to cooperate with Glagg and rid the village of the guilty party. Then everything will be as it was.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A10_000_002: Is it really “prudent” to follow harm with cruelty?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERE03954_000_: Of course it will. It has to be.
Believe me, if there were a better way...
If it weren't, Glagg wouldn't have suggested it. He's the elder. He knows how these things work. If not, then...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERA03954_000_: It's better this way, trust me. You do trust me...right?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERB03954_000_: I'm right─you'll see. You'll all see...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERD03954_000_: You don't understand─I can't be h-held accountable...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Well, they've settled down a bit, at least. Thanks for that.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_GLAGG_000_351: <sniff> Still sober, eh? Then I'll ask─what do you reckon we should do?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A11_000_001: Stop this before it's too late.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A11_000_002: Whatever doesn't involve me hearing everyone's opinions again...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A11_000_003: How should I know better than any of you?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERA03954_000_: Maybe the outsider's right. We'll never agree on who should take the blame for the attack. Which means the real problem is...Glagg!
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERC03954_000_: I did feel a lot more confident before he started telling us to “listen to other perspectives”...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERB03954_000_: He's been trying to turn us against each other, but he's the elder here. Shouldn't he have seen our village's fiery destruction by skybound machines coming?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: What? No!
No one could've foreseen this. No matter how wise they are, or how hard they try...no one's right every time!
We've all made mistakes here, believe me. Anogg, Konogg, Glagg, the whole lot of you...and me. All of us!
We failed each other.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERC03954_000_: Well? Don't let him get away!
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERD03954_000_: If... If doing nothing is just as wrong, then maybe it wouldn't be so bad to make my own choices...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_GLAGG_000_390: Are my ears goin', or am I bein' insulted left and right?
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-sorry you had to see that-ho. I may not be cut out for public speaking...
I won't give up on putting Komra back together, though─in whatever way I can.
I don't know what we should have done, but...there's nothing for it but to try and do better. Day by day, moment by moment.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A12_000_001: Day by day, moment by moment.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_A12_000_002: Need some help with that? 'Course you do.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I admit, I feel better knowing you'll be around.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERD03954_000_: I, er...I was thinking about what you said, and I realized I probably haven't been the most helpful...
I want─ I'm choosing to try harder, from now on. So if you need another pair of hands...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: You're more than welcome to join us.
Though I'd say we're all past due for a little breather, after all that's happened. Take a rest! Chief's orders.
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_VILLAGERD03954_000_: Understood! I'll be just over there, then. With my thoughts. Yes. Not a problem...
TEXT_LUCKTA503_04036_DWARFMASTER03671_00: He's a little odd, but he's got the spirit. I look forward to putting the both of you to work─at your earliest convenience, of course.
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-thanks again for offering to help us rebuild our village-ho. So, are you rested and ready to begin the work?
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_A1_000_001: There's no time like the present.
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_A1_000_002: Not just yet. I still have worlds to save and packages to deliver.
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Wonderful. I can't tell you how reassuring it is to have you with us.
Now, to begin with, we need to discuss how we're going to tackle our task.
If you could join our nervous friend over there, I'll be along after I see to some preparation.
Well, far be it from me to rush you. When you're done saving all the worlds and delivering all the packages, we'll be waiting for you right here.
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_VILLAGERD03954_000_:
Uwaaah! It's come! My doom is come! Doooooom!
...Oh, it's just you. Sorry, force of habit. So, uh...is it time? To rebuild, that is.
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Everyone's here. Good. Let's get right to it. I have an idea that I want to run by the two of you.
In order to rebuild, we're going to need lots of supplies and willing hands, neither of which we have a whole heap of at the moment.

But then I thought: what if we availed ourselves of the technology used by the machines? With the wealth of parts they left behind, we have all the materials we need to rebuild and upgrade our automata to do the work.
Not only would it be practical─since we'd be using the force behind our destruction for our salvation, it's also poetic!
For your part in this, , I'd ask you to venture into the tunnels and gather those items what might be useful.
Whatever you find, you can bring to our friend here. He'll examine the objects to see how they might be put to use.
And that's about it. So, what do you think?
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_A2_000_002: I, uh...wasn't paying attention. Could you explain it again?
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Had a few ales too many, did you? After recent events, I don't blame you. Anyway, let me explain it all again.
Good, good. With this, the rebuilding can finally commence. We'll prove to everyone that you can't keep us dwarves down─except maybe with copious amounts of grog. That's been an issue, historically.

Well, I'd best be getting back to my post. Without someone breathing down their necks, our miners are liable to stand around with their thumbs up their arses. You have any questions, you can direct them at our friend here.
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_VILLAGERD03954_000_: Between you and me, we're probably doomed to fail. But if it's going to happen anyway, there's no point in delaying it. That's to say, if you're ready to begin, then so am I!
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_SYSTEM_100_064: A weekly quest which continues the story is now available from the doomsaying dwarf in Komra.
TEXT_LUCKTA510_04043_SYSTEM_200_065: Lend your aid and help the dwarves of Komra to rebuild their home.
TEXT_LUCKTA521_04050_VILLAGERD03954_000_: Ready to go to your doom─er...I mean, get to work, are you? Good, good.
As per the chief's instructions, your task is to gather items the machines left behind that might prove useful for rebuilding our village.
Do you know any suitable places for this?
TEXT_LUCKTA521_04050_A1_000_001: The machines have a base deep in the tunnels.
TEXT_LUCKTA521_04050_A1_000_002: There's a ruined factory strewn with machina.
TEXT_LUCKTA521_04050_VILLAGERD03954_000_: Oho, that sounds perfectly forbidding!
While you're out there searching, I'll get my tools ready for dismantling.
I look forward to seeing the spoils of your foray!
How goes the search? I stand ready to dismantle the spoils of your foray!
Well, drench my beard, I've never seen anything like this... It's not going to suddenly spring to life and strangle me, is it?
No? Well, if you're sure... I'll set about studying it at once.
Oh, I should mention that the chief was looking for you. Seems he has news to share. It's something dreadful, I shouldn't doubt...
Have you spoken with the chief yet? Seems he has news to share. It's something dreadful, I shouldn't doubt...
Hm? Ready for another foray, are you? Well, if it wouldn't be too much of a bother...
Excellent! Let our inexorable march towards failure continue!
So, do you recall the machina you brought back last time? Unfortunately, they were rather far gone, and I couldn't salvage much of them. Do you think you could bring back more of the same?
Thank you! With the bits from the extra specimens, I think we can put together something useful─even if we're inevitably doomed to fail.
