Please bring me more of the same machina as last time. With the bits from the extra specimens, I think we can put together something useful─even if we're inevitably doomed to fail.
Ah, yes, precisely the same as last time! This ought to suffice for our purposes, thank you!

You know, I've been feeling a little bit more optimistic in spite of myself. By keeping occupied with our work, I find my mind doesn't stray towards the doom and gloom as often as it used to. Seems it's better to take action than being idle with negative thoughts.
If only it weren't so hard to take action in the first place...
Well, I should be getting back to my work. Perhaps you could report to the chief, in case he has other tasks that want doing. Thanks again for bringing the parts!
To be deleted.
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_VILLAGERB03954_000_: I appreciate you letting me join you...and apologize for my earlier rudeness. Not to make an excuse, but it's been a trying time for us all.

Now, I've been pondering the ways in which I might contribute to the rebuilding effort. While I don't have many talents─not outside of those considered normal for a dwarf such as drinking, at any rate─people do say that I have the gift of the gab.

Using this gift, I've a mind to peddle wares in the outside world to earn coin to put towards our work. There's just one problem: at the moment, we don't have anything that would fetch a halfway decent price.
No, we need something more unusual and exotic than our grog and automata. And as I racked my beard for ideas, it came to me: what could be more unusual and exotic than objects from another world?

The machines have a base inside the crater, and I understand it's brimming with all manner of their paraphernalia. Such items are guaranteed to fetch a high price─we just need someone to venture in to retrieve them: you!
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_A1_000_001: If you're not fussed about what I bring back...
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_A1_000_002: I'm not sure if they'd be worth that much...
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_VILLAGERB03954_000_: As long as it's unusual, I'm confident I can spin a sales pitch for it. Oh yes, the coinbags of Eulmore would trip over themselves for such rare curios.
So just bring back the items, and leave the rest to me. Our coffers will be full before you know it!
How fares the search in the crater? Remember, I'm not fussed about what you bring back as long as it's unusual.
Back from the crater, are you? Come, come, show me what you were able to find.
Oho, strange and wondrous items, all! I'll examine everything closely before I attempt to peddle them, but these ought to be snapped up with nary a fuss.
My thanks for bringing these. Now I can do my little part for our village.
Ah, and before I forget, the chief was asking for you earlier. If you have a moment, do go and see what he wants.
To be deleted.
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_VILLAGERB03954_100_: The chief has been asking for you. If you have a moment, do go and see what he wants.
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_VILLAGERB03954_000_: Ah, I was wondering when you would come by again.
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_VILLAGERB03954_100_: The items you brought back last time are perfect, but I'm hoping to have more stock before I head to Eulmore to do my peddling.
TEXT_LUCKTA522_04051_VILLAGERB03954_000_: Could I trouble you to go on another foray into the crater?
With just a few more items from the crater, I'll have enough stock to make it worth setting out to do my peddling. My thanks in advance.
There you are. Were you able to find anything else of interest?
Marvelous! With the addition of this little lot, I'm now ready to set forth!
If truth be told, I'm a little daunted by the prospect of going all the way to Eulmore. But if I have confidence in myself─and some grog is always good for that─I'm sure that all will be well.
Oh yes, I'll see to it our wares fetch the best coin they can, and prove to everyone that I'm worth more than the ale I can hold.
Thanks for all your help, my friend. I'll be fine from here, and you can let the chief know as much.
To be deleted.
TEXT_LUCKTA523_04052_VILLAGERC03954_000_: Oh, it's you. I've been meaning to apologize─for my behavior at the meeting.
For all my bluster, I had nothing to offer. You made me see the hypocrite that I was, and I'm determined to do better.
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't struggling, though...
We need more automata to help us rebuild, you see, and I thought that we could repurpose the ones we've got guarding the village.
But when I went to shut one down, the blasted thing tried to bash my head in. Barely escaped with my beard, I tell you. Whoever programmed them did their job a little too well...

You're supposed to be a mighty warrior, though, ain't that right? Think you could subdue an ironbeard for me, just to show how it's done? If I could see it once, I reckon I could deal with them by myself.
I'm in your debt. Here, take this sack. You can slip it over an ironbeard to keep it subdued after you've knocked it around enough.
TEXT_LUCKTA523_04052_VILLAGERB03954_000_: How fares the peddling? Extremely well! The Eulmorans can't get enough of our rare and wondrous wares.
TEXT_LUCKTA523_04052_VILLAGERD03954_000_: In spite of myself, I have to say that things are coming along nicely. Who would've thought that we could achieve so much by working together instead of bickering?
TEXT_LUCKTA523_04052_VILLAGERC03954_000_: In case you weren't sure, the ironbeards patrol the area just west of the village. I'll be watching─from a safe distance.
Bugger my beard, you took care of the automaton so quickly, I would've missed it if I'd blinked!
Thanks for bringing this thing back, and for the lesson as well. I reckon I've got the trick of it now.
I've also come to realize something: there ain't no action so noble as one that you take for another.
I'll keep that close to my heart, and strive to be someone who strives for others, just like you.
By the way, the chief came looking for you while you were outside the village. It seemed important, so go and see what he wants, eh?
Have you gone to see the chief yet? It seemed important, so go and see what he wants, eh?
Ah, it's you again. Thanks to you, we've now got a good lot of automata helping us out, but we could still do with more.
If you're not too busy, do you think you could retrieve another ironbeard for us? Rest assured you won't be doing it alone this time─I'm going to retrieve one too.
When we're done, let's meet back here. Happy deactivating!
TEXT_LUCKTA523_04052_VILLAGERB03954_000_: There're still some among us who don't understand the work we're doing. But like you won us over, we can win them over too.
TEXT_LUCKTA523_04052_VILLAGERD03954_000_: Sometimes, someone will come over and tell me off. “The hells you thinking, playing around with bits of those machines? It's downright creepy!” they'd say.
I don't let it discourage me, though. This is what I've chosen to do, and I'm going to keep doing it, rain, hail, or doom.
TEXT_LUCKTA523_04052_VILLAGERC03954_000_: Ugh, of all the times to get a cramp... You go on ahead─I'll be on my way as soon as I can... <grunt>
Whew... It was rough going even with your example, but I managed to shut down an automaton in the end. How about you?
Great! With these two additional units on duty, I'll be able to spend more time drink─
Er...I mean, I'll be able to spend more time doing...things. That automata can't do. For the rebuilding. Yes, yes, that's it!

...Ahem. Thanks to you, I've found something that I can do for Komra. But as helpful as you are, it wouldn't do to rely on you forever. No, from this point on, I want to make sure I can get by on my own when the time comes.
There might be others who could use a hand, though, so you ought to talk to the chief. Thanks again, and be seeing you!
To be deleted.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-I can't thank you enough-ho! Komra is looking like its old self again─better, if we're honest.
You can see that for yourself, though, so let me tell you something you don't know.
I hear that automata of dwarven make have been spotted about Eulmore of late. Signature frog motif and all.
Now, where would those city folk have gotten their hands on artisanry like that? We certainly haven't been peddling them to outsiders─er, you aside.
I can think of one dwarf who might be, though. One with the right skills, and little else to his name...
If it is Konogg...well, I have a lot to say to him. “I'm sorry,” for starters.
And it'd be nice if he could see how far we've come. The new Komra.
I like to think he'd be happy here.
...Anyway, seeing as you're the worldly sort, I doubt you'll have too much trouble picking up his trail in Eulmore. Let me know what you find.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_EULMOREMERCHANT0405: I've got gold! I've got jewels! I've got gold-plated jewels!
I did see a dwarf in black, though, yes. Odd little fellow. Came selling one of those Gogg contraptions─not quite to my personal tastes, but a rare find to be sure!
He placed an order, as well. Paid in advance! Say... If you're looking for the chap anyway, would you save me some time and take it to him?
He mentioned that he was sleeping down in the Derelicts─odd lad, as I said. I'm not sure how familiar you are with the place, but fortunately he drew a map to his preferred hovel.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_KONOGG_000_055: Wait just a little longer, Anogg. With the machines' technology, I can bring you back. I will.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_KONOGG_000_056: I'll make it work. I will. I will!
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_KONOGG_000_059: I'm not...not good enough...never good enough... I can't...
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_KONOGG_000_061: I can't live in a world without you. I just can't...
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_ANOGG_000_064: The one and─ Well, suffice it to say that I'm back! Thanks to your hard work...and my innate genius, of course.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_KONOGG_000_065: Anogg, I... I have nowhere to go. I'm all alone.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_ANOGG_000_066: That was before. You have me, now.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_ANOGG_000_067: And don't you dare say we have nowhere to go. There's a whole world waiting for us, Konogg!
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_DWARFMASTER03671_00: Lali-don't keep me in suspense-ho! Did you find Konogg?
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_A1_000_001: I found his workshop, but I don't know where he's gone.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_A1_000_002: You were right that he was in Eulmore, but now...
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_DWARFMASTER03671_00: That's...disappointing. Still, I appreciate you letting me know all the same.
What's that you have there? Some kind of fancy mead?
Konogg... But what's it for? Aside from the obvious, I mean.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_A2_000_001: I think he'd appreciate it if you passed it on to the woman who was injured.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_A2_000_002: Just make sure Konogg gets it when he comes home.
TEXT_LUCKTA601_04053_DWARFMASTER03671_00: I will. I only wish things hadn't turned out like this. What happened to the village was bad enough, but then everyone was at each other's throats, and Anogg and Konogg were gone... Don't even get me started on the Glagg debacle.
I keep turning it all over in my mind, and I see nothing but the mistakes we made. And I wonder, how can any of us be sure that we won't make a mess of things again?
Maybe we can't. Maybe we just try to remember, every single day, how bloody wrong we probably are, and...we learn to live with that. Maybe that's the only answer we get.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_000: Hehe, it appears my calculations were correct! I knew that at this very spot, I would encounter none other than , the hero who saw us through the Final Days. So certain was I of my math that I stood here for... Well, let's not concern ourselves with that.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_001: I am Nemjiji, assistant to one Professor Claudien. We work with the Aitiascope, to observe the aetherial sea and delve into its myriad mysteries.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_002: Some mysteries, though, are beyond even our capabilities to unravel... The strange crystal we but recently discovered, for instance, defies our every conjecture.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_003: You've been to the center of the star and far beyond it, however, so we hope that you may see something in this crystal that we academics do not. I beg you lend us your well-traveled eye at Aporia─Professor Claudien will be eagerly awaiting your arrival.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_005: Welcome, welcome. We appreciate any insight you can provide on the matter of this crystal. Professor Claudien will share the particulars with you.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_RUISSENAUD_000_010: As I live and breathe, it really is you! I assumed Nemjiji was simply attempting to “pull one over” on me, as it were. Perhaps I should pay more heed to her wild claims.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_030: Greetings, , and welcome to my humble laboratory. I am sure Nemjiji has already told you plenty about us, but allow me to introduce myself personally. I am Claudien, leader of this little research collective.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_031: I must admit, I have been nervous about this meeting ever since Nemjiji set out to find you. For a researcher in my field, there is no greater an honor than to meet the first  in history to traverse the aetherial sea and return to tell the tale.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_032: The professor speaks often and at length of your deeds, but he has no small number of achievements to his own name. He has peered deeper into the aetherial sea than any other in Sharlayan, and the breadth of his knowledge is peerless.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_033: Peerless, perhaps, but for a single ... We must seize this precious opportunity to learn what we can from , and perhaps crack this conundrum that has stumped the three of us for moons.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_034: It was we who peered into the fathomless sea from the Antitower in the Dravanian hinterlands. There we spoke with Hydaelyn, and learned of the fate that would befall this star─the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_035: Soon thereafter all research was moved to Labyrinthos, and through the Aitiascope did we continue our vigil. As impressive a work as the device is, however, it can glimpse but a fraction of the sea's infinite depths.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_036: Which brings us to the matter at hand. Not long after the exodus was declared, we recovered an unusual crystal shard during a routine observation. It appeared before us suddenly, as if propelled to the surface by some unknown force.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_037: We found that it possessed an aetherial density that exceeds that of normal crystals by orders of magnitude. And its shape resembles nothing which occurs in the natural world─it was made, not formed.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_100_037: Unfortunately, that was the extent of the information we could glean before we were forced to turn our focus towards the exodus. The crystal was very nearly forgotten amidst the sudden upheaval.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_038: But thanks to the efforts of a certain someone, that crisis is now behind us, and we are free to resume our research.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_039: Thus did we decide to seek you out─the dauntless adventurer who delved into the unknown and beheld its innermost secrets. And now we would have you see for yourself...
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_198: Here is the crystal in question.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_199: If it resembles aught you have encountered before, even by the smallest degree, please say so.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_A2_000_100: I know of someone who bears a similar crystal.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_200: As I thought, you do know what this is! Please, tell me everything.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_201: I see. The Ascians use these to transfer their memories to new vessels. Fascinating indeed.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_202: It was plain that this crystal was special somehow, but this revelation surpasses even my considerable expectations.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_203: Similar artifacts have appeared throughout the ages. Memories of martial techniques manifested as crystalline shards on the battlefield, or storied stones passed from master to student...
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_204: A comparison between said artifacts and this crystal may prove a fruitful first step in unveiling its true nature. What do you think, Professor?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_205: Ascian memories... Windows through which we can gaze upon the Convocation of Fourteen...
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_206: ...Unlike the crystal in 's story, this one does not bear the mark of the Convocation. Who, then, could these memories belong to?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_207: And more importantly, why were they stored in this particular shard? More importantly still, why was it set adrift on the aetherial sea?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_NEMJIJI_000_210: I'm well aware that contemplation is the key to breakthrough, but there is propriety to consider. We have a guest─one you invited explicitly. Must we do this every time?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_211: What...? Ah! Yes, of course, our guest! Terribly sorry─I do so easily find myself unmoored by the tides of rumination...
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_212: Perhaps a more, er...engaging use of your time with us would be for you to take up that crystal. If indeed there are memories stored within, they may reveal themselves to you upon contact.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_215: That expression does not bode well... What did you see?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_216: ...“Pandæmonium”? 'Tis not a word I have heard before. If my knowledge of the ancient tongue serves me, it means “all demons.” Not a name that inspires optimism, all things considered.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_217: In the event that another star-shattering cataclysm is in fact bearing down upon us, I would have the aforementioned examples of crystallized memory to hand. Nemjiji, Ruissenaud─I entrust their procurement to you. If there are more memories to be extracted from this crystal, we will find them.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_218: As for you, , there is a person I would have you seek─the one who has delivered so dire a warning.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_219: Your story tells us that this crystal could very well have been made by one of the ancients.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_220: If that is the case, then discerning the nature of this “Pandæmonium” would require a trip far into the past. To an era before the sundering.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_221: I know of only one individual capable of such a feat─the very hero who traversed time to prevent the world's doom.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_222: I must confess, the tales people tell of your adventures beggar belief, and their veracity has been a subject of much debate among my peers. After today's meeting, however, there can be no doubt in my mind that every incredible exploit is fact.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_223: So I ask you now─return to the past. Find out what and where Pandæmonium is, and if we need be concerned by this message.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_CLAUDIEN_000_224: Thank you. For the time being, you should keep the crystal in your possession. I do not think you have seen the last of its memories, and more may be drawn out as you approach their source. Safe travels, and may we meet again soon to share our findings.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_302: (-Confused Boy-)...No, of course not. Apologies, but for the briefest moment I thought you to be a dear friend of mine. I realize now that such a notion is preposterous.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_303: (-Confused Boy-) told me a falling star would appear before me, and I suppose you must be it. Truth be told, I did not expect the expression to be so...literal.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_320: Ah, apologies for not introducing myself properly. My name is Themis. As you can see by my bare face, I am not one of Elpis's observers.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_321: Rather, I am come here on an assignment, which has been more or less routine up until this very moment...
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_322: You certainly do know how to make an entrance. I must wonder what brought you here, for it is plain that you do not belong here─or any place I know, for that matter.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_A2_000_200: I'm also here on an assignment.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_325: Hmm, it appears my initial impression was not so preposterous after all. I did not know my friend had such a unique familiar at  disposal.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_326: If you are here at Azem's behest, then I believe I can hazard a guess as to your purpose. You are here to investigate Pandæmonium, yes?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_330: Hmm...are you here to investigate Pandæmonium, perchance? It would not surprise me should we share a purpose...
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_335: If so, we may be able to help one another. But first, might I trouble you to explain how you came to collide with my skull?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_336: I see. I believe that dispels any major doubts I had concerning your intentions. Apologies for being so intrusive, but you must understand this is an uncommon occurrence.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_337: I shall pry no further, for I am well aware that we all have secrets we must keep. However, if I may, I would very much like to take a look at this crystal of yours.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_338: Fascinating. While I cannot say much as to what it contains, it is clear that there are memories stirring within.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_339: Memories that speak of something gravely amiss in Pandæmonium...
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_340: The facility extends beneath Elpis, and is overseen by the Words of Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_341: It houses those creations that are highly valued as research subjects...and highly dangerous to the star. Naturally, it is strictly guarded, and under constant surveillance.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_342: Several days ago, however, an unnatural shift in the flow of its surrounding aether was detected. Soon thereafter, all communications from Pandæmonium ceased.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_343: I am here as representative of an organization that works directly with the Convocation, and have been tasked with investigating this incident.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_THEMIS_000_344: Now that there is some measure of transparency between us, might I offer a suggestion as to what we should do next?
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_SYSTEM_000_350: During the course of your investigation, you may discover valuable artifacts.
TEXT_AKTKRA101_04475_SYSTEM_000_351: These can be exchanged for equipment by speaking with Mylenie in Aporia or Djole in Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_000: Now then, my proposal is a simple one: let us journey to Pandæmonium together. Our destination is the same, and I suspect the arrangement would work to our mutual benefit.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_001: Besides, I should have no trouble gaining us both access. I do hope you agree─I would be loath to part ways from the falling star I had been waiting so long for.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_002: Originally I had planned to conduct my investigation with the friend I mentioned earlier.  had also noticed the anomaly near Pandæmonium, so it only seemed natural that we should investigate it together.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_003: However,  eventually decided that it would be unwise for us both to go. If two members of our organization were seen poking our heads about restricted facilities, it could raise questions, you see.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_004: I decided to go alone, but  left me with these words: “Fear not, for in my absence a star shall fall before you.”
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_005: While I could not comprehend  meaning at the time, I believe now I understand.  does have a way of being right about these things.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_100_005: Even so,  hints of what to come are generally more cryptic. I suppose I should have kept my gaze to the heavens.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_006: Suffice it to say that I am grateful for your presence either way. As for the matter at hand, we must first gain permission from the Words of Lahabrea for entry into Pandæmonium. There ought to be a speaker waiting at Anagnorisis...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_010: I sent a request for permission before setting forth to Elpis. With luck we shall not be waiting long.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_020: What a fascinating aetheric signature... Ahem. In accordance with the Convocation's request, the two of you have been granted leave to observe Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_021: I shall register your aether for the records. From this point on, you may freely come and go from Pandæmonium as you please.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_022: Now, that was a painless process. I take this as a sign that we were meant to conduct our investigations together.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_023: Of course, while you have been permitted entry into the facility, the specimens housed inside must be handled with the utmost care. You are to heed the warders' instructions at all times.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_024: Those who conduct their work within Pandæmonium are called “warders” for their role with respect to the creatures within.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_025: Generally, creations that pose a threat to the safety of the star must be undone. However, the Words of Lahabrea has deemed certain such creations as worthy of further study, interring them within the facility.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_027: Those who spend their days in Pandæmonium are not merely researchers─they must work tirelessly to ensure that none of their subjects slip their shackles.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_028: For all intents and purposes, the place is a dungeon. Perhaps such a comparison arouses frightful imagery, but Pandæmonium is a frightful place.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_029: I know not the purpose of your investigation, but if you discover aught that merits a report, pray do so with utmost haste. Master Lahabrea shall guide us upon the proper course of action from there.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_100_029: Then I take it that means you have detected nothing amiss as of late?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_101_029: The warders have reported nothing that would cause alarm. Minor fluctuations in aether have been observed, but surely Master Lahabrea would have acted if they were anything worth worrying about.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_030: I see. It appears Lahabrea is kept well abreast of the goings-on here, then...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_031: I hope I am not overstepping my boundaries by asking, but... You seem to be quite familiar with Master Lahabrea. Do you know him?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_A2_000_200: Oh, the stories I could tell you...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_100_031: ...That a mere familiar would have had the honor to meet Master Lahabrea! He is not known to easily afford others his time, so you must be extraordinary indeed to be granted even a moment of it.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_105_031: You are no mere familiar, are you? Master Lahabrea is not known for being generous with his time─that one would have “stories” of his company almost beggars belief.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_110_031: Regardless, while I doubt I need to tell you this, he is of the Convocation. Take care that your actions do not hinder his work.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_031: And with that, we are free to make our way to Pandæmonium. The neus that will take us there is on the eastern bank of Lethe─let us delay no further.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_STAFF04476_000_040: Pandæmonium can be reached via the neus on the island to the northeast. I suggest you hurry before your companion leaves you behind.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_045: I had to contain my surprise for the sake of appearances, but is it true that you too have met Lahabrea in the flesh? I find you more fascinating by the moment...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_100_045: Still, I shall refrain from asking too many questions. Secrets will make our journey all the more intriguing.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_101_045: We shall come to know each other in time, I wager. Or else why would fate have orchestrated our meeting?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_102_045: In any case, let us be off. Truth be told, this will be my first time beholding the fabled Pandæmonium with my own eyes. Here's to a new adventure, eh?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_060: It is much as I feared...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_100_060: The speaker seemed in such high spirits that for a moment I thought the aetherial irregularity not nearly so grave a portent as I had imagined... Alas, 'twas a fleeing and vain hope.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_061: To gaze upon this complex network of chains and wards, the untrained eye might not sense anything awry. No effort has been spared in making this place impenetrable.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_062: Even the finest of masterworks is not without its flaws, however...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_063: Someone, or something, is tampering with the protections.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_100_063: It is working from within, eroding them from the inside out.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_064: Fear not─there is no immediate danger. I reinforced what protections I could the moment we arrived.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_065: This will not put an end to whatever is occurring, but it shall at least serve to slow its progress. One small victory─though the road ahead of us is yet long.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_066: Yes... Powerful forces are at work here.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_067: The silence in the air speaks volumes. While I did not expect a bustling facility, I see not a single warder.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_068: Our first course of action should be to seek one out, wherever they may be.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_070: However, there is something you must know...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_071: The magic I wove upon entering requires my constant awareness. That is to say─if we are forced to fight, I cannot risk joining you in battle.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_072: Should I lose focus, Pandæmonium's protections will rapidly crumble before the force assailing them.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_100_072: Were there another way, I would gladly choose it─but let us at least be grateful that neither of us is here alone, trapped in hopeless circumstances.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_073: If we should fail to find a peaceable solution, then I hope that I can rely on your strength to see us through.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_A1_000_100: Of course. You have my promise.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_A2_000_100: This request doesn't come as a surprise, to be honest.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_080: Thank you for offering your help so willingly. If weapons are drawn, I hope to be able to lend at least a touch of magical support.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_085: At least you received it with good humor. Rest assured I do not mean to stand by idly while you risk life and limb─I hope to be able to lend at least a touch of magical support.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_090: Creation magicks do have their uses in that regard. I had it in mind to use your aether as basis for illusory allies that will fight at your side.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_091: Perhaps...seven shall do. Not exactly an army, but by the looks of you, a formidable band nonetheless.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_093: Then so shall it be. Now...what, I wonder, awaits us in Pandæmonium's pitiless halls?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_100: I cannot say for sure what awaits us. Let us make ready for the worst, and we shall not be taken by surprise.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_200: That was a thrilling display! And if I may be so vaunting, the warriors I spun from your aether fought even more splendidly than I had anticipated. I suppose they were cut from excellent cloth, after all.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_201: We should wait until this man regains his senses. He wears the robes of a warder, and I would be very curious to know what drove him to attack us sight unseen.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_21: It... It's coming back to me... My mind was filled with a storm of desperation...anger... I leapt at you, though I knew naught of your intentions...
Pray accept my apologies. And my thanks. Had you not knocked some sense back into me, I may have fallen upon someone less capable of defending themselves.
I am Erichthonios, a warder of Asphodelos─Pandæmonium's highest layer, and the place we're in now.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_216: One must wonder why you were so desperate to keep us out. What is happening in Pandæmonium?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_21: The creations interred within Asphodelos have been set free, and stalk its halls to no end but violence.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_218: That is...not good, to say the least. Has this ever happened before?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_21: No, never. Each level of Pandæmonium is under the charge of a keyward, who keeps strict control over the most minute aspects of their domain. They're selected with great care, and their loyalty to Master Lahabrea is absolute...
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_22: Yet something has gone terribly wrong. Try as we might to hold the line, the chaos within is overwhelming... I hardly realized that I had become separated from my colleagues.
I remember a chorus of whispers assailing my senses, and afterwards only flashes of rage and fury. Then blackness...from which I awoke to find that whatever had overcome me was gone.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_222: I see... Your senses may have been muddled by magicks that affect the mind─perhaps the selfsame ones that saw you separated from the other warders.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_22: Whatever had taken hold of me, thank you for releasing me from its clutches. That you've come here from the surface must mean some word of our plight has reached the outside world. If you know anything that may help, pray tell.
Horror among horrors... So Pandæmonium's protections are indeed being dismantled from within.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_225: By the same individual─or individuals─that released its captives and set them upon you, no doubt. Such knowledge avails us little, however, if we cannot ascertain their identity.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_22: ...Themis, was it? You said you worked for an organization under the auspices of the Convocation. Were they to receive word of what has transpired here, what measures would they take?
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_227: Doubtless they would consider this place to be a lost cause. Pandæmonium's ties to the outside world would be severed, or perhaps it would be wiped from existence entirely.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_22: As I thought. Were the creatures to escape into the outside world, there would be untold carnage. The Words of Lahabrea would never risk that, despite what value the research subjects may hold.
All the more reason to work with haste. If we can't expect further help, then it falls upon me to save the others. I'll not leave them behind!
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_23: I won't leave the other warders to face certain doom.
I know they fight for survival even now. They wouldn't abandon their duty─they would see the creatures returned to their cells at all costs.

And so I must do the same. Themis, I know the request I'm about to make of you is a monumental one, but please...say not a word of this to the Convocation until I've been given a chance to set things right.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_234: ...Forgive my rudeness, Erichthonios, but my decision cannot be swayed by emotion. You would only be consigning yourself to an early death─strength of resolve alone cannot win in the face of overwhelming odds.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_235: That being said, our investigation has only just begun, and we would be remiss to turn back ere we've made an exhaustive survey. So, for the time being, there is slightly more than resolve to rely upon.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_250: Heh... I knew you would be all too eager to join us.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_251: Each moment since you fell from the skies has been more interesting than the last. More and more you remind me of my dear friend.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_252: ...Which goes some way toward encouraging me that this matter will yet reach a satisfactory conclusion.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_254: For the moment, our goals align. The protective magicks of Pandæmonium yet hold, so for the moment time is in our favor. Let us proceed upon the course you and  have set us upon.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_ERICHTHONIOS_000_25: Themis and..., yes? Thank you. The warders owe you a great debt already.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_100_255: We shall be glad to have someone familiar with Pandæmonium's halls by our side. A party of three is ever so much more entertaining than a pair of two.
TEXT_AKTKRA102_04476_THEMIS_000_256: Now, let us turn our attention to rescuing your colleagues. Perhaps it would be wise to approach the gates, in case any have followed you out.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_000: It seems our investigation will be quite the ordeal after all. Still, I find it hard to believe that Lahabrea knows naught of what has transpired here. Whoever the mastermind of this crisis is, they do not lack for power and cunning.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: Not a sound can be heard from within, which means neither creature nor warder has made it this far. We should begin forming a plan to save them at once.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_012: ...Forgive me if I misunderstand, but do you mean to rescue the warders and creations both?
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: Naturally. Although they may be dangerous, they're valuable research subjects. I wouldn't see our labor─our untold hours of study─go to waste.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_014: I daresay Lahabrea would smile to hear you say such a thing. That is, if we had cause to report this incident to him.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: Smile? I'm not sure his face is capable of such warmth.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_016: ...Ah, so you have met him before? I was under the impression he rarely visited Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: I have, yes. My mentor was the previous head of this facility─that is to say, Lahabrea's predecessor in the position of chief keyward.
Her name was Athena, and she was a researcher with the Words. 'Twas she who appointed me to this position, in fact.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_020: I see... I did not know there was a chief keyward before Lahabrea. Your motivation to save your research subjects is not entirely driven by duty to the Words, then─you wish also to preserve the work of your mentor.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_02: You've the right of it. I'm lacking in ideas of how to go about that, however. I'm a mere warder, and cannot wield interment magicks.

Ah, but of course I can hardly expect you to be versed in the magicks we use here. If you recall, during our battle earlier I bound you in aetherial shackles. Interment is a more refined and powerful magick based upon the same principles.
While both are used to keep our subjects docile, only the keyward of each tier is permitted to use interment. Even if I were allowed, I lack the aptitude to use the spell to any notable effect.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_024: Fascinating. I have some knowledge of these forms of spellcraft, actually. Lahabrea himself established their foundation, if I recall.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_100_024: While shackles are meant to bind an object in place for a short time, interment freezes the very space around it for as long as the caster wills.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_101_02: Indeed. While the illusory beings you summoned in our fight suggested as much, I see your knowledge of magic is vast. Perhaps you've already mastered the art of interment, and I've been lecturing you like a child all this time...
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_025: I am afraid my knowledge ends there. I have not the precise understanding of how the invocations interact with natural laws that would be needed to cast said spells with any consistency.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_026: While I consider myself well versed in various magicks, I would be ill-advised to assume the duties of keyward without instruction. That being said, if I were to learn more of interment and its inner workings, perhaps...
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_A1_000_100: Well, you have a warder standing in front of you.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_A2_000_100: Leave the fighting to me. You two can figure out the rest.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_030: Well, the solution is obvious when you put it like that.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_035: Hmm... I daresay we can do just that.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_036: Erichthonios, you implied that what prevented you from performing interment was lack of magical capacity. What if I supplemented your power with my own? Would the spell succeed then?
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: I...I can't say for certain. I've never heard of such a thing being done.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_038: I believe it may be our best recourse. That is, of course, assuming you can perform the initial rites and incantations flawlessly. Even the smallest misstep and we would have to start over.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: You needn't worry about that. I've seen the spells cast so many times that their motions have been burned into my memory. I won't disappoint.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_040: Very well, let us work out the specifics afterwards. Once we do, we can test out our methods on one of the escaped creatures─though I suppose there is the matter of finding one...
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_041: It would be foolish to rush in blindly, lest we find ourselves surrounded with naught but an untested stratagem at our disposal. Nay─I would prefer to engage a single creature that  could dispatch on  own if the spell were to go awry.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: I agree─and I may have an idea in that regard. I recall seeing the hippokampos wandering the waterways during my flight. Perhaps it's still there.
Few of the subjects housed within Asphodelos are fond of water, and I believe we'll be able to engage the beast without fear of unwanted guests.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_045: Then that shall be our first target─or perhaps “subject” is a better term. Before we commence with the interment magicks, the creature should be weakened to a sufficient degree. I believe I can trust you with that task.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_046: As dependable as ever. Once you have given it a thorough trouncing, we shall bind this hippokampos with the keyward's magic. Until then, my illusions shall fight by your side.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: The hippokampos will be alone, but it's a daunting opponent nonetheless. Its magic warps the environment around it, and it will be at home amidst the waterways. Steel yourself for a fight.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_060: I take it we are each ready to fulfill our respective roles. Truth be told, this will be the first time I have practiced magic that requires such a degree of cooperation between parties. How thrilling!
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_06: Athena ever drove home the fact that our subjects should be treated with the utmost care. 'Twould be best if we could see them confined once again rather than disposed of like beasts gone feral.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_100: That was a trial by fire─or water, I suppose─but I had faith we would see it through. So long as we had your stout arm, of course.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: I knew that you were no mere mercenary, but to make such clean work of the hippokampos... Seasoned fighters scarcely have occasion to visit Pandæmonium, let alone display their skills. Mastery takes all forms, indeed.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_100_12: Needless to say, our plan worked to perfection. In no small part thanks to you two.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: Themis's power was more than enough to complete the interment. Spellcasting was never my strong suit, but that almost made me feel like a proper magos.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_THEMIS_000_122: Truly? Having seen your abilities firsthand in your fight with , I beg to disagree.
TEXT_AKTKRA103_04477_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: Shackles is the one exception. And 'tis only because I've been forced to practice it since I was but a small child. Other magicks leave me feeling completely out of my depth.
Regardless, it seems luck is on my side, to guide me to you. We may prove the impossible possible after all.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_00: After witnessing the hippokampos's capabilities, I should not blame you for wishing to avoid engaging any further creations in the place of their choosing... Alas, I doubt we will have the luxury.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_000: While our success in sealing away the hippokampos is certainly heartening, the fact that we have yet to see any other warders concerns me.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_00: The keyward of Asphodelos is nothing if not cautious. Doubtless he has gathered what warders he could and retreated to a safe area.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_002: Let us hope so. It occurs to me that I know little of the keywards besides their magical prowess. Is there aught more you can share?
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_00: Of course. A man named Hesperos is in charge of Asphodelos. Not only does he have thorough knowledge of the creatures here, but he takes great pains to be a mentor to each of the warders under his charge.
He has done much to ensure that I flourished here, in spite of my ineptitude at magic...and I have always known him to be the sort of man who faces difficult decisions with unwavering composure.

Furthermore, keywards are not only masters of interment─they can also bend the hallways of Pandæmonium to their will with creation magicks. With all this in mind, I am certain that so long as Hesperos guides them, the other warders are safe.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_006: I can see why absolute control over the environs is imperative. Had we faced the hippokampos upon arid sands instead of the waterways, I suspect the battle would have ended much more quickly...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_007: In any case, if this Hesperos is as capable and caring as you say, we would do well to seek him out as soon as we can. He has like as not taken your colleagues to a secure location.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_00: The safest place would be the innermost circle of Asphodelos. From there they could flee to Abyssos if hard-pressed.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_100_00: Even should they have sought safe haven within the other circles, if we make for the fourth, we ought to encounter them on the way.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_101_008: Indeed─and we shall gain a comprehensive understanding of the situation within Asphodelos, which will be essential in determining whether we ought continue down to Abyssos.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_00: The rub, of course, is that I myself possess no power to bend the circles to my will... Instead, we must proceed through the central corridor─which was barred by the phoinix, last I checked.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_010: Phoinix... I have heard the name before. A fiery bird with life eternal.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_011: Beyond unquenchable brilliance, the perfected concept boasts nigh-boundless restorative powers, if I recall. Truly an exemplary feat of creation magicks.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_012: Perfection is ever built on the back of failure, however, and Lahabrea suffered countless missteps during his experiments...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_013: ...And he was hardly the only one. This phoinix will be but one of many attempts at the concept gone awry.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: Aye. Far from evoking wonder, our phoinix is a creature of fury and wrath, and seeks only to turn the world to ash. Thus was it confined within Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_015: Development of the concept continued elsewhere, but as the moons turned, more and more researchers abandoned the project as an impossibility... Save for Lahabrea and his Words.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_016: When I received word that at long last Lahabrea had succeeded where so many others had failed, I was nearly overcome. Pray tell─how did the warders of Pandæmonium celebrate their master's accomplishment?
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: I...don't believe we did. The research of the Words of Lahabrea has little consequence to our work here, save for those rare times it charges us with a new specimen. Truth be told, I don't remember anyone making note of the occasion.
...But enough reminiscing─we must make ready to confront the phoinix.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_100_01: While it's possible that it flew off to some other wing of Pandæmonium, we would make that assumption at our own peril. Better to assume that we'll need to bring Asphodelos's most unruly subject to heel.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_019: I certainly see no reason to delay. The phoinix's power over flame will avail it far less in a barren corridor than elsewhere, so it may well serve us to subdue it sooner rather than later.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_100_026: It seems whoever is behind this can alter the space around us at will. We face an uphill battle.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_100_02: Impossible... If those were creation magicks at work, then that means...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_100_028: Let us confront that reality after we have conquered the enemy in front of us. Every drop of our focus shall be required if we are to inter the phoinix.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_035: We shall gain naught from allowing the larger implications of this to distract us from the fight ahead. The phoinix's rage will be unbridled, but I trust you are prepared for the worst.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_50: With that, the phoinix is shackled once more. However, there is yet the matter of this...arena.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_501: As you've told us, there is but one person in Asphodelos with the ability and authority to wield such magicks...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_502: Though fortunately, it appears he has saved us the trouble of finding him.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_503: (-???-)A contemptible display─as befits an inferior specimen.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_504: (-???-)Even so, I expected it would at least delay your advance. Imagine my surprise when I saw the chains of interment drag the phoinix back to its cage...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_505: (-???-)Either the bird is even more of a failure than its creators cared to admit, or you are no mean trespassers.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_506: I had hoped our suspicions were misplaced, but alas...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_50: Keyward Hesperos, why!? Why have you brought such chaos to your beloved Pandæmonium!?
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_509: Pandæmonium─pitiless, impenetrable, and utterly steadfast...unlike those charged with its keeping.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_51: What has possessed you!? I don't understand!
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_511: Oh, Erichthonios, must you pester me with these inane questions? Think for yourself─surely you can muster a theory or two with that dim wit of yours.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_512: Then again, you have never been one for insight. Why Master Lahabrea suffers your mediocrity I shall never understand.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_51: You... You may look like him, but you're not the Hesperos I know. Something has warped you, too, from the inside out...
The keyward I knew had compassion for all those under his charge, be they clad in robes or shackled in chains.
Was that all a farce? Did you hide your contempt for us all these years!?
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_516: Those who are content to merely glimpse the water's surface are doomed to be dragged into its depths. You prove my opinion of you with every word.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_517: My mind is clearer than it has ever been. Even now, seeing you feebly grasp for answers makes the bile rise in my throat.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_518: Such wasted potential! To be son to Master Lahabrea, yet no more skilled with magic than a newborn babe!
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_ERICHTHONIOS_000_51: But of course. It's always about Lahabrea...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_520: Silence! You are not worthy to utter his name!
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_521: For once, be grateful to witness a feat beyond your meager abilities. Beyond your shallow reckoning. I have slipped the surly bonds of mortality!
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_522: I have become one with our mythic creations, and rid myself of imperfections. I stand upon the threshold of godhood!
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_523: As a hemitheos shall I serve Master Lahabrea, ever faithful, unto the end of days...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_524: And he shall require no other!
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_526: Are you so blinded by arrogance that you have lost sight of what it means to serve? Erichthonios is more capable than you could ever know.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_527: It was thanks to his instruction that I was able to master the art of interment. Both how to wield it...and how to break free of it.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_528: , let us quit this place. Whatever poison has corrupted Hesperos's mind, it is plain his power far eclipses our own. We must have time to gather our strength.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_529: Hmph. Weaklings though they may be, it takes a singular aptitude to master interment so quickly. To say nothing of how swiftly that familiar laid low the phoinix...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_530: Regardless, their noble aims will be their undoing. Where they fritter away their strength in calming the beasts of Asphodelos, I continue my work. Even should they survive long enough to reach the heart of my domain, naught shall await them but doom.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_HESPEROS_000_531: ...I eagerly await your arrival, Erichthonios. Even dullards have their uses.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_610: My darkest suspicions have been realized. We face the keyward of Asphodelos himself...
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_611: More than that revelation, however, Erichthonios worries me. He loved Hesperos for his compassion, but received naught but scorn from whatever the keyward has become.
TEXT_AKTKRA104_04478_THEMIS_000_612: ...He has said little since our return. I only hope that the shock of recent events does not prove to be a death knell for his resolve.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_010: Much as I am loath to disturb Erichthonios so soon after what just occurred, I am afraid circumstances do not afford us the luxury of time.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_011: Perhaps it will do him well to speak about recent events. Concerning both the keyward...and his father.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_020: He seemed reticent to say aught concerning Lahabrea when the subject was broached. Doubtless his relationship with his father is a fraught one.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: The creation of the ward which surrounds Pandæmonium was an astounding feat of magical prowess. A feat accomplished by none other than Lahabrea...
That both my father and I can bind others in chains is perhaps the only thing that we have in common.
Aye, I'm Lahabrea's son. Bereft of his talent for magicks or his brilliant mind, but his son nonetheless. Surely this doesn't come entirely as a surprise to you.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_034: Nay... I had an inkling when you said you had practiced aetherial shackles since childhood. Assuming you haven't been employed here quite that long, it had to indicate some long-held connection with Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: 'Twas Lahabrea that taught me how to cast aetherial shackles, but that was it. My further education was overseen by the Words of Lahabrea─more specifically my mother, who was a researcher there.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ETHEMIS_000_036: You did speak of Athena, chief keyward before Lahabrea. She is your mother, yes?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: How astute. I can see now why you were chosen to lead this investigation.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_100_03: You've the right of it. Athena was my mother, and it was she who invited me to join her here. Lahabrea had nothing to do with it.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_038: I see there is little love lost between you two. What I cannot see is why Lahabrea was appointed chief keyward when another was already in place.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: ...Was in place. My mother is no longer with us.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: And Lahabrea was all too eager to assume her responsibilities, with nary a moment spared to mourn her. What love do I owe him now, when he offered not one drop of compassion then?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_041: Ah...I see. “She is no longer with us.” An expression to convey the end of a life.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_042: I have known only the public face of Lahabrea. While he is lauded for his ability to maintain composure in the face of unnerving circumstances, I must admit that oft he comes across as...cold.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: ...Apologies, but can we speak of something else? This topic isn't an easy one for me to discuss...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_045: Of course. There are more pressing matters at hand, after all. Namely, how to deal with Hesperos.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_046: We have yet to see the other warders. Judging by what we know, we can surmise that Hesperos has confined them somewhere beyond our grasp.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_047: And now that he is aware of our presence, he will be preparing for our next encounter. We cannot expect to face him on equal footing. Quite the opposite, in fact.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_049: Every moment we spend chasing after the creations is another moment Hesperos can contrive another advantage for himself. The wisest course would be to find him first and foremost.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_05: He said that he has become one with the creations...perhaps that means he is vulnerable to interment?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_051: In theory, that should be possible. However, is it enough merely to confine him? After all he has done?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_05: I need to know why. I need to know what drove him to forsake everything he's worked for.
Was it all truly so that he could serve his master? To my mind, he's merely put Lahabrea's own work at risk in trade for some nebulous power.
Lahabrea is the chief keyward of Pandæmonium─how would throwing it into disarray win his favor? It doesn't make any sense...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_055: I share your curiosity, but we must consider that our enemy has us at a disadvantage in every sense. ...What do you think? Should we seek to put him in fetters, or would it be too dangerous to allow him quarter?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_A2_000_200: If you fail to confine him, I can always strike him down.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_060: Daring as ever, I see. I know not which trials you have faced in your past, but to see you so certain is all the convincing I need. Very well, let us try Erichthonios's plan.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_06: I believe I can shed some light on the nature of our foe. When Hesperos spoke with us, I noticed he bore the telltale fangs of the vrykolakas, a beast which feeds off the aether of its prey. Likely that is the creation Hesperos merged his essence with.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_063: And we know all too well that he can change the environment around himself at will. The battle will not be an easy one, but I believe in our victory.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_07: That Hesperos possessed such a lust for power that he would resort to this... Clearly I misjudged him. I'd like nothing more than to strike him down myself, but seeing you wipe that arrogant grin off his face will taste just as sweet.
He called himself a hemitheos, and claimed immortality. I know not how he discovered this dark art, but his actions do not bespeak a sound mind.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_50: Now, Themis. We end this here!
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_HESPEROS_000_501: Fools... I will not be put in chains...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_HESPEROS_000_502: To think that I would fall before one such as you. Perhaps I should have treated you as more than a mere nuisance.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_HESPEROS_000_503: Despite your victory, you shall never have the knowledge you seek. The secrets of my transformation, the secrets of my deception─they shall return to the star with me!
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_504: You are wasting your breath, Hesperos. We have the upper hand now, surely you can see that.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_HESPEROS_000_505: Yes, yes. My repertoire is not exhausted yet, however... Although I have failed, my end shall be on my terms.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_HESPEROS_000_506: I remain loyal to my very last... Come what may, I die...with dignity...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_50: ...How did your ambition lead you so astray, Hesperos? You were better than that.
Your star shone more brightly than any other in Pandæmonium. You had Lahabrea's respect, his trust─what more did you seek? That you would forsake all that, and sully your legacy besides...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_509: He became so blinded by his own desires that he lost sight of his duty. In the end, he lost everything, and his plans lie in tatters. I fail to see any dignity in that.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_51: Even so, I would have liked to know why he chose this path.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_511: Hesperos's infatuation with your father was his undoing. Perhaps he was jealous that fate had chosen you, and not him, to be Lahabrea's son. So terrible did this jealousy become that he sought verboten power─power that Lahabrea would be unable to ignore.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_51: How does a pursuit for respect warp one's heart so? How does infatuation with one person turn into contempt for everyone else? I've never heard of such a thing.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_A1_000_100: It's not as uncommon as you might think.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_A2_000_100: It happens, but that doesn't mean it's right.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_52: I see... I admit I cannot but find it vexing, but perhaps that signifies naught but my own capacity for bitterness...
I do understand what it is to have a beacon to follow in dark times─a person you trust to guide you true. How it is to desperately wish their light would fall upon you again.

...But we have spent enough time assuming the intentions of the departed─there are the living to consider. We must find the other warders and round up the remaining creations forthwith. Of that, at least, we can be certain.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_523: I believe I can be of help in that matter.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_524: The influence of Hesperos's magic is fading throughout Asphodelos. Now is the perfect opportunity to seize control of the facilities and restore things to their original state.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_100_52: Seize control...? Can you really do that?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_526: Erichthonios. What lies beyond that threshold?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_52: That's the passage which connects Asphodelos to Abyssos. Why?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_528: Be on your guard, you two.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_529: Now that Asphodelos is free of obstructions, I can more easily sense disturbances in the lower levels. Something stirs in Abyssos!
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_531: Let us return to the gates for now. I should like to appraise the situation from there.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_532: Needless to say, our investigation is far from over.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_60: Just when I had thought our work to be done... Did this tragedy unfold all throughout Pandæmonium?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_610: Although we have defeated Hesperos, it appears we have but scratched the surface of Pandæmonium's troubles.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_61: My head is still swimming with questions, but could this mean that Hesperos wasn't actually behind this?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_612: It is a stark possibility, yes. The root of this crisis may lie somewhere much deeper than even Abyssos.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_100_612: When we first encountered you, you said the memories of your escape were vague and that your senses were muddled. I believe this was more than the result of a panicked mind─you were made to feel this way by a powerful magical influence.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_613: It is possible that this same magic could have poisoned Hesperos's heart, twisting his affection for Lahabrea into a burning obsession. Then, in his altered state, he was made an offer of power he could not refuse...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_61: Wait... Are you suggesting that someone else turned Hesperos into that...thing? If so, it stands to reason that they wouldn't stop at him...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_615: Indeed. Our mysterious mastermind does not lack for subjects for his experiments. For more potential hemitheoi.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_61: If what you're saying is true, then my colleagues...they're doomed to share the same fate as Hesperos.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_617: Do not lose heart yet, Erichthonios. Hesperos challenged us alone, and that tells me that the process of his creation was a long and taxing one. If he was the first hemitheos, then the rest of the warders are likely still alive.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_618: However, much as I would like to hasten deeper into Pandæmonium, the way forward is sealed off. We must focus our efforts on finding a way through.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_61: With the creations still having free rein of Asphodelos, that won't be easy...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_620: On the contrary, I yet retain control of these circles, and thus can wield interment magick within their halls at will. The creatures will pose no threat to us.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_62: Just like that!? Then nothing's stopping us from returning order to Asphodelos.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_622: Just so. I shall require your expertise to keep the peace after the subjects have been returned to their confinement, however. You are Asphodelos's sole remaining warder, after all.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_623: Truth be told, I did not expect this investigation to become so involved. Of course, I would like to resolve matters here without resorting to outside help, but...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_62: Do you mean to send a report to Lahabrea?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_625: 'Tis too soon to say. Let us first find a way into Abyssos. It would be best to withhold our judgment until we have ascertained the whereabouts of the other warders and the identity of the party responsible for their disappearance.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_62: Agreed. Even so, if it means saving even a single life within Pandæmonium, then I'm not above asking Lahabrea for help...should it come to that.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_627: Recent discoveries certainly paint Hesperos's actions in a new light... The number of unknown elements in this investigation grows, and we must proceed forward with the utmost caution.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_628: To that end, Erichthonios and I shall remain here for the time being. Much as I enjoy your company, I do not believe we shall be needing protection so long as we remain in Asphodelos.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_62: You should take this time to rest. Surely you are weary, and there may be more battles ahead of us. Themis's burden may grow heavier in your absence, but he's shown that he's more than capable to bear it.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_100_62: Still, I would help wheresoever I'm able. All we've achieved so far has been thanks to you two, and I mean to repay the debt I owe. I don't know what use I can be outside of placating the creatures, but I'll find a way.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_630: Nonsense, you owe us nothing. It was thanks to your knowledge of the magicks which govern this place that we were able to come this far. Elsewise we would have likely succumbed to the hippokampos's assault.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_100_630: Each of us has arrived at this dire pass by separate paths, but it is only by combining our respective expertise that we will reach the end of it and see Pandæmonium saved.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_101_63: Thank you, Themis. Hesperos's words seem to have affected me more than I realize. Together we've come this far, and together we'll reach the end.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_102_630: I have no doubt we will. Even so, let us allow   rest.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_THEMIS_000_631: Besides, you have someone awaiting a report on your progress, yes? I daresay your story will be much more than they ever imagined.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_ERICHTHONIOS_000_64: Ah, so you don't serve the Convocation. I suppose I needn't worry about you going behind our backs to curry favor with Lahabrea.

My friend would be very curious to hear what has occurred here. However, I fear that if I left Pandæmonium, the wards protecting it would quickly deteriorate. I hope  does not mind assuming some of my duties in the meantime.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_NEMJIJI_000_650: At the professor's behest, we have kept our reports on recent events as vague as we can manage. Even if we wished to do otherwise, not much of note has transpired here as of late...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_RUISSENAUD_000_655: Professor Claudien has tasked me with recording the aetherial signatures of each and every crystal in his recent orders. As a lowly assistant, I'm honored to be given such an enormous and monumental assignment!
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_700: Welcome, ! Back from the past none the worse for wear, I see. So, what did you find?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_701: So there is evil afoot in Pandæmonium─an already ominous place, I must say. Mythic beasts and missing warders... Truly, we are fortunate to see you returned to us in one piece.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_NEMJIJI_000_702: It appears the voice  heard from the crystal spoke the truth. As for who left it behind, and why, those are yet questions to be answered.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_703: Indeed. It could be someone who lived among the ancients, or it could be someone trying to avert a tragedy from the future. Much remains shrouded in mystery.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_704: Yet ilm by ilm, we shall unveil that mystery. With the help of , of course! By  actions was the fabric of the past reshaped, yet  returns to the same present  left.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_705: Which can only mean one thing: that  intervention in Pandæmonium's crisis is but one of the countless building blocks of history upon which our present has been built.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_706: There is no telling what consequences would arise if we stopped pursuing this matter now. Whatever plot is unraveling within Pandæmonium, we must not let it reach its conclusion. If one of those creatures should escape, what ripples would carry forth to the future?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_707: They might wreak havoc upon the world of the ancients, and their despair would leave an indelible mark upon history's pages. That despair would only feed the terrible beasts that arose during the Final Days.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_RUISSENAUD_000_708: The first Final Days already had a drastic effect on the eons that followed. If the scars it left were made even deeper, then we risk losing our present entirely...
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_709: Whatever the cost, our connection with the future of Elpis must be preserved. I know I have asked much of you already, but can I count on you to continue your work in Pandæmonium?
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_710: Your tireless efforts are much appreciated. If there is aught we can do to ease your burden, you need only say the word.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_711: Speaking of which, might you return the crystal into our keeping? While we cannot accompany you to the past, perhaps something can be gained by researching it further.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_712: Ah, it shines just as splendidly as the day we met! We shall begin work right away, but I cannot promise any meaningful results for some time. And as matters in Elpis seem to be in a similar state, I must ask that you rest.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_100_712: But before that, allow me to make an introduction. As our research moves into its critical stage, I found it only suitable to recruit another assistant.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_101_712: Mylenie is an expert in armaments from throughout history, be they from the far-flung past or made in the most modern forges. Should you find aught of interest in your adventures, bring it here and she will be glad to offer her services.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_102_712: We know researchers in numerous fields that would love to get their hands on artifacts from bygone eras, and would give you goods in return that should aid you in trials ahead.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_103_712: Furthermore, if you ever wish to peruse the records of events you have reported here, Nemjiji has been taking faithful and thorough notes. She is at your complete disposal.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_104_712: ...I sense that we have embarked upon something monumental. Something that will dwarf all else I have accomplished in my many years of research.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_105_712: I can think of no greater honor, nor reassurance, than to have your capable assistance in this endeavor. If there is anything to be found that will contribute to your success, we shall find it.
TEXT_AKTKRA105_04479_CLAUDIEN_000_713: We shall not rest until we have unlocked the mysteries of this crystal! And you will be the first to know when we do.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_BALDESIONSTAFF04536: Are you perchance here to see Krile? I'm given to understand she has a task for which she desires your assistance...
Then I shall fetch her at once. Pray wait a moment!
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_003: , my thanks for coming. If you're now available, I'd like you and Raha to assist me in the task I had mentioned.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_004: For you to call on , I assume the task in question is somewhat more exciting than sorting through paperwork─which, I am pleased to add, I have finished.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_005: So if  is ready, then so am I. Our venture to the Bounty has only served to whet my appetite for fieldwork!
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_006: Not to oversell things, but I suspect you won't be disappointed. Ere I divulge the details, however, permit me to provide some background.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_007: As you know, our organization, the Students of Baldesion, was founded by my grandfather, Galuf.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_008: Our stated mission was to uncover the mysteries of Hydaelyn and interpret Her will, particularly through the study of Her gift to us.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_100_008: We've since learned the whole truth, and it might be said that we've fulfilled our mission. But our work is far from over.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_009: In the course of our endeavors, we've also sought to devise countermeasures against threats that come to light. Our involvement with the Crystal Tower is an example of such.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_010: In the course of our endeavors, we've also sought to devise countermeasures against threats that come to light. Our involvement with the Warring Triad is an example of such.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_011: 'Tis my belief that, in continuing to seek out the unknown and dealing with threats, we best carry on the Students' mission.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_012: We best honor those we lost when the Isle of Val was destroyed...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_013: We best honor Grandfather and his comrades, who made the ultimate sacrifice to protect the world...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_014: Forgive me, I didn't mean to darken the mood. In saying all this, I simply wanted to clarify our organization's purpose for a new age.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_015: In line with said purpose, I've been reviewing new requests...and one in particular jumped out at me.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_100_015: It comes from none other than Rammbroes, of the Sons of Saint Coinach.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_016: Truly!? Has something happened in Mor Dhona, then?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_017: So it would seem, and he wishes to entrust the matter to us.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_018: While his missive is sparse on details, he writes that it lies beyond the Sons' expertise. “Uncharted territory” are the exact words he used.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_019: I'd like you to meet with Rammbroes and conduct a preliminary survey. What say you?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_020: Wonderful. When you are ready, pray make your way to Revenant's Toll. I shall let Rammbroes know to receive you there.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_KRILE_000_021: I must remain here to oversee our operations, but should it transpire that more hands are needed, don't hesitate to send word.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_022: Well, there's no time like the present. If you could go on ahead to Revenant's Toll, I shall make ready and then be on my way.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_040: There you are, . 'Twould seem we're early.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_042: Rammbroes, what a pleasure to see you again! How have you been?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_RAMMBROES_000_043: The pleasure is all mine, my friend. I've been well, and it gladdens me to see that you are too.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_RAMMBROES_000_044: Now, I know you have many demands upon your time, so I shall explain the particulars of our request at once.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_RAMMBROES_000_045: Recently, an explorer came to us who claimed to have discovered the phantom realm.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_046: The phantom realm!? So this is what you meant by “uncharted territory”...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_047: You're not familiar? Perhaps unsurprising, given that it is a lesser-known legend.
