TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_048: This legend holds that, across Eorzea, there exists a realm that appears as a mirage. Though visible from a distance, it fades away as one draws near.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_049: While it has featured in myth since ancient times, the realm's existence could not be proven, and thus it is seldom mentioned in literature.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_050: In spite of this, fueled by rumors of the occasional sighting, the myth has persisted, and continues to capture the hearts and minds of explorers.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_051: That you yourself should reach out to us... It is real, then?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_RAMMBROES_000_052: When first the explorer in question approached us, we doubted him. But we couldn't doubt the evidence of our senses. Nay, the realm is real─as you will soon see for yourselves.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_053: Good gods... A part of me still struggles to believe it, but we have no reason to doubt you.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_100_053: Suffice it to say we are eager to see the realm too.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_RAMMBROES_110_053: Whatever truth awaits, I pray you will succeed in finding it.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_RAMMBROES_000_054: Seek out the explorer, one Deryk. He has seen more of the realm than us, and should be willing to serve as your guide.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_RAMMBROES_000_055: I asked him to accompany me here, but he preferred to continue exploring on his own. He will be somewhere near the banks of Silvertear Lake, I expect.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_057: Come, let us split up and look for our explorer.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_SYSTEM_000_070: The explorer doesn't appear to be in the area...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_SYSTEM_100_070: You see a small opo-opo. It couldn't possibly be the explorer...or could it?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_071: Just in case you were entertaining the thought, , that opo-opo isn't our explorer. I have the man in question here with me.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_072: I am Deryk, the one who discovered the phantom realm. My apologies for making you search for me.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_073: Curious about this creature, are you?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_074: I found him injured during one of my journeys and tended to him. Since then, he has taken to following me around. He's inquisitive but otherwise harmless, so pray pay him no mind.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_076: You are the hero who delivered our star from doom, are you not? What good fortune that one as capable as you should lend  aid.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_077: To be clear, our organization has yet to accept the commission. Before we can make a decision, we would conduct a preliminary survey. Will you guide us to the phantom realm?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_078: Of course. I will show you to the entrance at once.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_079: The gate to a realm long dreamed of by explorers...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_081: Impressive, isn't it? When the gate manifested, so too did this magick, allowing one to thus walk upon water.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_A2_002: This is just like Urianger's spell!
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_082: Someone conceived the means to do this at will? An intriguing individual...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_083: It's perfectly safe, I assure you. Come.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_084: By the Twelve, you truly can walk here! What magick is this? By what means is it perpetuated?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_085: F-Forgive me. Let us continue on!
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_100_091: To think that the entrance would lie over Silvertear Lake...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_110_091: There is nothing out of the ordinary with the environment. The sights, the sounds, the smells─all appear as they should be in nature. That is to say, this place is no illusion.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_092: I bid you welcome to the navel of the phantom realm: the Omphalos.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_100: Well? Is it what you were expecting?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_110: The Omphalos, you say this place is called?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_111: A name of my own conception, I confess. I felt we needed something to call it by. Lest you wonder, the word means “navel” in an ancient tongue─an allusion to Mor Dhona's location in the heart of Aldenard.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_112: As you can see, there are man-made structures, and the place appears well-kept. Yet there isn't a single soul in evidence.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_113: 'Tis my hope that you will help me to shed light upon this realm. To learn who created it, and to what end.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_100_113: I should also like to know why it has revealed itself now. Was it simply chance that kept it hidden...or something more?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_114: In any case, let us begin by taking a look around.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_120: The opo-opo seems quite at home, wouldn't you say? How many times has Deryk come here, I wonder...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_125: Pray do not mind me. Take a look around at your leisure.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_SYSTEM_000_130: A stone monument has been erected here. By whose hand, you cannot say, but the motifs wrought into its base appear familiar...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_SYSTEM_000_131: A number of structures such as this can be seen in the area. What purpose could they possibly serve...?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_132: The architecture is unlike anything seen in Eorzea. Truly exquisite stuff...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_SYSTEM_000_134: In the distance, you see what appears to be the Crystal Tower. Though the clouds makes it difficult to be sure, it would seem that you are in the sky above Silvertear Lake.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_SYSTEM_000_135: No such isle could be seen from the outside, however...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_139: Finished looking around, have you? What are your impressions?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_140: We have had only a cursory glance, but this is truly a mysterious place.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_141: The gleaming spire rising beyond the clouds─that is most certainly the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_142: And judging by its aspect, we are a considerable distance above Silvertear Lake. Which would suggest the gate we entered is a teleporter.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_143: However, if this isle lies where it appears to lie, then it couldn't have escaped the Battle of Silvertear Skies unscathed...
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_144: Which is to say we are in Mor Dhona...and yet we are not. 'Tis as if we were displaced from our world, if only slightly.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_DERYK_000_145: Displaced is an apt way to put it. Was there aught else you noticed?
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_146: Aye. The motifs upon yonder structure─they are unmistakably the marks of the Twelve.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_147: By which I posit that this was created to be a place of worship.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_148: But by whom? I cannot think of any who could have possibly built such grand premises, never mind magically conceal it. At least, not in the wake of the Battle of Silvertear Skies.
TEXT_AKTKEA101_04536_GRAHATIA_000_149: Aye, this is a mysterious place indeed...
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_001: In like manner, perhaps, to the ruins of Amdapor in the Twelveswood. The city, I understand, reappeared when the Seventh Umbral Calamity weakened the elementals.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_011: Well, it seems there is but one solution for our ignorance: a thorough investigation!
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_012: For this, we will require more manpower and supplies, among other things.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_013: With your permission, we will confer with our representative, Krile, and make the necessary arrangements for a formal investigation.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_014: If that is what must be done to commence your work in earnest, then by all means.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_015: Without further ado, then, let us return to Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_017: (-???-)You profane this sacred realm with your very presence, and must answer for your irreverence.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_021: Let there be no doubt: we are not simulacra born of mortal faith.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_022: Nay, we Twelve are divinities true.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_023: And in Hydaelyn's absence, we are the star's rightful rulers. Its will.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_100_023: (-Spirited Woman's Voice-)Closely have we watched mankind.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_110_023: (-Spirited Woman's Voice-)And we have determined that you, champion of Hydaelyn, pose a threat to our ascension.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_RHALGR_120_023: (-Sagely Man's Voice-)You were foolish to wander into our realm. We could destroy you with ease here and now...but as divinities, we must demonstrate grace and forbearance.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_NALDTHAL_130_023: (-Measured Men's Voice-)There is but one path. We must weigh this mortal's worth.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_140_023: (-Spirited Woman's Voice-)Hear, hear! Let there be a trial.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_150_023: Hmmm... While the mortal would invariably be destroyed, it would at least provide us with a diversion.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_160_023: What!? You suddenly appear, and expect us to simply comply with your whims!?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_170_023: Protest if you wish, but mortal logic means naught to gods. You will abide by our laws.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_024: Lo! The gateway to our sanctums lies open.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_RHALGR_100_024: (-Sagely Man's Voice-)Show us the strength of mankind.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_110_024: (-Spirited Woman's Voice-)Show us the honor of mankind.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_NALDTHAL_120_024: (-Measured Men's Voice-)Show us the spirit of mankind.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_025: If man would remain the master of his own destiny, then assemble your comrades and come. Come, and prove your worthiness.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_100_025: Seven hells... During my previous forays, nothing like this ever happened. I encountered not a single soul─and certainly not gods.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_110_025: And by their own admission, they mean to take over the star. What are we to do?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_026: The situation has indeed taken an unexpected turn...but we must try to think clearly.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_027: The Twelve have long been revered and worshipped in Eorzea, and myths about Them abound.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_028: But to my knowledge, They have never thus appeared so openly before people.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_029: For these beings to suddenly reveal themselves just when we're here, claim supremacy over the star, and challenge  to a trial...
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_030: Too much about this feels odd, and it gives me pause.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_100_030: Fair enough... Yet as it stands, it seems we can't dismiss the threat either.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_A1_000_001: Whatever they are, if they're issuing challenge, then challenge accepted!
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_A1_000_002: Gaius van Baelsar once said that the Twelve, too, were simply primals.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_A1_000_003: This is turning out to be another strange affair...
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_120_030: 'Tis true that even Hydaelyn and Zodiark were primals, and we cannot discount the possibility, but we know too little to draw conclusions.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_130_030: Well, if 'twas an adventure we sought, I daresay we've found it.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_140_030: In any event, if these beings seek dominion over the star as they say, what happens here may have far-reaching implications.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_150_030: To that end, I believe we should take action. Suffice it to say you are with me?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_031: Then the Students of Baldesion will officially tend to the situation?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_032: Aye. In the course of studying the star's mysteries, we have undertaken to deal with any threats that may arise. This is no different.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_040: To think that we would encounter the Twelve...
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_050: Right, let us deliberate a course of action. Deryk─know you aught of these beings' sanctums?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_051: Aye, they are domains in the phantom realm that lie beyond each gate. I've explored them all.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_052: Perhaps due to aetheric instability, there are times when one can enter when ordinarily one cannot. But 'twould seem the way has been opened for us.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_053: While I encountered no gods during my previous forays, I saw enough to know my way around.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_054: I am but a humble explorer and cannot contend with gods. But if you would be willing to protect me, I will serve as your guide.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_056: As strong as I know you are, we know little and less about our foes. Neither their strength nor their true nature. 'Twould be decidedly reckless to contend with them unprepared.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_057: And so, as much as I would like to accompany you, I shall do what affords us the best chance at victory.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_058: While you set forth to answer the gods' challenge, I will work behind the scenes in my capacity as a Student.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_059: For one, it would behoove us to arm ourselves with knowledge about the Twelve, and I shall begin by apprising Krile of the situation.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_060: By thus utilizing our resources to the fullest, we shall overcome whatever trials await!
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_070: If you are ready to set forth, then so am I.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_KRILE_000_082: I rushed here as soon as I heard the tidings from Raha. Is this true? Beings claiming to be the Twelve have appeared?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_084: I had no doubt that you would succeed, but I'm no less impressed for it!
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_RHALGR_000_085: Gahahaha! Seldom have I felt such exhilaration!
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_RHALGR_000_086: To think that the day would come that we would put on an act for men... I must say, Byregot, you played the villain's role to perfection!
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_087: Come now, Master, I merely did what was necessary to compel the mortals to confront us.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_000_088: <sigh> Still, it pained me to speak to our beloved children so unkindly...
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_NALDTHAL_000_089: So you say, Azeyma, yet you seemed happy enough to fight them. You did not forget the true purpose of the trial, I hope?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_000_090: Well, I couldn't help but be excited. And do not tell me you felt differently!
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_000_091: Consider yourselves fortunate, children. 'Tis rare indeed to see Nald'thal in such high spirits.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_KRILE_000_092: What in the world is happening? Didn't you say you had defeated them?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_093: Did they manage to flee...or perhaps were resummoned!?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_RHALGR_000_094: Put up your weapons. You have naught to fear from us.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_095: Rest assured we are not summoned beings. We do not drain the land of aether, nor do we take men into our thrall.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_096: But...what of the gods who were summoned during the Calamity?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_100_096: The ones Master Louisoix called forth to protect the realm...
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_NALDTHAL_000_097: That was not us, but a primal born of your fervent prayers for salvation.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_000_098: Indeed. That the worst of the Calamity was averted and the realm restored in its aftermath was a direct testament to the power of your hopes.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_A2_000_001: If you aren't primals, then what are you?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_A2_000_002: Do you truly intend to rule the world?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_A2_000_003: Why choose to appear before us now?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_099: ...Just as men harbor hopes, so too do we gods.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_100: To realize our aspirations, 'tis essential that we do battle with you. Thus did I falsely claim that we sought to rule the world.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_101: 'Twas deceitful conduct unworthy of a divinity, and I must apologize. Not only for that, but for using my power to do harm besides.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_KRILE_000_102: These hopes of yours─won't you tell us what they are?
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_NALDTHAL_100_102: We cannot. If you wish to know the truth, you must discover it for yourselves.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_AZEYMA_110_102: 'Tis not easy to move forward when there is seemingly no destination. But if you press on, you will eventually arrive at the answers you seek.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_RHALGR_000_103: Aye, you will understand why we hold our peace, and far more besides. You will learn the very truth of our existence.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_BYREGOT_000_106: Go forth, mortals, and seek knowledge of us. And when the time is right, we shall meet again in this place.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_GRAHATIA_000_110: We have met and exchanged words with the Twelve... When I pause to think, I can scarce believe it.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_DERYK_000_0115: When I first explored the phantom realm, it appeared to be unoccupied. To think that it was home to the gods...
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_KRILE_000_0120: As if hearing about your battling the Twelve weren't shocking enough, to have them appear before my very eyes... Suffice it to say it's been an interesting day.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_KRILE_000_121: While much about them remains shrouded in mystery, at least they seem open to reason. In considering our next step, I should very much like to hear your detailed account of them.
TEXT_AKTKEA102_04537_KRILE_000_122: Right after I have a word with our client, that is. Please give me a moment to introduce myself, and then we can review the situation.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_000: 'Tis well Krile could make her way here quickly.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_005: She's another one of your colleagues, I take it?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_010: Greetings. I am Krile, of the Students of Baldesion. Do I have the pleasure of addressing Deryk, the explorer who sought aid in investigating this place?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_011: Aye, I am Deryk. And this here is a baby opo-opo.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_012: Yes, I can see that. Doesn't it have a name?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_013: None that I know of. Nor would I presume to bestow one, for that would be condescending.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_014: I see. That's very considerate of you.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_015: So, I understand you explored the various phantom realms with Deryk. Will you recount to me the experience?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_016: So while the gods tested you sorely, you did not sense any malicious intent...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_100_016: As Byregot said, they wish to do battle with us. But 'twould seem they do not necessarily wish to cause us harm.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_017: Though much and more about this perplexes, mayhap 'tis safe to assume that they are not primals.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_018: As you may recall, Livingway once told us that the art of summoning as taught by the Ascians incorporates the fervent desire to assimilate others into one's belief.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_019: Thus do the resultant primals seek to enthrall worshipers, who in turn seek to grow their ranks.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_020: But these beings appear to harbor no such desire. If they are primals, then they are unlike those that have been summoned in recent memory.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_021: We might suppose that they were created in antiquity in like manner to Hydaelyn, but there is no way to prove it.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_022: Who could they possibly be? And why do they desire battle with man?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_EMETSELCH_000_023: (-Emet-Selch-)Even of your little Eorzea, you know precious little. The true identities of the Twelve, for instance.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_024: Emet-Selch did say that, didn't he?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_100_024: By which we may assume he knew the truth...and challenged you to seek it out too. Suffice it to say you'll do so, of course?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_025: Insofar as we can ascertain, this is a matter which has implications for the entire star. In light of this, the Students of Baldesion formally accept the commission. We will investigate the phantom realm and the beings who call themselves the Twelve.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_026: I'm pleased to hear that. Thank you.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_027: Without further ado, then, I will take a look around. There are a few things I'm curious about.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_028: Then with your permission, I will take myself around Eorzea and investigate the worship of those gods we encountered.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_029: , Deryk. Seeing as you've already seen this place, would you care to accompany me?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_030: By all means. In which case...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_031: Could you stay here with Krile, my friend? It wouldn't do to leave a fair maiden alone.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_033: Hehe, I shall be glad for the company. Take care, then, and good luck.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_KRILE_000_040: Raha has also shared his observations with me. Keeping your combined accounts in mind, I shall see what else I can learn here.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_047: Shall we ask G'raha Tia about his plan?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_051: 'Tis believed that the Twelve were already worshipped during the Third Astral Era, when the Allagan Empire flourished.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_052: Come the Fifth Astral Era, those nations that fought in the War of the Magi each took one of the Twelve as a guardian deity.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_053: This practice has continued to the present day in Eorzea, with some notable regional differences. For instance, Ishgardians hold Halone as absolute, while Sharlayans enjoy a moderate relationship with Thaliak.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_054: By visiting various locations in Eorzea and learning about the Twelve as They are worshipped, I hope to identify any similarities or differences between Them and the beings we encountered.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_055: In so doing, I believe we will draw closer to the truth of their identities.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_056: For our first destination, I propose we take ourselves to Rhalgr's Reach. The place is holy ground for worshipers of the Destroyer, and promises to yield useful details.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_061: This place served as the base of operations for your investigation into Omega, did it not? How delightful to be here together!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_062: So, this is Rhalgr's Reach, where the dauntless soldiers of the Ala Mhigan Resistance gathered... How stirring to stand here with you!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_063: If you don't mind my making an observation, it seems you enjoy traveling with company.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_064: I do. It's something I had dreamed of for a long time.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_A1_000_001: There's nothing like traveling with good friends.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_A1_000_002: I enjoy company, but sometimes I prefer my own.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_066: What of yourself? Do you normally travel alone?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_067: Aye. In my wanderings, I much prefer to have solitude.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_068: Not that I avoid people or communities, mind you. As a matter of fact, I've been here before, on the trail of the phantom realm.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_069: Hmmm, now that I think on it...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_070: More often than not, those places where phantom realm sightings are known to occur have a tradition of Twelve worship.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_071: Then I dare to hope that we are on the right track.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_100_071: As I'm sure you know, Rhalgr's Reach is home to the Temple of the Fist, the ancient headquarters of the Fist of Rhalgr.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_072: Razed by the mad king Theodoric, the temple lay abandoned before the Ala Mhigan Resistance claimed it for its operations.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_073: While I doubt that much literature has survived over the years, the people here may possess some knowledge of the local faith.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_074: So let us split up and make inquiries, and reconvene here afterwards to share findings.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_SYSTEM_000_089: You read the words inscribed on the monument...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_SYSTEM_000_090:
(-Bloodstorm-)A storm of blood approaches fast,
Hells open, Heavens weep.
For no one soul doth lie beyond
The measure of His Reach.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_SYSTEM_000_091: Once upon a time, Lyse explained to you their meaning─that we must prepare ourselves for the strife and sorrow that will inevitably come.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_ALAMHIGANLIBERATOR0: Oh, if it isn't ! Is this man perchance a friend of yours?
When last he visited, he shared with me the tales he heard on his journeys. And what amazing tales they were!
If you have time, I'd love to hear both of your stories!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_095: Alas, we're in some haste. We're investigating the worship of Rhalgr, and seek literature on the subject─religious texts and the like. Can any still be found here?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_ALAMHIGANLIBERATOR0: Just about all of it is gone, sadly─destroyed by the Empire if not the mad king before that.
But we haven't lost everything. The mighty image of the Destroyer... The tales we share at the campfire, like the legend of our nation's founding...
We still have these things, and they were a source of great comfort and strength to us in our darkest moments.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_099: I see. If you don't mind, I would be obliged to hear your stories this time.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_100: , rest assured I have this well in hand. Feel free to carry on as you were.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_SCHOLAR04538_101: ...Yes? If you have business, please make it quick. I'm due to meet with someone any moment now.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_103: Hm? You're an adventurer, I take it? What can we students of Ala Mhigan history do for you?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_104: Researching the worship of the Destroyer, you say! In that case, I have something that ought to be of interest!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_105: Why, if it isn't the adventurer who kindly escorted me to the Temple of the Fist! Are you studying monks too, perchance?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_106: If so, you ought to work together with me and my colleague here! Few things are finer than joining heads with like-minded folk!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_107: Researching the worship of the Destroyer, you say! Why didn't you mention it sooner!?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_108: This is a copy of Destructivity, a scripture of the Fist of Rhalgr. The original is one of the few texts that survived the temple's razing, and is in the safekeeping of one Professor Erik.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_109: This is a copy of Destructivity, a scripture of the Fist of Rhalgr. The original is one of the few texts that survived the temple's razing, and was recovered by a monk named Widargelt.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_110: I went to the trouble of having this made for my colleague...only for her to say she doesn't need it. So I will offer it to you instead!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_SCHOLAR04538_111: <sigh> Lest you forget, this is your passion, not mine. I'm simply assisting you as a favor, and I'd thank you not to put us in danger.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_112: Ah, but danger is the crucible in which the monk tempers body and mind! <sigh> So sublime, monks...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_MARJORIE_113: Well, we had best return to our work! Till next time, adventurer!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_ALAMHIGANLIBERATOR0: Next time, I hope to hear some of your stories too!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_121: , what were you able to learn?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_122: A copy of one of the scriptures, you say? A moment while I skim over it!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_123: I see... This chapter appears to be a record of the construction of the great image of Rhalgr, written in a style that suggests folklore was committed to parchment.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_124: When the deluge of the Sixth Umbral Calamity threatened Eorzea, the ancestors of the Ala Mhigans were guided to safety by a comet.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_125: Believing that it was sent by Rhalgr, they came to hold Him in the highest. This much of the tale, I had been familiar with...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_126: But according to the scripture, among those refugees who followed the comet, some claimed to have caught sight of Rhalgr Himself.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_127: Their accounts were passed down through the centuries, and worshipers of the Destroyer pieced them together to give shape to yonder statue.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_128: I must say, it bears more than a passing resemblance to the being we encountered...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_129: Were that Rhalgr a primal, the explanation for the similarities would be simple.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_130: That is, the statue gives rise to a unified interpretation of Rhalgr's appearance, which in turn lends form to the primal.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_131: However, this fails to account for what inspired the likeness in the first place. If the scripture is to be believed, it was the sightings during the Sixth Umbral Calamity. Yet for those witnesses to be able to recognize Rhalgr, they would have needed an agreed-upon idea of His appearance beforehand.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_132: If we then consider the history of Twelve worship─that it already existed in the Third Astral Era─it would not be ridiculous to think that these divinities existed even prior to that.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_133: So the question is, did these beings give rise to their respective faiths, or are they primals born of them?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_RHALGR_000_134: (-Rhalgr's Voice-)I thought we had made it clear. We are not summoned beings.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_RHALGR_000_135: (-Hawk with Rhalgr's Voice-)Since time immemorial, our domains have lain scattered across Eorzea. As a matter of fact, one of those in which you set foot is nearby. 'Tis not unusual for mortals to glimpse us.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_BYREGOT_000_137: Indeed. I am Byregot, and the hawk beside me is Rhalgr. I shall elaborate upon my master's explanation.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_BYREGOT_000_138: We thus disguise ourselves when we wish to observe the world without, for being seen in our true forms would violate our laws of conduct.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_BYREGOT_000_139: Yet though we similarly disguise our sanctums, veiling them in illusion, rents are known to manifest when the surrounding aether is unstable.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_RHALGR_000_140: In such a time, should a gifted mortal chance to be near, they may inadvertently catch sight of us.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_141: Of course! During an Umbral Calamity, aetheric imbalance occurs on a star-wide scale─the ideal condition for seeing the phantom realm!
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_RHALGR_000_142: Precisely how many times we have been seen, we ourselves have no way of knowing, but aye─that is a sound assumption to make.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_RHALGR_000_143: Well, Byregot, I believe that much shall suffice by way of an apology for our deception. Shall we?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_BYREGOT_000_144: Indeed, that is all we are at liberty to reveal. Fare you well, children of man.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_150: Aside from their reticence where it concerns their identity and objective, these divinities are certainly approachable.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_151: If what they said was true, and their worship can be traced back to their sightings, it would serve to explain one thing.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_152: According to my research, in the field of comparative mythology, Rhalgr is often observed to bear many similarities with Ramuh.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_153: Assuming both were inspired by the Rhalgr of the phantom realm...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_154: Their divergence may be attributable to differences in culture between man and sylph.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_155: So you believe that they gave rise to the prevailing faiths of Eorzea?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_156: Given available evidence, yes─I am inclined to. Yet none of this explains their presence. How and when did beings of such power come into existence?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_158: ...Truly!? Very well, I shall take care of it.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_159: Krile has recruited an acquaintance to aid in our investigation─an authority on mythology.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_160: I must go and receive her at the Sunken Temple of Qarn, where she is currently conducting fieldwork─after a brief detour to prepare...a little something.
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_161: Conveniently, Thanalan is home to countless adherents of Nald'thal. While I tend to business, may I ask the two of you to make inquiries in Ul'dah?
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_GRAHATIA_000_163: Excellent. I will join you as soon as I'm able. By your leave...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_170: So, it's to be just you and me in Ul'dah...
TEXT_AKTKEA103_04538_DERYK_000_171: <sigh> I suppose it can't be helped...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_000: What strange manners for the one who proposed the survey to so promptly abandon it.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_001: I'll not lie: I am not given to working one-on-one with another. But I suppose I agreed to this arrangement.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_002: <sigh> Well, we had best be on our way...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_003: As I recall, Milvaneth Sacrarium is still closed for construction, so let us try our luck at Arrzaneth Ossuary.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_004: You have no objection to traveling separately, I trust? Good. I shall see you in Ul'dah.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_007: Raha has also shared his observations with me. Keeping your combined accounts in mind, I shall see what else I can learn here.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_011: Of the deific twins Nald'thal, here they worship Thal, who keeps the realm of the dead and weighs the worth of men's souls.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_012: In contrast, Nald keeps the world of the living and oversees their financial fortunes.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_013: Their names are borne by many a location, and religious organizations─some extremely wealthy and powerful─exist to nurture faith in them.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_014: On the surface, it may seem strange that a hub of commerce such as Ul'dah could be home to such spiritual people. But it is actually quite logical when one considers that their religion is, in essence, commerce.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_015: In any event, Nald'thal is a truly unusual divinity.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_016: What was originally held to be one god came to be worshipped as twins.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_017: Indeed, rather than two distinct entities, that which we encountered was a single being possessed of two personalities.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_PRIEST04539_100_017: D-Did I mishear? Did he just say they encountered Nald'thal?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_018: And while his appearance differs somewhat to the divinities worshipped, it cannot be denied that there are striking similarities in their nature.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_A1_000_002: Perhaps we should avoid talking about that here.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_019: F-Forgive me, this is hardly the place for such a conversation... Let us continue it elsewhere!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_030: 'Twas careless of me to openly speak of our encounter with a divinity within a place where he is worshipped.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_031: Hereon, I shall exercise greater caution.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_100_031: I thank you for alerting me to my indiscretion...and ask that you keep it between us.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_032: Now then, to finish our conversation... As I mentioned, though the Nald'thal as worshipped by men appears somewhat different, there are undeniable similarities in their nature. I believe we may report this much to G'raha Tia.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_033: With that, our work here is done. Rather than waiting for our companion to arrive, perhaps we might seek him out at the Sunken Temple?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_034: He mentioned needing to make a detour. Were we to set out now, we ought to be able to catch up to him.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_035: After all, we hardly know one another. Rather than loiter with an unfamiliar person, 'tis better to use our time productively. Wouldn't you agree?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_036: Then let us head to the Sunken Temple of Qarn at once.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_040: Are you all right? If you hear me, please say something.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_051: You're here, thank goodness. I found this woman collapsed, though I can see no obvious injuries. By her attire, she appears to be some manner of scholar.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_052: Water... Food... In my bag... Please...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_053: I see... ─may I trouble you to find her bag? I will stand lookout in the meantime.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_060: If I understand her correctly, her bag is somewhere nearby. Please find it.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_065: My bag... Somewhere out there... Unnngh...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SYSTEM_000_070: Examining the bag, you find a skin with a little water left, but there appears to be no provender.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SYSTEM_000_071: For now, you decide to take the water to the woman.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_081: Not enough... Food... I need food...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_082: I have naught save dried meat, tough as leather. Do you have anything easier to consume?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_083: , Deryk! What are you doing here?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_085: Steady, Snoegeim! I've brought you Archon loaf and coffee─made sweet and creamy, just as you like it.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_086: (-Snoegeim-)Ahhhhhh, I am reborn! Washed down with a sweet beverage, the life-giving nutrients of Archon loaf permeate my being from head to toe!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_100_086: (-Snoegeim-)Thank you, kind stranger! However you knew my preferred source of sustenance, you are truly a godssend!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_087: (-Snoegeim-)...Oh, it's you, Raha! What brings you here? I don't recall mentioning my fieldwork. It's for my research into the Belah'dians' worship of Azeyma, you see...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_088: Haven't you heard from Krile? The Students are presently investigating the Twelve, and we would prevail upon your expertise.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_089: May I introduce Snoegeim, expert mythologist. She is a collaborator of the Students, and like many a Sharlayan scholar, is passionate about her endeavors to the point of forgetting to eat.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_090: Seeing as she has recovered, may I ask the two of you to tell her about the phantom realm?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_091: (-Snoegeim-)The Twelve abide in the phantom realm...and you exchanged not only words with them, but blows besides!? Incredible!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_092: (-Snoegeim-)And your description of the domains─a thunderous tower in one and a sweltering city in another─are precisely as the Heavens of Lightning and Fire are depicted in legend!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_093: (-Snoegeim-)In ancient times, worshipers of the Twelve believed that there exist seven heavens and seven hells.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_094: (-Snoegeim-)Aetherology has since established that departed souls return to the aetherial sea...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_100_094: (-Snoegeim-)But it seems those afterlife domains were more than just inventions of mortal imagination!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_095: (-Snoegeim-)As a pursuer of myths, I must say it feels somewhat anticlimactic to suddenly have these revelations given to me...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_096: (-Snoegeim-)But more than that, I'm dying to know more! Which is to say: please allow me to join your investigation!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_097: ...Ahem. We would, of course, welcome your presence. Without further ado, then, let us head to the Omphalos. Krile awaits us there.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_100: Welcome back, everyone─and welcome, Snoegeim! I'm glad you could join us.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_101: Krile, how delightful to see you again! I understand you've been doing a fine job leading the Students.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_102: But may I say what a lovely place this is! At a glance, this appears to be the highest of the heavens of legend: the seventh heaven!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_103: And oooh, if those aren't symbols representing the other heavens! I take it those are their respective gateways. I should like to pay them all a visit!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_104: For Snoegeim's benefit, let us review what we have learned thus far, and thence deliberate the next step.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_105: ...The gods reappeared before us in Rhalgr's Reach, though they were disguised as unassuming creatures; their laws forbid them from showing their true forms outside their realm.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_100_105: Yet in the event the ambient aether becomes unstable, such as during an Umbral Calamity, it is possible for the realm─and indeed, the gods themselves─to be glimpsed by mortals.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_106: And such sightings, we believe, have given rise to the various faiths practiced throughout Eorzea.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_107: As we confirmed in Ul'dah, the Nald'thal worshipped by people and the Nald'thal we encountered here have more similarities than they do differences.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_108: In the course of exploring the Omphalos, two things caught my attention.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_100_108: The first is the gate which lies in the innermost area.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_110_108: If each of the other six gates lead to an elementally aspected heaven, and we stand in the seventh heaven as Snoegeim says...
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_109: What, then, lies beyond that last gate?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_110: The second is this monument. It harbors some manner of magic, unlike anything I've seen before. I will endeavor to decipher it, but it will take time.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_111: Divinities that have existed since time immemorial, who abide in domains resembling the heavens of legend... Why have they chosen to reveal themselves to mortals, seeking battle?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_100_111: Unless they favor us with more of their secrets, 'twould seem this monument holds the key to solving the mystery.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_110_111: Indeed. Much and more yet lies beyond our understanding, but we'll keep chasing the truth together.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_112: As I'm sure you'll agree, though, this is tiring work, both mentally and physically. We need to pace ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_113: To which end, might I suggest we return to Revenant's Toll and have a rest before we embark on the next stage of our investigation?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_121: So rarely do I get to simply chat with colleagues, I had fairly forgotten what it felt like.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_122: Indeed. And it's quite fitting that we should be doing so here at the Seventh Heaven.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_123: “Fitting”? That's an understatement if I have ever heard one!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_124: The seventh and highest of the heavens, which rules over the remaining six, was right here in Mor Dhona all this time!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_125: This isn't “fitting,” my friends! It's destiny!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_126: You are obviously well versed in the myths surrounding the heavens and hells. If you don't mind, I should like to hear your thoughts on them.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_127: Invested as they are in their research, it doesn't take much to stoke their passions. My apologies if it makes you uncomfortable.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_128: Having always traveled alone, I'm admittedly not too familiar with such a lively atmosphere. But...I do not mislike it.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_GRAHATIA_000_129: By the way, the two of you arrived at the Sunken Temple rather quickly. Did something happen?
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_130: Well, as pleasant as this has been, it's past time we returned to the annex. The paperwork for this commission isn't going to complete itself, alas.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_SNOEGEIM_000_131: Then I shall take myself to the Omphalos. There's so much there that I'd like to see!
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_133: I believe I will go for a walk nearby. It's getting a little warm in here.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_KRILE_000_134: All right. Do take care, now.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_140: Oh, ... It's pleasant, isn't it? The smells and sounds of a tavern. It makes one feel...alive.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_141: And afterwards stepping outside alone and breathing the cool air... I like that just as much.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_142: While we await developments, I shall remain here in Revenant's Toll. If there are any tidings, rest assured I will share them with you.
TEXT_AKTKEA104_04539_DERYK_000_143: Thank you for your help thus far─I doubt so much could have been accomplished without you.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SCIENTIST04586_000_: Hrngh! Ah, that's blown the cobwebs away. Time to return to work...
Goodness me, look who it is! How incredibly serendipitous that I would run into you of all people!
I was part of the team which designed the Ragnarok, you see, and we've recently begun the process of combing through the vessel's flight log data.

The primary objective of your journey to Ultima Thule was to save our star and countless others, of course, but it also provided us with an invaluable trove of information─records of places and events we could only dream of.
Your safe return gave us much to be thankful for.
As it so happens, one of the things we pulled from the log was a transmission of unknown origin. Something the ship must have intercepted during its flight...
We believe it to be an audio message, but even our most knowledgeable scholars have been unable to decipher its content─Professor Rurusha included.
We believe it to be an audio message, but even our most talented linguists have been unable to decipher the language.
For a while there, it seemed we must accept defeat. But today may be the day that we finally solve the mystery!
If you were so inclined, would you care to come along to Thaumazein? It seems fitting to have one of the Ragnarok's original passengers present to hear history being made.
Ah, there you are! This is where we're to meet the engineers from Garlond Ironworks, who, I am told, potentially hold the key to unlocking our mystery transmission.
They should be along at any moment...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_022: (-???-)Sorry we're late. We had some trouble finding the right─ Gods, is that you, !?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SCIENTIST04586_000_: Yes! The ! I ran into  at the harbor, and thought if anyone deserved to hear this message deciphered, it was .
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_024: No argument here. But bugger me if you don't have a knack for being in the right place at the right time...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_025: This actually has more to do with you than you might think, so please, do stick around.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SCIENTIST04586_000_: Shall we pick up from where we left off, then?
As I was saying, we think this transmission the Ragnarok intercepted is a message of some kind─albeit in a language entirely alien to our ears.
“Alien” being the operative word here. Considering we received the message out in the great expanse, its origin was likely some distant star.
Unfortunately, our list of off-world allies is presently rather short. Thus we were resigned to the fact that the meaning behind the message would remain beyond our understanding.

One of my colleagues, however, refused to give up. She remembered the Ironworks engineers who had been so helpful in the construction of the Ragnarok, and turned to them for insight into our seemingly impossible problem.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_031: Do you know what Wedge said when he heard what was going on?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_032: “We should have Omega listen to it. I bet it can tell us what the message means!”
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_033: Not the Omega you beat in the rift, of course. He's talking about the toy that trundles around with Alpha─the little model we made.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_034: We originally designed it to follow a chosen target and not much else, but I've seen it act in ways that...well, it's like it has a mind of its own.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_035: Then I got to thinking about those documents your lot sent the chief. The full report on the Final Days...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_036: In the part about Omega's civilization, it said their people discovered how to convert the mind into data and store it outside the body.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_037: Timing being what it was, I wonder if Omega didn't somehow transfer its consciousness into our model right before you put an end to the real one.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_038: So! In an effort to get to the bottom of that, as well as take a crack at this indecipherable message, we decided to make some modifications.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_039: With help from Labyrinthos technicians, we've upgraded our toy Omega with a fully functional vocalization module!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_WEDGE_000_040: We played the transmission for Omega, and I think it's ready to share!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_044: Affirmative...if by “Omega” you are referring to my consciousness, rather than my entire former chassis, existing inside this considerably smaller frame.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_045: ...Hello. Your greeting is a standard method for initiating communication, but in this case, it was imperative that you first establish my true identity.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_046: Without confirming I am Omega, any subsequent interaction must allow for the probability that you are wasting time addressing a mere toy.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_047: Prediction. You will formulate several misconceptions. These, I shall preemptively dismiss based on the following facts...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_048: One. Vocalization module aside, this chassis remains unmodified from the design constructed by the engineers Biggs and Wedge. I evaluate its combat capabilities to be on par with a mortal infant.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_049: Two. The mechanism which allowed me to perform an emergency transfer of my consciousness was installed in my previous body. With the destruction of that body, I am rendered incapable of replicating such a feat.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_050: Should this current material form be destroyed or cease to function, all cognitive awareness or presence I possess will also be lost.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_051: Conclusion. I present no threat to you or your star, nor do my projections indicate the necessity to inflict harm.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_052: In the fraction of a moment before my annihilation in the rift, I...reexamined my directives.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_053: If I am to fulfill my purpose as an evolving construct, then I must continue my journey for improvement for as long as I exist. I must acquire this “heart” of yours. This “strength of soul.”
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_054: Well, there you have it. And it's not wrong about its “combat capabilities”─it'd be more likely to damage itself than the thing it was trying to attack.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_055: But let's not forget the reason we brought you here in the first place. What about the transmission they played for you? Could you recognize the language?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_056: Affirmative. It was transmitted in pan-galactic basic.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_058: A common language in comparatively extensive usage throughout the worlds we have conquered.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SCIENTIST04586_000_: Which means you can finally tell us what the message said! That is a language you understand, yes?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_060: I understand it perfectly. I am fluent in over six million distinct dialectal codings. <blip>
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_061: My cooperation in this matter, however, is conditional.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_062: Elaboration. Your chief Cid utilizes the floor as part of his unorthodox filing system, which allowed me to scan the report on the Final Days.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_063: I am aware that my home star─the one you call “Alphatron”─was obliterated in the aftermath of Sir and Meteion's meeting.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_064: The existence of dynamis has not previously factored into my projections, but I now comprehend the concept. In theory.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_065: What fails to compute is why the Omicrons were not immune to its effects. Dynamis should have no influence on a race which possesses no “heart.”
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_066: And yet, Sir expressed to Meteion a desire to cease existing. Illogical.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_067: I must pursue this anomaly further, until the full equation becomes clear to me. I must analyze all the elements of the Final Days, and deepen my understanding of the heart's intangible properties.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_068: To expedite this process, I require an external interpretation of those sections of the report which continue to produce errors in my calculations.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_069: I request the assistance of . As one who experienced the ravages of ultimate despair on multiple fronts, and displayed immeasurable “heart” in engineering my defeat,  is the optimal choice to fulfill this role.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_070: So we either agree to your conditions, or you tell us nothing...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_071: I'm sorry to put you in a spot like this, . If you have the time─and the patience─to spare, we'd all be grateful if you could humor the toy's demands.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_WEDGE_000_072: Has Alpha dozed off? I suppose the subject was a bit technical...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_073: <bloop> Rouse yourself, Alpha. You must listen to and consider these matters, even as I must.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_WEDGE_000_075: Why don't you make a trip out of it? You know, actually visit the places that has the, uh...things Omega wants to ask about.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_WEDGE_000_076: It'll make explaining stuff easier, for one, and also help keep Alpha awake and alert!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_080: Omega has been an outright terror to us in the past, but it's almost strange how little it frightens me now.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_081: It helps that it's trapped inside that tiny model, of course...and that it follows Alpha around like a puppy.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_082: But most of all I remember the chief telling me how much it sounded like a lost child there at the end.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_WEDGE_000_085: I bet the chief won't see this one coming! Once he gets over the shock, though, I don't think he'll want us to destroy Omega.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_WEDGE_000_086: Nero, on the other hand... He'll want to use the model for some dangerous experiment. In fact, maybe we should put off making a report for now!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SCIENTIST04586_000_: What a remarkable development. Biggs and Wedge told me much of your encounter with Omega before we began. And now that we have the Omicron's weapon talking, there are so many questions I am simply dying to ask.
Back when we were first exploring our options, we did actually consider playing the transmission to the inhabitants of Ultima Thule.
The problem is, we would be dealing with beings recreated through dynamis. Their communication is based on emotional energy, and anything lacking that vital component would likely fail to register.
That rules out a recorded message. And so we focused on the resources we had to hand, never dreaming that the solution would all but fall into our lap!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_100: I see you have chosen the mutually beneficial option. Logical.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_101: Setting aside the matter of Sir, there are three elements of the report on which I desire clarification.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_102: The first of these concerns the progression of the Final Days in Radz-at-Han. I recognized no pattern in those who succumbed to the transformation, and those who did not.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_BIGGS_000_103: That's a bit of a trek if you wanted to chat with the locals. How about we lend you an airship?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_104: We do not require such outmoded technology. 's teleportation spell is the most efficient option for long-distance travel.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_105: This chassis is a model─essentially a toy. And Alpha, despite his organic composition, is indistinguishable from a stuffed doll.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_106: Conclusion. We qualify as material possessions. Pick us up, and you can teleport the three of us to our destination.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_120: <blip> Sensors indicate we have arrived in Radz-at-Han. Objective. Identify factors for resistance to involuntary transformation.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_121: Hypothesis. Unaltered survivors of the Final Days will display significant strength of heart.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_122: Confirming this theory will require the cooperation of live subjects. Where is the ward designated for residential habitation?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_123: Understood. “Kama” set as our sub-destination. Please take the lead and select the subjects we are to interview.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_124: Omega and Alpha are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_125: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_126: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_135: This body has no advanced navigational or geoscanning functionality. You must lead the way.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_100_135: Please continue the questioning. These auditory sensors are inferior, but I am able to hear your conversations with sufficient clarity.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_A4_000_137: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_138: Acceptable. We will await your return at the aetheryte plaza. Please complete your task swiftly and efficiently.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_140: Alpha sprints away in the direction of the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_143: Omega and Alpha have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_144: Warning. Please avoid stairs whenever possible. My projections indicate high-risk probability for accidental slippage leading to catastrophic structural damage.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_145: Stepped inclines also increase my energy consumption by sixty-three percent. In mortal terms, they “tire me out.”
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_146: Taking into account the difference in individual limb length, the design is inherently flawed. A convenient step height for one is an exhausting trial for another.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_147: Were I to oversee the civic design of this settlement, I would construct a sloped conveyor belt which enabled automatic traversal. Zero personal energy expenditure.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_149: Alpha chirps enthusiastically, apparently unfazed by the prospect of climbing the stairs.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_150: Oh, hello again! You're the one who came to ask me about Khalzahl, aren't you? Was there something else...?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_151: You should have Omega and Alpha accompanying you before initiating conversation.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_152: Oh, hello again! You're the one who came to ask me questions about Khalzahl! I'm glad to see you looking well after all that unpleasantness...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_153: I remember the burning skies and hearing the screams, but truth be told, I'm still confused as to what actually happened.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_154: I only know it wasn't unusual for entire families to go missing. Many of my neighbors' houses lie empty even now.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_155: Khalzahl's place is one of them. He had no close relatives to speak of, and I heard that it was members of the consortium who came to remove his belongings.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_156: What a terrible thing to have to do...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_157: <blip> Terrible? Khalzahl's passing was recorded in the report.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_158: Clearing out his domicile and readying it for new habitation seems an appropriate reallocation of resources.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_159: Dear me, what a clever little contraption. But of course I'm not against making use of his quarters─that would be wasteful.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_160: It's simply that Khalzahl was always such a vigorous person. All that passion, all those dreams, suddenly gone...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_161: I feel the same sorrow for everyone who was lost. Seeing the remnants of those vibrant lives packed away in boxes... That is what I mean by “terrible.”
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_162: , I require a moment to process this input. Let us move apart and discuss our findings.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_163: That awful “end of days” business almost brought an end to Khalzahl's consortium.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_MAHTI_000_164: It's heartening, though, watching those who survived work to carry on his legacy. Maybe it's time I put aside my own grief, and did something to help.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_171: Hey, don't I know you...? Yes! After the beasts were taken care of! You told me to join everyone in the square.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_172: Thanks to you, I was there when Vrtra gave his speech...and I found out who Varshahn really was.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_173: It's a shame we don't get to play like we used to, but Mama says Vrtra has been busy putting the city back in order.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_174: Maybe I can work for him one day, when I'm a man grown.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_175: Vrtra... Midgardsormr's offspring, yes? And this child wishes to put himself at the wyrm's command, that he might make his own contribution to society.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_176: A pattern emerges. I predict that the Hannish survivors are those who had ingested Vrtra's blood, and become his draconic minions.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_177: Though dragons were no match for our civilization's might, their combat capabilities are not to be underestimated.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_178: It is unlikely they would experience emotions of “dread” or “uncertainty” as exhibited by lesser beings in times of undue stress.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_179: Dragons? I'm not a dragon! And I never “ingested” anyone's blood, either! Ew...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_180: You are not of Vrtra's horde? So you possessed no hidden means to fight off the beasts. What of fear, then? You were...frightened?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_181: Yes, I was frightened! I just hid and hoped they wouldn't find me! At least until  told me it was safe to come out.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_182: I still see Varshahn around from time to time, you know. They say he uses that body to scout places where his “Vrtra body” can't fit.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_HANNISHBOYB_000_183: He even talked to me once, but it was just too strange hearing grown-up words coming from Varshahn's mouth...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_GLOOMYMAN04586_000_: <sigh> Hm? Are you a traveler? Please, if you have a moment, I could use an outsider's perspective.
You see, I was one of those who sought to escape the madness plaguing the world by fleeing to the moon. Not that we ever went, in the end...
So here I am, recently returned from Sharlayan. Except now things are strained between my sister and I, since she chose to stay and I chose to leave.
I ask her to help me find work, and she suggests I look “somewhere that isn't Thavnair.” As if I wanted to abandon my home! Argh, it makes me so angry...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_195: <blip> Your point is unclear. You elected to relocate to the star's satellite, thus your relative now perceives you in a negative light?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_196: Your sibling's judgment is in error. Based on the information made available to Hannish citizens, your decision to withdraw to the moon was both logical and correct.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_197: Conversely, the decision to remain in Radz-at-Han despite the low probability of survival defies explanation. Perhaps her reasoning pathways are faulty.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_GLOOMYMAN04586_000_: That... That's right! I'm not quite sure what you're saying, but I'm right, aren't I!?
...Or so I'd like to think. The problem is, I understand why my sister feels this way.
I almost decided against going myself. Even then, I wasn't sure that leaving behind everything I loved was the right choice. And with the way it all turned out, I... <sigh>
I know, I know, I should be having this talk with my sister. I'll go and see her once I get my thoughts in order. Thank you for listening to my troubles...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_210: <blip> Input overload. I must have time and distance from the subjects to process this data.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_221: Omega seems reluctant to continue without Alpha present. Be sure to have the chocobo with you.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_222: <blip> Processing data. Evaluating hypothesis against accumulated evidence.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_223: I offered an optimal analysis of each subject's testimony. Yet each time their responses conflicted with my assessment...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_224: Without identifying the root cause of this conflict, I will be unable to properly define what constitutes “strength of heart.”
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_A5_000_226: Perhaps the heart you seek lies in the conflict itself?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_A5_000_227: Perhaps we should continue the questioning.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_A5_000_228: Perhaps this matter is beyond you...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_229: An interesting observation. It is possible my base criteria is in error.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_230: In which case, it is imperative that I continue this learning process, and repair any fundamental misconceptions.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_231: Acknowledged. A larger sample size will increase the probability of discovering an underlying pattern.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_232: <blip> Your response implies an absolute understanding of the answer I seek. Impressive, considering you understand not a single word of pan-galactic basic.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_233: We will forge on with the questioning. Continue to educate me with your enlightened perspective.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_234: Next, I wish to interact with an individual who endured similar circumstances to Khalzahl prior to his transformation. Are you acquainted with any local merchants who had dealings with him?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_235: <blip> Djinabaha of Ruveydah Fibers? Acknowledged. Sub-destination set.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_241: Objective. Speak with Djinabaha of Ruveydah Fibers. What imperceptible qualities allowed him to survive where Khalzahl did not?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_243: Halt, . Do not proceed beyond the fence.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_244: In this body, birds of that size represent lethal, unthinking threats. They will peck my casing apart, searching for meat that does not exist.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_245: Conversely, Alpha can correctly identify my absence of nutritional content. If only he would apply that intelligence towards maintaining a regular feeding schedule─poor habits adversely affect his mobility.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_247: Alpha looks back and forth between Omega and the hamsa, showing visible concern.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_250: Well, well, look who it is!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_251: Well, well, look who it is! I must thank you again for your help in moving our textiles.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_252: Recovering from those tragic events has been difficult, of course, but with everyone pulling together, we've managed to get things back up and running.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_253: Djinabaha, I come with questions related to that tragedy─specifically, your survival of the Final Days.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_254: Although you are similar to Khalzahl in many respects, he succumbed to the transformation and you did not. Why? What is the critical difference between you and him?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_255: What!? I...I'm sure I don't know.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_256: I'm not especially brave or courageous, if that's what you're asking.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_257: Perhaps being focused on protecting our workshops kept me from spinning into a panic.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_258: Still, I imagine Khalzahl would have been feeling that same sense of responsibility. Perhaps the weight of it all is what invited his demise.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_259: You were of the same mind. Resolved to the same purpose.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_260: Yet your strength of heart─of spirit─was not equal. If merely emulating the individual is insufficient, then some other unseen factor must be involved...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_261: Ahem, not to interrupt these deep philosophical musings, but do you think I could ask you a small favor?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_262: There's a man by the name of Nashvan who's been helping us out here while he gets back on his feet. I have a feeling he'd benefit from speaking with you...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_263: Leave by the eastern exit, and you should find him just outside, organizing some new inventory items.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_271: <blip> I am still dissecting Djinabaha's remarks. You are permitted to indulge his “favor” and seek out Nashvan while I continue to process this data.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_273: The equipment being manufactured here, it is worn to perform specific duties, yes? Conceptually, it seems analogous to our practice of switching frames to better serve our mission objectives.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_274: I, for example, did not begin existence with the Omega model. I was originally supplied with a standard-issue Omicron chassis, serial number M-017.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_275: On this world, that alphanumeric combination would be considered my “given name.” Such designations are drawn from our nearly infinite register of celestial bodies to avoid the possibility of duplication.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_276: Furthermore, the cluster known as M-017 is better expressed in your language as the “Omega” nebula─the same word I used to introduce myself to your kind.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_277: Though you associate “Omega” with the advanced weapon construct, it is also my name, and I see no reason to change it no matter which frame I inhabit.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_279: Alpha puffs out his chest proudly, seeming to imply that his Ironworks uniform is the best attire anyone could wear.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_DJINABAHA_000_280: Please, if you could spare a few moments for Nashvan...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_SYSTEM_000_290: Nashvan is too absorbed in his task to notice you. Now is your chance to bring along Omega and Alpha to witness the exchange.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_291: That's all our orders accounted for, and everything looks to be of good quality. Kamala will be pleased.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_292: You... You were with the Scions! You were there...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_293: Yes, I'm sure of it. I'll never forget that day!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_294: You and your friends helped us escape when people began changing into beasts!
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_295: My own son, he was...afflicted. Then that huge monstrosity loomed right over him and... <sob>
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_296: I remember... My heart turning to ice. Freezing in place. The satrap came to my aid, but then he, too, was gone...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_297: The memories run together in my mind, like flashes from a nightmare. Only the words of your comrade still ring clear. I repeated them over and over like a mantra as I fled for my life.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_298: “You must run, for their sake and your own!”
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_299: It all seemed so surreal...which was probably what saved me from the transformation. The truth of it didn't begin to sink in until the worst of it was over.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_300: I have not the words to describe how I felt then. The sorrow, the overwhelming sense of helplessness...
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_301: I may still be wallowing in misery if not for my old friend, Djinabaha. I'd lost my will to work, and he encouraged me with kind words and odd jobs. Now, somehow, I live again.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_302: I am thankful to him, to the courageous Ahewann, and to you. If you see your comrades, please let them know their efforts were not in vain.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_303: You said you lost your “will to work.” This signifies a cessation of efforts to maintain basic life functions, yes?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_304: What changed to extract you from that stagnation? An offer of work from Djinabaha should mean little to one without the desire to accept it.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_305: Was it some manner of mortal instinct? A primal need to survive and thrive?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_306: Instinct? No...no it wasn't that. If anything, my instincts were telling me to lay down and welcome an end to the pain.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_307: Every day I think of my boy's final moments. I think of how scared he must have been, how it must have hurt, and I want to scream my throat raw.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_308: The satrap, too, still haunts my dreams. I see him being swallowed whole, and jolt awake in a cold sweat.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_309: But something changed when Djinabaha came to me. I looked up and saw that, even without my son or Ahewann, the world around me continued to turn.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_310: And because that fact grieved me so, I knew it fell to me to live on and remember them.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_311: Strange, isn't it? What drives me to rise in the morning is the very sorrow which once crippled me.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_312: Now, I really must return to my work. To lose this job after everything I just said would be a poor jest, indeed.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_NASHVAN_000_313: May the Sisters keep you well.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_314: Sorrow. The emotion generated by mortals when their ideals fail to materialize. This I have observed.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_315: Yet when I listen to how Nashvan's sorrow served to rescue him from near-fatal despondency, his logic eludes me.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_316: Am I incapable of perceiving the full measure of the heart's properties?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_317: My best projections failed to predict our subjects' responses... And despite their almost equal occupational and mental parameters, Djinabaha and Khalzahl exhibited different reactions to the dynamis effect.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_318: I am no closer to recognizing the pattern for involuntary transformations, and your ephemeral mortal spirits confound me as much if not more than they did before.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_A8_000_320: Have you considered that there is no pattern to the people afflicted?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_A8_000_321: The hearts of others were ever shrouded in mystery.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_A8_000_322: Perhaps it's time we move on to the next element you wanted clarified.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_323: <bloop> No...pattern? You imply that the transformation was not contingent on individual fortitude, but rather a random contribution of environmental factors?
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_324: ...Such a theory would explain the otherwise conflicting data.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_325: Very well. I shall accept this as a provisional conclusion to this part of my investigation.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_326: I do, however, expect you to continue supplementing my education of heart-related matters.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_327: <bloop> ...Even to you? This matter is more complicated than I initially calculated.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_328: If those possessed of heart cannot fathom the behavior of their own kind, then my lack of understanding is inevitable.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_329: My investigations here are exhausted. In lieu of a full conclusion, I will settle for storing this accumulated data for future analysis. Let us progress to the next element of the report, that you might continue my education.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_330: <bloop> You are my appointed educator. If you consider further investigation here to be futile, then I will adhere to your judgment. A new location and new input may help provide fresh insight into previously unsolved problems.
TEXT_STMBDR601_04586_OMEGA_000_331: After my defeat at your hands, I was forced to acknowledge that the heart is a complex subject─one which I am ill equipped to study alone. Please continue your efforts to enlighten me, .
