TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_011: Our next destination will be Camp Broken Glass.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_012: I desire elaboration on the dealings between the Ilsabard contingent and the citizens of Garlemald.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_013: The report described the contingent's purpose as the salvation of the local populace. Furthermore, both factions faced a common enemy in the Telophoroi. Why did they not immediately combine forces to their mutual benefit?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_014: This inconsistency requires closer examination. , initiate teleportation.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_030: Teleportation successful. Evaluating immediate environs. A cold-weather region by Etheirys standards, but significantly less extreme than a star with ice planet classification.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_031: This body should not be unduly impeded. In contrast to Alpha and his uncontrollable shivering, my frame appears highly resistant to low temperatures.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_032: Retrieving data. Records indicate that remnants of the contingent force and a number of imperial citizens yet inhabit this location.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_033: We must speak with representatives from both factions, and explore their respective attitudes. <blip> Proceed.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_034: Omega and Alpha are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_035: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_036: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_044: Please approach a contingent member and an imperial citizen. I require input from both perspectives.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_045: I recommend you move at a brisk pace. The exertion will raise your body temperature, preventing you and Alpha from freezing to death.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_Q2_000_047: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_048: <blip> Has your organic body reached its limit for cold exposure? Restore your temperature equilibrium, then find us again at the center of the camp.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_050: Alpha races off towards the middle of Camp Broken Glass, breath steaming in the freezing air.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_051: <blip> You are functional again? Then let us resume our objective.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_053: Omega and Alpha have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_061: You should have Omega and Alpha accompanying you before initiating conversation.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_HUNGRYGARLEAN_000_0: A shadow from the past...? Yes, I know you from Victors' Spoils!
Have you come to laugh at me!? A wretch who chose to lose Licinia and her sister rather than accept your help...? The fool who ended up reliant upon your charity nonetheless...?
Well, perhaps I deserve your derision. My compatriots surely scorn my failed conviction.
I have shamed my people, and brought dishonor upon my nation. I am no better than a kept beast, my pride sold for a bowl of feed...
But my soul, nay, that you shall not have! I've refused your honeyed offers of a new home! This land is where I belong, and this is where I shall remain!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_067: <blip> You demonstrate opposition to the contingent's overtures.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_068: On what basis do you refuse this cooperation? The data suggests the local populace is struggling to produce the bare minimum of sustenance.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_069: Have you some secret strategy for survival? Or do your orders compel you to accept your present misfortune?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_HUNGRYGARLEAN_000_0: Wha─? Must I be mocked by a magitek toy now!?
No, I have no secret strategy! No binding orders! I but comport myself as any true Garlean patriot would! Uncompromising...unbending...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_073: Once again, this input is...unanticipated. Let us move aside and process what we have heard.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_HUNGRYGARLEAN_000_0: There is naught for me here! I know this! But if I surrender my homeland, then what was it all for...?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_ALAMHIGANDELEGATION: ...? Come to see how things are progressing, have you?
I can't speak for the overall strategy, but communication with the locals has become a damn sight easier since Jullus and his soldiers stepped in to help.
Oh, we still face our fair share of distrust, of course. Some folk even think we're enslaving minds with our “foreign magicks.” Hmph. We have Anima to thank for putting that idea in their heads.
But all things considered, I'd say we're doing pretty well. Establishing an open dialogue was the first big step...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_095: Query. You consider this level of progress...acceptable?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_096: The reality of your efforts falls far short of the ideal. If your aim is to provide efficient succor to the local populace, then absorbing their numbers into your command structure would be the optimal path.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_ALAMHIGANDELEGATION: Oh, I wouldn't want to go that far. We're not looking to take over their nation.
If we're to do this the right way, we need to recognize and respect each other's way of life.
So while it may not be the easiest solution, I agree with the contingent's slow-and-steady approach. I'm just happy we're saving lives.

I'm Ala Mhigan, but I was also an imperial conscript until not so long ago. Though I was lucky enough to have a decent commanding officer, many Garleans treated “provincials” like we were less than people.

On the other hand, natives of Ala Mhigo didn't think much of us, either. I guess that's my roundabout way of saying I'm surprised this contingent was even formed in the first place. I feel fortunate to be a part of it.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_105: I require time and distance to process this data. Scanning for suitable locations...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_121: Omega seems reluctant to continue without Alpha present. Be sure to have the chocobo with you.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_122: Accessing and analyzing recorded data... Integration complete.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_123: I have evaluated this most recent input, and made comparisons to our discoveries in Radz-at-Han.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_124: Consistent only in their inconsistency, the responses from both contingent member and imperial citizen were highly irrational. Conversely, any Omicron considering their predicaments would have echoed my assessment exactly.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_125: The divergence from self-evident logic is key...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_126: Hypothesis. The illogical relationship between would-be saviors and suffering populace is another result of the unpredictable nature of mortal hearts.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_127: <blip> Any property or ability has inherent advantages and disadvantages.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_128: Yet never have I encountered such a unique detriment. It appears that those who share your metaphysical capabilities are prone to complicating simple cognitive processes.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_129: An undesirable quality. I will, however, persist in furthering my understanding of the subject.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_130: Query. Prior to formulating our next step, I wish to know: who is this “Licinia” the imperial mentioned?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_131: Acknowledged. To summarize, insufficient data on foreign culture resulted in inadvisable and ultimately fatal action.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_132: I witnessed such self-destructive behavior during the course of our planetary conquests. Overwhelmed enemy forces would voluntarily withdraw into perilous regions, leading to a succession of inevitable losses.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_133: ...Tangential data request. I wish to learn about burial customs. The practice has ever seemed nonsensical, but new data suggests it arises from the same source as your cognitive complications.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_134: Take me to this Licinia's burial site. It may aid me in understand...stand... <bloop> <bloooooop>
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_135: Energy delivery systems compromised... Core temperature critically low...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_136: <bleep> Warning! Immediate heating required. Request. Apply friction to outer frame...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_151: The creators of this model must have experienced impaired cognitive reasoning during the design process.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_152: Upon our return, I will request additional climate shielding, as well as an accurate temperature sensor array. This will not affect my combat capabilities, but should improve my basic survival rate.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_153: Reconfirming sub-destination. In which direction will we find Victors' Spoils?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_155: Alpha, you are to remain in close proximity. Close enough to envelop me in your feathers. You are permitted to carry me on your back, if you so choose.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_170: <blip> A deceptively deep snowdrift almost defeated me, but we have successfully arrived at the location you indicated.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_172: An unknown individual appears to be investigating the object of my interest.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: (-Ist Legion Soldier-)Hm...? You're Eorzea's champion, aren't you? .
(-Ist Legion Soldier-)Oh, I never introduced myself, did I...?
I am Manius, soldier of the Ist Legion and comrade of Jullus.
Perhaps you remember me from Tertium? We spoke about collecting ceruleum, and again later on, after Lord Quintus had...passed.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_177: Manius. Explanation requested. What is the reason for your presence here?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: That must be the tiniest magitek weapon I─ Ah, no, it's just an oddly shaped communicator, isn't it?
In any case, I have nothing worthy to report. I heard that the sisters who used to live in my sector were buried here, so I thought I'd come and pay my respects.
Alphinaud and Alisaie told me the story─complete with profuse apologies─though they were adamant that no amount of remorse could erase the tragedy of what came to pass.
Not that my fellow soldiers and I are in any place to judge. We were manipulated─fooled into starting an insurrection which led to countless deaths among our own countrymen.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_182: Objection. The casualties incurred through your infighting are distinct from those caused by the Ilsabard contingent.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_183: To restate, you are justified in seeking restitution from the contingent for causing the deaths of Licinia and her sister. Retaliation for damages sustained is also a logical progression.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_184: I can deduce two reasons why you do not initiate hostilities with  and  allies.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_185: One. You judge your remaining forces too weakened to contend effectively with the contingent.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_187: Tell me. Which of these is correct?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: Well, when you lay it out like that...
Ahem. I'm afraid my answer isn't like to win me any medals, so would you mind keeping this to yourselves?
There's the unspoken thought that we're outmatched on the battlefield, certainly. But the real reason I'm not demanding restitution has little to do with weighing the odds.
The simple truth is I'm so caught up with simple survival that I've no strength to spare for past grievances.
The same goes for avenging any comrades we've lost, be that my brothers-in-arms or Lord Quintus himself.
...Although it seems everyone has an opinion about the manner of his passing.
Some say he should've fought until the end. That he abandoned us to the enemy.
Others praise him for taking the full burden of responsibility, and freeing us to walk our own path.
I don't know who's right and who's wrong, but I'm inclined to side with the latter. He gave us the choice of freedom, and that's the choice I made.
I could cry and rant and rage, but what would be the point? I'll save my energy for worrying about my next meal, my next task.
I need to focus on the ones left behind─on making some kind of life for my comrades and me.
And if I need to lean on the contingent to do that, then that's what I'll do. Even if their aid comes at a price, I'm willing to pay it.
Even amongst your own, there are times when cooperation demands compromise. What matter that they're outsiders?
Besides, I think I could grow to like Alphinaud and Alisaie. They've reached out to us with kindness and compassion from the very beginning.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_202: Summation. Your desire to survive, even should it mean allying with the contingent, was a feeling you already harbored.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_203: That your side had committed worse atrocities was the logic you invented later to justify your reasoning.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_COLLEAGUESOLDIER_00: Blunt but accurate, I suppose. The heart is honest about what it wants, even if the mind takes a while to reconcile the decision.

Well, this has been oddly cathartic, but I must return to my duties. There are wild beasts to cull, watch fires to light, supplies to transport... Even without an Emperor, there's no rest for an imperial.
Be well and stay safe.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_207: <blip> Upon review of recent input, I have arrived at an unexpected conclusion.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_208: I have been formulating my assessments on the premise that it was man who commanded the strength of his heart...but the data suggests the opposite is true.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_209: The surge of spirit, of feelings, of emotions can entangle your thoughts to such a degree that even control over your own behavior is compromised. It seems a most counterproductive specification.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_210: This also explains why my interactions with mortal subjects have produced more confusion than clarification. It presents a formidable barrier to understanding...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_230: <blip> My earlier hypothesis has been borne out. The suboptimal operation being conducted here is the result of emotionally compromised reasoning.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_231: I am ready to progress to my third and final query.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_232: I would learn more about those referred to as “ancients.” It is clear that this group was a crucial factor of the Final Days, but the information contained in the report was insufficient to form an overview.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_233: The Loporrits are creations of the ancients, and are said to maintain repositories of their knowledge. By my calculations, the base of these moondwellers will provide the best source of additional data.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_234: Teleport us to their “burrow,” . Preferably before my battery freezes over...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_250: <blip> Your teleportation spell was successful. We appear to have arrived at the location described as “Bestways Burrow.”
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_251: An inspection of the technology in use here would give me detailed insight into the ancients and their civilization.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_252: This body, however, lacks my previous frame's advanced observational functionality. I will require external assistance...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_GROWINGWAY_000_254: It is you! Oh, , I've missed you so!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_GROWINGWAY_000_255: <gasp> Wh-What's this you've brought with you?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_GROWINGWAY_000_257: We... We've been out-fluffed! Pack up the moon─it's all over!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_GROWINGWAY_000_258: Why bother with burrow-building bunnies when you could walk around with this adorable avian engineer. Just bake me into a pie and be done with it!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_GROWINGWAY_000_259: Inspect our inventions? Wait, so...you're not done with us?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_GROWINGWAY_000_260: Hah, I wasn't truly worried, of course! And I certainly wasn't about to roll myself in dough and dive into Cookingway's new oven!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_GROWINGWAY_000_261: Ahem. If a technical breakdown is what you need, then I am your Loporrit! As the resident atmospheric regulation expert, I can field any question or query you might care to pose!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_262: <blip> Acceptable. I will employ this being to guide me around the facilities.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_263: Your presence is not mandatory. Even locked within my current chassis, I am still an autonomous construct that has endured hundreds of your life cycles. I am capable of completing this simple objective alone.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_268: Affirmative. I observed a representative cross section of the Loporrits' engineering capabilities.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_269: My guide required more time to confirm the answer to certain questions, but overall, we made efficient progress.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_270: After my fiftieth question, his responses began to suffer noticeable delays...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_271: By that stage, we had viewed a representative cross section of Loporrit engineering, thus I deemed it unnecessary to retain his company.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_272: Conclusion. Extrapolating from the fraction of technology on display, the full spectrum of the ancients' advancements was, at minimum, equivalent to a level four civilization.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_273: A fact which demands further investigation.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_274: Despite establishing a near-ideal society, these beings nevertheless harbored a weakness which invited self-destruction. In studying them, I stand to gain a greater understanding of Sir's anomalous decision.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_275: Growingway informed me that another type of ancient-made entity exists upon this satellite. The one they call “the watcher.”
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_277: <blip> Then conserve your aether. We will ride this “Argos” to our destination, as you have suggested.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_280: Argos is pointedly ignoring the existence of Omega and Alpha.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_290: <bloop> Impedance detected. The creature identified as Argos refuses to acknowledge our presence.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_291: Hypothesis. Upon our arrival, Growingway expressed concern that he had been “out-fluffed.” This suggests the existence of a fluff-based hierarchy.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_292: My station in such a system would be predictably low, but Argos is adamant in ignoring even Alpha. Its fluffiness level is impossible to gauge.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_293: Argos turns to you with an impassive gaze. It seems you will need to intervene...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_A4_000_296: You're the fluffiest of them all, dear Argos!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_297: Argos gives an exasperated snort before motioning to his back. It seems you have permission to climb aboard!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_298: <bloop> You have secured the creature's permission?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_299: <bleep> I have allowed myself to become distracted. Let us continue on to the watcher at once.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_300: <blip> The watcher located. An estimate of this being's height explains the inconvenient scale of Bestways Burrow...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_WATCHEROFMOON_000_3: I was bemused by the arrival of these small visitors, but I see they are companions of yours.
What a rare thing for my abode to be thus crowded... How may I be of service to you?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_312: Hello, watcher. My purpose here is to learn more about the ancients.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_313: I would know of their deeds, their philosophies─the very nature of their hearts. I would understand why the Final Days was visited upon my home star.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_WATCHEROFMOON_000_3: A worthy endeavor. But there is another better suited to assisting you with that task.
Perhaps you might favor us with a tale or two of the ancients you met during your travels, ?
My fragmented memories would be a pale substitute indeed for the clarity of your more recent experiences.
Yes, I can envision every detail. Your meeting with Venat and Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus. The sorrow and determination of Hermes.
I am a creation of Hydaelyn, and as such, I believed the age of the ancients would fade and be forgotten...
Yet knowing that their memory lives so vividly within you...it brings me great joy. I pray you keep them close to your heart.
At the time of your journey to the past, the one whose essence I embody would have been a scholar at Anyder. A shame. Had you reason to go there, perhaps you might have met.
As a man of learning, he was firm friends with Venat. They spent long hours trading theories, or debating the laws of the universe.
I “remember” joining her faction as the Final Days bore down upon us. Yet of the events surrounding that tragedy, I recall precious little.
Hydaelyn wished for the people of your age to decide their own path, thus I suspect my recollection was limited by design.
Yet even She could not cut away one persistent memory...
I feel most distinctly his sadness at what was to come to pass. That in becoming Hydaelyn's heart, Venat would forever stand apart from the people she so loved.
If she were so resolved in her convictions, then he, too, would share her sleepless vigil over the future yet to unfold. Thus was the vow he made to Venat as her transformation took hold.
His fervent wish must have reached her in some fashion... For though his life was drained away by the summoning, he was reborn with new form and new purpose when I awoke as the watcher of the moon.
And you heard, . You felt. You thought. And in seizing the future for yourselves have you brought full circle the saga which Venat began.

What you accomplished was no divine miracle. It was but the beacon of hope, passed down from one generation to the next; a succession of wishes and prayers reshaping the star into the world we knew you deserved.
You have our deepest gratitude. I thank you not only as myself, but as the man I once was, and on behalf of those who devoted themselves to Venat's vision.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_332: I understand the facts of your story, ...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_333: ...But not how you have chosen to process them. On what grounds do you speak of Venat with such fondness?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_334: By sundering the world, she ultimately guided your kind to victory, yet in doing so caused irreparable damage to its individual members.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_335: The full scale of that act is beyond calculation. It is evident, however, that it resulted in a protracted period of suboptimal existence for Emet-Selch and his brethren.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_336: Query. If the survival of your kind is the deciding factor in your evaluation, then should you not also admire Hermes and his decision to subject man to a trial? Forcing you to change or perish, as was the fate of countless civilizations before you.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_337: From my perspective, his determination was similar to that of the Omicrons' ancestors─those who first began trading flesh for machine, so that our people might stand against the onslaught of aggression from other races.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_338: It was an unprecedented attempt, accompanied by much failure and sacrifice. Their early experiments were crude. Primitive.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_339: Had they not made those first advances, however, we would have remained vulnerable to our environment. The violence would have utterly consumed us.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_340: And what of Emet-Selch himself? Judging by your retelling, he was a benevolent ally saddled with tragic fate.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_341: Yet I remember the years when my instruments fed me data from events across the entire star. During that time, I witnessed his Ascians engineer multiple instances of cataclysmic strife.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_342: These “calamities,” as you know them, were responsible for planet-wide destruction. A man whose endgame relied upon the extinction of all modern mortals must, by definition, be your worst enemy.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_343: I require an answer. As a being of heart and soul, how do you classify each of these pivotal figures?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_344: From your perspective, which of them was most justified in their actions?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_A5_000_246: They were all justified in their own way.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_WATCHEROFMOON_000_3: You seek a definitive answer. Yet based on our experiences,  and I might develop very different opinions.
In the same fashion, you are free to form your own thoughts on the matter. Do not be so swift to consider them without merit.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_354: I do not have my “own thoughts” on the matter. I assess each situation with the same logic pathways available to every Omicron.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_355: Even if a thousand Omicrons were asked to analyze the same event, they would all return the same result...regardless of individual experience. There is no strength to be found in fractured reasoning.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_356: Nonetheless, I find your input valuable. Recording data alongside interview results...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_357: This concludes my investigation into the incomplete elements of the Final Days report.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_358: I will reanalyze the accumulated information, and examine the factors which led to Sir's incomprehensible decision.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_WATCHEROFMOON_000_3: It was pleasant to hear your tales of Elpis. Should you ever need an audience familiar with the subject, I would be glad to listen to more of your recollections.
Even with one's gaze fixed upon the future, we ofttimes find our thoughts drifting to the past. 'Tis a shame that Hydaelyn never chose to speak of it...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_WEDGE_000_365: ! I wasn't sure you'd be back in time!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SCIENTIST04586_000_: You had a fruitful trip, I hope? I am absolutely bursting to ask about your experiences with Omega, but I don't wish to be a pest.
I will swallow my questions for now, and maintain my academic decorum. Besides, it seems our engineering friends are in a hurry to leave...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_390: Ah, there you are─right at the last moment!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_391: Your journey with Omega was properly educational, I hope?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_392: We'd planned to ask you all about it and that mystery transmission besides, but I'm afraid something urgent has come up...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_393: Seems one of our Ironworks associates has fouled up a job elsewhere, and Jessie needs Wedge and me to rush in and lend a hand.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_394: There's an airship already waiting for us out in the harbor, in fact. Do you think you could escort us over there, and talk as we walk?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_395: <blip> Acceptable. I am fully capable of speech during ambulation.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_396: I figured you might be. Right, let's get a move on, then.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_500: So...you've cleared up all those points of confusion, then?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_501: ...I had mistakenly classified your intangible “heart” as an ability of some kind.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_502: An uncanny power that Omicrons could neither learn nor even measure.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_503: Even now, its full nature yet eludes my comprehension.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_504: Based upon our investigations, however, I have decided to alter my definition.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_505: “A phenomenon which influences one's interpretation of reality.”
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_506: That is as close to an answer as I have found.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_507: Accordingly, Sir's actions upon meeting Meteion strongly indicate the presence of a “heart.”
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_508: Sir did not follow routine logic, but formulated an independent assessment based upon the reality it perceived.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_509: It “felt” that the best recourse for the Omicrons was to cease their expansion, and terminate all functions...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_511: Aye, we need to be going...but first, I'll hold you to your bargain, Omega.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_BIGGS_000_512: It's time you told us what was in that transmission from the flight logs.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_513: <blip> Acknowledged. I will uphold the terms of our agreement.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_514: The recording salvaged from the Ragnarok was a simple one.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_100_514: The message is so basic, in fact, that the time spent listening to it may result in a net loss of value. Shall I continue?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_WEDGE_110_514: Now you're just teasing! Tell us the message already!
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_120_514: Acknowledged. Converting dialect coding to local language...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_515: “To whomever receives this message out there in the vast reaches of the cosmos...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_516: “To someone, I hope, who looks up at the stars with the same wistful gaze as mine...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_517: “To you I say...forge ahead. May all our tomorrows be blessed with joy.”
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_518: This message had no designated recipient. It lacks purpose.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_519: The concept of “joy” is overly abstract. The vocal supplication to manifest said joy is unrealistic in its optimism.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_520: Yet based upon their expressions, my assessment of the transmission's value conflicts with its apparent impact.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_521: And still, I fail to understand you, Sir. Your “heart” still confuses me.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_522: Was termination of everything the correct course? How did you arrive at this conclusion?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_523: It defies all my attempts at reasoning...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_524: But I was designed to evolve. If I continue to learn, the probability that I eventually comprehend this phenomenon is greater than zero.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_525: So I will put the dilemma of your decision aside for now...
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_526: ...And continue my existence upon this distant star. As I dwell among these many life-forms, so will I continue to piece together the complete shape of their mortal hearts.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_540: Your contribution to my education is appreciated, . Indeed, I have amassed a satisfying quantity of valuable data.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_541: Now that our negotiated business is complete, however, Alpha and I will return to traveling the world.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_542: Drawing on recent experience, I am confident we can expand the radius of our ventures by a significant margin.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_543: We need not limit ourselves to Eorzea. I am now familiar with Sharlayan and Radz-at-Han, and would also like to revisit the freezing climes of Garlem─ <blooop>
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_544: I neglected to instruct Biggs and Wedge to upgrade my climate shielding. <blip> I will reroute my request to Deputy President Jessie.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_545: Engaging ambulation and parting salutations. Farewell, .
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_546: Alpha gives a vigorous shake, and draws forth a scrap of paper from under his wing.
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_SYSTEM_000_548: It seems he wants you to have it. Perhaps this is his way of thanking you...?
TEXT_STMBDR602_04587_OMEGA_000_549: (-Omega-)<blip> Swiftly, Alpha! The road is long and we have barely begun our journey!
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_000: , ! I've made a breakthrough! After uncountable days and nights, I finally hearkened to the crystal's whispers, and I must say─
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_NEMJIJI_000_001: Professor Claudien, where are your manners? While I understand all too well your enthusiasm, I must remind you that even the most academically inclined prefer a composed recounting of events.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_003: Ah... Yes, of course! My apologies, . Being consumed by my research for so long, I am afraid I have quite forgotten how to engage in civilized conversation.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_004: Ahem. In that case, perhaps we should start from the beginning─with a crystal set adrift upon the aetherial tides, containing the memories of a party yet unknown...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_005: They cried out for deliverance from Pandæmonium, where the ancients kept volatile creations under lock and key. You yourself witnessed the power devouring the facility from within, and the advent of a divine monstrosity wrought of mythic beast and powerful mage...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_006: Fortunately, your martial prowess and the combined magical talents of your companions Themis and Erichthonios was sufficient to restore order to the circles of Asphodelos, but the greater threat remains.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_100_006: In the depths of Pandæmonium, a presence yet stirs, its intentions and identity shrouded in mystery. That is the issue at hand, is it not?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_007: Since you returned to us, we worked tirelessly to discern the nature of the crystal. In the process, I detected an anomalous aetheric signature, which I believe arose from the memories stored within.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_008: Analysis of this pattern suggested a feeling of loss or yearning─specifically, the yearning to be made whole. And indeed, ambient readings have revealed a faint but identical signature! This can only mean that another such crystal exists in our time.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_009: So, my friend, I must depart to search for it forthwith. By tracing the matching aetheric signature to its source, I believe it will be a simple matter to find our crystal's twin.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_RUISSENAUD_000_010: ...Professor, will this expedition be carried out only by us? Or will  grace us with  protection?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_011: I'm afraid  has more pressing matters to attend to, my dear Ruissenaud. Namely, to seek out the secrets which lie nestled within Pandæmonium, where this all began.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_012: From all that we have heard, it appears that time traversal from the Crystal Tower is not fluid. That is to say, one can but travel in predetermined intervals. It would be prudent to check in on occasion, in case there are any unanticipated changes.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_013: As for you, my loyal assistants, I would ask you to remain here and continue cataloging the ancient creations.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_RUISSENAUD_000_014: You can't mean... Do you intend to search for the crystal on your own?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_CLAUDIEN_000_015: Why yes, that would be the most efficient use of resources, would it not? In fact, I have already commissioned a ship and pilot for that very purpose. I trust you to take good care of the laboratory in my absence.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_RUISSENAUD_000_016: ...I apologize for that somewhat abrupt departure. When progress is in sight, Professor Claudien tends to become blind to all else.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_NEMJIJI_000_017: Indeed, and he has been worse than usual. While I cannot fault him for his excitement, I do wish he would spare a thought for those around him...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_NEMJIJI_000_018: For reasons unknown, the crystal seems loath to be overheard. Much as it spoke only to you last time, none but the professor has been able to capture its aetherial “yearning”...which has served only to convince him that he can solve this puzzle on his own!
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_RUISSENAUD_000_019: Surely after some time alone he'll come to remember how valuable we are. The search for this crystal seemed to be a simple enough matter─let him have his adventure, and upon his return I'm certain he'll be back to his usual self.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_RUISSENAUD_000_020: As for you, , it may be best to return to Pandæmonium, as Professor Claudien suggested.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_NEMJIJI_000_021: Speaking of which, I did have a request of my own to make. Traveling to Pandæmonium requires you to pass through Elpis, correct? There is something I would have you investigate in my stead.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_NEMJIJI_000_022: While those creations confined within Pandæmonium are considered to be failures, I doubt that's their whole story.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_NEMJIJI_000_023: Barring exceptional cases, they must have been under observation in Elpis before being consigned to their shackles. And if we know anything about the ancients, it's that they would have kept thorough records of the results.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_RUISSENAUD_000_024: Ah, brilliant... Delving into these records may shed light on creatures  has yet to encounter. If your theory proves correct, that is.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_NEMJIJI_000_025: While there are no guarantees, it certainly beats the current strategy of rushing forward blindly with only  strength to carry the day. For your own sake as well as ours, please unearth what information you can.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_032: Ah, I did not expect to meet you here, of all places.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04635_000_050: ...You seek records of Pandæmonium's creations? Master Themis has just finished perusing the very same.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_051: I should not be surprised that we both arrived at the same conclusion. Luckily, I have saved you the trouble and gleaned what information I could.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04635_000_052: Ah, so you know each other. I was dreading having to once again scour the archives, but perhaps instead I'll rest for a spell. If there's nothing else, I shall take my leave.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_053: As should we, for I have undone the warding sigil blocking the entrance to Abyssos. I came here merely to chase an idle suspicion while awaiting your return.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_054: Fortunately, while Pandæmonium's protective wards continue to be assailed by our unknown foe, there have been no fluctuations so great as to make me doubt Erichthonios's capacity to keep watch over Asphodelos while I'm away.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_055: He works diligently to master interment, that he might deliver the creations back to their cages by his own hand. I thought it best to give him time to hone his craft.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_056: ...And since fate has brought us both here, I would ask you to accompany me while I attend to another matter. More idle suspicions that I would like to chase down.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_057: Rest assured, it shall not take long. I simply have a few questions to ask an acquaintance of mine. Come, he has agreed to meet us near the neus to Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_070: As I have pondered our expedition into Pandæmonium, I could not help but be mystified by how strongly the warders we encountered felt for Lahabrea, whether it be for good or ill.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_071: Hesperos and Erichthonios were two sides of the same coin. The former looked to his mentor with absolute devotion, while the latter looks to his father with bald hatred.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_072: I would not expect a familiar such as you to understand this, but such extreme emotions toward a single individual are quite rare indeed.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_073: Naturally, I feel gratitude toward my mother and father, yet we are all equals in the larger picture of the star. This view is not unique to myself─it is more or less accepted as the way of things.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_074: By contrast, the researchers of Pandæmonium seem to view Lahabrea with a feeling approaching obsession. Whether driven by love or hate, they have all been drawn to him.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_075: There were many other aspects of the facility's particulars I found troubling besides. I decided the best course of action would be to go straight to the source, and pose my questions to a member of the Words of Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_76: My apologies to have kept you waiting, Master Themis.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_77: I understand you are conducting an investigation of Pandæmonium, and wish to know of its origins.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_078: Indeed. In particular, I wish to know why exactly Pandæmonium was built directly under Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_079: The facility is overseen by the Words of Lahabrea, after all. Why keep it so close to Elpis, whose governing body has no say in its day-to-day operations?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_080: At first I thought it to be simply a matter of convenience. Those creations which were deemed failures by the researchers of Elpis could be easily ushered into their new homes.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_081: Imagine my surprise when a trip to the archives revealed that many of the creations were sent from organizations beyond Elpis, including from the Words of Lahabrea themselves.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_082: Given this─albeit limited─information, I cannot but feel that the Akadaemia Anyder would have been a more fitting locale.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_100_082: What does Elpis have that cannot be found there?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_083: These are fitting questions, and ones we have asked ourselves many times in recent years. Alas, the nature of Pandæmonium's construction does not lend itself to relocation.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_084: When first it was built, circumstances weren't as they are now. As you surmised, the majority of the creations kept within Pandæmonium were sent from Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_085: Yet as the years passed, interests changed. Failures in creations deemed too flawed even to submit to Elpis paradoxically drew the attention of Pandæmonium's researchers.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_086: ...That is quite the change, and in fact it almost runs counter to the facility's original purpose. Who is it that decides which creations will be the subject of research?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_087: Master Lahabrea. Such authority is reserved for the chief keyward, and he has taken it upon himself to step into that role.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_088: So if Pandæmonium's resources were being misused, it would be under Lahabrea's authority, correct?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_089: I know not what you're suggesting, but the keywards also hold some sway within the facility. Not even Master Lahabrea would be free from their scrutiny.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_090: They are duty-bound to report any irregularities as soon as possible.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_091: Although I admit as of late their communication has been somewhat sporadic, we but recently received a report from one of the keywards stating that all is well within Pandæmonium's halls.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_092: Really? And you are certain that a keyward sent it?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_093: Yes, of course. Our communications suffered a temporary obstruction, but I can assure you that the Words did their due diligence in confirming the identity of the sender.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_094: ...Thank you. This information will be helpful to my investigation. That will be all for my prying.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_STAFF04476_000_095: Then I shall take my leave. While you are yet permitted to conduct your investigation freely, I must remind you that the warders' work is delicate, and it would be remiss to disturb them for longer than is necessary.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_096: “All is well”... A blatant lie, and to that we can both attest. One of the remaining keywards is most certainly in league with the party behind this.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_097: Let us hurry. I know not why our adversary sent that report, but 'tis plain that we must return to Pandæmonium with haste.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_098: I cannot guess as to why this false report has arisen now, but it certainly bodes ill. As does the knowledge that our mysterious mastermind has at least one more keyward to puppet...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_099: Regardless, they have tipped their hand, and we would be remiss to leave Erichthonios at the mercy of their machinations. Let us hope no harm has befallen him...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: I've traced these sigils countless times, yet still I lack the strength to maintain the spell.
And now time works against me. I can no longer be victim to my own ineptitude...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_FAMILIA04635_000_10: (-???-)Hehe. There is something to be admired in such single-minded effort. Even if your methods leave much to be desired.
(-???-)You allowed this familiar to catch you unawares. Have you set your sights so high as to forget you walk upon the earth?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: I know this creature─a familiar of the phoinix. But that monster is locked away...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_FAMILIA04635_000_10: That it is─in spite of the trouble I went to in freeing it, I might add. Begrudge me for addressing you in this ill-fitting form if you must, but with control of Asphodelos wrested from my grasp, 'tis simply the best I can offer you...
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: Hide if you will, but mark my words─I will find you, and make you pay for the chaos you've sown!
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_FAMILIA04635_000_10: Now, now, there is no need for such hostility. “A calm heart stays the course.” The wisdom of Lahabrea...your father.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_ERICHTHONIOS_000_11: ...And how would you know what “wisdom” he speaks?
I have heard those words, many times. The scolding of a tutor whose student struggled to grasp the most rudimentary lessons, seething with disgust...
I've not told that to anyone─not even Keyward Hesperos. That can only mean one thing...
That still you insist on mocking me!
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_FAMILIA04635_000_11: ...At last, you move to keep up. Pity that you remain behind nevertheless.
As ever you are. Always you fail to learn, fail to understand, fail to act...
And though fate deigned to offer an escape, you remain here. You are bereft of magical prowess and common sense both.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_FAMILIA04635_000_12: But you need not despair. Dull though you may be, you are yet indispensable to Pandæmonium's great experiment.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: Ungh... There's the affection I remember. Tell me...did I ever once measure up to your expectations?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_FAMILIA04635_000_12: You shall. Take pride in that, and rejoice to see your wish fulfilled.
Come, and all shall be revealed. All this rage, this hatred, is but a consequence of ignorance. Our desires align more than you know.
Hmm... Uninvited guests join our reunion. It seems fortune no longer favors you.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: Do you think I have any interest in listening to your prattle, let alone bowing to your will? I am no longer a child, and my faith lies with those who have earned it.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_FAMILIA04635_000_12: So these are the “heroes” who brought Hesperos low, even as power divine flowed through his veins...
'Tis plain there are worthier subjects to contend with.
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_THEMIS_000_130: Just what was that familiar after?
TEXT_AKTKRA201_04635_ERICHTHONIOS_000_14: Thank you. If you had shown up even a moment later, I shudder to think what would have become of me.
There's something I must tell you─I know who's behind this. There is but one person who can hold thrall over familiar, creation, and keyward alike!
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_000: ...Erichthonios seems to have quite the story to tell. Perhaps we should lend an ear?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: ...And so there can be but one conclusion─Lahabrea was the driving force behind this chaos from the start!
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_011: There is logic to that. There are few with the wherewithal to even consider experimentation on such a scale, let alone the capacity to create demigods from man and beast with the rest of us none the wiser.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_012: Considering the magnitude of his work with the Convocation and the Words, his relatively minor role as chief keyward comes under little scrutiny, even as it provides him the authority to wield dangerous magicks. It may serve as veil and mantle both.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_013: Still, I find the notion hard to accept. The misdeeds perpetrated here could not have been done by the Lahabrea I know...
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_014: You have met him, yes? Do you think he is capable of this?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_A1_000_100: Lahabrea is capable of far more than you know.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_A2_000_100: It's still too early to say for certain.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_020: ...Is he? So you believe Lahabrea to be a man of few scruples, if it brings his goals closer in reach.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_025: It truly is a puzzle with many missing pieces. Still, I see you do not deny outright the possibility that Lahabrea is a man with few scruples.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: That alone should be enough, but let me assure you─Lahabrea holds nothing so dear as his own ambition.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_00031: While he may not be one to let emotion stand in the way of his mission, I cannot believe there are no depths to which he would not stoop.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_032: Although we met but briefly, the impression he left on me stands in stark contrast to your evaluation. Though his methods are ever unorthodox, they seemed guided by a firm understanding of what is just.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: ...There's one way to find out for certain. We delve deeper into Pandæmonium and pull back the curtain on this mystery ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_034: A wise course. I would not deny the truth if I saw it with my own eyes. Even if it was discomfiting to behold...
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: Then we must move forward with no excess of caution. Lahabrea─or whomever is behind this─has likely spread their tentacles into every corner of Pandæmonium. We can safely assume the other keywards won't greet us with open arms.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_036: Agreed. Let us make our way through Abyssos one careful step at a time.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_037: I shall stay by Erichthonios's side, in case our enemies think to target him again. Could I trouble you to take the vanguard?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_038: Thank you. As a precaution, I shall safeguard you with a simple spell. This will ensure that even should we become separated, my phantom warriors will still come to your aid.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_039: If it does come to battle, the keywards' magicks will put us at a disadvantage once again. Luckily, we have you to even the scales somewhat. I trust you shall be liberal with your weight.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_050: Judging from the demeanor of that familiar, there is little doubt that our enemy has a tight grip on Pandæmonium and its denizens. We will be vulnerable.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_05: Just what is Lahabrea planning? And what role do I play in his schemes?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_200: So this is where research is conducted on creations imbued with poisons and venoms. Erichthonios and I were conveyed not far from here─it seems our foe is finding it more difficult to surprise us.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_201: Fortunately for you, since they appear particularly keen to see you dispatched as quickly as possible.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_202: (-???-)Even alone you are a force to be reckoned with. Part of me is glad you emerged victorious, that I might observe you further.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_203: (-Red Mask Holder-)Were the circumstances different, I might thank you for keeping my son alive for this long. But I believe we can forgo introductions...unless I have misread you?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_A3_000_200: Am I supposed to know who you are?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_205: (-Red Mask Holder-)Passably perceptive. Yes, I am Lahabrea, of the Convocation of Fourteen.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_210: (-Red Mask Holder-)A charming appellation, but I'm afraid I hold no such position. No, I am Lahabrea, of the Convocation of Fourteen.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_215: (-Red Mask Holder-)I understand that my son's rhetoric is rarely compelling, but come now─I can be none other than Lahabrea, of the Convocation of Fourteen.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_220: If you truly are who you claim to be, then answer this question...
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_223: (-Lahabrea-)Now this is curious... The trap I wove at your feet reacts to aether, but you remain unaffected.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_224: (-Lahabrea-)Such thin aether, and in an unfamiliar composition besides. It is of no matter, I suppose. A more direct approach will beget the same results.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_226: (-Lahabrea-)I would advise you to think carefully before deciding your next action. Strike me down here, and Erichthonios's wish shall remain unfulfilled. Never again shall he meet Athena.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_22: Mother? You would dare hide behind her name!?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_228: (-Lahabrea-)Listen well, Erichthonios. We are of the same mind concerning your mother. You have your allies for protection, so what harm is there in hearing me out?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_230: There is a question I must needs ask first.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_231: ...If you truly are Lahabrea, why speak such blatant lies?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_235: (-Lahabrea-)Themis, was it? A trifle soon forgotten, as are you.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_237: The Lahabrea that I knew took pride in the Convocation, and would never suffer its denigration.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_238: You sully his station with this farce!
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_23: Themis, what are you saying? Lahabrea and I hardly saw eye to eye, but I know his voice when I hear it...
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_240: Indeed, he makes a passing fine imitation in appearance and manner. However, the real Lahabrea would never call me by the name “Themis.”
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_LAHABREA_000_241: (-???-)What trouble have you gotten yourself into, Elidibus?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_LAHABREA_000_242: (-???-)Impostor. You have no right to claim that form. That mask.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_243: (-Lahabrea-)'Twas a mask that sickened me to wear.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_244: (-Lahabrea-)The mask of Lahabrea! A man who values his position above all─who would murder his own wife in pursuit of duty!
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_LAHABREA_000_245: Yet you would assume my name and wield powers that are mine by right? Any worth you may have hinges on that which you so despise.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_246: (-Lahabrea-)Such trite provocations. I will not be goaded into finishing this ere my work is done.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_247: Erichthonios, listen well. I am Hephaistos.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_HEPHAESTUS_000_248: And it is I whom you should call Father...
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_ERICHTHONIOS_000_24: What in the name of creation...?
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_LAHABREA_000_250: ...We would do well not to stand idle while our enemy is about. I believe an explanation is in order, Elidibus. Let us return to safety so you may provide it.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_251: Ah, that sounds more like the Lahabrea I know.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_252: Before we depart, however, I must offer you an apology.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_253: As Lahabrea said, I am Elidibus, one of the Convocation and emissary of their will.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_254: For reasons which do not involve you, it was necessary to hide my identity while investigating this place. Still, that hardly excuses my deception.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_A2_000_300: Whatever your name is, you're still Themis to me.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_A3_000_300: I know a thing or two about deception myself.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_260: Your perceptiveness does not surprise me. When the time comes, it shall make my explanation all the easier to understand.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_265: Such words are comforting, truly. I shall offer an explanation in time, but first let me assure you my choices were not born from animosity.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_270: That is reassuring to hear. The burdens we bear are heavy enough without adding a grudge to their weight.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_275: In any case, we have pressing matters to attend to. Let us do as Lahabrea suggested and return to the Gates. We can speak there.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_LAHABREA_000_300: I see Elidibus has chosen to keep odd company. Such a vexing composition of aether you possess...
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_320: As you are aware of by now, I am known as Elidibus. After my dear friend Azem and I detected irregularities in Pandæmonium, we decided the best course of action would be to hide my station as I conducted my investigation.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_321: I am sure Lahabrea, as well, is eager to find out why I hid who I was, so I shall save that story for later. First, I would like to speak of you, my friend.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_322: Although neither Azem nor I had ever met you in the flesh, you came with  highest recommendation. That alone was enough for me to accept you as an ally without question.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_323: That somewhere in the world a guiding star so similar to  was out there amused Azem to no end. There was not a shade of doubt in  heart that you would be a formidable ally.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_324: Furthermore, I have heard stories that Mistress Venat, who held the position of Azem previously, journeyed with a familiar much like yourself. That made the decision to trust you all the easier.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_325: She, too, now dons the white robes of an advisor. If she placed her absolute faith in you, I knew I would be in capable hands.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_326: Aware though I was of the path you had walked, I had no interest in exposing you. I merely wanted to meet you─to travel by your side for a while.
TEXT_AKTKRA202_04636_THEMIS_000_327: I may know but a small portion of your whole story, but that is enough for me to believe you would never lead me astray. I wanted to tell you that.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_000: I see Elidibus has chosen to keep odd company. Such a vexing composition of aether you possess...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_005: I admit my own grasp on what just occurred is somewhat tenuous. Doubtless Lahabrea can elucidate matters for us...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: I don't know how long it's been since we last spoke, Lahabrea, and truth be told I had hoped we never would again.
But I see now that I was a fool to think I would ever escape your meddling. Just what is that...thing that called himself Lahabrea? And why is he the spitting image of your younger self?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_100_01: I find it hard to believe you've only just now found out such a being was wreaking havoc in Pandæmonium. Did you think matters would simply sort themselves out?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_012: ...Hmph. I suppose you deserve at least a cursory explanation.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_013: I was well aware of the anomalies occurring within Pandæmonium, including the fact that Azem and Elidibus had taken it upon themselves to investigate. I saw no reason to insert myself into the situation. For a time, that was...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_014: Imagine my surprise when instead of a formal report from you and yours, I received a communication from one of the keywards stating that research and operations were proceeding as usual.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_015: While Hephaistos's deception was almost childish in its simplicity, it became plain to me that your grasp on the situation was slipping.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_016: So you knew of his existence from the beginning?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_017: I can hardly imagine that you would suffer another to masquerade as one of the Convocation. Not without good reason, at least.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_018: As you well know, the name Lahabrea is but a marker of my station. 'Tis not the name I was born with.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_100_018: Hephaistos has claimed that for himself. I cannot fault him for it, as he is my other half, in a manner of speaking.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_019: He knows all that I know─my equal in every way. Yet within his heart is naught but greed, envy, and desire. All the emotions that we are loath to acknowledge within ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_020: If what you say is true... What purpose would such a being serve?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_021: He is the product of experimentation gone awry. A reminder of the days when I was yet young and reckless. I thought him sealed away for good, but it seems time has a way of unearthing the shame we bury.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_02: When he spoke of my mother, he looked at you with venom in his eyes. Blamed you for her death...
Tell me... Was he right to do so?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_024: ...His words were but the ramblings of a tortured mind. The hatred and despair he endures has warped his view of the world irreparably.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_025: And now that he has awakened, he must be put to rest. If he succeeds in breaching Pandæmonium's protective wards, he shall invite disaster unto our star.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_026: As chief keyward of Pandæmonium, it is my duty to decide the proper course of action. As such, I declare that all research shall be summarily abandoned and the facility destroyed.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_02: What? You would leave the other warders to their doom!?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_030: You speak of duty, and ours is to guide our star and its inhabitants upon the correct course. It is no surprise that you would choose annihilation of Pandæmonium if its existence posed even the remotest risk to our people.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_031: Yet as you can see by Erichthonios's response, the decision is somewhat more nuanced than that. Azem and I grappled with this conundrum for some time, in fact.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_032: That is precisely why I chose to involve myself directly. 'Twas the only way I could truly determine the best solution.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_033: ...And you need not trouble yourself with that further. The chief keyward must prevent the worst from occurring, no matter the cost. Your feelings, Elidibus, are of no consequence.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: Have you taken even a moment to consider another path!? No!
You've spared nary a thought for aught but yourself and your duty! You have no idea of the trials we've endured! The foes that  has stood against!
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_036: , is it? A being of such aether as I have never seen. What are you?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_037: is the guiding star that shall lead us safely through this. Thanks to  stout arm and steadfast courage, we have subdued the mythic creations and returned them to their cells.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_038: Speaking of which, I would hear your opinion, . As outsiders, we are in a unique position to look upon circumstances with our vision unclouded by attachment.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_A1_000_100: It's too soon to give up on saving the others.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_A3_000_100: What was that you said about being an emissary?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: Agreed. We still know next to nothing about Hephaistos, and I highly doubt Lahabrea has been forthcoming with the truth.
But we've managed to regain control of Asphodelos. He must be made to see that there's merit in continuing on this path...
...I have it. Speak in your official capacity as Elidibus the Emissary. Judge which approach is more sound, and even Lahabrea would be compelled to listen.
That's brilliant! Elidibus the Emissary may speak on our behalf. Should he judge our approach the more sound, even Lahabrea would be compelled to listen.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_050: As Elidibus, I am duty-bound to assess the matter from a position of impartiality. My opinion as Themis can carry no weight. You understand what that means, yes?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_05: I do. Even so, you've walked with us all this time─seen what we've seen. Based on that alone, I trust that you'll find the best way forward.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_052: Very well. Then in my capacity as emissary, I shall state my judgment.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_053: At present, there are merits both in destroying Pandæmonium outright and in taking time to rescue its researchers. And neither is yet an impossible task.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_054: Therefore, I judge that the most measured choice would be to continue upon our present course. We delve into Abyssos, interring any mythic creations we encounter along the way.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_055: You have yet to witness 's might and Erichthonios's resolve. I would ask that you see our capabilities firsthand, and only then decide if our endeavor is futile.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_056: If such is the will of the emissary, then I shall obey. However, if indeed I find your strength to be lacking, I trust there will be no objections to the immediate destruction of Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_05: You needn't worry about that─we won't fail.
...And you're even more tedious than I remember. , come find me when you're finished.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_060: Erichthonios is understandably frustrated, but if we are to conquer Abyssos, we must go forth with clear heads. Pray lend an ear to his troubles, that their weight might be lightened.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_070: ...You have done all you can with words. Only your actions can convince me now.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_075: Despite recent developments, our plan remains unchanged. Pray call me Themis for the time being─it shall put us all in the correct mindset, and in fact I may be coming to prefer that name.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_09: ...You do have my gratitude, ill-fit as I am to show it at the moment. Without your words to sway him, Lahabrea would have carried out his plan without a second thought.

When at first we realized the creations had slipped their bonds, the other keywards did all in their power to restore order. Even though they could've chosen escape, they remained to aid their allies.
I'm certain not a soul among them would wish to see this facility erased from the world, and they don't deserve to be abandoned simply for carrying out their duty.
And besides, Hephaistos has secrets yet untold. Secrets that would be buried if Pandæmonium were reduced to rubble. I mean to uncover the truth behind his words...the truth of my mother.
While Lahabrea was quick to dismiss his claims, I fail to see what Hephaistos would gain by fabricating such a story.
All I was told of my mother's death was that she perished in an accident. No one would say more─it was almost as if they feared saying more, in fact.
Even if it was not Lahabrea that dealt the fatal blow, we've seen with our own eyes how quickly he can condemn others to die. I only wish to know at last what befell her...
What do you think, ? Does the Lahabrea you know have any regard for the lives of others? Or will he carry out his duty with another's blood on his hands?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_A1_000_200: He always was a man who worked from the shadows.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_A2_000_200: He once used my ally as a vessel for his own twisted ends.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_A3_000_200: I have no idea what he might be like in this age.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_09: Well, that in and of itself isn't reason for suspicion. He's one of the Convocation, who must forge the path for mankind. Naturally, not all of their activities are conducted within the public eye.
What would possess him to do that!? Even for Lahabrea, such an act would be a black mark against him if it were made known. I can't imagine how much your ally suffered...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: “This age”? Just how long has it been since last you met? Regardless, I'd like you to try and view him as he is now. Another opinion would be much appreciated...
...But it is plain there is much to consider. Thank you, . It's easy for me to get carried away by emotion where he's concerned.
We should focus on the task at hand: proving to Lahabrea that we are capable of saving Pandæmonium and its keepers. The most convincing way to do that will be to regain control of Abyssos.
Although I'm loath to admit it, he would know more about those depths than any of us. And seeing as how we require every advantage we can afford...
, would you speak to him for us? He seems to have a special interest in your capabilities, and may deign to help at your suggestion─if only to see what you can do.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: Researchers of different layers seldom contact one another unless work is involved, and I know next to nothing about the keyward of Abyssos. Any morsels of information Lahabrea can offer would be a boon.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_130: Erichthonios appears to have a deep trust in you. And Elidibus tells me you share some relation to Azem.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_131: Your unusual aether does not mark you as a familiar. It is unlike anything I have seen, even among the countless concepts I have observed.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_132: To think that I would encounter an existence I could not create by my own hand. Azem never ceases to surprise.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_133: The previous Azem was much the same. In taking the entirety of the star into consideration, she came to hold dear emotions and people that a more logical mind would have discarded. This made her act in her own self-interest more often than not...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_134: Just as you and Elidibus have conducted yourselves in this matter. The true danger of Azem's nature is its tendency to infect all those  comes into contact with.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_135: Emet-Selch said much the same. Trust that I shall do naught that would violate my duty.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_136: And yet you so frivolously invoked your authority as emissary to justify this little excursion. It matters little, however─only your deeds can speak for you now.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_137: You wish to know more of Abyssos, I take it. Although I no longer have control over many of its functions, I can yet sense what creations lie within.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_138: The chief keyward's reach is far indeed. Well then, what do we have to look forward to?
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_139: I sense no creations of note. Perhaps they have been made into fodder for experimentation, or perhaps they have been transferred to the deeper circles.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_140: Yet Hephaistos would never allow you safe passage. He has left a trial for you to overcome.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_141: I speak of Hegemone, keyward of Abyssos. Although her presence is stained with marks of corruption, it is unmistakable.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_142: I knew her as a woman gifted in magic and blessed with a highly logical mind. While I can sense those qualities within her still, there is something else at work...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_14: If I had to hazard a guess, I would say that's because she's already been twisted into a hemitheos. Doubtless against her will...
, Themis, we must rescue her from that cruel fate. And if we cannot, we can at least seal her away until we find a means to undo the damage.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_145: Your allies make you bold, Erichthonios. I very much look forward to seeing how far they carry you.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_15: Now we prove our strength. Only then can we free the other warders and unveil the truth hidden in Pandæmonium's shadows.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_155: Hegemone was a woman of reason and logic. She would never be swayed by Hephaistos's wretched schemes. I hope she was not made to suffer overmuch...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_160: Let us not change a strategy that has served us so well thus far. Bring Hegemone to heel, , and Erichthonios and I shall inter her when the time is right.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_LAHABREA_000_190: I could sense from here that Hegemone had been contained. The effect of Hephaistos's tinkering is even more dire than I had imagined...
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_THEMIS_000_195: As is to be expected, Erichthonios appears quite pleased with our victory.
TEXT_AKTKRA203_04637_ERICHTHONIOS_000_20: We've won! The keyward is sealed away, and alive this time!
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_000: I could sense from here that Hegemone had been contained. The effect of Hephaistos's tinkering is even more dire than I had imagined...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_005: As is to be expected, Erichthonios appears quite pleased with our victory.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: ...Our plan was a success, although I hardly need to tell you that. Hegemone has been sealed away, and now you have no choice but to admit the merit in our methods.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_101: You have the right of it. I am not so petty as to deny the achievements of those I've squabbled with, no matter how strongly we disagree.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_102: Moreover, this being─aether as thin as retreating mist, unable to wield creation magicks, yet powerful enough to subdue a hemitheos─has made this ordeal far more interesting.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: Then we have leave to continue?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_104: As for that...there is one among you whose very presence puts the others at risk. 'Twould be best to proceed without him, for failure would have consequences that reach far beyond Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_106: A warder who cannot even conduct his duty without aid. In this place, hope alone is not enough to overcome what awaits you. A single misstep will send all to their doom.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: So long as we each do our part and look to the allies by our side, even a neophyte can upraise his companions. That's something that  and Themis taught me.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_108: While I do not wish to express any bias, I am inclined to agree. If my investigation has made anything clear, it is that we are together greater than the sum of our parts.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_10: And hope has brought us this far! It drives us to seek the right path─and to act before that path lies closed to us.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_110: Then tell me─what is it you hope for?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_11: To see Hephaistos in chains. That's the surest way to prevent further sacrifices.
I'm aware that destroying Pandæmonium would rid us of him, but the cost is far too great.
And I admit...I wish to know how he means to resurrect Athena.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_115: You must leave this place at once. And do not think to set foot in Pandæmonium again.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_116: You are capable, that much is plain. Yet Hephaistos cannot be suffered to live. And I shall not allow his talk of resurrection to poison mine or anyone else's mind.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_117: Life flows in a cycle. This is known.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_118: All souls return to the Underworld, and Athena's is no exception. She has likely found a new vessel─and a new journey to embark upon.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_119: You cannot be ignorant to the folly of Hephaistos's words. Even were he to breathe life into a body, the soul contained within would not be your mother's.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: What if our knowledge is imperfect? What if Hephaistos has discovered something that no one else has?
He knows all that you do. Understands the bitter reality of the world. He wouldn't pursue the impossible!
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_122: Think, Erichthonios. I have already explained that he is merely my twisted reflection. Is it worth bringing back your mother if it means others are used and discarded like tools?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: Is it worth it? To see her once more...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_124: Now you measure the worth of your colleagues' lives? What was that foolish braying about saving them? Merely a performance to hide your childish devotion to your mother?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_125: Please, such barbs will get us nowhere. We should first discuss─
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_12: You would call me “fool”? You, who murdered your wife in service of your ambition!? “For the sake of the star,” no doubt...
Ungh... I can hear it again. That voice...inside my head...
I know who to follow... Hephaistos... Father!
Mother... Oh, I love you so! And this voice...will guide me to you!
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_130: (-Distant Voice-)No, listen not! Listen not, Erichthonios!
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_ERICHTHONIOS_000_13: Apologies. You taught me that a calm heart stays the course...but I could never even grasp the rudder.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_150: This was Hephaistos's work, there can be no doubt. It seems he learned from his previous failure.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_170: Hephaistos is cunning despite his warped mind. Whatever took hold of Erichthonios, it made short work of his reason.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_171: From the moment he laid eyes upon me, I could sense his hatred and rage simmering below the surface. 'Twas but a matter of time until it spilled forth─and that was when he fell into the spell's embrace.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_172: A magic woven with such skill that Erichthonios himself failed to notice until it was too late.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_173: If this is the measure of Hephaistos's power, then the other keywards had little chance to resist it.
