TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_100_173: We saw his work during our encounter with Hesperos. Doubtless Hephaistos's magicks fed his admiration and envy until there was room for naught else in his heart.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_174: And there was something else besides... Did you not feel the presence of another?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_175: As I thought. Someone was trying to warn Erichthonios, but whom? Could it have been one of the keywards?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_176: Alas, their warning arrived too late. I had already provoked Erichthonios past the point of no return.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_177: I bear the burden for this failure. In my stubbornness I could but scorn the boy, and Hephaistos knew that.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_178: And now I dread to think of the ordeal that awaits him due to my rashness...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_179: ...There is time yet to save him. We can easily regain control of Abyssos, giving us a firm foothold from which to brave Pandæmonium's lowest level. The enemy is within reach.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_180: Just as with Hesperos, Erichthonios is in danger of being consumed by Hephaistos's spell. However, I have faith that he will not easily lose sight of himself!
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_181: The way forward is clear. Lahabrea, pray tell us all you know of what we shall find beyond Abyssos. I can only assume one more keyward lies in wait.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_182: The deepest level of Pandæmonium is called Tartaros, and your passage shall be challenged not only by a keyward...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_183: Hephaistos has laid traps in every corner of its halls. You have no hope of surviving far past the threshold.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_184: ...That, I expect, is where  shall shine.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_185: dissolute aether shall allow  to slip through the traps unimpeded. We saw it when Hephaistos's had no effect, and doubtless even he has yet to devise a countermeasure.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_186: Then time is of the essence. Hephaistos is already well aware that you can match a keyward in battle─he will not stand idle while you stroll past his other defenses at your leisure.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_187: Agreed. However, clarity will be indispensable to our success, and I'm afraid I must insist upon it ere we depart.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_188: We have yet to discern to what end Hephaistos would use Erichthonios. If you know, I would ask that you enlighten us.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_189: And then there is the matter of Athena. Why do you so fiercely rebuke Erichthonios's feelings for his mother?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_190: While I understand the very thought of resurrecting the dead is anathema, you act as if grief over her passing should be equally so. How are we to grapple with what plagues our friend and drives our foe if you refuse to acknowledge it?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_191: I do acknowledge it. I wish only to spare those that feel it still greater pain.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_A1_000_100: Did you mean to protect Erichthonios with your silence?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_A2_000_100: So instead of being honest, you bicker like a child?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_A3_000_100: And so you drove your own son over the edge.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_196: ...No, no. You are right. The blame for Erichthonios's fate rests squarely on my shoulders.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_197: Very well. I shall lay bare the truth, but only after the foe before us has been laid low.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_198: The remaining keyward is Agdistis. She has served in Pandæmonium since its inception, and her affinity for magic is peerless even among the keywards.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_199: Hephaistos knows that losing her would mean the end of his experiments. He has hidden her in a space unreachable by conventional means.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_200: But your presence makes mockery of such barriers. The scarcity of your aether means it will be trivial to send you directly to Agdistis.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_201: We shall approach as closely as caution will allow. We know where the battle will commence, so I do not anticipate difficulty in detecting your presence.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_202: From afar, I shall do my best to provide you with ground on which to fight and phantom allies to aid you. As for the interment, I have yet to think of a foolproof method...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_204: From here I can sense Agdistis's essence...but it is scarcely recognizable. Hephaistos was more ambitious with her than he was with Hegemone. She has been transfigured such that barely a scantling of her self remains.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_205: We can but take comfort in what a mercy the Underworld will be to her.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_220: I shall establish control of Abyssos while keeping an eye on your battle. When the dust has settled, Hephaistos will have nowhere left to flee.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_225: I sense that Hephaistos has come close to perfecting his image of a hemitheos. Which means his research is in its final stage...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_500: The moment Agdistis was slain, the flow of aether in Pandæmonium focused keenly on this location, creating a tunnel of sorts through which we could quickly convey ourselves. 'Twas almost as if we were ushered here...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_501: This space was created with care, and concealed with powerful wards. Only a keyward would have been able to detect it, and even then with great difficulty. Ergo...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_502: If only I could restore Tartaros to order...but I am afraid this is the most I can manage with such power as remains to me.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_503: It has been too long, Master Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_504: Likewise, Keyward Agdistis. I should not be surprised you were able to break free of Hephaistos's spells, even diminished as you were.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_505: 'Twas not an easy task, even with your aid. His curses dig into one's heart, creating a storm of emotions that is all too easy to become lost in. Only by chance did a fragment of my self remain, illuminating a path through the madness.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_506: And thus am I able to appear before you now. Even while my body was powerless to resist Hephaistos's commands, some small part of my logical mind stood alone in defiance. It even managed to speak to the outside world.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_508: Doubtless you recognize my voice from the many times I have called out to you. The hope that those pleas would not fall on deaf ears was all that kept me from succumbing to hopelessness.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_509: But I have a greater purpose here than simply saying my farewells. There is something you must know, that the tragedies of the past do not repeat in the present.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_510: Forgive me for what I am about to do, Master Lahabrea, but the story must be told. 'Tis the only way to understand Hephaistos's fixation on Erichthonios.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_511: No longer can you hide your heart away...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_512: Hephaistos? No, the mask marks him as Lahabrea...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_513: Master Lahabrea had brought an end to Lady Athena's life, and sealed away a part of his memories and emotions within Hephaistos. These are my recollections of the moments following.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_514: ...And you truly have no intention of revealing the truth to Erichthonios?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_515: My lesser half is now buried where none can find it. We would be wise to do the same with our memory of this day.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_516: Blood should not sway the spirit so, but Athena's teachings have warped the boy. I fear he would see our star burn to keep his mother safe.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_517: Erichthonios believes that he feels love, but he is shackled by dependence. He could not bear the truth.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_518: His dependence makes it all the more important to be open with him. He will seek answers about his mother's loss, which shall inevitably lead him to you. Are you willing to accept the blame for Athena's death? Are you willing to accept your son's hatred?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_519: If that is what comes to pass, then so be it. Better to be burdened with hatred than the knowledge that Athena thought his body and soul mere tools. To be used and discarded...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_520: Even were I to tell him what his mother plotted, he would ever seek reasons to believe that the true fault lies with me─or with him. Should he merely hate me, he will remain unfettered by doubt─free to serve the star far from his parents' shadow.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_521: Erichthonios loved his mother more than life itself, and yet... What a dreadful truth you've borne all this time.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_523: Such is Lahabrea's nature. Every action, every word a solution to life's great dilemmas─and none to spare for his own.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_524: What I have revealed to you is but a small portion of a larger picture. I shall leave it to Lahabrea to paint the rest for you─and for Erichthonios, I hope.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_DEIANEIRA_000_526: I always admired you, you know. What choice did I have, when you sacrificed so much to guide our star to the heavens?
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_527: Hephaistos has doubtless sensed that his final keyward has fallen. We should return to the surface before he moves to strike us here.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_528: If we are to face him, we must be prepared to bring our full strength to bear.
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_540: It was Erichthonios's hatred of his father that caused him to fall victim to Hephaistos's magicks. Yet the roots of that hatred were born from a son's love...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_THEMIS_000_541: ...A love nurtured not by a mother caring for her offspring, but by a researcher creating the ideal test subject. Pandæmonium abounds with demons indeed...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_550: Agdistis was ever a bold woman, even in her final moments. That she would unearth the secrets of my past for all to look upon...
TEXT_AKTKRA204_04638_LAHABREA_000_551: ...Still, full glad am I that she faced you as her last opponent. I could think of none more worthy to send her soul off to the other side.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_000: From a son's undying love for his mother was born a deep well of hatred for his father.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_001: For Erichthonios, those emotions were all too real─the efficacy of Hephaistos's magicks attests to that. Yet they were spun by a guiding hand, one which sought to use his inner turmoil as a tool for experimentation.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_010: The vision you saw told the story far more eloquently than I ever could. Athena was consumed by her research, and was willing to sacrifice her own child if it hastened her progress.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_011: She did not offer him a position here out of a sense of love or pride─'twas merely because she knew he would be the most pliable test subject.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_012: I see now why you hid the truth from him. I cannot say with certainty that Erichthonios could handle the weight of such betrayal, after holding his mother on a pedestal for so long...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_013: Unfortunately, it seems not even her death has ensured his safety. Hephaistos has taken up Athena's research, and succeeded in creating hemitheoi.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_014: I know not what his ultimate end is, but 'tis plain it is connected with the resurrection of Athena.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_015: That knowledge alone is sufficient to direct our next course of action. As for the rest of your story, we shall hear it after we have returned Erichthonios to safety, in accordance with Agdistis's last wish.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_017: I can, at least, assure you that finding him shall prove relatively simple now that Hephaistos can no longer bend Pandæmonium to his will.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_019: There is but one place left for him to find refuge: the black heart of Tartaros, where Athena built her testing compound.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_020: We can assume that Hephaistos will offer fierce resistance. I must focus my every effort on securing a safe means of approach.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_021: Lahabrea, I would ask that you assume the duty of summoning 's phantom warriors.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_022: ...I have no objections. My ability to fight within Tartaros would be greatly diminished in any case.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_023: However, I wish to deal the final blow to Hephaistos myself. There is no need to dirty your hands with such a deed.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_024: I take it, then, that you have no intent to seal him away as before.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_100_024: The presence I felt when I encountered Hephaistos bore little resemblance to the entity I created. By his own hand he has become something far more wicked, and the same magicks that once shackled him may very well shatter before the power he wields.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_025: On my pride as a researcher, I am loath to repeat the same mistake twice. I would not see these events play out again, and so he must be extinguished.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_026: Well then, I shall open the way forward. May we finish this─together!
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_030: The end is in sight. Return to me safely, friend.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_032: If Hephaistos truly means to continue Athena's research, then Erichthonios is indispensable to his goals. He is safe, but for how much longer I cannot say...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_050: The chain of events that led to this moment began with my error, when out of mercy I confined you here. Now I break it, and leave no trace of you behind.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_052: I see you will not go peacefully...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_HEPHAESTUS_000_053: Even a castoff would uphold his pride. Though such an impulse must speak to the overwhelming arrogance of my other half...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_HEPHAESTUS_000_054: The name “Hephaistos” shall grow to eclipse yours. None shall remember the deeds of Lahabrea once I fulfill Athena's ambition...and bring Erichthonios's dream to life!
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_055: You speak as if you care a whit for the boy. Why then do you cower behind him?
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_056: There are some desires which must not be realized. Athena would see the world destroyed if it meant she could find hers in the ruins. As for Erichthonios...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_057: He knows not what his wish would beget─a truth which you have hidden from him. Do you truly believe a father's role is to deceive and manipulate?
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_059: You would claim the name Hephaistos and call yourself his father, yet you bind his mind and body in dark chains. Your words─and your pride─ring hollow.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_HEPHAESTUS_000_060: Athena wanted her son by her side, and he desires to return there. What wickedness is there in mending a broken family?
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_061: Athena cared naught for Erichthonios, beyond how he could serve her ends.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_062: You claim to be acting in his interest, but 'tis plain you are no different.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_063: As I ushered Athena to her end, I vowed that my sole mission in life would be to guide this star true.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_064: In service to that vow, I silenced the whispers of my heart. I could not nurture a son whilst an entire world looked to me for guidance. For that choice, I bear the responsibility...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_065: Yet he is still my son, and I'll not suffer you to seduce him with false hope. You, who are naught but the bitter dregs of Athena and I─the very worst of us!
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_ERICHTHONIOS_000_06: Mother, she... N-No! Then who─ How do I...?
I-I hear you... I owe you...and Themis...an apology...
Athena, did you ever...? And Lahabrea, I...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_ERICHTHONIOS_000_07: I can't explain. 's words reached me through the haze...
As did the words of another. In a voice much like yours, but resounding with truth!
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_HEPHAESTUS_000_074: How... When did you master these bonds!?
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_ERICHTHONIOS_000_07: It appears my failures have borne fruit after all...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_THEMIS_000_092: What is this? The barriers around Pandæmonium are no longer under assault.
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_100: With Hephaistos's essence contained in this crystal, we may safely return Erichthonios above. That he would bind Hephaistos with only half his senses intact...
TEXT_AKTKRA205_04639_LAHABREA_000_101: You quite understated his adeptness in the art of interment. It was hardly what I had in mind, but a feat deserving of praise nonetheless.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_002: What is this? The barriers around Pandæmonium are no longer under assault.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_010: I feel no trace of Hephaistos's poison in your mind, and for a blessing, it appears your body is none the worse for wear.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_011: I made my way here as soon as I could. I no longer sense Hephaistos, and the force assailing Pandæmonium's barriers has ceased. Are we rid of him for good and all?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_012: ...I see. Despite his muddled senses, Erichthonios felt that to seal Hephaistos away was the proper course.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: It wasn't so noble as that. I only knew something had to be done, so I acted.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_100_01: Lahabrea...was that how you dealt with Hephaistos in the past?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_014: Indeed. He was naught but the parts of my memory and soul that I had cut away─a mass of aether without a material vessel. Storing his essence within a crystal was the most logical choice.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_015: ...On that matter, I believe the time has come for you to share the rest of your tale. Of Hephaistos's creation and Athena's end.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: I heard your words, but only vaguely, as if from under the surface of a deep pool. My mother wished...to use me?
I would hear the whole truth. I want to know what happened here, and what drove Athena to act as she did. I'm ready.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_018: Athena's brilliance outshone us all─even the other members of the Words of Lahabrea were as children in comparison. So dedicated to research was she that it was not unheard of for her to forget meals or even sleep.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_019: Her mind was ever grasping for knowledge, and it was in this endless search that she became obsessed with uncovering the secrets of life.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_020: You see, while we can conceive life in various forms, the means of creating a soul are beyond our ken. Similarly, though we can enhance and alter our physical vessels, we have ever been bound to them. Athena's purpose was to shatter these limitations.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_021: Such limitations as we were not meant to surpass. She sought to enter the realm of the gods.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_022: Scarce few have the ability to comprehend what such a task entails, let alone the courage to attempt it.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_02: For most, the thought would be an idle fancy, considered once and then discarded. Not so for Athena...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_024: As leader of the Words of Lahabrea, I spoke with her often about transcending our being. From an academic perspective, the challenge has plagued countless researchers through the ages.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_025: It was during these musings that I began to formulate a theory─a means by which a person could meld with a creation. The weaknesses of one would be mitigated by the strengths of the other, and the result could be something greater than we have ever imagined.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_026: Although it was but a theory, Athena insisted I develop it further, curious about every detail along the way. Our conversations became more frequent, and our platonic relationship grew into something much more...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_02: I take it I was born not soon after...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_028: Just so. I believed she bore true affection for me, and was blind to her hidden intentions. When Pandæmonium was built and she requested to lead the researchers, I saw no reason to deny her.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_029: Even setting aside our relationship, her accomplishments as a scholar made her the obvious choice. However, in giving her Pandæmonium, I also gave her free rein to conduct whatsoever experiments she could devise.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: And when you found out what she was doing...you killed her.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_031: I made haste to Pandæmonium the moment I learned of these hidden chambers. I left Agdistis to keep watch from Tartaros's vestibule as I ventured deeper, knowing not what would await me.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_032: ...As for what occurred next, 'tis best to see with your own eyes.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_051: You are well aware that out of respect for our neighbors in Elpis, the researchers of Pandæmonium are not to be masked.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_052: Yet you stand before me with your face covered. What petty defiance is this?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_053: What indeed? So quick you are to rebuke me, though you yourself have not set foot in these halls since their inception.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_054: You must have known you could not conceal this from myself and Agdistis forever...as well you know that I cannot allow it to continue.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_055: I shall say this but once: release Erichthonios. Else I shall have no choice but to strike you down.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_056: I would meet my end at the hands of none other. However, ere my time is come, I will have you know the why of it.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_058: Once you understand what has driven me this far, you shall see that stopping was never an option.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_059: The feelings of one weigh little against the needs of the entire star.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_060: Of course, of that I am well aware. But you did not deign to descend from your lofty heights simply to lecture me as you would a child.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_061: You have an interest in my motivations. What possessed Athena, peerless researcher and mother to the son of the great Lahabrea, to embark upon the path to her downfall?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_062: History will demand an answer, but it is you who deserves one. Give me your hand, Lahabrea, and we shall know one another more deeply than ever before.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_064: Aye. That the boundaries between us would cease to be... She offered me everything, to be understood.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_065: I found myself unable to refuse. At that moment, my mind was a storm of questions, yet one roared the loudest...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_066: Did Athena ever truly love me?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_067: I am become thee, memory and mind...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_100_069: (-Athena's Voice-)My heart... All that I am.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_070: Yes. As if it were my own...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_071: A fathomless desire to dissect the mysteries of life... To transcend our mortal flesh, and bleed into a higher plane of existence!
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_072: An unquenchable thirst for knowledge. Not a single thought spared for another...for the star!
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_074: Yet what is known cannot be unknown. You have beheld my life's work.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ATHENA_000_075: Try as you might to excise the memory, the seed of desire remains. And when it takes root, you too shall be consumed by the selfsame fervor.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_076: I will dig it out! I will dispense with the corruption in my soul ere your rotten insight spreads.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_077: 'Twas my weakness that let this wickedness fester─but never again. Today I cast aside fickle emotion, and abide in duty alone.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_078: Today I renounce all that I was, and live only as Lahabrea!
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_079: Thus did I forsake the part of myself that had been polluted by Athena, sealing it within a crystal.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_080: Never did I think I would one day face those memories made flesh.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_081: Forgive my bluntness, but your actions bordered on insanity. To go to such lengths to escape your memories... You nearly rewrote your very existence.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_082: Rest assured, the change did not go unnoticed by our colleagues in the Convocation. Igeyorhm and Emet-Selch, in particular, made plain the suspicions they harbored.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_083: As well they should have... That you escaped with your life was nothing short of a miracle.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_08: ...Why didn't you destroy the crystal then and there? Did you think to one day make use of the knowledge it contained?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_085: I will not deny such considerations played into my decision, but my main motivation was fear. I had never attempted such a feat before.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_086: The crystal was my sole recourse should something go awry with the remainder of my soul. In hindsight, to cling to it was a mistake born of doubt...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_087: Athena must have anticipated that I would resort to such measures, and prepared a vessel beforehand that would accept the dregs of my soul.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_088: Hephaistos doubtless believed he was performing his duty as a husband and father should. Yet in truth, he was but a puppet being pulled to and fro by Athena's desires.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_089: His goal was not to raise himself high... He thought only of seeing his dear Athena live again, that she might finish what she began.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_090: Yet for all of that, he and I were alike. We yet shared a fatal flaw, you see─our need for control blinded us to other perspectives.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_09: While I was in thrall to Hephaistos, you called out to me. What say you now? Does Lahabrea speak true?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_A2_000_100: Yes, and now it's your turn to do the same.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_A3_000_100: What does your heart tell you?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_09: ...I just want to know one thing. Did you truly believe that hiding the truth was best for me? Even knowing how I felt about my mother?
The Lahabrea I know had a “fatal flaw,” after all. I'm still not convinced.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_097: I have said all that I can say. Now it is for you to choose to believe me...or not.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_09: The Lahabrea I know holds duty above all else. I would sooner prostrate myself before an erupting volcano than place my fickle emotions in his path.
When you return to the surface, you'll doubtless don that mask once more. So before we climb out of this forsaken pit, I suppose I should say...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_110: I have said all that needs to be said. From this moment forward, I pledge that my heart shall not lead me astray.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_115: Hephaistos was far more than an imitation of Lahabrea. He was quite literally a part of him...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_116: But Lahabrea, to me, is a man who thinks of naught but his duty. By casting aside the burden that Hephaistos represented, he shall become ever more “himself,” in a way.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_13: I've heard enough. There is more I would yet discuss, but we should first return to Pandæmonium's gates. I'll gather my thoughts on the way.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_140: Athena viewed Erichthonios as the ideal test subject. Hephaistos's research must have been very nearly complete, to seek him out like he did...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_145: We have regained complete control of the facility, but it shall take some time yet until things are in working order again.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_15: I owe you an apology, . It was due to my own inexperience that Hephaistos was so easily able to take hold of my mind.
I also owe you thanks. If you and Themis hadn't chosen to brave the chaos occurring in Pandæmonium, then I would have never known Lahabrea's story. My father's story.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_152: 'Twas a tale I too was fascinated to hear. I very much look forward to speaking with Azem upon my return─I cannot help but wonder how much of this  foresaw.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_153: ...I am afraid I cannot allow that, Elidibus. So long as you retain control of Pandæmonium, there is work to be done.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_154: But of course. I shall first free the remaining warders and restore this place to its former glory.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_155: Using the facilities in Tartaros, we should be able to reverse the changes made to their bodies and minds. I shall stay behind to oversee the process.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_15: That is well, but I must yet learn why I was considered the key to Hephaistos's experiments, and how he intended to revive Athena.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_157: Such questions are best left unanswered. In fact, I forbid the pursuit of that knowledge─the boundary between man and creation shall never again be crossed.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_100_157: And I intend to destroy the crystal containing Hephaistos's essence, that this mistake never again repeats.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_158: I see no reason to gainsay your judgment.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_159: There is yet the matter of your crystal, however. Truth be told, I had not considered its origin until I saw the one containing Hephaistos's aether. I was struck by how wholly different they were.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_161: While imbuing a crystal with memories is a simple process, storing a message─a warning, even─would be something altogether more complex.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_162: This also means that someone besides the present company─and Azem─was aware of the plot unfolding within Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: Then why would they not make themselves known, even now? No threats remain...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_164: Perhaps it was one of the other warders. We shall question them after they are freed.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: That task may take some time─a resource I'd rather not steal more of from you. Return at your leisure, and we will share our results then. You've done more than enough for the time being.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_166: I am of the same mind. Leave the loose ends to us, and continue upon your journey. Or if you are so inclined, take a much-needed repose.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_167: ...This talk of journeys smacks of Azem.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_168: As well it should.  has pledged to keep moving until  has seen every corner of the world.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: If you do find yourself with a spare moment, you might bring that crystal of yours to Lahabrea─he may be able to offer further insight. Until then, my friend.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_ERICHTHONIOS_000_18: As you may have noticed during our battle, Lahabrea's mask crowns me when I've transformed.

It is said that we manifest in a way that reflects our innermost selves. I had thought that mask a symbol of the chains that bound my heart, but recent events have caused me to reconsider that assumption...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_THEMIS_000_185: I look forward to your returning with the crystal... But worry not, I shall try my level best to stave off loneliness while you are gone.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_190: The crystal that hangs from Erichthonios's waist was a gift from me, made in the hopes that it would spark growth in his aptitude for magic. 'Tis plain he no longer requires it, but I see no reason he cannot wear it for a while longer.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_200: Why, if it isn't ! Excuse me if I'm not my usual chipper self, but we have not been without our difficulties in your absence...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_201: You see, communication with the airship Professor Claudien commissioned for his search was lost some time ago, and now we have quite lost track of where he might be!
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_LAHABREA_000_202: And to make matters worse, Nemjiji has just sent word of an unusually large amount of energy coming from somewhere within the aetherial sea. I was just on my way to the Aitiascope, in fact─please, you must come with me!
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_RUISSENAUD_000_700: What... What is that? Is it real!?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_FOURCHENAULT_000_70: (-???-)Why is it that whenever danger visits the world, you are never far behind?
And you two... Professor Claudien's assistants, I take it?
As you arrived before me, I take it you are involved in this. I would thank you to furnish me with an explanation.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_FOURCHENAULT_000_72: While the research summary you submitted to the Forum gave us no cause for concern, these details are...alarming.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_NEMJIJI_000_721: The professor's last message indicated he was on his way to Azys Lla, but we know not whether he ever reached his destination.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_FOURCHENAULT_000_72: A rash endeavor, even for Claudien─but he has ever allowed the thrill of discovery to cloud his better judgment. We have no recourse but to entreat Ishgard's aid in searching for him.
As for that unsightly fortress which materialized in the aetherial sea─Pandæmonium, was it?─it cannot be left alone.

For the time being, information regarding this matter must be strictly controlled so as to minimize panic. We will gather those with knowledge of the aetherial sea, and continue monitoring it for further irregularities.
You two, submit a detailed report to the Forum at once.
At present, we have far more questions than answers. Nevertheless, I would ask for your assistance at such a time that our investigation has concluded.
Very good. Now if you will excuse me, I must apprise the Forum of what has occurred here.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_RUISSENAUD_000_760: Just when we need him the most, Professor Claudien remains unaccounted for.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_RUISSENAUD_100_760: He even brought the crystal with him. We are left with scarce few straws to grasp at...
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_RUISSENAUD_000_761: While I am but a lowly assistant, even I can see that our two current problems are likely related. The same party or phenomenon may be responsible for both.
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_RUISSENAUD_000_762: Conversely, I see now that my unexperienced imagination failed to do Pandæmonium's pitiless spires justice. I can only wonder─if the facility itself traversed the ages, did the creations within do the same? What of the keywards?
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_RUISSENAUD_000_763: ...But answers to these questions shall come in time, I am sure. For now, I must do as Master Fourchenault asked and write that report!
TEXT_AKTKRA206_04640_RUISSENAUD_000_764: As for you, , pray get what rest your responsibilities will allow. When next we call upon you, I wager we shall need you in prime condition!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_100_000: If you've come to ask about developments in our phantom realm investigation, then your timing couldn't be better.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_001: A short while ago, I received word from G'raha Tia. He and Krile have completed their preparations in Sharlayan, and are ready to resume fieldwork.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_003: Even as we speak, they make their way hither. Let's wait for them together, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_012: What in the heavens are you carrying?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_013: This, my friends, is the latest technological marvel to come out of Sharlayan...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_100_013: I give you the aetheric analyzer!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_014: Holding it thus, you take a measure of the ambient aether...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_015: ...Whose waveform is then recorded by the aetherotranscriber at the back. This provides us with detailed data of the environment, which we can study at our leisure.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_100_015: As you know, the phantom realms are hidden by illusions. In order to ascertain their nature, I suggested to Krile that we record the data with proper equipment.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_016: Alas, said equipment is tremendously cumbersome. Raha has done well to bring it here in one piece, and as expensive as it doubtless is, I hope we can return it in the same condition...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_018: Yes, to the Forum. In approving our investigation, they granted us use of the device in addition to their financial backing.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_019: Despite the Students' greatly reduced scale, the Forum has faith in our endeavors─thus did the approval notice declare, I'm proud to say.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_020: We owe much of this goodwill to the Scions, yourself not least of all.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_021: That being said, we can't depend on the Forum indefinitely. No, we must stand on our own two feet again, and it begins with our efforts in this investigation.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_022: The Twelve are meant to be Eorzea's guardian deities, yet they seek battle with mankind. What could it possibly be that motivates them?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_023: In treating with them earnestly, I am hopeful that we will find the answer.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_024: Well, we shouldn't keep Snoegeim waiting. Without further ado, let's join her in the Omphalos.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_100_030: Well now, if that isn't the aetheric analyzer! You've done well to get a hold of it!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_110_030: Indeed, we're duly grateful to the Forum for the loan. It's no small thing to be lugging about, but I've always wanted to try it.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_031: If you are ready, Raha, you may proceed with measuring the aether of the phantom realm. ─please assist him, will you?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_032: In the meantime, I have a mind to further examine the monument with Snoegeim. How does that sound?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_033: Like a plan! As a matter of fact, I've already done a little bit of work on that front.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_034: As you previously determined, the monument harbors some manner of magic. And this magic, I've since found, takes the form of an epigraph!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_035: By consulting Professors Rurusha and Namono, Sharlayan's foremost experts in the field of archaeology, I was able to make a discovery.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_036: By consulting experts in the field of archaeology, I was able to make a discovery.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_037: Oh yes, a most startling discovery!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_038: ...That is, the epigraph is largely incomplete, so we can't read it.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_039: So you didn't make a discovery...?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_040: Ah, but see, establishing what one doesn't know is also an important step in research!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_041: For a blessing, the language used doesn't appear to be completely unknown. If we can but fill in the missing information, it should be possible to make sense of it.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_042: But where do we even begin looking for such information?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_043: Why, we ask the gods themselves, of course!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_100_043: By giving them the battle they desire, we're doing them a favor, are we not? That being the case, I daresay they would grace us with their presence if called. Please come with me!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_110_043: Oh, the things I would ask them if they really did appear...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_044: Now, going by astrology, the Heaven of Earth should be the next to open. And it just so happens I know the perfect incantation for this purpose!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_046: It's a time-honored charm passed down in Gridania, whose patron is Nophica, one of the deities said to dwell in the Heaven of Earth. Come, everyone─say it with me!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_048: (-Cheery Voice-)Hehe, what delightful children you are. I too have desired to speak with you.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_049: B-By the Twelve! It's her! It's really her!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_050: She looks precisely as depicted in legend! Amazing!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_051: 'Tis an honor to meet you, Nophica. If I may, what is it that you wish to speak about?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_052: You seek to decipher the monument, do you not? If you face more of us in battle, I myself included, we shall grant you the key to unlocking that mystery.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_053: We would of course be much obliged for such a gift, but are you certain? The gods before were not exactly forthcoming with your secrets.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_054: Closely have we watched you from our respective sanctums. Watched as you faced us and pursued the truth with pure hearts and minds.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_055: In light of what we have seen, we have concluded thus:
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_056: Even should you uncover the monument's purpose, you would still be willing to lend us your aid.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_057: Help us to fulfill our heart's desire, and so too shall we grant you yours.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_058: I look forward to receiving you in my sanctum, my dear children.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_060: Our efforts to understand the Twelve appear to have paid off.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_065: I wasn't expecting a god to actually appear. 'Twas but a coincidence, surely...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_070: It worked! The charm reached the Matron! If it can be repeated, I shall have to mention it in my thesis!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_080: The original plan was to revisit the Heavens of Lightning and Fire...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_081: But I believe all would agree that we should prioritize Nophica's invitation.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_082: Well, Snoegeim, your charm did the trick. The way to another heaven lies open, and beyond it the truth of the monument.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_083: I can scarcely wait to pore over the aetheric data! Raha, ─I leave it in your capable hands!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_084: As for you, Deryk─may we rely on your guidance once more?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_085: Now that we know what awaits, I do not feel my presence is necessary; on the contrary, I would only be a burden.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_100_086: We can still count on you to pray for our friends, though, I trust?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_087: I'm glad that I can join you this time, .
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_088: Encumbered as I am with the analyzer, I fear I won't be able to assist in battle, but I shall do my part and secure the data we need!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_090: Curious about my attire, are you? I borrowed it alongside the analyzer. It's the choice of gleaners, cleverly designed to help one bear great loads.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_100_090: And hefty as the analyzer is, by now I'm quite used to the feel of it. That's to say, I won't unduly slow you down. Come, let us set forth!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_091: In actually fighting the gods, yours is the hardest task of all.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_092: The rest of us are truly grateful to you, and we shall do our utmost to support your efforts.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_093: Knowing you, you should have no trouble finding your way without me. I will cheer you on from here.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_095: Thanks to the aetheric analyzer, even those who can't accompany you will have access to valuable data. Compliments to the Forum for the loan!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_100_096: You have the data, then? Wonderful, wonderful!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_110_096: I don't suppose I could do the honors and replace the transcriber cartridge? I've always wanted to take a closer look!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_100: Take care removing it, now. We don't want anything to happen to the data.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_100_100: Carefully does it... Come to me, O knowledge divine! Come to me!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_099_102: I-It's all right! Th-The cartridge is safe!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_100_102: Let's finish the task before there are any more surprises...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_ALTHYK_000_103: You have our gratitude for bringing us closer to achieving our dream.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NYMEIA_000_104: Oh, Althyk, must you always be so formal? Although he has trouble expressing it, I assure you, my brother is absolutely giddy with joy.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_HALONE_000_105: Why are you here, Nophica? Have you not sufficiently amused yourself with the mortals?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_106: Not nearly! I would talk to them some more.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_107: Nophica promised you the key to deciphering the monument, did she not?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_ALTHYK_000_109: Then you would do well to hold in your minds that which harbors information.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NYMEIA_000_110: Come now, Brother, you need to speak plainer than that. To clarify, we shall create the objects you need, but your assistance is required to give them form.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NYMEIA_000_111: Worry not─appearance has no effect on function. Just try and imagine that which, in your minds, is used to hold information.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NYMEIA_000_112: There. These instruments shall be useful in your quest.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_ALTHYK_000_113: Across Eorzea lie eternal stones that hold the information required to complete the words of the monument.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_ALTHYK_000_114: By holding an instrument out to a stone, it will take that information unto itself.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_ALTHYK_000_115: We scattered these stones across the realm that mortals would not uncover our secrets. Of late, however, 'twould seem you have found alternate uses for them as objects of worship.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_116: Could they be the marks of the Twelve!?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_100_116: They are, aren't they? Oh, to think that they harbored information on the gods!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_117: It seems we have our next destinations. Aside from the three city-states, I believe the marks are located in Coerthas and Mor Dhona.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_118: I propose we split up, the quicker to finish the task.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_NOPHICA_000_120: No, Menphina. 'Twould not do to burden these children so.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_121: After all this time, we finally have the chance to speak with mortals─to learn about them from up close. And we're not like to have another...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_HALONE_000_122: I must say, I share Menphina's view.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_124: I'd like to learn about you too, and I believe I speak for all of us! By all means, let us travel together!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_125: Music to my ears! We shall watch over you and see that you safely reach your destinations. Without further ado, then...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_AZEYMA_000_127: (-Meerkat with Azeyma's Voice-)Did you think you could go frolicking without us? The others have our domain well in hand, so we are coming too.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_128: Well now, far be it from us to stop you. Let us assume our disguises too, and then each choose a mortal to accompany!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_129: Please, let it be something inconspicuous...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_000_130: Hm-hm! I believe my destination is Thanalan. Then it's La Noscea for Raha, the Twelveswood for Krile...
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_SNOEGEIM_100_130: And last but not least, Mor Dhona and Coerthas for Deryk and .
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_GRAHATIA_000_131: Will you be all right, Krile?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_KRILE_000_132: I shall be fine. You needn't worry.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_140: Never before have I traveled with mortals. Ahhh, such fun this will be!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_HALONE_000_145: Others will remain to keep watch over our domain. You needn't worry on our account.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_150: We abided by the gods' selections...but why do you suppose the two of us were grouped together?
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_151: Why, because you make the most intriguing pair. The gods-felling hero, and the world-faring explorer!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_100_151: I shall relish the chance to learn about both of you!
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_152: Now then, the others have already set forth, so let us do the same. Aside from my own mark, I believe we'll find those of Thaliak and Halone in Mor Dhona and Coerthas.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_MENPHINA_000_154: Oh my, what an adorable creature! Delighted to meet you, little one.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_HALONE_000_155: It seems to want to join us too.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_156: What an unusual company this has become... The gods truly know no inhibition.
TEXT_AKTKEA201_04666_DERYK_000_157: Forgive me, . I couldn't have anticipated this turn of events...
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_005: Menphina is winsome, is she not? We all think of her as our youngest sister.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_020: Well, what are we waiting for? Let us seek out the marks at once!
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_021: Yes, yes... No need to be so hasty.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_022: The nearest mark is Thaliak's, just outside in Mor Dhona. If memory serves, it overlooks the lake at a place called Rathefrost.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_026: Do you like traveling, ? I adore it, and not simply for its own sake.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_027: It's an important way to perform one of our foremost duties, you see─peering into the hearts of mortals.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_030: Now then, we're to hold out an instrument to the stone. Would you care to do the honors here, ?
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_032: 'Tis done. The information held in the stone has been etched.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_033: As Althyk said, these stones are eternal. No matter their shape or location, their nature is unchanging.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_034: Together with the monument in the Omphalos, they have remained the same since time immemorial.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_035: 'Twas the love that men bear for us, and we for the star, that compelled us to create the monument and the stones.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_036: And though men do not know the truth of the stones, they offer them prayer.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_100_036: This act is a manifestation of your bond with us.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_110_036: While the stones are a manifestation of our bond with the star.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_037: And so, by praying to the stones, you effectively cultivate a bond between yourselves and us and the star! Delightful, is it not?
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_038: Ahem. Though we appreciate your eagerness to talk, perhaps we should save some conversation for the destinations to come.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_039: If we linger too long in any one place, we are liable to be late to reconvene with the others.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_040: Then let us make for the central highlands of Coerthas. Within the Fury's Gaze, my own mark awaits.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_050: In this land where mankind's faith in me is strong, I cannot help but feel uplifted.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_055: There is nothing like taking to the road with agreeable company, do you not agree?
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_SYSTEM_000_060: The baby opo-opo shivers uncontrollably in the cold...
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_070: There it is─the mark of the Fury.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_071: It wouldn't do to burden you constantly. I shall extract the information this time.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_072: Looking back, Halone, you've grown noticeably more imposing this past millennium. There are also more statues in the Heaven of Ice...
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_073: Ooh, but an idea occurs to me! ─this time I want you to share what you know about the worship of Halone.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_074: I daresay it will be interesting to hear what mankind thinks of her from your perspective!
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_A1_000_001: The Ishgardian Orthodox Church is the heart of faith in the Fury.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_A1_000_002: You often hear Halone's name invoked in battle.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_A1_000_003: The church is returning to its roots, and moves to separate itself from the state.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_100_074: Ah, yes. The prayers of the people are fervent indeed, and through the church they evolved─a change I felt with my very being.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_110_074: Ah, yes. Ever did I feel the people's fervent desire to be strong, that they might protect that which they hold dear.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_120_074: Ah, so the people's faith continues to evolve. You and yours are ever on the move, marching inexorably forward. 'Tis a quality I find admirable.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_075: Well, how very fascinating! 'Tis a fine thing indeed to hear directly from mortals.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_100_075: Still...as much as Halone loves her children, it troubled her to see them at war with the dragons. To see those who share this star spill each other's blood.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_076: As you should well know, Menphina, it isn't our place to judge the faith of mortals.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_100_076: Even when we lend them our aid, we must refrain from intervening in their affairs.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_077: Lest there be any doubt, mankind's faith in us is mankind's alone.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_100_077: By your prayers, our forms are become that which they need to be.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_079: Acquired the information, have you? Excellent. Let us proceed to the next mark─mine!
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_080: As I recall, it lies near the Steel Vigil, by the cliff west of the entrance. Follow me!
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_090: Well now, aren't we quick? My mark lies just ahead. Let's wait for the others and then continue together.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_100: Oh look, someone's praying. Hehe, how delightful to see one of my faithful children!
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_REDROBEMAN04668_000: (-Red-robed Man-)O benevolent goddess... Grant me deliverance, I beseech you. Save my soul...
(-Red-robed Man-)Y-You! You're the one who was hunting down the Lambs of Dalamud!
(-Red-robed Man-)I knew it─knew you wouldn't stop till you've dealt with every last one of us. And now you've come for me... Ah, to think that this is Her will...
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_105: They are the cult that appeared prior to the Seventh Umbral Calamity, are they not? In the name of their faith, they abducted and sacrificed innocent souls, and did not fear death.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_REDROBEMAN04668_000: I've committed no crimes, I swear it! Menphina as my witness!
In the beginning, we simply prayed to the twin moons─for Dalamud to one day shepherd our souls to the bosom of His mistress.
But it all changed when Dalamud began turning red. More and more of us began believing that He was our savior. That we must prove our loyalty with our lives, else we would suffer eternal damnation...
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_109: So that's how your group took on its fanatical ways, and came to be branded a dangerous cult.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_110: And at some point, I assume you were tasked with hunting them down.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_REDROBEMAN04668_000: I used to be a merchant in Ul'dah. But timid as I am, I struggled to survive in that cutthroat world.
That's why I turned to Menphina. I wanted to bask in Her gentle acceptance, and gain courage from Her strong and faithful hound. They were my solace─the only way I could be at peace with myself.
But they took it from me! My fellows who committed those horrible deeds, and those who reviled me as one of them! They took it away!
Y-You're strong, aren't you? Grant me deliverance, I beg you! Judge me and show me the way!
<sob> I just can't bear it anymore... What good is a god I can't see, who won't grant me a thimble of succor no matter how much I pray?
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_116: ...You mustn't seek in men what you seek in gods.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_117: Strong as  is,  is but a mortal. Like you,  is made of flesh and blood and possessed of  own will. Nothing more, nothing less.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_118: It avails you naught to raise others up while belittling yourself. You are your own person, with a path of your own to walk. Even should you be taken by despair, that you are here now makes you no different from this .
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_119: So believe me when I say, all will be well. Keep your faith in Menphina─believe in Her love and grace─and you will surely learn to love others as well as yourself.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_REDROBEMAN04668_000: Please forgive me for my unseemly outburst... I had been feeling lost, and all my anguish came spilling out.
It was Menphina Herself who brought you here, I'm certain of it. To encourage and guide me. Taking your words to heart, I'll try searching for a new path.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_122: Should you feel lost again─take to the road. See what is out there. Learn how others live and think. And you are bound to find your way.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_123: Blessings be upon you on the road ahead, dear child.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_HALONE_000_130: Your faith in us can harm as well as heal, but never forget: that faith belongs to mankind, and mankind alone.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_135: That child will be fine, I am certain of it.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_149: <sigh> Unsolicited though it was, I don't regret saying those words to him. He needed to hear them.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_DERYK_000_150: But come, . This time it's your turn to extract the information.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_152: Forgive me, . I fear I've caused you trouble.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_153: I'm relieved to know that. You truly are strong, in body and spirit both.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_154: Far be it from me to ask this of you, but please do not hold it against that child.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_155: We do not wish for our existence to bring grief to our children.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_156: Yet no matter which faith, we are who we are because of those who believe in us.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_157: My hound is no exception. He was born when men came to worship the object their ancestors cast unto the heavens.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_158: We are not all-powerful. We can't grant all of mankind's wishes.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_159: Nonetheless, we always─always─hear you. No hope is too small, no prayer too faint.
TEXT_AKTKEA202_04667_MENPHINA_000_160: I just wanted to make that clear. Lest you forget, we love mankind dearly!
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_HALONE_000_000: Among us Twelve, Menphina is the most approachable to mortalkind. 'Tis one of her positive traits.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_MENPHINA_000_005: Suffice it to say we love you too, !
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_020: With this, we have completed our task and may return to the Omphalos...
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_021: Yet I can't help but think about Krile.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_022: G'raha Tia seemed to be worried about her, did he not? 'Twas as if something weighed on her mind. Though she is in the company of deities, I find myself worrying too.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_A1_000_001: Whatever it is, there's only one way to find out!
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_024: So you didn't notice anything amiss? Perhaps I simply imagined it, but I worry nonetheless.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_025: If there are no objections, let us seek out Krile.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_MENPHINA_000_026: She has headed to the Twelveswood with Nophica and Byregot, yes?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_MENPHINA_000_027: They are presently too far away for us to sense, but we should be able to locate them once in the forest.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_028: I see. In that case, let us make for Gridania.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_HALONE_000_030: As I understand it, mortals hold that Nophica and I are at odds. Like other details about us, you are free to believe what you wish.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_MENPHINA_000_035: For all his preference for solitude, Deryk certainly seems concerned for the welfare of others. How very intriguing...
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_050: So, here we are in Gridania. Can you sense Nophica and Byregot?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_HALONE_000_052: Indeed. They appear to be in different places.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_HALONE_000_053: Nophica is the nearer of the two, and is quite close by. I shall go and find her.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_054: Wait! You mustn't go off on your own!
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_055: Ugh, confound it all! After her, !
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_060: I'd thank you not to do that again...
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_MENPHINA_000_065: Both Nophica and Halone are very good to me. 'Tis our way to look out for one another.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_075: Oh? Have you already finished visiting your stones?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_081: Well now, I wasn't expecting to see you all here... Is aught the matter?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_082: You're supposed to be with Krile and Byregot. Where are they?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_083: Oh, we became separated while I was distracted, listening to the elementals.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_084: The beings are the voice of those who call the wood home. As I'm the patron of this land, they could not help but report to me.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_085: You gods can sense each other. Even should you become separated, shouldn't it be a simple matter to find them again?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_HALONE_000_086: Indeed. 'Twould seem you are keeping something from us, Nophica.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_087: Oh, Halone, there is simply no fooling you. Very well, I shall confess all.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_088: The child Krile wanted to visit our stones alone, you see. To complete her task without us watching over her.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_100_089: With her abilities, I do not believe she is in any danger. But the worrier that he is, Byregot decided to follow after her discreetly.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_MENPHINA_000_090: If this is her wish, then indeed, we must abide by it.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_091: As for Byregot... Ah, yes. I sense him in the place men call the South Shroud.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_092: One of the stones is situated there, I believe near Camp Tranquil. Let us search that area for Byregot─if we find him, we should find Krile as well.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_SYSTEM_000_100: You scour the undergrowth, but see no signs of Byregot. It must have simply been the wind.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_SYSTEM_000_109: You search the broken barrel, but find no god disguised as an adorable critter.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_111: We understand you've been following Krile. Where is she?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_BYREGOT_000_112: Having acquired information from my stone, she now makes for Althyk's.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_BYREGOT_000_113: I keep my distance to avoid being seen, and was about to continue on when you appeared.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_NOPHICA_000_114: Althyk's stone is her last destination, is it not? Let us all go and meet her there.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_BYREGOT_000_115: If everyone so wishes, then very well.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_BYREGOT_000_116: To hasten our passage, I shall call upon Master Rhalgr's servants to bear the mortals.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_120: It seems we have the use of these hawks. Let's see if we can spot Krile from above.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_121: I will bring our companions, so you needn't worry about them. Are you ready, ?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_SYSTEM_000_122: Mount the hawk and search for Krile?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_130: Go, my feathered friend. Fly like the wind.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_131: I must thank you, . Talking to you helped me to find the resolve to seek out Krile.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_132: No signs of her here... Let's continue on to Althyk's stone.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_133: There she is already. She certainly wasted no time.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_200: Well, now... Did you come all this way just to check on me?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_201: I've been on edge, worrying that I might stumble into Odin, so you gave me a bit of a fright.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_202: Nophica tells us that you wished to travel alone. What prompted you to send the gods away?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_204: I suppose... I suppose I wanted to seek the answers in my own way.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_205: As the gods told us, if we wish to know the truth, we must discover it for ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_206: In spite of this, they've seen fit to not only set us upon the right path, but accompany us besides.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_207: This bespeaks the faith that they have in man's spirit of inquiry. And it gives me heart.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_208: After all, 'tis the selfsame spirit that defines the Students of Baldesion.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_209: Like everyone, I want to uncover the truth of the Twelve. To know their aspirations and understand them.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_210: And having seen a dear friend embark on countless adventures, I've developed the desire to see and experience the world for myself.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_211: There are dangers out there, of course, but I wanted to prove that I could handle them and perform my task.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_212: ...I see. Indeed, as much as we can learn from others, there's no substitute for seeing with one's own eyes.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_213: And in yours, I see the gleam of yearning for exploration and discovery. It reveals to me the love you bear for our star...and it makes me glad.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_214: Wh-What's this all of a sudden? It's embarrassing when you say such things with a straight face...
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_KRILE_000_215: Right, then. I've yet to acquire the information here, so I'll tend to it at once. Perhaps you'd like to wait for me at Quarrymill?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_HALONE_000_217: In this land, those voices raised in praise for Nophica are especially strong.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_MENPHINA_000_218: Nophica and Byregot are also kind, are they not?
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_220: Let's wait for Krile here. Nophica and Byregot are with her, so she will be fine.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_221: <sigh> First the man at Menphina's mark, and now Krile... In the course of traveling with you and yours, it seems I inevitably end up encroaching upon others' lives.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_223: Aye, yours as well... Though nothing binds you to me, you've followed me ever since I tended your wounds. You're free to go anywhere, you know.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_224: A person's life belongs to that person alone. Others can't be expected to assume responsibility for it, and thus is it wrong to interfere.
TEXT_AKTKEA203_04668_DERYK_000_225: Alas, once I've glimpsed someone's heart, I find I can't avert my gaze. It truly is difficult to be amidst people...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_HALONE_000_000: In this land, those voices raised in praise for Nophica are especially strong.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_MENPHINA_000_005: Nophica and Byregot are also kind, are they not?
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_020: It doesn't take too long to extract the information. Krile should be here any moment now.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_021: Apologies for the wait. With that, I've obtained information from all of my stones.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_022: You've taken care of yours already, yes?
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_023: Thank you for worrying about me. While it's good to know that I can handle myself, I'm heartened to be doing this with you all.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_024: I owe you thanks as well, Byregot and Nophica, for accepting my request with good grace.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_BYREGOT_000_025: Think naught of it. You did well to see your task through, little one.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_NOPHICA_000_026: Indeed. Come, come, let us all return to the Omphalos.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_100: You took your time, . Did something happen?
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_SNOEGEIM_000_101: Ah, so you rendezvoused with Krile. How was your experience with the gods, if I may ask?
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_102: Not only did you help a disillusioned man find his way, you looked in on Krile besides...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_103: Thank you, . And you as well, Deryk.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_104: ...I fear I overstepped my bounds, but what's done is done.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_MENPHINA_000_105: We shall return to our sanctums. You have our gratitude for the delightful time!
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_NYMEIA_000_106: By holding your instruments out to the monument, you will be able to augment the missing information. Be well, dear children.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_108: Amazing! What was impossible to decipher is now crystal clear!
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_100_108: Without further ado, I shall read out the epigraph...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_109: (-Omphalos Monument-)As beings who endure by the will of the star, we are susceptible to the influence of hopes and prayers. Thus do we commit our yokes herein, lest we stray from our purpose.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_110: (-Omphalos Monument-)He who is named Byregot shall preside over construction. His duty: to fortify the works of men, and encourage them to build.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_111: (-Omphalos Monument-)He who is named Rhalgr shall preside over destruction. His duty: to galvanize the star's beating heart, and facilitate mankind's regeneration.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_112: (-Omphalos Monument-)She who is named Azeyma shall preside over the sun. Her duty: to nurture its life-giving light, and illuminate the truth for all to see.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_113: (-Omphalos Monument-)He who is named Nald'thal shall preside over the subterrane. His duty: to make gleam the riches hidden in the darkest depths─and in men themselves.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_114: (-Omphalos Monument-)She who is named Nophica shall preside over fertility. Her duty: to fill the land with life, and prepare a path of peace and plenty.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_115: (-Omphalos Monument-)He who is named Althyk shall preside over space and time. His duty: to endow the star with material vigor, that mankind's march may never cease.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_116: (-Omphalos Monument-)She who is named Halone shall preside over the glaciers. Her duty: to hold the melting ice at bay, and imbue men with constancy and tranquility.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_117: (-Omphalos Monument-)She who is named Menphina shall preside over the moon. Her duty: to perpetuate the turning of night and day, and foster love in the hearts of all.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_118: (-Omphalos Monument-)He who is named Thaliak shall preside over the rivers. His duty: to quench the thirst of men, and water their minds with wisdom.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_119: (-Omphalos Monument-)She who is named Nymeia shall preside over the stars. Her duty: to preserve the celestial fabric of the seasons, and weave the threads of men's lives.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_120: (-Omphalos Monument-)She who is named Llymlaen shall preside over the seas. Her duty: to administer the tides, and inspire men to come together as one and seek new horizons.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_121: (-Omphalos Monument-)He who is named Oschon shall preside over the mountains. His duty: to sustain the breath of the firmament, and in wandering share in men's solitude.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_122: (-Omphalos Monument-)He who is unnamed shall watch unflinching. His duty: to stand guard over his charge, always and unto the end.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_123: There the epigraph concludes. We've been given quite a lot to ponder...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_SNOEGEIM_000_140: Writings about the gods, written by the gods themselves... This is utterly unprecedented!
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_150: Hopes and prayers influencing their nature...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_151: Have you any thoughts on the contents of the epigraph, ?
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_A1_000_001: The prayers of her faithful made Halone more imposing.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_A1_000_002: The worship of Dalamud brought forth Menphina's hound.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_SNOEGEIM_000_152: You mean to say that prayers have changed the Twelve into their present forms? That is rather hard to believe...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_153: Given what we now know of dynamis, I believe it is entirely possible. In the presence of that energy, hopes and prayers have more tangible results than one might expect.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_154: Its power may be curbed upon our star, but over thousands of years of worship, it could have influenced the gods in various ways.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_155: Ways such as that which  just described, for one. Others that come to mind are Halone's shield and spear, which reflect her status as a goddess of war, and Nymeia's spinning wheel, which is an apt apparatus for a goddess of fate.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_156: Thus did they create this monument─this yoke─that they might never lose sight of their duty, no matter how much they may change.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_157: I'm inclined to agree with Raha.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_158: The gods wrote that they endure by “the will of the star.”
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_159: Who that refers to, we all know too well.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_161: By sundering reality, She must have known that She would shake the very foundation of existence. Anticipating the potential chaos, I suspect She charged Her collaborators with maintaining stability.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_162: If this is true, then might not the thirteenth unnamed being be the watcher on the moon?
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_163: The pieces certainly fall into place. I wonder if he would be willing to share what he knows...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_164: As it stands, we've yet to encounter three gods. As there's no telling what may happen once we've fought them all, I believe we should try to uncover as much of the truth as we can, the better to know how to proceed.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_KRILE_000_165: To that end, ere we seek out the watcher, Raha and I shall return to Sharlayan to compile our findings─the data from the analyzer not least of all.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_SNOEGEIM_000_166: To think that the investigation might lead us to the moon! I eagerly look forward to the next stage of our fieldwork!
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_GRAHATIA_000_167: . Like as not, yet more grueling encounters with the gods await. You should rest up and gather your strength.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_168: Not long now ere we arrive at the truth...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_169: For the longest time I've journeyed alone, not involving myself in the affairs of others.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_170: But I've enjoyed our time together. You've undertaken the investigation with all earnestness, and it has been a pleasure to be part of it.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_171: When I imagine the moment we must part ways, I can't help but be saddened. And it surprises me that I feel that way.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_172: ...Forgive me, I didn't mean to wax sentimental. If you'll excuse me, I shall head outside for some fresh air.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_SNOEGEIM_000_173: There he goes again... ─do you suppose you could follow after him?
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_SNOEGEIM_000_174: I can't quite say why, but I feel as though he'll suddenly vanish one day, never to return...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_181: Snoegeim's worried that I'll suddenly vanish, you say...
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_182: Well, as the saying goes, all things must come to an end. Whether we will it or no.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_183: When our work is finished, we must go our separate ways.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_110_183: Doing so will sadden me, as you know.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_120_183: Yet that sadness is part of the joy I have derived from our companionship.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_130_183: So I will accept it when the time comes, and strive with you to the last.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_150_183: As you know, my friend, I would rather you live your own life. But having helped you, I won't send you away against your will.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_184: ...Well, you are a busy , so I won't keep you.
TEXT_AKTKEA204_04669_DERYK_000_185: As before, rest assured I will share with you any tidings I receive from Krile. Take care, my friend, and see you again in due course.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_RUISSENAUD_000_000: Ah, , I had a feeling you would arrive soon! Urgent tidings always seem to carry you in their wake, after all, and Master Fourchenault recently sent word regarding his investigation.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_RUISSENAUD_000_001: It seems he's uncovered information regarding Professor Claudien's whereabouts and the sudden appearance of Pandæmonium in the aetherial sea. We would do well to meet with him at once.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_RUISSENAUD_000_002: If you have no objections, I ask that you proceed to the Aitiascope forthwith. I shall make the necessary arrangements and join you shortly.
