TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_RUISSENAUD_000_005: I shall send word to Master Fourchenault of our departure. Make your way to the Aitiascope, and quickly─I'm afraid time isn't our ally in this matter.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_000_02: I thank you for answering my summons with haste. Let us forgo formalities and jump straight to the heart of the matter.
Namely, the whereabouts of Professor Claudien, who has not been seen since his ill-advised journey to Azys Lla.
A subsequent expedition discovered an airship in the vicinity of the Aetherochemical Research Facility. Although the vessel clearly belonged to the professor, he was nowhere to be found.
There were signs that someone─perhaps the man himself─had forced their way into the facility, so this trail was duly followed. However...
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_100_02: The trail led nowhere, in the most literal sense. 'Twas almost as if an entire sector of the facility had been wrested from existence.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_000_02: Further investigation confirmed the expedition party's suspicions─nigh on an entire sector of Azys Lla has been teleported elsewhere.
We believe that its destination was none other than the aetherial sea. Here were its Allagan facilities reconstituted as the halls of Pandæmonium─to great success, as you can see.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_RUISSENAUD_000_027: So that means Professor Claudien is in there? In that monstrous fortress?
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_000_02: That is our leading theory. We are certain enough, at least, to risk sending you into its depths in search of the missing man.
Yet before we do, there is another pressing matter...
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_000_03: While Pandæmonium may appear firmly sealed, an unknown entity was recently spied crawling forth from its gates.
We observed its behavior with the Aitiascope, and to our horror, witnessed it gorging upon the surrounding aether like a ravenous beast.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_NEMJIJI_100_034: The aetherial sea harbors the souls of the departed─'tis the wellspring from which all creatures are born. If its flow were disturbed, life itself might cease to be!
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_000_03: Precisely. Its safety must be our first priority.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_100_03: Rid us of this menace, . Then we will be at liberty to investigate what wicked machinations are afoot.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_000_03: This memory crystal was recovered from Claudien's airship. Take it with you─it may yet provide some insight into the enigma of Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_NEMJIJI_000_038: Without Themis, there will be no army of phantom warriors. I realize you are more than capable in combat, but are you certain you'll be all right?
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_A1_000_100: Themis isn't the only one who can summon our illusory allies.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_A2_000_100: As long as I'm free to focus on my foe, there's naught to worry about.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_NEMJIJI_000_040: He...isn't? Wh-Why of course, I should have known someone of your talents would master even the ancients' arcane arts! Apologies for my failure of imagination.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_NEMJIJI_100_040: Once we are freed of the looming specter of Pandæmonium, you must promise to share your knowledge─for the sake of thorough reports, of course. In the meanwhile, I shall focus my efforts on providing you with what information and support I can!
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_NEMJIJI_000_045: That's the spirit! I would lend you my arms, such as they are, but I believe I'll be more useful in the provision of information and non-martial support!
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_FOURCHENAULT_000_05: I shall gather researchers from the Confluence to construct a means to convey you to your destination. The rest is in your hands.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_NEMJIJI_000_065: In truth, my days are stuffed to the brim, what with all the record-taking and document fetching─but worry not! The knowledge that the realm's survival hinges on my efforts sustains me.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_RUISSENAUD_000_070: At this depth, the aetherial sea itself poses little real danger, but we know not what else awaits you! I shall monitor your health from a distance, that we might leap to your aid should a crisis be at hand.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_500: (-???-)Impressive work, . Their memories of your tenacity were not embellished in the slightest.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_501: (-???-)Do not be alarmed. A proper introduction shall set your mind at ease.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_502: I am Athena, chief keyward of Pandæmonium. Wife to Lahabrea, and mother to Erichthonios. And it is I who made Pandæmonium anew in the Underworld.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_503: In a manner of speaking, I am the source of all your recent troubles.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_504: I must say, I did not imagine I would meet you in this age! A slight miscalculation, but perhaps a fortunate one. For your deeds in the past have left quite an impression on me.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_505: I understand you have reason to be wary, but I assure you there is no need.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_506: I know not what Lahabrea has told you of me, but all that I have done, I have done out of sincere scientific curiosity.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_507: That appetite yet remains, even after my rebirth. Conflict is the furthest thing from my mind, and I ask that you at least hear me out before brandishing your weapon.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_A3_000_300: So you have no intention of halting your “research”?
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_5110: In a sense, yes. 'Twas the only way I could see my research completed. The myriad souls floating in the aetherial sea provide all the raw material I require─and your Professor Claudien proved a most welcome surprise.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_511: Worry not, for I treat all my tools with care. Especially those with which I will grasp godhood.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_515: Claudien? ...Ah, you must be referring to the man who set foot in Azys Lla.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_516: He is now indispensable to my work. Worry not, for I treat all my tools with care. Especially those with which I will grasp godhood.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_520: I have not endured this long journey to let my dream of godhood go unrealized. The souls of the aetherial sea and the man you call Claudien are indispensable to my work.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_521: Worry not, for I treat all my tools with care. Especially those with which I will grasp godhood.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_525: You are as stubborn as Lahabrea, I see. Although I speak in earnest, you refuse to hear the meaning of my words. Perhaps you would be better served by a different teacher...
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_526: Luckily, you already possess the tools I require to make one for you.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_528: Memories of two souls you know quite well─Lahabrea and Erichthonios.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_529: I shall stitch them into the fabric of two errant souls, that with their help, you may come to see clearly.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_531: Surely these two have much to tell you of me, and I would have you listen. Perhaps then you shall better understand me─my desire for godhood.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_532: There is another, but their soul has proven...difficult to work with. However, with these memories, I may very well manage to weave together something presentable.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ATHENA_000_533: You have a place in my plans. I do hope that in time, you come to realize that cooperation is the best path forward.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_534: I have little understanding of where we are, yet somehow, I am unsurprised to find you here.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_535: At present I have more questions than answers─perhaps you can help me address this inequity. Is there somewhere we can speak without fear of interruption?
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_NEMJIJI_000_550: H-How unexpected! I do hope we can consider them allies...?
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_RUISSENAUD_000_555: One with an aura of overwhelming authority, and another that seems uncomfortable in his own skin. I believe I understand just well enough to be thoroughly intimidated!
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_560: Some hints, I can glean from the surroundings, but I would prefer you simply cut through this knot of questions.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ERICHTHONIOS_000_58: I don't know how long it's been, , but it's good as ever to see your face! Would that it were under more...conventional circumstances.
Just where are we? And what events have led to this unexpected reunion?
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ERICHTHONIOS_000_59: ...Ah, yes, I remember you telling us about this memory crystal.
To think that it contained our memories...
This is a lot to take in, not least of all the fact that you hail from the future. I searched for you after a time, but could find no trace. Now I know why.
Our age had its share of surprises, if my memories are to be believed. The supposedly world-ending Final Days came upon us...yet here we are, in a future where you, at least, exist.
Do we overcome the despair that befalls us? Do we find a way to live on?
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_100_599: Questions without simple answers, it seems. Let us take heart that life endured in some form─as but memories, we may never have the luxury of the larger picture.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_592: Regardless, now that it has come to pass, this future must be protected from Athena's scheming. Let this conviction guide our every action.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ERICHTHONIOS_000_59: Agreed. But as memories given fleeting form, we are bereft of any physical or magical talents. We cannot aid  in battle.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_593: Nay. Athena meant us to speak, and nothing more.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_594: But though we may be tools, we need not be slaves to her whims. We will tear ourselves from her grasp and shatter her ambitions.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_ERICHTHONIOS_000_59: I must wonder how she knew of our history with .
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_600: Likely she possessed some means by which to observe events within Pandæmonium, either while they were occurring or after the fact. Regardless, her knowledge far exceeds our own─a shortcoming we must remedy at once.
TEXT_AKTKRA301_04756_LAHABREA_000_601: We would do well to learn more of the Pandæmonium now dominating the landscape of souls. 's colleagues will doubtless prove to be of value in that respect.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_NEMJIJI_000_000: H-How unexpected! I do hope we can consider them allies...?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_RUISSENAUD_000_005: One with an aura of overwhelming authority, and another that seems uncomfortable in his own skin. I believe I understand just well enough to be thoroughly intimidated!
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_01: Are those two over there researchers from this era? We must share what we know at once, that we might piece together this vexing puzzle.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_020: Why do your companions hesitate to approach? We may be unusual visitors, but time is of the essence. Bring them here.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_NEMJIJI_000_030: Although you may be but a confluence of memory, it is an honor to meet the personages I have only read of in 's reports. As a researcher, this is beyond exciting, but I admit to no small measure of fear as well.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_RUISSENAUD_000_031: I know what you mean... I can scarcely stop my legs from shaking!
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: We're powerless to do aught but speak. I see no reason why you should be afraid.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_NEMJIJI_100_034: It isn't my life I fear for─I only fear that I might not have the chance to ask you all the questions now burning a hole in my mind! We stand before two of the ancients, who hold priceless knowledge beyond the ken of any of our peers.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_NEMJIJI_000_034: But what purpose does fear serve if not to be confronted and conquered? To that end, we shall share with you our records, and perhaps together we can find the thread which will lead us safely out of this conundrum.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_035: Information shall be our most precious resource, for that is the only weapon we can wield in these forms. Our memories are at your complete disposal.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_036: We can start with Athena, whose thirst for discovery would see all life consumed.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: Her desires haven't changed. Still she seeks to transcend her mortal existence so that she might unravel the mysteries of life. She would become a god.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_038: A nebulous concept, but Athena had her own ideas on what divinity entailed. In her mind, a god can create souls at will.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_039: Thus she chose the Underworld─or the aetherial sea, as it is known in this age─as the staging ground for her final experiments. Here lies a practically bottomless well of aether.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: Even if it means stemming the flow of life itself, she intends to continue her work. She thinks of nothing else...
We caught a glimpse of Athena as we came into this world. Her smile, her voice...they were just as I remember. Without even realizing it, I found myself feeling...an affection for her.
Don't look at me like I've gone mad! I'm not asking you to join her side─I know the true Erichthonios would never want that. But these emotions remain─in memory, if nowhere else.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_044: We shall remain here to compile what information we can. You must infiltrate Pandæmonium and seek out Athena.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_045: I would ask that you leave the memory crystal with us. It may hold secrets which have yet to be unveiled.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: All that's left is to cross that menacing threshold. Shall we take a closer look?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_047: I have one question for you.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_048: Does the word “auracite” mean aught to you?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_NEMJIJI_000_049: Auracite? Why, yes, there are a few records of its existence. It mainly makes appearances in the legends of Ivalice, and in tales concerning the Ascian Laha─
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_NEMJIJI_000_050: Ahem, well, in tales concerning an entity known as an Ascian. This personage is associated with black auracite known as the Heart of Sabik, a source of considerable power.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_051: I see...so time has not buried it.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_NEMJIJI_000_060: Lahabrea asked me about auracite and has yet to say a word since he heard the answer. Did I say something wrong? He is quite...intimidating in his silence.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_RUISSENAUD_000_065: I've read that the ancients were much larger than the people of our era... Perhaps Athena endeavored to make them less imposing.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_070: ...I must think. Leave me be while you attend to your task.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_08: From the outside, Pandæmonium looks no different than it does in the past.
However, there is no guarantee that the inside will be familiar. You would do well to secure the area near the entrance first.
Once it has been cleared of threats, Lahabrea and I can approach, and we shall begin our exploration of the interior.
The portal should convey you to Pandæmonium's gates. I hardly need to tell you to keep your weapon at the ready!
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_101: I never lost faith that we would meet again. I told you as much, did I not?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_102: I understand you may be confused. I was, too, at first.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_103: You see, I am not the true Themis. I was made by Athena, molded from one of the many souls at her disposal. I am only an illusion built from memory, no more real than Lahabrea or Erichthonios.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_104: Even so, I believe I have a grasp on the situation. This is the distant future.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_105: A future where Athena lives once more, although the means of her rebirth are yet beyond me. You are here to stop her. Have I the right of it so far?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_106: Very good. I would be disappointed if you did not rise to her challenge.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_107: ...Although I am sorry to say that I cannot aid you. My creator has tampered with my essence, and I am oddly inclined to act in her interests.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_108: I can do naught but offer you words of warning... We will fight, and it cannot be avoided.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_109: There is no need for that pained expression. Remember, I am but an illusion─nothing worth shedding tears over.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_A1_000_100: We can free you, just as we freed Agdistis!
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_A2_000_100: I would feel terrible if I had to trounce Elidibus again...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_110: I thank you for the sentiment, but I am afraid that is quite impossible. Athena's grip on my mind is unyielding...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_111: I know not what is in your mind, but I must stress once again that I cannot defy the urge to stand against you.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_112: Athena's hold over me is unyielding...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_113: Still, I would ask that you listen carefully to the advice I offer you now.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_114: Athena has prepared a new vessel to replace Erichthonios, so that she may become a god. By gathering the souls readily available in this sea of aether, she tempers her own essence.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_115: Yet the souls are faint, diffuse. She doubts whether they are sufficient for her goals, so she has turned her gaze to you. Despite your thin aether, you managed to lay Hephaistos low, and Athena would know the secret of your strength.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_116: To that end, she has prepared an experiment for her observation. Fight for your life against Athena's creation, and in doing so give her the knowledge she desires.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_118: Athena has made her move. We must find a way to reach her, or all is lost.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_11: We can do little but hope for 's success...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_130: Pandæmonium. Once a mass of lifeless stone, now imbued with a soul...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_131: Athena has grown much since her death at Lahabrea's hand. Although the souls she creates are imperfect, they act with absolute obedience.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_132: I know you shall cut your way through this monster, as you have so many others. Then you shall come before me...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_133: Do not hesitate to do what you must, for that is the only way to stop Athena.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_160: That she would give life to those pitiless stones... , you know what you must do. We will stay here and do what we can to decipher the nature of this space Athena has created.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: Well, it seems you can come and go from that dark space as you please. We still don't know if it's safe for us, but must find out quickly─there's no telling what else awaits you in there.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_200: That was a beautiful display, as always. I stand enchanted by your grace in battle.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_THEMIS_000_202: Pandæmonium's final gate has been cast wide. I shall await your arrival beyond.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_20: Apologies for not coming sooner─this space is enveloped by some fell energy, and we couldn't risk venturing through it before taking due precautions.
Were my eyes mistaken? Was that Themis?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_205: Tell us what you know. We must consider our next course of action carefully.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_26: That must have been Themis... But how?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_280: I ought to have anticipated this.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_100_280: If she bore witness to past events within Pandæmonium, Athena would have found Elidibus impossible to overlook. Few possess such a talent for magicks─to say naught of the emissary's discerning judgment.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_281: And so she found his soul upon the tides of the aetherial sea, and used his memories to craft a puppet that would serve her whims.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_28: But is what Themis said true? She imbued Pandæmonium itself with a soul?
To breathe life into that which should never live... Athena's research is fast approaching its culmination.
Fortunately, with the information shared with us by your friends, we've made some strides toward figuring out how to stop her.
A crystal called the Heart of Sabik may be the key.

The researchers related a quick but thorough history of events leading to the present. The sundering of the star, the emergence of the Ascians, and the calamities that they brought to bear upon the realm...
Tales that under other circumstances we would have considered childish fantasy, if not for a name that rang true to Lahabrea's memories.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_289: The Heart of Sabik. To you, the secret of the Ultima Weapon's might─not least the spell known as “Ultima”─and a source of enduring mystery.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_290: We are told that a general from the Garlean Empire was gifted this auracite by an “Ascian,” that the Ultima Weapon might be perfected.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_291: The identity of this shadowy benefactor, however, remains a curious unknown.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_100_291: You seem to be a veritable trove of uncommon knowledge. If there is aught you are withholding...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_292: ...Very well. At present, the Heart of Sabik itself is of greater moment.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_293: It is a creation of Athena's, made during her time with the Words of Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_294: This predates even Pandæmonium's construction. She brought before us a crystal she claimed to have chanced upon, saying it contained immense power.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_295: She dubbed it “auracite,” studying it with a fervor unusual even for her. The eventual fruit of her efforts was a stygian crystal unlike aught we had ever seen: the Heart of Sabik.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_A2_000_200: How did she find this auracite?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_A3_000_200: Did Athena encounter Ultima, the High Seraph, perchance?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_300: We theorized that it came from beyond our star. Beyond that, naught was ever known.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_305: Athena was never forthcoming as to how she found the crystal. We came to believe that it originated outside our star, but could deduce little else.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_310: An unexpectedly specific question. I gather that the Heart of Sabik is not the only auracite in this era? Regardless, I know naught of this High Seraph. Athena was never forthcoming as to how she found the crystal, though we came to suspect that it was not of our star.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_315: Much later, we discovered that auracite magnifies the desires of those who come into contact with it. This would do much to explain Athena's actions following her recovery of the crystal.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_100_315: Alas, this realization came too late. By the time I moved to seal the auracite and its insidious influence away, Athena's plot had already been laid.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_ERICHTHONIOS_000_31: ...So what became of the Heart of Sabik?
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_317: I took it from Athena's laboratory after I ended her life.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_318: The density of the aether within was unlike anything I had observed. I knew its capacity for destruction, but further analysis proved impossible. I elected to safeguard it myself.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_319: It is possible that Athena herself obscured the crystal's contents. Even were her memories stored within, I would have remained in ignorance.
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_320: If she included some mechanism by which to give these memories form, as she did with our own...
TEXT_AKTKRA302_04757_LAHABREA_000_322: Ironic, that I should have protected those very memories in the name of safeguarding the star. Fate is loath to see mistakes go unpunished.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_000_00: The monster unleashed Ultima? I can only guess that it was Athena's hand that placed such magic within the Heart of Sabik...if so, it's only natural she would gift her own creations with such terrible power.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_010: ...I have told you all I know of Athena and the many secrets she kept hidden from the world.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_011: If she indeed stored her memories within the Heart of Sabik, we must ask ourselves how they were awakened in this age. When was the crystal last sighted?
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_A1_000_000: During my fight with the Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_A2_000_000: In the hands of the Ascians, presumably.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_014: In which you triumphed, but failed to recover the Heart. Yet according to your colleagues, there was another on the battlefield that day. An Ascian...
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_020: Based on the information your colleagues provided, I presume the same. If an Ascian was present during your defeat of the Ultima Weapon, it stands to reason that he recovered the Heart.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_025: And this selfsame Ascian was later struck down at a location known as the “Aetherochemical Research Facility.”
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_100_02: I've heard that name...and recently! The site of Professor Claudien's disappearance.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_101_025: Indeed. He was tracing an aetherial signature resembling that of the memory crystal in his possession─a signature that may well have belonged to the Heart of Sabik. In which case, it is no coincidence that Athena's awakening followed.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_000_02: But what reason would he have to bring her back to life? Was his mind not his own?
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_100_027: Although Athena's essence is that of memory, her magicks have not suffered for lack of a physical body. As the world is now, it should not be possible, but she must have found a suitable vessel.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_101_027: If Elidibus is to be believed, she readies this vessel for godhood─and is perilously close to success.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_102_027: It beggars belief. As you well know, you were the lynchpin of her ambition.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_028: Yours was the only form that could contain the immense power Athena required, and it has long since turned to dust.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: As pleasant as this discussion is, we require more information if we're to unravel this mystery.
You know who awaits you, : Themis. I fear you won't find him so cooperative as we're accustomed to.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_100_032: We know not how vast the space beyond these gates may be, but somewhere within lurks Athena, with Elidibus leashed at her side.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_000_03: ...This may be a simplistic theory, but hear me out. If Themis arose from his memories intact, he will be eager to see reason. We need only break the magicks that bind him to regain our old ally.
When I had fallen under Hephaistos's influence, you didn't stop trying until I was freed. I would ask that you do the same for Themis.
Though none of us are real in the conventional sense, I feel it must be done. Themis would never have wished to be your enemy.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_036: While Erichthonios's perspective is a sentimental one, Elidibus may possess privileged knowledge. To question him unimpeded by magicks would be ideal.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_037: Agdistis broke free of her bonds in her final moments, suggesting that Athena's hold weakens under the weight of combat. You might use the same principle to unshackle Elidibus's mind.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_038: But remember that our very nature is fragile. Even if he inhabits a vessel with which to meet you in battle, I am certain it is not meant to endure.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_039: If left weakened for too long, his aether may dissipate back into the aetherial sea. You had best act quickly.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_000_05: We know not for how long we'll have free rein to go between here and the Aitiascope. We'll remain here for now unless absolutely necessary.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_055: The crystal? I have returned it to the safekeeping of your colleagues. I could find nothing new amongst the memories stored within.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_056: This space, on the other hand, is fascinating. Wrought by the same power the keywards wielded, perhaps.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_400: The fog...has lifted. I knew that Athena's magicks magnified the desires of their victim at the expense of aught else, but I never guessed what desire of mine she could exploit...
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_401: Since the moment we met, I have made plain my interest in you─my desire to understand your nature. I suppose that curiosity extended to how each of us would fare in a match of strength.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_403: Free... Then I am no longer needed.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_404: Do not look so crestfallen, my friend. These few moments of clarity are more than I could have asked for.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_A3_000_100: You must render judgment of Athena's actions.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_406: You've grasped the fraying strands of my being and tied them together with your own...
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_407: Nevertheless, I fear that I am here on borrowed time.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_408: I only hope that I can see you through the last of our battles. Until then, I will cherish every moment.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_410: As such, it falls upon me to judge Athena, who would disrupt our carefully maintained balance to fulfill her own desires. I swear I shall not waver in this duty.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_411: Let us return to Erichthonios and Lahabrea. There is much I would share with you before we embark upon our final ascent.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_420: As I surmised, Elidibus was constructed with the strength to see your battle done. Yet I fear his aether may not sustain him through another...
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_425: The four of us are together once again. Although I may not have directly experienced our adventures, my memories make our bonds as real as any other.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_000_45: Themis, it's good to see you. I knew  would guide you to our side once again.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_451: I am grateful  had the patience to tolerate my lapse in manners. Athena's hold upon me is broken, and I pledge every moment of my remaining time to seeing that she answer for her deeds.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_452: Very good. To that end, I would have you share what you know of her plan.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_453: Of course. As I mentioned, Athena possesses a vessel that may serve in the creation of a god.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_100_453: It is someone  knows well─a man by the name of Claudien. By a twist of fate, his body proved to be ideal for Athena's purpose.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_455: The creation of a person requires not just body, soul, or memory, but rather all three.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_100_455: We are made from the memories of our ancient counterparts, etched upon drifting souls and given form through the infusion of aether. We lack a physical body, yet you can see and feel us all the same.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_101_455: Athena is different. She has carved her memories into Claudien's soul while it was still within its body, and thus made both her own.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_102_455: But even she is prone to error. After the sundering, beings became more fragile in both body and soul, and this difference prevents Athena from realizing the full extent of her desires.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_103_45: So that's why she has turned her sights toward ...  uncommon strength rivals even the mightiest of our age.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_104_455: By scrutinizing  feats in battle, Athena aims to deduce the secret of 's prowess and use it to fortify her own vessel. Only then will the culmination of her research be at hand.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_A2_000_200: Can't we simply remove Athena's memories from Claudien's body?
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_A3_000_200: Then to fight Athena, we must fight Claudien as well...
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_460: An arduous task, but not impossible.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_465: We need not hasten to the man's destruction.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_LAHABREA_000_470: Athena can inscribe herself upon another's soul, but she cannot erase its will. If we awaken Claudien's spirit to the reality of his bondage, he might be compelled to wrest his body from Athena's clutches.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_ERICHTHONIOS_000_47: We still don't know why she chose Claudien... What makes him more suited than anyone else?
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_474: Although I have never spoken to Claudien, I did witness an incident that may prove revelatory.
TEXT_AKTKRA303_04758_THEMIS_000_475: When instructing the vessel to do her bidding, she called it by a familiar name─Erichthonios.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_00: Why would Athena use my name? More questions, and few answers to go around.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_005: Our course of action is clear: we must lay Athena low and rescue Claudien. A difficult task, to be sure, but one which the present company is more than capable of achieving.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_020: Themis, you may have just handed us the key to rescuing Claudien.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_022: First and foremost, we must confront Athena. She must be made vulnerable, as Elidibus was.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_100_022: Yet our opponent stands on the verge of godhood. As we are now, she would unmake us in an instant.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_023: , we have no choice but to place the burden of our fate─and the fate of many more besides─squarely upon your shoulders. I trust you have no objections.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_A1_000_000: God or no, I shall cast her down.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_A2_000_000: It's a burden I'm used to carrying.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_025: If you have faith in your victory, then so do I.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_030: I imagine so. Ever have we relied upon your skill at arms.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_035: Though we know not what form Athena will take, I have faith that your skill will see us through this trial, as it has many times before.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: And we all appreciate 's willingness to fling  at the unknown. However, we have yet to hear how this will liberate Claudien...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_041: ...I have a plan. Do not trouble yourself over the details.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_042: The same goes for you, . You must focus the entirety of your attention on Athena. She will not be easily bested, even by one of your prowess.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_043: Then let us trust in Lahabrea, and prepare for the battle to come.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_04: Before we face Athena, I must know...
If she had never discovered the auracite─had never fallen under its influence─would she have lived a normal life? Would she have been a mother to me?
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_046: I have asked myself the same questions. Questions with no answer, I fear.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_047: But let us put them out of our mind. There is something we must discuss, and I would do so not as Lahabrea, but as a father to his son.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_05: For now we place our trust in you. The rest must wait until we have Athena before us.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_055: Right now, Athena must be the sole focus of your attention. She shall not hesitate to exploit any weakness she can sense.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_060: Athena maintains absolute control over this space. Beyond the gate, she has doubtless built herself an abode worthy of a god, and now awaits the arrival of her supplicants...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_400: Countless years I waited within that stifling crystal. And now, when my dream is finally within reach, you stand in my way.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_40: Your “dream” is naught but selfish ambition. Its fulfillment would benefit only you.
And why, Athena? At the end of this road to godhood, what did you hope to find?
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_403: It matters not. The fact remains that she worked against the interests of the star.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_40: Even so, I would hear her answer. I would know why my mother cast us aside.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_405: How unlike you, Erichthonios. You were never so inquisitive before.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_406: Having struck upon a hypothesis, there is but one thing the wise woman desires.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_407: My theory was that any true god would see us as we are─imperfect. She would hammer out our flaws, and build something...greater.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_408: To prove this could not but benefit the star! I would give it the perfect stewards, that it might shine brighter than any other.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_40: And you would destroy the lives already upon it!
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_410: In that, I am no different from our peers. Over the course of eons, how many creations have we wrought? Such creatures cannot but usher their inferior predecessors into oblivion.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_411: Even without our meddling, nature would take the selfsame course.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_412: If the destination is the same, is it somehow worse to arrive there by the guidance of a god? I think not.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_413: The auracite made such thoughts irresistible, perhaps. But it cannot have created them from whole cloth. This is Athena's truth.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_414: What right have you to pass judgment? You were but a vessel for my masterwork─your purpose ends there. My only mistake was leaving you possessed of a soul.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_416: Poor Erichthonios. Always the last to arrive at the obvious conclusion...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_100_416: I gave birth to you for a single reason: that you might serve as my tool. And like any tool, I crafted you to suit my needs, that you might accept my essence when the time came.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_417: Of course, I also made you more amenable to my demands, and ensured that you would feel a cloying affection for your dear mother. However, it seems that my tinkering was insufficient...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_41: My very feelings were of your design?
You created a boy unable to grasp even the simplest magic. Ever hopelessly clinging to his mother's robes, unable to do otherwise. I was doomed from the start...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_420: Yet here you are, standing in defiance of her design. You are more than what she made you!
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_42: I still feel the sting of it. But with pain comes clarity...
You ill deserve to wear the mantle of a god!
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_423: As stubborn as you are witless. If this star will not be mine, then it serves no purpose!
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_424: She aims to obliterate the aetherial sea and stem the flow of life!
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_42: Before the battle, Lahabrea told me I was the key to finishing this.
Although I am but an illusion, my soul has crossed eons to find its home in another. One whose body Athena has seen fit to purloin as her own.
Much of what I once was now resides in him. Should my memories seize this chance to follow suit, they may resound enough to wake his mind.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_429: But Athena inhabits him still! What will become of you!?
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_43: I don't know, but if I can rouse his soul, perhaps it will disrupt Athena's hold. It's the best chance we have.
My whole life others have looked down upon me, but I've never given up searching for my purpose. Now I've found it.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_432: This decision is yours to make, and yours alone.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_433: Do as you will, my son. I know you shall make me proud.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_43: Your words hold sway over me no longer. My life is my own...
And I have found my true family!
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_438: What is happening? Athena's magicks should be impotent with no body to fuel them...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_439: Precisely. Athena was the sole force holding the space around Pandæmonium together, and now it crumbles...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_LAHABREA_000_440: Although little would change if we were buried here, we cannot let this be 's final resting place.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_441: Of all my miscalculations...to think that you would be my undoing. That you would even be capable of defying me...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_442: Ah, is there more you would say to me?
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_443: Or have you decided to return to your dear mother's bosom? Have you brought Claudien back to me?
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_44: Apologies, but I am only the dregs of your own memory. I can do naught but watch as the evil you've wrought collapses, burying you under its weight.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ATHENA_000_445: How disappointing... Truly, useless to the last.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_ERICHTHONIOS_000_44: And who made me that way?
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_NEMJIJI_000_505: At least on the surface, Professor Claudien appears unharmed. We must wait for him to regain consciousness to judge anything beyond that, I fear...
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_RUISSENAUD_000_510: Questions, questions, and more questions! Why did Claudien set out by himself? What did he see? Oh, I do hope he wakes up soon!
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_550: Although Erichthonios was naught but a collection of memories, I know his absence pains you.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_551: But he acted with resolve, full aware of the potential consequences. Let us look back on this moment not with sorrow, but with pride.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_552: You both are the heroes of the day. Athena's ambitions would have swallowed the world had you not stemmed their advance.
TEXT_AKTKRA304_04759_THEMIS_000_553: We shall stay here, both to look over Professor Claudien and ensure that there are no further disturbances in the aetherial sea. You should rest─and I will not take no for an answer.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_NEMJIJI_000_000: At least on the surface, Professor Claudien appears unharmed. We must wait for him to regain consciousness to judge anything beyond that, I fear...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_RUISSENAUD_000_005: Questions, questions, and more questions! Why did Claudien set out by himself? What did he see? Oh, I do hope he wakes up soon!
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_010: We shall stay here and wait for Claudien to regain his senses. Pray rest while you can.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_020: It seems we can do naught but wait.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_400: Perhaps we might discuss a matter which has been troubling me.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_401: While your colleague Nemjiji was enlightening us on the historical events which led to this era, she let slip the name of one of the Ascians...Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_402: Although she knew of the figure only from her research, she was most insistent that there is no evidence connecting the Ascian to myself.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_403: Yet I am aware that this Lahabrea used the Heart of Sabik to sow chaos throughout your world, and I would be a fool to deny such strong connections between us.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_404: You are the only one present who has met the Ascian in question, so I would ask you directly. Are he and I one and the same? Is my fate to work in the shadows and bring about untold destruction?
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_405: ...I see. If you say it is so, then there is no reason to disbelieve it.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_410: A diplomatic answer. I understand the Ascians often use the bodies of others to enact their plots, so it is impossible to say who they truly are...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_415: Perhaps silence is the most prudent response. I understand the Ascians often use the bodies of others to enact their plots, so it is impossible to say who they truly are...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_420: These Ascians─or “Paragons,” I'm told─were ruthless in their schemes to rejoin the sundered worlds. I have heard but a small number of their deeds, and still I find it difficult to comprehend the depths to which they were willing to sink.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_421: To choose a path of evil, all for the sake of the star...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_422: ...I admit, 'tis a decision I would make under the right circumstances. Although the ages may take their toll, my devotion to my duty will never waver.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_423: Paying no heed to what might be lost, I will treat the Heart of Sabik as a mere tool for my own ends.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_424: Never caring to look beyond the surface, I will unleash forces that I fail to truly comprehend...and remain blissfully ignorant of my hypocrisy all the while.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_425: Ah, it appears Claudien has awakened.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_426: ... I have some faint memories of what transpired. You stood against Athena and won.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_427: Lahabrea. Erichthonios's memories of you dwell within me still.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_428: Through unyielding discipline you hoped to forge a son equal to yourself, but the crucible you placed him in left scars which were loath to heal.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_429: Yet you were never motivated by selfishness. All you did was in service of your duty. At the least, I...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_430: ...I will hear no more. Though you may possess Erichthonios's memories, you are not him. In rebirth you have become someone else entirely, and you belong to this age.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_431: As such, I am your enemy. And an enemy does not deserve sympathy.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_432: Of course, I would never condone the actions of the Ascian. But you are not him─you are Lahabrea, of the Convocation.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_433: You spared no effort in saving us from Athena's machinations. For that you deserve the utmost praise─and my personal thanks.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_434: ...If you insist on deceiving yourself, then so be it. My stance remains unchanged.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_435: The most difficult of your trials is behind you─but you may find that Pandæmonium has yet to relinquish the last of its secrets.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_436: Among them is the identity of Hephaistos's liberator, who set the very first wheels in motion. There is but one place to find these answers: the past.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_437: However, I must insist that you keep silent about Athena's fate. While I doubt it would change the decisions I make, you should not tender us information we could not uncover ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_438: Now that I have said my piece, I shall follow in my son's footsteps.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_439: These odious memories will fade to nothing, as was always their fate.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_441: My time, too, draws near, but I believe I can stay long enough to see this matter through.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_442: You shall journey to the past to seek out the truth of Lahabrea's words, yes? While Themis himself may have been there to see this encounter, I have the unique opportunity to hear your perspective on the matter. That is, of course, if you will share it with me.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_443: I look forward to it. I shall take in the aetherial sea one final time as I await your return.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_200: I, too, shall stay here and await your return. I could use the rest, and there is a matter I would discuss with you and Themis before we say our farewells.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_NEMJIJI_000_205: Ruissenaud and I shall return to Aporia and make our report to Master Fourchenault at once. Oh, where to begin?
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_RUISSENAUD_000_210: I believe we've yet to see the full effect these events will have on the aetherial sea. Once Professor Claudien recovers, we must conduct a thorough investigation!
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_215: Now all that is left is to return to Pandæmonium and ask Lahabrea to shed light upon its few remaining mysteries. I look forward to your return.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_220: Ah, you must be . I am Hegemone, keyward of Abyssos─but I suspect you may already know that. We did meet once before, after all, although I was not entirely myself at the time.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_221: Thanks to you, however, I can rightly say my faculties are mine once more. At present, I am taking stock of the damage done to the facility.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_22: ! I didn't expect to see you again so soon, but 'tis always a joy. You seem...quite happy to be here.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_230: Thank you for checking up on us. Did you speak with Hegemone and the other warders on your way here? The work is long, but we have made great strides in undoing Athena's meddling.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_250: . Truth be told, I thought you would have little reason to ever visit this place again. It seems I was wrong.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_A2_000_200: I just wanted to say hello.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_255: How neatly you obfuscate your motivations. Do as you will, then.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_265: has gone through the trouble to visit us, so I hardly think curtness is in order. We braved Pandæmonium together─why not at least share with  our progress?
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_266: I have relinquished control of Pandæmonium to Lahabrea. I was never meant to hold it for long, and now such authority resides in rightful hands.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_267: With Lahabrea's help, we have pored through Athena's research into the hemitheoi. Thus were we able to restore Hegemone's mind and body.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_26: Yet there is still much work to be done. Damage to repair, keywards to replace...the tasks are too many to count.
But although the path may be long, our progress is steady. I believe we can safely say that Pandæmonium will soon function as it did before.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_270: Indeed. Before we reach that point, however, there are some matters which must be put to rest.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_271: One concerns Pandæmonium itself, and another is a personal matter. Until they are settled, I cannot move forward.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_272: It shall not take long. Lack of resolve caused me to delay, but I have chosen my course.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_27: These concerns must be weighty indeed. Do you intend to share your burdens with us?
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_274: If you would bear witness, then come.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_275: Your arrival at this very moment almost beggars belief, but I shall not ask you to leave. I simply ask that you do not interfere─no matter what may happen.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_450: Stay here. This will be over soon.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_451: Why did you call me here, Master Lahabrea? There is still much to be done if the warders are to be freed...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_452: You have served within Pandæmonium since Athena's time, have you not? That makes you the most senior keyward, now that Agdistis is gone.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_453: As such, you deserve to know a secret few others are privileged to hear. One concerning myself.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_454: Separating Hephaistos from myself required removing part of my soul.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_455: A necessary sacrifice, but one which came at no small cost to my natural talents. I am but a shadow of the man I was at the time of my appointment as Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_456: I could never hope to wield the same magicks that Hephaistos used to bind the warders' minds, let alone break their shackles.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_457: That tone of defeat does not befit your voice, Master Lahabrea. Do not give in to despair.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_458: There is no despair─only truth. I do not confide in you to garner cheap sympathy.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_459: Hephaistos left behind fascinating research. His conclusion was that in order to transform a vessel into a hemitheos, absolute control over their mind was essential.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_460: As you well know, the magicks used to achieve such dominion exploited strong emotions within their victims' hearts. In the case of Hesperos and Agdistis, their respect for me.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_461: Upon slipping his bonds, Hephaistos took steps to throw Pandæmonium into chaos. With their attention divided, keyward and warder alike were easy targets.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_462: But there was an act that came before. Regardless of Hephaistos's prowess, he could not have won freedom on his own.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_463: For long days and nights I pondered who might have released him. I could only conclude that Athena's plans were set in motion long, long ago, when she claimed the mind of one of her admirers...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_464: Hegemone. None would question your pride in your position. Your devotion to Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_465: But you do not believe I am the one fit to lead it, do you? Your loyalty lies not with my vision for Pandæmonium, but Athena's.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_466: Master Lahabrea, whatever has spurred this sudden accusation, I assure you there is a proper explanation...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_469: As I have already stated, even should I detect Athena's tinkering, I am currently powerless to dispel it.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_470: And so I have come to a decision. One which was made with the best interests of our star in mind. In order to build a better future, I require the strength I have lost.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_471: I must embrace these odious memories!
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_472: Mark well this sight─engrave it upon your very soul.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_473: You now bear witness to the true Lahabrea!
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_474: I cannot imagine this was an easy choice...but it is done.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_476: Yes...and she shall remember this lesson well.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_477: Athena's puppet no longer, I see...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_478: She may yet harbor ill will toward me, but that is a risk I am willing to take.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_479: Our star requires a steady hand to guide it, and now mine is equal to the task. I can no longer allow Pandæmonium to divert my focus.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_480: Hegemone, I would ask that you serve me anew. There is none other more suited to overseeing this prison─none other who will take such pride in their duty.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_481: My loyalty to Athena led me to betray you once before. Why would you allow me to keep the position of keyward?
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_482: I require your talents─as I require Hephaistos's. The past is of no consequence.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_483: Very well. In honor of our fallen colleagues, I shall restore this institution to its former glory.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_48: Lahabrea is himself once more. He wields his authority without hesitation, and thinks not twice once his judgment has sounded.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_485: Yet he is different from Athena. He thinks only of the betterment of the star. So long as duty guides his actions, he shall not share her fate.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_486: And should his convictions ever waver, the emissary will set him back on the proper course.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_48: Good. If this is the path he chooses to walk, then I will walk with him.
I'll allow our bond to fray no further. As his son, I will support him in the days ahead.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_489: I would not ask you to say the same, . You and I stand on peaks separated by vast chasms. Our perspectives shall never align.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_490: And never shall one give way to the other, for such is our nature. With that in mind...let us consider any debts between us to be void.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_491: Before you leave here, mark well these words...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_492: My resolve shall weather loss unfathomable, and yield before no obstacle. Walk your path with the same conviction.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_HEGEMONE_000_300: Master Lahabrea saw through me long ago... But now my mind is unclouded by doubt, and I shall not fail him again.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_30: From this day forward, I will do what I can to aid my father. In this way I shall forge my own future.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_310: Hephaistos and Lahabrea were one and the same when he was named as one of the Convocation. This change poses no need for concern, for all is as it should be.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_315: If not for you, my long-slumbering demons may have gone unslain. I would have never been forced to reconsider my true nature. Yet as I said, do not consider this an admission of debt.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_LAHABREA_000_316: Now, I believe you have other places to be. Remain here any longer and I may be inclined to place you in a cell next to one of our more...recalcitrant subjects.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_RUISSENAUD_000_325: My own research and studies have fallen by the wayside in Professor Claudien's absence. My thesis remains unwritten, and its deadline looms on the horizon...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_330: Ah, you are returned. I should like to hear of what you discovered, though I believe your friend has business with us first...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_350: There you are, . While you were away, Themis brought me up to speed on all that happened while I was held prisoner.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_351: His story shone light upon any number of questions that were niggling at my conscious. Namely, those concerning the aetherial signature emanating from Azys Lla.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_352: Doubtless its source was Athena, reaching out as far as she could from her prison. Ever grasping for someone to take Erichthonios's place...grasping for the body his soul resided in.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_353: I wanted to ask─when you first found the crystal, were you unable to hear the memories stored within?
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_354: Indeed. It was only after our research was well underway that I could hearken to its whispers.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_355: Contact with the crystal should have awakened the memories, but the passage of time likely changed Erichthonios's soul in subtle ways. Perhaps aetherial resonance was a gradual process in this case.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_356: However, being attuned to Erichthonios exposed you to Athena's voice, as well. Doubtless the choice to venture forth into Azys Lla was not your own─it was Athena's influence working through you.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_357: I do recall being strangely fixated on acting alone─I never would have encouraged such recklessness usually. Although the choice was not entirely my own, I am still ashamed of my actions.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_358: Reflection is how we plant the seeds of growth. Although we must not blame ourselves for events out of our control...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_THEMIS_000_359: That the voice in the crystal belonged to the person from which your soul originated... Well, not even the most brilliant researcher could come to that conclusion.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_360: Your reassurance means more than you know. Thank you.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_100_360: Now, one final matter. It concerns the very crystal whose discovery set this adventure in motion.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_361: Perhaps sparked by recent events, a new light began to shine from within its depths. From my experience, this may indicate that a new memory has floated to the surface, eager to be observed.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_362: For some time, the question of why Lahabrea and Erichthonios would leave such a crystal behind in the first place has lingered in the back of my mind.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_363: With Erichthonios's memories and such magical talents as are at my disposal, I believe I can make this final memory manifest for us all to behold. Shall we witness it together?
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_50: I leave this memory for you, the future of our star.
The Final Days have come, and the creation magicks we have so relied upon now hasten our downfall.
But despair has not yet won out. Lahabrea and the others of the Convocation are working to stem the chaos which threatens to engulf our star.
Their plan requires great sacrifice. Elidibus─Themis─has already offered to give his life for our salvation.
Yet there is another problem which must be dealt with: Pandæmonium, wherein are confined our most vicious creations.

Even should we survive the Final Days, it will take time to restore order. If Pandæmonium's cells were breached and their prisoners set upon the star, our hard-won peace would be obliterated in an instant.
Someone must stay behind to ensure that never happens. With Themis and Lahabrea otherwise indisposed, that responsibility falls to me.
And that is why I must defy the directive of the Convocation. My soul will not be offered to manifest the will of the star, but instead consigned to eternal vigil.
I know that in doing so, the Final Days may take me. I may not live to see my duty upheld.

That's why I have resolved to set this crystal adrift in the tides of the Underworld. It contains memories of Pandæmonium from both my father and I, and shall bear this warning to the future even if I cannot.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_ERICHTHONIOS_000_51: I've imbued the crystal with magicks that will attract it to my essence. Even should I journey through the Underworld and be born anew, this message will reach me. Pandæmonium shall not be left unattended.
If all else fails, then perhaps another  like my dear friend will come along. One with an almost unnatural ability to pick up the scent of trouble.
I wonder where  is now. How many souls has  saved, and how many beasts has  slain since last we met?
Alongside my warning, this memory shall carry a wish. ...may we meet again.
Now listen well: If anyone receives this message, you must come to Pandæmonium. Please make haste. I repeat...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_515: Well, that dispels the last of my doubts. Thank you for humoring me. And now we come to this...
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_100_517: The tie that bound Athena's memories to my body, no doubt. When I regained my senses, I found it on my person.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_518: Now it appears your efforts have left it bereft of memories. No trace remains of Athena.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_519: However, its power as auracite yet remains, and it may prove to be a valuable trove of knowledge in the hands of the right researcher. I feel that fate has left it with me for a reason.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_520: I shall take my leave, but on behalf of my colleagues─nay, the entire star─I thank you both for putting an end to Athena's wickedness.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_530: Pay the rest of us no mind─you deserve time to say your farewells.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_550: ...Welcome back, . I hope you said farewell to Themis for me.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_551: Recent events have given me not only a new focus for my research, but also insight into my own origins. Truly, 'tis a gift I could never hope to repay.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_552: As Lahabrea said, I am not Erichthonios. Yet I bear a part of him inside me, and I shall do what I can to follow the traces he has left behind in the present day.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_553: A spark has been struck in my mind─I am ready to pursue my research with a fervor the likes of which I have not had since my youth.
TEXT_AKTKRA305_04760_CLAUDIEN_000_554: Doubtless I shall have need of you in the days and moons ahead. When that time comes, I only hope that you will once again lend me your sound counsel. Until then, may you fare well!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_000: Oh, . 'Tis good of you to come, but I'm afraid there is still no word from Krile and G'raha Tia.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_001: They're working as fast as they can to compile the findings of our investigation, I shouldn't doubt.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_002: But between the phantom realm's aetheric data and the monument's epigraph, they have much and more to review.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_003: Now, while awaiting developments, I had a mind to pay Snoegeim a visit in the Omphalos.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_004: If you aren't otherwise occupied, you should come too.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_010: Snoegeim has become something of a fixture here. So focused is she on her work, she often neglects taking sustenance. I pray her health doesn't suffer...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_020: Oh, if it isn't  and Deryk!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_021: But no Krile or Raha, I see...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_022: Unfortunately. Speaking of whom, would you not prefer to be with them in Sharlayan? You're a researcher too, after all.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_023: I find myself much more effective in the field. Being here gives me inspiration, you see, and of late I've been mulling over the opening words of the epigraph.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_024: “As beings who endure by the will of the star, we are susceptible to the influence of hopes and prayers. Thus do we commit our yokes herein, lest we stray from our purpose.”
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_025: The suggestion that faith has shaped the nature of the Twelve paints a truly intriguing picture!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_026: If truth be told, I was also hoping that I might speak with the gods again...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_027: But they haven't graced us since the time we solved the mystery of the monument. They only do so on exceptional occasions, it seems.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_028: Be that as it may, I believe there might be another way to see them.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_029: When we journeyed with the gods, Azeyma told me that each of them wished to speak with you in private. You, !
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_030: If you were to call them before their heavens, I have a feeling they will answer!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_031: So...won't you give it a try? And afterwards, let us know what they said?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_032: I for one see no harm in it.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_033: But if you are disinclined, then do not feel pressured. It is entirely your decision.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SYSTEM_000_034: You now have the opportunity to speak with those of the Twelve whom you have encountered thus far. To do so, call to them before the entrances to their respective heavens.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SYSTEM_000_035: You may advance the quest at any time by speaking with Deryk in the Omphalos.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_050: Spoken to your satisfaction, have you? Then let us await Krile and G'raha Tia together.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_051: Hmmm... Still no sign of them...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_052: Ah, there is something I've been meaning to ask you.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_053: As an adventurer, you are better traveled than most. Of the places you have seen, what kind do you like best?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_A1_000_003: Faraway lands where new encounters await.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_A1_000_004: Quiet places where I can enjoy solitude.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_054: Ah yes, I can see the appeal in that. Though I travel alone, I quite enjoy listening to the sounds of life in the cities and towns I visit.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_055: So you too enjoy being amidst nature... It gladdens me to know that we have that in common.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_056: Ah yes, I can imagine you being given to such. The thrill of visiting unknown places is something I can understand.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_057: Is that so... Well do I understand it─the desire to have a place all your own, where you might be with your own thoughts.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_100_057: I myself am partial to wandering Eorzea. So rich in aether, this land, and possessed of so many aspects...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_058: 'Twas when I was traveling through the Twelveswood that I encountered this fellow. I knew not how he came to be injured and alone, but I couldn't turn a blind eye.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_059: He has long since recovered, and I probably should have returned him to his forest home.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_060: But when I see him here, undaunted in the presence of gods, I can't help but feel 'twas fate that delivered him to me.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_061: Still, the day will come when we must go our separate ways...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_063: Welcome back. How fared your work?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_064: It took longer than we anticipated, but we managed to compile our findings, and thence deliberated a course of action.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_065: Indeed. Hereon, we would do well to tread with caution.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_066: The waveforms we recorded with the aetheric analyzer revealed an unsettling occurrence.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_067: In the course of fighting us, the gods expended a tremendous amount of their aether. So much so as to dilute their very essence.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_068: Lest you worry, you've done no wrong, . The gods themselves wished to fight, after all.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_069: That being said, we should avoid engaging in further battle until we learn more about their true objective.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_070: To that end, we will seek out the thirteenth unnamed being, whose duty is to watch unflinching.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_071: If Raha is correct, and we have no reason to believe otherwise, said being is the watcher on the moon.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_072: You'll be pleased to know I've already acquired permission to use the Tower of Babil from the Ilsabard contingent, who presently oversee the structure.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_073: You'll be pleased to know I've already acquired permission to use the Tower of Babil from the Ilsabard contingent, who oversee the structure with the Garlean people's leave.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_074: We...we're really going, then? To the moon? Huzzah!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_075: Hehe, I wonder what the watcher is like! If there are no other matters, then let us set forth at once!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_076: If you still wish to speak with the gods, best to seek them out now. They may not be there later.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: Greetings, Hydaelyn's champion. You are ever welcome here, as are your companions.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_102: 'Tis a pleasure to meet you, watcher. We come hoping that you would answer some questions for us─questions about Hydaelyn.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_103: We have deciphered the monument at the heart of the phantom realm. In addition to the names and duties of the Twelve, it speaks of one who is unnamed, who shall watch unflinching.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_104: Are we correct in assuming that that individual is you?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_105: The Twelve have existed for eras. If you know aught about them, will you not share your knowledge with us?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_106: They have a desire which they claim can only be fulfilled through battle with mankind. We wish to understand what that is.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: So man has managed to come this far...
Very well. You have earned the right to know.
Remember, however, that I am but a creation. Though I have been imbued with some memories of the past, they are far from complete.
First of all, I am indeed the unnamed being the monument describes.
An entity created by Hydaelyn to serve a purpose, alongside the Twelve.
Together, they were charged with preserving equilibrium on a sundered and unstable star.
Like myself, they were given shape from people who once existed.
And like myself, they believed that the world should be entrusted to the new life that had emerged.
While I do not possess detailed memories of that time, Venat selected those she deemed best suited to their respective duties.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_117: That would explain why the Twelve appear to have personalities like mortals...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: The men and women they once were influenced their personalities, yes, but so too did the faith of mortals.
Knowingly or no, when men pray, they will the object of their worship to assume a form that can better grant them their heart's desire.
In this manner have the Twelve been shaped over eons into images that fit men's ideals.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_121: So you were right, Raha. Hopes and prayers have the power to influence the gods.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: Yet even as they thus changed, at Venat's behest, they would have refrained from intervening in mortal affairs.
As a result, there will have been times when they acted in ways that are contrary to your expectations.
But now that Hydaelyn is no more and the Final Days averted, the Twelve have arrived at a decision regarding their fate all their own.
'Tis not for me to reveal the truth of their desire. I can, however, guarantee that it will not visit harm upon mankind. Nay, far from it.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_126: Well, I for one never felt that the gods meant us ill. To have your guarantee as well, we couldn't possibly doubt them anymore!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_127: It is most assuring to confirm the connection between you and the Twelve.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_128: With this, we may proceed in our quest with easier hearts.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_129: Thank you for sharing your knowledge with us. We shall return to the Omphalos and continue engaging with your brethren.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_WATCHEROFMOON_000_1: That is well. As I watch on, I shall pray that the tale comes to a happy conclusion for gods and men alike.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_201: Something's amiss. The gods' avatars are nowhere to be seen...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_LLYMLEAN_000_202: (-Audacious Woman-)That's because our preparations are complete!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_LLYMLEAN_000_203: (-Audacious Woman-)Ahhh, I've waited so bloody long for this moment!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_204: (-Sagely Man-)Tsk-tsk, Llymlaen. Are such uncouth words the first you would speak unto our guests?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_LLYMLEAN_000_205: Oh, leave off, Thaliak! You can't tell me you're not as excited as I am!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_206: I would be the first to admit my joy, but on such a momentous occasion, I would act with due propriety.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_207: Well met, children of man. 'Tis our understanding that you have spoken with the watcher and ascertained our true nature.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_208: Indeed, we were created by Hydaelyn to tend the star.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_209: Having built the Omphalos at its heart, and our sanctums throughout aether-rich Eorzea, we labored to preserve the balance of reality.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_210: All of this we have learned, but there is still one thing we do not understand.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_211: Our analysis of the phantom realm revealed that you and yours dilute your very selves by fighting us.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_212: Would this not impede your ability to carry out your duties?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_213: We appreciate your concern, but you needn't worry.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_A2_000_002: I knew it─you were him all along.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_A2_000_003: So...the baby opo-opo was Oschon all along?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_215: I haven't been honest with you, and for that I apologize.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_216: Likewise, I knew that you harbored suspicion as to my true identity.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_100_216: Loath though I am to disappoint, it isn't the little fellow.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_217: While my brethren used various creatures as their avatars, I chose the form of a man, the better to share in your solitude.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_219: (-Oschon-)...The Wanderer, to beckon unto the Omphalos they who could grant our wish.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_220: Wh-What? How could you hide such a thing from us!?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_221: (-Oschon-)Had you known my true identity and our purpose, we feared that you would refuse to fight us.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_222: (-Oschon-)But our fears were unfounded. You've heeded our request and, despite the hardships, endeavored to grant it.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_223: (-Oschon-)Forgive me, , but I must leave the little fellow in your care.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_224: (-Oschon-)In the innermost part of our realm, we shall reveal the truth in its entirety.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_225: (-Oschon-)As your patron deity, ever have I watched over you. And now I await your coming with bated breath.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_226: (-Oschon-)I await your coming with bated breath.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_LLYMLEAN_000_227: I know the ones who are mine, and I know you too, . Gird your loins and have at us!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_LLYMLEAN_000_228: This is our grandest moment, mortal. Gird your loins and have at us!
