TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_229: As your patron deity, I shall receive you with my all. Be as a raging torrent, child of man.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_230: I shall receive you with my all. Be as a raging torrent, child of man.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_240: I don't blame Deryk for hiding the truth. 'Tis no easy thing to say that you're actually a god.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_245: In his wanderings, I can't help but wonder what Deryk thought and felt...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_260: So Deryk is the Wanderer, the deity who shares in men's solitude...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_261: And in order to beckon us to the phantom realm, he posed as an explorer and solicited the aid of the Sons of Saint Coinach.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_262: In spite of this, I do not feel as though I've been deceived, nor do I harbor any resentment. Rather, I simply feel sad.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_263: I understand. 'Tis as if a dear friend were suddenly spirited far away...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_264: In hindsight, perhaps it was in expectation of the coming battle that he had kept men at arm's length.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_266: I imagine it must be even harder for you...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_267: But to know that one of the Twelve walked among us... It makes me want to do the best we can by them.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_268: Aye. Since time immemorial, the Twelve have watched over all who abide on this star.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_269: And even as they fulfilled their purpose of maintaining stability, as beings possessed of sentience, they also heeded the hearts of men.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_270: So let us likewise heed their hearts, and do our utmost to grant them their desire.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_271: Then I believe we all know what comes next.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_272: By all indications, this will be the final foray into the gods' sanctum. This task, we entrust to you and your adventurer friends once more, .
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_273: As there's no telling what may happen afterwards, I shall remain on guard here.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_274: Twice now you have triumphed, and I have faith that you will do so yet again. Go well, !
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_280: Worry not, I shall hold the fort here. Pray focus on the battles ahead.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_285: Though we're assured that fulfilling the gods' desire won't visit harm upon the star, I cannot help but worry what may come to pass. We must be prepared.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_290: For the coming foray, you should face Thaliak in the Heaven of Water, and Llymlaen and Oschon in the Heaven of Wind.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_SNOEGEIM_000_291: While Nymeia would also abide in the former, I believe she has already fulfilled her part. Which means an easier time for you...or so I hope!
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_402: Thanks for clearing the way, . That being, I presume, is the Twelve...?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_403: You have done well, children of man. As promised, we shall reveal the truth in its entirety.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_404: Our desire is simply thus: to give ourselves unto the star as a blessing.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_405: In the twelve millennia we have existed, we have come to harbor tremendous power through prayers.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_406: Through battle, our essence shall unravel and return to the star, where it might give rise to new life. Such is our final gift to you.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_408: Yes. The fragments of our former souls which serve as the core of our existence shall rejoin the Lifestream.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_409: Yet though we may fade from sight, our individuality lost, our stabilizing influence shall endure.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_410: The only thing to change is where your prayers find their way. Henceforth, it shall be this, the instrument of blessing, that receives of mortal hopes─hopes that shall be given back to the star.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_411: But your presence brings comfort to mankind. Everyone would wish for you to remain. Must you truly fade away?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_412: Such gladdening things you say, child. We must confess, what we do, we also do for ourselves.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_413: When mankind overcame the Final Days, it so moved us that even we who are but constructs knew the greatest joy.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_414: You have shown your unfaltering love for the world. In return, we would show our undying love for you.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_415: Worry not. Myths are wont to be woven and passed down.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_416: So long as men hold the Twelve in fondness, we shall live on in your faith in us.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THETWELVE_000_418: The moment of parting is come. By our blessing, may you march towards a brighter future.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_ALTHYK_000_420: When you are ready, brothers and sisters.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_BYREGOT_000_421: May the font of your ingenuity ever flow.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_RHALGR_000_422: Yours is the strength to destroy all obstacles.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_AZEYMA_000_423: Abide in virtue, and hold fast to the truth.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_NALDTHAL_000_424: There is meaning in your deeds. Celebrate life and embrace death.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_NOPHICA_000_425: May you flourish, and reap a bountiful harvest.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_ALTHYK_000_426: In your limited time, have boundless compassion.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_HALONE_000_427: Carry yourself with honor and forge on, towards victory.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_MENPHINA_000_428: Harbor love in your heart─for yourself, for others, and for the world.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_THALIAK_000_429: From past to future the river of knowledge flows. Be part of its nourishing waters.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_NYMEIA_000_430: May a wonderful new world greet you beyond destiny's horizon.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_LLYMLEAN_000_431: Be calm as the ocean, and you shall weather any storm.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_OSCHON_000_432: As the wind blows unfettered, may you be free to follow your heart.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_NOPHICA_000_435: (-Nophica's Voice-)Remain with them if that be your desire.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_OSCHON_000_436: But...this is what we've dreamed of. To return to the star together.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_OSCHON_000_437: I just... I never imagined that I would grow so fond of them. That parting would be so hard...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_NALDTHAL_000_438: (-Nald'thal's Voice-)Long as we have abided in patience to rejoin the Lifestream...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_ALTHYK_000_439: (-Althyk's Voice-)For the drop in the river of time that is man's fleeting life...
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_NYMEIA_000_440: (-Nymeia's Voice-)Why not share your fate with them?
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_LLYMLEAN_000_441: (-Llymlaen's Voice-)Follow your heart, as you ever have.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_MENPHINA_000_442: (-Menphina's Voice-)And when the time comes, we shall meet again.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_443: I've...decided to continue journeying a while longer.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_DERYK_000_450: That I'm still here... I can scarce believe it myself.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_GRAHATIA_000_455: It cannot have been easy for Deryk to break with his decision. I should like to hear what went through his mind.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_470: Words can't well express my surprise when I opened my eyes to see Deryk standing there.
TEXT_AKTKEA301_04791_KRILE_000_471: I'm naturally curious as to what happened, but above all, I rejoice for a dear friend returned.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_GRAHATIA_000_000: It cannot have been easy for Deryk to come to this decision. I should like to hear what went through his mind.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_005: I expect Deryk has a few words to say. Let us lend him an ear.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_020: <sigh> What to say in such a moment...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_100_020: Best to speak from the heart, I suppose. I'm glad to be back.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_021: And we're glad to have you back!
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_022: “Glad” hardly suffices to describe it! We're over the moon that you're still here, Deryk! Or should we call you Oschon?
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_023: I no longer have Oschon's power. Deryk will do.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_024: I was remade from the portion of my essence that wasn't returned to the star, and will live out my days as a man.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_GRAHATIA_000_025: May I ask what happened? No sooner had the Twelve vanished than you reappeared before us...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_026: At the very last, I couldn't bear it. Couldn't bear to say farewell.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_027: Your earnest friendship had weighed down my steps.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_028: And the little fellow's fervent call halted them.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_029: I was overwhelmed by the keenest longing to remain among you and see more of the world I love.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_030: Upon seeing me torn, my brethren bade me follow my heart. I needed no further urging.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_031: We created the instrument of blessing in the faith that, one day, the star would no longer need our guiding hand.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_032: Thanks to you, that day has finally come.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_033: Ah, but I ramble. How uncharacteristic. Let us head back to the Omphalos, shall we?
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_041: Well, we must return to Sharlayan. The Forum will be expecting a report.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_042: Yet if the entire truth were to be revealed to the public, it would shake the very foundation of the worship of the Twelve...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_GRAHATIA_000_043: Aye, in penning our report, we would do well to consult the Forum on what details are safe to disclose.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_GRAHATIA_000_044: Much pertaining to the field of mythology will need to be obfuscated, I fear...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_045: Worry not on my account! Inspired by our findings, I have a mind to examine the Twelve in the context of reception theory.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_046: The people's perception of deities are wont to be informed by their culture.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_047: By comparing the differences across eras and regions, I believe we may uncover heretofore unseen aspects to the Twelve!
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_048: Reception theory, you say. Most intriguing. I should like to see the fruits of your research when I visit Sharlayan.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_049: When you do, have care not to reveal who you used to be. Our scholars would be all over you like starved beasts.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_050: I see... Perhaps I shall wait a while before I come calling...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_051: Before I came to you, I simply roamed the world. I had no objective─nothing I wished to find.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_052: With this second chance I have, I mean to undertake my travels with a renewed perspective.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_054: I would move my brethren's hopes elsewhere, to a place in men's midst.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_055: Oh, what a wonderful idea! If you don't mind, we should like to accompany you.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_056: By all means. We make for the Sanctum of the Twelve, in the East Shroud.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_060: Feel free to go on ahead, my friend. While this won't be my last time here, I need a moment before I leave...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_GRAHATIA_000_065: The words of the monument are a promise by the gods to watch over mankind.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_GRAHATIA_000_066: 'Tis comforting to know that their promise will endure...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_070: As engrossed as we've been in our work, we've seldom had the chance to thus gather and relax. The last and only time would have been the meal in Revenant's Toll, I think.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_075: The Sanctum of the Twelve! I couldn't imagine a more fitting place for their memories!
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_101: Ahhh! No matter how many times I visit the Sanctum, its majesty never fails to move me!
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_102: And the rich history! Originally built during the dawn of the Fifth Astral Era, it was reclaimed by the wood before being restored in the wake of the Calamity.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_103: Truly, it stands as a testament to the influence that magical civilizations and city-states have had upon Eorzean culture!
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_104: This Sanctum harbors the hopes of men. And now, those of my brethren shall join them.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_105: If you are not averse, I would speak a little of my brethren─that is, those individuals whose essence lent them form. As it pertains to another age, some concepts may be foreign to you, but would you be interested nonetheless?
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_107: Byregot was a man with a gift for creating inanimate objects such as buildings and furnishings.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_108: With his abilities, he served a supervisory role at the Bureau of the Architect, where he was nothing short of a pillar. His chief was carefree to a fault, you see, and he took it upon himself to ensure the work was done.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_109: Rhalgr was a brawny man whom Venat encountered on her travels.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_110: They quickly struck up a friendship, and he joined her on a quest to destroy an enormous meteor that was hurtling towards the star. 'Tis fair to say this event gave rise to the legends surrounding the Destroyer.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_111: Azeyma was a woman who served as a judicial officer in the Bureau of the Administrator─an experience which served her well as the Warden.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_112: She was an ardent proponent of the seat of Azem, and dreamed of training under Venat and her successor.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_113: Nald'thal was a close personal friend of mine. A merchant by trade, he was outwardly gregarious, but also possessed a reserved side and knew quiet joy in his passion for ore.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_114: When men began treating him as a dual-aspected god, it reminded me of the person he used to be, and I couldn't help but be struck with the pang of nostalgia.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_115: Nophica was a landscape architect of great repute who grew plants gathered from the star over.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_116: Despite being skilled in magic, she preferred to nurture plants as nature intended, and her garden ever bloomed with beautiful flowers. All who visited were said to leave with their souls salved.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_117: Althyk was a researcher who observed newly made creations in Elpis. He possessed mastery over time magicks, and was known to be a kind-hearted if reticent man.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_118: Althyk was a researcher who observed newly made creations in Elpis.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_119: Although it was at his sister's urging that he first joined our faction, he soon became a stalwart believer in the cause, and always took the initiative in discussion.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_120: Halone was a formidable warrior tasked with hunting creations that were deemed detrimental to the star.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_121: For her prowess, she had been regarded as a leading candidate for the seat of Pashtarot, preserver of discipline and order.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_122: Menphina was the youngest among us, a student affiliated with the Words of Lahabrea at the Akadaemia Anyder.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_123: Even within that prestigious institution she was considered a prodigy, and hers were the hands that created the magick to isolate and seal Zodiark.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_124: Thaliak was the headmaster of the Akadaemia Anyder. A man of learning and leadership both, he presided over the institution's myriad faculties.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_125: No known phenomenon existed in which he wasn't versed. Words do not do justice to express the remarkable scholar that he was.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_126: Nymeia was an observer in Elpis, like her older brother Althyk.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_127: She possessed a caring and inquisitive nature, and was liked and trusted by her peers. 'Tis said that she began the custom of offering flowers to the departed.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_128: She possessed a caring and inquisitive nature, and was liked and trusted by her peers.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_129: Llymlaen was a researcher at Metabaseos Thalassai, a facility for the observation and evaluation of sea life.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_130: So passionate was she about her work, she once threw a knife at someone who inadvertently came too close to her observation subject.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_131: Oschon was a traveler whom Venat encountered in the wilderness. They shared a campfire and discussed at length what it meant to be free.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_132: Leaving my hopes as the Wanderer in this place, I shall set forth anew─as simply a man named Deryk.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_100_132: And last but not least, the watcher. He was the chief archivist at Anamnesis Anyder, and respected Venat deeply as an individual even as he cared for her as a dear friend.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_110_132: Indeed, among our number, none was more devoted to Venat. And that devotion made him best suited to his duty and the solitude that accompanies it.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_133: ...That is all. 'Tis a lot to remember, but I should be glad if they remain with you in some way.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_134: We're grateful that you should share with us these new aspects of Hydaelyn and the Twelve. Thank you.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_GRAHATIA_000_135: Well, 'tis past time we headed back to Sharlayan. It wouldn't do to keep Ojika waiting.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_136: I assume you will be traveling via Limsa Lominsa. In which case, allow us to see you off from there.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_137: Till now I have wandered alone, but as I recently learned─a journey is better shared.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_160: Our friends are presently booking their passage.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SNOEGEIM_000_162: There's room aboard the next ship, so we'll be setting sail shortly.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_163: Oh, Deryk! No sooner do we arrive in a crowded place than you up and disappear!
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_164: Ah, 'tis a force of habit, in order to avoid people...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_165: But I needn't do so anymore, do I? On the contrary, I should embrace the chance to connect with other souls.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_166: As your comrades, we completely agree.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_167: And remember, you're always welcome at the Baldesion Annex, so be sure to pay us a visit.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_169: Thank you, Deryk. For giving us your trust.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_170: And thank you as well, . Had you not been with us, we would have struggled to grant the Twelve their wish.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_KRILE_000_171: Well, we had best find our vessel. While the report remains to be compiled, I believe we can officially declare our investigation complete. Till next we meet, my friends!
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_173: Ere I embark on my journey, there is a place nearby I would like to visit. Might I ask you to accompany me?
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_174: Thank you. Come, we shall head outside the city via the Tempest Gate.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_190: Here, the wind whips in from the sea like a storm...but I've always found the sensation quite invigorating.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_191: Lest you wonder, I intend to strike west, and thence make my way through upper and outer La Noscea.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_192: And in order to mark my new beginning as a man, en route I wish to see Oschon's Embrace with you.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_193: You need only accompany me across the bridge.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_194: From there, I shall continue on my own.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_210: Such a great wave that was that ripped the Gods' Grip from the mainland...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_211: In the wake of the Calamity, my brethren and I were all occupied with our respective duties. This is my very first time seeing the bridge.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SYSTEM_000_220: Follow Deryk's lead and try not to fall behind.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_230: 'Tis a fine bridge, boasting splendid views and brimming with life. The very image of man's determination to overcome adversity.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_231: I am honored that it should be named Oschon.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_251: Well, this is as far as I asked you to come...
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_252: But if you are willing, might we converse a little more?
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_253: It occurs to me I hadn't asked you about your opinion of the Twelve.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_254: How you personally perceive us, for instance, or what you felt when you faced us.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_255: Your words from the heart, I would take with me as a memento.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_301: Is that so? The others will be glad to hear that.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_302: Thank you for humoring me, ...and apologies for keeping you so long.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_303: I am ready to set forth now. To witness a world filled with our blessing.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_304: To begin with, I shall tour La Noscea and visit those locales which are named after the Twelve. After which, I shall go wherever the wind blows.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_305: Together with this fellow, of course─until such time as he tires of my company.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_307: This time, I shall embrace the joy of meeting and accept the sorrow of parting.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_308: And when the time comes for me to return to the star, I shall share my experiences with my brethren.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_309: Needless to say your words will feature prominently in my recounting.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_310: You will continue your own journeys, will you not?
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_DERYK_000_311: Then I shall look for you out there. Fare you well, my friend─and may the Twelve bless you and keep you.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SYSTEM_000_400: The paintings of the Twelve are now available for purchase from Duremert in the Pillars.
TEXT_AKTKEA302_04792_SYSTEM_000_405: By completing the quest “Soaring Profits,” the paintings of the Twelve will become available for purchase.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_000: Ah, I've found you at last!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_001: You, my good , were born to be a star!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_002: (-Metem-)Allow me to introduce myself. I am Metem, head of strategic management at Ascension Arcadia, the premier enterprise for entertainment in Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_003: (-Metem-)Our flagship facility is the Arcadion, a combat arena, and it is there that we host the Ascension Arcadia Championship. It is the pinnacle for fighters in Alexandria─and I want you to be among them!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_004: (-Metem-)As you may have heard, circumstance had forced us to close the arena's doors for a time. But the time is right to reopen them.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_005: (-Metem-)Her Majesty's tragic passing has left our citizens disconsolate. By providing them with gripping entertainment, it is our hope to help them to forget their cares for a while.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_006: (-Metem-)If we are to accomplish that, however, it will not do to show them what they have seen countless times before. No, they need something new─someone new!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_007: (-Metem-)And who better than  who not only protected our citizens from the king's army, but struck down the king himself! ...That was you, yes?
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_008: (-Metem-)So it was, so it was! And so, for your strength and valor, the president of the federation has marked you to be the Arcadion's next great star!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_009: (-Metem-)Just imagine it: an upstart─the people's protector─arrives on the scene, and challenges the Arcadion's mightiest to rise up as grand champion! What could be more gripping, I ask you!?
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_010: (-Metem-)For your part, you will naturally be well compensated! The finest equipment Solution Nine has to offer awaits you after each and every victory!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_011: (-Metem-)I daresay this has you enticed, but you needn't make up your mind right away. If you are keen to test your strength and win rich rewards, then come to the Arcadion at the end of this avenue. The attendant will show you in.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_100_011: (-Metem-)With that, I bid you farewell for now. I shall look forward to a favorable response!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_ARCADIAATTENDANT_00: Ah, . Master Metem has been expecting you. If you would follow me, I will take you to him.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_100: You came! By this, I take it you will fight in the Arcadion!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_101: Allow me to be the first to welcome you to the fold! Now then, I shall explain to you─
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_YAANA_000_102: (-Haughty Lass-)Hmph... You look like you've got some fight in you, I suppose.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_YAANA_000_103: (-Haughty Lass-)Still, you can only be so strong without being a soulshifter. You wouldn't last long against any of us.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_HONEYBLOVELY_000_10: (-Darling Damsel-)Well, aren't you just a treat? I look forward to meeting you on stage!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_BRUTEBOMBER_000_105: (-Hulking Bruiser-)You're a puny candle before my roaring flame! Make it to me, and I'll blast you out of the ring!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_106: Those are some of the fighters you will face. They are all...ahem, characters, as you can see, but I hope you do not take offense at their words. Consider it their way of welcoming you!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_100_106: Now, where was I? Ah, yes. As I have mentioned, the Ascension Arcadia Championship is a fighting competition. The realm's mightiest duke it out in a bid to become the grand champion.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_100_107: I've no doubt that all Alexandrians would be captivated by your journey as a challenger, and cheer you on as you fight your way up the ranks!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_107: And speaking of ranks, the fighters of the Arcadion are divided into three tiers: light-heavyweight, cruiserweight, and heavyweight.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_100_108: The ultimate objective is to become the undisputed champion in all the tiers, and thereby rise up as the grand champion.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_108: As a rookie, your campaign begins in the light-heavyweight tier, where you must defeat your three rivals ranked therein.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_109: Goodness gracious me, I almost forgot to mention a most important thing!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_110: The Arcadion has its own repository of feral souls, which our fighters utilize in battle.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_111: So potent are these souls, they alter the fighters' very forms. Lest you wonder, it is the potency of the souls employed that separates the championship's three tiers.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_112: Now, I'm given to understand you do not use a regulator. Even when you faced the king, you did not rely on souls of any kind. That is most impressive indeed!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_113: Be that as it may, it would be egregiously unfair for you to compete with naught to balance the scales.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_114: Fortunately, here at the Arcadion, we also have the souls of former champions in storage. We will use them to create allies to fight alongside you.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_115: And to make sure they work with you like a well-oiled machine, we will draw upon your memories to fine-tune their appearance and abilities to your liking!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_A1_000_001: That sounds a lot like the Endless.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_A1_000_002: Like the arcane manifestation of Gulool Ja Ja...
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_116: “Endless”? I'm not familiar with that term, but I assure you there is nothing untoward in the technique we employ. It simply brings forth a temporary simulacrum.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_000180_METEM_000_11: My, such marvelous magicks exist in your world? Intriguing! Electrope is the medium employed here, but I daresay it is similar in bringing forth a temporary simulacrum.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_118: And for the purposes of evening the odds, I believe seven of these simulacra should suffice. What do you think?
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_A2_000_001: Using souls for entertainment is wrong.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_A2_000_002: The souls in your repository should be set free.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_122: Hm-hm... I had expected that you might harbor reservations about the use of souls. Those who hail from outside the barrier often do.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_123: And so I have a proposal─an additional incentive, if you will. For each victory you claim, I shall release the souls of those who fought beside you.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_100_124: You, my friend, would be the star who brings fresh change to the Arcadion!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_100_125: So, what say you? Are you willing to fight under those terms?
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_100_126: Excellent! Now, I would tell you more about the Arcadion...but let us save it for after your first bout. After all, it'd be pointless if you end up losing straightaway.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_METEM_000_130: With that, I officially welcome you as a fighter of the Arcadion! When you are ready to take to the arena, you need but say the word!
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_SYSTEM_000_140: By completing matches in the Ascension Arcadia Championship, you may earn valuable artifacts.
TEXT_KINGRA101_04960_SYSTEM_000_141: These can be exchanged for equipment by speaking with Hhihwi in Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_100_000: You're ready, then? Excellent. Rest assured I will be here to guide you in the beginning.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_000: Now, I shall introduce your first opponent. Pray look at the monitor.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_001: This here is Black Cat, feared as the claw in the dark!
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_002: That's right, she's the one who took your measure earlier. While she's still a rookie herself, you'd be wise not to underestimate her. She has real talent and is expected to go far.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_003: Her feral soul is Cath Palug, a terrible feline said to have pushed a legendary hero to his limits.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_004: With its power, she becomes unimaginably nimble, and her very claws can rend steel. You'll need to keep your wits about you.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_005: Now, you should know that the ring is uniquely configured to complement the fighting style of your foes.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_006: This is in order to provide the audience with a spectacle. After all, we're first and foremost in the business of entertaining!
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_007: On a similar note, I should mention that I'm also the commentator for matches. Leave it to me to squeeze every drop of excitement out of your fight!
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_008: Now then, you had best see to your preparations. May you emerge victorious in your debut!
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_100: Bravo, bravo! You were simply magnificent out there!
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_101: The president's eye for talent is keen as ever.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_102: So, now that you have your first victory under your belt, I shall tell you more about the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_103: The championship traces its roots to a time in Alexandria long before the coming of the Turali people.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_104: It was very different in the beginning, though, with matches pitting recreated simulacra against each other.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_105: That's right─the very same that fought at your side. But with the advent of soul-derived resuscitation, battles to the death between living combatants became the norm─and all without any actual deaths.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_106: After Zoraal Ja was made king, he proposed the use of feral souls to enhance one's flesh, leading to the technology for it being devised.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_107: With this new innovation, the contest evolved once more. Combatants took on the power and likeness of beasts, and the audience experienced newfound heights of excitement!
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_108: However, when Zoraal Ja raised the banners of war to embark on his conquest, all feral souls were reserved for the army's use. We had no choice but to suspend operations at the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_109: What happened afterwards, I believe you know. Having gone mad, the king was vanquished by your hands, and shortly thereafter, our beloved queen was taken from us... Though we are thankfully safe now, sadness and uncertainty darken our hearts...
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_110: Some may think it in poor taste to resume the championship now of all times, but it is now most of all that the people need cheering up. And as I mentioned when first we spoke, we wish to help them forget their cares.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_111: Did you see how the audience roared when you, the upstart challenger, triumphed over our rising rookie? You have captured their imaginations, and I hope you will continue to do so!
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_YAANA_000_112: (-Black Cat-)Ugh, I can't believe I lost to someone who wasn't even using a feral soul! What are you!?
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_YAANA_000_113: (-Black Cat-)Damn it all! I can't leave things like this...
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_YAANA_000_114: (-Black Cat-)Say, would you mind if I watched you for a while? Don't worry, I don't have any hard feelings. I'm just curious, that's all─about what you can do.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_A3_000_002: As long as you don't get underfoot.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_YAANA_000_120: Don't mind me. I'm just going to be watching you quietly.
TEXT_KINGRA102_04961_METEM_000_130: As fickle as a feline, that one... But I do hope you won't hold it against her. Deep down, she has a good heart.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_000: Don't mind me. I'm just going to be watching you quietly.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_100_000: Although unexpected company has appeared, let us focus on the match ahead.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_100: Allow me to introduce your next opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_101: This is Honey B. Lovely, the darling of the Arcadion!
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_102: As you can doubtless guess, she utilizes the soul of a bee─and an extremely venomous one at that. But rather than her poison, you should be wary of her ability to charm all before her.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_103: For in addition to her winsome charm, which serves her well as a songstress, she can produce the pheromones of a queen bee to enthrall even her foes. Those who fall under her spell delight in the torment she unleashes upon them.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_100_103: Which is why the audience will be spectating via special contraptions cloaked in holograms. It wouldn't do to have hundreds of people be enthralled.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_104: (-Black Cat-)In short, there's nothing lovely about her. Despite what she might claim, you're in for a bad time.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_105: That may be so, but I have faith that you will prevail. Now, sally forth and show us your mettle!
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_110: Let's see how you hold up this time without a feral soul.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_130: What a performance that was! I knew you could do it, my friend!
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_131: To think you actually managed to take Honey B. down... You're the real deal!
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_132: With this victory, you're now eligible to challenge the reigning champion of the light-heavyweight division. And as eager as I am to see you claim the crown, it will take some time to make arrangements for the match.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_133: While you wait, why not find yourself a “second”? That is, someone who supports you by gathering information on your opponents and giving advice on your training.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_134: W-Wait! If  needs a second, then please let me do it!
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_135: Those who lose aren't allowed to fight for a while, so I'm free. But above all, I'd like to see the person who defeated me defeat everyone else too!
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_136: Hmmm... As an active fighter, I suppose you would know your opponents better than most. If  is willing, then I certainly wouldn't object.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_A1_000_001: I'd be happy to have Black Cat in my corner.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_137: You won't regret this! Now, if I'm to be your second, you ought to know my real name.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_138: (-Yaana-)I'm Yaana. I look forward to working together!
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_140: Young though she is, Yaana is a certified fighter of the Arcadion. With her knowledge of your opponents, I believe she is a sound choice for your second.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_YAANA_000_150: Let's head to my gym. It's a bit messy, but it's far more comfortable than in this dreary old place.
TEXT_KINGRA103_04962_METEM_000_151: As you seem to have everything well in hand, I will excuse myself. I shall see you again when it is time for the match.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_000: Right then, follow me. The gym isn't too far from here.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_EXCITABLEMAN_000_10: Hey, aren't you , the fighter who doesn't use a regulator!?
To not only fight, but win without using a feral soul... You're absolutely amazing! I'll be cheering for you from now on!
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_EXCITABLEBOY_000_10: I was so surprised when I saw you in the ring! You're the hero who protected us from the soldiers!
I've been your biggest fan ever since! You'll win your next match too, I just know it!
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NERVOUSYOUTH_000_10: You heartless fiend! How dare you embarrass our sweet Honey B. like that!? I hate you!
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_UNCOUTHMAN_000_105: Enjoy this feeling while you can, new blood! You'll be begging for mercy come your next match...
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_GABBRO_000_106: (-Genial Gentleman-)My, the fans are quite riled up today. I understand the need to let out their frustration, but I wish they could find more productive ways to use that energy.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_GABBRO_000_107: (-Genial Gentleman-)Ah, but do excuse me. I'm something of a storyteller, and I have a keen interest in seeing how this championship unfolds. When you have a moment, I would love to ask you a few questions.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_DISSATISFIEDMAN_000: Wait, you're Black Cat! What are you doing, keeping company with the  who just beat you!?
That's probably why you lost─you don't have any pride! Hmph, I'd much rather watch your sister fight. Nobody put on a show like Wicked Thunder!
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_110: This is never-ending. Let's get out of here.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_111: Looks like we managed to slip away. Come on, the gym's just over here.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_120: And here it is. Tritails Training, the home of Alexandria's finest fighters! That being said, I'm the only one here at the moment...
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_121: It's also my actual home. The first floor is where I live, and the basement is where I train. Now don't be shy, go on in and make yourself comfortable!
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_200: It's a pleasure to meet you, ! My name is Neyuni. Thank you very much for looking after my sister!
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_201: Thanking  for knocking me out, are you?
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_202: Anyway, as you may have pieced together, I have two sisters. And though they're gone now, our parents were originally from Tural.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_203: They happened to be in Yyasulani when the dome appeared, and ended up trapped.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_204: Here they took up work as hunters, but they were always opposed to regulators and never wore them. And one day, they went out and never came back...
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_205: Truth be told, I became interested in you because you reminded me of our parents. Like them, you're averse to using souls.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_206: We, on the other hand, don't see such a problem with the practice. So at our sister's urging, we started wearing regulators after Mother and Father died.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_207: It's only because they weren't wearing regulators when they passed that we can still remember them. Whether we're better or worse off for it, I can't say...
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_208: I was too little to understand when it happened, but I've heard the story from my sisters. So when I see you fight, I can't help but feel anxious.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_209: , I say this knowing your stance, but won't you consider wearing a regulator in matches? If only to revive yourself should the worst come to pass.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_210: I'm afraid you can't change people's minds when it comes to soul use, Neyuni. It's a question of culture and upbringing.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_211: But rather than talk about such things...
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_212: We should celebrate! You've won two championship matches now, ─this calls for drinks! We've only got energy tonics, but it's the gesture that counts, right?
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_213: You're celebrating even though you lost...?
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_214: So, after what that delightful fan said outside earlier, I imagine you're curious about my sister.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_215: Her name's Eutrope, and she rose to be a top contender in the heavyweight division. She became a fighter to look after me and Neyuni first and foremost, but it turned out she was great at it.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_216: Hardly surprising, I suppose. She always excelled at anything she set her mind on. She was a natural at combat, and on top of that she mastered how to wield electrope.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_100_216: Hold on, I've just the thing.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_217: Wicked Thunder was her ring name. She harnessed the levinsteed's soul in conjunction with electrope, and could shapeshift to adapt to her enemies in battle.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_218: I'm confident enough in what I can do─Eutrope herself taught me how to fight─but I could never emulate her fighting style.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_219: The thing is, she just disappeared one day, without saying a word to us.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_220: She was so close to being immortalized, too.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_221: Right, you wouldn't know. All Arcadion fighters retire young. Feral soul transfiguration is just too much of a burden on the body.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_222: Those who fight to the age of twenty are immortalized in the Ascension Arcadia Hall of Fame. This comes with the privilege of moving to the luxury residences on Everkeep's upper level, where they can live out their days in comfort.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_223: Eutrope threw all of that away when she vanished. I just can't wrap my head around why...
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_224: But that's enough reminiscing for now. It can't be long now before your next match, so let's head back to the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_NEYUNI_000_225: Good luck, ! And please, be careful...
TEXT_KINGRA104_04963_YAANA_000_240: Here we go, ! I'll do my best to support you as your second!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_100_000: If you win this next fight, you'll become champion of the light-heavyweight division! Let's give it everything we've got!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_100: Right, let's take a look at your opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_101: That there, I regret to say, is the reigning light-heavyweight champion, the Brute Bomber.
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_102: He uses the might of the bomb king to ignite all that he touches. But that'll be the least of your worries.
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_103: He's a dirty fighter who'll do anything and everything to win, the rules be damned. Countless of his opponents have had to be carried to the infirmary.
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_104: But you'll be fine, I'm sure of it! If you bested me, you can best the Brute Bomber too!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_105: Now go and blast that loathsome lout out of his own ring, and come back here the new champion!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_110: I believe in you, ! Blast the Brute Bomber out of his own ring and become champion!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_120: You did it! You really did it! Even though you beat me, I'm absolutely over the moon for you!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_121: It's truly astonishing what you can do without a feral soul...
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_122: With this, you're now the light-heavyweight champion! Congratulations, !
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_123: Now, there's going to be a ceremony to officially crown you champion. All and sundry will be watching, so make sure you wear something you won't regret!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_130: Ready, are you? Then let's get you on stage for your big moment!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_000870_METEM_000_20: My fellow citizens! We are gathered to recognize a new champion in the Arcadion─a rising star who shot to the top of the light-heavyweight division at breakneck speed!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_201: Without further ado, please give a warm welcome to the  of the hour!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_202: The unstoppable upstart, the unenhanced-but-unbeatable, the one and only !
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_BRUTEBOMBER_000_204: Your victory was a farce, and I refuse to accept it!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_205: Oh my! It appears the Brute Bomber is unsatisfied with the outcome of his match!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_BRUTEBOMBER_000_206: You fought with eight of you! How is that fair!? Let's settle this one-on-one, just you and me!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_YAANA_000_207: You're one to talk about fair! If it's supposed to be a one-on-one, fight without your bloody bomb king!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_BRUTEBOMBER_000_208: Shut your mouths! I make the rules here!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_209: What in the world just happened!?
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_211: I-I don't believe it! Wicked Thunder, the heavyweight fighter who suddenly vanished, has returned!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_EUTROPE_000_212: I will have your soul! Prepare yourself!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_213: What's this!? Wicked Thunder has just challenged the unstoppable upstart!
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_214: Alas, as much as I wish to bear witness to their clash, Wicked Thunder's license was revoked upon her disappearance. I am unable to sanction such a match...
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_ARCADIAOWNER_000_21: (-Ascension Arcadia President-)I will allow a special exhibition match. Prepare Wicked Thunder's ring...and prepare yourself, upstart.
TEXT_KINGRA105_04964_METEM_000_218: You heard it, folks! By permission of the president, a match will be held! Who will emerge the victor: neoteric witch or the unenhanced warrior!? This is an event you cannot afford to miss!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_000: Eutrope... Where have you been? And why have you come back now?
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_001: I'm sorry. It's just, I wasn't prepared to see my sister like that...
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_002: It's a shame your big moment was spoiled. But now that the match's been decided, there's nothing for it but to prepare.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_003: As a former heavyweight fighter, Eutrope's more than a cut above everyone you've faced thus far.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_004: Even so, having seen how quickly you've climbed up the ranks to become champion, I reckon you're far from overmatched.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_005: As Neyuni mentioned, Eutrope─or rather, Wicked Thunder─harnesses the levinsteed's soul and employs electrope in battle.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_006: Her ring's a recreation of an imaginary city designed to allow her the full use of her powers. Her bouts are notoriously so dangerous that there isn't even seating for spectators.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_007: And while she's my sister, I'm your second. So you go out there, , and you win this!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_010: Wicked Thunder will be your toughest opponent so far, and by far. But you have what it takes, ! I know it!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_020: You're safe, thank goodness. But for you to actually triumph... It seems you have the stuff to succeed even in the upper divisions.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_021: I was hoping to have a word with Eutrope, but she's disappeared again... There's nothing else to do for now, so let's head back to the gym.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_030: Neyuni will have watched the fight at home. I wonder what she thought of...well, everything. Come on, let's head in.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_NEYUNI_000_100: I'm relieved you're unharmed, . But what a shock it was to see Eutrope again, and in that manner...
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_102: Well, no matter. I'm not here to fight you, but to talk to my sisters.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_103: Good, because we have a mountain of questions for you. Why did you disappear without a word? What exactly have you been doing all this time?
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_104: I'll explain everything in due course. But if you want to live, Yaana, you need to give up fighting right now.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_106: Because if you repeatedly transfigure your flesh with a feral soul, you'll eventually develop psychonekrosis─an irreversible disease where your own soul degrades.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_107: Once it's begun, it's too late. All you can do is await death...like me.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_108: This...this can't be true. I knew there were risks, but isn't that why fighters are immortalized? So we can get out before it's too late?
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_109: Yaana. Have you ever met one of the immortalized?
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_110: The life of comfort promised at retirement is just a lie woven to exploit us and cover up our deaths.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_111: B-But I remember them all! How can that be if they're dead?
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_112: Rather than to new homes, the fighters are taken to a secret facility. There, their regulators are removed, and they are kept in confinement until they die.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_100_112: Without their regulators fitted, Everkeep's systems have no way of detecting their death─nor of preserving their memory.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_113: I had noticed changes to my body, and so decided to seek the counsel of the immortalized. And when I snuck into the president's office to ascertain their whereabouts, I discovered the sordid truth.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_114: I feared I would become another victim if I remained. And so I disappeared, and began searching for a cure to the illness.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_116: In theory, the remedy is another person's soul, but an ordinary one won't do. No, it has to be surpassingly dense.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_117: Like yours. I bear you no ill will, but you're my only hope of survival.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_118: Rather than ambush you in the city and cause a disturbance, I challenged you in the ring, certain I would claim my prize.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_119: I knew the president wouldn't pass by the opportunity for a thrilling match, but I had become weaker than I'd realized. That's the only reason we're having this conversation now.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_120: Next time, I will have your soul!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_121: Wait, Eutrope! Even if it's to save yourself, you can't just take the soul of another! It isn't right!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_EUTROPE_000_122: That's easy for you to say! You don't live with the knowledge that, every single moment, your soul is being eaten away!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_123: Forgive my intrusion. I'd come to see how you were faring after your sister's sudden appearance...but I fear I've overheard something most distressing.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_124: So you didn't know either? Despite your position in Ascension Arcadia...
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_125: Had I known, I assure you I would not commentate with such enthusiasm. It was in the belief that our fighters were safe that I enjoyed my work.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_126: There's only one thing to do: we make the truth public and stop the fights. I don't want anyone else to suffer.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_127: Oh no, that is the worst thing we could possibly do! The president shows no mercy to those who get in his way!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_128: Should we go public with his secret, no one would be safe. Not you or me or any of the fighters. That Eutrope has kept silent, I suspect, is because she understood this.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_130: In hindsight, it's because he's such a ruthless man that he could cover up the disease... I believe we have but one recourse.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_131: ! You must rise to the very summit of the Arcadion and become the grand champion!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_132: You see, the grand champion is granted access to all the souls in our repository. While it wouldn't be the intended purpose of this privilege, you would be at liberty to release them!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_133: By thus getting rid of all feral souls left, the fighters would no longer be at risk. With the skill you've displayed thus far, I have faith that you can do it!
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_A1_000_003: Sure, as long as I keep getting rewarded.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_METEM_000_134: Good, good. Now, it would garner suspicion if I lingered too long, so I shall take my leave. If you'll excuse me...
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_135: As you'll recall, I can't fight in any matches for a while─and given what I know now, it's just as well. But I'll of course continue to support you as best I can.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_136: At the same time, Neyuni and I'll undertake our own search for a cure for psychonekrosis. There has to be a way to save our sister without sacrificing you─or anyone else, for that matter.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_150: <sigh> To be honest, I'm still trying to wrap my head around everything...
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_151: I put on a brave face for Neyuni's sake, but the truth is I'm terrified. I'm really glad to have you with us in this.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_152: This has become more than just a fighting competition, but for the sake of our goal, we'll have to go along with it. So come and find me here when it's time to begin your cruiserweight campaign.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_GABBRO_000_153: (-???-)Ah, there is our new light-heavyweight champion! I have been most eager to talk to you, my friend.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_GABBRO_000_154: I believe a proper introduction is in order. My name is Gabbro, and I am a cartoonist─that is, a storyteller in the medium of art.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_GABBRO_000_155: Most of my works are inspired by the battles in the Arcadion, and I'd love nothing more than to chronicle the journey of the unstoppable upstart.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_GABBRO_100_156: Now, I still have some few preparations to attend to. But as soon as that is finished, I should be most obliged to hear your tales.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_GABBRO_000_156: I shall make myself available nearby, for when you have a moment to share your tales.
TEXT_KINGRA106_04965_YAANA_000_157: Gabbro's works are tremendously popular in Solution Nine, and the fact that he wants to make a story about you is proof of your own popularity. You could do worse than have a chat with him.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_HOOBIGO05233_000_00: Say, aren't you ? That certainly saves me a lot of trouble. I was asked to find you on behalf of Miilal Ja.
Curious happenings abound in Mamook of late, and we thought one with your worldly experience may be able to help us make sense of things.
If you have the time and inclination to aid us, she awaits you in Mamook. You'll find her west of the plaza, in the large building near the two-headed statue.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_100: Thank you for coming. Truth be told, I was unsure if I was right to call on you, but the troubles we now face cannot be overcome with our strength alone.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_101: It all began when we found a fallen traveler in the Skydeep Cenote. For a mercy, his wounds were not life-threatening.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_102: His kind is not a common sight in these lands. Tall and slender of build, with pointed ears.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_103: He has yet to awaken, but speaks in his sleep of strange things that make little sense to us.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_104: It was our hope that you might recognize something in his ramblings, or perhaps even jog his memory once he regains consciousness. Might you be willing to speak with him?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_105: Very good. If you would be so kind as to bring him here?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_106: We are glad to see you awake, and in good health besides. May I ask your name, traveler?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_108: It would seem the fall has affected his memory. In any case, his presence here is a complete mystery to us, his armor the only hint as to whence he came. Does anything about him strike you as out of the ordinary?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_A1_000_001: Looks like your typical adventurer to me.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_A1_000_002: Not much different from any other Elezen I've met. Or...would that be Eldite?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_111: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)Elezen? Eldite? No, that's not quite right...
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_113: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)I...I remember. I'm an Elvaan. An Elvaan adventurer!
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_114: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)And you're Mamool Ja... Could it be I've come to Mamook?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_115: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)Wait, if I'm in Mamook, then...I must have been taken prisoner!
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_116: To so readily believe us enemies, perhaps he comes from a land unfamiliar with our customs, across the salt.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_118: We've no way to know for certain. In which case─
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ZEREELJA_000_119: Miilal Ja! We must gather our strongest fighters at once!
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ZEREELJA_000_120: Gulool Ja Ja's shade has returned! It's been sighted near Gok Draak Descent. Bakool Ja Ja has engaged the apparition, but I fear the worst.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ZEREELJA_000_121: The Vow of Resolve's companion, from the Feat of the Brotherhood. I suspect you would understand the graveness of this situation better than most.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ZEREELJA_000_122: In recent days, the late Dawnservant's shade has been seen wandering the woods of Yak T'el. I have reason to believe it was invoked in like manner to the one used in the feat.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ZEREELJA_000_123: Only a privileged few of the Boonewa should be privy to the knowledge required to perform the rite. The culprit will be found in time, but we've a more pressing matter at hand now.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ZEREELJA_000_124: I must hurry and inform the Landsguard. Bakool Ja Ja requires reinforcements.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_100_125: The Dawnservant's shade... I fear he may not hold out until the guard assembles.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_110_125: I am loath to ask such a favor, but would you aid Bakool Ja Ja in this battle?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_126: I'm in your debt. Gok Draak Descent is to the west of here. Please, go and help my son.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_MIILALJA_000_130: It goes without saying that Gulool Ja Ja's shade is dangerous. Please hurry. I fear my son will not last long on his own.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_REMNANTGULOOLJAJA_0: (-Shade of Resolve-)Hmph. Pathetic. And you dare call yourselves blessed siblings?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_202: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)<pant> <pant> Not bad... You might actually prove a challenge.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_203: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)If you've come to help, best stay on your guard. He's not alone...
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_204: (-Rambunctious Youth-)What's this? Another monster in need of slaying? Don't worry─I'll send them packing!
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_208: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)I can't explain why, but something told me I had to be here.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_209: (-Rambunctious Youth-)Hah! Not bad. Not bad at all. But it'll take more than a couple of tauri to stop me!
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_211: (-Rambunctious Youth-)You can speak! A shame you don't seem to have any manners.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_212: The name's Prishe. You'd do well to remember it.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_215: One taurus down, one to go. I hope you're ready!
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_REMNANTGULOOLJAJA_0: (-Shade of Reason-)Gehehehe. At ease, Prishe. We've seen to our task. Come.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_100_217: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Ulmia? What is she talking about?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_219: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'm guessing word of the Dawnservant's shade is what brought you here. I don't know what that girl has to do with all this, but clearly she's aligned with whoever summoned them.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_221: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)The way remains open, though there's no telling where it leads.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_220: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Even so, they can't be allowed to return. We've a duty to protect this forest, and I'll not see it torn apart by some two-headed impostor.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_222: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Let's hurry after them, Brother. Watch over that one, won't you?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_300: Everything's still hazy, but I recall fighting alongside that girl. We were comrades-in-arms, I think.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_301: But something was clearly wrong with her. She not only mistook me for a monster, but she called her two-headed companion “Ulmia.”
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_302: The Ulmia I know is an Elvaan woman. A far cry from the reptilian fiend we encountered.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_303: Something dark has taken hold of her, clouded her mind. I have to go and─
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_A3_000_001: You're not going anywhere with those wounds.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_307: You would go in my stead? I know not how to thank you.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_308: You would put yourself in harm's way for my sake? Thank you...
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_100_308: I recognize that look. The eyes of a  who's seen more than their fair share of battle.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_110_308: Despite what Prishe has done, she was a dear friend to me. I'm fairly certain.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_309: Have care, friend. There's no telling what lies beyond that portal.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_310: I was expecting the townsfolk to be indifferent, if not hostile, when I asked for a sword and shield, but they did not hesitate to help and send me on my way.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_ALXAAL_000_311: I think I've always been accustomed to such armaments, though. Once recovered, I should be glad to put them to good use at your side.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_500: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Are you all right?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_501: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)She's merely sleeping. It remains to be seen if she'll give us a fight when she wakes.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_503: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Ah, she stirs.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_505: A-A two-headed lizard! Trying to take a bite out of me, huh!?
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_506: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)A scrawny thing like you would barely make a snack.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_507: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Besides, we don't eat people!
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_100_507: Sorry, I'm a little on edge.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_110_507: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)If you've no quarrel with us, we've none with you.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_120_507: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)We only wish to talk.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_509: I should know better than to judge people based on their appearance.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_510: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)It's fine. We're an intimidating specimen.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_511: I'm Prishe, by the way. Nice to meet you.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_PRISHE_000_550: Today's just been full of surprises.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_600: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)There is much of this we don't understand, but what we do understand is the battle is won. For now, at least.
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_601: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What would've otherwise been a struggle proved a decisive victory against the Dawnservant's shade and the rest of those fiends. That is to say...erm...
TEXT_KINGEA101_05233_BAKOOLJAJA_000_602: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Thank you for your help, .
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_001: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Hopefully this girl can give us some answers.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_012: You look like a Hume. More importantly, you look like the adventuring type.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_013: You look like an Elvaan, like me. More importantly, you look like the adventuring type.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_014: A Tarutaru. You are a Tarutaru, aren't you? I'd expect you to be...shorter.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_015: You look like a Mithra. More importantly, you look like the adventuring type.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_016: Wait... A male Mithra!? Well, now I've seen everything!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_017: You look like a Galka, but where's your tail? Hacked off on some wild adventure, I bet.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_018: I don't know where you're from, but I can tell I'd love to visit. Can't say I've ever seen anyone quite like you before.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_019: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)If you're done with the small talk, would you mind explaining why you attacked us?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_020: What in the world are you talking about?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_021: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Don't play the fool with us. You were spouting nonsense about us being “tauri,” and nearly killed a man on your rampage.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_022: Well, I do recall fighting tauri not long ago. To protect Ulmia.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_024: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)A friend of hers, you say? That's all well and good, but she was addressing Gulool Ja Ja's shade with that name.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_025: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Hmmm... The incantations needed to summon it are said to be based on a much older magick, one capable of clouding people's minds. If our enemy is skilled enough to summon Gulool Ja Ja, it stands to reason such tricks are not beyond them.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_026: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Meaning young Prishe here was likely tricked into believing the shade was this Ulmia person.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_027: So it was all an illusion, then.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_028: It's starting to come back to me. There was someone who warned me that a dear friend needed my protection.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_029: He was blue like your left head, and he gave me these bizarre weapons.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_100_029: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Blue like me?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_030: I usually fight with my fists, but didn't think twice to accept what they gave me. I suppose their magick's to blame.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_031: In any case, I hope the real Ulmia hasn't been dragged into all this.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_032: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Can you tell us anything about the one you thought was your Ulmia? Where they may be hiding, perhaps?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_033: Would that I could, but when I got here, I was all by my lonesome.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_034: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Here being where, exactly?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_035: Jeuno. At least, I think this is Jeuno. There was never anything like that here before.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_037: It's mostly empty, but there are a few people lingering about, if you know where to look. Maybe they can tell us something.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_038: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Go with Prishe, and see what you can learn of this place and the whereabouts of that shade.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_100_038: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)We will remain here and keep watch on this rift.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_040: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)I sense something foul on the winds here. The sooner we leave this place, the better.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_100: Right, then. Let's have a look around.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_101: Oh, and we should probably stop by the Tenshodo as well. It's in the back of Neptune's Spire, across the way from the fountain.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SYSTEM_000_102: Prishe is now accompanying you. Keep her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SYSTEM_000_103: You can leave Prishe behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with her and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SYSTEM_000_104: If you wish to have Prishe accompany you again, return and speak with her at the original location.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SYSTEM_000_200: You must be accompanied by Prishe and have her at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SYSTEM_000_201: Prishe has yet to arrive. Be sure she is at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_203: I've only visited Jeuno a handful of times, when I needed a place to lay low, and maybe to lick my wounds once or twice.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_204: I always enjoyed my time here, though. Met quite a few interesting people along the way.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_Q5_000_000: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companion?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_205: Oh. Well, if you're busy, don't let me keep you. The big guy can keep me company until you return.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_206: All set? Then let's get going!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_207: Adventurers gather from all corners of the world to buy and sell their spoils here. The taxes are a pain, but it's worth it for the wide selection. Just between you and me, though, I've heard you can cut a good deal with merchants peddling their wares just outside of town.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_208: But why is it closed? The auction house never closes...
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_209: Maybe they're waiting for things to return back to normal around here. Whenever they reopen, I suggest you stop by. Who knows, you may get lucky and find something waaay below market price.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_210: What!? Why is this blocked off?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_211: There are supposed to be stairs here leading up to the residential area.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_212: <sigh> I swear, things get stranger here by the minute.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_VANAADVENTURER05234: Oh, good. I was hoping to run into you two.
I don't wish to be overly forward, but why were you speaking with that Mamool Ja earlier? More importantly, what was it doing here?
They would never dare venture beyond the shores of Aradjiah, unless... My gods, has Gulool Ja Ja laid siege to Aht Urhgan? Is Jeuno next to fall!?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_216: I don't know anything about sieges or invasions, but that Mamool Ja over there is a friend of mine. There ain't nothing for you to worry about.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_217: The poor man's probably more confused than we are about all this.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_VANAADVENTURER05234: I do hope Serpent General Aliapoh is all right...
Hmmm. Can't say I've seen your sort around here before. Where are you from, stranger?
? Can't say I've heard of it.
Most folks passing through hail from San d'Oria, Bastok, or Windurst.
Considering the present state of Jeuno, though, seems strange is becoming a common occurrence.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_234: I'd be lying if I said I'd heard of your homeland either, but that's not important right now. At times like this, we need to know who can be trusted.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_VANAADVENTURER05234: What sort of place is , anyway? Maybe I can visit someday.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_VANAADV05234C_000_2: You're new to Jeuno, aren't you? I can tell by the way you were taking in the sights.
The city was built upon Heavens Bridge, connecting the two great continents of Quon and Mindartia.
You'll find there's an upper and lower level, a port, and the administrative plaza of Ru'Lude Gardens.
At least, you would have before. All ways in and out of Lower Jeuno appear to be blocked or cut off.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_244: The situation here is worse than I thought.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_VANAADV05234C_000_2: Even teleport and recall spells seem to have no effect. What do you suppose has trapped us here?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SYSTEM_000_250: You press against the door, but it refuses to budge.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_251: Won't open? <sigh> Then I guess we won't be meeting Aldo.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_252: He's head of the Tenshodo. When the world's in danger, he's always there to lend me a hand.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_A2_000_001: Reminds me of my friends─the Scions.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_A2_000_002: A shame I can't meet him.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_254: Scions, eh? They sound like a competent lot. Unfortunately, we're on our own here...
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_255: I'm sure the two of you would have gotten along famously. Unfortunately, we're on our own here...
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_270: Whatever's happening here, these people are just as bewildered as we are. We should go back and find Bakool Ja Ja. See if he's noticed anything.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_300: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Returned at last. With answers, I hope.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_301: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)So we're truly in this “Jeuno,” as she says.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_302: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)But I've traveled all over Tural, and never heard of a “Jeuno” or “San d'Oria” or any of those other places.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_303: What in Altana's name is Tural? I thought all you Mamool Ja are from Aradjiah.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_ALXAAL_000_305: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)And she has you to thank, I'm sure.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_306: Uh, thanks for caring. I guess... And who are you, exactly?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_A3_000_001: I thought he was a friend of yours.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_A3_000_002: He's the one who asked me to go and look for you.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_308: What? I've never seen him before in my life.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_309: I appreciate the concern, but I've never seen him before in my life.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_ALXAAL_000_310: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)How can you say such a thing!?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_311: I mean, you do look like the sort I might know, but I'm drawing a blank. What was the name, mister...?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_ALXAAL_000_312: (-Armor-clad Wanderer-)Ah, my name is... My name is...
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_313: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)You must be the one they found wounded in the Skydeep Cenote. Well, we have to call you something.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_315: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)“Vagabond” in the Mamool Ja tongue.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_316: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Though it may be closer to “adventurer” in 's Eorzean. Nicely chosen, Brother.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_ALXAAL_000_317: That does have a rather nice ring to it. Alxaal it is.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_319: Jeuno. Or at least, a close approximation. Surely, you remember this place, don't you?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_322: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What's so special about this place, anyway? And where did that damn shade get off to? Bah, none of this makes any sense!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_400: (-Familiar Voice-)My, my, what a vexing predicament.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_100_400: Hey! That's the one that put me under a spell, I'm sure of it!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_401: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)So, the Boonewa sycophant yet lives. What are you doing here!?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_402: As you've found me in a generous mood, I thought I might enlighten you as to the nature of this place. That is why you've come, isn't it?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_403: The young lady is correct. This is the Grand Duchy of Jeuno.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_ALXAAL_000_404: So we really are in Jeuno. And yet something about it feels so...off.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_405: I never said this is the real one. It is an imitation─a rather convincing one, I might add─which I created based on visions of another world.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_406: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)You built this?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_407: That I did. While you and yours were holding the Dawnservants' coronation, Zoraal Ja and I ventured to the gate of the golden city.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_408: Everything was proceeding as planned─the gate's key was in our possession, the power to reshape the world within our grasp. Or so I thought.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_409: In the eyes of the Resilient Son, I was but a useless tool to be cast aside.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_410: By all rights, I should have died when he struck me down, but once the chamber was empty─the gate still open─I saw my chance.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_411: What I found when I dragged myself across the threshold was an emptiness. A space beyond time. It was there in this dark expanse I beheld another world.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_413: What a load of rubbish. As if anyone would believe that everything and everyone here is little more than one of your toys.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_415: As I said, everything you see here is of my creation.
