TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_416: Much like we fashioned a phantom of Gulool Ja Ja for the Feat of the Brotherhood, I was able to use our ceremonial tools to breathe life into my visions of Vana'diel.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_417: Under normal circumstances, my conjurings only have strength enough for a brief clash. With that stone, however, my magicks are capable of so much more.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_418: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Isn't that what Zoraal Ja used to build his army? Electrope, he called it.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_420: If you know its name, then I trust you also know these stones are possessed of immense power. Power enough for my creations to persist for as long as I please.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_421: Fortunate, then, that that world between worlds was filled with structures made from electrope. More than I could ever hope for.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_PRISHE_000_422: Wait! If everything we see here─everything we believed was from Vana'diel─is of your making, then...am I...?
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_ALXAAL_000_423: Gods, that would mean I am as well.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_424: You...? Yes, well...a trivial thread in the tapestry of my grand designs.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_425: And what a wondrous weave it will be, made possible by the endless possibilities gleaned in that Walk of Echoes!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_426: The memories buried there─those remnants of echoes─will shape my dreams into reality.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_427: I once believed that dream lay in the Resilient Son, but that bastard is dead to me. By my hand, Tural will have the greatest ruler the world has ever known!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_428: I've made an admirable start, but my work is far from finished.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_429: Very soon, I will draw upon the echoes once more to summon the greatest beings of Vana'diel, and their strength will be made one with this magnificent shade.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_430: The reason and resolve which built the nation of Tuliyollal, matched with the uncompromising tyranny that commanded the Mamool Ja of that world.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_A1_000_001: You'll never get away with this. I'll make sure of it!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_A1_000_002: I won't let you sully the memories of Vana'diel!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_A1_000_003: If you won't listen to reason, then maybe you'll listen to my fists.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_SAREELJA_000_432: That's the spirit! My preparations will take time, of course, but when I am ready, you can be certain I will call upon you. To bear witness to my greatness.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_100_432: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Sareel Ja, wait!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_100_500: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Damn it all!
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_500: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Just when I thought things couldn't become more complicated. Making sense of Alexandria was trouble enough, but now we have this Vana'diel to deal with as well.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_501: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I can only imagine how Prishe and Alxaal must be feeling.
TEXT_KINGEA102_05234_BAKOOLJAJA_000_502: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What do you do when your very existence is called into question?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_005: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)First he served that tyrant Zoraal Ja, and now he would dare usurp the throne for this pale imitation of the Dawnservant. Sniveling wretch.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_020: Try as I might, I can recall nothing of my past to refute Sareel Ja's claims.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_021: Prishe, on the other hand, seems to know everything of her past and who she is. Yet to be told the memories of your life are not your own... I can only imagine how she must feel.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_022: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Now's not the time to be disheartened. At least, not here, anyway. I wouldn't trust anything made by Sareel Ja to be safe for long.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_100_022: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Or to remain functional...
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_023: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Let's return to Mamook, while we still can. My mother will want to know of what we've seen here.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_025: Now that we're returned, I can see now this isn't the Mamook that I know.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_MIILALJA_000_026: I am glad to see you and Bakool Ja Ja returned safely. And you've brought a new guest.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_100: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)There you are. I thought you should be the one to explain what happened out there in Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_MIILALJA_000_101: Not simply from another territory, but another world entirely? That explains much of the initial confusion between us.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_102: My apologies for any trouble I may have caused. And thank you for taking me in.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_103: Different worlds, and yet we seem to have so much in common.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_104: I cannot help but wonder what it is that links the two together.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_MIILALJA_000_105: What indeed... You mistook us for the Mamool Ja of your Vana'diel when we first met. May I ask what they are like?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_106: Nothing at all like you and yours, even if they do bear a striking resemblance.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_107: There was a time when all the peoples of Vana'diel, the Mamool Ja included, knew peace.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_100_107: But a tyrant possessed of a terrible power claimed rulership over the Mamool Ja, and turned them against us. Before we realized it, we were at war.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_MIILALJA_000_108: A tale similar to ours, in a way. The rare few of us born with two heads grow to be immensely powerful. That power was used to justify our preeminence over all others.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_100_111: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)But that is not who we are anymore. We can be better than our forebears. We will be better.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_110_111: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)All of our hard work will be for nothing if Sareel Ja succeeds in seizing the throne.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_112: Well, you'll not want for aid in stopping him. I promise you that.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_113: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Oho! Keen to lend a hand, are you?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_114: I don't need to know who I am to know the right thing to do.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_115: My blade is yours. On my honor as an adventurer of Vana'diel, we will put an end to Sareel Ja's schemes!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_116: If  were here, I'm sure 'd have done the same.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_118: We can worry about whether or not I'm real another day.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_119: I'm not going to stand around and let this Sareel Ja piss all over the memories of my home!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_120: So you can count me in, too!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_121: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Don't think you can forget about us. This all started in Yak T'el, and we have a duty to keep our forest safe.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_122: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Sareel Ja has left us without a trail to follow, but it's only a matter of time before he reveals himself to challenge  once more.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_123: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)If you're to be ready, I think it prudent the two of you learn more of our world.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_124: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)An excellent idea, Brother. We should start with Tuliyollal, and see to our own preparations while we're there.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_125: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)If you would meet us at the dirigible landing, we will see Prishe and Alxaal to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_200: Those balloon-powered airships are really something. I didn't expect the flight to be so smooth!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_210: Before I forget, I couldn't help but notice how much you seem to know about me. Is there anything else you remember?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_212: I'm afraid I don't. And as you don't recognize me either, perhaps we weren't acquaintances after all. What I know of you was likely overheard in a tavern somewhere─patrons sharing stories of your famed exploits.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_213: I see... Well, I'll leave it at that, then.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_214: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Now, where to begin?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_215: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Brother. Would it not be wise to first apprise the Landsguard of what's happened? Or would you prefer another stern lecture from the Vow of Reason?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_216: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Ugh, I'd sooner rip off our tail... Fine.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_217: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Could you keep them occupied while we see to the Landsguard? Maybe take them to eat or something.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_218: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Ah, I know. Take them to Aunt Tii's to sample her tacos. Here─for that first meal of yours we spoiled.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_100_218: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)And just so we're clear, we're not expecting to earn your forgiveness. No amount of good deeds will ever undo our past, but there's always time to build a better future.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_219: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)When you get there, tell her we sent you. She'll see that they're taken care of.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_220: I hoped she might remember me, but she doesn't even seem to know me. Gods, who am I...?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_300: Aunt Tii's Tacos, eh? Let me guess: they serve tacos?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_301: Oh, I can hardly wait! I ate tacos all the time back home.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_302: Though I suppose it wouldn't hurt to take a more scenic route. Maybe something along the way will help jog Alxaal's memory.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SYSTEM_000_303: Prishe and Alxaal are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SYSTEM_000_304: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SYSTEM_000_305: If you wish to have your companions accompany you again, return and speak with them at the original location.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_SYSTEM_000_307: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_309: The diversity of the people here is unlike anything I've ever seen in Vana'diel. I can't tell you what a relief it is to know everyone here can get along.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_310: Walking the streets of an unfamiliar city, it feels like I'm back on another adventure.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_Q4_000_000: Are you sure you wish to part ways with Prishe and Alxaal?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_311: What? But our tacos! Oh, all right... We'll wait for you back near the airships, but you better hurry back─I'm starving!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_312: Prishe seems convinced she'll starve to death if we don't eat soon, but if you have other business, who are we to stop you? Go on, friend. We'll wait for you at the landing.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_313: My stomach demands sustenance, . Onward, to Aunt Tii's Tacos!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_314: So we're finally off to Aunt Tii's, eh? Lead the way.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_315: My home is surrounded by ocean too, you know. It has the most beautiful views on a clear day.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_316: Not without the occasional monster, though. It's nice being able to walk around like this without your guard up all the time.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_317: I cannot say why, but I've remembered something looking out at the sand dunes.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_318: There was a man out on the docks who claimed he could teach me new battle arts. But he would only agree on the condition that I retrieved for him a damselfly worm, an apron, and a magicked skull. I don't suppose you've met anyone on your travels who's made such queer requests?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_319: So these are the markets of Tuliyollal. There are so many stands, I wouldn't know where to begin. It's enough to make my head spin.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_320: Some fruit would sure hit the spot right about now... No, Prishe. Remember─you're about to eat tacos.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_321: I happened to spy a few goblins on the way to the market. I remember them living in the major cities of Vana'diel as well.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_322: Of course, there was no shortage of the unscrupulous sort living in the wilds as well. They would gather in droves and give chase to adventurers, forcing anyone and everyone to retreat back to the safety of town.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_330: What in Altana's name is that!? Do people actually ride those things?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_331: Chocobos are the only beasts I've ever seen used for riding in Vana'diel. If they have any, I'd sure like to see them.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_332: Those creatures remind me of the chocobos in Vana'diel. To say we adventurers found them indispensable would be no exaggeration.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_333: From shore to shore, they were our faithful companions wheresoever the roads might lead us.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_323: This is the place, right? I can smell the savory meats already!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_324: And you must be Aunt Tii. Bakool Ja Ja recommended we sample your tacos, so...we'll have three of your finest, please!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_TIISOLJA_000_325: Bakool Ja Ja sent you, did he? Take a seat, and I'll be right over with a tray of our world-famous fare!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_400: Tacos at long last! Oh, how I've waited for this moment!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_402: I thought nothing could match the rich flavor of our tacos back home, but the spicy seasoning of this meat is something else!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_A1_000_001: Eat as many as you'd like.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_A1_000_002: This meal's on Bakool Ja Ja, so don't hold back!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_405: Prishe has taken the lead, but we won't be outdone, surely?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_406: Phew, I couldn't eat another bite. Thanks for treating us.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_407: It was almost like a taste of home. Tavnazia...
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_408: Seeing as we still have a little extra time to ourselves, care to hear more about Vana'diel?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_409: Twenty years ago, the land was gripped by a terrible conflict─the Crystal War, they called it─and it wasn't long before my home, Tavnazia, was drawn into the struggle.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_410: During their assault on the peninsula, the beastmen launched a weapon so powerful, it sundered the land connecting us to the mainland.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_411: Those who survived fled to the Tavnazian Safehold. It wasn't much, but we were able to piece together a modest living down in those caves.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_412: Sorry. I'm spoiling the mood, aren't I?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_413: You're an adventurer too, aren't you? Have any tales of daring you can share with us?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_414: Traveling to other worlds, and saving this one from the very embodiment of despair.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_415: Wait, really!? You're not just an adventurer, you're a godsdamned living legend!
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_417: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Sorry for the wait.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_418: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)There was much to apprise the Landsguard of, as you well know.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_419: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)That Sareel Ja was behind the stolen relics and the sightings of Gulool Ja Ja was understandably difficult for them to hear.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_420: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)And yet there are others enticed by the rumors of a strange portal in the woods. I've heard some foolhardy treasure seekers have even gone off looking for it.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_421: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)A dangerous thought, knowing Sareel Ja could show up at any time with more of those echoes.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_422: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Which is why I'm going back to Jeuno to make sure our people stay out of there.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_423: If you're going, then so are we! It beats sitting around waiting.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_BAKOOLJAJA_000_450: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Maybe we should bring Wuk Lamat and that other friend of yours. Krile, was it?
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_ALXAAL_000_451: I'm fairly sure I've had Tavnazian tacos before. They were famous for their heartiness and helped stave off fatigue, perfect for those who often found themselves on the defensive in battle.
TEXT_KINGEA103_05235_PRISHE_000_500: Gods, those tacos were bloody brilliant. There's nothing better than good food and good company to pass the time.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_001: As soon as Bakool Ja Ja gives the word, we'll be off!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_005: I'm fairly sure I've had Tavnazian tacos before. They were famous for their heartiness and helped stave off fatigue. Those who often found themselves on the defensive in battle would do well to eat one before a fight.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_010: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Would that we had time to show you more of Tuliyollal, but we can't afford to have anyone wandering about in Jeuno.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_012: Then let us make haste to Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_013: It's hard to blame anyone for wanting to take a peek inside. I know I certainly would.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_014: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)The sooner we clear this place out the better.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_100: I can only speak for myself, but the idea of running headlong through a mysterious rift to gods-know-where in search of treasure seems absurd.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_101: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Tural has no shortage of legends like the city of gold to inspire would-be treasure seekers. No risk is too great if they believe their dreams can be realized.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_102: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Efforts better spent on a more honest living, I'd say.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_103: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Gehehehe! Walking the noble path like you, Brother?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_104: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)In any case, whoever we find in there, we have to get them out. Quickly.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_105: ...And what if one of those weird shadow things decides to gobble you up!?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_110: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We don't mean to threaten you, but you need to leave at once. This place is more dangerous than it looks.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_115: I realize how preposterous it seems, but none of this is real. A Mamool Ja by the name of Sareel Ja created this place.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236A_000_200: When I jumped through that rift, I was expecting a dungeon, or maybe a labyrinth, not...whatever all this is.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236A_000_201: It's dangerous, and I need to leave? Don't make me laugh.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236A_000_202: Not long ago, I heard someone crowing in the streets about some rare stone they found. Something like that could be worth a fortune! I'm not going anywhere if there's riches just lying around for the taking.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236A_000_: Never seen a city like this in Tural before...
Dangerous, you say? Perhaps I should hold off on surveying further, then.
What a shame. I happened upon a rather curious stone I hoped to take with me, but it was stolen by some Tonawawtan brute.
Without knowing the value of that stone, I can't say it's worth giving chase, but he ran off to the south if you mean to go after them.
I'll be leaving now. If it's truly as dangerous as you say, I hope you'll be leaving soon as well.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236A_000_210: You're not fooling anyone. You just want all the treasure for yourself, but I'm not leaving until I've found it!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236B_000_300: You came looking for some fancy trinkets, too? Well feast your eyes on this!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_301: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We spoke with anyone who would listen, though a few were too stubborn to heed our warnings.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_302: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)A block of raw electrope? But how?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_303: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I take it you're the one that found this? I'm sorry, but we can't let you leave with that stone. It's too dangerous.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236B_000_304: You expect me to just hand it over? Bah! This isn't Tuliyollal─you have no authority here! I found it, and I'm keeping it!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_305: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)This is for your own good. Put the stone down and walk away, or else...
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_306: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Careful, Brother. Lay a hand on him, and the Vow of Resolve will never let us hear the end of it.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_307: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Ugh... We're already in her debt as it is.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_308: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Fine. You've come here to make your fortune, yes? Then let me pay you for it.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236B_000_309: That would certainly save me the trouble of finding a suitable buyer. But don't expect me to let it go for cheap.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: We couldn't help but overhear you're selling an artifact found in these ruins.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236B_000_: Whatever this gentleman's willing to pay, I assure you I can pay more.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_312: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Great. Just what we needed. What do you suppose we do now?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_313: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Explaining the circumstances surrounding this place would likely take more time than we can afford.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_315: Why not hold an auction for the stone?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: An auction? That would certainly simplify matters.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_317: It would save you the trouble of bargaining with all interested parties separately, and incentivizes them to pay you handsomely, lest they be outbid.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236B_000_318: Fine by me. But I'll only be accepting payment in gil. This money'll be taking me overseas, where I can finally live the life I've always wanted.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_320: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Let's hold the auction already and get this over with!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_325: I'm guessing Alxaal was inspired by the nearby auction house. Still, that was quick thinking!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_330: An auction should hopefully make things easier for Bakool Ja Ja. Assuming he can outbid his competition, of course.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: My work has been turning a tidy profit these days, so I've coin to spare.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236B_000_: I'll offer up every last gil to my name if I have to─that stone will be mine!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SYSTEM_000_400: The following event cannot be skipped. You may wish to cancel any pending Duty Finder registrations.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_402: If I may have your opening bids?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_403: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Can you handle the bidding? We don't have much experience with auctions, but we do have coin you can use: around a million gil saved up from our work with the Landsguard. Hopefully that will be enough.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SYSTEM_000_404: Upon speaking with the Tonawawtan thief, the auction will begin. You may also first speak with the other prospective buyers to receive hints regarding their potential bids.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_405: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We've a million gil all told, but I'm trusting you won't need to spend all of it.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_406: Damn. I wish I had money to join in. Seems like fun.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_407: While it's imperative that we recover the electrope, it wouldn't do to show your hand too early. Better to be conservative with your bids, staying just ahead of the competition.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: Foreign merchants relieved me of my stock a few moons past, and it's a good thing they did. One million, five hundred thousand gil, and I was forced to spend half of it in preparation for this expedition.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236B_000_: I've no time for the back and forth of this bargaining nonsense. All I need is one bid to win that stone.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SYSTEM_100_412: The auction has begun. Outbid your competitors for the electrope while conserving your capital.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_412: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Right, then. How much will you start with?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: Is that all? Then I'll start with four hundred thousand gil.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236B_000_: A bold opening bid, but I'm willing to bet that's all you have. Five hundred and sixty thousand gil!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_416: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Four hundred thousand!? I was hoping to keep at least half my savings, but if we have to bid more...
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_Q4_000_000: How much will you bid? (Current Highest Bid: 400,000 gil)
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236B_000_: A bold move, but I'm willing to bet that's all you have. Five hundred and sixty thousand gil!
S-Six hundred thousand!? How is anyone meant to compete with that?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: One out of the running. Good. Then I'll bid seven hundred thousand.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_421: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Half my savings gone. Surely they're close to conceding...right?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_Q5_000_000: How much will you bid? (Current Highest Bid: 560,000 gil)
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236B_000_: S-Six hundred thousand!? How is anyone meant to compete with that?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: One out of the running. Good. Then I'll bid seven hundred thousand.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236B_000_: S-Seven hundred thousand!? How is anyone meant to compete with that?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: Dammit all. I'm not leaving without that stone. Seven hundred and twenty thousand gil!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_427: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Gehehehe! Only one left now, but I don't think he'll give up without a fight.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_Q6_000_000: How much will you bid? (Current Highest Bid: 700,000 gil)
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_A6_000_001: Seven hundred and ten thousand gil.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_EXPLORER05236C_000_: Shit, shit, shit... Well, I've come too far to back down now. S-Seven hundred and twenty thousand gil!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_430: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Raising their bid by such a narrow margin? Someone's reached their limit.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_Q7_000_000: How much will you bid? (Current Highest Bid: 720,000 gil)
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_A7_000_001: Seven hundred and thirty thousand gil.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_432: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Finally, it's over. You have a knack for business dealings, . Maybe you were a merchant in another life.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_433: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Two hundred thousand gil to spare. Not bad, .
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_434: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)My...My savings... Did you really have to spend all of it!?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_435: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)<sigh> I foresee many nights of plain tortillas in our future, Brother...
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_THIEF05236B_000_436: This looks to be all of it. The stone is yours.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_440: As fun as that looked, I'm sure I would've made a mess of things if that were me. I tend to get a little carried away under pressure.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_441: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)That was more expensive than I would've liked, but nothing a few hunt bills can't make up for. I hope...
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_449: Well done, friend. Now let's have a look at that electrope.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_450: Gah! This presence... It feels familiar.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_452: There's no mistaking that deep and bitter malice. This stone must have served as the heart of the Shadow Lord's echo.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_453: He was a being of pure hatred, responsible for bringing about the Crystal War. I was part of the company that would eventually bring his reign of terror to an end.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_454: You helped defeat the Shadow Lord!?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_455: (Meaning Alxaal must have been there with . But I don't remember ever hearing about that.)
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_456: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)In any case, I will hold on to the electrope. We should hurry back and speak with the Landsguard.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_VANAADV05234C_000_4: Excuse me, but were you speaking of the Shadow Lord just now?
If there's more you wish to know, perhaps I can be of help. I've heard a great many tales of the fiend from the bards who frequent the taverns here in Jeuno.
I've been waiting over yonder near the fountain for my companions to arrive, but you're welcome to speak with me until they do.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_460: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)A most welcome offer, though there is much to be said for a firsthand encounter with the echo in question.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_461: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Perhaps we can revisit these tales another time, after we've made certain no more treasure hunters can readily gain entry.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_462: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Let's return to Tuliyollal and speak with the Landsguard. , come and meet us at Brightploom Post.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_470: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I was hoping a few of the Landsguard would be here already. Hmmm...
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_471: The Landsguard all appear to be well trained and well armed. I daresay they would be a match even for our soldiers back home.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_500: Once again, we're left with nothing but time on our hands until Sareel Ja shows himself. I suppose there's no shortage of work to be done if we ask the Landsguard.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_501: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)You may be better served exploring Tural, familiarizing yourself with the land. It wouldn't do to find yourself lost when you're needed most.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_502: An honest-to-gods adventure! What a great idea!
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_503: You're coming with me, Alxaal, and don't you dare say you're not interested. Any self-respecting adventurer would jump at a chance like this.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_504: I'll not deny the suggestion piques my interest.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_505: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We warn you now, though, the wilds of Tural are rife with danger. It is no place for the unprepared.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_507: I can hardly count the number of times Vana'diel's been visited by some world-ending calamity. But no matter how dire things may have seemed, we always found a way through. Together.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_PRISHE_000_508: This'll be no different. I'm sure of it. There's nothing we can't do so long as we have each other.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_ALXAAL_000_509: A band of adventurers barely met, united in the face of great peril. Just like old times...
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_510: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Are adventurers always so sentimental?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_000_511: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Is that so terrible a thing?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_BAKOOLJAJA_100_512: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Ah, here he is. The moment we learn anything about Sareel Ja's movements, I've asked him to contact you.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SYSTEM_000_600: Meanwhile, in the Echo of Tu'Lia...
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_REMNANTGULOOLJAJA_0: (-Shade of Reason-)Gehehehe! Soon, we will slaughter them all. Is that not so, Sareel Ja?
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SAREELJA_000_602: Soon, my Dawnservant, very soon. Then there shall be none to stop you from taking your rightful place on the throne.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SAREELJA_000_603: Hehehe. How fortunate for me he lacks the wisdom of the true Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SAREELJA_000_604: But if he will be made fit to rule, I must choose from the echoes carefully.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SAREELJA_000_605: The Shadow Lord showed promise, but Vana'diel is a land of rich history. I needn't settle for those who are but a blink of an eye in the annals of history.
TEXT_KINGEA104_05236_SAREELJA_000_606: With the strength of the ancients, I will bring Tural─no, the whole world─to its knees.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIENASSISTANT_0: Oh, you must be ! Why, you look exactly as Professor Claudien described. It's a pleasure to finally meet you.
I'm the professor's new assistant, you see. His stories of your foray into Pandæmonium have been an endless well of knowledge and entertainment.
In fact, there is a small matter that has arisen with regard to the facility that he wishes to discuss with you, thus my seeking you out. He asks that you stop by Aporia at your earliest convenience.
Professor Claudien can fill you in on the details better than I, so please visit him at Aporia when you're able.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_050: , you are ever a sight for sore eyes! I trust you've been well since last we spoke?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_100_050: Good, good. Now, as much as I'd like to reminisce, it will serve us both better if I cut to the quick.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_051: I asked you here to discuss a matter concerning Erichthonios, whom I'm sure you remember.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_052: I certainly do, for his memories reside within me still.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_053: Every so often, my mind's eye glimpses the grim spectacle of the Final Days. Though there are also visions of a simpler time...
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_054: In one, I saw a warder under siege by colleagues. They demanded to know why a tiny Erichthonios was running amok in the halls of Pandæmonium.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_055: Upon hearing that the mammet was created out of profound admiration, my past self gave only a rueful smile.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_100_055: "Then Themis would have been a far superior choice of subject. Alas, I suppose you've never seen the man...“
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_NEMJIJI_000_056: An inadvertently revealing deflection, we believe. As Themis's duties as emissary kept him away from Pandæmonium, Erichthonios doubtless grew to miss his dear friend.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_NEMJIJI_000_057: And we know what Themis looked like. So we thought: why not make a mammet here and send it as a gift?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_NEMJIJI_000_058: We employed a local artisan to take care of the first step. The resulting work is masterful indeed!
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_059: Since you're the only one among us who can return to Pandæmonium, might I ask you to deliver this to Erichthonios?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_A1_000_101: You don't think it will distract him from his work?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_A1_000_102: You don't think he'd want a doll that looks like me, too?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_060: Thank you, . I suspect that he will be overjoyed.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_100_060: As I've recalled more of his memories, I've noticed that Erichthonios seldom expressed his own desires.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_065: I understand the threat of distraction more than most, but there is more to life than work, is there not? And as I've recalled more of Erichthonios's memories, I've noticed that he seldom expressed his own desires.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_070: The discretionary portion of our funding only extends so far, alas, though he very well might. As I've recalled more of his memories, I've noticed that he seldom expressed his own desires.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_071: Perhaps it was an unspoken rule in the society of the ancients. Nonetheless, I would very much like to do something for him. A small kindness is the least we owe him.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_072: I imagine you can still reach Pandæmonium from the neus in Elpis. Once there, the keywards will surely assist you in tracking him down.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_100: Are you returned to us so soon, ? Naught is amiss, I hope...
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_101: And this gift is for Erichthonios, you say? A man much in demand of late...
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_102: People expect great things of him now─greater than he's prepared for, by his estimation. Thus is he at this very moment studying at the Words of Lahabrea.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_103: Under his father's tutelage, he hopes to gain further mastery over the creations here, that he might one day become keyward himself.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_104: Although Master Lahabrea's harsh methods have more than once driven him to the verge of surrender, his determination to prove himself always drags him back from the brink.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_A2_000_202: He'll keep at it, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_A2_000_203: But they have so little time...
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_105: Indeed. And while I'm certain he would enjoy seeing you, I wonder if he would rather the reunion occur after he has come into his own.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_110: You speak as if you've already seen it come to pass. Though he would doubtless find that encouraging, I wonder if he would rather your reunion occur after he has come into his own.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_115: You should have more faith, . I assure you, the pace of Erichthonios's growth leaves naught to be desired...though I do wonder if he'd rather your reunion occur after he's come into his own.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_116: That said, I understand why you wish to be there when he sees your little Themis simulacrum. Would that I could witness his reaction myself...
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CRISPWARDERS00000_0: Keyward Hegemone, we've received word from Erichthonios. He says he'll soon be returning.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_118: His message is well received. Yes... I see in this a tidy solution.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_119: When he arrives, can you tell him to attend me here? Say that there is something I would show him.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_120: I want you to choose a suitably dark place from which to eavesdrop on our conversation. When the moment is right, send the poppet this way.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_121: Thus shall we both be privy to his reaction, even as you remain undetected. While such subterfuge would usually fall outside my duties as keyward, rest assured I am happy to help.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_140: He shouldn't notice you if you hide beyond the threshold yonder. Keep the tiny Themis close at hand─I trust you will choose the right moment to send it out.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_160: ...I see that Master Lahabrea has not softened. You've done well to endure his methods.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: Sometimes I feel he's become even more difficult... Were I not recently made privy to his true nature, I would have abandoned hope within moments.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_162: Such is his way of nurturing your talents, I suppose.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: I know. He still aggravates me, but I have come to see that even our quarrels are a means to know him better─as a father and one of the Fourteen both.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_164: ...Ah, yes. I called you here because I had something to show you.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: Themis!? Why are you so small? ...Ah.
Another poppet, I see. But who managed to render such a striking likeness?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_167: They asked me not to divulge their identity. I can say only that they have your best interests at heart.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_ERICHTHONIOS_000_16: How curious. And to think such a gift would arrive so soon after I met with the man himself!
I happened to run into him at the Words of Lahabrea. It was my first time speaking with him in his capacity as Elidibus, but he was friendly as ever.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_ERICHTHONIOS_000_17: He told me of yet more belegged plants from the Words of Halmarut, which had escaped and taken root in a region designated for Loghrif creations, making proper assessment quite impossible.

Themis was called upon to judge whether to switch testing grounds for convenience or uproot the unwelcome creations. So soon after returning from Pandæmonium, he said he finds such minor squabbles a welcome change.
And of course, we spoke of .
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_173: Naturally. Perhaps we can ask your admirer to make a likeness of  as well?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_ERICHTHONIOS_000_17: As much as I would like that, I don't believe it would suit . Unlike Themis and I,  isn't bound to  own small domain.
I think  rather belongs to the entire star. To keep ─or even an imitation─confined here would feel wrong.
and Themis are both dear friends, and I need no tangible proof to be certain of our bond. Though I admit that it will be nice to have a reminder of at least one of them around.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_178: Now, I believe you have duties to return to. If you wouldn't mind fetching those reports from Peripeteia on the new creations sent from Elpis...
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_ERICHTHONIOS_000_17: Gladly, Keyward Hegemone. And little Themis here will come with me.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_200: That turned out well, wouldn't you say? Erichthonios has a new companion, and you were able to witness his joy at meeting him.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_201: Each and every warder here owes you a great debt. I hope that charming charade helped repay mine in some small way.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_HEGEMONE_000_202: I must attend to my own work, but I wish you all the best. Whether or not we meet again, fare thee well, .
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_220: There you are, ! Judging by the grin on your face, I trust the mammet is safely in Erichthonios's hands?
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_221: I knew we could count on you! May that doll provide him some small reprieve from the stresses of his station.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_222: Speaking of which, I know you had to pull yourself from your own adventures to take care of this little errand, so I don't intend to let you go unrewarded.
TEXT_AKTKRA401_05252_CLAUDIEN_000_223: That's why we commissioned two mammets from the start. I daresay Themis will be delighted to travel a whole new era by your side.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_000: Hey, . You're just the person I wanted to see.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_001: Cruiserweight matches have yet to begin, but Neyuni and I've made some breakthroughs in our research about psychonekrosis. Come inside─we'll tell you what we've learned.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_005: It's good to see you, . As you may have heard, we've managed to dig up a lead regarding psychonekrosis.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_010: Before diving into the details, perhaps a refresher is in order. It's a rather complicated affair, after all...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_010: You had barely been crowned champion of the light-heavyweight division before our sister, Eutrope, challenged you. She was intent on claiming your soul as a means to cure psychonekrosis.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_011: The illness appears to afflict those who use feral souls to an excessive degree─those such as Arcadion fighters.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_012: We learned from Eutrope that the immortalized, who we thought lived in luxury in the upper levels, are actually dead─taken by the disease.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_100_013: Since that revelation, we've looked for alternate ways to cure psychonekrosis, and we finally have some news to share.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_011: It's all thanks to Neyuni. Like Eutrope, she has a sense for electrope technology. She's learned to do all sorts of things from tinkering on her own.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_012: Oh Yaana, don't give  the wrong idea. It's the people of Oblivion that we have to thank for our discoveries. I had attempted to access Everkeep's core systems for information on souls, you see...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_013: Unsurprisingly, I failed. What's more, an Oblivion member who was monitoring unauthorized access found me.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_200_013: She took me to task, scolding me to never again do something so reckless.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_014: When I explained our predicament, however, she kindly shared research data Oblivion had acquired from Origenics. The data was quite difficult to parse, but I managed to find some relevant information.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_015: Namely, that the military was well aware of psychonekrosis, having also sought to utilize feral souls. Furthermore, they had developed a method to identify the presence of the affliction.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_016: This brings us to our next move. Now that we're privy to this method, we feel that we should use it to diagnose other fighters. They deserve to know if they're ill.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_A2_000_001: Indeed. It isn't right to leave them ignorant.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_A2_000_002: It would be risky to alert them.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_017: I'm glad you agree. I can't sit idly by knowing that they might die.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_018: Yes, very. That's why we came to you before taking action.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_019: As Metem warned us, the president doesn't take kindly to those who get in his way. He'd be extremely unimpressed if we revealed the secret to those you've yet to fight, and caused their withdrawal.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_020: Of course, you're still liable to incur the president's ire by becoming grand champion and releasing all the souls in the repository. But we should avoid getting in his crosshairs for as long as we can.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_021: That's why I propose we approach only those fighters you've already bested. As they're barred from fighting for a time, it wouldn't have an immediate impact on the championship.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_021: There are still risks, however. Every time our fellow fighters use a feral soul, they bring themselves closer to psychonekrosis─including in a match against you.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_022: Which is why it's important we tell them the truth as soon as possible. So we can stop that from happening for good.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_022: Knowing what the illness has done to Eutrope...it feels nothing less than personal.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_023: To begin with, let's reveal the truth to Honey. Despite being rivals, we're actually quite close. Just a moment while I call her...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_023: She's busy as I expected, but can spare a moment for us. She's on her way here now.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_200_023: Honey manages to balance two careers at once. I can't help but admire her.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_200_024: I was frightened at first when Oblivion found me, but when I actually met its members, they all turned out to be quite nice.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_HONEYBLOVELY_100_02: So, what's this about, then? I hope it's as urgent as you say it is.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_HONEYBLOVELY_000_02: My stars... You're serious, aren't you? C-Could I be afflicted as well...?
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_025: There's a way to diagnose you. Regulators are designed to monitor the state of the wearer's soul. If we connect yours to a terminal, we can confirm whether there are signs of the disease.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_026: Please be at ease, Miss Honey. Your soul shows no signs of degradation.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_HONEYBLOVELY_000_02: Truly? Oh, what a relief! I shudder to imagine how I might be affected by such a dreadful disease...
You're fine too, I suppose? You joined the Arcadion well after I did, after all.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_029: W-Well, I haven't gotten any symptoms yet...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_030: Yaana was so eager to prove herself, she utilized feral souls numerous times when training. So when I examined her, we found that she's on the threshold of developing the disease.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_HONEYBLOVELY_000_03: For mercy's sake, Yaana! We're forbidden from training with feral souls! ...And knowing what I know now, I'd say it's because the president doesn't want us to die too early. It'd be bad for entertainment.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_032: At any rate, neither of us should use feral souls again. Which means we can't fight in the Arcadion anymore...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_034: R-Really!? I wasn't expecting you to decide so quickly...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_HONEYBLOVELY_000_03: While I've graced countless magazine covers and concert stages, I never shined so brightly as when I fought in the ring, it's true.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_HONEYBLOVELY_100_03: But everything I've done was so that I could bask in the adoration of the people. I couldn't do that if I were dead, now could I?
So I'll look for another avenue to apply my talents, and you can be sure that I'll succeed. After all...
I'm Honey B. Lovely, the brightest star in the sky!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_HONEYBLOVELY_000_03: Now then, I'm scheduled to appear on a broadcast, so I must be on my way. Thanks for the warning, my dears. You're lifesavers!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_038: She really is something else, Honey...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_037: Right, that leaves one other fighter I'd like to inform: the Brute Bomber, who you defeated to become light-heavyweight champion.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_038: We're not exactly friends, but I won't abandon him either. He's not likely to answer when called, though, so we'll need to visit him at his home, in residential radius 9-11.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_050: I always carry a personal terminal with me, so we can check for the illness when we arrive at the apartment.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_060: Here we are. Let's hope he's willing to hear us out...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_BRUTEBOMBER_000_100: You're all so cute, I could eat you up!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: (-Gentle Man-)Hmph, why do they flock only to you? It's hardly fair.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_BRUTEBOMBER_000_102: Well, these are my kittens. If you don't like it, you can go back to your woman.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: (-Gentle Man-)...Rub salt in the wound, will you? You know full well she left me.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: (-Gentle Man-)Come on, little ones. Come to me.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_104: Er...that man there is Eutrope's─ I mean, that's the champion of the cruiserweight division.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_104: This poses a problem. We can't reveal the truth with him here...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_BRUTEBOMBER_000_105: The blazes are you doing here!? You want to get your arses kicked!?
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: (-Gentle Man-)You are , the unenhanced warrior, yes?
The Howling Blade, at your service. It's a pleasure to meet you, and I hope we have the chance to meet in the ring soon.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_A1_000_002: You'll be the “Whimpering Blade” when I'm finished with you!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: You're rather more spirited than I expected. I didn't have the impression that you were also a “heel.”
Lest you wonder, I do not make a habit of wearing a regulator. My parents didn't believe in using them.
Yaana and her sisters were raised with similar values, as I recall, before adapting at Eutrope's insistence.
However, I still use a regulator in battle like every fighter─except you.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_112: I...er, didn't know the two of you were friends.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: Surprised that a reviled heel like him and a beloved face like me get along? Truth is, we've known each other since childhood. We just can't seem to be rid of each other.

We both couldn't fit into any of the jobs that were introduced to us, and got up to all manner of mischief together. We would've likely carried on like that if the president of Ascension Arcadia hadn't come and taken us in.

Though it isn't easy being a fighter, we felt like it was our calling. Believe it or not, he used to be so shy that he could hardly form a sentence. But when he became the Brute Bomber, it was as if he was reborn.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_BRUTEBOMBER_000_116: Sh-Shut up! They don't need to know that!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: Thinking back, we owe everything to the Arcadion. To the president.
Well, I've seen the kittens as I had intended, so I'll take my leave now.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_122: There's something you need to know...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_124: I have the results of the examination... I'm afraid his soul already shows signs of psychonekrosis.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_127: As the soul is eaten away, it loses its connection to the body, leading to bouts of intense dizziness─the early symptoms of the disease. If left unchecked, the body will continue to weaken until...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_128: The Arcadion means a lot to you, I know. It means a lot to me too.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_128: But you need to retire. You're already ill. Until we can find a cure, the only way to prevent your condition from worsening is to stop fighting.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_BRUTEBOMBER_000_129: Enough! I won't listen to any more of your nonsense! Get out of my sight!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_130: We've done what we could. It's up to him what he does now. Let's go home.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_140: It was difficult to tell Mister Brute his diagnosis...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_151: Not only Eutrope, but the Brute Bomber too... We need to find a cure as soon as we can.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_152: According to Eutrope, the remedy is an infusion of an extremely dense soul. That's why she targeted you.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_153: The data from Origenics seems to support this. Though it was only a hypothesis, the researchers believed reinforcement from a dense soul could be an effective treatment. But this isn't the solution we seek.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_154: We'll find another way! I'll scour an ocean of data if I have to!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_155: For all her searching, Eutrope could only find the one cure...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_156: Still, something about her actions doesn't sit right with me. The Eutrope I know wouldn't think to save herself at the cost of someone else's life. I can't help but feel she's still hiding something...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_158: That was Metem. Cruiserweight matches are ready to begin, and he wants us to meet him in the greenroom.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_159: Then best of luck with your next match,  , and please be safe!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_NEYUNI_000_160: Please leave the search for a cure to me, and focus only on the coming match!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_ARCADIAATTENDANT_00: We've been awaiting your arrival, . Allow me to show you to the greenroom.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_DANCINGGREEN_000_30: (-Boisterous Binger-)Ah, here  is at last! Now the party can truly begin!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SUGARRIOT_000_301: (-Defiant Damsel-)That's better. This drab room was begging for a touch of color.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_SUGARRIOT_000_302: (-Defiant Damsel-)Love your work, by the way. A match with you is sure to be a font of inspiration.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_DANCINGGREEN_000_30: (-Boisterous Binger-)We're going to get down, you and I! Oh, yes we are!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_METEM_000_304: As you'll have surmised, they are your rivals in the cruiserweight division. And I understand you're already acquainted with the champion...
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_METEM_000_305: Given the situation in the realm, you may have doubts about fighting for entertainment. But it's now most of all that the citizens are in need of a diversion to help them forget their cares.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_METEM_000_306: I am counting on you to captivate the audience once more with rousing combat, and make the very walls of the Arcadion shake with excitement!
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_000_310: The fighters in this division are characters too, eh? But there's far more to them than their showmanship.
TEXT_KINGRA201_05289_YAANA_100_310: As you already know, cruiserweight fighters utilize more potent feral souls. Their attacks pack a heavier punch, so you'll need to brace yourself and be fully prepared!
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_000: Ready, are you? Good. Let the unstoppable upstart's cruiserweight campaign begin!
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_100: Right, let's take a look at your first opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_102: He's a shameless playboy who loves partying the night away in pubs and clubs. Even his Arcadion bouts he treats as parties where he's the center of attention.
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_103: Using the soul of a terrible toad, he gains heightened physical prowess, and seamlessly incorporates dance moves into combat. Victory will come down to how well you ride the rhythm.
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_104: Your best bet might be to treat the fight as a party as well. Let yourself go with the flow─you just might be surprised by what follows.
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_105: Now then, go and show that party animal you've got moves of your own, and seize your first victory in the cruiserweight division!
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_110: I should mention that the ring will be a dazzling dance floor, and the crowd is certain to be electric. So soak up the atmosphere, , and be the star of the show!
TEXT_KINGRA202_05290_YAANA_000_120: Well fought, ! With this victory, you've proven yourself a force to be reckoned with in the cruiserweight division!
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_000: Right then, let's ride the wave of this momentum towards our next victory!
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_100: And here is your next opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_101: A fighter who lives and breathes art, she uses the ring as her gallery─Sugar Riot!
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_102: Before coming to the Arcadion, she was a graffiti artist, you see. Most of the graffiti you see in Solution Nine was either by her, or by those imitating her style.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_103: By injecting herself with the soul of a deadly pudding, she's able to concoct special paint that can cause actual change to reality─even the ring itself.

TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_105: If you can manage that, you'll surely overcome Sugar Riot, and continue on your way to the top of the cruiserweight division!
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_110: I neglected to mention that the audience will be watching the match remotely. Sugar personally designed their avatars, so try and steal a glance when you can.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_120: Well done, ! I knew you could do it!
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_121: Your next match will be against the cruiserweight champion himself. But seeing as we have a bit of time, there's something I'd like to tend to first.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_122: I want to tell Dancing Green and Sugar Riot about psychonekrosis, and see if they've developed any symptoms. We have to save them too if we can.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_123: I've borrowed Neyuni's terminal, so we'll perform the examination here in this room. Rest assured I've already checked for listening devices.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_124: The two should be here any moment now...
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_DANCINGGREEN_100_12: So, what's this about, baby? Are we havin' a party here?
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SUGARRIOT_100_125: If that's the case, I'll excuse myself. I'm rather keen to give form to the inspiration you've given me!
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_125: While I'm relieved to say you haven't manifested the disease yet, you're both dangerously close to doing so. Just one more feral soul injection could push you beyond the brink. It would be wise to stop fighting in the Arcadion.

TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SUGARRIOT_000_127: This is all very sudden, and I struggle to accept it. But for both you and Honey to retire...there must be truth to your words.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_128: It's no easy thing to retire, I know. But for your own safety, I ask that you give it careful consideration.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_DANCINGGREEN_000_12: I've made up my mind. I'll retire. This doesn't leave the room...but I've always struggled to play the part of Dancing Green.

I pushed through it all because I didn't want to disappoint the fans, but this revelation sets me free. Dancing used to be my passion─perhaps I can learn to love it again.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_132: I always thought you were a genuine party animal, living only to revel. To think that it was actually a burden on your shoulders...

TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SUGARRIOT_000_134: But it was on the streets that I started plying my craft, and this revelation might be a sign telling me to go back to my roots.

TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_SUGARRIOT_000_137: Well, we'd rather not die, of course. And it's you we have to thank for warning us.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_DANCINGGREEN_100_13: We're liable to attract suspicion if we stay here too long. We'll discuss when to break the news to management at a later time.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_200_137: Thankfully, those two have other places to employ their talents, like Honey.
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_000_138: To the Brute Bomber and the Howling Blade, however, the Arcadion is everything...
TEXT_KINGRA203_05291_YAANA_100_138: It isn't easy for them to retire─this, I know better than most. But it's a matter of life and death...
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_YAANA_000_000: ...In any case, our priority for now is to win the title match. Let's return to the gym and prepare.

TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_NEYUNI_000_111: This is likely because it greatly accelerates the soul's degradation, leading to psychonekrosis...

TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_YAANA_000_113: I'm sorry, but we couldn't simply leave him to his fate...

TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_METEM_000_122: So prepare as best you can, and then meet me at the Arcadion. I will have a chauffeur take us to the venue.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_YAANA_000_123: I'm coming too. I'm the one who caused all this by revealing the disease to the Brute Bomber. The least I can do is be there.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_YAANA_000_130: Let's waste no time, ! The broadcast may have been staged, but the Brute Bomber's desire for revenge is most definitely real. There's no telling what foolishness he might commit while we keep him waiting.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_METEM_000_131: If you are ready to depart, then pray let the chauffeur know as much.
TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_ARCADIADRIVER_000_1: , I've awaited your arrival. It will be my pleasure to escort you via air-wheeler to the location of your match, the eighth level demolition site.

TEXT_KINGRA204_05292_ARCADIADRIVER_100_1: Ah,  . If it please you, I shall escort you to the location of your match.

But worry not. I will join you soon...

Your sister and I began experiencing bouts of dizziness at the same time, not long before she disappeared without a word. I realize now that she must've been searching for a way to fight her fate.

TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_120: You did it! You really did it! You're amazing, you know that?
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: You were simply too strong for me...
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: I gave my word, and I intend to keep it. I will retire from fighting.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: With this, I've escaped imminent death. But I've also lost my purpose in life.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: Tell me, what am I to do with myself now? I truly do not know...
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_A1_000_001: There are battles you can still fight. Help us oppose the president.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_A1_000_002: Let's avenge the Brute Bomber together!
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: The president has sacrificed the lives of countless fighters for the sake of entertainment, and as good as killed my friend. He should be stopped, I know.
The president has sacrificed the lives of countless fighters for the sake of entertainment, and as good as killed my friend. I ought to despise him, I know.
But as I said before, we owe everything to him. That's why we continued to fight willingly even if it meant dying from our illness.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_126: You fool! You can't tell me that the Brute Bomber went willingly to his death, and there are people who care for you even if you don't seem to care for yourself! All this time, Eutrope's been fighting alone to try and save you!
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: She vanished without a word soon after we developed symptoms of psychonekrosis...
I searched and I searched, but could find no trace of her. I was more shocked than anyone when she suddenly showed up and challenged .
Seeing how strong she still was, I assumed that her symptoms had abated, and she decided to resume fighting...
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_128: <sigh> Let me make it crystal clear. You've been using your debt to the president as an excuse not to face the bitter truth. And in doing so, you've lost sight of those dearest to you.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_100_128: It was in order to save you that Eutrope went after  for  soul.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_100_129: She thought it was the only way she could be with you, who could see no life outside the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: You're right about everything. The choices I've made have been out of fear that I would no longer be the Howling Blade.
That's why I did nothing to stop my friend, even though I knew he was going to his death...
Forgive me, Hector... I should've tried to save you, like they did...
Thank you for bringing me to my senses. The president has done enough harm. I will help you to stop him.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_134: It's heartening to count the Howling Blade himself as our ally!
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: (-Retsarra-)The Howling Blade is no more. From now on, it's simply Retsarra.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_100_135: Let's continue talking at my gym. Eutrope and Neyuni are there, and they'd be happy to see you.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: (-Retsarra-)Understood. There's one matter I need to tend to, so I'll meet you there shortly.
Pets are forbidden where I live, so I was hoping that you could look after these little ones...
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_201: We'd be glad to. Neyuni has been wanting to adopt a cat for a while now.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_202: She must be upstairs with Eutrope. I'll go and see how they are.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_204: Of course. You and Eutrope have a lot of catching up to do, I expect.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_205: We have a situation! Neyuni and Eutrope are gone!
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_206: Neyuni wouldn't take Eutrope outside in her current state, and her terminal was left on the bed! Something's happened to them!
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_ARCADIAOWNER_000_20: (-Familiar Voice-), the unenhanced warrior. For your contributions to the excitement provided by Ascension Arcadia, you have my utmost esteem.
(-Ascension Arcadia President-)However, I cannot suffer anyone to rewrite my script.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_ARCADIAOWNER_000_21: (-Ascension Arcadia President-)And so, as a safeguard against further deviations, I have taken Eutrope and Neyuni into my care.
(-Ascension Arcadia President-)After some coaxing, Metem divulged to me that you wish to cure psychonekrosis.
(-Ascension Arcadia President-)And it just so happens I know where you can find the stimulant you seek. “The Drop of Life,” it is called.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: What do you want from us?
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_ARCADIAOWNER_000_21: (-Ascension Arcadia President-)Two simple things:  must continue fighting at the Arcadion, and you must never again meddle with my script. Nothing needs to change otherwise.
(-Ascension Arcadia President-)If you become grand champion, , our soul repository will be at your disposal, and I will even disclose the location of the Drop of Life.
(-Ascension Arcadia President-)That is all. I look forward to seeing your exploits at the pinnacle of the Ascension Arcadia Championship, the heavyweight division.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: So the president was a step ahead of us... One wrong move, and Eutrope and Neyuni will come to harm.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_218: It seems we have no choice but to place our hopes in ...
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_219: Thank you. As your second, I'll continue doing my best to support you.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_220: I'm sorry to make you bear such a heavy burden. As your second, I'll do my best to bear it with you.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: As will I. I won't turn a blind eye to the president's depraved actions any longer.
Never again will I let anyone be taken away from me...
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_100_241: ...Sorry, I'll be fine. As long as we do what the president says, no harm should come to my sisters.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_240: Now, ahead of your campaign to become grand champion, I want you to prepare as best you can in your own way.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_241: Whether you train to hone your skills or rest to recover your strength, see to it you're ready for your next fight.
TEXT_KINGRA206_05294_YAANA_000_242: I'm truly sorry to place so much on your shoulders, but you're the only one we can depend on. Please come and find me here when it's time for heavyweight matches to begin!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_LANDSGUARD05326_000: Ah, . Your timing couldn't be better.
I've just received word from Yak T'el─unknown beasts have been sighted near the rift and attacked the sentries standing guard.
Bakool Ja Ja believes them to be echoes, and is headed there as we speak.
It goes without saying the threat more of them could pose to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_A2_000_002: I should be only too happy to help.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_LANDSGUARD05326_000: Our last contact came from Toraal Ja in Mamook. I suggest speaking with him first to learn more of Bakool Ja Ja's whereabouts.
You should hurry to Mamook. I've no doubt Toraal Ja will be able to help you find Bakool Ja Ja.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_TORAALJA_000_100: Ah, you must be . Bakool Ja Ja asked that I take you to him as soon as you arrived. When last we spoke, he was hunting for the echo somewhere to the north of Gok Draak Descent.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_TORAALJA_000_101: Climb aboard and we can be on our way.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SYSTEM_000_102: You can now travel directly to Gok Draak Descent, near the entrance to Jeuno, by speaking with Toraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_150: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)There you are. I'm afraid you've missed all the excitement.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_151: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)They raised arms to attack before we even had time to say hello.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_152: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)To be fair, we also put them down before they had time to say good-bye, hahaha!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_153: ! Bakool Ja Ja! We came as fast as we could.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_155: Like the ones that attacked my home. To say they're violent'd be an understatement, and they usually move in large packs. Tavnazia always had a hard time holding them off.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_156: Is there any chance these brutes are native to your lands?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_157: It seems we have our answer.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_159: It's a letter. Penned in your people's hand, I think. Would you take a look?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJALETTER_000_:
(-Sareel Ja-)To the Dawnservant's champion,
The stage has been set for your next challenge. Thus do I hereby invite you to return to Jeuno.
(-Sareel Ja-)Should you refuse, a horde of echoes will be unleashed upon Yak T'el. The choice is yours...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_162: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)So this is his long-awaited invitation? I know a snake when I see one, and this one is rotten to the core.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_163: What choice do we have but to accept?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_164: That bastard... Let's get going. The sooner we're back in Jeuno, the sooner he can get reacquainted with my fists.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_170: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Why am I not surprised? He makes a big show of threatening us to return, then has the nerve to make us wait.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_175: Conjuring the Shadow Lord was bad enough. What could he be plotting this time? And what part am I meant to play in all this?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_180: The Orcs we saw earlier share a long, bitter history with the people of my home, San d'Oria.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_181: When I first took up the adventuring profession, one of my first tasks was to rout a band of Orcs that had set up an encampment in the nearby woods of Ronfaure. Though my memory is a little hazy...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_200: Hehehe... How good of you to come.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_201: It would have been a shame were I forced to set more echoes upon the good people of Tural. The Dawnservant would have been most displeased to see his dear people come to harm.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_202: Enough of these games, Sareel Ja.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_203: We will not let you besmirch the memories of Vana'diel with these abhorrent echoes any longer!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_204: ...Why are you here, exactly? I don't recall requesting your presence here today.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_205: Hmph. A minor setback on my path to greatness, as you all will soon see. Come forth!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_206: Allow me to introduce you to Kam'lanaut, Archduke of the Grand Duchy of Jeuno. But do not let his title deceive you, for he is─
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_207: The last of the Zilart, from ten thousand years ago.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_100_207: They existed in a time before the five races inhabited Vana'diel...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_208: I know how ridiculous that must sound, but we might have a real problem on our hands this time.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_A1_000_001: Sounds a lot like the ancients of this world.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_A1_000_002: Oh gods, he sounds like an Ascian...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_210: You had ancients like the Zilart here, too? Our worlds are more alike than I thought.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_211: If I remember correctly, Kam'lanaut had an older brother. I can't imagine Sareel Ja would have overlooked such a detail.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_KAMLANAUT_000_212: Older brother? How would you know anything about that?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_213: Come now, Kam'lanaut. You needn't trouble yourself with the ramblings of a dead man.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_KAMLANAUT_000_214: I see. You would use these adventurers to take my measure.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_KAMLANAUT_000_215: Well, they're certainly a far cry from the riffraff I'd imagined.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_KAMLANAUT_100_215: Fine—I'll play along with your little scheme. For now.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_216: And with that, the curtain rises on your second challenge.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_218: Before you go, I have to know. Am I...am I really just an echo?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_219: We've been over this, child. But it seems your heart refuses to accept what your head knows to be true. I pity you, I do.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_220: Here, let me ease your burden. And return you to electrope.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_223: Playing hero to this heap of stone masquerading as a child. My, how the mighty have fallen.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_224: With him out of the way, that's one less distraction for you in the coming contest. So come, bring your all to bear, that I may create the perfect vessel─the perfect ruler!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_KAMLANAUT_000_225: I shall await you in a more fitting place for our battle. I do hope you won't keep me waiting.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_226: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Are you all right?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_227: Gods, this is all my fault...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_228: As much as I'd love to hand Sareel Ja a fat knuckle sandwich, I can't just leave you here like this.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_229: I never dared imagine we would be made to trade blows with the Archduke.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_230: And though I'm loath to do anything that might play into his hands, we can ill afford to let him have his way with the memories of Vana'diel. When you're duly prepared, but say the word and we'll be off.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_300: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Twice now he's bested me. He may only be a shade, but he's not to be underestimated.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_305: You let me worry about Bakool Ja Ja. Now get in there and show Kam'lanaut what you're made of!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_310: There's no telling what other echoes we'll find inside. Best stay on your guard, my friend.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_400: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Prishe was worried sick about you. I'm sure she's glad to see you're back, and with barely a scratch on you. But where is Alxaal? Did something happen?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_400: , you're back! And still in one piece.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_402: You had to fight Omega and Ultima too!? Wow, Sareel Ja wasn't holding back this time.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_403: But you made it out fine, and I'm sure Alxaal did too.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_405: Oh dear, it seems your merry little band is a member short. Could it be their life was cut tragically short on the field of battle?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_406: Though I suppose “life” would be something of an exaggeration, wouldn't it?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_407: Ah, but I digress. I came here to congratulate you on your impressive trouncing of the echoes.
