TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_408: Indeed, your struggles have afforded me vital knowledge—knowledge I will put to good use in my next selection.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_409: Spare us the bravado. Anyone with eyes can see you're really upset about losing.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_410: Why would I have cause to be upset when everything is going to plan? The stronger  proves to be, the more powerful our ruler will be when all is said and done.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_411: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)But why? Why go to such lengths?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_412: Because we deserve better than that mockery of a contest could muster, and the world will soon see that I am fit to govern alongside a true ruler.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_413: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Usurp the throne and the world will only see you as a would-be tyrant and traitor. Please, Sareel Ja, it's not too late to stop this.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_414: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Despite what you may think, the Dawnservants have served the people well. And I have no doubt they would forgive you your transgressions just as they forgave me.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_415: What happened to you, Bakool Ja Ja? What happened to the proud warrior who vied for the throne, understanding that only we Mamool Ja are fit to rule?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_416: Whatever bonds you believe you've forged with Wuk Lamat are merely an illusion born of convenience.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_417: You think your loyalty sets you along a noble path, but you're nothing more than her lapdog. A means for her to harness the might of the blessed siblings. And when she falls, you'll find yourself a mongrel on the streets─as you've always been!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_418: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)You're wrong, Sareel Ja! You're wrong!
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_420: Easy, Bakool Ja Ja. You'll reopen your wounds.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_421: Hahaha. Serves you right for trying to protect that thing. Considering the damage her core incurred battling our champion, she hasn't long left anyway.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_422: But she's not the only one in a precarious position, is she? Or have you forgotten the contents of my letter?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_423: It would be all too easy to unleash an army of echoes upon the good people of Yak T'el. If you value their safety, then my selections must continue.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_424: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)You disgust me, Sareel Ja... And that's saying something.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SAREELJA_000_425: If there's nothing else, I have much to prepare—and more still to consider—before making my next selection. Until the next time...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_426: My apologies for the delay. Fighting off the echoes took longer than I had anticipated.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_427: Clearly you had no trouble fighting your way out, so why the long faces? Did something happen?
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_500: How long do I have, before I...I...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_BAKOOLJAJA_000_505: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)That rotten snake...
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_600: If what he says is true─and the two of us are indeed echoes─then any significant injury could quite literally wipe us from existence.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_ALXAAL_000_601: Be that as it may, even if I am not real, the love I bear for Vana'diel and her memories is. That's why I'll keep fighting.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_PRISHE_000_602: Me too. Worrying about it isn't going to get us anywhere.
TEXT_KINGEA201_05326_SYSTEM_000_604: The memories sleeping in Jeuno stir. Perhaps the Hume adventurer has new knowledge to share with you.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_001: To defeat not only Kam'lanaut, but also his brother Eald'narche, is nothing short of miraculous. I daresay there are few adventurers of your caliber in Vana'diel.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_005: I'm tired of just standing around. There has to be something we can do!
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_010: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Until Sareel Ja makes himself known again, all we can do is wait. <sigh> Feels like we're playing right into his hands.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_011: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)But enough of my rantings. You must be tired after all he's put you through. Why don't we return to Tuliyollal for now? I'll meet you all at Brightploom Post.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_015: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'm much better now, thanks to Prishe and my brother's healing magicks. Rest assured, you won't find me underfoot next time.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_020: We've spent so much time here, one might say this has become our base of operations.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_100: After those Orcs and everything else Sareel Ja threw at us, it's nice to finally get a chance to breathe, ain't it?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_101: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Speaking of which, what were the two of you up to the first time we were afforded a reprieve from his scheming?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_102: Doing as any good adventurer would─exploring. More specifically, in Yok Tural.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_103: We happened upon a most fascinating settlement of giants on our travels. The Yok Huy, I believe they called themselves. They bear a striking resemblance to the Trolls of our world.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_104: Only in appearance, mind. Trolls are a hostile sort—given to looting and plundering, and known to serve as sellswords.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_105: That wasn't all we saw, though─we traveled all over. I was hoping we'd find someone who might've seen Sareel Ja, or at the very least knew something about electrope.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_106: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'd be surprised if you did. Electrope isn't native to Tural. It comes from the Kingdom of Alexandria, inside the dome in Xak Tural.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_107: The dome! They said we needed some sort of permit to cross the bridge leading north.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_108: If that's where electrope comes from, do you reckon there's anyone there who could help figure out if we're really echoes?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_109: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Oblivion may be able to shed some light on things. As they've been working rather closely with the Landsguard of late, I see no reason why a request couldn't be made through the Wing of Reflection.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_110: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Meaning we should go and pay them a visit, yes? Just as well, if we're going to get these two travel passes. I'm sure the guard will expedite the process if we mention they're to accompany .
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_111: Wouldn't such a permit normally require some manner of rare goods in exchange? Or perhaps an exorbitant sum of gil?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_112: Ah, right. I've heard stories about adventurers struggling to get a pass for the airships in Vana'diel. I'd sooner walk if I had to pay those prices.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_113: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Sorry for the wait. The Landsguard had no trouble readying passes for the both of you.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_100_113: So soon? Gods, the depth of his coffers must be staggering...
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_114: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)As for Oblivion, they're keen to learn more about you. In fact, they've asked to meet on the outskirts of Alexandria. It's a rather long way from here to the dome, though...
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_115: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We should stop in Sheshenewezi Springs─catch our breath and shore up supplies. I'll show them the way there.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_000_200: (-Anxious Eldite-)Excuse me, . I'm looking for my daughter. Have you seen a little Eldite girl anywhere?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_000_201: (-Anxious Eldite-)I see... <sigh> Gods, where could she have run off to?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_202: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Say, you're from the dome, aren't you? What's got you so worked up and in a hurry?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_000_203: Yes, I am. My name is Jasper. A-And it's my daughter─she's gone missing!
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_204: Try to stay calm, all right? Maybe we can help. What does she look like?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_000_205: Right... Her name is Scoria. She's an Eldite like me, with long red hair.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_000_206: We were planning to move from Solution Nine to Tuliyollal, and so we came to visit first. Learn about our home-to-be.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_000_207: We were waiting to ride the rroneek, and before I knew it she had wandered off.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_208: I think I may have seen her a little while ago─girls like your daughter don't seem all that common in these parts. Pretty sure she was heading somewhere to the south.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_209: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We'd better hurry and find her, before something in the wilds finds her first.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_210: You leave this to us. She'll be back and safe before you know it.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_211: Sorry to put our plans on hold after dragging you all the way out here.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_212: We should have more than enough time before we're to meet with Oblivion. Besides, what manner of adventurers would we be to ignore a person in need?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_213: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Well, let's be quick about it. I'll go with Jasper and ask around if anyone has seen Scoria. You three check to the south.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_100_213: Oh, thank you, sir. Thank you! Please do be careful out there.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_214: You heard Bakool Ja Ja. Let's get going!
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_215: There was a settlement to the south if memory serves. Perhaps someone there has seen Scoria.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_216: Let's each speak with three or so people, then reconvene to see what we can piece together of her whereabouts.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_JASPER_000_220: If what your young friend said is true, and my daughter really is somewhere to the south, I pray you find her quickly.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_BAKOOLJAJA_000_225: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)The sooner we find her, the sooner we can meet with Oblivion.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_230: I'm looking for a young Elvaa─ Ahem... Eldite girl said to be wandering about nearby. Would you happen to have seen her?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SHELOWEKWI_000_300: I was just up north a little while ago, but I didn't see any Eldite girl wandering about. Poor thing─I hope she's not in any trouble.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_LENYIKKWE_000_301: A young Eldite girl? No, I haven't. It's not often you hear of Eldite looking to move to Tuliyollal. If we can expect more in the future, I'd certainly like to get to know them.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_WORKMAN05327_000_30: Ah, I saw her wandering about outside of town, but only for a moment. No sooner had our eyes met than she'd ran off. I'd love to help, but I have to get back to work.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_SHELOWEKWI_000_305: I'll be sure to keep a lookout in case she comes back. Hopefully she turns up before long.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_LENYIKKWE_000_310: The poor girl must be terrified out there all alone. The sooner she's found, the better.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_400: I think I've learned all I can from the people here. Did you discover anything of note?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_ALXAAL_000_401: I heard much of the same. So we can say with certainty she passed through here not long ago.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_500: There you are. I take it you haven't had any luck finding her either?
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_501: All I found searching around here was monsters. To be honest, it felt like a waste of time, at first.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_502: While I was thumping this one, though, I could've sworn I saw a kid off in the distance.
TEXT_KINGEA202_05327_PRISHE_000_503: I'm betting it was her. If we hurry, we might be able to catch up to her.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_JASPER_000_001: If what your young friend said is true, and my daughter really is somewhere to the south, I pray you find her quickly.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_BAKOOLJAJA_000_005: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)The sooner we find her, the sooner we can meet with Oblivion.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_010: Whoever that was I saw scurrying off can't be far. Let's go─before any monsters find them!
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_102: The name's Prishe. Your father asked us to come and find you. What are you doing out here all by yourself?
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_103: He said we have to move, but I don't want to go. I want to stay in Alexandria, and be a singer...
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_104: I know nothing about the music in Tuliyollal, and they'd never listen to a nobody like me who's not even from Tural.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_105: Thinking about it made me so mad, I just... I needed to be alone to think. So I ran, and I kept running. Then somehow I found myself here.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_106: I'm sorry if I caused you all any trouble...
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_107: No need to be sorry! You're safe, and that's all that matters.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_108: You know, you remind me of a friend of mine.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_109: Ulmia. One day, I found her out near the coast with a beautiful view just like this, crying like it was the end of the world.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_110: She had been trying to join the choir, but turns out she was too nervous to sing in front of people.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_111: But this world is one damn big place. If you spend all your time dwelling on small setbacks, you'll never be able to appreciate the bigger picture.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_112: It'd be a lie to say I know what you're going through, but what I do know is this: giving up on singing would mean the end of the world you've been working toward.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_100_112: I told Ulmia the same thing, and you know what? She kept pursuing her passion for singing, and eventually joined the Tavnazian Cathedral Choir, just like she'd always dreamed.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_113: But...what if they hate my songs? What if they all just laugh at me?
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_114: All sorts of people live here in Tural, you know. And now there are even folks from another world mingling with the locals─it's full to bursting with diversity.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_115: Being different is what'll make your songs special, and I'm sure there are people here who appreciate that. So I say keep singing─share your music with this big, wide world!
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_116: Would it be all right if I start by sharing with you?
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_160: I'm sorry for making you worry...
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_ALXAAL_000_165: Safe and sound without a scratch. I can only imagine the weight lifted off her father's heart.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_170: Scoria was pretty amazing, wasn't she? I listened to Ulmia practice singing heaps, so believe me when I say Scoria will be just fine.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_BAKOOLJAJA_000_175: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)As resourceful as ever, I see. Well done.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_JASPER_000_200: Ah, there you are! It's so good to see you all safe.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_JASPER_000_201: Scoria has told me everything. I don't know how I could ever repay you.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_JASPER_000_202: But after we've finished moving to Tuliyollal, I certainly intend to try. You have my word on that.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_203: I hope to see you again soon. And I'd love to meet your friend Ulmia, as well.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_ALXAAL_000_205: When we do, we'll be certain to tell Ulmia that Prishe has another dear friend who is dying to meet her.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_207: And I promise to keep singing, sharing my music with the world just like you said.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_SCORIA_000_208: So you better come back! I'll have a front row seat waiting for you!
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_JASPER_000_210: We had better be on our way. Thank you again, for everything.
TEXT_KINGEA203_05328_PRISHE_000_211: Till we meet again. I hope...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_010: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Now that Scoria is safe and reunited with her father, I think it's time we make for the dome. We can take the train from Shaaloani Station.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_011: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Prishe...? It's time to go.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_012: Oh, sorry! Right. Let's get going.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_020: I'd heard tell of the dome before, but it's quite the sight, even at this distance.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_100: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What luck! The train's just arrived.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_101: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We need but follow the tracks.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_102: I know I said worrying about if we're real isn't going to get us anywhere, but...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_103: Gods, I feel like such a damn hypocrite.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_104: I can't stop thinking about what Sareel Ja said. I'm not scared, though─I mean, it is a little scary. But more than that, it's uh...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_100_104: Ugh, why does this have to be so complicated!?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_A1_000_001: You really miss home, don't you?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_A1_000_002: You really miss Ulmia, don't you?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_106: That's probably it. Listening to Scoria sing reminded me of Ulmia. And home...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_107: It makes me wonder what everyone is up to. I can think of at least one person who's already in the midst of their next grand adventure.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_108: Even if we're merely echoes, who is to say we cannot return to Vana'diel? I've no doubt Sareel Ja would know a way.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_109: And what place would I have in Vana'diel when the real Prishe is already there?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_110: Just when I think I've put it out of my mind, I think of Kam'lanaut and Eald'narche. Clearly impostors, and proof we're living the same lie.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_111: Then we met Scoria. She's so excited to have us come back and see her sing, and saying we would just felt like more of that lie...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_112: There's no doubt in my mind we'll stop Sareel Ja, but then what? What happens to us?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_113: Would that I had an answer for you, but I don't. No one does. Because the future is what we make of it.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_114: Once this is over, I intend to see all this world has to offer. I may be without memories, but I've not lost my adventurer's heart.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_115: Perhaps I'll even find a new calling along the way. The world is “one damn big place,” after all. I daresay there's something out there for the both of us.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_116: When you're right, you're right. I guess we'll just find our own place to call home.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_117: But first things first─we need to go and meet with Oblivion.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_135: Even if these memories of adventure etched upon our hearts are not our own, we're still here. In this moment. And that makes us real.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_145: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Kikwezana has agreed to speak with us on behalf of Oblivion. Best not keep him waiting.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_200: Ah, you must be the ones Shale told me about. I'm Kikwezana, one of the electrope engineers.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_201: So, what was it you wanted to discuss?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_202: I see... Well, that'd take more than just memories etched into electrope. Mamool Ja magicks are quite impressive, though. They almost seem alive.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_203: I-I mean, of course you're alive. Technically. Maybe...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_204: Let's just forget I said anything, alright?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_205: Don't worry about it. We're not even sure ourselves, to be honest.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_206: The only thing we're certain of is that our bodies are made from electrope. We were hoping you could help figure out what that means for us.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_207: We can't just sit around moping, you know?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_208: I'm not sure how much I can help, but I'd certainly love to try.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_209: We are in your debt, sir.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_210: While you're conducting your tests, would it be all right if we have a look around? There's something about unfamiliar lands that stirs an adventurer's blood and─
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_211: Wait... If we're made of electrope, do we even have blood to stir?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_212: Hah. Even if we don't, that's an absurd question to ask, don't you think?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_213: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Hmph. Well, at least they seem to be in better spirits.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_214: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Perhaps they simply find the truth comforting.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_215: If we might return to the topic at hand, yes─feel free to explore as you like.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_216: Then it's settled. The site of our next adventure will be here in the dome. And then, Xak Tural!
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_PRISHE_000_217: I hope we'll see you around, .
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_218: And worry not─I will keep a close eye on Prishe, and ensure we're not away overlong. We mustn't lose sight of our true goal, after all.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_ALXAAL_000_219: To defeat Sareel Ja, and─gods willing─secure a means of persisting without his magicks.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_A2_000_001: Mark my words─Sareel Ja will be stopped.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_A2_000_002: And I'll stand by the both of you every step of the way.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_KIKWEZANA_000_221: If the two of you will follow me, I need to collect a few samples.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_100_221: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)...Oh no! I forgot!
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_110_221: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I never took them to Xbalyav Ty'e for tacos. There's so much in Tuliyollal they've yet to see. So much they've yet to eat.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_120_221: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I suppose I'll have to bring food here when they're free.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_130_221: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)A fine idea, Brother.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_222: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Perhaps, but it will have to wait. Let's return to Brightploom Post for now.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_225: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I've told the Landsguard what I could of recent events, though I'm sure there's still plenty more you have to share.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_LANDSGUARD05326_000: Bakool Ja Ja told me what happened. Well done defeating Sareel Ja's echoes.
We'll make certain the guard is duly prepared should new threats arise in Yak T'el.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_302: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Waiting for Sareel Ja to show himself is maddening, but it will be worth it to finally put him to the sword.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_303: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)At the first sign of activity in those woods, you can be certain the Landsguard will contact you.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_BAKOOLJAJA_000_304: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Until next time, take care.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_REMNANTGULOOLJAJA_0: (-Shade of Resolve-)How much longer must I wait for this vessel you promised me?
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_000_403: It is no simple matter to fashion a vessel befitting one of your majesty. But soon, very soon, preparations will be complete.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_000_404: How many times have I explained this to that insufferable oaf. I thought him a kindred spirit from across the rift, but his impulsiveness is beginning to test my patience...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_000_405: At least that adventurer, for their part, continues to exceed my expectations. Once I find the echo that proves  match, everything else will fall into place.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_000_406: did well to stand against the ancients, but against the gods? Not a chance.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_000_407: companions will need to be dealt with as well. Prishe will be simple enough, but the other one. Alxaal, was it? I thought he was nothing more than the middling amalgamation of memories. That he continues to survive defies all reason.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_000_408: A man of such resilience in Vana'diel would have to be...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_000_410: If I'm right about this, then... No matter. Thankfully, I'm not without my contingencies.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_100_410: We deserve better. We will have better. Only blessed siblings, possessed of resolve and reason, are fit to rule.
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SAREELJA_110_410: Bakool Ja Ja was little more than a witless brute before, but clearly his companions have stirred something within him. Perhaps he's not without value after all...
TEXT_KINGEA204_05329_SYSTEM_120_410: The memories abiding within Jeuno stir once more. Perhaps the adventurers there have new knowledge to share with you.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_000: Ah, ! I was hoping you'd drop by.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_001: There's something I wanted to share with you before heavyweight matches begin. Come on in.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: The kittens have taken to their new home, in case you're wondering. Still, I can tell they miss Hector, the poor things...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_010: I've asked Honey and the others to come as well. Before they arrive, let's have a quick refresher of the situation.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_011: During your cruiserweight campaign, we managed to convince several fighters to retire from the ring. Not least of all Retsarra, who was already afflicted with psychonekrosis.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_100_011: There was one who couldn't be persuaded, though. The Brute Bomber...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_013: I myself developed symptoms of psychonekrosis after Eutrope ambushed us. I got a little carried away, using a feral soul to stop her.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_014: There was a glimmer of hope when Neyuni discovered the existence of a cure, but it was dashed when the president took her and Eutrope hostage. He wouldn't allow us to deviate from his script.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: But in an unexpected turn, the president himself was aware of the cure─the “Drop of Life.” And he said he'd divulge its location if you could become grand champion.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_016: How did he learn all this? Where does he get his information? I've never met the man, so he's a complete mystery to me. That's why I wanted to gather everyone, in order to form a better picture of who we're dealing with.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_HONEYBLOVELY_000_01: Heeello, my dears! We let ourselves in through the back. You never know who's watching, after all.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_DANCINGGREEN_000_01: Hey, hey! What's the occasion? We havin' a retirement party or something?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_HONEYBLOVELY_000_02: Sorry hon, but I haven't met the president in the flesh either. He only called me a few times to give instructions, and it wasn't him but Metem who came to recruit me at one of my performances.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: While he recruited me and Hector in person, all contact afterwards was via communicator. He'd speak solely about business, never private matters.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_SUGARRIOT_000_023: Same with me, I'm afraid. Dancing Green, on the other hand, is well acquainted with the man.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_DANCINGGREEN_000_02: After a fashion. The geezer has a love for the theatrical. As a performer myself, we quickly hit it off, and often had debates about the best way to engage the audience.
While I believe the key is making folks feel good, he insists that they need to feel a measure of discomfort. And that's the job of a heel.
“'Tis when the loathsome are laid low that the audience knows the highest high─and the fighters burn brightest,” he'd always say.

That sort of poetic justice has appeal, I'll admit. For proof, you need look no further than the frenetic crowds at the Brute Bomber's matches. Whatever else the president may be, he's a damned good showman!
Right, right, the president's personal life... All I know is, he traces his ancestry to Lindblum.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_029: Lindblum!? That's where the stimulant for the regeneration factor was apparently researched!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_DANCINGGREEN_000_03: Well, what do y'know! Unfortunately, I never got the opportunity to hear more about his past. The last time I saw the old man was three years ago.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: Three years ago... That would be around when Metem approached Honey? I wonder if something happened to the president that's kept him from appearing in public. But with the limited knowledge we have, we can only speculate.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_032: <sigh> So even between all of us, we hardly know anything about the president...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_DANCINGGREEN_000_03: Our play remains  becoming grand champion. Only then will the president share the cure's whereabouts.
And if he goes back on his word, we can threaten to reveal the truth about the immortalized to the public.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: If all else fails, then we do have that hand. But if we're to use it, we must first rescue Eutrope and Neyuni.
So as to not endanger them, the plan will need to be discreet and foolproof, and I could use everyone's help. Can I count on you all?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_HONEYBLOVELY_000_03: I'm offended you thought you had to ask! Of course you can count on us. We'll save Yaana's sisters and give that rotten president a piece of our minds!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_DANCINGGREEN_000_03: I got along with the old man well enough, but I had no idea about his shenanigans. Art and entertainment shouldn't come at the cost of those who make it─ain't that right, Sugar?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_038: Thank you all so much! With everyone's cooperation, we'll work to free my sisters while  continues  campaign to become grand champion.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_100_038: It goes without saying, but I'll continue supporting you as your second. Together, we'll carve a path through the heavyweight division!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: It seems we all have our tasks. The rest of us will begin exploring ways to rescue the girls at once.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_100: So, there's about to be an Arcadion broadcast.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_101: It's a regular program intended for fans, so it might not help much with your preparation, but it couldn't hurt to give it a watch.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_110: Fans of the fight and connoisseurs of combat! I bid you welcome to another edition of the Arcadion Hour!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_111: For today's special guest, we have the heavyweight fighter who shall soon face the unenhanced upstart, , in the ring...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_112: The devilishly divine dominatrix, Vamp Fatale!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_113: As indicated by  appellation,  has climbed  way up the ranks without the use of a feral soul.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_114: Should this upstart rise to become grand champion, they would be able to do as they please with the Arcadion's soul repository. And it seems they intend to release all the souls...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_115: This would fundamentally alter the Arcadion, leaving it a championship of unenhanced fighters. What are your thoughts on this?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_VAMPFATALE_000_116: Don't make me laugh. The “upstart” would only bore us to death.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_VAMPFATALE_000_117: Our fans crave spectacular battles that will blow them away, and you simply can't get that without feral souls.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_118: So sayeth the lady. But what do you, the people, actually think? We hit the streets to find out!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_ARCADIONFANA_000_11: Fight without feral souls? What'd even be the point?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_ARCADIONFANA_000_12: This is the Arcadion we're talking about! If I can't watch a muscular woman imbued with a beast's soul squeeze the life out of her enemies like she's making juice, I'm not interested!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_ARCADIONFANB_000_12: The unenhanced warrior? Just a novelty, I reckon, there to drum up excitement for the championship.
It was interesting at first, I'll admit. But the act has gotten old, and everyone's had enough of it. I know I have.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_ARCADIONFANC_000_12: Frankly, I despise the upstart.  forced the Howling Blade to retire with that outrageous wager, for one thing.
We don't need some outsider barging in and running roughshod over our traditions! Leave the Arcadion alone, you hear me? Leave the Arcadion alone!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_VAMPFATALE_000_125: See? No one wants  pathetic excuse for entertainment.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_126: Huh, that's odd... There should've been some interviewees who supported  as well...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_VAMPFATALE_000_128: You're next, darling. You've been a naughty, naughty .
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_VAMPFATALE_100_128: And I'm going to give you the punishment you deserve.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_140: Damn them! They clearly only showed the interviews that serve the president's agenda!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_141: I'm sorry you had to see that, .
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_100_140: But you have plenty of supporters out there, and that's the honest truth.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_EXCITABLEMAN_000_14: Forgive our sudden intrusion! But after the broadcast just now, we simply couldn't sit still...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_EXCITABLEBOY_000_14: You're my hero, ! I'll keep cheering you on, so please don't give up!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_UNENHANCEDWARRIORFA: There are many of us who feel the same. We believe in you, and we wanted you to know that.
I get nervous whenever I watch you fight, but at the same time I'm inspired. Given courage. I don't get that from fighters who use feral souls.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_EXCITABLEMAN_000_14: That's right! And don't forget, souls weren't even used in the Arcadion in the beginning!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_UNENHANCEDWARRIORFA: I bet the other fighters could also put on a thrilling show without enhancing themselves!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_EXCITABLEMAN_000_14: Battles with feral souls are a spectacle, there's no denying that. But by the same token, it feels artificial.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_EXCITABLEMAN_100_14: Your fights, on the other hand, are as real as it gets, and it fires me up like nothing else! So keep your head held high, and keep fighting the good fight in the heavyweight division!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_EXCITABLEBOY_000_14: P-Please let me join your gym! I want to become a fighter just like !
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_150: Well now, we'd be glad to have such an enthusiastic trainee!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_151: I must warn you, though, that the training isn't easy. Why don't you come back with your parents for a tour first?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_152: See? You have quite the following!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_153: Even if there aren't any more feral souls, it doesn't spell the end of the Arcadion. Many people admire and support you, and it's for them as well that you fight.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_154: Once I'm cured, I'd love to come out of retirement and fight unenhanced myself. And I believe the others feel the same.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_155: ...Is that so? Alright, we'll be there!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_156: This is it, ─the heavyweight matches are beginning. Metem's asked us to meet him at the greenroom as usual.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_160: I'm going to give him some choice words about those interviews...
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_170: It's good to see you again, my friends! How have you been?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_171: We've been better. What's the big idea with that broadcast?
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_172: I'm sorry, but it was the president's orders. It was all I could do to drop a hint that there were other opinions.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_173: The mass retirement in the cruiserweight division has left the president feeling threatened. Whatever he may have said before, he's eager to be rid of you.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_174: On that matter, it's no use trying to convince the heavyweight fighters to quit. They've all been informed about their psychonekrosis, and choose to continue fighting of their own volition.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_175: That's because they've been told that, if they can defeat you, they would be able to use your soul to cure their affliction.
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_YAANA_000_176: Grrr, that bastard and his low tricks!
TEXT_KINGRA301_05435_METEM_000_177: Victory is your only way through this, so what anger you have, I suggest you channel into the ring. As you did before, I have no doubt that you will make your mark in the heavyweight division as well!
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_000: Grrr... Just when I think I've seen it all with the president, he comes up with another underhanded move!
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_100_000: <sigh> If what Metem says is true, we've little hope of convincing your opponents to quit...
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_001: There's nothing for it but to stay the course, then. While you fight to become grand champion, we trust in the others to rescue my sisters.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_002: If we can get the Drop of Life's whereabouts from the president in the end, we'll be able to save everyone.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_100: Right then, let's take a look at your first heavyweight opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_101: Vamp Fatale, whom you had the displeasure of seeing in the broadcast earlier.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_102: She's a fiendish fighter who harnesses the soul of the desmodont, a giant bat whose power allows her to suck the life out of her opponents.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_103: Her biggest claim to infamy, though, is the fact that she's a sadist. Inflicting pain brings her pleasure, and her ring is filled with apparatuses for that purpose. Mind your surroundings out there, or you'll become her plaything.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_104: Remember: you have plenty of fans who believe in you. So believe in yourself, and show them the strength of the unenhanced warrior!
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_105: Now, get out there, give Vamp Fatale what for, and claim your first heavyweight victory!
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_110: You might not be aware, but Vamp Fatale and Honey are bitter rivals. They snipe at each other constantly, and when they fought in an open-weight bout, it was ugly.
TEXT_KINGRA302_05436_YAANA_000_120: And there it is─your first heavyweight victory! I never doubted you for a moment, ! And I'm sure you heard them, but the audience was going absolutely wild!
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_000: Now then, there's a bit of time before your next bout. That's because your opponent originally would have been none other than Wicked Thunder─Eutrope.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_001: For reasons we know all too well, they have to call up a replacement, and who that is hasn't been decided yet.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_002: So let's head back to the gym for now. With some luck, Retsarra has made some progress on the rescue.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_020: That's the boy from before... What could be the matter?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_DEEPBLUE_000_101: (-???-)Hey there, kitty cat. We made ourselves at home while you were out.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_102: You're the ones who did this!?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_DEEPBLUE_000_103: (-Smug Lad-)We heard this was the unenhanced kook's haunt, so we decided to drop by to say hello.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_METEM_000_104: What have we here!? It's the dynamic duo who have taken tag team matches by storm─the Xtremes! Could they be 's next opponents!?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_METEM_000_105: The unenhanced warrior is a singles specialist, though, so I expect  will be pitted against only one of them.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_METEM_000_106: Which brother will it be that takes to the ring? The older, cool and collected Deep Blue? Or the younger, fierce and fiery Red Hot?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_DEEPBLUE_000_107: It'll be both of us, naturally. We don't work any other way. Don't worry, though─we'll tag in and out, so it'll be a fair fight.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_A1_000_002: Come at me together if you like. That's the only way you can win.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_109: Oh, please. Everyone knows you'll break the rules and come at  together.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_DEEPBLUE_000_110: C'mon now, we wouldn't stoop to that. Right, bro?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_DEEPBLUE_100_110: Big words, big shot, but we wouldn't break the rules. Right, bro?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_REDHOT_000_111: We wouldn't? But don't we always─
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_REDHOT_000_113: Oh, was that meant to be a secret?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_DEEPBLUE_000_114: Ugh... Not another word out of you.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_DEEPBLUE_000_115: You've had a good ride so far, kook, but it won't go so smooth for you on our surf. You're gonna wipe out, and wipe out hard.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_METEM_000_116: ...And there you have it─your next opponents. Please see to your preparations and come to the greenroom. And...I'm sorry for this awful mess. There was nothing I could do to prevent it.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_117: This isn't a good time for a tour, I'm afraid. Would you mind coming back after I've sorted things out?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_118: Those bastards did a real number...
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: They're safe, thankfully. They sensed the danger and fled upstairs.
I actually arrived earlier and witnessed them in the act. I was furious and wanted to stop them, but I feared it would draw the president's attention. Forgive me...
I have news─we've found a promising lead on Neyuni and Eutrope's whereabouts.
One of Honey's devoted fans is an employee of Ascension Arcadia, and he divulged the details of the security at the company complex.
Thanks to him, we now know that right after your sisters were kidnapped, they curiously doubled the watch in a certain area.
According to Green, it's a plushy reception hall used to entertain important guests. In all likelihood, that's where the girls are being held.
While security is tight, we have a plan to create an opening and mount a rescue. Sugar will use her magicks to cause a commotion, which I'll exploit to sneak inside.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_127: That's quite a daring strategy... But I have faith that you can pull it off!
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_128: We will carry out the mission during your next match. If you do what you do best and put on a good show, the attention you'd draw to the ring would only aid our cause.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: So...you'll be pitted against the Xtremes next.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: It reminds me of my own time fighting as a tag team with Hector, when we were still no-name newcomers.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_130: What!? Why've I never heard about this?
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: Our signature move was the “Ultimate Megaboom Kick.” Hector would encase me in flames and send me flying at our opponents. Not only did it look impressive, it had some kick to it as well─pardon the pun.
Alas, we hardly drew any spectators, so management disbanded our team. We were still trying to find our place back then...
But getting back to the present─like all tag teams, the Xtremes will unleash powerful coordinated attacks. Take care when you face them.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_134: Well, I suppose we'd better head to the greenroom. The mess can wait for now...
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_200: Right, let's take a closer look at your opponents.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_201: Red Hot and Deep Blue, who form the popular tag team, the Xtremes.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_202: They're originally professional surfers who rose to fame with their feats at Solution Nine's artificial wave pool.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_203: The brothers harness the souls of storm divers─great lizards capable of manipulating the elements─to perform dangerous techniques. As you can probably guess, Deep Blue commands water, while Red Hot wields flames.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_204: I say “brothers,” but they're obviously not related by blood. It's just a part of their gimmick. Having said that, they do make a fearsome team. To echo Retsarra, you'll need to be ready for their coordinated attacks.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_205: Once you've dealt with them, you'll be just one bout away from becoming grand champion. So get out there, and give those gym-wreckers what for! We'll see who's the one who wipes out!
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_210: The brothers love to perform outrageous stunts, and one time they used up so many souls to revive themselves, they were roundly criticized for squandering resources. Which is to reiterate the need to be careful. Their recklessness makes them all the more dangerous.
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_220: You did it again, ! Even together, the brothers were no match for you!
TEXT_KINGRA303_05437_YAANA_000_221: Hehe, seeing you humble those smug thugs really made my day. Serves them right for making a mess of my gym!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_000: With this, you've earned your title shot against the grand champion! You'll need to be more prepared than ever for that bout, but for now a good rest is in order. Let's head back to the gym.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_EXCITABLEMAN_000_10: First Vamp Fatale, now both the Xtremes at once! You're incredible!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_EXCITABLEBOY_000_10: I knew you'd beat those bullies, ! You looked so cool out there!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_VAMPFATALE_000_103: How will you fare when you have no simulacra at your disposal?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_105: (-Dignified Warrior-)Honorless curs. You are a blight upon the Arcadion. Begone from my sight!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_ARCADIONFANA_000_10: It's the Tyrant! What's the grand champion doing here!?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_107: Put up your weapon, challenger. A true warrior does not engage  opponent outside the sacred ring.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_108: I am the grand champion of the Ascension Arcadia Championship.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_109: And I know all about you, upstart. You think yourself a babyface who brings change, but to me, you are a heel who would tear down our traditions.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_ARCADIONFANC_000_11: That's right! You're nothing but a villain!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_111: If you are resolved to destroy the Arcadion as we know it, it is only meet that you understand how it came to be. Listen well.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_112: It all began with the president's ancestor. The man was a noble in the kingdom of Lindblum, known for his love and patronage of the theatrical arts.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_113: When the Storm Surge came to a head, he was forced to flee his homeland. For years he wandered the endless wastes until, in desperation, he sought refuge here, in the enemy nation of Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_114: To his great surprise, the Alexandrians welcomed him with open arms. And in the sight of them toiling hand in hand to build new lives, he saw a vision of that ancient paradise of myth─Arcadia.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_115: He longed to repay the kindness he had received, and at length found the answer in the fighting contests that the people enjoyed in secret as a diversion.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_116: Using the riches he had brought with him, he created a new form of entertainment─one that blends thrilling fights and gripping theatrics. Thus was the Arcadion born.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_117: Alas, it did not endure in its original iteration. As survival grew more challenging, it became increasingly difficult to host matches. Eventually, they ceased to be held altogether, and the Arcadion was all but forgotten.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_118: The years passed. Advancements in electrope brought stability, and the advent of soul technology a sense of security. For the first time in generations, Alexandrians experienced tedium.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_119: Wishing to provide the excitement they craved, the president revived the Arcadion, and held matches that pitted recreated simulacra against each other.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_120: And when the people clamored for fiercer fights, he satisfied them by introducing the use of feral souls. In this way did the Arcadion rise up to become the premier form of entertainment in Alexandria and a pillar of our culture.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_121: This is the Arcadion's history─the legacy that lives on in its sacred halls. This is what you seek to destroy!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_122: Feral souls are the very soul of we fighters, and we will not allow an outsider to dictate our culture and take them from us!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_ARCADIONFANA_000_12: Hear, hear! All hail the Tyrant! The one true king of the Arcadion!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_A1_000_001: You can satisfy people even unenhanced.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_A1_000_002: Feral souls obfuscate the true splendor of battle.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_UNENHANCEDWARRIORFA: That's right!  has shown us how exciting unenhanced battles can be!
Exactly! More than a spectacle, I want to see a real fight! That's where the excitement lies!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THETYRANT_000_126: You may have garnered attention for fighting unenhanced, but in the end you are naught more than a heel intended to create excitement. It is your fate to fall.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_127: As you saw for yourself, the Tyrant's a force to be reckoned with even when not using a feral soul. What's more, as grand champion, he has free access to the soul repository, and can choose the best soul for each opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_128: That makes it hard to offer advice. If only we knew which soul he'd use, we'd have something to work with...
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_129: Anyway, let's get back to the gym. I'm anxious how the rescue mission went...
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_140: Retsarra and the others haven't returned yet. I hope they're alright...
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: I'm sorry. We weren't able to rescue Eutrope.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_HONEYBLOVELY_000_15: We found Neyuni in the reception hall, but there was no sign of Eutrope─and no time to search for her.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_NEYUNI_000_154: The kidnappers removed Eutrope's regulator when they abducted us. And then they took her somewhere else.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_155: R-Removed her regulator? Oh no... That's what they do to the immortalized...
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_DANCINGGREEN_000_15: C'mon now, don't lose heart yet.
Times like this, you gotta keep on groovin'!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SUGARRIOT_000_158: Have some tact, will you? We're talking about their sister!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_159: No, he's right. Now isn't the time to be fearing the worst. It's already a blessing that Neyuni is safe and sound.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_160: Still, I doubt the president will sit idly by in response. I worry what he might do next...
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: You can rest easy on that front. We actually have a collaborator on the inside.
We approached him without expectation, and were pleasantly surprised when he agreed to help. He's contrived to make it so the president doesn't learn of our foray in a hurry.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: Furthermore, Metem has an idea of where Eutrope might be. He promised he would see her safely returned.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_163: Metem did all that? Perhaps I misjudged him...
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_A3_000_002: He might be the president's pawn.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_100_164: I feel uneasy too, to be honest. But right now, we don't have any other choice but to trust him.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_NEYUNI_000_164: Oh, right! I have some good news, too. While I was locked away in the reception hall, I was able to access a terminal, and retrieved some useful information.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_NEYUNI_000_165: That is, the Tyrant's data! In the upcoming title match, he intends to use the soul of a behemoth!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_166: Neyuni, that's amazing!  will have a much better chance now thanks to you!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_167: I expect the preparations for the match will be finished soon, so let's head to the Arcadion. We can discuss the fight in detail there.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: It'll be over soon, once Eutrope has been freed and you've become grand champion. No one will fight with feral souls again, and those afflicted with psychonekrosis can be cured.
As before, we're counting on you, . We'll all be praying for your triumph!
It seems Pomb wants to join you. Perhaps she thinks Hector will be at the Arcadion...
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_171: Maybe she wants to cheer  on as well. Let's bring her along, eh?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: While we trust in Metem to keep his word, you must focus wholly on the title match. Become the grand champion, , and free all the souls in the repository─for Hector not least of all!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_NEYUNI_000_181: If the president is descended from Lindblum nobility, it makes sense that he knows about the cure for psychonekrosis. If you can defeat the Tyrant, then we can save everyone!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_HONEYBLOVELY_000_18: The Arcadion is Alexandria's biggest stage, and I'm counting on your victory to make a dazzling comeback. Don't let me down, or I shall have to sting you!♪
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_DANCINGGREEN_000_18: Anxious about the title match? You've got this, baby. Just relax and enjoy yourself, and before you know it, you'll be dancin' the night away at your victory party!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SUGARRIOT_000_184: An image comes to me! You're being crowned grand champion, and everyone you've saved are all there celebrating!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_190: Right, let's make our way to the Arcadion. Given the huge publicity surrounding the match, there's bound to be some fans along the way.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_191: Why not take a moment to talk to them? I expect they'll have some words of encouragement for you!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_200: Next time you walk these streets, you'll be the grand champion. I'm sure of it!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SYSTEM_000_202: Judging by her spirited mewing, Pomb is eager to get to the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SYSTEM_000_210: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_211: What!? An urgent matter at a time like this!? Fine, we'll wait for you back at the gym─but try to be quick about it!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_220: Ah, there you are! Let's get going!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SYSTEM_000_230: You must be accompanied by Yaana and Pomb, and have them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_SYSTEM_000_231: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_UNENHANCEDWARRIORFA: ! I can't believe your heavyweight title match is already happening! Ah, but isn't Yaana with you?
Th-The unstoppable upstart is speaking to me! But wait, where's your second? Aren't you heading to the ring yet?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_EXCITABLEBOY_100_23: You can do it, ! You can beat the Tyrant! Oh, but where's Yaana...?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_ARCADIAATTENDANT_10: Greetings, . When your second, Yaana, arrives, I will show the two of you to the greenroom.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_UNENHANCEDWARRIORFA: ! I can't believe your heavyweight title match is already happening! I have every faith you'll win and usher in a new era for the Arcadion!
Now that we are connected to the outside world, our society has begun to change. It's only natural that the Arcadion changes as well.
Th-The unstoppable upstart is speaking to me! What an honor this is!
Truth be told, I lost someone dear to me in the recent attacks. But as I was wallowing in grief, I saw you facing your foes entirely unenhanced, and it gave me the courage to carry on.
I'm not the only one either. There are many others like me who are inspired by your unfaltering figure in the ring, and to see you become grand champion would be the greatest inspiration of all!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_EXCITABLEBOY_000_24: You can do it, ! You can beat the Tyrant and become the grand champion!
When I grow up, I'm going to become a fighter like you! Then we can form a tag team together and teach the bad guys a lesson!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_249: Hehe, hearing from the fans really fires you up, doesn't it? They inspire you as much as you inspire them. Come on, let's continue on to the greenroom.
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_UNENHANCEDWARRIORFA: I have faith that you'll win, and change the Arcadion for the better!
You've inspired me and many with your courage, . And if you become grand champion, that would be the greatest inspiration of all!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_EXCITABLEBOY_000_25: You can do it, ! You can beat the Tyrant and become the grand champion!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_EXCITABLEFATHER_000: My son and I will be praying for your victory with all our hearts!
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_YAANA_000_261: She wants to cheer  on. That's not a problem, is it?
TEXT_KINGRA304_05438_ARCADIAATTENDANT_00: No, certainly not. If you would please follow me.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_SYSTEM_100_001: Pomb mews forlornly at the door...
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_000: Well, here we finally are: the heavyweight title match. I'm starting to feel a little nervous, I have to admit...
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_100: Seems she wants to find her master, just like Retsarra said. It's heartbreaking...
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_101: Right, better focus. I suppose this'll be the last time for this, but let's take a look at your opponent.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_102: The reigning grand champion of the Arcadion─the Tyrant!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_103: Prior to becoming a fighter, he was a peerless hunter renowned for his mastery of all weaponry. In the ring, he wields an arsenal of arms, and freely switches between them as the situation demands.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_104: Based on the information Neyuni found, he'll be using the soul of a behemoth, a fell beast that possesses terrible strength and magicks.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_105: In addition to powerful physical attacks, he'll unleash devastating whirlwinds and meteors. More than ever, you'll have to take care.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_106: Now, go out there and win one last time! Claim the title, and usher in a new era for the Arcadion─one where lives aren't sacrificed for entertainment!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_110: As your second, there is nothing left for me to do but cheer you on to victory...which I'm sure we'll be celebrating very soon!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_200: has deposed the Tyrant to rise up as the grand champion...
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_201: Oh? What brings the referee out now?
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_20: (-Familiar Voice-)I'm pleased to see I was not mistaken about you.
None other, though this is obviously not my true form. I am in my quarters on the uppermost floor.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_205: A deal's a deal! Tell us where the Drop of Life is!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_20: It is here with me. Come─I shall give it to you. You have earned a personal audience.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_207: The Drop of Life...? I haven't the faintest what this is about, but I'd better take a camera to capture these events!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_21: The Lindwurm, legendary serpent of eld and namesake of my homeland. By infusing myself with its soul, I have come to assume this form.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_212: Th-The president has become this terrifying creature!?
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_213: And those people... Why, they're the immortalized!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_100_214: M-Metem, why is she... You promised you would save her!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_100_215: I'm truly sorry, but it seems he was one step ahead of us...
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_100_21: You have served me well, Metem. But I have long been aware of your duplicity.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_21: Arrayed behind me are all the fighters who have been immortalized. With each feral transformation, their souls were ravaged until they ultimately met their demise. A pitiable fate.
They shall make a fitting audience for the final act, here in this faithfully recreated Lindblum theater.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_217: To use the bodies of the departed as a decoration... This is pure depravity...
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_21: People of Alexandria. In my mission to bring you ever more thrilling entertainment, I have given my very body and soul.
I acquired the power of the mighty Lindwurm, and thence sought to create fighters who could offer me fierce contest. Alas, all died prematurely, taken by a soul-consuming affliction.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_22: But at last they may know peace, for the one I have long awaited has appeared.
With the actors thus assembled, the greatest show in Arcadion history may finally begin! In feverish highs shall all sorrow and tedium be swept away!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_223: This is unconscionable! How could the president do such a thing simply for entertainment!?
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_22: Unenhanced warrior. Know that you have merely become heavyweight champion. If you wish to be crowned the true grand champion, you must now defeat me!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_A1_000_001: I'll defeat you, don't you worry!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_A1_000_002: I'll send you slithering back to your hole!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIAOWNER_000_22: That's the spirit. See to it that you spare no preparation. Nothing short of perfection will suffice for our performance.
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_METEM_000_226: A shocking truth has been revealed, and the final match has been set! How will this harrowing tale conclude!?
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_ARCADIONFANA_000_23: To think that the fighters were dying from using feral souls...
The Arcadion was my escape. But if I'd known the price for it...
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_EXCITABLEMAN_100_23: If this is the way it is, then our only hope is for the unstoppable upstart to win!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_UNENHANCEDWARRIORFA: That's right! Let's all cheer  on against the evil president!
TEXT_KINGRA305_05439_YAANA_000_250: <sob> Not you too, Eutrope... Not you too...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SYSTEM_100_001: As before, Pomb mews somberly in front of the doors...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_000: Deep down, I'd feared we might be too late. I'd steeled myself for the worst. But the reality was too much to bear...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_001: When I saw how the president had exploited my sister and all those others, I tried to use a feral soul without thinking.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_002: I want nothing more than to fight with you, but I know I'd only hold you back. And I'd be a fool to tempt fate again with a feral soul.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_003: In his twisted mind, the president might think this is just a show. But to me, this is a reckoning. For Eutrope and all the fallen fighters, bring that monster to justice, !
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_010: This “Lindwurm” is a complete mystery, so I can't offer you any meaningful advice.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_011: But you're the grand champion for a reason, . You've bested every opponent you've faced, and I'm sure you can best this fiend too!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_100: You did it, ! Just as I thought you would!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_101: Now, tell us where the Drop of Life is! We won't allow anyone else to die!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_102: That which you seek lies before you. The aether yielded by the Lindwurm's heart is the stimulant for the regeneration factor.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_103: Now, set aside your grief, for Eutrope and the other fighters have not perished. Everyone can still be saved. Everyone, except the president...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_105: Everything has been part of the president's plan to produce the cure to psychonekrosis.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_106: When the first fighter was diagnosed with the disease, the president was utterly shaken. He cursed himself for ever introducing the use of feral souls.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_107: Determined to find a cure, he turned to the treasure that had been passed down through his line: the egg of a Lindwurm, a creature known for its phenomenal regenerative abilities.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_108: After much experimentation, he ultimately extracted the soul of the unborn beast and took it into himself. And though he transformed into a monstrosity possessed of preternatural regeneration, he sadly could not use his power to heal others.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_109: To make matters worse, that power meant he was forever locked in its serpentine form. So it was that he was forced to confine himself to this mausoleum.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_110: For a small blessing, his regulator still allowed him control over the Arcadion's devices, and he could remotely operate machinery.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_111: That was how he was able to make contact with me and convey his intent: to sacrifice himself, and have the cure made from his heart.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_112: Alas, the Lindwurm was too powerful. Even the Tyrant proved no match, and the Arcadion remained in operation as the search continued for a warrior capable of defeating him.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_113: Those fighters who developed psychonekrosis had to be retired and put into a deep sleep─a cold stasis to keep the disease at bay until they could be cured. It was for this reason that Eutrope was kidnapped. The president lamented subjecting more souls to the disease, but for want of other solutions, he could only press on with his plan.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_114: If that's the truth, then why didn't you tell us!?
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_115: The president was nothing if not a showman. He dedicated his regrets, his desire for atonement, and indeed his very life, to bring greater thrills to the masses.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_100_115: In so doing, he would promote fiercer competition and give rise to ever stronger fighters, one of whom he hoped would rise up to challenge him.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_116: It was to keep the competition running that the disease was kept secret. And though many fighters showed promise, it seemed as though none would ever transcend the Tyrant.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_117: That is, until you appeared. From the moment he saw you, the president was certain that you'd be the one to defeat him.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_100_117: All he needed to do was to spur you on. And to do so, he cast you as a rebel who would tear down the Arcadion, and himself as the greatest heel it has ever known.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_100_118: The man couldn't help but turn everything into a spectacle. It's so absurd, one can't help but admire it...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_118: So this entire time, we've been puppets in the president's play?
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_BRUTEBOMBER_000_124: The questions can wait. Right now, I need you all to channel me your aether!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_128: We need to finish him now!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_THETYRANT_000_129: (-???-)You've fought well, champion. Leave the rest to us.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_THETYRANT_000_130: The president confided in us long ago. We've been acting according to his instructions.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_THETYRANT_200_130: It was my duty to serve as the challenger's final test...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_THETYRANT_100_130: And to ensure their hands would not be sullied!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_ARCADIAOWNER_000_13: It was the battle of a lifetime... Even without feral souls, the Arcadion's future is bright...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: (-Retsarra-)Hector, I thought you were gone... That you'd died after becoming that fiend...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_BRUTEBOMBER_000_133: I'd thought the same. But then I woke up, and I was myself again.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_BRUTEBOMBER_000_134: Metem explained everything after that. The president had given me less-potent souls for the bout, and then his people restored me back to normal.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_BRUTEBOMBER_000_135: I've been resting in the Arcadion's infirmary ever since. But when I saw what was happening on the broadcast, nothing could keep me from coming to help.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_136: I-I might've pushed myself too hard... Forgot I had this...little disease...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_137: R-Right, that! We should move everyone to the infirmary immediately and have the cure created!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_138: I shall personally tend to matters from here. Every soul will be saved, I give you my word!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_HONEYBLOVELY_000_15: I have to say I'm a mite miffed that Brute stole the spotlight, but I'm glad everyone is safe!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_DANCINGGREEN_000_15: Heh, had a feeling it'd play out like this. For all his quirks, I knew the old man couldn't truly've been a villain!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_SUGARRIOT_000_152: Try not to encourage the verdant dancer. He's already insufferably smug enough as it is.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_NEYUNI_000_200: I watched the broadcast from start to finish! You were absolutely amazing, !
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_NEYUNI_100_200: Though it's taken some time, you've inspired me to change my view towards souls. Like Yaana, I've decided to remove my regulator as well.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_NEYUNI_000_201: By the way, some people from the Arcadion dropped by earlier to apologize for the president's deception. They even helped fix up the gym.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_NEYUNI_000_202: It's been quite a whirlwind of events, but it seems the worst is over. All that remains is to pray that everyone is cured...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_300: I'm pleased to say the treatment was effective! Everyone has made a full recovery from psychonekrosis!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_301: The symptoms are completely gone! I feel like myself again thanks to the cure─and of course to you as well, !
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_EUTROPE_000_302: Yaana has told me all. Words do not suffice to show my gratitude...but please accept my thanks.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_THEHOWLINGBLADE_000: Before setting off for their homes, the heavyweight fighters and those who were in stasis also expressed their heartfelt gratitude for you.
And it'd be remiss of me not to do the same. Thank you, .
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_307: I, meanwhile, must apologize to everyone. Though it was to conceal the president's plan, the fact remains that I deceived you.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_A1_000_003: And here I thought you were the true mastermind...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_309: Ahhh, those words mean more to me than you can know... There were times when I felt I would be crushed by the weight of the deception...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_310: O-Oh dear! Have mercy, I beg you! The fighters are all hale and whole─surely you can find it in your heart to forgive me?
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_311: Me, the mastermind? You give me too much credit. I've not the imagination to conceive such an audacious plan.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_100_311: That said, I did work behind the scenes to ensure all went according to script. In light of this, perhaps I could be considered the mastermind.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_312: In the end, everything is as the president had hoped. Wherever he is now, he too would doubtless be overjoyed...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_BRUTEBOMBER_100_313: He sacrificed himself to save us all... Another debt I can never repay.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_100_314: The president actually had one last wish: that those who still bear love for the Arcadion, even after everything, continue to fight and bring excitement to the fans.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_THEHOWLINGBLADE_100: Heh, he really had us all figured out. It's as if we're still dancing in the palm of his hand.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_313: Ah, lest you wonder, I've arranged for the souls in the repository to be set free as you desired. Never again shall feral souls be wielded in the Arcadion.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_314: From now on, matches will only be fought between unenhanced warriors. The upstart's revolution was a success.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_315: This means, however, that there are none at present who could offer you contest. Until our fighters have become strong enough, I'm afraid we won't have any matches for you.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_A2_000_001: I was looking forward to defending my title...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_A2_000_002: I'm sure that day will come soon.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_316: I think I speak for everyone when I say I'd love to face you unenhanced. I won't stop training until I'm ready!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_317: Now then, there is to be a crowning ceremony for the new grand champion.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_318: Naturally, it can't begin without you, so pray come to the greenroom at your earliest convenience!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_350: The ceremony will be held in the very ring we fought in. It wasn't all that long ago, yet somehow it feels like an age...
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_351: But come, everyone's already out there waiting. Make sure you're dressed for the occasion, because all of Alexandria will be watching!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_Q3_000_000: Begin the ceremony in your current attire?
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_400: My fellow citizens! We are gathered to recognize a new grand champion in the Arcadion─an unstoppable force of nature who tore through every obstacle in  way!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_401: Please join me in welcoming this radiant star to the stage!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_402: The  who boldly ushered in revolution, the unenhanced-yet-undefeated  of the Arcadion, !
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_BRUTEBOMBER_000_404: (-Hoarse Voice-)It's a farce that you're grand champion! I refuse to accept it!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_405: Oh my! The Brute Bomber has barged into 's ceremony again! Does the man never learn!?
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_BRUTEBOMBER_000_406: I demand a rematch! Just you and me, unenhanced!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_408: Watching you get tossed aside by  would hardly be entertaining! I'll be your opponent!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_409: Black Cat has leapt into the ring! I daresay this should be an even match!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_410: With the president no longer with us, it falls to my humble self to authorize matches!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_411: And on this occasion, I am pleased to approve an impromptu exhibition!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_412: Let this be the clash to christen the Arcadion's rebirth!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_413: She's the claw that gleams in revolution's shadow! The rebel that prowls the dark, Black Cat!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_METEM_000_414: He's the man who's been to hell and lived to tell the tale! The incorrigible, reprehensible Brute Bomber!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_500: Hehe, I did it! I beat the Brute Bomber!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_501: Sorry for spoiling your moment with that charade, but we wanted to kick off the new era of the Arcadion with a bang. Metem came up with a last-minute script, and I agreed to join in.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_502: Retired fighters have been returning as well, eager to fight in unenhanced matches. We're all going to do our part to keep the Arcadion exciting.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_100_502: And as you may've already noticed, everyone's decided to remove their regulator. That's because we won't be needing souls anymore, feral or otherwise.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_503: Meanwhile, since you have no equal, you've been granted the title of eternal grand champion and entered into the Hall of Fame. You're already a legend, basically!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_504: Now, though you may not be able to fight, we'd still love to see you. So don't be a stranger, and drop by at my gym or the greenroom from time to time!
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_505: As much as I hate to admit it, we played into the president's hands from the start. But it was only because you were the protagonist of his script that we could bring the tale to a happy conclusion.
TEXT_KINGRA306_05440_YAANA_000_506: We truly couldn't have done it without you, our unenhanced grand champion, so please allow me to thank you again. We're forever in your debt!
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_LANDSGUARD05326_000: Welcome back, . You'll be happy to know the guard remains on high alert in the event any echoes appear in Yak T'el.
As of now, there have been no reported sightings. We did, however, recently receive a missive from Kikwezana.
He's finished conducting his tests with Prishe and requests an audience. Bakool Ja Ja has already left to meet with him.
I can only assume you wish to be present to hear the results, so I would suggest you make for the outskirts at once.
I expect Kikwezana is waiting for your arrival to share the results of his research, so best not to keep them waiting overlong.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_BAKOOLJAJA_000_010: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I thought you might come. You're just in time to hear what Kikwezana's learned of Alxaal and Prishe.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_PRISHE_000_015: There's still a lot I'd like to see, both in and outside of the dome, but first I've got to know what Kikwezana's found out.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_ALXAAL_000_020: Kikwezana was a most hospitable host during our time in Solution Nine. The dining establishments he took us to were most unusual, but the meals were surprisingly delicious.
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_BAKOOLJAJA_000_101: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)So, what have you learned?
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_KIKWEZANA_000_102: After a thorough examination of Prishe and Alxaal, we discovered that... Erm...
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_PRISHE_000_103: Spit it out, already! You've made your point that we're not really living. How bad could it be?
TEXT_KINGEA301_05479_KIKWEZANA_000_104: Yes, as you say. You are indeed artificial life-forms, each possessed of an electrope core.
